lines.english: Those who praise You gather the wealth in their laps; this is Nanak's wealth.
lines.transliteration: tuDh saalaahan t in Dhan palai naanak kaa Dh an so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ਚੰਿਗਆਈ  ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਫਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever shows respect to them is not summoned by the Messenger of Death. ||4||3|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1328-8) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay ko jee-o kahai onaa ka-o jam kee talab na ho-ee. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਤੀਆ  ਚੰਿਗਆਈਆ  ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: One who has no beauty, no social status, no mouth, no flesh
lines.transliteration: jaa kai roop naahee jaat naahee naahee mukh  maasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਨ  ਿਤਨ  ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satgur milay niranjan paa-i-aa t ayrai naam hai nivaasaa. ||1|| - meeting with the True Guru, he finds the Immaculate Lord, and dwells in YourName. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ  ਕਹੈ ਓਨਾ  ਕਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: O detached Yogi, contemplate the essence of reality,
lines.transliteration: a-oDhoo sehjay t at beechaar.
jaa tay fir na aavhu saisaar. ||1|| rahaa-o. and you shall never again come to be born into the world. ||1||Pause||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੁਖੁ ਮਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: One who does not have good karma or Dharmic faith, sacred rosary or mala
lines.transliteration: jaa kai karam naahee Dharam naahee naahee such maalaa.
siv jot kannahu buDh  paa-ee sat guroo rakh vaalaa. ||2|| - through the Light of God, wisdom is bestowed; the True Guru is our Protector. ||2||

lines.english: One who does not observe any fasts, make religious vows or chant
lines.transliteration: jaa kai barat naahee naym naahee naahee bakbaa-ee.

lines.english: True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gat avgat  kee chint  naahee sat guroo furmaa-ee. ||3|| - he does not have to worry about good luck or bad, if he obeys the Command of the

lines.english: One who is not hopeful, nor hopeless, who has trained his intuitive consciousness
lines.transliteration: jaa kai aas naahee niraas naahee chit surat  samjh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸੁਿਚ ਮਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tant ka-o param t ant mili-aa naankaa buDh  paa-ee. ||4||4|| - his being blends with the Supreme Being. O Nanak, his awareness is awakened.||4||4|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1328-14) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਵ ਜੋਿਤ  ਕੰਨਹੁ ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਰਖਵਾਲਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: What he says is approved in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: taa kaa kahi-aa d ar parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਰਤੁ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਨੇਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਬਕਬਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: He looks upon poison and nectar as one and the same. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bikh amrit  du-ay sam kar jaan . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਤ  ਅਵਗਿਤ  ਕੀ ਿਚੰਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਫੁਰਮਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: What can I say? You are permeating and pervading all.
lines.transliteration: ki-aa kahee-ai sarbay rahi-aa samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਸ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਨਰਾਸ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਸਮਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever happens, is all by Your Will. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh vart ai sabh  tayree rajaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ  ਤੰਤੁ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਬੁਿਧ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: The Divine Light shines radiantly, and egotistical pride is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: pargatee jot chookaa abh imaan.

lines.english: The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur d ee-aa amrit  naam. ||2||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, one's birth is approved,
lines.transliteration: kal meh aa-i-aa so jan jaan.
saachee dargeh paavai maan . ||3|| if one is honored in the True Court. ||3||

lines.english: Speaking and listening, one goes to the Celestial Home of the Indescribable Lord.
lines.transliteration: kahnaa sunn aa akath gh ar jaa-ay.

lines.english: Mere words of mouth, O Nanak, are burnt away. ||4||5|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1328-18) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kathnee badnee naanak jal jaa-ay. ||4||5||

lines.english: One who bathes in the Ambrosial Water of spiritual wisdom takes with him the virtues of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: amrit neer gi-aan man majan ath sath tirath sang gahay.

lines.english: The Guru's Teachings are the gems and jewels; the Sikh who serves Him searchesand finds them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur updays javaahar maan ak sayvay sikh  so kh oj lahai. ||1||

lines.english: There is no sacred shrine equal to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur samaan tirath nahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਮਿਹ ਆਇਆ  ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru encompasses the ocean of contentment. ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1329
lines.transliteration: sar santokh  taas gur ho-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Guru is the River, from which the Pure Water is obtained forever; it washes away the filth and pollution of evil-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: gur daree-aa-o sad aa jal nirmal mili-aa d urmat  mail harai.

lines.english: Finding the True Guru, the perfect cleansing bath is obtained, which transforms evenbeasts and ghosts into gods. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur paa-i-ai pooraa naavan  pasoo parayt ahu d ayv karai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ  ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥
lines.english: He is said to be the Guru, with the scent of sandalwood, who is imbued with the TrueName to the bottom of His Heart.
lines.transliteration: rataa sach naam t al hee-al so gur parmal kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਪਾਇਐ  ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਦੇਵ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: By His Fragrance, the world of vegetation is perfumed. Lovingly focus yourself on HisFeet. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa kee vaas banaaspat sa-urai t aas charan  liv rahee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਾ ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਲ ਹੀਅਲੁ  ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ  ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The life of the soul wells up for the Gurmukh; the Gurmukh goes to the House of God.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jee-a paraan upjahi gurmukh  siv gh ar jaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਨਾਸਪਿਤ  ਸਉਰੈ  ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣ  ਿਲਵ ਰਹੀਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, merges in the True One; the Gurmukh attains the exaltedstate of the self. ||4||6|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1329-4) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak sach samaa-ee-ai gurmukh  nij pad  paa-ee-ai. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਉਪਜਿਹ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਸਵ ਘਿਰ ਜਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, contemplate spiritual knowledge; read it and study it, and you shall be honored.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee vidi-aa veechaarai parh  parh paavai maan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਨਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Within the self, the self is revealed, when one is blessed with the Ambrosial Naam, theName of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapaa maDhay aap pargaasi-aa paa-i-aa amrit  naam. ||1||

lines.english: O Creator Lord, You alone are my Benefactor.
lines.transliteration: kartaa t oo mayraa jajmaan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਿਵਿਦਆ  ਵੀਚਾਰੈ  ਪਿੜ ਪਿੜ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: I beg for only one blessing from You: please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ik dakh inaa ha-o t ai peh maaga-o d eh aapn aa naam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਾ  ਮਧੇ ਆਪੁ  ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The five wandering thieves are captured and held, and the egotistical pride of themind is subdued.
lines.transliteration: panch taskar Dh aavat  raakh ay chookaa man abh imaan.

lines.english: Visions of corruption, vice and evil-mindedness run away. Such is the spiritual wisdomof God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: disat bikaaree d urmat  bhaagee aisaa barahm gi-aan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਦਿਖਣਾ  ਹਉ ਤੈ ਪਿਹ ਮਾਗਉ  ਦੇਿਹ ਆਪਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please bless me with the rice of truth and self-restraint, the wheat of compassion, andthe leaf-plate of meditation.
lines.transliteration: jat sat  chaaval d a-i-aa kan ak kar paraapat  paatee Dh aan.

lines.english: Bless me with the milk of good karma, and the clarified butter, the ghee, of compassion. Such are the gifts I beg of You, Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dooDh  karam sant okh ghee-o kar aisaa maaNga-o d aan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ  ਧਾਵਤ  ਰਾਖੇ ਚੂਕਾ  ਮਿਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Let forgiveness and patience be my milk-cows, and let the calf of my mind intuitivelydrink in this milk.
lines.transliteration: khimaa Dh eeraj kar ga-oo lavayree sehjay bachh raa kh eer pee-ai.

lines.english: I beg for the clothes of modesty and the Lord's Praise; Nanak chants the GloriousPraises of the Lord. ||4||7|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1329-10) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sifat saram kaa kaprh aa maaNga-o har gun  naanak ravat  rahai. ||4||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਚਾਵਲ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਣਕ  ਕਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਾਪਿਤ  ਪਾਤੀ  ਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: No one can hold anyone back from coming; how could anyone hold anyone back fromgoing?
lines.transliteration: aavat kinai na raakh i-aa jaavat  ki-o raakh i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮੁ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਘੀਉ  ਕਿਰ ਐਸਾ ਮਗਉ  ਦਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He alone thoroughly understands this, from whom all beings come; all are mergedand immersed in Him. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jis tay ho-aa so-ee par jaan ai jaaN us hee maahi samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਮਾ  ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਿਰ  ਗਊ ਲਵੇਰੀ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਬਛਰਾ  ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Waaho! - You are Great, and Wondrous is Your Will.
lines.transliteration: toohai hai vaahu t ayree rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਫਿਤ  ਸਰਮ  ਕਾ ਕਪੜਾ ਮਗਉ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਵਤੁ  ਰਹੈ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.english: Whatever You do, surely comes to pass. Nothing else can happen. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karahi so-ee par ho-ibaa avar na karn aa jaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The buckets on the chain of the Persian wheel rotate; one empties out to fill another.
lines.transliteration: jaisay harhat kee maalaa tind lagat hai ik sakh nee hor fayr bh aree-at  hai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤੁ  ਿਕਨੈ ਨ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਜਾਵਤੁ  ਿਕਉ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This is just like the Play of our Lord and Master; such is His Glorious Greatness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: taiso hee ih kh ayl kh asam kaa ji-o us kee vadi-aa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ  ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ  ਜ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Following the path of intuitive awareness, one turns away from the world, and one's vision is enlightened.
lines.transliteration: surtee kai maarag chal kai ultee nad ar pargaasee.

lines.english: Contemplate this in your mind, and see, O spiritual teacher. Who is the householder,and who is the renunciate? ||3||
lines.transliteration: man veechaar daykh  barahm gi-aanee ka-un girhee ka-un ud aasee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਇਬਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Hope comes from the Lord; surrendering to Him, we remain in the state of nirvaanaa.
lines.transliteration: jis kee aasaa tis hee sa-up kai ayhu rahi-aa nirbaan .

lines.english: We come from Him; surrendering to Him, O Nanak, one is approved as a householder,and a renunciate. ||4||8|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1329-16) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis tay ho-aa so-ee kar maani-aa naanak girhee ud aasee so parvaan . ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਹਟ  ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ  ਿਟੰਡ ਲਗਤ  ਹੈ ਇਕ ਸਖਨੀ  ਹੋਰ ਫੇਰ ਭਰੀਅਤ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that one who binds in bondage his evil and corrupted gaze.
lines.transliteration: disat bikaaree banDh an baaNDhai ha-o t is kai bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਿਜਉ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: One who does not know the difference between vice and virtue wanders arounduselessly. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paap punn kee saar na jaanai bh oolaa firai ajaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਰਤੀ  ਕੈ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਚਿਲ  ਕੈ ਉਲਟੀ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Speak the True Name of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: bolhu sach naam kartaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਦੇਖੁ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਕਉਨੁ ਿਗਰਹੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Then, you shall never again have to come into this world. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: fun bahurh na aavan  vaar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਸਉਿਪ  ਕੈ ਏਹੁ ਰਿਹਆ  ਿਨਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator transforms the high into the low, and makes the lowly into kings.
lines.transliteration: oochaa tay fun neech karat  hai neech karai sult aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ  ਸੋਈ ਕਿਰ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਗਰਹੀ  ਉਦਾਸੀ  ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.english: Those who know the All-knowing Lord are approved and certified as perfect in this world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jinee jaan sujaan i-aa jag t ay pooray parvaan . ||2||

lines.english: If anyone is mistaken and fooled, you should go to instruct him. pMnw 1330
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o samjh aavan  jaa-ee-ai jay ko bh oolaa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ  ਐਸਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself plays all the games; only a few understand this. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay khayl karay sabh  kartaa aisaa boojh ai ko-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਪਰ੍ਭਾਤੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਛੋਡਹੁ ਦੁਨੀ  ਪਰੀਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Name, and the Word of the Shabad, in the early hours before dawn; leave your worldly entanglements behind.
lines.transliteration: naa-o parbhaat ai sabad  Dhi-aa-ee-ai chh odahu d unee pareet aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸਿਨ  ਦਾਸਾ  ਜਿਗ  ਹਾਿਰਆ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਜੀਤਾ  ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, the slave of God's slaves: the world loses, and he wins. ||4||9|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1330-2) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak d aasan d aasaa jag haari-aa t in jeet aa. ||4||9||

lines.english: The mind is Maya, the mind is a chaser; the mind is a bird flying across the sky.
lines.transliteration: man maa-i-aa man Dhaa-i-aa man pankh ee aakaas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਕਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: The thieves are overpowered by the Shabad, and then the body-village prospers and celebrates.
lines.transliteration: taskar sabad  nivaari-aa nagar vuth aa saabaas.

lines.english: Lord, when You save someone, he is saved; his capital is safe and sound. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jaa too raakh ahi raakh  laihi saabat  hovai raas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਹ ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੈਿਹ ਸਾਬਤੁ  ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Such is my Treasure, the Jewel of the Naam;
lines.transliteration: aisaa naam ratan niDh  mayrai.
gurmat d eh laga-o pag t ayrai. ||1|| rahaa-o. please bless me with the Guru's Teachings, so that I may fall at Your Feet.||1||Pause||

lines.english: The mind is a Yogi, the mind is a pleasure-seeker; the mind is foolish and ignorant.
lines.transliteration: man jogee man bhogee-aa man moorakh  gaavaar.

lines.english: The mind is the giver, the mind is the beggar; the mind is the Great Guru, theCreator.
lines.transliteration: man daat aa man mangt aa man sir gur kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ  ਮਨੁ ਭੋਗੀਆ  ਮਨੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The five thieves are conquered, and peace is attained; such is the contemplativewisdom of God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: panch maar sukh paa-i-aa aisaa barahm veechaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮੰਗਤਾ  ਮਨ ਿਸਿਰ  ਗੁ ਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is said to be in each and every heart, but no one can see Him.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ayk vakh aanee-ai kaha-o na d aykhi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਿਰ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਐਸਾ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The false are cast upside-down into the womb of reincarnation; without the Name,they lose their honor.
lines.transliteration: khoto pooth o raalee-ai bin naavai pat  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ  ਕਹਉ  ਨ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom You unite, remain united, if it is Your Will. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaa too mayleh t aa mil rahaaN jaaN tayree ho-ay rajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਟੋ ਪੂਠੋ ਰਾਲੀਐ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿਤ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: God does not ask about social class or birth; you must find your true home.
lines.transliteration: jaat janam nah poochh ee-ai sach gh ar layho bat aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿਹ  ਤਾ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹ ਜ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That is your social class and that is your status - the karma of what you have done.
lines.transliteration: saa jaat saa pat  hai jayhay karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਤ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਨਹ ਪੂਛੀਐ  ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of death and rebirth are eradicated; O Nanak, salvation is in the Lord's Name. ||4||10|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1330-9) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh  kaatee-ai naanak chh ootas naa-ay. ||4||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾ ਜਾਿਤ  ਸਾ ਪਿਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He is awake, and even happy, but he is being plundered - he is blind!
lines.transliteration: jaagat bigsai mooth o anDh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਛੂਟਿਸ  ਨਾਇ  ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The noose is around his neck, and yet, his head is busy with worldly affairs.
lines.transliteration: gal faahee sir maaray DhanDh aa.

lines.english: In hope, he comes and in desire, he leaves.
lines.transliteration: aasaa aavai mansaa jaa-ay.

lines.english: The strings of his life are all tangled up; he is utterly helpless. ||1||
lines.transliteration: urjhee t aanee kichh  na basaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord of Awareness, the Lord of Life is awake and aware.
lines.transliteration: jaagas jeevan jaagan haaraa.

lines.english: He is the Ocean of peace, the Treasure of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar amrit  bhandaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He does not understand what he is told; he is blind - he does not see, and so he does his evil deeds.
lines.transliteration: kahi-o na boojhai anDh  na soojh ai bhoNdee kaar kamaa-ee.

lines.english: The Transcendent Lord Himself showers His Love and Affection; by His Grace, Hebestows glorious greatness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay pareet paraym parmaysur karmee milai vadaa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: With the coming of each and every day, his life is wearing away, bit by bit; but still,his heart is attached to Maya.
lines.transliteration: din din aavai t il til chh eejai maa-i-aa moh gh ataa-ee.

lines.english: Without the Guru, he is drowned, and finds no place of rest, as long as he is caught induality. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bin gur boodo tha-ur na paavai jab lag d oojee raa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹਓ  ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਭੋਂਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, God watches over and takes care of His living beings; they receive pleasure and pain according to their past actions.
lines.transliteration: ahinis jee-aa daykh  samHaalai sukh  dukh purab kamaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਕਰਮੀ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak, the unfortunate one, begs for the charity of Truth; please bless him with thisglory. ||4||11|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1330-15) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karamheen sach bh eekhi-aa maaNgai naanak milai vadaa-ee. ||4||11||

lines.english: If I remain silent, the world calls me a fool.
lines.transliteration: masat kara-o moorakh jag kahee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੋ ਠਉਰ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਦੂਜੀ  ਰਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: If I talk too much, I miss out on Your Love.
lines.transliteration: aDhik baka-o t ayree liv rahee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ ਜੀਆ  ਦੇਿਖ ਸਮਾਲੈ  ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਿਬ  ਕਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: My mistakes and faults will be judged in Your Court.
lines.transliteration: bhool chook t ayrai d arbaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮਹੀਣੁ  ਸਚੁ ਭੀਿਖਆ  ਮਗੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can I maintain good conduct? ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa kaisay aachaar. ||1||

lines.english: Such is the falsehood which is plundering the world.
lines.transliteration: aisay jhooth  muth ay sansaaraa.

lines.english: The slanderer slanders me, but even so, I love him. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: nindak nind ai mujh ai pi-aaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He alone knows the way, who has been slandered.
lines.transliteration: jis nindeh so-ee biDh  jaanai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is stamped with the Lord's Insignia in HisCourt.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabday d ar neesaan ai.

lines.english: He realizes the Naam, the Cause of causes, deep within himself.
lines.transliteration: kaaran naam ant argat jaanai.

lines.english: He alone knows the way, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karay so-ee biDh  jaanai. ||2||

lines.english: I am filthy and polluted; the True Lord is Immaculate and Sublime.
lines.transliteration: mai mailou oojal sach so-ay.

lines.english: Calling oneself sublime, one does not become exalted.
lines.transliteration: ootam aakh  na oochaa ho-ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh openly eats the great poison.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kh ooliH mahaa bikh  khaa-ay.

lines.english: But one who becomes Gurmukh is absorbed in the Name. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay so raachai naa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: I am blind, deaf, foolish and ignorant, pMnw 1331
lines.transliteration: anDhou bolou mugaDh  gavaar.
heenou neech burou buri-aar. the lowest of the low, the worst of the worst.

lines.english: I am poor, but I have the Wealth of Your Name, O my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: neeDhan kou Dh an naam pi-aar.

lines.english: This is the most excellent wealth; all else is poison and ashes. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ih Dhan saar hor bikh i-aa chh aar. ||4||

lines.english: I pay no attention to slander and praise; I contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ustat nindaa sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: I celebrate the One who blesses me with His Bounty.
lines.transliteration: jo dayvai t is ka-o jaikaar.

lines.english: Whomever You forgive, O Lord, is blessed with status and honor.
lines.transliteration: too bakh sahi jaat  pat ho-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I speak as He causes me to speak. ||5||12|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1331-3) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai kahaavai so-ay. ||5||12||

lines.english: Eating too much, one's filth only increases; wearing fancy clothes, one's home isdisgraced.
lines.transliteration: khaa-i-aa mail vaDh aa-i-aa paiDh ai ghar kee haan .

lines.english: Talking too much, one only starts arguments. Without the Name, everything is poison- know this well. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bak bak vaad chalaa-i-aa bin naavai bikh  jaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਇਆ  ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ  ਪੈਧੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: O Baba, such is the treacherous trap which has caught my mind;
lines.transliteration: baabaa aisaa bikham jaal man vaasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਕ ਬਿਕ ਵਾਦੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਜਾਿਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bibal jhaag sahj pargaasi-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o. riding out the waves of the storm, it will be enlightened by intuitive wisdom.

lines.english: They eat poison, speak poison and do poisonous deeds.
lines.transliteration: bikh kh aanaa bikh  bolnaa bikh  kee kaar kamaa-ay.

lines.english: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are punished; they can be saved onlythrough the True Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jam dar baaDh ay maaree-ah chh ootas saachai naa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: As they come, they go. Their actions are recorded, and go along with them.
lines.transliteration: jiv aa-i-aa tiv jaa-isee kee-aa likh  lai jaa-ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh loses his capital, and is punished in the Court of the Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: manmukh mool gavaa-i-aa d argeh milai sajaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਮ ਦਿਰ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਿਹ  ਛੂਟਿਸ  ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The world is false and polluted; only the True One is Pure. Contemplate Him throughthe Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jag khotou sach nirmalou gur sabd eeN veechaar.

lines.english: Those who have God's spiritual wisdom within, are known to be very rare. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tay nar virlay jaan ee-ahi jin ant ar gi-aan muraar. ||4||

lines.english: They endure the unendurable, and the Nectar of the Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss,trickles into them continuously.
lines.transliteration: ajar jarai neejhar jh arai amar anand saroop.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗੁ ਖੋਟੌ ਸਚੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੌ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀਂ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the fish is in love with the water; if it pleases You, Lord, please enshrine such love within me. ||5||13|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1331-9) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jal kou meen sai thay bhaavai raakh o pareet . ||5||13||

lines.english: Songs, sounds, pleasures and clever tricks;
lines.transliteration: geet naad  harakh  chaturaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਨੀਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਅਮਰ  ਅਨੰਦ  ਸਰੂਪ  ॥
lines.transliteration: rahas rang furmaa-is kaa-ee. joy, love and the power to command;

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਲ ਕੌ ਮੀਨੁ ਸੈ ਥੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥੫॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: painHan kh aanaa cheet  na paa-ee. fine clothes and food - these have no place in one's consciousness.

lines.english: True intuitive peace and poise rest in the Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saach sahj sukh naam vasaa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: What do I know about what God does?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jaanaaN ki-aa karai karaavai.

lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing makes my body feel good.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa tan kichh  na sukh aavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Yoga, thrills, delicious flavors and ecstasy;
lines.transliteration: jog binod savaad  aanand aa.
mat sat  bhaa-ay bh agat gobind aa. wisdom, truth and love all come from devotion to the Lord of the Universe.

lines.english: My own occupation is to work to praise the Lord.
lines.transliteration: keerat karam kaar nij sand aa.

lines.english: Deep within, I dwell on the Lord of the sun and the moon. ||2||
lines.transliteration: antar ravt ou raaj ravind aa. ||2||

lines.english: I have lovingly enshrined the love of my Beloved within my heart.
lines.transliteration: pari-o pari-o pareet paraym ur Dh aaree.

lines.english: My Husband Lord, the Lord of the World, is the Master of the meek and the poor.
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath pee-o banvaaree.

lines.english: Night and day, the Naam is my giving in charity and fasting.
lines.transliteration: an-din naam d aan barat kaaree.

lines.english: The waves have subsided, contemplating the essence of reality. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taripat  tarang t at beechaaree. ||3||

lines.english: What power do I have to speak the Unspoken?
lines.transliteration: akthou katha-o ki-aa mai jor.

lines.english: I worship You with devotion; You inspire me to do so.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  karee karaa-ihi mor.

lines.english: You dwell deep within; my egotism is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: antar vasai chookai mai mor.

lines.english: So whom should I serve? There is no other than You. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kis sayvee doojaa nahee hor. ||4||

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is utterly sweet and sublime.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad mahaa ras meeth aa.

lines.english: Such is the Ambrosial Nectar I see deep within.
lines.transliteration: aisaa amrit ant ar deeth aa.

lines.english: Those who taste this, attain the state of perfection.
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhi-aa pooraa pad  ho-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are satisfied, and their bodies are at peace. ||5||14|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1331-17) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak Dharaapi-o t an sukh  ho-ay. ||5||14||

lines.english: Deep within, I see the Shabad, the Word of God; my mind is pleased and appeased. Nothing else can touch and imbue me.
lines.transliteration: antar d aykh sabad  man maani-aa avar na raaNganhaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Day and night, God watches over and cares for His beings and creatures; He is theRuler of all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ahinis jee-aa daykh  samaalay t is hee kee sarkaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: My God is dyed in the most beautiful and glorious color.
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh raaNg ghanou at roorh ou.

lines.english: Merciful to the meek and the poor, my Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; He is so very sweet, imbued with the deep crimson color of His Love. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal pareet am manmohan at  ras laal sagoorh ou. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Well is high up in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Nectar flows, and I drink it in.
lines.transliteration: oopar koop gagan panihaaree amrit peevan haaraa.

lines.english: The creation is His; He alone knows its ways and means. The Gurmukh contemplates spiritual wisdom. ||2|| pMnw 1332
lines.transliteration: jis kee rachnaa so biDh jaan ai gurmukh  gi-aan veechaaraa. ||2||

lines.english: The rays of light spread out, and the heart-lotus joyfully blossoms forth; the sun enters into the house of the moon.
lines.transliteration: pasree kiran ras kamal bigaasay sas gh ar soor samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਸਰੀ  ਿਕਰਿਣ  ਰਿਸ ਕਮਲ  ਿਬਗਾਸੇ  ਸਿਸ ਘਿਰ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I have conquered death; the desires of the mind are destroyed. By Guru's Grace, Ihave found God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaal biDhuns mansaa man maaree gur parsaad  parabh  paa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਬਧੁੰਿਸ  ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਿਨ ਮਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. I am not colored by any other color.
lines.transliteration: at ras rang chaloolai raat ee doojaa rang na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਤ  ਰਿਸ ਰੰਿਗ ਚਲੂਲੈ  ਰਾਤੀ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, my tongue is saturated with the taste of God, who is permeating andpervading everywhere. ||4||15|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1332-4) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak rasan rasaa-ay raatay rav rahi-aa parabh  so-ee. ||4||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਸਿਨ  ਰਸਾਏ  ਰਾਤੇ ਰਿਵ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Yogis are divided into twelve schools, the Sannyaasees into ten.
lines.transliteration: baarah meh raaval khap jaaveh chahu chh i-a meh sani-aasee.

lines.english: The Yogis and those wearing religious robes, and the Jains with their all hair plucked out - without the Word of the Shabad, the noose is around their necks. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jogee kaaprhee-aa sirkh oothay bin sabd ai gal faasee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰਹ  ਮਿਹ ਰਾਵਲ  ਖਿਪ ਜਾਵਿਹ  ਚਹੁ ਿਛਅ  ਮਿਹ ਸੰਿਨਆਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are the perfectly detached renunciates.
lines.transliteration: sabad rat ay pooray bairaagee.

lines.english: They beg to receive charity in the hands of their hearts, embracing love and affectionfor the One. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: a-uhath hasat  meh bh eekhi-aa jaachee ayk bh aa-ay liv laagee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Brahmins study and argue about the scriptures; they perform ceremonial rituals,and lead others in these rituals.
lines.transliteration: barahman vaad  parheh kar kiri-aa karn ee karam karaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਹਿਠ  ਹਸਤ  ਮਿਹ ਭੀਿਖਆ  ਜਾਚੀ  ਏਕ ਭਾਇ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Without true understanding, those self-willed manmukhs understand nothing. Separated from God, they suffer in pain. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin boojhay kichh  soojh ai naahee manmukh  vichh urh dukh paa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Those who receive the Shabad are sanctified and pure; they are approved in the TrueCourt.
lines.transliteration: sabad milay say soochaachaaree saachee d argeh maanay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਣ  ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜਿਹ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Naam; throughout the ages, theyare merged in the True One. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din naam rat an liv laagay jug jug saach samaanay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Good deeds, righteousness and Dharmic faith, purification, austere self-discipline, chanting, intense meditation and pilgrimages to sacred shrines - all these abide in theShabad.
lines.transliteration: saglay karam Dharam such sanjam jap t ap tirath sabad  vasay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਮਾਨੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, united in union with the True Guru, suffering, sin and death run away.||4||16|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1332-10) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur milai milaa-i-aa d ookh paraachh at kaal nasay. ||4||16||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤਿਨ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੇ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਜੁਿਗ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਨੇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The dust of the feet of the Saints, the Company of the Holy, and the Praises of theLord carry us across to the other side.
lines.transliteration: santaa kee rayn  saaDh  jan sangat  har keerat  tar taaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੇ  ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਸੁਿਚ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਵਸੇ ॥
lines.english: What can the wretched, terrified Messenger of Death do to the Gurmukhs? The Lordabides in their hearts. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kahaa karai bapuraa jam darpai gurmukh rid ai muraaree. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਲੈ ਿਮਲਾਇਆ  ਦੂਖ ਪਰਾਛਤ  ਕਾਲ  ਨਸੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life might just as well be burnt down.
lines.transliteration: jal jaa-o jeevan naam binaa.

lines.english: The Gurmukh chants and meditates on the Lord, chanting the chant on the mala; theFlavor of the Lord comes into the mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har jap jaap japa-o japmaalee gurmukh aavai saad  manaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find true peace - how can I even describe theglory of such a person?
lines.transliteration: gur updays saach sukh  jaa ka-o ki-aa t is upmaa kahee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰਾ  ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਿਰਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh seeks and finds the gems and jewels, diamonds, rubies and treasures. ||2||
lines.transliteration: laal javayhar ratan pad aarath kh ojat gurmukh  lahee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: So center yourself on the treasures of spiritual wisdom and meditation; remainlovingly attuned to the One True Lord, and the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: cheenai gi-aan Dhi-aan Dh an saachou ayk sabad  liv laavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ  ਜਪਮਾਲੀ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਆਵੈ  ਸਾਦੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Remain absorbed in the Primal State of the Fearless, Immaculate, Independent, Self-sufficient Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: niraalamb nirhaar nihkayval nirbha-o t aarhee laavai. ||3||

lines.english: The seven seas are overflowing with the Immaculate Water; the inverted boat floatsacross.
lines.transliteration: saa-ir sapat bh aray jal nirmal ultee naav t araavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ  ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਕਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਉਪਮਾ  ਕਹੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The mind which wandered in external distractions is restrained and held in check; theGurmukh is intuitively absorbed in God. ||4||
lines.transliteration: baahar jaatou th aak rahaavai gurmukh  sahj samaavai. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਲ  ਜਵੇਹਰ ਰਤਨ  ਪਦਾਰਥ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਹੀਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is a householder, he is a renunciate and God's slave, who, as Gurmukh, realizes hisown self.
lines.transliteration: so girhee so daas ud aasee jin gurmukh  aap pachh aani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚੀਨੈ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚੌ ਏਕ ਸਬਿਦ  ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, his mind is pleased and appeased by the True Word of the Shabad; thereis no other at all. ||5||17|| rwgu pRBwqI mhlw 3 caupdy  (1332-17) raag parbhaat ee mehlaa 3 cha-upd ay Raag Prabhaatee, Third Mehl, Chau-Padas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1332-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai avar nahee doojaa saach sabad  man maani-aa. ||5||17||

lines.english: Those who become Gurmukh and understand are very rare; God is permeating and pervading through the Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa ko-ee boojh ai sabd ay rahi-aa samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਇਰ  ਸਪਤ  ਭਰੇ ਜਲ ਿਨਰਮਿਲ  ਉਲਟੀ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find everlasting peace; they remain lovingly attuned to the True One. ||1|| pMnw 1333
lines.transliteration: naam ratay sad aa sukh  paavai saach rahai liv laa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu jan bhaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes steady and stable; night and day, it remains satisfied with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad man asthir hovai an-d in har ras rahi-aa agh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਮਨੁ ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਰਿਹਆ ਅਘਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Night and day, perform devotional worship service to the Lord, day and night; this isthe profit to be obtained in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: an-din bh agat karahu d in raat ee is jug kaa laahaa bh aa-ee.

lines.english: The humble beings are forever immaculate; no filth ever sticks to them. They focustheir consciousness on the True Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa jan nirmal mail na laagai sach naam chit  laa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰਹੁ ਿਦਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ  ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ  ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has revealed the ornamentation of peace; the Glorious Greatness ofthe Naam is Great!
lines.transliteration: sukh seegaar sat guroo d ikhaa-i-aa naam vadee vadi-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Inexhaustible Treasures are overflowing; they are never exhausted. So serve the Lord forever, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||
lines.transliteration: akhut bh andaar bh aray kad ay tot na aavai sad aa har sayvhu bh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਿਦਖਾਇਆ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਵਡੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator comes to abide in the minds of those whom He Himself has blessed.
lines.transliteration: aapay kartaa jis no d ayvai t is vasai man aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਖੁਟ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਭਰੇ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, which the True Guru has revealed. ||4||1|| pRBwqI mhlw 3 ] (1333-6) parbhaat ee mehlaa 3. Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam Dhi-aa-ay sad aa too sat gur dee-aa d ikhaa-ee. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਿਤਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am unworthy; please forgive me and bless me, O my Lord and Master, and unite mewith Yourself.
lines.transliteration: nirgunee-aaray ka-o bakh as lai su-aamee aapay laihu milaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਦਖਾਈ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: You are Endless; no one can find Your limits. Through the Word of Your Shabad, You bestow understanding. ||1||
lines.transliteration: too bi-ant  tayraa ant  na paa-i-aa sabd ay dayh bujh aa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: O Dear Lord, I am a sacrifice to You.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o tuDh  vitahu bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ  ਕਉ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਲੈਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate my mind and body and place them in offering before You; I shall remain inYour Sanctuary forever. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tan man arpee t uDh aagai raakh a-o sad aa rahaaN sarnaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਿਬਅੰਤੁ  ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਬਦੇ  ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Please keep me forever under Your Will, O my Lord and Master; please bless me withthe Glorious Greatness of Your Name.
lines.transliteration: aapnay bh aanay vich sad aa rakh  su-aamee har naamo d eh vadi-aa-ee.

lines.english: Through the Perfect Guru, God's Will is revealed; night and day, remain absorbed in peace and poise. ||2||
lines.transliteration: pooray gur tay bh aanaa jaapai an-d in sahj samaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ  ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ  ਰਾਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those devotees who accept Your Will are pleasing to You, Lord; You Yourself forgivethem, and unite them with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: tayrai bh aanai bhagat jay tuDh bhaavai aapay bakh as milaa-ee.

lines.english: Accepting Your Will, I have found everlasting peace; the Guru has extinguished thefire of desire. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tayrai bh aanai sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa gur t arisnaa agan bujh aa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣੇ  ਭਾਣੇ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਦਾ ਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਿਹ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever You do comes to pass, O Creator; nothing else can be done.
lines.transliteration: jo too karahi so hovai kart ay avar na karn aa jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਾਣਾ  ਜਾਪੈ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, nothing is as great as the Blessing of the Name; it is obtained through thePerfect Guru. ||4||2|| pRBwqI mhlw 3 ] (1333-11) parbhaat ee mehlaa 3. Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naavai jayvad avar na daat aa pooray gur t ay paa-ee. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਗਿਤ  ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ  ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord; praising the Lord, they know Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har salaahi-aa jinna t in salaahi har jaat aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Doubt and duality are gone from within; they realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.||1||
lines.transliteration: vichahu bharam ga-i-aa hai d oojaa gur kai sabad  pachh aataa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਹ  ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You are my One and Only.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o too mayraa ik so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ  ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ  ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.english: I meditate on You and praise You; salvation and wisdom come from You. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tuDh japee t uDhai saalaahee gat  mat tujh tay ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs praise You; they receive the most excellent and sweet Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh saalaahan say saad  paa-in meeth aa amrit  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਸਾਲਾਿਹਆ  ਿਜੰਨਾ  ਿਤਨ  ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: This Nectar is forever sweet; it never loses its taste. Contemplate the Word of theGuru's Shabad. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sadaa meeth aa kad ay na feekaa gur sabd ee veechaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਗਇਆ  ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਪਛਾਤਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He makes it seem so sweet to me; I am a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: jin meethaa laa-i-aa so-ee jaan ai tis vitahu bal jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, I praise the Giver of peace forever. I have eradicated self-conceit from within. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabad salaahee sad aa sukh -daata vichahu aap gavaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ  ਗਿਤ  ਮਿਤ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: My True Guru is forever the Giver. I receive whatever fruits and rewards I desire.
lines.transliteration: satgur mayraa sad aa hai d aataa jo ichh ai so fal paa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; through the Word of theGuru's Shabad, the True One is found. ||4||3|| pRBwqI mhlw 3 ] (1333-17) parbhaat ee mehlaa 3. Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee gur sabdee sach paa-ay. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਾਲਾਹਿਨ  ਸੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, are saved by Your Protective Power.
lines.transliteration: jo tayree sarn aa-ee har jee-o t in too raakh an jog.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਮੀਠਾ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਫੀਕਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I cannot even conceive of any other as Great as You. There never was, and there never shall be. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tuDh jayvad mai avar na soojh ai naa ko ho-aa na hog. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਮੀਠਾ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o sadaa t ayree sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਲਾਹੀ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਵਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: As it pleases You, You save me, O my Lord and Master; this is Your GloriousGreatness. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o raakh o mayray su-aamee ayh t ayree vadi-aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ  ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, You cherish and sustain those who seek Your Sanctuary. pMnw 1334
lines.transliteration: jo tayree sarn aa-ee har jee-o t in kee karahi part ipaal.

lines.english: O Dear Lord, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch those whom You, in Your Mercy, protect. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aap kirpaa kar raakho har jee-o pohi na sakai jamkaal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਪੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: True Is Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; it never diminishes or goes away.
lines.transliteration: tayree sarn aa-ee sachee har jee-o naa oh gh atai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਸਚੀ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਨਾ ਓਹ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who abandon the Lord, and become attached to the love of duality, shallcontinue to die and be reborn. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo har chhod d oojai bh aa-ay laagai oh jammai t ai mar jaa-ay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਛੋਿਡ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਓਹੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who seek Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, shall never suffer in pain or hunger foranything.
lines.transliteration: jo tayree sarn aa-ee har jee-o t inaa d ookh bhookh kichh  naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||4|| pRBwqI mhlw 3 ] (1334-4) parbhaat ee mehlaa 3. Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi sadaa t oo sachai sabad  samaahi. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਿਹ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Dear Lord forever, as long as there is the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har jee-o sad aa Dh i-aavahu jab lag jee-a paraan.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind becomes immaculate, andegotistical pride is expelled from the mind.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee man nirmal ho-aa chookaa man abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਦਾ ਿਧਆਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful and prosperous is the life of that mortal being, who is absorbed in the Nameof the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: safal janam tis paraanee kayraa har kai naam samaan. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਚੂਕਾ  ਮਿਨ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, listen to the Teachings of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur kee sikh sun eejai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਫਲੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਕੇਰਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace forever. With intuitive ease, drink in theSublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa sukh -daata sehjay har ras peejai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those who understand their own origin dwell within the home of their inner being, inintuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: mool pachhaan an tin nij gh ar vaasaa sehjay hee sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and egotism and evil-mindedness are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal pargaasi-aa ha-umai d urmat  kho-ee.

lines.english: The One True Lord is pervading amongst all; those who realize this are very rare.||2||
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa meh ayko sach vart ai virlaa boojh ai ko-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਨ  ਿਤਨ ਿਨਜ ਘਿਰ  ਵਾਸਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind becomes immaculate, speaking the AmbrosialEssence.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee man nirmal ho-aa amrit  tat vakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord dwells in the mind forever; within the mind, the mind is pleasedand appeased.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa man vasi-aa vich man hee man maanai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਮਿਹ ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਿਵਰਲਾ  ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, through whom I have realized the Lord, theSupreme Soul. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sad balihaaree gur apunay vitahu jit  aatam raam pachh aanai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਹੋਆ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those human beings who do not serve the True Guru - their lives are uselesslywasted.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam satguroo na sayvi-aa birthaa janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.english: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, then we meet the True Guru, merging inintuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay t aaN satgur maylay sehjay sahj samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਿਜਤੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, by great good fortune, the Naam is bestowed; by perfect destiny, meditate.||4||5|| pRBwqI mhlw 3 ] (1334-12) parbhaat ee mehlaa 3. Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadi-aa-ee poorai bhaag Dh i-aa-i-aa. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨਸ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: God Himself fashioned the many forms and colors; He created the Universe and staged the play.
lines.transliteration: aapay bhaaNt banaa-ay baho rangee sisat upaa-ay parabh  khayl kee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ ਕਰੇ ਤ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Creating the creation, He watches over it. He acts, and causes all to act; He givessustenance to all beings. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kar vaykhai karay karaa-ay sarab jee-aa no rijak d ee-aa. ||1||

lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord is All-pervading.
lines.transliteration: kalee kaal meh ravi-aa raam.

lines.english: The One God is pervading and permeating each and every heart; the Name of theLord, Har, Har, is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at poor rahi-aa parabh  ayko gurmukh  pargat har har naam. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਭਿਤ  ਬਣਾਏ  ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਿਸਸਿਟ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is hidden, but it is pervasive in the Dark Age. TheLord is totally pervading and permeating each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: guptaa naam vart ai vich kaljug gh at ghat har bh arpoor rahi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਆ  ਨੋ ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਦੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Jewel of the Naam is revealed within the hearts of those who hurry to theSanctuary of the Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam ratan t inaa hird ai pargati-aa jo gur sarn aa-ee bh aj pa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Whoever overpowers the five sense organs, is blessed with forgiveness, patience andcontentment, through the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: indree panch panchay vas aan ai khimaa sant okh gurmat  paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Blessed, blessed, perfect and great is that humble servant of the Lord, who is inspired by the Fear of God and detached love, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so Dhan Dh an har jan vad pooraa jo bh ai bairaag har gun  gaavai. ||3||

lines.english: If someone turns his face away from the Guru, and does not enshrine the Guru'sWords in his consciousness
lines.transliteration: gur tay muhu fayray jay ko-ee gur kaa kahi-aa na chit  Dharai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਪਤਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਕਲਜੁਿਗ  ਘਿਟ ਘਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ਰਿਹਆ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kar aachaar baho sampa-o sanchai jo kichh karai so narak parai. ||4|| - he may perform all sorts of rituals and accumulate wealth, but in the end, he will fallinto hell. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟਆ  ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਿਜ ਪਇਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The One Shabad, the Word of the One God, is prevailing everywhere. All the creationcame from the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ayko sabad ayko parabh  vartai sabh  aykas t ay utpat chalai.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ੀ  ਪੰਚ ਪੰਚੇ ਵਿਸ ਆਣੈ  ਿਖਮਾ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is united in union. When the Gurmukh goes, he blends into theLord, Har, Har. ||5||6|| pRBwqI mhlw 3 ] (1334-19) parbhaat ee mehlaa 3. Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mayl milaa-ay gurmukh  har har jaa-ay ralai. ||5||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੋ ਭੈ ਬੈਰਾਿਗ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O my mind, praise your Guru. pMnw 1335
lines.transliteration: mayray man gur apnaa saalaahi.

lines.english: Perfect destiny is inscribed upon your forehead and face; sing the Praises of the Lord forever. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: pooraa bhaag hovai mukh  mast ak sad aa har kay gun  gaahi. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਿਹ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord bestows the Ambrosial Food of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam bh ojan har d ay-ay.

lines.english: Out of millions, only a rare few receive it
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay ko-ee virlaa lay-ay.
jis no apnee nad ar karay-i. ||1|| - only those who are blessed by God's Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.english: Whoever enshrines the Guru's Feet within his mind,
lines.transliteration: gur kay charan man maahi vasaa-ay.
dukh anHayraa and rahu jaa-ay. is rid of pain and darkness from within.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ ਵਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord unites him with Himself. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aapay saachaa la-ay milaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: So embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee si-o laa-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, this is your only Support.
lines.transliteration: aithai othai ayhu aDhaar.

lines.english: The Creator Lord Himself bestows it. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aapay dayvai sirjanhaar. ||3||

lines.english: One whom the Lord inspires to accept His Will,
lines.transliteration: sachaa manaa-ay apnaa bh aanaa.
so-ee bhagat  sugh arh sojaan aa. is a wise and knowing devotee.

lines.english: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||4||7||17||7||24|| pRBwqI mhlw 4 ibBws  (1335-6) parbhaat ee mehlaa 4 bibh aas Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl, Bibhaas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1335-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak tis kai sad  kurbaan aa. ||4||7||17||7||24||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with joyous love and delight; I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: rasak rasak gun gaavah gurmat liv unman naam lagaan.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I drink in the Ambrosial Essence; I am asacrifice to the Naam. ||1||
lines.transliteration: amrit ras pee-aa gur sabd ee ham naam vitahu kurbaan. ||1||

lines.english: The Lord, the Life of the World, is my Breath of Life.
lines.transliteration: hamray jagjeevan har paraan.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਲਵ ਉਨਮਿਨ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: The Lofty and Exalted Lord became pleasing to my heart and my inner being, whenthe Guru breathed the Mantra of the Lord into my ears. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har ootam rid  antar bhaa-i-o gur mant  dee-o har kaan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Come, O Saints: let us join together, O Siblings of Destiny; let us meet and chant theName of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aavhu sant milhu mayray bh aa-ee mil har har naam vakh aan.

lines.english: How am I to find my God? Please bless me with the Gift of the Lord's Teachings. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kit biDh  ki-o paa-ee-ai parabh  apunaa mo ka-o karahu upd ays har d aan. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਊਤਮੁ  ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਭਾਇਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾਨ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, abides in the Society of the Saints; joining this Sangat, the Lord's Glories are known.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  meh har har vasi-aa mil sangat  har gun jaan.

lines.english: By great good fortune, the Society of the Saints is found. Through the Guru, the TrueGuru, I receive the Touch of the Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag sat sangat  paa-ee gur sat gur paras bh agvaan. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਿਮਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of God, my Inaccessible Lord and Master; singing HisPraises, I am enraptured.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavah parabh agam th aakur kay gun gaa-ay rahay hairaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਤੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਿਕਉ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ  ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਦਾਨ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; in an instant, He blessed himwith the Gift of the Lord's Name. ||4||1|| pRBwqI mhlw 4 ] (1335-13) parbhaat ee mehlaa 4. Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o gur kirpaa Dhaaree har naam d ee-o kh in daan. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਵਿਸਆ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨ ॥
lines.english: With the rising of the sun, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord. All through the night, hedwells upon the Sermon of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ugvai soor gurmukh har boleh sabh  rain samHaalih har gaal.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਿਸ  ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੩॥
lines.english: My God has infused this longing within me; I seek my Lord God. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hamrai parabh ham loch lagaa-ee ham karah parabh oo har bh aal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਗਮ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ਰਹੇ ਹੈਰਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is the dust of the feet of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: mayraa man saaDhoo Dh oor ravaal.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ  ਿਖਨ ਦਾਨ  ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Sweet Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. I dust the Guru's Feet with my hair. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har naam darirh -aa-i-o gur meeth aa gur pag jh aarah ham baal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Dark are the days and nights of the faithless cynics; they are caught in the trap ofattachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: saakat ka-o d in rain anDh aaree mohi faathay maa-i-aa jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਉਗਵੈ  ਸੂਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਸਭ ਰੈਿਨ ਸਮਾਲਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਗਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God does not dwell in their hearts, even for an instant; every hair of theirheads is totally tied up in debts. ||2||
lines.transliteration: khin pal har parabh  ridai na vasi-o rin baaDh ay baho biDh  baal. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਰੈ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਹਮ ਲੋਚ ਲਗਾਈ  ਹਮ ਕਰਹ  ਪਰ੍ਭੂ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, wisdom and understanding areobtained, and one is released from the traps of egotism and possessiveness.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  mil mat  buDh  paa-ee ha-o chh ootay mamt aa jaal.

lines.english: The Lord's Name, and the Lord, seem sweet to me. Through the Word of His Shabad,the Guru has made me happy. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har naamaa har meeth lagaanaa gur kee-ay sabad  nihaal. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਮੀਠਾ  ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਹ  ਹਮ ਬਾਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am just a child; the Guru is the Unfathomable Lord of the World. In His Mercy, Hecherishes and sustains me.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik gur agam gusaa-ee gur kar kirpaa partipaal.

lines.english: I am drowning in the ocean of poison; O God, Guru, Lord of the World, please saveYour child, Nanak. ||4||2|| pRBwqI mhlw 4 ] (1335-19) parbhaat ee mehlaa 4. Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bikh bh a-ojal dubd ay kaadh  layho parabh  gur naanak baal gupaal. ||4||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਿਦਨੁ ਰੈਿਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ  ਮੋਿਹ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਾਇਆ  ਜਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord God showered me with His Mercy for an instant; I sing His Glorious Praises with joyous love and delight. pMnw 1336
lines.transliteration: ik khin har parabh  kirpaa Dh aaree gun gaa-ay rasak raseek.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ  ਰਸਕ  ਰਸੀਕ  ॥
lines.english: Both the singer and the listener are liberated, when, as Gurmukh, they drink in the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gaavat sunat  do-oo bh a-ay mukt ay jinaa gurmukh  khin har peek. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਦੋਊ ਭਏ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਿਖਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਪੀਕ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is enshrined within my mind.
lines.transliteration: mayrai man har har raam naam ras teek.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੀਕ ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the cooling, soothing Water of the Naam. I eagerly drinkin the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam seet al jal paa-i-aa har har naam pee-aa ras jh eek. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ  ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ  ਰਸੁ ਝੀਕ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are imbued with the Love of the Lord have the mark of radiantpurity upon their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: jin har hirdai pareet  lagaanee t inaa mast ak oojal teek.

lines.english: The Glory of the Lord's humble servant is manifest throughout the world, like themoon among the stars. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har jan sobhaa sabh  jag oopar ji-o vich udvaa sas keek. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਨੀ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਊਜਲ  ਟੀਕ ॥
lines.english: Those whose hearts are not filled with the Lord's Name - all their affairs are worthlessand insipid.
lines.transliteration: jin har hirdai naam na vasi-o t in sabh  kaaraj feek.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਊਪਿਰ  ਿਜਉ ਿਵਿਚ  ਉਡਵਾ  ਸਿਸ ਕੀਕ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: They may adorn and decorate their bodies, but without the Naam, they look like their noses have been cut off. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jaisay seegaar karai dayh maanukh  naam binaa naktay nak keek. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਓ  ਿਤਨ ਸਿਭ ਕਾਰਜ  ਫੀਕ ॥
lines.english: The Sovereign Lord permeates each and every heart; the One Lord is all-pervadingeverywhere.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at rama-ee-aa ramat  raam raa-ay sabh  vartai sabh  meh eek.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਨਕਟੇ  ਨਕ ਕੀਕ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the Word of theGuru's Teachings, I have meditated on the Lord in an instant. ||4||3|| pRBwqI mhlw 4 ] (1336-7) parbhaat ee mehlaa 4. Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o har kirpaa Dhaaree gur bachan Dh i-aa-i-o gh aree meek. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ ਰਮਈਆ  ਰਮਤ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ  ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ  ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਈਕ ॥
lines.english: God, the Inaccessible and Merciful, has showered me with His Mercy; I chant theName of the Lord, Har, Har, with my mouth.
lines.transliteration: agam da-i-aal kirpaa parabh  Dhaaree mukh  har har naam ham kahay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ਘਰੀ  ਮੀਕ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; I am rid of all my sins andmistakes. ||1||
lines.transliteration: patit paavan har naam Dh i-aa-i-o sabh  kilbikh  paap lahay. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, chant the Name of the All-pervading Lord.
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam rav rahay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਧਾਰੀ  ਮੁਿਖ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਕਹੇ ॥
lines.english: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain. Following theGuru's Teachings, I gather in the Wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal d ukh bhanjan gaa-i-o gurmat  naam pad aarath lahay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ਸਿਭ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਪਾਪ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Lord abides in the body-village; through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar nagar har basi-o mat gurmat  har har sahay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਪ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.english: In the lake of the body, the Lord's Name has been revealed. Within my own home andmansion, I have obtained the Lord God. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sareer sarovar naam har pargati-o ghar mand ar har parabh  lahay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਓ  ਗੁ ਰਮਿਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those beings who wander in the wilderness of doubt - those faithless cynics arefoolish, and are plundered.
lines.transliteration: jo nar bharam bh aram ud i-aanay t ay saakat  moorh  muhay.

lines.english: They are like the deer: the scent of musk comes from its own navel, but it wandersand roams around, searching for it in the bushes. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ji-o marig naabh basai baas basnaa bh aram bh armi-o jh aar gahay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਿਰ  ਨਗਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਬਿਸਓ  ਮਿਤ ਗੁ ਰਮਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸਹੇ ॥
lines.english: You are Great and Unfathomable; Your Wisdom, God, is Profound andIncomprehensible. Please bless me with that wisdom, by which I might attain You, OLord God.
lines.transliteration: tum vad agam agaaDh  boDh  parabh  mat dayvhu har parabh  lahay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰੀਿਰ  ਸਰੋਵਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟਓ  ਘਿਰ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Guru has placed His Hand upon servant Nanak; he chants the Name of the Lord.||4||4|| pRBwqI mhlw 4 ] (1336-13) parbhaat ee mehlaa 4. Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka-o gur haath sir Dhari-o har raam naam rav rahay. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਭਰਿਮ  ਭਰਿਮ  ਉਿਦਆਨੇ  ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ  ਮੂੜ ਮੁਹੇ ॥
lines.english: My mind is in love with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I meditate on the Great LordGod.
lines.transliteration: man laagee pareet raam naam har har japi-o har parabh  vadfaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਨਾਿਭ  ਬਸੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਨਾ  ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭਰ੍ਿਮਓ  ਝਾਰ ਗਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Word of the True Guru has become pleasing to my heart. The Lord God has showered me with His Grace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur bachan sukh aanay hee-arai har Dh aaree har parabh  kirpfaa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ  ਅਗਾਿਧ  ਬੋਿਧ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਿਤ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਲਹੇ ॥
lines.english: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord's Name every instant.
lines.transliteration: mayray man bhaj raam naam har nimkh afaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਉ ਗੁਿਰ ਹਾਥੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਧਿਰਓ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. TheLord's Name abides in my mind and body. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: har har daan d ee-o gur poorai har naamaa man t an basfaa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lord abides in the body-village, in my home and mansion. As Gurmukh, Imeditate on His Glory.
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa nagar vasi-o ghar mand ar jap sobh aa gurmukh  karpafaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਲਾਗੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਓ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਵਡਫਾ  ॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, the Lord's humble servants are embellished and exalted; theirfaces are radiant; as Gurmukh, they are carried across. ||2||
lines.transliteration: halat palat  jan bh a-ay suhaylay mukh  oojal gurmukh  tarfaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਚਨ  ਸੁਖਾਨੇ  ਹੀਅਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਧਾਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਫਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am lovingly attuned to the Fearless Lord, Har, Har, Har; through the Guru, I haveenshrined the Lord within my heart in an instant.
lines.transliteration: anbha-o har har har liv laagee har ur Dh aari-o gur nimkh afaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰ ਿਨਮਖਫਾ  ॥
lines.english: Millions upon millions of the faults and mistakes of the Lord's humble servant are alltaken away in an instant. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kot kot kay dokh  sabh  jan kay har d oor kee-ay ik palfaa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਬਸਫਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your humble servants are known only through You, God; knowing You, they becomessupreme.
lines.transliteration: tumray jan t um hee t ay jaanay parabh  jaani-o jan t ay mukh faa.

lines.english: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined Himself within His humble servant. O Nanak, the Lord God and His servant are one and the same. ||4||5|| pMnw 1337 pRBwqI mhlw 4 ] (1337-1) parbhaat ee mehlaa 4. Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har har aap Dhari-o har jan meh jan naanak har parabh  ikfaa. ||4||5||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਹ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਇਕਫਾ  ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord within me. I was dead, but chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been brought back tolife.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur naam d arirh-aa-i-o har har ham mu-ay jeevay har japibh aa.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo gur sat gur pooraa bikh  dubd ay baah d ay-ay kadh ibhaa. ||1|| Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru; He reached out to me with His Arm, and pulled me up and out of the ocean of poison. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਓ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਮ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਭਾ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, meditate and worship the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam arDhaaNbhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਿਬਖੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਇ ਕਿਢਭਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: God is never found, even by making all sorts of new efforts. The Lord God is obtainedonly through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: upjamp upaa-ay na paa-ee-ai kathoo gur poorai har parabh  laabh aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Sublime Essence of the Lord's Name is the source of nectar and bliss; drinking inthis Sublime Essence, following the Guru's Teachings, I have become happy.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ras raam rasaa-in ras pee-aa gurmat  rasbh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਜੰਿਪ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਕਤਹੂ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਲਾਭਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Even iron slag is transformed into gold, joining the Lord's Congregation. Through the Guru, the Lord's Light is enshrined within the heart. ||2||
lines.transliteration: loh manoor kanchan mil sangat har ur Dh aari-o gur haribh aa. ||2||

lines.english: Those who are continually lured by greed, egotism and corruption, who are luredaway by emotional attachment to their children and spouse
lines.transliteration: ha-umai bikhi-aa nit  lobh lubhaanay put  kalat  mohi lubh ibhaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ  ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਰਸਭਾ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tin pag sant  na sayvay kabhoo t ay manmukh  bhoombh ar bharbhaa. ||3|| - they never serve at the feet of the Saints; those self-willed manmukhs are filled withashes. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਹ ਮਨੂਰ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਿਮਿਲ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਹਿਰਭਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues; I have grown weary - I seek YourSanctuary.
lines.transliteration: tumray gun t um hee parabh  jaanhu ham paray haar t um sarnabh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਨਤ  ਲੋਿਭ ਲੁਭਾਨੇ  ਪੁਤ ਕਲਤ  ਮੋਿਹ ਲੁਿਭਭਾ  ॥
lines.english: As You know best, You preserve and protect me, O my Lord and Master; servantNanak is Your slave. ||4||6|| Ckw 1 ] (1337-7) chhakaa 1. First Set of Six|| pRBwqI ibBws pVqwl mhlw 4  (1337-8) parbhaat ee bibh aas parh -taal mehlaa 4 Prabhaatee, Bibhaas, Partaal, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1337-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: ji-o jaanhu ti-o raakh o su-aamee jan naanak d aas tumnabh aa. ||4||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਪਗ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭੂੰਭਰ ਭਰਭਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O mind, meditate on the Treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam niDhaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮਰੇ  ਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਹਾਿਰ  ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਭਾ  ॥
lines.english: You shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har dargeh paavahi maan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਿਤਉ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਨਭਾ  ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who chant and meditate shall be carried across to the other shore. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin japi-aa tay paar paraan. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Listen, O mind: meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: sun man har har naam kar Dhi-aan.

lines.english: Listen, O mind: the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is equal to bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
lines.transliteration: sun man har keerat ath sath majaan.

lines.english: Listen, O mind: as Gurmukh, you shall be blessed with honor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sun man gurmukh paavahi maan. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, chant and meditate on the Supreme Transcendent Lord God.
lines.transliteration: jap man parmaysur parDhaan.

lines.english: Millions of sins shall be destroyed in an instant.
lines.transliteration: khin kh ovai paap kotaan.

lines.english: O Nanak, you shall meet with the Lord God. ||2||1||7|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ibBws  (1337-13) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5 bibh aas Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Bibhaas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1337-13) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: mil naanak har bhagvaan. ||2||1||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰ ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord created the mind, and fashioned the entire body.
lines.transliteration: man har kee-aa tan sabh  saaji-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਨ ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਮਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: From the five elements, He formed it, and infused His Light within it.
lines.transliteration: panch tat  rach jot  nivaaji-aa.

lines.english: He made the earth its bed, and water for it to use.
lines.transliteration: sihjaa Dharat  bartan ka-o paanee.

lines.english: Do not forget Him for an instant; serve the Lord of the World. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nimakh na visaarahu sayvhu saarigpaanee. ||1||

lines.english: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain the supreme status.
lines.transliteration: man satgur sayv ho-ay param gat ay.

lines.english: If you remain unattached and unaffected by sorrow and joy, then you shall find the Lord of Life. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: harakh sog t ay raheh niraaraa t aaN too paavahi paranpat ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He makes all the various pleasures, clothes and foods for you to enjoy.
lines.transliteration: kaaparh bh og ras anik bh unchaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਿਜਆ  ॥
lines.english: He made your mother, father and all relatives.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa kutamb sagal banaa-ay.

lines.english: He provides sustenance to all, in the water and on the land, O friend.
lines.transliteration: rijak samaahay jal thal meet.

lines.english: So serve the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so har sayvhu neetaa neet . ||2||

lines.english: He shall be your Helper and Support there, where no one else can help you.
lines.transliteration: tahaa sakh aa-ee jah ko-ay na hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ  ਗਤੇ ॥
lines.english: He washes away millions of sins in an instant.
lines.transliteration: kot apraaDh ik kh in meh Dh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਹ  ਿਨਰਾਰਾ  ਤ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨਪਤੇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: He bestows His Gifts, and never regrets them.
lines.transliteration: daat karai nahee pachh otaavai.

lines.english: He forgives, once and for all, and never asks for one's account again. ||3|| pMnw 1338
lines.transliteration: aykaa bakhas fir bahur na bulaavai. ||3||

lines.english: By pre-ordained destiny, I have searched and found God.
lines.transliteration: kirat sanjogee paa-i-aa bh aal.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord of the World abides.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  meh basay gupaal.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, I have come to Your Door.
lines.transliteration: gur mil aa-ay tumrai d u-aar.

lines.english: O Lord, please bless servant Nanak with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||1|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1338-2) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak darsan d ayh muraar. ||4||1||

lines.english: Serving God, His humble servant is glorified.
lines.transliteration: parabh kee sayvaa jan kee sobh aa.

lines.english: Unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and unsatisfied greed are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh mitay t is lobh aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
lines.english: Your Name is the treasure of Your humble servant.
lines.transliteration: naam tayraa jan kai bh andaar.

lines.english: Singing His Praises, I am in love with the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi parabh d aras pi-aar. ||1||

lines.english: You are known, O God, by Your devotees.
lines.transliteration: tumree bh agat parabh  tumeh janaa-ee.

lines.english: Breaking their bonds, You emancipate them. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaat jayvree jan lee-ay chhadaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Those humble beings who are imbued with God's Love
lines.transliteration: jo jan raataa parabh  kai rang.
tin sukh  paa-i-aa parabh  kai sang. find peace in God's Congregation.

lines.english: They alone understand this, to whom this subtle essence comes.
lines.transliteration: jis ras aa-i-aa so-ee jaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: Beholding it, and gazing upon it, in their minds they are wonderstruck. ||2||
lines.transliteration: paykh paykh  man meh hairaanai. ||2||

lines.english: They are at peace, the most exalted of all,
lines.transliteration: so sukhee-aa sabh  tay oot am so-ay.
jaa kai hirdai vasi-aa parabh  so-ay. within whose hearts God dwells.

lines.english: They are stable and unchanging; they do not come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: so-ee nihchal aavai na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: an-din parabh  kay har gun  gaa-ay. ||3||

lines.english: All bow down in humble respect to those
lines.transliteration: taa ka-o karahu sagal namaskaar.
jaa kai man pooran nirankaar. whose minds are filled with the Formless Lord.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੇ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Show mercy unto me, O my Divine Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa mohi thaakur d ayvaa.

lines.english: May Nanak be saved, by serving these humble beings. ||4||2|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1338-8) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhrai jan kee sayvaa. ||4||2||

lines.english: Singing His Glorious Praises, the mind is in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat man ho-ay anand.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate in remembrance on God.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar simra-o bh agvant .

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, the sins go away.
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simran kalmal jaahi.

lines.english: I fall at the Feet of that Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tis gur kee ham charnee paahi. ||1||

lines.english: O beloved Saints, please bless me with wisdom;
lines.transliteration: sumat d ayvhu sant  pi-aaray.
simra-o naam mohi nistaaray. ||1|| rahaa-o. let me meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and be emancipated.||1||Pause||

lines.english: The Guru has shown me the straight path;
lines.transliteration: jin gur kahi-aa maarag seeDhaa.

lines.english: I have abandoned everything else. I am enraptured with the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sagal ti-aag naam har geeDh aa.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru;
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai sad aa bal jaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: I meditate in remembrance on the Lord, through the Guru. ||2||
