lines.transliteration: har simran jis gur tay paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.english: The Guru carries those mortal beings across, and saves them from drowning.
lines.transliteration: boodat paraanee jin gureh t araa-i-aa.

lines.english: By His Grace, they are not enticed by Maya;
lines.transliteration: jis parsaad mohai nahee maa-i-aa.
halat palat  jin gureh savaari-aa. in this world and the next, they are embellished and exalted by the Guru.

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: tis gur oopar sad aa ha-o vaari-aa. ||3||

lines.english: From the most ignorant, I have been made spiritually wise,
lines.transliteration: mahaa mugaDh t ay kee-aa gi-aanee.
gur pooray kee akath kahaanee. through the Unspoken Speech of the Perfect Guru.

lines.english: The Divine Guru, O Nanak, is the Supreme Lord God.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm naanak gurdayv.

lines.english: By great good fortune, I serve the Lord. ||4||3|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1338-15) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag paa-ee-ai har sayv. ||4||3||

lines.english: Eradicating all my pains, He has blessed me with peace, and inspired me to chant His Name.
lines.transliteration: saglay dookh  mitay sukh  dee-ay apnaa naam japaa-i-aa.

lines.english: In His Mercy, He has enjoined me to His service, and has purged me of all my sins.||1||
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apnee sayvaa laa-ay saglaa durat  mitaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I am only a child; I seek the Sanctuary of God the Merciful.
lines.transliteration: ham baarik saran parabh d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Erasing my demerits and faults, God has made me His Own. My Guru, the Lord of theWorld, protects me. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avgan kaat kee-ay parabh  apunay raakh  lee-ay mayrai gur gopaal. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My sicknesses and sins were erased in an instant, when the Lord of the World becamemerciful.
lines.transliteration: taap paap binsay kh in bheetar bha-ay kirpaal gusaa-ee.

lines.english: With each and very breath, I worship and adore the Supreme Lord God; I am asacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saas saas paarbarahm araaDhee apunay sat gur kai bal jaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੇ  ਦੂਖ ਿਮਟੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Infinite. His limits cannot befound.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar bi-ant su-aamee t aa kaa ant  na paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਅਪਨੀ  ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ  ਸਗਲਾ  ਦੁਰਤੁ  ਿਮਟਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: We earn the profit, and become wealthy, meditating on our God. ||3|| pMnw 1339
lines.transliteration: laahaa khaat ho-ee-ai Dh anvant aa apunaa parabh oo Dh i-aa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on the Supreme Lord God; I sing His Glorious Praises forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar paarbarahm Dh i-aa-ee sad aa sad aa gun gaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਪਹਰ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਿਧਆਈ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, my desires have been fulfilled; I have found my Guru, the Supreme LordGod. ||4||4|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1339-2) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak mayray pooray manorath paarbarahm gur paa-i-aa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Meditating in rememberance on the Naam, all my sins have been erased.
lines.transliteration: simrat naam kilbikh  sabh  naasay.

lines.english: The Guru has blessed me with the Capital of the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sach naam gur deenee raasay.

lines.english: God's servants are embellished and exalted in His Court;
lines.transliteration: parabh kee d argeh sobh aavant ay.
sayvak sayv sadaa sohant ay. ||1|| serving Him, they look beauteous forever. ||1||

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu mayray bhaa-ee.

lines.english: All sickness and sin shall be erased; your mind shall be rid of the darkness of ignorance. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: saglay rog dokh  sabh  binsahi agi-aan anDh ayraa man t ay jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru has saved me from death and rebirth, O friend;
lines.transliteration: janam maran gur raakhay meet .

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲੇ  ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਸਿਭ ਿਬਨਸਿਹ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ  ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I am in love with the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kay naam si-o laagee pareet.

lines.english: The suffering of millions of incarnations is gone;
lines.transliteration: kot janam kay ga-ay kalays.
jo tis bh aavai so bh al hos. ||2|| whatever pleases Him is good. ||2||

lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru;
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka-o ha-o sad  bal jaa-ee.
jis parsaad har naam Dh i-aa-ee. by His Grace, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

lines.english: By great good fortune, such a Guru is found;
lines.transliteration: aisaa gur paa-ee-ai vadbhaagee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jis miltay raam liv laagee. ||3|| meeting Him, one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||3||

lines.english: Please be merciful, O Supreme Lord God, O Lord and Master,
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa paarbarahm su-aamee.

lines.english: Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts.
lines.transliteration: sagal ghataa kay ant arjaamee.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I am lovingly attuned to You.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar apunee liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God. ||4||5|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1339-9) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak parabh kee sarnaa-ay. ||4||5||

lines.english: In His Mercy, God has made me His Own.
lines.transliteration: kar kirpaa apunay parabh kee-ay.

lines.english: He has blessed me with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam japan ka-o dee-ay.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun gaa-ay gubind .

lines.english: Fear is dispelled, and all anxiety has been alleviated. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bhai binsay ut ree sabh  chind . ||1||

lines.english: I have been saved, touching the Feet of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ubray satgur charnee laag.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਨ  ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ॥
lines.english: Whatever the Guru says is good and sweet to me. I have renounced the intellectual wisdom of my mind. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jo gur kahai so-ee bhal meeth aa man kee mat  ti-aag. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: That Lord God abides within my mind and body.
lines.transliteration: man tan vasi-aa har parabh  so-ee.

lines.english: There are no conflicts, pains or obstacles.
lines.transliteration: kal kalays kichh bigh an na ho-ee.

lines.english: Forever and ever, God is with my soul.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa parabh  jee-a kai sang.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ  ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਿਤਆਿਗ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Filth and pollution are washed away by the Love of the Name. ||2||
lines.transliteration: utree mail naam kai rang. ||2||

lines.english: I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord;
lines.transliteration: charan kamal si-o laago pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: I am no longer consumed by sexual desire, anger and egotism.
lines.transliteration: binsay kaam kroDh ahaNkaar.

lines.english: Now, I know the way to meet God.
lines.transliteration: parabh milan kaa maarag jaanaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਜੀਅ  ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Through loving devotional worship, my mind is pleased and appeased with the Lord.||3||
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ay bh agat har si-o man maanaaN. ||3||

lines.english: Listen, O friends, Saints, my exalted companions.
lines.transliteration: sun sajan  sant meet  suhaylay.

lines.english: The Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is unfathomable and immeasurable.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan har agah at olay.

lines.english: Forever and ever, sing the Glories of God, the Treasure of Virtue.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa parabh  gun niDh gaa-ee-ai.

lines.english: Says Nanak, by great good fortune, He is found. ||4||6|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1339-15) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak vadbhaagee paa-ee-ai. ||4||6||

lines.english: They are wealthy, and they are the true merchants,
lines.transliteration: say Dhanvant  say-ee sach saahaa.
har kee dargeh naam visaahaa. ||1|| who have the credit of the Naam in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

lines.english: So chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in your mind, my friends.
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man meet.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru is found by great good fortune, and then one's lifestyle becomes perfect and immaculate. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paa-ee-ai vadbhaagee nirmal pooran reet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They earn the profit, and the congratulations pour in;
lines.transliteration: paa-i-aa laabh vajee vaaDh aa-ee.
sant parsaad  har kay gun gaa-ee. ||2|| by the Grace of the Saints, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.english: Their lives are fruitful and prosperous, and their birth is approved;
lines.transliteration: safal janam jeevan parvaan.
gur parsaadee har rang maan. ||3|| by Guru's Grace, they enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away;
lines.transliteration: binsay kaam kroDh ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਰੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, they are carried across to the other shore. ||4||7|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1339-19) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ut reh paar. ||4||7||

lines.english: The Guru is Perfect, and Perfect is His Power. pMnw 1340
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa pooree taa kee kalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਅਟਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is unchanging, forever and ever.
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad sad aa sad  atlaa.

lines.english: All pains and afflictions run away from those, whose minds are filled with the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee jis man vasai. d ookh darad sabh  taa kaa nasai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਸਭੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Imbued with the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har rang raataa man raam gun gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਾ  ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: They are liberated, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mukto saaDh oo Dh ooree naavai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, they are carried across to the other shore;
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee utray paar.
bha-o bh aram binsay bikaar. they are rid of fear, doubt and corruption.

lines.english: The Guru's Feet abide deep within their minds and bodies.
lines.transliteration: man tan ant ar basay gur charnaa.

lines.english: The Holy are fearless; they take to the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: nirbhai saaDh  paray har sarnaa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: They are blessed with abundant bliss, happiness, pleasure and peace.
lines.transliteration: anad sahj ras sookh  ghanayray.

lines.english: Enemies and pains do not even approach them.
lines.transliteration: dusman d ookh na aavai nayray.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru makes them His Own, and protects them.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai apunay kar raakhay.

lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are rid of all their sins. ||3||
lines.transliteration: har naam japat kilbikh  sabh  laathay. ||3||

lines.english: The Saints, spiritual companions and Sikhs are exalted and uplifted.
lines.transliteration: sant saajan sikh  bha-ay suhaylay.

lines.english: The Perfect Guru leads them to meet God.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai parabh si-o lai maylay.

lines.english: The painful noose of death and rebirth is snapped.
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh  faahaa kaati-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru covers their faults. ||4||8|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1340-6) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur parh-d aa dh aaki-aa. ||4||8||

lines.english: The Perfect True Guru has bestowed the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur poorai naam d ee-aa.

lines.english: I am blessed with bliss and happiness, emancipation and eternal peace. All my affairs have been resolved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: anad mangal kali-aan  sadaa sukh  kaaraj saglaa raas thee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The Lotus Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gur kay man voothay.

lines.english: I am rid of pain, suffering, doubt and fraud. ||1||
lines.transliteration: dookh  darad bharam binsay jh oothay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਦ  ਮੰਗਲ  ਕਿਲਆਣ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਗਲਾ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਥੀਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Rise early, and sing the Glorious Word of God's Bani.
lines.transliteration: nit uth  gaavhu parabh  kee ban ee.

lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, O mortal. ||2||
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har simrahu paraan ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਿਨ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
lines.english: Inwardly and outwardly, God is everywhere.
lines.transliteration: ghar baahar parabh  sabh nee thaa-ee.

lines.english: Wherever I go, He is always with me, my Helper and Support. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sang sahaa-ee jah ha-o jaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer.
lines.transliteration: du-ay kar jorh  karee ard aas.

lines.english: O Nanak, I meditate forever on the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||4||9|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1340-10) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: sadaa japay naanak gunt aas. ||4||9||

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God is All-wise and All-knowing.
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm parabh sugh arh sujaan .

lines.english: The Perfect Guru is found by great good fortune. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paa-ee-ai vadbhaagee d arsan ka-o jaa-ee-ai kurbaan . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: My sins are cut away, through the Word of the Shabad, and I have foundcontentment.
lines.transliteration: kilbikh maytay sabad  santokh.

lines.english: I have become worthy of worshipping the Naam in adoration.
lines.transliteration: naam araaDhan ho-aa jog.

lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have been enlightened.
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang ho-aa pargaas.

lines.english: The Lord's Lotus Feet abide within my mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man maahi nivaas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ  ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The One who made us, protects and preserves us.
lines.transliteration: jin kee-aa tin lee-aa raakh .

lines.english: God is Perfect, the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: parabh pooraa anaath kaa naath.

lines.english: Those, upon whom He showers His Mercy
lines.transliteration: jisahi nivaajay kirpaa Dhaar.
pooran karam taa kay aachaar. ||2|| - they have perfect karma and conduct. ||2||

lines.english: They sing the Glories of God, continually, continuously, forever fresh and new.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai nit  nit nit navay.

lines.english: They do not wander in the 8.4 million incarnations.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh jon na bh avay.

lines.english: Here and hereafter, they worship the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: eehaaN oohaaN charan poojaaray.

lines.english: Their faces are radiant, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: mukh oojal saachay d arbaaray. ||3||

lines.english: That person, upon whose forehead the Guru places His Hand
lines.transliteration: jis mastak gur Dh ari-aa haath.
kot maDhay ko virlaa d aas. - out of millions, how rare is that slave.

lines.english: He sees God pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky.
lines.transliteration: jal thal mahee-al paykhai bh arpoor.

lines.english: Nanak is saved by the dust of the feet of such a humble being. ||4||10|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1340-17) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak uDhras t is jan kee Dh oor. ||4||10||

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to my Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: kurbaan jaa-ee gur pooray apnay.

lines.english: By His Grace, I chant and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jis parsaad har har jap japnay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Listening to the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, I am exalted and enraptured.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee sun at nihaal.

lines.english: My corrupt and poisonous entanglements are gone. ||1||
lines.transliteration: binas ga-ay bikhi-aa janjaal. ||1||

lines.english: I am in love with the True Word of His Shabad.
lines.transliteration: saach sabad si-o laagee pareet .

lines.english: The Lord God has come into my consciousness. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har parabh apunaa aa-i-aa cheet . ||2||

lines.english: Chanting the Naam, I am enlightened. pMnw 1341
lines.transliteration: naam japat ho-aa pargaas.

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has come to dwell within my heart. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur sabday keenaa rid ai nivaas. ||3||

lines.english: The Guru is All-powerful and Merciful forever.
lines.transliteration: gur samrath sadaa d a-i-aal.

lines.english: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, Nanak is exalted and enraptured. ||4||11|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1341-2) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: har jap jap naanak bha-ay nihaal. ||4||11||

lines.english: Chanting Guru, Guru, I have found eternal peace.
lines.transliteration: gur gur karat sad aa sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: God, Merciful to the meek, has become kind and compassionate; He has inspired me to chant His Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: deen d a-i-aal bh a-ay kirpaalaa apn aa naam aap japaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Joining the Society of the Saints, I am illumined and enlightened.
lines.transliteration: santsangat  mil bh a-i-aa pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਇਆਲ  ਭਏ ਿਕਰਪਾਲਾ  ਅਪਣਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਆਿਪ  ਜਪਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my hopes have been fulfilled. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har har japat pooran bh a-ee aas. ||1||

lines.english: I am blessed with total salvation, and my mind is filled with peace.
lines.transliteration: sarab kali-aan sookh  man vooth ay.

lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; O Nanak, the Guru has been gracious to me.||2||12|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 Gru 2 ibBws  (1341-6) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5 gh ar 2 bibh aas Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Bibhaas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1341-6) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: har gun gaa-ay gur naanak t oothay. ||2||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪਤ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਭਈ ਆਸ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: There is no other place of rest,
lines.transliteration: avar na doojaa th aa-o.
naahee bin har naa-o. none at all, without the Lord's Name.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
lines.english: There is total success and salvation,
lines.transliteration: sarab siDh kali-aan.
pooran hohi sagal kaam. ||1|| and all affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||

lines.english: Constantly chant the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har ko naam japee-ai neet.

lines.english: Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away; let yourself fall in love with the OneLord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ahaNkaar binsai lagai aykai pareet . ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, pain runs away. In His Sanctuary, Hecherishes and sustains us.
lines.transliteration: naam laagai dookh  bhaagai saran paalan jog.

lines.english: Whoever has such pre-ordained destiny meets with the True Guru; the Messenger ofDeath cannot grab him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai jam na t aytai jis Dh ur hovai sanjog. ||2||

lines.english: Night and day, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; abandon the doubts of your mind.
lines.transliteration: rain dinas Dh i-aa-ay har har t ajahu man kay bh aram.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਲਗੈ ਏਕੈ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: One who has perfect karma joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meets the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  har milai jisahi pooran karam. ||3||

lines.english: The sins of countless lifetimes are erased, and one is protected by the Lord Himself.
lines.transliteration: janam janam bikhaad  binsay raakh  leenay aap.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਪਾਲਨ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: He is our Mother, Father, Friend and Sibling; O servant Nanak, meditate on the Lord,Har, Har. ||4||1||13|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ibBws pVqwl  (1341-12) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5 bibh aas parh -taal Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Bibhaas, Partaal: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1341-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa meet  bhaa-ee jan naanak har har jaap. ||4||1||13||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਤੇਟੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਧੁਿਰ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
lines.transliteration: ram raam raam raam jaap.

lines.punjabi: ਰੈਿਨ ਿਦਨਸੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਤਜਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ  ॥
lines.english: Conflict, suffering, greed and emotional attachment shall be dispelled, and the fever ofegotism shall be relieved. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: kal kalays lobh moh binas jaa-ay ahaN taap. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Renounce your selfishness, and grasp the feet of the Saints; your mind shall besanctified, and your sins shall be taken away. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aap ti-aag sant  charan laag man pavit  jaahi paap. ||1||

lines.english: Nanak, the child, does not know anything at all. O God, please protect me; You aremy Mother and Father. ||2||1||14|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1341-15) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak baarik kachhoo na jaanai raakh an ka-o parabh  maa-ee baap. ||2||1||14||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਾਿਪ  ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩॥
lines.english: I have taken the Shelter and Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal saran tayk.

lines.english: You are Lofty and Exalted, Grand and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; You alone are above all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: ooch mooch bay-ant th aakur sarab oopar t uhee ayk. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: He is the Support of the breath of life, the Destroyer of pain, the Giver ofdiscriminating understanding. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paraan aDhaar d ukh bidaar dainhaar buDh  bibayk. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਕਲੇਸ  ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇ  ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.english: So bow down in respect to the Savior Lord; worship and adore the One God.
lines.transliteration: namaskaar rakhan haar man araaDh  parabh oo mayk.

lines.english: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints, Nanak is blessed with countless comforts. ||2||2||15|| pMnw 1342 pRBwqI AstpdIAw mhlw 1 ibBws  (1342-1) parbhaat ee asatpad ee-aa mehlaa 1 bibh aas Prabhaatee, Ashtapadees, First Mehl, Bibhaas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1342-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: sant rayn kara-o majan naanak paavai sukh  anayk. ||2||2||15||

lines.english: The insanity of duality has driven the mind insane.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa ba-uree man ba-uraa-i-aa.

lines.english: In false greed, life is wasting away.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ai laalach janam gavaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Duality clings to the mind; it cannot be restrained.
lines.transliteration: lapat rahee fun banDh na paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਲਪਿਟ  ਰਹੀ ਫੁਿਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru saves us, implanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord within. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur raakh ay naam drirh -aa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Without subduing the mind, Maya cannot be subdued.
lines.transliteration: naa man marai na maa-i-aa marai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The One who created this, He alone understands. Contemplating the Word of theShabad, one is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jin kichh kee-aa so-ee jaan ai sabad  veechaar bh a-o saagar t arai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Gathering the wealth of Maya, kings become proud and arrogant.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa sanch raajay ahaNkaaree.

lines.english: But this Maya that they love so much shall not go along with them in the end.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa saath na chalai pi-aaree.

lines.english: There are so many colors and flavors of attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mamtaa hai baho rangee.

lines.english: Except for the Name, no one has any friend or companion. ||2||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko saath na sangee. ||2||

lines.english: According to one's own mind, one sees the minds of others.
lines.transliteration: ji-o man daykh eh par man t aisaa.

lines.english: According to one's desires, one's condition is determined.
lines.transliteration: jaisee mansaa taisee d asaa.

lines.english: According to one's actions, one is focused and tuned in.
lines.transliteration: jaisaa karam taisee liv laavai.

lines.english: Seeking the advice of the True Guru, one finds the home of peace and poise. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur poochh  sahj gh ar paavai. ||3||

lines.english: In music and song, the mind is caught by the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: raag naad man d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.english: Filled with deception deep within, one suffers in terrible pain.
lines.transliteration: antar kapat mahaa d ukh paa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with clear understanding,
lines.transliteration: satgur bh aytai sojh ee paa-ay.
sachai naam rahai liv laa-ay. ||4|| and remains lovingly attuned to the True Name. ||4||

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, one practices Truth.
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sach kamaavai.

lines.english: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani.
lines.transliteration: sachee banee har gun  gaavai.

lines.english: He dwells in the home of his own heart deep within, and obtains the immortal status.
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaas amar pad  paavai.

lines.english: Then, he is blessed with honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: taa dar saachai sobh aa paavai. ||5||

lines.english: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship,
lines.transliteration: gur sayvaa bin bhagat  na ho-ee.
anayk jatan karai jay ko-ee. even though one may make all sorts of efforts.

lines.english: If one eradicates egotism and selfishness through the Shabad,
lines.transliteration: ha-umai mayraa sabday kh o-ee.
nirmal naam vasai man so-ee. ||6|| the Immaculate Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||6||

lines.english: In this world, the practice of the Shabad is the most excellent occupation.
lines.transliteration: is jag meh sabad karn ee hai saar.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, everything else is the darkness of emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai hor moh gubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਰਣੀ  ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Through the Shabad, the Naam is enshrined within the heart.
lines.transliteration: sabday naam rakh ai ur Dh aar.

lines.english: Through the Shabad, one obtains clear understanding and the door of salvation. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sabday gat  mat mokh  du-aar. ||7||

lines.english: There is no other Creator except the All-seeing Lord God.
lines.transliteration: avar naahee kar daykh anhaaro.

lines.english: The True Lord Himself is Infinite and Incomparably Beautiful.
lines.transliteration: saachaa aap anoop apaaro.

lines.english: Through the Lord's Name, one obtains the most sublime and exalted state.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ootam gat  ho-ee.

lines.english: O Nanak, how rare are those humble beings, who seek and find the Lord. ||8||1|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1342-13) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak khoj lahai jan ko-ee. ||8||1||

lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is spread out all over the world.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi sagal jag chhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: Seeing a beautiful woman, the man is overcome with sexual desire.
lines.transliteration: kaaman d aykh kaam lobh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: His love for his children and gold steadily increases.
lines.transliteration: sut kanchan si-o hayt  vaDh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: He sees everything as his own, but he does not own the One Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  apnaa ik raam paraa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: I meditate as I chant on such a mala,
lines.transliteration: aisaa jaap japa-o japmaalee.
dukh sukh  parhar bh agat niraalee. ||1|| rahaa-o. that I rise above pleasure and pain; I attain the most wondrous devotional worship ofthe Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.english: O Treasure of Virtue, Your limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan tayraa ant  na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Through the True Word of the Shabad, I am absorbed into You.
lines.transliteration: saach sabad t ujh maahi samaa-i-aa.

lines.english: You Yourself created the comings and goings of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: aavaa ga-on t uDh aap rachaa-i-aa.

lines.english: They alone are devotees, who focus their consciousness on You. ||2||
lines.transliteration: say-ee bhagat  jin sach chit  laa-i-aa. ||2||

lines.english: Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the Lord, the Lord of Nirvaanaa
lines.transliteration: gi-aan Dhi-aan narhar nirbaan ee.
bin satgur bh aytay ko-ay na jaan ee. - without meeting the True Guru, no one knows this.

lines.english: The Lord's Light fills the sacred pools of all beings.
lines.transliteration: sagal sarovar jot samaan ee.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to the Embodiment of Bliss. ||3||
lines.transliteration: aanad roop vitahu kurbaan ee. ||3||

lines.english: Through the Guru's Teachings, one achieves loving devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-o bh agat gurmat ee paa-ay.

lines.english: The Shabad burns away egotism from within. pMnw 1343
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vichahu sabad jalaa-ay.

lines.english: Dhaavat  raakh ai thaak rahaa-ay. The wandering mind is restrained and held in its place.
The True Name is enshrined in the mind. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam man vasaa-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The exciting and intoxicating worldly plays come to an end,
lines.transliteration: bisam binod rahay parmaad ee.
gurmat maani-aa ayk liv laagee. for those who accept the Guru's Teachings, and become lovingly attuned to the OneLord.

lines.english: Seeing this, the fire in the water is extinguished.
lines.transliteration: daykh  nivaari-aa jal meh aagee.

lines.english: They alone realize this, who are blessed by great good fortune. ||5||
lines.transliteration: so boojhai hovai vadbh aagee. ||5||

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, doubt is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay bh aram chukaa-ay.

lines.english: Those who are lovingly attuned to the True Lord remain awake and aware night and day.
lines.transliteration: an-din jaagai sach liv laa-ay.

lines.english: They know the One Lord, and no other.
lines.transliteration: ayko jaanai avar na ko-ay.

lines.english: Serving the Giver of peace, they become immaculate. ||6||
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata sayvay nirmal ho-ay. ||6||

lines.english: Selfless service and intuitive awareness come by reflecting upon the Word of theShabad.
lines.transliteration: sayvaa surat sabad  veechaar.

lines.english: Chanting, intensive meditation and austere self-discipline come by subduing the ego.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam ha-umai maar.

lines.english: One becomes Jivan-mukta - liberated while yet alive, by listening to the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: jeevan mukat jaa sabad  sunaa-ay.

lines.english: Living a truthful way of life, one finds true peace. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sachee rahat sachaa sukh  paa-ay. ||7||

lines.english: The Giver of peace is the Eradicator of pain.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d aata dukh maytan haaraa.

lines.english: I cannot conceive of serving any other.
lines.transliteration: avar na soojhas beejee kaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਆਗੈ  ਰਾਿਖਆ  ॥
lines.english: I place my body, mind and wealth in offering before Him.
lines.transliteration: tan man Dh an har aagai raakh i-aa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, I have tasted the supreme, sublime Essence of the Lord. ||8||2|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1343-6) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai mahaa ras chaakhi-aa. ||8||2||

lines.english: You may perform exercises of inner purification, and fire up the furnace of the Kundalini, inhaling and exhaling and holding the breath.
lines.transliteration: nivlee karam bhu-angam bh aathee raychak poorak kumbh  karai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਵਲੀ  ਕਰਮ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ  ਭਾਠੀ  ਰੇਚਕ  ਪੂਰਕ  ਕੁੰਭ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, you will not understand; deluded by doubt, you shall drownand die.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kichh  sojhee naahee bh armay bh oolaa bood marai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ  ਭਰਮੇ  ਭੂਲਾ ਬੂਿਡ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The spiritually blind are filled with filth and pollution; they may wash, but the filthwithin shall never depart.
lines.transliteration: anDhaa bh ari-aa bh ar bhar Dh ovai ant ar kee mal kad ay na lahai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਾ ਭਿਰਆ  ਭਿਰ ਭਿਰ ਧੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਰ  ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all their actions are useless, like themagician who deceives through illuions. ||1||
lines.transliteration: naam binaa fokat sabh karmaa ji-o baajeegar bh aram bh ulai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨਾ  ਫੋਕਟ  ਸਿਭ ਕਰਮਾ  ਿਜਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਿਮ ਭੁਲੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The merits of the six religious rituals are obtained through the Immaculate Naam.
lines.transliteration: khat karam naam niranjan so-ee.

lines.english: You, O Lord, are the Ocean of virtue; I am so unworthy. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: too gun  saagar avgun  mohee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Running around chasing the entanglements of Maya is an evil-minded act of corruption.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa DhanDh aa Dh aavnee durmat  kaar bikaar.

lines.english: The fool makes a show of his self-conceit; he does not know how to behave.
lines.transliteration: moorakh aap gan aa-idaa boojh  na sakai kaar.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is enticed by his desires for Maya; his words are useless andempty.
lines.transliteration: mansaa maa-i-aa mohnee manmukh  bol kh u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ  ਗਣਾਇਦਾ  ਬੂਿਝ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The ritual cleansings of the sinner are fradulent; his rituals and decorations areuseless and empty. ||2||
lines.transliteration: majan jhooth aa chandaal kaa fokat chaar seeNgaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਸਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੋਲ ਖੁਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: False is the wisdom of the mind; its actions inspire useless disputes.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ee man kee mat  hai karn ee baad  bibaad .

lines.punjabi: ਮਜਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਚੰਡਾਲ  ਕਾ ਫੋਕਟ  ਚਾਰ ਸੀਂਗਾਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The false are filled with egotism; they do not obtain the sublime taste of their Lordand Master.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ay vich ahankaran  hai kh asam na paavai saad .

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ ਹੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਿਦ  ਿਬਬਾਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Name, whatever else they do is tasteless and insipid.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai hor kamaavanaa fikaa aavai saad .

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੇ ਿਵਿਚ  ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ  ਹੈ ਖਸਮ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
lines.english: Associating with their enemies, they are plundered and ruined. Their speech is poison,and their lives are useless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: dustee sabh aa viguchee-ai bikh  vaatee jeevan  baad . ||3||

lines.english: Do not be deluded by doubt; do not invite your own death.
lines.transliteration: ay bharam bh oolay marahu na ko-ee.

lines.english: Serve the True Guru, and you shall be at peace forever.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sad aa sukh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one is liberated.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur mukat  kinai na paa-ee.

lines.english: They come and go in reincarnation; they die, only to be reborn and die again. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaaNhi mareh mar jaa-ee. ||4||

lines.english: This body wanders, caught in the three dispositions.
lines.transliteration: ayhu sareer hai tarai gun  Dhaat.

lines.english: It is afflicted by sorrow and suffering.
lines.transliteration: is no vi-aapai sog santaap.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.english: So serve the One who has no mother or father.
lines.transliteration: so sayvhu jis maa-ee na baap.

lines.english: Desire and selfishness shall depart from within. ||5||
lines.transliteration: vichahu chookai tisnaa ar aap. ||5||

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see Him.
lines.transliteration: jah jah daykh aa tah tah so-ee.

lines.english: Without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh aytay mukat  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Enshrine the True One in your heart; this is the most excellent action.
lines.transliteration: hirdai sach ayh karn ee saar.

lines.english: All other hypocritical actions and devotions bring only ruin. ||6||
lines.transliteration: hor sabh pakh and pooj kh u-aar. ||6||

lines.english: When one is rid of duality, then he realizes the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: dubiDh aa chookai t aaN sabad  pachh aan.

lines.english: Inside and out, he knows the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: ghar baahar ayko kar jaan .

lines.english: This is the most Excellent Wisdom of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ayhaa mat sabad  hai saar.

lines.english: Ashes fall on the heads of those who are in duality. ||7||
lines.transliteration: vich dubiDh aa maathai pavai chh aar. ||7||

lines.english: To praise the Lord through the Guru's Teachings is the most excellent action.
lines.transliteration: karnee keerat  gurmat  saar.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, contemplate the Glories of God and His spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa gun  gi-aan beechaar.

lines.english: Whoever subdues his mind, knows the state of being dead while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: man maaray jeevat mar jaan .

lines.english: O Nanak, by His Grace, the Gracious Lord is realized. ||8||3|| pMnw 1344 pRBwqI mhlw 1 dKxI ] (1344-1) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1 d akh-nee. Prabhaatee, First Mehl, Dakhnee:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree nad ar pachh aan. ||8||3||

lines.english: Ahalyaa was the wife of Gautam the seer. Seeing her, Indra was enticed.
lines.transliteration: gotam t apaa ahili-aa ist aree t is daykh indar lubh aa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਤਮੁ  ਤਪਾ ਅਿਹਿਲਆ  ਇਸਤਰ੍ੀ  ਿਤਸੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਇੰਦਰ੍ੁ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: When he received a thousand marks of disgrace on his body, then he felt regret in his mind. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sahas sareer chihan bhag hoo-ay t aa man pachh otaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸ  ਸਰੀਰ ਿਚਹਨ  ਭਗ ਹੂਏ ਤਾ ਮਿਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Siblings of Destiny, no one knowingly makes mistakes.
lines.transliteration: ko-ee jaan na bh oolai bh aa-ee.

lines.english: He alone is mistaken, whom the Lord Himself makes so. He alone understands, whomthe Lord causes to understand. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: so bhoolai jis aap bh ulaa-ay boojh ai jisai bujh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਭੂਲੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਿਪ  ਭੁਲਾਏ  ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Harichand, the king and ruler of his land, did not appreciate the value of his pre-ordained destiny.
lines.transliteration: tin haree chand  parithmee pat  raajai kaagad  keem na paa-ee.

lines.english: If he had known that it was a mistake, he would not have made such a show of givingin charity, and he would not have been sold in the market. ||2||
lines.transliteration: a-ugan jaan ai ta punn karay ki-o ki-o naykh aas bikaa-ee. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਨ  ਹਰੀ ਚੰਿਦ  ਿਪਰ੍ਥਮੀ  ਪਿਤ ਰਾਜੈ ਕਾਗਿਦ  ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord took the form of a dwarf, and asked for some land.
lines.transliteration: kara-o adhaa-ee Dh artee maaNgee baavan roop bahaanai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਉਗਣੁ  ਜਾਣੈ  ਤ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਰੇ ਿਕਉ  ਿਕਉ  ਨੇਖਾਿਸ  ਿਬਕਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: If Bal the king has recognized Him, he would not have been deceived, and sent to the underworld. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ki-o pa-i-aal jaa-ay ki-o chhalee-ai jay bal roop pachh aanai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਉ  ਅਢਾਈ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਮਗੀ  ਬਾਵਨ  ਰੂਿਪ ਬਹਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Vyaas taught and warned the king Janmayjaa not to do three things.
lines.transliteration: raajaa janmayjaa day mat eeN baraj bi-aas parhHaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ ਪਇਆਿਲ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਕਉ  ਛਲੀਐ  ਜੇ ਬਿਲ ਰੂਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: But he performed the sacred feast and killed eighteen Brahmins; the record of one'spast deeds cannot be erased. ||4||
lines.transliteration: tiniH kar jag ath aarah gh aa-ay kirat  na chalai chalaa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜਾ  ਜਨਮੇਜਾ  ਦੇ ਮਤੀ ਬਰਿਜ  ਿਬਆਿਸ ਪੜਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I do not try to calculate the account; I accept the Hukam of God's Command. I speakwith intuitive love and respect.
lines.transliteration: ganat  na gan eeN hukam pachh aanaa bolee bh aa-ay subh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਨ  ਕਿਰ ਜਗ ਅਠਾਰਹ  ਘਾਏ  ਿਕਰਤੁ  ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: No matter what happens, I will praise the Lord. It is all Your Glorious Greatness, OLord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh vart ai tuDhai salaaheeN sabh  tayree vadi-aa-ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗਣਤ  ਨ ਗਣੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਬੋਲੀ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੁਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh remains detached; filth never attaches itself to him. He remains foreverin God's Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh alipat  layp kad ay na laagai sad aa rahai sarn aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਤੁਧੈ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਿਡਆਈ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not think of the future; he is overtaken by pain,and then he regrets. ||6||
lines.transliteration: manmukh mugaDh  aagai chayt ai naahee d ukh laagai pachh utaa-ee. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅਿਲਪਤੁ  ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator who created this creation acts, and causes all to act.
lines.transliteration: aapay karay karaa-ay kartaa jin ayh rachnaa rachee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਮੁਗਧੁ  ਆਗੈ  ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਦੁਿਖ ਲਾਗੈ  ਪਛੁਤਾਈ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O Lord, egotistical pride does not depart from the soul. Falling into egotistical pride, one is ruined. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har abhimaan na jaa-ee jee-ahu abh imaanay pai pachee-ai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ  ਰਚੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Creator does not make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: bhulan  vich kee-aa sabh  ko-ee kart aa aap na bh ulai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਜੀਅਹੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੇ  ਪੈ ਪਚੀਐ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, salvation comes through the True Name. By Guru's Grace, one is released.||8||4|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1344-11) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak sach naam nistaaraa ko gur parsaad  aghulai. ||8||4||

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਲਣ ਿਵਿਚ  ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤਾ  ਆਿਪ  ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
lines.english: To chant and listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my Support.
lines.transliteration: aakh-n aa sunn aa naam aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਚ ਨਾਿਮ  ਿਨਸਤਾਰਾ  ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਅਘੁਲੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.english: DhanDh aa chh utak ga-i-aa vaykaar. Worthless entanglements are ended and gone.
The self-willed manmukh, caught in duality, loses his honor.
lines.transliteration: ji-o manmukh d oojai pat  kho-ee.

lines.english: Except for the Name, I have no other at all. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin naavai mai avar na ko-ee. ||1||

lines.english: Listen, O blind, foolish, idiotic mind.
lines.transliteration: sun man anDh ay moorakh  gavaar.

lines.english: Aren't you ashamed of your comings and goings in reincarnation? Without the Guru, you shall drown, over and over again. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat  laaj nahee laagai bin gur boodai baaro baar. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: This mind is ruined by its attachment to Maya.
lines.transliteration: is man maa-i-aa mohi binaas.

lines.english: Dhur hukam likh i-aa taaN kahee-ai kaas. The Command of the Primal Lord is pre-ordained. Before whom should I cry?

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਲਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh virlaa cheenHai ko-ee.

lines.english: Without the Naam, no one is liberated. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonaa mukat na ho-ee. ||2||

lines.english: People wander lost, staggering and stumbling through 8.4 million incarnations.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh aram dolai lakh  cha-uraasee.

lines.english: Without knowing the Guru, they cannot escape the noose of Death.
lines.transliteration: bin gur boojhay jam kee faasee.

lines.english: This mind, from one moment to the next, goes from the heavens to the underworld.
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa khin kh in oobh  pa-i-aal.

lines.english: The Gurmukh contemplates the Naam, and is released. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh chh ootai naam samHaal. ||3||

lines.english: When God sends His Summons, there is no time to delay.
lines.transliteration: aapay saday dh il na ho-ay.

lines.english: When one dies in the Word of the Shabad, he lives in peace.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai sahilaa jeevai so-ay.

lines.english: Without the Guru, no one understands.
lines.transliteration: bin gur sojhee kisai na ho-ay.

lines.english: The Lord Himself acts, and inspires all to act. ||4||
lines.transliteration: aapay karai karaavai so-ay. ||4||

lines.english: Inner conflict comes to an end, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jhagarh  chukh aavai har gun  gaavai.

lines.english: Through the Perfect True Guru, one is intuitively absorbed into the Lord.
lines.transliteration: pooraa satgur sahj samaavai.

lines.english: This wobbling, unsteady mind is stabilized,
lines.transliteration: ih man dolat t a-o th ehraavai.
sach karnee kar kaar kamaavai. ||5|| and one lives the lifestyle of true actions. ||5||

lines.english: If someone is false within his own self, then how can he be pure?
lines.transliteration: antar jooth aa ki-o such ho-ay.

lines.english: How rare are those who wash with the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: sabdee Dh ovai virlaa ko-ay.

lines.english: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, live the Truth.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ko-ee sach kamaavai.

lines.english: Their comings and goings in reincarnation are over and done. ||6|| pMnw 1345
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan aa thaak rahaavai. ||6||

lines.english: Those who eat and drink the Fear of God, find the most excellent peace.
lines.transliteration: bha-o kh aanaa peen aa sukh  saar.

lines.english: Associating with the humble servants of the Lord, they are carried across.
lines.transliteration: har jan sangat paavai paar.

lines.english: They speak the Truth, and lovingly inspire others to speak it as well.
lines.transliteration: sach bolai bolaavai pi-aar.

lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the most excellent occupation. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad karn ee hai saar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ  ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who take the Lord's Praises as their karma and Dharma, their honor andworship service
lines.transliteration: har jas karam Dharam pat  poojaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ  ਧਰਮੁ  ਪਿਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh agnee meh bh ooNjaa. - their sexual desire and anger are burnt off in the fire.

lines.english: They taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and their minds are drenched with it.
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakhi-aa t a-o man bh eejaa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਿਖਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ  ॥
lines.english: Prays Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||5|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1345-3) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1. Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naanak avar na d oojaa. ||8||5||

lines.english: Chant the Lord's Name, and worship Him deep within your being.
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap antar poojaa.

lines.english: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and no other. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur sabad veechaar avar nahee d oojaa. ||1||

lines.english: The One is pervading all places.
lines.transliteration: ayko rav rahi-aa sabh th aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: I do not see any other; unto whom should I offer worship? ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: avar na deesai kis pooj charh aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: I place my mind and body in offering before You; I dedicate my soul to You.
lines.transliteration: man tan aagai jee-arh aa tujh paas.

lines.english: As it pleases You, You save me, Lord; this is my prayer. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ji-o bhaavai t i-o rakh ahu ard aas. ||2||

lines.english: True is that tongue which is delighted by the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sach jihvaa har rasan rasaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ  ਜੀਅੜਾ  ਤੁਝ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one is saved in the Sanctuary of God. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gurmat chh ootas parabh  sarnaa-ee. ||3||

lines.english: My God created religious rituals.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam parabh  mayrai kee-ay.

lines.english: He placed the glory of the Naam above these rituals. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naam vadaa-ee sir karmaaN kee-ay. ||4||

lines.english: The four great blessings are under the control of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai vas chaar pad aarath.

lines.english: When the first three are put aside, one is blessed with the fourth. ||5||
lines.transliteration: teen samaa-ay ayk kirt aarath. ||5||

lines.english: Those whom the True Guru blesses with liberation and meditation
lines.transliteration: satgur d ee-ay mukat  Dhi-aanaaN.
har pad cheeneh bh a-ay parDh aanaa. ||6|| realize the Lord's State, and become sublime. ||6||

lines.english: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed; the Guru imparts this understanding.
lines.transliteration: man tan seet al gur boojh  bujhaa-ee.

lines.english: Who can estimate the value of those whom God has exalted? ||7||
lines.transliteration: parabh nivaajay kin keemat  paa-ee. ||7||

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has imparted this understanding;
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur boojh bujh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਗੁਿਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naam binaa gat kinai na paa-ee. ||8||6|| without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is emancipated. ||8||6|| pRBwqI mhlw 1 ] (1345-10) parbhaat ee mehlaa 1.

lines.english: Some are forgiven by the Primal Lord God; the Perfect Guru makes the true making.
lines.transliteration: ik Dhur bakh as la-ay gur poorai sachee ban at banaa-ee.

lines.english: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord are imbued with Truth forever; their pains are dispelled, and they obtain honor. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har rang raatay sad aa rang saachaa d ukh bisray pat  paa-ee. ||1||

lines.english: False are the clever tricks of the evil-minded.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ee durmat  kee chat uraa-ee.

lines.english: They shall disappear in no time at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: binsat baar na laagai kaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਧੁਿਰ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲਏ ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੀ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Pain and suffering afflict the self-willed manmukh. The pains of the self-willedmanmukh shall never depart.
lines.transliteration: manmukh ka-o d ukh darad vi-aapas manmukh  dukh na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ  ਦੁਖ ਿਬਸਰੇ  ਪਿਤ ਪਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh recognizes the Giver of pleasure and pain. He merges in His Sanctuary.||2||
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh daataa gurmukh  jaataa mayl la-ay sarn aa-ee. ||2||

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know loving devotional worship; they are insane,rotting away in their egotism.
lines.transliteration: manmukh t ay abh  bhagat na hovas ha-umai pacheh d ivaanay.

lines.english: This mind flies in an instant from the heavens to the underworld, as long as it doesnot know the Word of the Shabad. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ih manoo-aa khin oobh  paa-i-aalee jab lag sabad  na jaanay. ||3||

lines.english: The world has become hungry and thirsty; without the True Guru, it is not satisfied.
lines.transliteration: bhookh  pi-aasaa jag bh a-i-aa t ipat nahee bin sat gur paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ  ਿਵਆਪਿਸ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Merging intuitively in the Celestial Lord, peace is obtained, and one goes to the Lord's Court wearing robes of honor. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sahjai sahj milai sukh paa-ee-ai d argeh paiDh aa jaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਜਾਤਾ  ਮੇਿਲ ਲਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lord in His Court is Himself the Knower and Seer; the Word of the Guru's Bani isImmaculate.
lines.transliteration: dargeh d aanaa beenaa ik aapay nirmal gur kee ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਤੇ ਅਭ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਿਸ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਪਚਿਹ  ਿਦਵਾਨੇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is the Awareness of Truth; He Himself understands the state of nirvaanaa.||5||
lines.transliteration: aapay surtaa sach veechaaras aapay boojh ai pad  nirbaan ee. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਿਖਨੁ ਊਿਭ ਪਇਆਲੀ  ਜਬ ਲਿਗ  ਸਬਦ  ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: He made the waves of water, the fire and the air, and then joined the three togetherto form the world.
lines.transliteration: jal tarang agnee pavnai fun t arai mil jagat  upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਖ ਿਪਆਸਾ  ਜਗੁ ਭਇਆ  ਿਤਪਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: He blessed these elements with such power, that they remain subject to HisCommand. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aisaa bal chhal t in ka-o d ee-aa hukmee th aak rahaa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜੈ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.english: How rare are those humble beings in this world, whom the Lord tests and places inHis Treasury.
lines.transliteration: aisay jan virlay jag andar parakh  khajaanai paa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਗਹ  ਦਾਨਾ  ਬੀਨਾ  ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: They rise above social status and color, and rid themselves of possessiveness andgreed. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jaat varan t ay bh a-ay at eetaa mamt aa lobh  chukaa-i-aa. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸੁਰਤਾ  ਸਚੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਸ  ਆਪੇ  ਬੂਝੈ ਪਦੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੀ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are like immaculate sacred shrines; they are rid of the pain and pollution of egotism.
lines.transliteration: naam ratay t irath say nirmal d ukh ha-umai mail chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲੁ ਤਰੰਗ  ਅਗਨੀ ਪਵਨੈ  ਫੁਿਨ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਿਮਿਲ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak washes the feet of those who, as Gurmukh, love the True Lord. ||8||7|| pMnw 1346 pRBwqI mhlw 3 ibBws  (1346-2) parbhaat ee mehlaa 3 bibh aas Prabhaatee, Third Mehl, Bibhaas: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1346-2) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kay charan pakh aalai jinaa gurmukh  saachaa bh aa-i-aa. ||8||7||

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, see that the Temple of the Lord is within you.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee vaykh t oo har mand ar tayrai naal.

lines.english: The Temple of the Lord is found through the Word of the Shabad; contemplate the Lord's Name. ||1||
lines.transliteration: har mandar sabd ay kh ojee-ai har naamo layho samHaal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਵੇਖੁ ਤੂ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O my mind, be joyfully attuned to the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: man mayray sabad rapai rang ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ  ਖੋਜੀਐ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੋ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: True is devotional worship, and True is the Temple of the Lord; True is His ManifestGlory. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagat  sachaa har mand ar pargatee saachee so-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: This body is the Temple of the Lord, in which the jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed.
lines.transliteration: har mandar ayhu sareer hai gi-aan rat an pargat ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਿਤ  ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਟੀ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not know anything at all; they do not believe that the Lord's Temple is within. ||2||
lines.transliteration: manmukh mool na jaan nee maan as har mand ar na ho-ay. ||2||

lines.english: The Dear Lord created the Temple of the Lord; He adorns it by His Will.
lines.transliteration: har mandar har jee-o saaji-aa rakh i-aa hukam savaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਰਤਿਨ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Dhur laykh  likhi-aa so kamaavan aa ko-ay na maytan haar. ||3|| All act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਮਾਣਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Contemplating the Shabad, peace is obtained, loving the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sabad cheeneh sukh  paa-i-aa sachai naa-ay pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ  ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਰਿਖਆ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Temple of the Lord is embellished with the Shabad; it is an Infinite Fortress ofGod. ||4||
lines.transliteration: har mandar sabd ay sohn aa kanchan kot apaar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਲੇਖੁ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: This world is the Temple of the Lord; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.
lines.transliteration: har mandar ayhu jagat  hai gur bin gh oranDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਚੀਿਨ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ਿਪਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: The blind and foolish self-willed manmukhs worship in the love of duality. ||5||
lines.transliteration: doojaa bh aa-o kar poojd ay manmukh  anDh  gavaar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ  ਸੋਹਣਾ  ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: One's body and social status do not go along to that place, where all are called toaccount.
lines.transliteration: jithai laykhaa mangee-ai t ithai d ayh jaat  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁਜਗਤੁ  ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੋਰੰਧਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; those in the love of duality are miserable. ||6||
lines.transliteration: saach ratay say ubray d ukhee-ay d oojai bh aa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਪੂਜਦੇ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam is within the Temple of the Lord. The idiotic fools do notrealize this.
lines.transliteration: har mandar meh naam niDh aan hai naa boojh eh mugaDh  gavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ  ਮੰਗੀਐ  ਿਤਥੈ ਦੇਹ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, I have realized this. I keep the Lord enshrined within my heart. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee cheenHi-aa har raakhi-aa ur Dh aar. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਚ  ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ  ਦੁਖੀਏ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who are attuned to the love of the Shabad know the Guru, through the Word ofthe Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: gur kee banee gur t ay jaat ee je sabad  ratay rang laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਿਹ  ਮੁਗਧ  ਗਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Sacred, pure and immaculate are those humble beings who are absorbed in the Nameof the Lord. ||8||
lines.transliteration: pavit paavan say jan nirmal har kai naam samaa-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਚੀਿਨਆ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Temple of the Lord is the Lord's Shop; He embellishes it with the Word of HisShabad.
lines.transliteration: har mandar har kaa haat hai rakh i-aa sabad  savaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ  ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੀ  ਿਜ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In that shop is the merchandise of the One Name; the Gurmukhs adorn themselveswith it. ||9||
lines.transliteration: tis vich sa-ud aa ayk naam gurmukh  lain savaar. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਵਤੁ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The mind is like iron slag, within the Temple of the Lord; it is lured by the love ofduality.
lines.transliteration: har mandar meh man lohat hai mohi-aa d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਹਾਟੁ ਹੈ ਰਿਖਆ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, the mind is transformed into gold. Its value cannot be described. ||10||
lines.transliteration: paaras bhayti-ai kanchan bh a-i-aa keemat  kahee na jaa-ay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸੁ ਿਵਿਚ  ਸਉਦਾ  ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲੈਿਨ  ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The Lord abides within the Temple of the Lord. He is pervading in all.
lines.transliteration: har mandar meh har vasai sarab nirant ar so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਮਿਹ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਹਟੁ ਹੈ ਮੋਿਹਆ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs trade in the merchandise of Truth. ||11||1|| pRBwqI mhlw 3 ] (1346-15) parbhaat ee mehlaa 3. Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh van jee-ai sachaa sa-ud aa ho-ay. ||11||1||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਿਸ  ਭੇਿਟਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Those who remain awake and aware in the Love and Fear of God, rid themselves ofthe filth and pollution of egotism.
lines.transliteration: bhai bh aa-ay jaagay say jan jaagran  karahi ha-umai mail ut aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰ  ਮਿਹ ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They remain awake and aware forever, and protect their homes, by beating anddriving out the five thieves. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sadaa jaageh gh ar apn aa raakh ahi panch t askar kaadh eh maar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਣਜੀਐ  ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧॥੧॥
lines.english: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man mayray gurmukh naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: O mind, do only those deeds which will lead you to the Path of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jit maarag har paa-ee-ai man say-ee karam kamaa-ay. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ  ਜਾਗੇ  ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗਰ੍ਣ  ਕਰਿਹ ਹਉਮੈ  ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The celestial melody wells up in the Gurmukh, and the pains of egotism are takenaway.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sahj Dh un oopjai d ukh ha-umai vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਿਹ  ਘਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ  ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ  ਕਾਢਿਹ  ਮਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord abides in the mind, as one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har naamaa har man vasai sehjay har gun gaa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings - their faces are radiant and beautiful. Theykeep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee mukh  sohn ay har raakh i-aa ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਨ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Here and hereafter, they find absolute peace; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are carried across to the other shore. ||3|| pMnw 1347
lines.transliteration: aithai othai sukh gh anaa jap har har ut ray paar. ||3||

lines.english: In egotism, one cannot remain awake and aware, and one's devotional worship of the Lord is not accepted.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai vich jaagran na hova-ee har bh agat na pav-ee thaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਜਾਗਰ੍ਣੁ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਪਵਈ  ਥਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs find no place in the Court of the Lord; they do their deedsin the love of duality. ||4||
lines.transliteration: manmukh d ar dho-ee naa laheh bh aa-ay d oojai karam kamaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਦਿਰ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਿਹ  ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Dharig kh aanaa Dh arig painHnaa jinHaa doojai bh aa-ay pi-aar. Cursed is the food, and cursed are the clothes, of those who are attached to the loveof duality.
They are like maggots in manure, sinking into manure. In death and rebirth, they arewasted away to ruin. ||5||
lines.transliteration: bistaa kay keerhay bistaa raat ay mar jameh hohi kh u-aar. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਿਬਸਟਾ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਹੋਿਹ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who meet with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o satgur bh ayti-aa t inaa vitahu bal jaa-o.

lines.english: I shall continue to associate with them; devoted to Truth, I am absorbed in Truth. ||6||
lines.transliteration: tin kee sangat  mil rahaaN sachay sach samaa-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਚ ਸਮਾਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: By perfect destiny, the Guru is found. He cannot be found by any efforts.
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag gur paa-ee-ai upaa-ay kit ai na paa-i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਿਗ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Guru, intuitive wisdom wells up; through the Word of the Shabad,egotism is burnt away. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satgur t ay sahj oopjai ha-umai sabad  jalaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਜਲਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O my mind, hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord; He is Potent to do everything.
lines.transliteration: har sarnaa-ee bh aj man mayray sabh  kichh  karnai jog.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰਣੈ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Whatever He does, comes topass. ||8||2||7||2||9|| ibBws pRBwqI mhlw 5 AstpdIAw  (1347-7) bibhaas parbh aatee mehlaa 5 asatpad ee-aa Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadees: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1347-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai jo kichh karai so hog. ||8||2||7||2||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੭॥੨॥੯॥
lines.english: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee sut  banit aa.
choogeh chog anand si-o jugtaa. - involved with them, people eat the food of bliss.

lines.english: The mind is entangled in sweet emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: urajh pari-o man meeth  mohaaraa.

lines.english: Those who seek God's Glorious Virtues are the support of my breath of life. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gun gaahak mayray paraan aDhaaraa. ||1||

lines.english: My One Lord is the Inner-Knower, the Searcher of hearts.
lines.transliteration: ayk hamaaraa antarjaamee.

lines.english: Dhar aykaa mai tik aykas kee sir saahaa vad purakh  su-aamee. ||1|| rahaa-o. He alone is my Support; He is my only Protection. My Great Lord and Master is over and above the heads of kings. ||1||Pause||
I have broken my ties to that deceitful serpent.
lines.transliteration: chhal naagan si-o mayree tootan ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰ ਏਕਾ ਮੈ ਿਟਕ ਏਕਸੁ  ਕੀ ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has told me that it is false and fraudulent.
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa ih jhooth ee Dh ohee.

lines.english: Its face is sweet, but it tastes very bitter.
lines.transliteration: mukh meeth ee kh aa-ee ka-uraa-ay.

lines.english: My mind remains satisfied with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam man rahi-aa agh aa-ay. ||2||

lines.english: I have broken my ties with greed and emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: lobh moh si-o ga-ee vikh ot.

lines.english: The Merciful Guru has rescued me from them.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaal mohi keenee chhot.

lines.english: These cheating thieves have plundered so many homes.
lines.transliteration: ih thagvaaree bahut  ghar gaalay.

lines.english: The Merciful Guru has protected and saved me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ham gur raakh lee-ay kirpaalay. ||3||

lines.english: I have no dealings whatsoever with sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh si-o th aat na bani-aa.

lines.english: I listen to the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: gur updays mohi kaanee suni-aa.

lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the most horrible goblins.
lines.transliteration: jah daykh -a-u t ah mahaa chandaal.

lines.english: My Guru, the Lord of the World, has saved me from them. ||4||
lines.transliteration: raakh lee-ay apunai gur gopaal. ||4||

lines.english: I have made widows of the ten sensory organs.
lines.transliteration: das naaree mai karee d uhaagan.

lines.english: The Guru has told me that these pleasures are the fires of corruption.
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa ayh raseh bikhaagan.

lines.english: Those who associate with them go to hell.
lines.transliteration: in sanbanDhee rasaat al jaa-ay.

lines.english: The Guru has saved me; I am lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: ham gur raakhay har liv laa-ay. ||5||

lines.english: I have forsaken the advice of my ego.
lines.transliteration: ahaNmayv si-o maslat chh odee.

lines.english: The Guru has told me that this is foolish stubbornness.
lines.transliteration: gur kahi-aa ih moorakh hodee.

lines.english: This ego is homeless; it shall never find a home.
lines.transliteration: ih neeghar gh ar kahee na paa-ay.

lines.english: The Guru has saved me; I am lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: ham gur raakh lee-ay liv laa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: I have become alienated from these people.
lines.transliteration: in logan si-o ham bha-ay bairaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਨੀਘਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: We cannot both live together in one home.
lines.transliteration: ayk garih meh du-ay na kh ataaN-ee.

lines.english: Grasping the hem of the Guru's Robe, I have come to God.
lines.transliteration: aa-ay parabh peh anchar laag.

lines.english: Please be fair with me, All-knowing Lord God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: karahu tapaavas parabh  sarbaag. ||7||

lines.english: God smiled at me and spoke, passing judgement.
lines.transliteration: parabh has bolay kee-ay ni-aaN-ayN.

lines.english: He made all the demons perform service for me.
lines.transliteration: sagal doot  mayree sayvaa laa-ay.

lines.english: You are my Lord and Master; all this home belongs to You.
lines.transliteration: tooN thaakur ih garihu sabh  tayraa.

lines.english: Says Nanak, the Guru has passed judgement. ||8||1|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1347-19) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl: pMnw 1348
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak gur kee-aa nibayraa. ||8||1||

lines.english: Within the mind dwell anger and massive ego.
lines.transliteration: man meh kroDh mahaa ahaNkaaraa.

lines.english: Worship services are performed with great pomp and ceremony.
lines.transliteration: poojaa karahi bahut bisthaaraa.

lines.english: Ritual cleansing baths are taken, and sacred marks are applied to the body.
lines.transliteration: kar isnaan tan chakar ban aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.english: But still, the filth and pollution within never depart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar kee mal kab hee na jaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਿਮ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਕਨ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: No one has ever found God in this way.
lines.transliteration: it sanjam parabh  kin hee na paa-i-aa.

lines.english: The sacred mudras - ritualistic hand gestures - are made, but the mind remains enticed by Maya. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bhag-ut ee mud raa man mohi-aa maa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: They commit sins, under the influence of the five thieves.
lines.transliteration: paap karahi panchaaN kay bas ray.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੰਚ ਕੇ ਬਿਸ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: They bathe at sacred shrines, and claim that everything has been washed off.
lines.transliteration: tirath naa-ay kaheh sabh  utray.

lines.english: Then they commit them again, without fear of the consequences.
lines.transliteration: bahur kamaaveh ho-ay nisank.

lines.english: The sinners are bound and gagged, and taken to the City of Death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jam pur baaNDh kh aray kaalank. ||2||

lines.english: The ankle-bells shake and the cymbals vibrate,
lines.transliteration: ghoogh ar baaDh  bajaaveh t aalaa.
antar kapat fireh bayt aalaa. but those who have deception within wander lost like demons.

lines.english: By destroying its hole, the snake is not killed.
lines.transliteration: varmee maaree saap na moo-aa.

lines.english: God, who created you, knows everything. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parabh sabh  kichh  jaanai jin t oo kee-aa. ||3||

lines.english: You worship fire and wear saffron colored robes.
lines.transliteration: pooNar taap gayree kay bast araa.

lines.english: Stung by your misfortune, you abandon your home.
lines.transliteration: apdaa kaa maari-aa garih t ay nast aa.

lines.english: Leaving your own country, you wander in foreign lands.
lines.transliteration: days chh od pard ayseh Dh aa-i-aa.

lines.english: But you bring the five rejects with you. ||4||
lines.transliteration: panch chandaal naalay lai aa-i-aa. ||4||

lines.english: You have split your ears, and now you steal crumbs.
lines.transliteration: kaan faraa-ay hiraa-ay tookaa.

lines.english: You beg from door to door, but you fail to be satisfied.
lines.transliteration: ghar gh ar maaNgai tariptaavan t ay chookaa.

lines.english: You have abandoned your own wife, but now you sneak glances at other women.
lines.transliteration: banitaa chh od bad  nadar par naaree.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਛੋਿਡ ਬਦ ਨਦਿਰ  ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: God is not found by wearing religious robes; you are utterly miserable! ||5||
lines.transliteration: vays na paa-ee-ai mahaa dukh i-aaree. ||5||

lines.english: He does not speak; he is on silence.
lines.transliteration: bolai naahee ho-ay baithaa monee.

lines.english: But he is filled with desire; he is made to wander in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: antar kalap bh avaa-ee-ai jonee.

lines.english: Abstaining from food, his body suffers in pain.
lines.transliteration: ann tay raht aa dukh dayhee saht aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਨ ਤੇ ਰਹਤਾ  ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਹਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He does not realize the Hukam of the Lord's Command; he is afflicted by possessiveness. ||6||
lines.transliteration: hukam na boojhai vi-aapi-aa mamt aa. ||6||

lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one has attained the supreme status.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kinai na paa-ee param gat ay.

lines.english: Go ahead and ask all the Vedas and the Simritees.
lines.transliteration: poochhahu sagal bayd  simrit ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do useless deeds.
lines.transliteration: manmukh karam karai ajaa-ee.

lines.english: They are like a house of sand, which cannot stand. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ji-o baaloo ghar th a-ur na th aa-ee. ||7||

lines.english: One unto whom the Lord of the Universe becomes Merciful,
lines.transliteration: jis no bha-ay gobind  da-i-aalaa.
gur kaa bachan tin baaDh i-o paalaa. sews the Word of the Guru's Shabad into his robes.

lines.english: Out of millions, it is rare that such a Saint is seen.
lines.transliteration: kot maDhay ko-ee sant  dikhaa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, with him, we are carried across. ||8||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kai sang t araa-i-aa. ||8||

lines.english: If one has such good destiny, then the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained. Awip qrY sBu kutMbu qrweIAY ]1] rhwau dUjw ]2] (1348-12) aap tarai sabh  kutamb t araa-ee-ai. ||1|| rahaa-o d oojaa. ||2|| He saves himself, and carries across all his family as well. ||1||SECOND PAUSE||2|| pRBwqI mhlw 5 ] (1348-13) parbhaat ee mehlaa 5. Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay hovai bhaag t aa darsan paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ  ਤਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, all the sins are erased.
lines.transliteration: simrat naam kilbikh  sabh  kaatay.

lines.english: Dharam raa-ay kay kaagar faatay. The accounts held by the Righteous Judge of Dharma are torn up.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: saaDhsangat  mil har ras paa-i-aa.

lines.english: I have found the Sublime Essence of the Lord. The Supreme Lord God has melted into my heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm rid maahi samaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Dwelling on the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace.
lines.transliteration: raam ramat har har sukh  paa-i-aa.

lines.english: Your slaves seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayray d aas charan sarnaa-i-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The cycle of reincarnation is ended, and darkness is dispelled.
lines.transliteration: chookaa ga-on miti-aa anDh i-aar.

lines.english: The Guru has revealed the door of liberation.
lines.transliteration: gur dikh laa-i-aa mukat  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: My mind and body are forever imbued with loving devotion to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har paraym bhagat  man t an sad  raataa.

lines.english: Now I know God, because He has made me know Him. ||2||
lines.transliteration: parabhoo janaa-i-aa t ab hee jaat aa. ||2||

lines.english: He is contained in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar ravi-aa so-ay.

lines.english: Without Him, there is no one at all.
lines.transliteration: tis bin beejo naahee ko-ay.

lines.english: Hatred, conflict, fear and doubt have been eliminated.
lines.transliteration: bair biroDh chh ayday bh ai bharmaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: God, the Soul of Pure Goodness, has manifested His Righteousness. ||3||
lines.transliteration: parabh punn aat mai keenay Dh armaa. ||3||

lines.english: He has rescued me from the most dangerous waves.
lines.transliteration: mahaa tarang t ay kaaNdhai laagaa.

lines.english: Separated from Him for countless lifetimes, I am united with Him once again.
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa tootaa gaaNdhaa.

lines.english: Chanting, intense meditation and strict self-discipline are the contemplation of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam naam samHaali-aa.

lines.english: My Lord and Master has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||4||
lines.transliteration: apunai thaakur nad ar nihaali-aa. ||4||

lines.english: Bliss, peace and salvation are found in that place, pMnw 1349
lines.transliteration: mangal sookh kali-aan  tithaa-eeN.
jah sayvak gopaal gusaa-ee. where the servants of the Lord of the World abide.

lines.english: God, the Lord of the World, is pleased and satisfied with me.
lines.transliteration: parabh suparsan bh a-ay gopaal.

lines.english: My disharmony with Him of so many lifetimes is ended. ||5||
lines.transliteration: janam janam kay mitay bitaal. ||5||

lines.english: Burnt offerings, sacred feasts, intense meditations with the body upside-down,worship services
lines.transliteration: hom jag uraDh t ap poojaa.
kot tirath isnaan kareejaa. and taking millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage
charan kamal nimakh rid ai Dhaaray. - the merits of all these are obtained by enshrining the Lord's Lotus Feet within the heart, even for an instant.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, all one's affairs are resolved. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gobind japat  sabh  kaaraj saaray. ||6||

lines.english: God's Place is the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: oochay tay oochaa parabh  thaan.

lines.english: The Lord's humble servants intuitively focus their meditation on Him.
