lines.transliteration: har jan laaveh sahj Dhi-aan.

lines.english: I long for the dust of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
lines.transliteration: daas d aasan kee baaNchha-o Dh oor.

lines.english: My Beloved Lord is overflowing with all powers. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa pareetam bh arpoor. ||7||

lines.english: My Beloved Lord, my Mother and Father, is always near.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa har pareet am nayraa.

lines.english: O my Friend and Companion, You are my Trusted Support.
lines.transliteration: meet saajan bh arvaasaa t ayraa.

lines.english: God takes His slaves by the hand, and makes them His Own.
lines.transliteration: kar geh leenay apunay daas.

lines.english: Nanak lives by meditating on the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||8||3||2||7||12|| ibBws pRBwqI bwxI Bgq kbIr jI kI  (1349-7) bibhaas parbh aatee ban ee bh agat kabeer jee kee Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1349-7) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jap jeevai naanak guntaas. ||8||3||2||7||12||

lines.english: My anxious fears of death and rebirth have been taken away.
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan kee sankaa naasee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਭਾਸ  ਪਰ੍ਭਾਤੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The Celestial Lord has shown His Love for me. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aapan rang sahj pargaasee. ||1||

lines.english: The Divine Light has dawned, and darkness has been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: pargatee jot miti-aa anDh i-aaraa.

lines.english: Contemplating the Lord, I have obtained the Jewel of His Name. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: raam ratan paa-i-aa karat  beechaaraa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Pain runs far away from that place where there is bliss.
lines.transliteration: jah anand dukh  door pa-i-aanaa.

lines.english: The jewel of the mind is focused and attuned to the essence of reality. ||2||
lines.transliteration: man maanak liv tat  lukaanaa. ||2||

lines.english: Whatever happens is by the Pleasure of Your Will.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh ho-aa so t ayraa bh aanaa.

lines.english: Whoever understands this, is intuitively merged in the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo iv boojhai so sahj samaan aa. ||3||

lines.english: Says Kabeer, my sins have been obliterated.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer kilbikh  ga-ay kh eenaa.

lines.english: My mind has merged into the Lord, the Life of the World. ||4||1|| pRBwqI ] (1349-11) parbhaat ee. Prabhaatee:
lines.transliteration: man bha-i-aa jagjeevan leen aa. ||4||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਇਵ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: If the Lord Allah lives only in the mosque, then to whom does the rest of the world belong?
lines.transliteration: alhu ayk maseet basat  hai avar mulakh  kis kayraa.

lines.english: According to the Hindus, the Lord's Name abides in the idol, but there is no truth ineither of these claims. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hindoo moorat  naam nivaasee d uh meh t at na hayraa. ||1||

lines.english: O Allah, O Raam, I live by Your Name.
lines.transliteration: alah raam jeeva-o tayray naa-ee.

lines.english: Please show mercy to me, O Master. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: too kar mihraamat  saa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਸੀਿਤ  ਬਸਤੁ  ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਮੁਲਖੁ  ਿਕਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The God of the Hindus lives in the southern lands, and the God of the Muslims lives in the west.
lines.transliteration: dakhan days haree kaa baasaa pachh im alah mukaamaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹੰਦੂ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਨਾਮ ਿਨਵਾਸੀ  ਦੁਹ ਮਿਹ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.english: So search in your heart - look deep into your heart of hearts; this is the home and theplace where God lives. ||2||
lines.transliteration: dil meh kh oj dilai dil khojahu ayhee th a-ur mukaamaa. ||2||

lines.english: The Brahmins observe twenty-four fasts during the year, and the Muslims fast duringthe month of Ramadaan.
lines.transliteration: barahman gi-aas karahi cha-ubeesaa kaajee mah ramjaanaa.

lines.english: The Muslims set aside eleven months, and claim that the treasure is only in the onemonth. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gi-aareh maas paas kai raakhay aykai maahi niDh aanaa. ||3||

lines.english: What is the use of bathing at Orissa? Why do the Muslims bow their heads in themosque?
lines.transliteration: kahaa udeesay majan kee-aa ki-aa maseet sir naaN-ayN.

lines.punjabi: ਦਖਨ  ਦੇਿਸ ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਾਸਾ  ਪਿਛਿਮ  ਅਲਹ  ਮੁਕਾਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: If someone has deception in his heart, what good is it for him to utter prayers? Andwhat good is it for him to go on pilgrimage to Mecca? ||4||
lines.transliteration: dil meh kapat nivaaj gujaarai ki-aa haj kaabai jaaN-ayN. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਲ  ਮਿਹ ਖੋਿਜ ਿਦਲੈ  ਿਦਿਲ  ਖੋਜਹੁ ਏਹੀ ਠਉਰ  ਮੁਕਾਮਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You fashioned all these men and women, Lord. All these are Your Forms.
lines.transliteration: aytay a-urat  mard aa saajay ay sabh  roop t umHaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਨ  ਿਗਆਸ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਚਉਬੀਸਾ  ਕਾਜੀ ਮਹ ਰਮਜਾਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer is the child of God, Allah, Raam. All the Gurus and prophets are mine. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kabeer poongraa raam alah kaa sabh gur peer hamaaray. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਰਹ  ਮਾਸ ਪਾਸ ਕੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕੈ ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਨਧਾਨਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, listen, O men and women: seek the Sanctuary of the One.
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunhu nar narvai parahu ayk kee sarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਾ ਉਡੀਸੇ  ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ  ਿਕਆ ਮਸੀਿਤ  ਿਸਰੁ ਨਏਂ  ॥
lines.english: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortals, and you shall surely be carried across. ||6||2|| pRBwqI ] (1349-18) parbhaat ee. Prabhaatee:
lines.transliteration: kayval naam japahu ray paraanee tab hee nihchai t arnaa. ||6||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਲ  ਮਿਹ ਕਪਟੁ ਿਨਵਾਜ  ਗੁਜਾਰੈ  ਿਕਆ  ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਏਂ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: First, Allah created the Light; then, by His Creative Power, He made all mortal beings.
lines.transliteration: aval alah noor upaa-i-aa kudrat  kay sabh  band ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤੇ ਅਉਰਤ  ਮਰਦਾ ਸਾਜੇ ਏ ਸਭ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: From the One Light, the entire universe welled up. So who is good, and who is bad? ||1|| pMnw 1350
lines.transliteration: ayk noor tay sabh  jag upji-aa ka-un bh alay ko mand ay. ||1||

lines.english: O people, O Siblings of Destiny, do not wander deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: logaa bharam na bh oolahu bh aa-ee.

lines.english: The Creation is in the Creator, and the Creator is in the Creation, totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: khaalik kh alak kh alak meh kh aalik poor rahi-o sarab th aaN-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਿਲਕੁ  ਖਲਕ  ਖਲਕ  ਮਿਹ ਖਾਿਲਕੁ  ਪੂਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਰ੍ਬ ਠਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The clay is the same, but the Fashioner has fashioned it in various ways.
lines.transliteration: maatee ayk anayk bhaaNt kar saajee saajanhaarai.

lines.english: There is nothing wrong with the pot of clay - there is nothing wrong with the Potter. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naa kachh poch maatee kay bh aaNday naa kachh  poch kumbh aarai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਟੀ  ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ  ਭਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਸਾਜੀ  ਸਾਜਨਹਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: The One True Lord abides in all; by His making, everything is made.
lines.transliteration: sabh meh sachaa ayko so-ee t is kaa kee-aa sabh  kachh  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਮਾਟੀ  ਕੇ ਭਡੇ ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਕੁੰਭਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Whoever realizes the Hukam of His Command, knows the One Lord. He alone is saidto be the Lord's slave. ||3||
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaanai so ayko jaanai band aa kahee-ai so-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord Allah is Unseen; He cannot be seen. The Guru has blessed me with thissweet molasses.
lines.transliteration: alhu alakh na jaa-ee lakh i-aa gur gurh  deenaa meeth aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ  ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, my anxiety and fear have been taken away; I see the Immaculate Lordpervading everywhere. ||4||3|| pRBwqI ] (1350-5) parbhaat ee. Prabhaatee:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer mayree sankaa naasee sarab niranjan deethaa. ||4||3||

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ਲਿਖਆ  ਗੁਿਰ ਗੁੜੁ ਦੀਨਾ  ਮੀਠਾ  ॥
lines.english: Do not say that the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran are false. Those who do notcontemplate them are false.
lines.transliteration: bayd kat ayb kahhu mat  jhoothay jhoothaa jo na bichaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਕਾ ਨਾਸੀ  ਸਰਬ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ  ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.english: You say that the One Lord is in all, so why do you kill chickens? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ja-o sabh meh ayk kh udaa-ay kahat  ha-o t a-o ki-o murgee maarai. ||1||

lines.english: O Mullah, tell me: is this God's Justice?
lines.transliteration: mulaaN kahhu ni-aa-o khud aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ  ਕਹਹੁ ਮਤ ਝੂਠੇ ਝੂਠਾ ਜੋ ਨ ਿਬਚਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: The doubts of your mind have not been dispelled. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tayray man kaa bh aram na jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਕਹਤ  ਹਉ ਤਉ ਿਕਉ  ਮੁਰਗੀ  ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You seize a living creature, and then bring it home and kill its body; you have killed only the clay.
lines.transliteration: pakar jee-o aani-aa dayh binaasee maatee ka-o bismil kee-aa.

lines.english: The light of the soul passes into another form. So tell me, what have you killed? ||2||
lines.transliteration: jot saroop anaahat  laagee kaho halaal ki-aa kee-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: And what good are your purifications? Why do you bother to wash your face? And why do you bother to bow your head in the mosque?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa ujoo paak kee-aa muhu Dho-i-aa ki-aa maseet  sir laa-i-aa.

lines.english: Your heart is full of hypocrisy; what good are your prayers or your pilgrimage toMecca? ||3||
lines.transliteration: ja-o dil meh kapat nivaaj gujaarahu ki-aa haj kaabai jaa-i-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਪਕਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਆਿਨਆ  ਦੇਹ ਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਮਾਟੀ  ਕਉ ਿਬਸਿਮਿਲ  ਕੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: You are impure; you do not understand the Pure Lord. You do not know His Mystery.
lines.transliteration: tooN naapaak paak nahee soojh i-aa tis kaa maram na jaani-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਹਤ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਕਹੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ  ਿਕਆ  ਕੀਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, you have missed out on paradise; your mind is set on hell. ||4||4|| pRBwqI ] (1350-11) parbhaat ee. Prabhaatee:
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer bhisat  tay chookaa d ojak si-o man maani-aa. ||4||4||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਉਜੂ ਪਾਕੁ ਕੀਆ  ਮੁਹੁ ਧੋਇਆ  ਿਕਆ  ਮਸੀਿਤ  ਿਸਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Hear my prayer, Lord; You are the Divine Light of the Divine, the Primal, All-pervadingMaster.
lines.transliteration: sunn sanDhi-aa t ayree d ayv d ayvaakar aDh pat aad samaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਿਦਲ  ਮਿਹ ਕਪਟੁ ਿਨਵਾਜ  ਗੁਜਾਰਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Siddhas in Samaadhi have not found Your limits. They hold tight to the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||1||
lines.transliteration: siDh samaaDh  ant nahee paa-i-aa laag rahay sarnaa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂੰ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ  ਪਾਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਿਝਆ  ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: Worship and adoration of the Pure, Primal Lord comes by worshipping the True Guru,O Siblings of Destiny.
lines.transliteration: layho aartee ho purakh  niranjan sat gur poojahu bh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਭਸਿਤ  ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ  ਦੋਜਕ  ਿਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.english: Standing at His Door, Brahma studies the Vedas, but he cannot see the Unseen Lord.||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: thaadh aa barahmaa nigam beechaarai alakh  na lakh i-aa jaa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: With the oil of knowledge about the essence of reality, and the wick of the Naam, theName of the Lord, this lamp illluminates my body.
lines.transliteration: tat tayl naam kee-aa baat ee deepak d ayh uj-yaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸੰਿਧਆ  ਤੇਰੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਕਰ  ਅਧਪਿਤ  ਆਿਦ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have applied the Light of the Lord of the Universe, and lit this lamp. God the Knowerknows. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jot laa-ay jagd ees jagaa-i-aa boojh ai boojh anhaaraa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਿਗ  ਰਹੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Unstruck Melody of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates andresounds. I dwell with the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: panchay sabad anaahad  baajay sangay saringpaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਹੁ ਆਰਤੀ  ਹੋ ਪੁਰਖ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, Your slave, performs this Aartee, this lamp-lit worship service for You, OFormless Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||3||5|| pRBwqI bwxI Bgq nwmdyv jI kI  (1350-16) parbhaat ee ban ee bh agat naamd ayv jee kee Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1350-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kabeer daas t ayree aart ee keenee nirankaar nirbaanee. ||3||5||

lines.punjabi: ਠਾਢਾ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਨਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਿਖਆ  ਜਾਈ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The mind alone knows the state of the mind; I tell it to the Knowing Lord.
lines.transliteration: man kee birthaa man hee jaanai kai boojhal aagai kahee-ai.

lines.english: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts - why should I be afraid? ||1||
lines.transliteration: antarjaamee raam ravaaN-ee mai dar kaisay chahee-ai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ  ਬਾਤੀ  ਦੀਪਕੁ  ਦੇਹ ਉਜਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: My mind is pierced through by the love of the Lord of the World.
lines.transliteration: bayDhee-alay gopaal gosaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ ਲਾਇ  ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਜਗਾਇਆ  ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰਾ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: My God is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: mayraa parabh ravi-aa sarbay th aa-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਚੇ ਸਬਦ  ਅਨਾਹਦ  ਬਾਜੇ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਾਿਰੰਗਪਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The mind is the shop, the mind is the town, and the mind is the shopkeeper.
lines.transliteration: maanai haat maanai paat maanai hai paasaaree.

lines.english: The mind abides in various forms, wandering all across the world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: maanai baasai naanaa bhayd ee bh armat  hai sansaaree. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭਾਤੀ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਨਾਮਦੇਵ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: This mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and duality is easily overcome. pMnw 1351
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad ayhu man raat aa dubiDh aa sahj samaan ee.

lines.english: He Himself is the Commander; all are under His Command. The Fearless Lord looks on all alike. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sabho hukam hukam hai aapay nirbh a-o samat  beechaaree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਸਮਤੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: That humble being who knows, and meditates on the Supreme Primal Being - hisword becomes eternal.
lines.transliteration: jo jan jaan bhajeh purkh otam taa chee abigat  banee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਿਨ  ਭਜਿਹ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ  ਤਾ ਚੀ ਅਿਬਗਤੁ  ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, I have found the Invisible, Wondrous Lord, the Life of the World,within my heart. ||4||1|| pRBwqI ] (1351-3) parbhaat ee. Prabhaatee:
lines.transliteration: naamaa kahai jagjeevan paa-i-aa hirdai alakh  bidaan ee. ||4||1||

lines.english: He existed in the beginning, in the primeval age, and all throughout the ages; Hislimits cannot be known.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  jugaad  jugo jug t aa kaa ant  na jaani-aa.

lines.english: The Lord is pervading and permeating amongst all; this is how His Form can bedescribed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sarab nirantar raam rahi-aa rav aisaa roop bakh aani-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਜੁਗੋ ਜੁਗੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe appears when the Word of His Shabad is chanted.
lines.transliteration: gobid gaajai sabad  baajai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਨਰੰਤਿਰ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਹਆ ਰਿਵ ਐਸਾ  ਰੂਪੁ ਬਖਾਿਨਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My Lord is the Embodiment of Bliss. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: aanad roopee mayro raam-ee-aa. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: The beautiful fragrance of sandalwood emanates from the sandalwood tree, and attaches to the other trees of the forest.
lines.transliteration: baavan beekhoo baanai beekh ay baas t ay sukh  laagilaa.

lines.english: God, the Primal Source of everything, is like the sandalwood tree; He transforms uswoody trees into fragrant sandalwood. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sarbay aad paramlaad  kaasat chand an bh ai-ilaa. ||2||

lines.english: You, O Lord, are the Philosopher's Stone, and I am iron; associating with You, I amtransformed into gold.
lines.transliteration: tumH chay paaras ham chay lohaa sangay kanchan bh ai-ilaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਵਨ  ਬੀਖੂ ਬਾਨੈ ਬੀਖੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਿਗਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: You are Merciful; You are the gem and the jewel. Naam Dayv is absorbed in theTruth. ||3||2|| pRBwqI ] (1351-7) parbhaat ee. Prabhaatee:
lines.transliteration: too da-i-aal rat an laal naamaa saach samaa-ilaa. ||3||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬੇ  ਆਿਦ  ਪਰਮਲਾਿਦ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਚੰਦਨੁ ਭੈਇਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Primal Being has no ancestry; He has staged this play.
lines.transliteration: akul purakh ik chalit  upaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਮ ਚੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਹਮ ਚੇ ਲੋਹਾ ਸੰਗੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭੈਇਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: God is hidden deep within each and every heart. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at ant ar barahm lukaa-i-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਰਤਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ  ਨਾਮਾ  ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਇਲਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.english: No one knows the Light of the soul.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kee jot na jaanai ko-ee.

lines.english: Whatever I do, is known to You, Lord. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: tai mai kee-aa so maaloom ho-ee. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: Just as the pitcher is made from clay,
lines.transliteration: ji-o pargaasi-aa maatee kumbhay-o.
aap hee kartaa beeth ul day-o. ||2|| everything is made from the Beloved Divine Creator Himself. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅ  ਕੀ ਜੋਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The mortal's actions hold the soul in the bondage of karma.
lines.transliteration: jee-a kaa banDhan karam bi-aapai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ  ਸੁ ਮਾਲੂਮੁ  ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whatever he does, he does on his own. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kee-aa so aapai aapai. ||3||

lines.english: Prays Naam Dayv, whatever this soul wants, it obtains.
lines.transliteration: paranvat  naamd ay-o ih jee-o chit vai so lahai.

lines.english: Whoever abides in the Lord, becomes immortal. ||4||3|| pRBwqI Bgq byxI jI kI  (1351-11) parbhaat ee bh agat bayn ee jee kee Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1351-11) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: amar ho-ay sad aakul rahai. ||4||3||

lines.english: You rub your body with sandalwood oil, and place basil leaves on your forehead.
lines.transliteration: tan chand an mast ak paat ee.

lines.english: But you hold a knife in the hand of your heart.
lines.transliteration: rid ant ar kar t al kaat ee.

lines.english: You look like a thug; pretending to meditate, you pose like a crane.
lines.transliteration: thag d isat bagaa liv laagaa.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਣਵਿਤ  ਨਾਮਦੇਉ  ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਿਚਤਵੈ  ਸੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.english: You try to look like a Vaishnaav, but the breath of life escapes through your mouth. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daykh  baisno paraan mukh  bhaagaa. ||1||

lines.english: You pray for hours to God the Beautiful.
lines.transliteration: kal bhagvat  band  chiraaNmaN.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭਾਤੀ  ਭਗਤ  ਬੇਣੀ  ਜੀ ਕੀ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: But your gaze is evil, and your nights are wasted in conflict. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: karoor disat rat aa nis baad aN. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You perform daily cleansing rituals,
lines.transliteration: nitparat  isnaan sareeraN.
du-ay Dh otee karam mukh  kheeraN. wear two loin-cloths, perform religious rituals and put only milk in your mouth.

lines.english: But in your heart, you have drawn out the sword.
lines.transliteration: ridai chh uree sanDh i-aanee.

lines.english: You routinely steal the property of others. ||2||
lines.transliteration: par darab hiran kee baanee. ||2||

lines.english: You worship the stone idol, and paint ceremonial marks of Ganesha.
lines.transliteration: sil poojas chakar ganaysaN.

lines.english: You remain awake throughout the night, pretending to worship God.
lines.transliteration: nis jaagas bhagat  parvaysaN.

lines.english: You dance, but your consciousness is filled with evil.
lines.transliteration: pag naachas chit akarmaN.

lines.english: You are lewd and depraved - this is such an unrighteous dance! ||3||
lines.transliteration: ay lampat naach aDharmaN. ||3||

lines.english: You sit on a deer-skin, and chant on your mala.
lines.transliteration: marig aasan t ulsee maalaa.

lines.english: You put the sacred mark, the tilak, on your forehead.
lines.transliteration: kar oojal tilak kapaalaa.

lines.english: You wear the rosary beads of Shiva around your neck, but your heart is filled with falsehood.
lines.transliteration: ridai koorh  kanth  rudraakh aN.

lines.english: You are lewd and depraved - you do not chant God's Name. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ray lampat krisan abhaakh aN. ||4||

lines.english: Whoever does not realize the essence of the soul
lines.transliteration: jin aatam t at na cheenHi-aa.
sabh fokat Dh aram abeeni-aa. - all his religious actions are hollow and false.

lines.english: Says Baynee, as Gurmukh, meditate.
lines.transliteration: kaho baynee gurmukh  Dhi-aavai.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, you shall not find the Way. ||5||1|| pMnw 1352 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1352-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: rwgu jYjwvMqI mhlw 9 ] (1352-3) raag jaijaavantee mehlaa 9. Raag Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: bin satgur baat na paavai. ||5||1||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord - meditate on the Lord; this alone shall be ofuse to you.
lines.transliteration: raam simar raam simar ihai tayrai kaaj hai.

lines.english: Abandon your association with Maya, and take shelter in the Sanctuary of God.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa ko sang ti-aag parabh  joo kee saran laag.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਰਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਇਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਿਜ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Remember that the pleasures of the world are false; this whole show is just anillusion. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: jagat sukh  maan mithi-aa jh ootho sabh  saaj hai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ਿਤਆਗੁ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਸਰਿਨ  ਲਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: You must understand that this wealth is just a dream. Why are you so proud?
lines.transliteration: supnay ji-o Dhan pachh aan kaahay par karat  maan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੁ ਿਮਿਥਆ  ਝੂਠੋ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: The empires of the earth are like walls of sand. ||1||
lines.transliteration: baaroo kee bheet  jaisay basuDh aa ko raaj hai. ||1||

lines.english: Servant Nanak speaks the Truth: your body shall perish and pass away.
lines.transliteration: naanak jan kahat baat  binas jaihai t ayro gaat .

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨੇ  ਿਜਉ  ਧਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਪਿਰ ਕਰਤ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Moment by moment, yesterday passed. Today is passing as well. ||2||1|| jYjwvMqI mhlw 9 ] (1352-7) jaijaavantee mehlaa 9. Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: chhin chh in kar ga-i-o kaal t aisay jaat  aaj hai. ||2||1||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਰੂ ਕੀ ਭੀਿਤ  ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Lord - vibrate on the Lord; your life is slipping away.
lines.transliteration: raam bhaj raam bh aj janam siraat  hai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਜਨੁ ਕਹਤੁ  ਬਾਤ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜੈਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਗਾਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: Why am I telling you this again and again? You fool - why don't you understand?
lines.transliteration: kaha-o kahaa baar baar samjhat  nah ki-o gavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਛਨੁ ਿਛਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਗਇਓ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੁ  ਆਜੁ  ਹੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.english: Your body is like a hail-stone; it melts away in no time at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: binsat nah lagai baar oray sam gaat  hai. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: So give up all your doubts, and utter the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sagal bharam daar d eh gobind  ko naam layhi.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਿਸਰਾਤੁ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, this alone shall go along with you. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ant baar sang t ayrai ihai ayk jaat  hai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਉ  ਕਹਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਸਮਝਤ  ਨਹ ਿਕਉ  ਗਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Forget the poisonous sins of corruption, and enshrine the Praises of God in your heart.
lines.transliteration: bikhi-aa bikh  ji-o bisaar parabh  kou jas hee-ay Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨਸਤ  ਨਹ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਰ ਓਰੇ ਸਮ ਗਾਤੁ  ਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak proclaims that this opportunity is slipping away. ||2||2|| jYjwvMqI mhlw 9 ] (1352-11) jaijaavantee mehlaa 9. Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan kahi pukaar a-osar bihaat hai. ||2||2||

lines.english: O mortal, what will your condition be?
lines.transliteration: ray man ka-un gat ho-ay hai t ayree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਗਲ  ਭਰਮ  ਡਾਿਰ  ਦੇਿਹ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: In this world, you have not listened to the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ih jag meh raam naam so ta-o nahee suni-o kaan.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਬਾਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਤੇਰੈ ਇਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਜਾਤੁ  ਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are totally engrossed in corruption and sin; you have not turned your mind away from them at all. ||1||Pause||
lines.transliteration: bikhi-an si-o at  lubhaan mat  naahin fayree. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You obtained this human life, but you have not remembered the Lord in meditation,even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: maanas ko janam leen simran nah nimakh keen.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਕਿਹ ਪੁਕਾਿਰ  ਅਉਸਰੁ ਿਬਹਾਤੁ  ਹੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.english: For the sake of pleasure, you have become subservient to your woman, and now yourfeet are bound. ||1||
lines.transliteration: daaraa sukh  bha-i-o d een pagahu paree bayree. ||1||

lines.english: Servant Nanak proclaims that the vast expanse of this world is just a dream.
lines.transliteration: naanak jan kahi pukaar supnai ji-o jag pasaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਉਨ  ਗਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Why not meditate on the Lord? Even Maya is His slave. ||2||3|| jYjwvMqI mhlw 9 ] (1352-14) jaijaavantee mehlaa 9. Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: simrat nah ki-o muraar maa-i-aa jaa kee chayree. ||2||3||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਿਨਓ ਕਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Slipping away - your life is uselessly slipping away.
lines.transliteration: beet jaihai beet  jaihai janam akaaj ray.

lines.english: Night and day, you listen to the Puraanas, but you do not understand them, you ignorant fool!
lines.transliteration: nis din sun kai puraan samjh at nah ray ajaan.

lines.english: Death has arrived; now where will you run? ||1||Pause|| pMnw 1353
lines.transliteration: kaal ta-o pahoochi-o aan kahaa jaihai bh aaj ray. ||1|| rahaa-o.

lines.english: You believed that this body was permanent, but it shall turn to dust.
lines.transliteration: asthir jo maani-o dayh so t a-o tayra-o ho-ay hai kh ayh.

lines.english: Why don't you chant the Name of the Lord, you shameless fool? ||1||
lines.transliteration: ki-o na har ko naam layhi moorakh nilaaj ray. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਜੋ ਮਾਿਨਓ  ਦੇਹ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਤੇਰਉ  ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.english: Let devotional worship of the Lord enter into your heart, and abandon the intellectualism of your mind.
lines.transliteration: raam bhagat  hee-ay aan chh aad d ay tai man ko maan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਉ  ਨ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਿਹ ਮੂਰਖ ਿਨਲਾਜ  ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: O Servant Nanak, this is the way to live in the world. ||2||4|| <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1353-4) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: slok shsik®qI mhlw 1 ] (1353-6) salok sehaskiritee mehlaa 1. Shalok Sehskritee, First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak jan ih bakhaan jag meh biraaj ray. ||2||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੀਏ ਆਿਨ  ਛਾਿਡ  ਦੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: You study the scriptures, say your prayers and argue;
lines.transliteration: parhH pustak sanDh i-aa baad aN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਇਹ ਬਖਾਿਨ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਿਬਰਾਜੁ  ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sil poojas bagul samaaDhaN. you worship stones and sit like a crane, pretending to meditate.

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: You speak lies and well-ornamented falsehood,
lines.transliteration: mukh jh ooth bibhookhan saaraN.
taraipaal t ihaal bichaaraN. and recite your daily prayers three times a day.

lines.english: The mala is around your neck, and the sacred tilak mark is on your forehead.
lines.transliteration: gal maalaa tilak lilaataN.

lines.english: You wear two loin cloths, and keep your head covered.
lines.transliteration: du-ay Dh otee bast ar kapaataN.

lines.english: If you know God and the nature of karma,
lines.transliteration: jo jaanas barahmaN karmaN.
sabh fokat nischai karmaN. you know that all these rituals and beliefs are useless.

lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord with faith.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak nischou Dhi-yaavai.

lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||1||
lines.transliteration: bin satgur baat na paavai. ||1||

lines.english: The mortal's life is fruitless, as long as he does not know God.
lines.transliteration: nihfalaN tas-y janmas-y jaavad  barahm na bindt ay.

lines.english: Only a few, by Guru's Grace, cross over the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: saagraN sansaarsa-y gur parsaadee tareh kay.

lines.english: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful. Thus speaks Nanak, after deep deliberation.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath hai kaho naanak beechaar.

lines.english: The Creation is under the control of the Creator. By His Power, He sustains andsupports it. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaaran kart ay vas hai jin kal rakh ee Dh aar. ||2||

lines.english: The Shabad is Yoga, the Shabad is spiritual wisdom; the Shabad is the Vedas for theBrahmin.
lines.transliteration: jog sabdaN gi-aan sabd aN bayd  sabd aN ta barahman eh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰੰ  ਸੰਸਾਰਸਯ੍ਯ੍  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ  ਤਰਿਹ  ਕੇ ॥
lines.english: The Shabad is heroic bravery for the Khshaatriya; the Shabad is service to others forthe Soodra.
lines.transliteration: kha-yt aree sabd aN soor sabd aN sood ar sabd aN paraa kirt eh.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Shabad for all is the Shabad, the Word of the One God, for one who knows this secret.
lines.transliteration: sarab sabdaN ta ayk sabd aN jay ko jaanas bh ay-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਣੁ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਵਿਸ ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Nanak is the slave of the Divine, Immaculate Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ko d aas hai so-ee niranjan d ay-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ  ਿਗਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ  ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ  ਤ ਬਰ੍ਾਹਮਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord is the Divinity of all divinities. He is the Divinity of the soul.
lines.transliteration: shsik®qI, mÚ 1) ayk krisanN ta sarab d ayvaa d ayv d ayvaa t a aatmah. aat maN saree baasavd aivas-y jay ko-ee jaanas bhayv.

lines.punjabi: ਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਤਰ੍ੀ ਸਬਦੰ  ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ  ਸੂਦਰ੍ ਸਬਦੰ  ਪਰਾ ਿਕਰ੍ਤਹ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is the slave of that one who knows the Secrets of the soul and the Supreme Lord God. He is the Divine Immaculate Lord Himself. ||4|| slok shsik®qI mhlw 5  (1353-15) salok sehaskaritee mehlaa 5 Shalok Sehskritee , Fifth Mehl: <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1353-15) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear.No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
lines.transliteration: naanak taa ko d aas hai so-ee niranjan d ayv. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸਬਦੰ  ਤ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ  ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਸ  ਭੇਉ ॥
lines.english: Who is the mother, and who is the father? Who is the son, and what is the pleasure ofmarriage?
lines.transliteration: katanch maat aa kat anch pit aa kat anch banit aa binod  sutah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Who is the brother, friend, companion and relative? Who is emotionally attached tothe family?
lines.transliteration: katanch bh araat meet  hit banDh av kat anch moh kutamb-yat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਿਕਰ੍ਸ੍ਨੰ ਤ ਸਰਬ  ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਹ  ॥
lines.english: Who is restlessly attached to beauty? It leaves, as soon as we see it.
lines.transliteration: katanch chapal mohnee roopaN paykh antay ti-aagaN karot .

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮੰ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਬਾਸਦੇਵਸਯ੍ਯ੍  ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨਿਸ  ਭੇਵ ॥
lines.english: Only the meditative remembrance of God remains with us. O Nanak, it brings the blessings of the Saints, the sons of the Imperishable Lord. ||1|| pMnw 1354
lines.transliteration: rahant sang bh agvaan simran  naanak labDh a-yaN achut  tanah. ||1||

lines.english: Dharigant  maat  pitaa sanayhaN Dharig sanayhaN bharaat baaNDhvah. Cursed is loving attachment to one's mother and father; cursed is loving attachment to one's siblings and relatives.
Dharig sneh-aN banit aa bilaas sut ah. Cursed is attachment to the joys of family life with one's spouse and children.
Dharig sneh-aN garihaarath kah. Cursed is attachment to household affairs.
Only loving attachment to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is True. Nanakdwells there in peace. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saaDhsang sneh sat i-yaN sukh -yaN basant  naankah. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ  ਸ੍ਨੇਹ ਸਿਤਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਸੁਖਯੰ  ਬਸੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕਹ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The body is false; its power is temporary.
lines.transliteration: mith-yant d ayhaN kheenant balanaN.

lines.english: It grows old; its love for Maya increases greatly.
lines.transliteration: barDhant  jaroo-aa hit -yant maa-i-aa.

lines.english: The human is only a temporary guest in the home of the body, but he has high hopes.
lines.transliteration: at-yant  aasaa aathit -y bhavanaN.

lines.english: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is relentless; he counts each and every breath.
lines.transliteration: ganant savasaa bh aiyaan Dh armaN.

lines.english: The human body, so difficult to obtain, has fallen into the deep dark pit of emotional attachment. O Nanak, its only support is God, the Essence of Reality.
lines.transliteration: patant  moh koop d urlabh a-y dayhaN tat aasar-yaN naanak.

lines.punjabi: ਪਤੰਿਤ  ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪ ਦੁਰਲਭਯ੍ਯ੍  ਦੇਹੰ ਤਤ ਆਸਰ੍ਯੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ॥
lines.english: O God, Lord of the World, Lord of the Universe, Master of the Universe, please be kindto me. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gobind gobind  gobind  gopaal kirpaa. ||3||

lines.english: This fragile body-fortress is made up of water, plastered with blood and wrapped inskin.
lines.transliteration: kaach kotaN rachant t o-yaN laypanaN rakat  charamn eh.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚ  ਕੋਟੰ ਰਚੰਿਤ  ਤੋਯੰ ਲੇਪਨੰ  ਰਕਤ  ਚਰਮਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: It has nine gates, but no doors; it is supported by pillars of wind, the channels of thebreath.
lines.transliteration: navant d u-aaraN bheet rahitaN baa-ay roopaN asthambh nah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਵੰਤ  ਦੁਆਰੰ  ਭੀਤ ਰਿਹਤੰ  ਬਾਇ  ਰੂਪੰ ਅਸਥੰਭਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: The ignorant person does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe;he thinks that this body is permanent.
lines.transliteration: gobind naamaN nah simrant  agi-aanee jaanant  asthiraN.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨਾਮੰ ਨਹ ਿਸਮਰੰਿਤ ਅਿਗਆਨੀ  ਜਾਨੰਿਤ  ਅਸਿਥਰੰ  ॥
lines.english: This precious body is saved and redeemed in the Sanctuary of the Holy, O Nanak,
lines.transliteration: durlabh  dayh uDh rant saaDh  saran  naanak.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਲਭ  ਦੇਹ ਉਧਰੰਤ  ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har har har haray japant. ||4|| chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Haray. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਜਪੰਿਤ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Glorious, Eternal and Imperishable, Perfect and Abundantly Compassionate,
lines.transliteration: subhant  tu-yaN achut  gunga-yaN pooranaN bahulo kirpaalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਭੰਤ  ਤੁਯੰ ਅਚੁਤ  ਗੁਣਗਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਪੂਰਨੰ  ਬਹੁਲੋ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Profound and Unfathomable, Lofty and Exalted, All-knowing and Infinite Lord God.
lines.transliteration: gambheeraN oochai sarbag apaaraa.

lines.english: O Lover of Your devoted servants, Your Feet are a Sanctuary of Peace.
lines.transliteration: bharit i-aa pari-aN bisraam charn aN.

lines.english: O Master of the masterless, Helper of the helpless, Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||5||
lines.transliteration: anaath naathay naanak sarnaN. ||5||

lines.english: Seeing the deer, the hunter aims his weapons.
lines.transliteration: marigee paykhant  baDh ik par-haarayn  lakh-y aavDh ah.

lines.english: But if one is protected by the Lord of the World, O Nanak, not a hair on his head will be touched. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aho jas-y rakhayn  gopaalah naanak rom na chh ayd-yt ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਅਹੋ ਜਸਯ੍ਯ੍ ਰਖੇਣ  ਗੋਪਾਲਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੋਮ ਨ ਛੇਦਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He may be surrounded on all four sides by servants and powerful warriors;
lines.transliteration: baho jatan kart aa balvant  kaaree sayvant  sooraa chat ur disah.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਜਤਨ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਬਲਵੰਤ  ਕਾਰੀ  ਸੇਵੰਤ  ਸੂਰਾ ਚਤੁਰ  ਿਦਸਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bikham thaan basant  oochah nah simrant  marn aN kadaaNcheh. he may dwell in a lofty place, difficult to approach, and never even think of death.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖਮ  ਥਾਨ ਬਸੰਤ  ਊਚਹ  ਨਹ ਿਸਮਰੰਤ  ਮਰਣੰ  ਕਦਚਹ  ॥
lines.english: But when the Order comes from the Primal Lord God, O Nanak, even an ant can takeaway his breath of life. ||7||
lines.transliteration: hovant aagi-aa bh agvaan pukh ah naanak keetee saas akarkh atay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਵੰਿਤ  ਆਿਗਆ  ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀਟੀ  ਸਾਸ ਅਕਰਖਤੇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: To be imbued and attuned to the Word of the Shabad; to be kind and compassionate; to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - these are the most worthwhile actions in thisDark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: sabdaN rataN hitaN ma-i-aa keert aN kalee karam krit u-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੰ  ਰਤੰ ਿਹਤੰ ਮਇਆ  ਕੀਰਤੰ  ਕਲੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਕਰ੍ਤੁਆ  ॥
lines.english: In this way, one's inner doubts and emotional attachments are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: mitant t atraagat  bharam mohaN.

lines.english: God is pervading and permeating all places.
lines.transliteration: bhagvaan ramn aN sarbat ar thaani-yaN.

lines.english: So obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; He dwells upon the tongues of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: darisat t u-yaN amogh  darsanaN basant  saaDh  rasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟ  ਤੁਯੰ ਅਮੋਘ  ਦਰਸਨੰ  ਬਸੰਤ  ਸਾਧ ਰਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, meditate and chant the Name of the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, Har, Haray.||8||
lines.transliteration: har har har haray naanak pari-aN jaap japnaa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅੰ  ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Beauty fades away, islands fade away, the sun, moon, stars and sky fade away.
lines.transliteration: ghatant  roopaN ghatant deepaN ghatant rav sasee-ar nakh -yatar gaganaN.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟੰਤ  ਰੂਪੰ ਘਟੰਤ  ਦੀਪੰ ਘਟੰਤ  ਰਿਵ ਸਸੀਅਰ  ਨਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਤਰ੍  ਗਗਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: The earth, mountains, forests and lands fade away.
lines.transliteration: ghatant  basuDh aa gir t ar sikh aNdaN.

lines.english: One's spouse, children, siblings and loved friends fade away.
lines.transliteration: ghatant  lalnaa sut  bharaat heetaN.

lines.english: Gold and jewels and the incomparable beauty of Maya fade away.
lines.transliteration: ghatant  kanik maanik maa-i-aa savroopaN.

lines.english: Only the Eternal, Unchanging Lord does not fade away.
lines.transliteration: nah ghatant  kayval gopaal achut .

lines.english: O Nanak, only the humble Saints are steady and stable forever. ||9||
lines.transliteration: asthiraN naanak saaDh jan. ||9||

lines.english: Do not delay in practicing righteousness; delay in committing sins.
lines.transliteration: nah bilamb DharmaN bilamb paapaN.

lines.english: Implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within yourself, and abandon greed.
lines.transliteration: darirh -aaNt naamaN tajant lobhaN.

lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, the sins are erased. The character of righteousness is received by that person,
lines.transliteration: saran sant aN kilbikh  naasaN paraapt aN Dharam lakh -yin.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੰਤੰ ਿਕਲਿਬਖ  ਨਾਸੰ ਪਰ੍ਾਪਤੰ  ਧਰਮ ਲਿਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਣ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, with whom the Lord is pleased and satisfied. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak jih suparsan maaDhvah. ||10||

lines.english: The person of shallow understanding is dying in emotional attachment; he isengrossed in pursuits of pleasure with his wife.
lines.transliteration: mirat mohaN alap buDh -yaN rachant  banit aa binod  saahaN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰਤ  ਮੋਹੰ ਅਲਪ  ਬੁਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਰਚੰਿਤ  ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ਸਾਹੰ ॥
lines.english: With youthful beauty and golden earrings,
lines.transliteration: jouban bahikaram kanik kundlah.
bachitar mand ir sobh ant bastaraa it -yant maa-i-aa bi-yaapit aN. wondrous mansions, decorations and clothes - this is how Maya clings to him.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਚਤਰ੍  ਮੰਿਦਰ  ਸੋਭੰਿਤ  ਬਸਤਰ੍ਾ  ਇਤਯ੍ਯ੍ੰਤ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਬਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਿਪਤੰ  ॥
lines.english: O Eternal, Unchanging, Benevolent Lord God, O Sanctuary of the Saints, Nanak humbly bows to You. ||11||
lines.transliteration: hay achut saran  sant naanak bh o bhagvaana-ay namah. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੋ ਭਗਵਾਨਏ  ਨਮਹ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: If there is birth, then there is death. If there is pleasure, then there is pain. If there isenjoyment, then there is disease.
lines.transliteration: janmaN ta marn aN harkh aN ta sogaN bhogaN ta rogaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੰ  ਤ ਮਰਣੰ  ਹਰਖੰ  ਤ ਸੋਗੰ ਭੋਗੰ ਤ ਰੋਗੰ ॥
lines.english: If there is high, then there is low. If there is small, then there is great. pMnw 1355
lines.transliteration: oonchaN ta neechaN naanHaa so moochaN.

lines.english: If there is power, then there is pride. If there is egotistical pride, then there will be a fall.
lines.transliteration: raajaN ta maanaN abhimaanaN ta heenaN.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੰ ਤ ਮਾਨੰ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੰ  ਤ ਹੀਨੰ ॥
lines.english: Engrossed in worldly ways, one is ruined.
lines.transliteration: parvirat maargaN vartant binaasanaN.

lines.english: Meditating and vibrating on the Lord of the Universe in the Company of the Holy, youshall become steady and stable. Nanak vibrates and meditates on the Lord God. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gobind bh ajan saaDh  sangayn  asthiraN naanak bh agvant  bhajnaasnaN. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਭਜਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ  ਅਸਿਥਰੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਭਜਨਾਸਨੰ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: By the Grace of God, genuine understanding comes to the mind.
lines.transliteration: kirpant haree-aN mat tat gi-aanaN.

lines.english: The intellect blossoms forth, and one finds a place in the realm of celestial bliss.
lines.transliteration: bigseeDhiy buDh aa kusal thaanaN.

lines.english: The senses are brought under control, and pride is abandoned.
lines.transliteration: bas-yant rikhi-aN ti-aag maanaN.

lines.english: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the wisdom of the Saints is implanted within.
lines.transliteration: seetlant  rid-yaN darirh sant gi-aanaN.

lines.english: Reincarnation is ended, and the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained.
lines.transliteration: rahant janmaN har d aras leen aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, the musical instrument of the Word of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within. ||13||
lines.transliteration: baajant naanak sabad  been aaN. ||13||

lines.english: The Vedas preach and recount God's Glories; people hear them by various ways andmeans.
lines.transliteration: kahant bayd aa gun ant gunee-aa sun ant baalaa baho biDh  parkaaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੰਤ  ਬੇਦਾ ਗੁਣੰਤ  ਗੁਨੀਆ  ਸੁਣੰਤ ਬਾਲਾ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Lord, Har, Har, implants spiritual wisdom within.
lines.transliteration: darirh -aaNt subid i-aa har har kirpaalaa.

lines.english: Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Guru is the GreatGiver, the Lord of the World. ||14||
lines.transliteration: naam daan jaachant  naanak d ainhaar gur gopaalaa. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Do not worry so much about your mother, father and siblings. Do not worry so muchabout other people.
lines.transliteration: nah chintaa maat  pit bharaatah nah chint aa kachh  lok kah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤ ਭਰ੍ਾਤਹ  ਨਹ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਕਛੁ ਲੋਕ ਕਹ ॥
lines.english: Do not worry about your spouse, children and friends. You are obsessed with yourinvolvements in Maya.
lines.transliteration: nah chintaa banit aa sut  meet ah parvirat  maa-i-aa sanbh anDhnah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤਹ  ਪਰ੍ਿਵਰਿਤ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਨਬੰਧਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord God is Kind and Compassionate, O Nanak. He is the Cherisher and Nurturer of all living beings. ||15||
lines.transliteration: da-i-aal ayk bh agvaan pukh ah naanak sarab jee-a part ipaalkeh. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਦਇਆਲ  ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ਪੁਰਖਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਅ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਕਹ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Wealth is temporary; conscious existence is temporary; hopes of all sorts aretemporary.
lines.transliteration: anit-y vit aN anit-y chit aN anit-y aasaa baho biDh  parkaaraN.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਤਯ੍ਯ੍  ਿਵਤੰ ਅਿਨਤਯ੍ਯ੍  ਿਚਤੰ  ਅਿਨਤਯ੍ਯ੍  ਆਸਾ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰੰ  ॥
lines.english: The bonds of love, attachment, egotism, doubt, Maya and the pollution of corruptionare temporary.
lines.transliteration: anit-y hayt aN ahaN banDh aN bharam maa-i-aa malanaN bikaaraN.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਤਯ੍ਯ੍  ਹੇਤੰ ਅਹੰ ਬੰਧੰ ਭਰਮ  ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲਨੰ  ਿਬਕਾਰੰ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal passes through the fire of the womb of reincarnation countless times. Hedoes not remember the Lord in meditation; his understanding is polluted.
lines.transliteration: firant jon anayk jh athraagan nah simrant  maleen  buDh -yaN.

lines.punjabi: ਿਫਰੰਤ  ਜੋਿਨ ਅਨੇਕ  ਜਠਰਾਗਿਨ  ਨਹ ਿਸਮਰੰਤ  ਮਲੀਣ  ਬੁਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ॥
lines.english: O Lord of the Universe, when You grant Your Grace, even sinners are saved. Nanakdwells in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||16||
lines.transliteration: hay gobind karat  ma-i-aa naanak pat it uDhaaran  saaDh  sangmah. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕਰਤ  ਮਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: You may drop down from the mountains, and fall into the nether regions of theunderworld, or be burnt in the blazing fire,
lines.transliteration: girant gir pat it paataalaN jalant  daydeep-y baisvaaNtareh.

bahant agaah t o-yaN tarangaN dukhant garah chint aa janmaN ta marn ah. or swept away by the unfathomable waves of water; but the worst pain of all ishousehold anxiety, which is the source of the cycle of death and rebirth.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੰਿਤ  ਅਗਾਹ  ਤੋਯੰ ਤਰੰਗੰ  ਦੁਖੰਤ  ਗਰ੍ਹ ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਜਨਮੰ  ਤ ਮਰਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: 5) anik saaDhanaN na siDh -yatai naanak asthambh aN asthambh aN asthambh aN sabad saaDh savajniH. ||17|| No matter what you do, you cannot break its bonds, O Nanak. Man's only Support, Anchor and Mainstay is the Word of the Shabad, and the Holy, Friendly Saints. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਸਾਧਨੰ  ਨ ਿਸਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ  ਅਸਥੰਭੰ  ਸਬਦ  ਸਾਧ ਸਜਨਹ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Excruciating pain, countless killings, reincarnation, poverty and terrible misery
lines.transliteration: ghor d ukh-yaN anik hat -yaN janam d aaridaraN mahaa bikh -yaadN.

lines.punjabi: ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਅਿਨਕ  ਹਤਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਜਨਮ  ਦਾਿਰਦਰ੍ੰ  ਮਹਾ ਿਬਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਦੰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: mitant sagal simrant  har naam naanak jaisay paavak kaasat bh asmaN karot . ||18|| are all destroyed by meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, O Nanak, just asfire reduces piles of wood to ashes. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਟੰਤ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਸਮਰੰਤ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਕ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਭਸਮੰ  ਕਰੋਿਤ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the darkness is illuminated. Dwelling on HisGlorious Praises, the ugly sins are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: anDhkaar simrat  parkaasaN gun ramant  agh khandnah.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ  ਿਸਮਰਤ ਪਰ੍ਕਾਸੰ  ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ  ਅਘ  ਖੰਡਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: Enshrining the Lord deep within the heart, and with the immaculate karma of doinggood deeds, one strikes fear into the demons.
lines.transliteration: rid basant  bhai bheet dootah karam karat  mahaa niramleh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਦ ਬਸੰਿਤ  ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਦੂਤਹ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਤ  ਮਹਾ ਿਨਰਮਲਹ  ॥
lines.english: The cycle of coming and going in reincarnation is ended, absolute peace is obtained,and the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
lines.transliteration: janam maran rahant  sarot aa sukh  samooh amogh  darasneh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ  ਸਰ੍ੋਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਅਮੋਘ  ਦਰਸਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: He is Potent to give Protection, He is the Lover of His Saints. O Nanak, the Lord Godblesses all with bliss. ||19||
lines.transliteration: saran jogaN sant pari-a naanak so bh agvaan kh aymaN karot . ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ  ਜੋਗੰ ਸੰਤ ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ਖੇਮੰ ਕਰੋਿਤ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: Those who were left behind - the Lord brings them to the front. He fulfills the hopesof the hopeless.
lines.transliteration: paachhaN karot  agarn eeveh niraasaN aas poornah.

lines.english: He makes the poor rich, and cures the illnesses of the ill.
lines.transliteration: nirDhan bh a-yaN Dhanvant ah rogee-aN rog kh andnah.

lines.english: He blesses His devotees with devotion. They sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bhagat -yaN bhagat daanaN raam naam gun  keerat neh.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਦਾਨੰ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who serve the Guru find the Supreme Lord God, the Great Giver||20||
lines.transliteration: paarbarahm purakh d aataareh naanak gur sayvaa kiN na labh -yatai. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਦਾਤਾਰਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਕੰ ਨ  ਲਭਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: He gives Support to the unsupported. The Name of the Lord is the Wealth of the poor.
lines.transliteration: aDhraN DharaN Dhaarnah nirDh anaN Dhan naam narhareh.

lines.punjabi: ਅਧਰੰ  ਧਰੰ ਧਾਰਣਹ  ਿਨਰਧਨੰ  ਧਨ ਨਾਮ ਨਰਹਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is the Master of the masterless; the Beautiful-haired Lord isthe Power of the weak.
lines.transliteration: anaath naath gobindah balheen  bal kaysvah.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਾਥ  ਨਾਥ ਗੋਿਬੰਦਹ  ਬਲਹੀਣ  ਬਲ ਕੇਸਵਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is Merciful to all beings, Eternal and Unchanging, the Family of the meek andhumble.
lines.transliteration: sarab bhoot  da-yaal achut  deen baaNDhav daamod areh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਭੂਤ ਦਯਾਲ  ਅਚੁਤ  ਦੀਨ  ਬਧਵ  ਦਾਮੋਦਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: The All-knowing, Perfect, Primal Lord God is the Lover of His devotees, the Embodiment of Mercy. pMnw 1356
lines.transliteration: sarabga-y pooran purakh bh agvaaneh bh agat vachh al karun aa ma-yeh.

lines.english: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent, Luminous Lord, dwells in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at basant  baasud ayveh paarbarahm parmaysureh.

lines.punjabi: ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਬਸੰਤ  ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਹ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak begs for this blessing from the Merciful Lord, that he may never forget Him, never forget Him. ||21||
lines.transliteration: jaachant naanak kirpaal parsaad aN nah bisrant  nah bisrant  naaraa-in eh. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਚੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੰ  ਨਹ ਿਬਸਰੰਿਤ  ਨਹ ਿਬਸਰੰਿਤ  ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: I have no power; I do not serve You, and I do not love You, O Supreme Sublime LordGod.
lines.transliteration: nah samrathaN nah sayvkaN nah pareet param parkh otamaN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਸਮਰਥੰ  ਨਹ ਸੇਵਕੰ  ਨਹ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਪਰਮ  ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੰ  ॥
lines.english: By Your Grace, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har,Har. ||22||
lines.transliteration: tav parsaad  simart ay naamaN naanak kirpaal har har guraN. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਤਵ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਿਸਮਰਤੇ  ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੰ ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: The Lord feeds and sustains all living beings; He blesses them gifts of restful peaceand fine clothes.
lines.transliteration: bharan  pokh an karant  jee-aa bisraam chh aadan dayvant  daanaN.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਣ  ਪੋਖਣ  ਕਰੰਤ  ਜੀਆ  ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ ਛਾਦਨ  ਦੇਵੰਤ  ਦਾਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: He created the jewel of human life, with all its cleverness and intelligence.
lines.transliteration: sirjaNt ratan janam chat ur chayt nah.

lines.english: By His Grace, mortals abide in peace and bliss.
lines.transliteration: vartant  sukh  aanand  parsaad eh.

lines.english: O Nanak, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, Haray,
lines.transliteration: simrant naanak har har haray.
anit-y rachnaa nirmoh t ay. ||23|| the mortal is released from attachment to the world. ||23||

lines.english: The kings of the earth are eating up the blessings of the good karma of their pastlives.
lines.transliteration: daanaN paraa poorbayn  bhuNchant ay maheepat ay.

lines.english: Those cruel-minded rulers who oppress the people, O Nanak, shall suffer in pain for a very long time. ||24||
lines.transliteration: bipreet buDh -yaN maarat  lokah naanak chirankaal d ukh bhogtay. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਪਰੀਤ ਬੁਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਮਾਰਤ  ਲੋਕਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਚਰੰਕਾਲ  ਦੁਖ ਭੋਗਤੇ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the Lord in their hearts, look upon even painas God's Grace.
lines.transliteration: baritha anugrahaN gobindah jas-y simran  ridantrah.

lines.english: The healthy person is very sick, if he does not remember the Lord, the Embodiment ofMercy. ||25||
lines.transliteration: aarog-yaN mahaa rog-yaN bisimritay karun aa ma-yeh. ||25||

lines.english: To sing the Kirtan of God's Praises is the righteous duty incurred by taking birth in thishuman body.
lines.transliteration: ramnaN kayvlaN keerat anaN suDh armaN dayh Dh aarnah.

lines.punjabi: ਰਮਣੰ  ਕੇਵਲੰ  ਕੀਰਤਨੰ  ਸੁਧਰਮੰ  ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak. The Saints drink it in,and never have enough of it. ||26||
lines.transliteration: amrit naam naaraa-in  naanak peevt aN sant na tariptayatay. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੀਵਤੰ  ਸੰਤ ਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: The Saints are tolerant and good-natured; friends and enemies are the same to them.
lines.transliteration: sahan seel sant aN sam mit arsa-y d urajneh.

lines.english: O Nanak, it is all the same to them, whether someone offers them all sorts of foods,or slanders them, or draws weapons to kill them. ||27||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhojan anik parkaarayn  nindak aavaDh  ho-ay upt istatay. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਭੋਜਨ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰੇਣ  ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਆਵਧ  ਹੋਇ ਉਪਿਤਸਟਤੇ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: They pay no attention to dishonor or disrespect.
lines.transliteration: tiraskaar nah bh avant  nah bh avant  maan bh angnah.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਰਸਕਾਰ  ਨਹ ਭਵੰਿਤ  ਨਹ ਭਵੰਿਤ  ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: They are not bothered by gossip; the miseries of the world do not touch them.
lines.transliteration: sobhaa heen nah bh avant  nah pohant  sansaar d ukhnah.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਭਾ ਹੀਨ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਿਤ  ਨਹ ਪੋਹੰਿਤ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਦੁਖਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chant the Name of the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, those mortals abide in peace. ||28||
lines.transliteration: gobind naam japant  mil saaDh  sangah naanak say paraan ee sukh  baasnah. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨਾਮ ਜਪੰਿਤ  ਿਮਿਲ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਹ  ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: The Holy people are an invincible army of spiritual warriors; their bodies are protectedby the armor of humility.
lines.transliteration: sainaa saaDh samooh soor ajit aN saNnaahaN tan nimart aah.

lines.punjabi: ਸੈਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੂਰ ਅਿਜਤੰ  ਸੰਨਾਹੰ  ਤਿਨ  ਿਨੰਮਰ੍ਤਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: Their weapons are the Glorious Praises of the Lord which they chant; their Shelter andShield is the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: aavDhah gun  gobind  ramn aN ot gur sabad  kar charamn eh.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਧਹ  ਗੁਣ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਰਮਣੰ  ਓਟ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ  ਕਰ ਚਰਮਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: The horses, chariots and elephants they ride are their way to realize God's Path.
lines.transliteration: aaroorh-t ay asav rath naagah bujh antay parabh  maargah.

lines.punjabi: ਆਰੂੜਤੇ  ਅਸ ਰਥ ਨਾਗਹ  ਬੁਝੰਤੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਾਰਗਹ  ॥
lines.english: They walk fearlessly through the armies of their enemies; they attack them with theKirtan of God's Praises.
lines.transliteration: bichartay nirabh -yaN satar sainaa Dh aa-yant ay gopaal keerat neh.

lines.english: They conquer the entire world, O Nanak, and overpower the five thieves. ||29||
lines.transliteration: jittay bisav sansaarah naanak vas-yaN karot  panch t askarahi. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤਤੇ  ਿਬਸ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਸਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਕਰੋਿਤ  ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ  ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Misled by evil-mindedness, mortals are engrossed in the mirage of the illusory world,like the passing shade of a tree.
lines.transliteration: marig tarisnaa ganDh arab nagraN darum chh aa-yaa rach d uramt ih.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰ੍ਗ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਨਗਰੰ  ਦਰ੍ੁਮ ਛਾਯਾ  ਰਿਚ ਦੁਰਮਿਤਹ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to family is false, so Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||30||
lines.transliteration: tatah kutamb moh mith-yaa simrant  naanak raam raam naamah. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਤਤਹ  ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮੋਹ ਿਮਥਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ  ਿਸਮਰੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਹ  ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: I do not possess the treasure of the wisdom of the Vedas, nor do I possess the meritsof the Praises of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: nach bidi-aa niDh aan nigamaN nach gun ga-y naam keerat neh.

lines.english: I do not have a beautiful voice to sing jewelled melodies; I am not clever, wise orshrewd.
lines.transliteration: nach raag ratan kanth aN nah chanchal chat ur chaat ureh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਚ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ  ਕੰਠੰ ਨਹ ਚੰਚਲ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਚਾਤੁਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: By destiny and hard work, the wealth of Maya is obtained. O Nanak, in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy, even fools become religious scholars. ||31||
lines.transliteration: bhaag ud im labDh a-yaN maa-i-aa naanak saaDh sang kh al pandit ah. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਗ ਉਿਦਮ  ਲਬਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਖਲ ਪੰਿਡਤਹ  ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: The mala around my neck is the chanting of the Lord's Name. The Love of the Lord ismy silent chanting.
lines.transliteration: kanth ramn eey raam raam maalaa hasat  ooch paraym Dh aarnee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਠ ਰਮਣੀਯ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਲਾ  ਹਸਤ  ਊਚ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਧਾਰਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting this most Sublime Word brings salvation and joy to the eyes. ||32||
lines.transliteration: jeeh bhan  jo utam salok uDh arnaN nain nand nee. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਹ ਭਿਣ ਜੋ ਉਤਮ  ਸਲੋਕ  ਉਧਰਣੰ  ਨੈਨ ਨੰਦਨੀ  ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: That mortal who lacks the Guru's Mantra - cursed and contaminated is his life.
lines.transliteration: gur mantar heen sa-y jo paraan ee Dh arigant  janam bh arsatn ah.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਰ੍ ਹੀਣਸਯ੍ਯ੍  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੰਤ  ਜਨਮ  ਭਰ੍ਸਟਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: That blockhead is just a dog, a pig, a jackass, a crow, a snake. ||33||
lines.transliteration: kookrah sookrah garaDh-bh eh kaakah sarapneh t ul khalah. ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਕਰਹ ਸੂਕਰਹ  ਗਰਧਭਹ  ਕਾਕਹ  ਸਰਪਨਹ  ਤੁਿਲ  ਖਲਹ  ॥੩੩॥
lines.english: Whoever contemplates the Lord's Lotus Feet, and enshrines His Name within the heart, pMnw 1357
lines.transliteration: charnaarbind  bhajanaN rid-yaN naam Dh aarnah.

lines.english: Messenger of Death. ||34||
lines.transliteration: keeratanaN saaDh sangayn  naanak nah d arisat-aNt jamd ootneh. ||34|| and sings the Kirtan of His Praises in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak, shall never see the

lines.punjabi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ  ਧਨੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ  ਸਰਗ ਰਾਜਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: Wealth and beauty are not so difficult to obtain. Paradise and royal power are not sodifficult to obtain.
lines.transliteration: nach durlabh aN danaN roopaN nach d urlabh aN savarag raajnah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ  ਭੋਜਨੰ  ਿਬੰਜਨੰ  ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ  ਸਛ ਅੰਬਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: Foods and delicacies are not so difficult to obtain. Elegant clothes are not so difficuiltto obtain.
lines.transliteration: nach durlabh aN bhojanaN biNjanaN nach d urlabh aN savachh  ambreh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ  ਸੁਤ ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਭਰ੍ਾਤ ਬਧਵ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ  ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਿਬਲਾਸਹ  ॥
lines.english: Children, friends, siblings and relatives are not so difficult to obtain. The pleasures ofwoman are not so difficult to obtain.
lines.transliteration: nach durlabh aN sut mitar bharaat baaNDhav nach d urlabh aN banit aa bilaaseh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ  ਿਬਿਦਆ  ਪਰ੍ਬੀਣੰ  ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ  ਚਤੁਰ  ਚੰਚਲਹ  ॥
lines.english: Knowledge and wisdom are not so difficult to obtain. Cleverness and trickery are notso difficult to obtain.
lines.transliteration: nach durlabh aN bidi-aa parbeen aN nach d urlabh aN chatur chanchleh.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ਨਾਮਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਬਿਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭੰ ॥੩੫॥
lines.english: ||35|| Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is difficult to obtain. O Nanak, it is onlyobtained by God's Grace, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||35||
lines.transliteration: durlabh aN ayk bh agvaan naamah naanak labDh i-yaN saaDh sang kirpaa parabh aN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤ ਕਤਹ  ਤਤਹ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਟੰ  ਸਰਗ  ਮਰਤ ਪਯਾਲ  ਲੋਕਹ  ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, whether in this world, in paradise, or the nether regions of the underworld.
lines.transliteration: jat kat ah tatah daristaN savarag marat  pa-yaal lokah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਰਮਣੰ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਿਲਪਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ  ॥੩੬॥
lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. O Nanak, no blame or stainsticks to Him. ||36||
lines.transliteration: sarbatar ramn aN gobind ah naanak layp chh ayp na lip-yat ai. ||36||

lines.english: Poison is transformed into nectar, and enemies into friends and companions.
lines.transliteration: bikhyaa bh a-yant  amrit aN darustaaN sakhaa savajniH.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖੰ ਭਯੰਿਤ  ਸੁਖਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਭੈ ਭੀਤੰ ਤ ਿਨਰਭਯਹ  ॥
lines.english: Pain is changed into pleasure, and the fearful become fearless.
lines.transliteration: dukhaN bha-yant  sukh -yaN bhai bheetaN ta nirabh yeh.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਨ ਿਬਹੂਨ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮ  ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਹ  ॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Those who have no home or place find their place of rest in the Naam, O Nanak,when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||37||
lines.transliteration: thaan bihoon bisraam naamaN naanak kirpaal har har gurah. ||37||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੀਲ  ਮਮੰ ਸੀਲੰ  ਸਰਬ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਮਮ ਪਾਵਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: He blesses all with humility; He has blessed me with humility as well. He purifies all, and He has purified me as well.
lines.transliteration: sarab seel mamaN seelaN sarab paavan mam paavnah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਕਰਤਬ  ਮਮੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਿਲਪਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ  ॥੩੮॥
lines.english: The Creator of all is the Creator of me as well. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks toHim. ||38||
lines.transliteration: sarab kartab mamaN kartaa naanak layp chh ayp na lip-yat ai. ||38||

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ  ਚੰਦਰ੍ ਦੇਵਹ  ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ  ਬਾਵਨ  ਚੰਦਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: The moon-god is not cool and calm, nor is the white sandalwood tree.
lines.transliteration: nah seetlaN chand ar dayvah nah seet laN baavan chandnah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸੀਤ ਰੁਤੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੀਤਲੰ  ਸਾਧ ਸਜਨਹ  ॥੩੯॥
lines.english: The winter season is not cool; O Nanak, only the Holy friends, the Saints, are cool and calm. ||39||
lines.transliteration: nah seetlaN seet rutayn naanak seet laN saaDh  savajniH. ||39||

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਤਰ੍ੰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੰ ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਪੂਰਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one meditates on the All-pervading Lord.
lines.transliteration: mantraN raam raam naamaN Dha-yaana sarbat ar poornah.

lines.english: Those who have the wisdom to look alike upon pleasure and pain, live the immaculatelifestyle, free of vengeance.
lines.transliteration: ga-yaana sam dukh  sukh aN jugat  nirmal nirvairn eh.

lines.english: They are kind to all beings; they have overpowered the five thieves.
lines.transliteration: da-yaalaN sarbat ar jee-aa panch d okh bivarjit eh.

lines.punjabi: ਭੋਜਨੰ  ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ  ਅਲਪ  ਮਾਯਾ  ਜਲ ਕਮਲ  ਰਹਤਹ  ॥
lines.english: They take the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise as their food; they remain untouched byMaya, like the lotus in the water.
lines.transliteration: bhojanaN gopaal keerat anaN alap maa-yaa jal kamal raht ah.

lines.punjabi: ਉਪਦੇਸੰ  ਸਮ ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਸਤਰ੍ਹ  ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਵਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: They share the Teachings with friend and enemy alike; they love the devotionalworship of God.
lines.transliteration: updaysaN sam mit ar sat reh bh agvant  bhagat bhaavnee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਿਨੰਦਾ ਨਹ ਸਰ੍ੋਿਤ ਸਰ੍ਵਣੰ  ਆਪੁ  ਿਤਯ੍ਯ੍ਿਗ ਸਗਲ  ਰੇਣੁਕਹ  ॥
lines.english: They do not listen to slander; renouncing self-conceit, they become the dust of all.
lines.transliteration: par nindaa nah sarot  sarvan aN aap t i-yaag sagal rayn ukeh.

lines.punjabi: ਖਟ ਲਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਣ  ਪੂਰਨੰ  ਪੁਰਖਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਸਜਨਹ ॥੪੦॥
lines.english: Whoever has these six qualities, O Nanak, is called a Holy friend. ||40||
lines.transliteration: khat lakh -yan pooranaN pukh ah naanak naam saaDh  savajniH. ||40||

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਾ  ਭੋਗੰਤ  ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੰ ਬਸੰਤੇ  ਸਮੀਿਪ  ਕੇਹਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: The goat enjoys eating fruits and roots, but if it lives near a tiger, it is always anxious.
lines.transliteration: ajaa bhogant  kand  moolaN basant ay sameep kayhrah.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤਰ੍ ਗਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ  ਿਬਆਪਤੇ ॥੪੧॥
lines.english: This is the condition of the world, O Nanak; it is afflicted by pleasure and pain. ||41||
lines.transliteration: tatar gat ay sansaarah naanak sog harkh aN bi-aapat ay. ||41||

lines.english: Fraud, false accusations, millions of diseases, sins and the filthy residues of evil mistakes;
lines.transliteration: chhalaN chhidaraN kot bigh anaN apraaDh aN kilbikh  malaN.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮ  ਮੋਹੰ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨੰ  ਮਦੰ ਮਾਯਾ  ਿਬਆਿਪਤੰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam mohaN maan apmaanaN madaN maa-yaa bi-aapit aN. doubt, emotional attachment, pride, dishonor and intoxication with Maya

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਰ੍ਤਯ੍ਯ੍ੁ ਜਨਮ  ਭਰ੍ਮੰਿਤ  ਨਰਕਹ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਉਪਾਵੰ  ਨ ਿਸਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: mitar-yo janam bh armant  narkah anik upaavaN na siDh -yatai. - these lead mortals to death and rebirth, wandering lost in hell. In spite of all sorts ofefforts, salvation is not found.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲੰ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ  ਜਪੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
lines.english: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Companyof the Holy, O Nanak, mortals become immaculate and pure.
lines.transliteration: nirmalaN saaDh sangah japant  naanak gopaal naamaN.

lines.english: They continually dwell upon the Glorious Praises of God. ||42||
lines.transliteration: ramant gun  gobind  nit parteh. ||42||

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਣ  ਸਰਣ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਰਮਣ  ਸੀਲ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: In the Sanctuary of the Kind-hearted Lord, our Transcendent Lord and Master, we arecarried across.
lines.transliteration: taran saran  su-aamee raman  seel parmaysureh.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥਹ  ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪੂਰਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: God is the Perfect, All-powerful Cause of causes; He is the Giver of gifts.
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samartheh d aan d ayt parabh  poornah.

lines.english: He gives hope to the hopeless. He is the Source of all riches.
lines.transliteration: niraas aas karnaN sagal arath aalyeh.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਣ ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਿਸਮਰੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਗਲ  ਜਾਚੰਤ  ਜਾਿਚਕਹ  ॥੪੩॥
lines.english: Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Treasure of Virtue; we are all beggars, begging at His Door. ||43||
lines.transliteration: gun niDh aan simrant  naanak sagal jaachant  jaachikeh. ||43||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਗਮ  ਸਥਾਨ  ਸੁਗਮੰ  ਮਹਾ ਦੂਖ ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: The most difficult place becomes easy, and the worst pain turns into pleasure.
lines.transliteration: durgam sathaan sugamaN mahaa d ookh sarab sookh -nah.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਬਚਨ  ਭੇਦ ਭਰਮੰ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਿਪਸਨੰ  ਤ ਸੁਰਜਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: Evil words, differences and doubts are obliterated, and even faithless cynics andmalicious gossips become good people.
lines.transliteration: durbachan bh ayd bharamaN saakat  pisanaN ta surajneh.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਿਥਤੰ  ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ  ਭੈ ਖੀਣੰ  ਤ ਿਨਰਭਵਹ  ॥
lines.english: They become steady and stable, whether happy or sad; their fears are taken away,and they are fearless. pMnw 1358
lines.transliteration: asthitaN sog harkh aN bhai kheenaN ta nirabh veh.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਅਟਵੀਅੰ  ਮਹਾ ਨਗਰ  ਬਾਸੰ ਧਰਮ  ਲਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਮਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The dreadful woods become a well-populated city; such are the merits of the righteous life of Dharma, given by God's Grace.
lines.transliteration: bhai atvee-aN mahaa nagar baasaN Dharam lakh -yan parabh  ma-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ  ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਣੰ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਯਾਲ  ਚਰਣੰ  ॥੪੪॥
lines.english: Chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak,the Lotus Feet of the Merciful Lord are found. ||44||
lines.transliteration: saaDh sangam raam raam ramn aN saran  naanak har har d a-yaal charn aN. ||44||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਅਿਜਤ  ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਾਮੰ  ਅਿਤ  ਬਲਨਾ  ਬਹੁ ਮਰਦਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: O emotional attachment, you are the invincible warrior of the battlefield of life; youtotally crush and destroy even the most powerful.
lines.transliteration: hay ajit soor sangraamaN at balnaa baho marad neh.

lines.punjabi: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਦੇਵ ਮਾਨੁਖਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਿਬਮੋਹਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: You entice and fascinate even the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, gods, mortals, beasts and birds.
lines.transliteration: gan ganDh arab d ayv maanukh -yaN pas pankh ee bimohneh.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੰ  ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਗਦੀਸਰਹ  ॥੪੫॥
lines.english: Nanak bows in humble surrender to the Lord; he seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord ofthe Universe. ||45||
lines.transliteration: har karanhaaraN namaskaaraN saran  naanak jagd eesvareh. ||45||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਕਾਮੰ ਨਰਕ  ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮੰ  ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰ੍ਮਾਵਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: O sexual desire, you lead the mortals to hell; you make them wander in reincarnationthrough countless species.
lines.transliteration: hay kaamaN narak bisraamaN baho jonee bharmaavn eh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤ  ਹਰਣੰ  ਤਰ੍ੈ ਲੋਕ ਗੰਮਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੀਲ  ਿਬਦਾਰਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: You cheat the consciousness, and pervade the three worlds. You destroy meditation,penance and virtue.
lines.transliteration: chit harn aN tarai lok gam-yaN jap tap seel bid aarneh.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਪ  ਸੁਖ ਅਿਵਤ  ਚੰਚਲ  ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਵਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: But you give only shallow pleasure, while you make the mortals weak and unsteady;you pervade the high and the low.
lines.transliteration: alap sukh avit  chanchal ooch neech samaavn eh.

lines.punjabi: ਤਵ ਭੈ ਿਬਮੁੰਿਚਤ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ  ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ  ॥੪੬॥
lines.english: Your fear is dispelled in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak,through the Protection and Support of the Lord. ||46||
lines.transliteration: tav bh ai bimuNchit saaDh  sangam ot naanak naaraa-in eh. ||46||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਕਿਲ  ਮੂਲ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੰ ਕਦੰਚ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨ ਉਪਰਜਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: O anger, you are the root of conflict; compassion never rises up in you.
lines.transliteration: hay kal mool kroDh-aN kadanch karun aa na uparjat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖਯੰਤ  ਜੀਵੰ ਵਸਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਕਰੋਿਤ  ਿਨਰਤਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਕਰੋਿਤ  ਜਥਾ ਮਰਕਟਹ  ॥
lines.english: You take the corrupt, sinful beings in your power, and make them dance likemonkeys.
lines.transliteration: bikh-yant  jeevaN vas-yaN karot  nirt-yaN karot  jathaa marakteh.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਸਾਸਨ  ਤਾੜੰਿਤ  ਜਮਦੂਤਹ  ਤਵ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਧਮੰ  ਨਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: Associating with you, mortals are debased and punished by the Messenger of Death in so many ways.
lines.transliteration: anik saasan taarh ant jamd ooteh tav sangay aDh amaN narah.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ  ਦਯਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ  ਰਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ ਕਰੋਿਤ  ॥੪੭॥
lines.english: O Destroyer of the pains of the poor, O Merciful God, Nanak prays for You to protectall begins from such anger. ||47||
lines.transliteration: deen d ukh bhanjan d a-yaal parabh  naanak sarab jee-a rakh -yaa karot . ||47||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਲੋਭਾ ਲੰਪਟ  ਸੰਗ ਿਸਰਮੋਰਹ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਲਹਰੀ  ਕਲੋਲਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: O greed, you cling to even the great, assaulting them with countless waves.
lines.transliteration: hay lobhaa lampat sang sirmohreh anik lahree kalolat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵੰਤ  ਜੀਆ  ਬਹੁ ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰੰ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਡੋਲਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaavant  jee-aa baho parkaaraN anik bh aaNt baho dolt ay. You cause them to run around wildly in all directions, wobbling and waveringunsteadily.

lines.punjabi: ਨਚ ਿਮਤਰ੍ੰ ਨਚ ਇਸਟੰ  ਨਚ ਬਾਧਵ  ਨਚ ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਤਵ ਲਜਯਾ  ॥
lines.english: You have no respect for friends, ideals, relations, mother or father.
lines.transliteration: nach mitraN nach istaN nach baaDh av nach maat  pitaa tav lajyaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਰਣੰ  ਕਰੋਿਤ  ਅਖਾਿਦਯ੍ਯ੍  ਖਾਦਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਅਸਾਜਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਸਾਿਜ  ਸਮਜਯਾ  ॥
lines.english: You make them do what they should not do. You make them eat what they should noteat. You make them accomplish what they should not accomplish.
lines.transliteration: akranaN karot  akhaad-ya kh aad-yaN asaaj-yaN saaj samajyaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਿਬਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਿਪ੍ਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਨਰਹਰਹ  ॥੪੮॥
lines.english: Save me, save me - I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Nanakprays to the Lord. ||48||
lines.transliteration: taraahi t araahi saran  su-aamee big-yaapat i naanak har narhareh. ||48||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਮੂਲੰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੰ  ਪਾਪਾਤਮਾ  ॥
lines.english: O egotism, you are the root of birth and death and the cycle of reincarnation; you arethe very soul of sin.
lines.transliteration: hay janam maran moolaN ahaNkaaraN paapaat maa.

lines.english: You forsake friends, and hold tight to enemies. You spread out countless illusions of Maya.
lines.transliteration: mitraN tajant satraN darirh-aaNt anik maa-yaa bist eerniH.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵੰਤ  ਜਾਵੰਤ  ਥਕੰਤ  ਜੀਆ  ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: You cause the living beings to come and go until they are exhausted. You lead themto experience pain and pleasure.
lines.transliteration: aavant jaavant  thakant  jee-aa d ukh sukh  baho bh ognah.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮ ਭਯਾਨ  ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਰਮਣੰ  ਮਹਾ ਿਬਕਟ  ਅਸਾਧ  ਰੋਗਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: You lead them to wander lost in the terrible wilderness of doubt; you lead them tocontract the most horrible, incurable diseases.
lines.transliteration: bharam bh a-yaan ud i-aan ramn aN mahaa bikat asaaDh  rognah.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਦਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰ  ਆਰਾਿਧ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥੪੯॥
lines.english: The only Physician is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God. Nanak worshipsand adores the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||49||
lines.transliteration: baid-yaN paarbarahm parmaysvar aaraaDh  naanak har har haray. ||49||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਣ  ਨਾਥ ਗੋਿਬੰਦਹ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਧਾਨ  ਜਗਦ  ਗੁਰੋ ॥
lines.english: O Lord of the Universe, Master of the Breath of life, Treasure of Mercy, Guru of theWorld.
lines.transliteration: hay paraan naath gobind ah kirpaa niDh aan jagad  guro.

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਤਾਪ ਹਰਣਹ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੋ ॥
lines.english: O Destroyer of the fever of the world, Embodiment of Compassion, please take awayall my pain.
lines.transliteration: hay sansaar taap harn ah karun aa mai sabh  dukh haro.

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਸਰਿਣ  ਜੋਗ ਦਯਾਲਹ  ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਮਯਾ ਕਰੋ ॥
lines.english: O Merciful Lord, Potent to give Sanctuary, Master of the meek and humble, please bekind to me.
lines.transliteration: hay saran jog d a-yaaleh d eenaa naath ma-yaa karo.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰੀਰ  ਸਸਥ  ਖੀਣ  ਸਮਏ  ਿਸਮਰੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ  ਮਾਧਵਹ ॥੫੦॥
lines.english: Whether his body is healthy or sick, let Nanak meditate in remembrance on You, Lord.||50||
lines.transliteration: sareer savasth kheen  sam-ay simrant  naanak raam d aamod ar maaDh vah. ||50||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਸਰਣੰ  ਰਮਣੰ  ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਕੀਰਤਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet, where I sing the Kirtan of His Praises.
lines.transliteration: charan kamal sarn aN ramn aN gopaal keerat neh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ  ਤਰਣੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ  ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥੫੧॥
lines.english: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak is carried across the utterlyterrifying, difficult world-ocean. ||51||
lines.transliteration: saaDh sangayn  tarnaN naanak mahaa saagar bh ai dutrah. ||51||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਰ ਮਸ੍ਤਕ  ਰਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੰ  ਹਸ੍ਤ ਕਾਯਾ  ਰਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Lord God has procted my head and forehead; the Transcendent Lordhas protected my hands and body.
lines.transliteration: sir mastak rakh -yaa paarbrahmaN hast kaa-yaa rakh -yaa parmaysvareh.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਧਨ ਚਰਣ  ਰਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: God, my Lord and Master, has saved my soul; the Lord of the Universe has saved mywealth and feet.
lines.transliteration: aatam rakh -yaa gopaal su-aamee Dh an charan  rakh-yaa jagd eesvareh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਰਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਯਾਲਹ  ਭੈ ਦੂਖ ਿਬਨਾਸਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Merciful Guru has protected everything, and destroyed my fear and suffering.
lines.transliteration: sarab rakh-yaa gur d a-yaaleh bh ai dookh binaasneh.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਵਛਲ  ਅਨਾਥ  ਨਾਥੇ ਸਰਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਅਚੁਤਹ  ॥੫੨॥
lines.english: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Master of the masterless. Nanak has entered theSanctuary of the Imperishable Primal Lord God. ||52||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  vachh al anaath naathay saran  naanak purakh  achut eh. ||52||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ  ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਆਕਾਸੰ  ਬੈਸੰਤਰੰ  ਕਾਸਟ  ਬੇਸਟੰ  ॥
lines.english: His Power supports the sky, and locks fire within wood.
lines.transliteration: jayn kalaa Dhaari-o aakaasaN baisaNtaaraN kaasat baystaN.

lines.english: His Power supports the moon, the sun and the stars, and infuses light and breath into the body. pMnw 1359
lines.transliteration: jayn kalaa sas soor nakh-yat ar jot -yaN saasaN sareer Dh aarnaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਸ ਸੂਰ ਨਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਤਰ੍  ਜੋਿਤਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਸਾਸੰ ਸਰੀਰ  ਧਾਰਣੰ  ॥
lines.english: His Power provides nourishment in the womb of the mother, and does not let disease strike.
lines.transliteration: jayn kalaa maat garabh  paritpaalaN nah chh aydant jathar rogn ah.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ  ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲੰ  ਨਹ ਛੇਦੰਤ  ਜਠਰ  ਰੋਗਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: His Power holds back the ocean, O Nanak, and does not allow the waves of water todestroy the land. ||53||
lines.transliteration: tayn kalaa asthambh aN sarovaraN naanak nah chh ijant tarang t oyneh. ||53||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਨ ਕਲਾ  ਅਸਥੰਭੰ  ਸਰੋਵਰੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਹ ਿਛਜੰਿਤ  ਤਰੰਗ  ਤੋਯਣਹ  ॥੫੩॥
lines.english: The Lord of the World is Supremely Beautiful; His Meditation is the Life of all.
lines.transliteration: gusaaN-ee garist roopayn simarn aN sarbat ar jeevn ah.

lines.english: In the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, He is found on the path of devotional worshipof the Lord. ||54||
lines.transliteration: labDha-yaN sant sangayn  naanak savachh  maarag har bh agat-neh. ||54||

lines.punjabi: ਲਬਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਛ ਮਾਰਗ  ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਣਹ  ॥੫੪॥
lines.english: The mosquito pierces the stone, the ant crosses the swamp,
lines.transliteration: maskaN bhagnant  sailaN kardamaN tarant papeelkeh.

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਕੰ  ਭਗਨੰਤ  ਸੈਲੰ ਕਰਦਮੰ  ਤਰੰਤ  ਪਪੀਲਕਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: saagraN laNghant  pi-angaN tam pargaas anDh kah. the cripple crosses the ocean, and the blind sees in the darkness,
saaDh sangayn  simrant  gobind  saran  naanak har har haray. ||55|| meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat. Nanak seeks theSanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||55||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਿਣ  ਿਸਮਰੰਿਤ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ ਸਰਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਹਰੇ ॥੫੫॥
lines.english: Like a Brahmin without a sacred mark on his forehead, or a king without the power ofcommand,
lines.transliteration: tilak heen aN jathaa bipraa amar heen aN jathaa raajnah.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਲਕ  ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਿਬਪਰ੍ਾ  ਅਮਰ  ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਰਾਜਨਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: aavaDh heen aN jathaa soorar naanak Dh aram heen aN tathaa baisnveh. ||56|| or a warrior without weapons, so is the devotee of God without Dharmic Faith. ||56||

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਧ  ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਸੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਰਮ  ਹੀਣੰ ਤਥਾ ਬੈਸ੍ਨਵਹ  ॥੫੬॥
lines.english: God has no conch-shell, no religious mark, no paraphernalia; he does not have blue skin.
lines.transliteration: na saNkhaN na chakaraN na gad aa na si-aamaN.

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਸੰਖੰ ਨ ਚਕਰ੍ੰ ਨ ਗਦਾ  ਨ ਿਸਆਮੰ  ॥
