lines.english: His Form is Wondrous and Amazing. He is beyond incarnation.
lines.transliteration: ascharaj roopaN rahant janmaN.

lines.english: The Vedas say that He is not this, and not that.
lines.transliteration: nayt nayt  kathant  bayd aa.

lines.english: The Lord of the Universe is Lofty and High, Great and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: ooch mooch apaar gobindah.

lines.english: The Imperishable Lord abides in the hearts of the Holy. He is understood, O Nanak,by those who are very fortunate. ||57||
lines.transliteration: basant saaDh  rid-yaN achut  bujhant naanak badbh aagee-ah. ||57||

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੰਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਿਰਦਯੰ  ਅਚੁਤ  ਬੁਝੰਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਡਭਾਗੀਅਹ  ॥੫੭॥
lines.english: Living in the world, it is like a wild jungle. One's relatives are like dogs, jackals anddonkeys.
lines.transliteration: udi-aan basanaN saNsaaraN sanbanDh ee savaan si-aal kh arah.

lines.punjabi: ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਬਸਨੰ  ਸੰਸਾਰੰ  ਸਨਬੰਧੀ  ਸਾਨ ਿਸਆਲ  ਖਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: In this difficult place, the mind is intoxicated with the wine of emotional attachment;the five unconquered thieves lurk there.
lines.transliteration: bikham sathaan man moh mad iraN mahaaN asaaDh  panch t askarahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖਮ  ਸਥਾਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਦਰੰ  ਮਹ ਅਸਾਧ  ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: The mortals wander lost in love and emotional attachment, fear and doubt; they arecaught in the sharp, strong noose of egotism.
lines.transliteration: heet moh bh ai bharam bh arman aN ahaN faaNs teekh-yan kathineh.

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਤ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ  ਭਰ੍ਮਣੰ  ਅਹੰ ਫਸ ਤੀਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਣ  ਕਿਠਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: The ocean of fire is terrifying and impassable. The distant shore is so far away; it cannot be reached.
lines.transliteration: paavak to-a asaaDh  ghoraN agam t eer nah langh nah.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਕ  ਤੋਅ ਅਸਾਧ  ਘੋਰੰ ਅਗਮ  ਤੀਰ ਨਹ ਲੰਘਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company ofthe Holy; O Nanak, by His Grace, we are saved at the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||58||
lines.transliteration: bhaj saaDh sang gopaal naanak har charan  saran  uDhran kirpaa. ||58||

lines.punjabi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਗਪਾਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰਣ ਉਧਰਣ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ॥੫੮॥
lines.english: When the Lord of the Universe grants His Grace, all illnesses are cured.
lines.transliteration: kirpaa karant gobind  gopaalah sagal-yaN rog kh andnah.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਰੰਤ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੋਪਾਲਹ  ਸਗਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak chants His Glorious Praises in the Saadh Sangat, in the Sanctuary of the PerfectTranscendent Lord God. ||59||
lines.transliteration: saaDh sangayn  gun ramat  naanak saran  pooran parmaysureh. ||59||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਿਣ  ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ  ॥੫੯॥
lines.english: The mortal is beautiful and speaks sweet words, but in the farm of his heart, heharbors cruel vengeance.
lines.transliteration: si-aamalaN maDhur maanukh -yaN rid-yaN bhoom vairn ah.

lines.english: He pretends to bow in worship, but he is false. Beware of him, O friendly Saints.||60||
lines.transliteration: nivant hovant  mithi-aa chayt naN sant savajniH. ||60||

lines.english: The thoughtless fool does not know that each day, his breaths are being used up.
lines.transliteration: achayt moorh aa na jaan ant ghatant saasaa nit  partay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਚੇਤ  ਮੂੜਾ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤ  ਘਟੰਤ  ਸਾਸਾ  ਿਨਤ  ਪਰ੍ਤੇ ॥
lines.english: His most beautiful body is wearing away; old age, the daughter of death, has seizedit.
lines.transliteration: chhijant  mahaa sund ree kaaN-i-aa kaal kanniaa garaast ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਛਜੰਤ  ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਕਇਆ  ਕਾਲ  ਕੰਿਨਆ  ਗਰ੍ਾਸਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: He is engrossed in family play; placing his hopes in transitory things, he indulges in corrupt pleasures.
lines.transliteration: rachant pukh ah kutamb leelaa anit  aasaa bikh i-aa binod .

lines.punjabi: ਰਚੰਿਤ  ਪੁਰਖਹ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਲੀਲਾ  ਅਿਨਤ  ਆਸਾ  ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਿਬਨੋਦ  ॥
lines.english: Wandering lost in countless incarnations, he is exhausted. Nanak seeks the Sanctuaryof the Embodiment of Mercy. ||61||
lines.transliteration: bharmant  bharmant  baho janam haari-o saran  naanak karun aa ma-yeh. ||61||

lines.punjabi: ਭਰ੍ਮੰਿਤ ਭਰ੍ਮੰਿਤ  ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ  ਹਾਿਰਓ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ  ॥੬੧॥
lines.english: O tongue, you love to enjoy the sweet delicacies.
lines.transliteration: hay jihbay hay rasgay maDhur pari-a t u-yaN.

lines.english: You are dead to the Truth, and involved in great disputes. Instead, repeat the holywords:
lines.transliteration: sat hat aN param baad aN avrat  aythah suDh  achh arneh.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤ ਹਤੰ ਪਰਮ  ਬਾਦੰ ਅਵਰਤ  ਏਥਹ  ਸੁਧ ਅਛਰਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: Gobind, Daamodar, Maadhav. ||62||
lines.transliteration: gobind d aamod ar maaDh vay. ||62||

lines.english: Those who are proud, and intoxicated with the pleasures of sex,
lines.transliteration: garbant naaree mad on mat aN.
balvant balaat  kaarn ah. and asserting their power over others,
charan kamal nah bhajant  tarin samaan Dh arig janamneh. never contemplate the Lord's Lotus Feet. Their lives are cursed, and as worthless asstraw.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਨਹ ਭਜੰਤ  ਿਤਰ੍ਣ  ਸਮਾਿਨ  ਿਧਰ੍ਗੁ ਜਨਮਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: You are as tiny and insignificant as an ant, but you shall become great, by the Wealthof the Lord's Meditation.
lines.transliteration: hay papeelkaa garastay gobind simran  tu-yaN Dhanay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੇ ਪਪੀਲਕਾ ਗਰ੍ਸਟੇ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਿਸਮਰਣ  ਤੁਯੰ ਧਨੇ ॥
lines.english: Nanak bows in humble worship, countless times, over and over again. ||63||
lines.transliteration: naanak anik baar namo namah. ||63||

lines.english: The blade of grass becomes a mountain, and the barren land becomes green.
lines.transliteration: tarin ta mayraN sehkaN ta haree-aN.

lines.english: The drowning one swims across, and the empty is filled to overflowing.
lines.transliteration: boodaN ta taree-aN oonaN ta bharee-aN.

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡੰ ਤ ਤਰੀਅੰ  ਊਣੰ ਤ ਭਰੀਅੰ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of suns illuminate the darkness,
lines.transliteration: anDhkaar kot soor ujaaraN.
binvant naanak har gur d ayaaraN. ||64|| prays Nanak, when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||64|| pMnw 1360

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਣਹ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਰਣੰ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਿਜ ਪੂਰਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: Associating with the Brahmin, one is saved, if his actions are perfect and God-like.
lines.transliteration: barahmaneh sang uDh arnaN barahm karam je poorn ah.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਤੰ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਗਹੰ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਹਫਲਹ ॥੬੫॥
lines.english: Those whose souls are imbued with the world - O Nanak, their lives are fruitless. ||65||
lines.transliteration: aatam rat aN sansaar gahaN tay nar naanak nihfaleh. ||65||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਦਰਬ  ਿਹਰਣੰ  ਬਹੁ ਿਵਘਨ  ਕਰਣੰ  ਉਚਰਣੰ  ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਅ  ਕਹ ॥
lines.english: The mortal steals the wealth of others, and makes all sorts of problems; his preachingis only for his own livelihood.
lines.transliteration: par darab hirn aN baho vigh an karn aN ucharn aN sarab jee-a kah.

lines.punjabi: ਲਉ ਲਈ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਅਿਤਪਿਤ ਮਨ ਮਾਏ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਤ  ਿਸ ਸੂਕਰਹ  ॥੬੬॥
lines.english: His desire for this and that is not satisfied; his mind is caught in Maya, and he is acting like a pig. ||66||
lines.transliteration: la-o la-ee tarisnaa at ipat man maa-ay karam karat  se sookrah. ||66||

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੇ ਸਮੇਵ  ਚਰਣੰ  ਉਧਰਣੰ  ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are intoxicated and absorbed in the Lord's Lotus Feet are saved from theterrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: matay samayv charn aN uDharnaN bhai dutrah.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੇਕ  ਪਾਿਤਕ  ਹਰਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ  ਨ ਸੰਸਯਹ  ॥੬੭॥੪॥
lines.english: Countless sins are destroyed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of theHoly; there is no doubt about this. ||67||4|| mhlw 5 gwQw  (1360-5) mehlaa 5 gaathaa Fifth Mehl, Gaat'haa: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1360-5) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: anayk paatik harn aN naanak saaDh  sangam na sansyah. ||67||4||

lines.english: Camphor, flowers and perfume become contaminated, by coming into contact with thehuman body.
lines.transliteration: karpoor puhap suganDhaa paras manukh -y dayhaN maleen aN.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਪੂਰ  ਪੁਹਪ  ਸੁਗੰਧਾ  ਪਰਸ  ਮਾਨੁਖਯ੍ਯ੍ ਦੇਹੰ ਮਲੀਣੰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the ignorant one is proud of his foul-smelling marrow, blood and bones.||1|| prmwxo prjMq Awkwsh dIp loA isKMfxh ] gCyx nYx Bwryx nwnk ibnw swDU n isD´qy ]2] (1360-7, gwQw, mÚ 5) parmaano parjant  aakaaseh d eep lo-a sikh andnah. gachh ayn nain bhaarayn  naanak binaa saaDhoo na siDh -yatai. ||2|| Even if the mortal could reduce himself to the size of an atom, and shoot through theethers, worlds and realms in the blink of an eye, O Nanak, without the Holy Saint, heshall not be saved. ||2||
lines.transliteration: majaa ruDhir d aruganDh aa naanak ath garbayn  agyaanan o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਮਜਾ ਰੁਿਧਰ ਦਰ੍ੁਗੰਧਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਿਥ  ਗਰਬੇਣ  ਅਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨਣੋ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Know for sure that death will come; whatever is seen is false.
lines.transliteration: jaano sat  hovant o marn o daristayn  mithi-aa.

lines.english: So chant the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; this alone shall go along with you in the end. ||3||
lines.transliteration: keerat saath chalantho bh anant naanak saaDh  sangayn . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਛੇਣ  ਨੈਣ ਭਾਰੇਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨਾ  ਸਾਧੂ ਨ ਿਸਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The consciousness wanders lost in Maya, attached to friends and relatives.
lines.transliteration: maa-yaa chit bh armayn  isat mit raykh  baaNDhvah.

lines.english: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak,the eternal place of rest is found. ||4||
lines.transliteration: labDha-yaN saaDh  sangayn  naanak sukh  asthaanaN gopaal bh ajnaN. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਚਲੰਥੋ  ਭਣੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The lowly nim tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, becomes just like thesandalwood tree.
lines.transliteration: mailaagar sangayn nimm birakh  se chandnah.

lines.english: But the bamboo tree, also growing near it, does not pick up its fragrance; it is too talland proud. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nikat basanto baaNso naanak ahaN buDh  na boht ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਲਬਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖ ਅਸਥਾਨੰ  ਗੋਪਾਲ ਭਜਣੰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: In this Gaat'haa, the Lord's Sermon is woven; listening to it, pride is crushed.
lines.transliteration: gaathaa gunf gopaal kathaN mathaN maan maradneh.

lines.english: The five enemies are killed, O Nanak, by shooting the Arrow of the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: hataN panch sat rayn naanak har baan ay par-haarn eh. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਬਸੰਤੋ  ਬਸੋ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਹੰ ਬੁਿਧ ਨ ਬੋਹਤੇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: The Words of the Holy are the path of peace. They are obtained by good karma.
lines.transliteration: bachan saaDh sukh  panthaa lahanthaa bad karamn eh.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਥਾ  ਗੁੰਫ ਗੋਪਾਲ  ਕਥੰ ਮਥੰ ਮਾਨ ਮਰਦਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: The cycle of birth and death is ended, O Nanak, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||7||
lines.transliteration: rahantaa janam marn ayn ramn aN naanak har keerat neh. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਹਤੰ ਪੰਚ ਸਤਰ੍ੇਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਬਾਣੇ  ਪਰ੍ਹਾਰਣਹ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: When the leaves wither and fall, they cannot be attached to the branch again.
lines.transliteration: patar bh urijayn  jharhee-yaN nah jarh ee-aN payd sapant aa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਚਨ  ਸਾਧ ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਲਹੰਥਾ  ਬਡ ਕਰਮਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, there is misery and suffering. Themortal wanders in reincarnation day and night. ||8||
lines.transliteration: naam bihoon bikh mataa naanak bahant  jon baasro rain ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਰਹੰਤਾ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣੇਨ  ਰਮਣੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: One is blessed with love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, by greatgood fortune.
lines.transliteration: bhaavnee saaDh  sangayn  labhaNtaN bad bh aagnah.

lines.punjabi: ਪਤਰ੍ ਭੁਿਰਜੇਣ  ਝੜੀਯੰ  ਨਹ ਜੜੀਅੰ  ਪੇਡ ਸੰਪਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is not affected bythe world-ocean. ||9||
lines.transliteration: har naam gun ramn aN naanak sansaar saagar nah bi-aapn eh. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਿਬਹੂਣ ਿਬਖਮਤਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਹੰਿਤ  ਜੋਿਨ ਬਾਸਰੋ  ਰੈਣੀ ॥੮॥
lines.english: This Gaat'haa is profound and infinite; how rare are those who understand it.
lines.transliteration: gaathaa goorh apaaraN samjh anaN birlaa janah.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ  ਲਭੰਤੰ  ਬਡ ਭਾਗਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: They forsake sexual desire and worldly love, O Nanak, and praise the Lord in theSaadh Sangat. ||10||
lines.transliteration: sansaar kaam tajn aN naanak gobind  ramn aN saaDh  sangmah. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰ  ਨਹ ਿਬਆਪਣਹ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The Words of the Holy are the most sublime Mantra. They eradicate millions of sinfulmistakes.
lines.transliteration: sumantar saaDh  bachnaa kot d okh binaasneh.

lines.english: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, O Nanak, all one's generations are saved. ||11||
lines.transliteration: har charan kamal Dh a-yaana naanak kul samooh uDh aarneh. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਕਾਮ ਤਜਣੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਰਮਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: That palace is beautiful, in which the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.
lines.transliteration: sundar mand ar sain ah jayn  maDh -y har keerat neh.

lines.english: Those who dwell on the Lord of the Universe are liberated. O Nanak, only the mostfortunate are so blessed. ||12||
lines.transliteration: muktay raman  gobind ah naanak labDh a-yaN bad bh aagnah. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਣਹ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: I have found the Lord, my Friend, my very Best Friend.
lines.transliteration: har labDho mit ar sumit o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁੰਦਰ  ਮੰਦਰ  ਸੈਣਹ  ਜੇਣ ਮਧਯ੍ਯ੍ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ  ॥
lines.english: He shall never break my heart.
lines.transliteration: bidaaran  kaday na chit o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਰਮਣ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦਹ  ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ  ਬਡ ਭਾਗਣਹ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: His dwelling is eternal; His weight cannot be weighed.
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa asthal tol amit o.

lines.english: Nanak has made Him the Friend of his soul. ||13||
lines.transliteration: so-ee naanak sakhaa jee-a sang kit o. ||13||

lines.english: One's bad reputation is erased by a true son,
lines.transliteration: apjasaN mitant sat  putreh.
simartab-y rid ai gur mant arneh. who meditates in his heart on the Guru's Mantra. pMnw 1361

lines.english: The Beloved Eternal Lord God,
lines.transliteration: pareetam bh agvaan achut .

lines.english: O Nanak, carries us across the world-ocean. ||14||
lines.transliteration: naanak sansaar saagar taarn ah. ||14||

lines.english: It is death to forget the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: marnaN bisran aN gobind ah.

lines.english: It is life to meditate on the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jeevanaN har naam Dh a-yaavan eh.

lines.english: The Lord is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lines.transliteration: labh-n aN saaDh  sangayn .

lines.english: O Nanak, by pre-ordained destiny. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak har poorab likh-n eh. ||15||

lines.english: The snake-charmer, by his spell, neutralizes the poison and leaves the snake without fangs.
lines.transliteration: dasan bihoon bh u-yaaNgaN mant raN gaarurh ee nivaaraN.

lines.english: Just so, the Saints remove suffering;
lines.transliteration: bayaaDh upaarh an santaN.

lines.english: O Nanak, they are found by good karma. ||16||
lines.transliteration: naanak labaDh karamn eh. ||16||

lines.english: The Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He gives Sanctuary to all living beings.
lines.transliteration: jath kath ramnaN sarnaN sarbat ar jee-an ah.

lines.punjabi: ਜਥ ਕਥ ਰਮਣੰ  ਸਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤਰ੍  ਜੀਅਣਹ॥
lines.english: The mind is touched by His Love, O Nanak,
lines.transliteration: tath lagn aN paraym naanak.
parsaadaN gur d arasneh. ||17|| by Guru's Grace, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||17||

lines.english: My mind is pierced through by the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: charnaarbind  man biDh -yaN.

lines.english: I am blessed with total happiness.
lines.transliteration: siDh-yaN sarab kusaln eh.

lines.english: Holy people have been singing this Gaat'haa, O Nanak, since the very beginning of time. ||18|| suB bcn rmxM gvxM swD sMgyx auDrxh ] sMswr swgrM nwnk punrip jnm n lB´qy ]19] (1361- 5, gwQw, mÚ 5) subh bachan ramn aN gavn aN saaDh  sangayn  uDharneh. sansaar saagraN naanak punrap janam na labh-yat ai. ||19|| Chanting and singing the Sublime Word of God in the Saadh Sangat, mortals are saved from the world-ocean. O Nanak, they shall never again be consigned toreincarnation. ||19||
lines.transliteration: gaathaa gavant naanak bh ab-yaN paraa poorabn eh. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਥਾ  ਗਾਵੰਿਤ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਬਯ੍ਯ੍ੰ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਣਹ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: People contemplate the Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras.
lines.transliteration: bayd puraan  saast ar beechaaraN.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ  ਰਮਣੰ  ਗਵਣੰ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਉਧਰਣਹ  ॥
lines.english: But by enshrining in their hearts the Naam, the Name of the One and Only Creator of the Universe,
lines.transliteration: aykankaar naam ur DhaaraN.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਸਾਗਰੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪੁਨਰਿਪ  ਜਨਮ  ਨ ਲਭਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੇ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: kulah samooh sagal uDhaaraN. everyone can be saved.

lines.english: By great good fortune, O Nanak, a few cross over like this. ||20||
lines.transliteration: badbhaagee naanak ko t aaraN. ||20||

lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of Lord of the Universe, all one'sgenerations are saved.
lines.transliteration: simarnaN gobind  naamaN uDharnaN kul samoohn eh.

lines.english: It is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. O Nanak, by great goodfortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is seen. ||21||
lines.transliteration: labDhi-aN saaDh  sangayn  naanak vadbh aagee bh aytant  darasneh. ||21||

lines.english: Abandon all your evil habits, and implant all Dharmic faith within.
lines.transliteration: sarab dokh  paraNtiaagee sarab Dh aram d arirh-aaNtanh.

lines.english: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is obtained, O Nanak, by those whohave such destiny written upon their foreheads. ||22||
lines.transliteration: labh-Dh ayn saaDh  sangayn  naanak mast ak likh -yan-a. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਲਬਿਧਅੰ  ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਭੇਟੰਿਤ  ਦਰਸਨਹ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: God was, is, and shall always be. He sustains and destroys all.
lines.transliteration: hoyo hai hovanto haran  bharan sampooran -a.

lines.english: Know that these Holy people are true, O Nanak; they are in love with the Lord. ||23||
lines.transliteration: saaDhoo sat am jaan o naanak pareet  kaarn aN. ||23||

lines.english: The mortal is engrossed in sweet words and transitory pleasures which shall soon fade away.
lines.transliteration: sukhayn  bain ratanaN rachanaN kasumbh  raNgan-a.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਯੋ ਹੈ ਹੋਵੰਤੋ  ਹਰਣ  ਭਰਣ  ਸੰਪੂਰਣਃ  ॥
lines.english: Disease, sorrow and separation afflict him; O Nanak, he never finds peace, even indreams. ||24|| Punhy mhlw 5  (1361-12) funhay mehlaa 5 Phunhay, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1361-12) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: rog sog biogaN naanak sukh na supnah. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਮ  ਜਾਣੋ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਾਰਣੰ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: With Pen in Hand, the Unfathomable Lord writes the mortal's destiny upon hisforehead.
lines.transliteration: haath kalamm agamm mastak laykh aavat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੇਣ  ਬੈਣ ਰਤਨੰ  ਰਚਨੰ ਕਸੁੰਭ  ਰੰਗਣਃ  ॥
lines.english: The Incomparably Beautiful Lord is involved with all.
lines.transliteration: urajh rahi-o sabh  sang anoop roopaavat ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਿਬਓਗੰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੁਪਨਹ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: I cannot utter Your Praises with my mouth.
lines.transliteration: ustat kahan na jaa-ay mukh ahu tuhaaree-aa.

lines.english: Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I am a sacrificeto You. ||1||
lines.transliteration: mohee daykh  daras naanak balihaaree-aa. ||1||

lines.english: Seated in the Society of the Saints, I chant the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa meh bais ke keerat  mai kahaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਉਰਿਝ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਭ ਸੰਿਗ  ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: I dedicate all my adornments to Him, and give all this soul to Him.
lines.transliteration: arpee sabh seegaar ayhu jee-o sabh  divaa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: With hopeful yearning for Him, I have made the bed for my Husband.
lines.transliteration: aas pi-aasee sayj so kant vichh aa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Lord! If such good destiny is inscribed upon my forehead, then I shall find my Friend. ||2||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN mastak hovai bh aag ta saajan paa-ee-ai. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਹ ਬੈਿਸ ਿਕ ਕੀਰਿਤ ਮੈ ਕਹ ॥
lines.english: O my companion, I have prepared everything: make-up, garlands and betel-leaves.
lines.transliteration: sakhee kaajal haar t ambol sabh ai kichh  saaji-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਪੀ  ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ  ਸਭੁ ਿਦਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: I have embellished myself with the sixteen decorations, and applied the mascara tomy eyes.
lines.transliteration: solah kee-ay seegaar ke anjan paaji-aa.

lines.english: If my Husband Lord comes to my home, then I obtain everything.
lines.transliteration: jay ghar aavai kant  ta sabh  kichh  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord! Without my Husband, all these adornments are useless. ||3||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN kantai baajh  seegaar sabh  birthaa jaa-ee-ai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਕਾਜਲ  ਹਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ  ਸਭੈ ਿਕਛੁ  ਸਾਿਜਆ  ॥
lines.english: Very fortunate is she, within whose home the Husband Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: jis ghar vasi-aa kant  saa vadbh aagnay.

lines.english: She is totally adorned and decorated; she is a happy soul-bride.
lines.transliteration: tis ban i-aa habh  seegaar saa-ee sohaagn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਘਿਰ  ਆਵੈ  ਕੰਤੁ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: I sleep in peace, without anxiety; the hopes of my mind have been fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: ha-o sutee ho-ay achint  man aas puraa-ee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਕੰਤੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਜਾਈਐ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Lord! When my Husband came into the home of my heart, I obtained everything. ||4|| pMnw 1362
lines.transliteration: harihaaN jaa ghar aa-i-aa kant  ta sabh  kichh  paa-ee-aa. ||4||

lines.english: My hope is so intense, that this hope alone should fulfill my hopes.
lines.transliteration: aasaa itee aas ke aas puraa-ee-ai.

lines.english: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then I attain the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur bh a-ay d a-i-aal t a pooraa paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ  ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: My body is filled with so many demerits ; I am covered with faults and demerits.
lines.transliteration: mai tan avgan  bahut  ke avgan  chhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਤਿਨ ਅਵਗਣ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਿਕ ਅਵਗਣ  ਛਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord! When the True Guru becomes Merciful, then the mind is held in place. ||5||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN satgur bh a-ay d a-i-aal t a man th ehraa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ  ਤ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਆ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, I have meditated on the Lord, Infinite and Endless.
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bay-ant bay-ant  Dhi-aa-i-aa.

lines.english: This world-ocean is so difficult to cross; the True Guru has carried me across.
lines.transliteration: dutar ih sansaar sat guroo t araa-i-aa.

lines.english: My comings and goings in reincarnation ended, when I met the Perfect Lord.
lines.transliteration: miti-aa aavaa ga-on jaaN pooraa paa-i-aa.

lines.english: O Lord! I have obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord from the True Guru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN amrit har kaa naam sat gur tay paa-i-aa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: The lotus is in my hand; in the courtyard of my heart I abide in peace.
lines.transliteration: mayrai haath padam aagan sukh  baasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਾਿਥ  ਪਦਮੁ  ਆਗਿਨ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O my companion, the Jewel is around my neck; beholding it, sorrow is taken away.
lines.transliteration: sakhee morai kanth  ratann paykh  dukh naasnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਖੀ ਮੋਰੈ ਕੰਿਠ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਪੇਿਖ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I abide with the Lord of the World, the Treasury of Total Peace. O Lord!
lines.transliteration: baasa-o sang gupaal sagal sukh raas har.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਸਉ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਸਗਲ  ਸੁਖ ਰਾਿਸ  ਹਿਰ ॥
lines.english: All wealth, spiritual perfection and the nine treasures are in His Hand. ||7||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN riDh siDh  nav niDh  baseh jis sad aa kar. ||7||

lines.english: Those men who go out to enjoy other men's women shall suffer in shame.
lines.transliteration: par tari-a raavan  jaahi say-ee t aa laajee-ah.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਿਤਰ੍ਅ  ਰਾਵਿਣ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਸੇਈ ਤਾ ਲਾਜੀਅਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those who steal the wealth of others - how can their guilt be concealed?
lines.transliteration: nitparat  hireh par d arab chh idar kat  dhaakee-ah.

lines.english: Those who chant the Sacred Praises of the Lord save and redeem all theirgenerations.
lines.transliteration: har gun ramat  pavit ar sagal kul t aar-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਸਗਲ  ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord! Those who listen and contemplate the Supreme Lord God become pure andholy. ||8||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN suntay bh a-ay puneet  paarbarahm beechaara-ee. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਸੁਨਤੇ  ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਬੀਚਾਰਈ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The sky above looks lovely, and the earth below is beautiful.
lines.transliteration: oopar banai akaas talai Dh ar soht ee.

lines.punjabi: ਊਪਿਰ  ਬਨੈ ਅਕਾਸੁ  ਤਲੈ ਧਰ ਸੋਹਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: Lightning flashes in the ten directions; I behold the Face of my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: dah d is chamkai beejul mukh  ka-o joht ee.

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਚਮਕੈ  ਬੀਜੁਿਲ  ਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਤੀ  ॥
lines.english: If I go searching in foreign lands, how can I find my Beloved?
lines.transliteration: khojat  fira-o bid ays pee-o kat  paa-ee-ai.

lines.english: O Lord! If such destiny is inscribed upon my forehead, I am absorbed in the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||9||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN jay mastak hovai bh aag ta daras samaa-ee-ai. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਜੇ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਦਰਿਸ  ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: I have seen all places, but none can compare to You.
lines.transliteration: dithay sabh ay thaav nahee t uDh jayhi-aa.

lines.english: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has established You; thus You are adornedand embellished.
lines.transliteration: baDhohu purakh  biDhaatai taaN too sohi-aa.

lines.english: Ramdaspur is prosperous and thickly populated, and incomparably beautiful.
lines.transliteration: vasdee sagh an apaar anoop raamd aas pur.

lines.punjabi: ਵਸਦੀ  ਸਘਨ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਅਨੂਪ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਪੁਰ ॥
lines.english: O Lord! Bathing in the Sacred Pool of Raam Daas, the sins are washed away, ONanak. ||10||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN naanak kasmal jaahi naa-i-ai raamdaas sar. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਸਮਲ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਨਾਇਐ  ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਸਰ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The rainbird is very smart; in its consciousness, it longs for the friendly rain.
lines.transliteration: chaatrik chit  suchit  so saajan chaahee-ai.

lines.english: It longs for that, to which its breath of life is attached.
lines.transliteration: jis sang laagay paraan t isai ka-o aahee-ai.

lines.english: It wanders depressed, from forest to forest, for the sake of a drop of water.
lines.transliteration: ban ban firat ud aas boond  jal kaarn ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਿਫਰਤ  ਉਦਾਸ  ਬੂੰਦ ਜਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord! In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||11||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN ti-o har jan maaNgai naam naanak balihaarn ay. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਮਗੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੇ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Consciousness of my Friend is incomparably beautiful. Its mystery cannot beknown.
lines.transliteration: mit kaa chit  anoop maramm na jaanee-ai.

lines.english: One who purchases the priceless virtues realizes the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: gaahak gunee apaar so tat  pachh aanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਹਕ  ਗੁਨੀ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: When the consciousness is absorbed in the supreme consciousness, great joy andbliss are found.
lines.transliteration: chiteh chit  samaa-ay t a hovai rang gh anaa.

lines.english: O Lord! When the fickle thieves are overcome, the true wealth is obtained. ||12||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN chanchal choreh maar ta paavahi sach Dh anaa. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਚੰਚਲ  ਚੋਰਿਹ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਤ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: In a dream, I was lifted up; why didn't I grasp the hem of His Robe?
lines.transliteration: supnai oobhee bh a-ee gahi-o kee na anchlaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਊਭੀ ਭਈ ਗਿਹਓ  ਕੀ ਨ ਅੰਚਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Beautiful Lord relaxing there, my mind was charmed and fascinated.
lines.transliteration: sundar purakh  biraajit  paykh  man banchlaa.

lines.english: I am searching for His Feet - tell me, where can I find Him?
lines.transliteration: khoja-o t aa kay charan  kahhu kat  paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਖੋਜਉ  ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ  ਕਹਹੁ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord! Tell me how I can find my Beloved, O my companion. ||13||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN so-ee jatann bat aa-ay sakh ee pari-o paa-ee-ai. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ ਸੋਈ ਜਤੰਨੁ ਬਤਾਇ  ਸਖੀ ਿਪਰ੍ਉ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The eyes which do not see the Holy - those eyes are miserable.
lines.transliteration: nain na d aykheh saaDh  se nain  bihaali-aa.

lines.english: The ears which do not hear the Sound-current of the Naad - those ears might just as well be plugged.
lines.transliteration: karan na sunhee naad karan mund  ghaali-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਨ  ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਕਰਨ  ਮੁੰਿਦ ਘਾਿਲਆ  ॥
lines.english: The tongue which does not chant the Naam ought to be cut out, bit by bit.
lines.transliteration: rasnaa japai na naam til t il kar katee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਸਨਾ  ਜਪੈ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਿਤਲੁ  ਕਿਰ ਕਟੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord! When the mortal forgets the Lord of the Universe, the Sovereign Lord King,he grows weaker day by day. ||14||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN jab bisrai gobid raa-ay d ino din ghatee-ai. ||14||

lines.english: The wings of the bumble bee are caught in the intoxicating fragrant petals of thelotus.
lines.transliteration: pankaj faathay pank mahaa mad guNfi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਕਜ  ਫਾਥੇ ਪੰਕ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਗੁੰਿਫਆ  ॥
lines.english: With its limbs entangled in the petals, it loses its senses. pMnw 1363
lines.transliteration: ang sang urjhaa-ay bisrat ay suNfi-aa.

lines.english: Is there any such friend, who can untie this difficult knot?
lines.transliteration: hai ko-oo aisaa meet je t orai bikh am gaaNth.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸਾ  ਮੀਤੁ ਿਜ ਤੋਰੈ ਿਬਖਮ  ਗਿਠ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One Supreme Lord and Master of the earth reunites the separated ones. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak ik sareeDhar naath je tootay lay-ay saaNth. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਕੁ ਸਰ੍ੀਧਰ  ਨਾਥੁ ਿਜ ਟੂਟੇ ਲੇਇ ਸਿਠ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Dhaava-o d asaa anayk paraym parabh  kaarn ay. I run around in all directions, searching for the love of God.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਉ  ਦਸਾ ਅਨੇਕ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕਾਰਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: The five evil enemies are tormenting me; how can I destroy them?
lines.transliteration: panch sataaveh d oot kavan biDh  maarn ay.

lines.english: Shoot them with the sharp arrows of meditation on the Name of God.
lines.transliteration: teekh an baan  chalaa-ay naam parabh  Dha-yaa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਖਣ ਬਾਣ  ਚਲਾਇ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord! The way to slaughter these terrible sadistic enemies is obtained from thePerfect Guru. ||16||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN mahaaN bikhaad ee gh aat pooran gur paa-ee-ai. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਮਹ ਿਬਖਾਦੀ  ਘਾਤ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: The True Guru has blessed me with the bounty which shall never be exhausted.
lines.transliteration: satgur keenee d aat mool na nikh uta-ee.

lines.english: Eating and consuming it, all the Gurmukhs are emancipated.
lines.transliteration: kaavahu bhunchahu sabh  gurmukh  chhut-ee.

lines.english: The Lord, in His Mercy, has blessed me with the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam niDh aan d itaa tus har.

lines.english: O Nanak, worship and adore the Lord, who never dies. ||17||
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa araaDh  kaday na jaaNhi mar. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਦਾ ਅਰਾਿਧ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਿਹ  ਮਿਰ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Wherever the Lord's devotee goes is a blessed, beautiful place.
lines.transliteration: jithai jaa-ay bhagat  so thaan suhaavan aa.

lines.english: All comforts are obtained, meditating on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: saglay ho-ay sukh har naam Dh i-aavan aa.

lines.english: People praise and congratulate the devotee of the Lord, while the slanderers rot and die.
lines.transliteration: jee-a karan jaikaar nindak mu-ay pach.

lines.english: Says Nanak, O friend, chant the Naam, and your mind shall be filled with bliss. ||18||
lines.transliteration: saajan man aanand naanak naam jap. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਮਿਨ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਪ ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The mortal never serves the Immaculate Lord, the Purifier of sinners.
lines.transliteration: paavan patit  puneet  katah nahee sayvee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਨ  ਪਿਤਤ  ਪੁਨੀਤ  ਕਤਹ  ਨਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal wastes away in false pleasures. How long can this go on?
lines.transliteration: jhooth ai rang kh u-aar kahaaN lag kh ayvee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕਹ ਲਗੁ ਖੇਵੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: Why do you take such pleasure, looking at this mirage?
lines.transliteration: harichand-uree paykh  kaahay sukh  maani-aa.

lines.english: O Lord! I am a sacrifice to those who are known and approved in the Court of theLord. ||19||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN ha-o balihaaree tinn je d argahi jaani-aa. ||19||

lines.english: The fool commits countless foolish actions and so many sinful mistakes.
lines.transliteration: keenay karam anayk gavaar bikaar ghan.

lines.english: The fool's body smells rotten, and turns to dust.
lines.transliteration: mahaa darugaNDhat vaas sath  kaa chh aar tan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਦਰ੍ੁਗੰਧਤ  ਵਾਸੁ ਸਠ ਕਾ ਛਾਰੁ ਤਨ ॥
lines.english: He wanders lost in the darkness of pride, and never thinks of dying.
lines.transliteration: firta-o garab gubaar maran  nah jaan-ee.

lines.english: O Lord! The mortal gazes upon the mirage; why does he think it is true? ||20||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN harichand-uree paykh  kaahay sach maan-ee. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਹਿਰਚੰਦਉਰੀ  ਪੇਿਖ ਕਾਹੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਨਈ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: When someone's days are over, who can save him?
lines.transliteration: jis kee poojai a-oDh t isai ka-un  raakh -ee.

lines.english: How long can the physicians go on, suggesting various therapies?
lines.transliteration: baidak anik upaav kahaaN la-o bh aakh-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਦਕ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਉਪਾਵ  ਕਹ ਲਉ ਭਾਖਈ  ॥
lines.english: You fool, remember the One Lord; only He shall be of use to you in the end.
lines.transliteration: ayko chayt gavaar kaaj t ayrai aavee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਿਤ  ਗਵਾਰ  ਕਾਿਜ  ਤੇਰੈ ਆਵਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord! Without the Name, the body turns to dust, and everything goes to waste. ||21||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN bin naavai tan chh aar baritha sabh  jaav-ee. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਸਭੁ ਜਾਵਈ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Drink in the medicine of the Incomparable, Priceless Name.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  naam apaar amolak peej-ee.

lines.english: Meeting and joining together, the Saints drink it in, and give it to everyone.
lines.transliteration: mil mil khaaveh sant  sagal ka-o d eej-ee.

lines.english: He alone is blessed with it, who is destined to receive it.
lines.transliteration: jisai paraapat ho-ay t isai hee paavn ay.

lines.english: O Lord! I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||22||
lines.transliteration: harihaaN ha-o balihaaree tinH je har rang raavn ay. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਤੰਨ  ਿਜ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਾਵਣੇ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: The physicians meet together in their assembly.
lines.transliteration: vaidaa sand aa sang ikth aa ho-i-aa.

lines.english: The medicines are effective, when the Lord Himself stands in their midst.
lines.transliteration: a-ukhad  aa-ay raas vich aap kh alo-i-aa.

lines.english: Their good deeds and karma become apparent.
lines.transliteration: jo jo onaa karam sukaram ho-ay pasri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਓਨਾ  ਕਰਮ  ਸੁਕਰਮ  ਹੋਇ ਪਸਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord! Pains, diseases and sins all vanish from their bodies. ||23|| cauboly mhlw 5  (1363-17) cha-ubolay mehlaa 5 Chaubolas, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1363-17) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: harihaaN dookh  rog sabh  paap t an tay kh isri-aa. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਹ  ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸਿਭ ਪਾਪ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਿਖਸਿਰਆ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: O Samman, if one could buy this love with money,
lines.transliteration: samman ja-o is paraym kee dam ki-yahoo hot ee saat.
raavan hutay so rank neh jin sir d eenay kaat. ||1|| then consider Raawan the king. He was not poor, but he could not buy it, even though he offered his head to Shiva. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਮਨ  ਜਉ ਇਸ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੀ ਦਮ ਿਕਯ੍ਯ੍ਹੁ ਹੋਤੀ ਸਾਟ ॥
lines.english: My body is drenched in love and affection for the Lord; there is no distance at allbetween us.
lines.transliteration: pareet paraym t an kh ach rahi-aa beech na raa-ee hot .

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਵਨ  ਹੁਤੇ ਸੁ ਰੰਕ ਨਿਹ ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਸਰ ਦੀਨੇ  ਕਾਿਟ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: My mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord. He is realized when one'sintuitive consciousness is attuned to Him. ||2|| pMnw 1364 swgr myr auidAwn bn nv KMf bsuDw Brm ] mUsn pRym iprMm kY gnau eyk kir krm ]3] (1364- 1, cauboly, mÚ 5) saagar mayr udi-aan ban nav kh and basuDh aa bh aram. moosan paraym piramm kai gan-o ayk kar karam. ||3|| I would cross the oceans, mountains, wilderness, forests and the nine regions of theearth in a single step, O Musan, for the Love of my Beloved. ||3||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man bayDhi-o boojh an surat  sanjog. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਗਰ  ਮੇਰ ਉਿਦਆਨ  ਬਨ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਭਰਮ  ॥
lines.english: O Musan, the Light of the Lord's Love has spread across the sky;
lines.transliteration: moosan maskar paraym kee rahee jo ambar chhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਸਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਪਰੰਮ  ਕੈ ਗਨਉ  ਏਕ ਕਿਰ ਕਰਮ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I cling to my Lord, like the bumble bee caught in the lotus flower. ||4||
lines.transliteration: beeDhay baaNDhay kamal meh bh avar rahay laptaa-ay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਸਕਰ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਕੀ ਰਹੀ ਜੁ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਛਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Chanting and intense meditation, austere self-discipline, pleasure and peace, honor,greatness and pride
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam harakh  sukh  maan mahat  ar garab.

lines.punjabi: ਬੀਧੇ ਬਧੇ ਕਮਲ  ਮਿਹ ਭਵਰ  ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: - O Musan, I would dedicate and sacrifice all these for a moment of my Lord's Love. ||5||
lines.transliteration: moosan nimkhak paraym par vaar vaar d ayN-u sarab. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ  ਹਰਖ  ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨ ਮਹਤ  ਅਰੁ ਗਰਬ  ॥
lines.english: O Musan, the world does not understand the Mystery of the Lord; it is dying and beingplundered.
lines.transliteration: moosan maram na jaan-ee marat hirat  sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਸਨ ਿਨਮਖਕ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਿਰ ਵਾਿਰ  ਵਾਿਰ  ਦੇਂਉ ਸਰਬ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: It is not pierced through by the Love of the Beloved Lord; it is entangled in falsepursuits. ||6||
lines.transliteration: paraym piramm na bayDhi-o urjh i-o mith bi-uhaar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਨਈ  ਮਰਤ  ਿਹਰਤ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: When someone's home and property are burnt, because of his attachment to them,he suffers in the sorrow of separation.
lines.transliteration: ghab d ab jab jaaree-ai bichh urat paraym bihaal.

lines.english: O Musan, when mortals forget the Merciful Lord God, then they are truly plundered.||7||
lines.transliteration: moosan tab hee moosee-ai bisrat  purakh  da-i-aal. ||7||

lines.english: Whoever enjoys the taste of the Lord's Love, remembers His Lotus Feet in his mind.
lines.transliteration: jaa ko paraym su-aa-o hai charan chitav man maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਸਨ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮੂਸੀਐ  ਿਬਸਰਤ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਦਇਆਲ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the lovers of God do not go anywhere else. ||8||
lines.transliteration: naanak birhee barahm kay aan na kathoo jaahi. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਸੁਆਉ  ਹੈ ਚਰਨ  ਿਚਤਵ  ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Climbing thousands of steep hillsides, the fickle mind becomes miserable.
lines.transliteration: lakh gh aateeN ooNchou gh ano chanchal cheet  bihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਰਹੀ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਕੇ ਆਨ  ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Look at the humble, lowly mud, O Jamaal: the beautiful lotus grows in it. ||9||
lines.transliteration: neech keech nimrit gh anee karnee kamal jamaal. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਘਾਟੀਂ  ਊਂਚੌ ਘਨੋ ਚੰਚਲ  ਚੀਤ  ਿਬਹਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord has lotus-eyes; His Face is so beautifully adorned.
lines.transliteration: kamal nain anjan si-aam chandar bad an chit  chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚ ਕੀਚ  ਿਨਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਘਨੀ  ਕਰਨੀ  ਕਮਲ  ਜਮਾਲ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: O Musan, I am intoxicated with His Mystery. I break the necklace of pride into bits. ||10||
lines.transliteration: moosan magan maramm si-o khand kh and kar haar. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਕਮਲ  ਨੈਨ ਅੰਜਨ  ਿਸਆਮ ਚੰਦਰ੍ ਬਦਨ  ਿਚਤ  ਚਾਰ ॥
lines.english: I am intoxicated with the Love of my Husband Lord; remembering Him in meditation,I am not conscious of my own body.
lines.transliteration: magan bha-i-o pari-a paraym si-o sooDh  na simrat  ang.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਸਨ ਮਗਨ  ਮਰੰਮ  ਿਸਉ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਿਰ ਹਾਰ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: He is revealed in all His Glory, all throughout the world. Nanak is a lowly moth at HisFlame. ||11|| slok Bgq kbIr jIau ky  (1364-10) salok bhagat  kabeer jee-o kay Shaloks Of Devotee Kabeer Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1364-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-i-o sabh  lo-a meh naanak aDh am pat ang. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਓ  ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਸਉ ਸੂਧ ਨ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਅੰਗ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, my rosary is my tongue, upon which the Lord's Name is strung.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mayree simrnee rasnaa oopar raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟ  ਭਇਓ  ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਧਮ  ਪਤੰਗ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, all the devotees abide in tranquilpeace. ||1||
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad ee sagal bh agat taa ko sukh  bisraam. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਲੋਕ  ਭਗਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਉ  ਕੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, everyone laughs at my social class.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mayree jaat ka-o sabh  ko rasnayhaar.

lines.english: I am a sacrifice to this social class, in which I chant and meditate on the Creator. ||2||
lines.transliteration: balihaaree is jaat ka-o jih japi-o sirjanhaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਦੀ  ਸਗਲ  ਭਗਤ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਿਬਸਰ੍ਾਮੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, why do you stumble? Why does your soul waver?
lines.transliteration: kabeer dagmag ki-aa karahi kahaa dulaaveh jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਿਤ  ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਹਸਨੇਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is the Lord of all comforts and peace; drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord'sName. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh ko naa-iko raam naam ras pee-o. ||3||

lines.english: Kabeer, earrings made of gold and studded with jewels,
lines.transliteration: kabeer kanchan kay kundal banay oopar laal jarhaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਡਗਮਗ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਕਹਾ ਡੁਲਾਵਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: deeseh d aaDhay kaan ji-o jinH man naahee naa-o. ||4|| look like burnt twigs, if the Name is not in the mind. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਸੂਖ ਕੋ ਨਾਇਕੋ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, rare is such a person, who remains dead while yet alive.
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa ayk aaDh jo jeevat  mirtak ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੰਚਨ  ਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਲ  ਬਨੇ ਊਪਿਰ  ਲਾਲ  ਜੜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he is fearless. Wherever I look, the Lord isthere. ||5||
lines.transliteration: nirbhai ho-ay kai gun ravai jat  paykh a-o tat so-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਸਿਹ  ਦਾਧੇ ਕਾਨ ਿਜਉ  ਿਜਨ ਮਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, on the day when I die, afterwards there shall be bliss.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaa din ha-o moo-aa paachh ai bha-i-aa anand.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਐਸਾ  ਏਕੁ ਆਧੁ  ਜੋ ਜੀਵਤ  ਿਮਰਤਕੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: I shall meet with my Lord God. Those with me shall meditate and vibrate on the Lordof the Universe. ||6||
lines.transliteration: mohi mili-o parabh aapnaa sangee bh ajeh gobind . ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਗੁ ਨ ਰਵੈ ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I am the worst of all. Everyone else is good.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sabh t ay ham buray ham t aj bhalo sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਿਦਨ ਹਉ ਮੂਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਭਇਆ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever understands this is a friend of mine. ||7||
lines.transliteration: jin aisaa kar boojhi-aa meet  hamaaraa so-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਿਹ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ  ਸੰਗੀ  ਭਜਿਹ  ਗਿਬੰਦੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, she came to me in various forms and disguises.
lines.transliteration: kabeer aa-ee mujheh peh anik karay kar bh ays.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਭ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਬੁਰੇ ਹਮ ਤਿਜ  ਭਲੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: My Guru saved me, and now she bows humbly to me. ||8||
lines.transliteration: ham raakhay gur aapnay un keeno aad ays. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਐਸਾ  ਕਿਰ ਬੂਿਝਆ  ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, kill only that, which, when killed, shall bring peace.
lines.transliteration: kabeer so-ee maaree-ai jih moo-ai sukh ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਆਈ  ਮੁਝਿਹ ਪਿਹ ਅਿਨਕ  ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰ ਭੇਸ ॥
lines.english: Everyone shall call you good, very good, and no one shall think you are bad. ||9||
lines.transliteration: bhalo bh alo sabh  ko kahai buro na maanai ko-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁ ਰ ਆਪਨੇ  ਉਿਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਦੇਸੁ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the night is dark, and men go about doing their dark deeds. pMnw 1365
lines.transliteration: kabeer raatee hoveh kaaree-aa kaaray oobh ay jant .

lines.punjabi: ਲੈ ਫਾਹੇ ਉਿਠ ਧਾਵਤੇ  ਿਸ ਜਾਿਨ  ਮਾਰੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: They take the noose and run around; but rest assured that God shall destroy them. ||10||
lines.transliteration: lai faahay uth Dh aavtay se jaan maaray bh agvant . ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਚੰਦਨ  ਕਾ ਿਬਰਵਾ  ਭਲਾ ਬੇਿੜਓ  ਢਾਕ  ਪਲਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the sandalwood tree is good, even though it is surrounded by weeds.
lines.transliteration: kabeer chandan kaa birvaa bh alaa bayrh eha-o dh aak palaas.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਭੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਬਸੇ ਜੁ ਚੰਦਨ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Those who dwell near the sandalwood tree, become just like the sandalwood tree. ||11||
lines.transliteration: o-ay bhee chand an ho-ay rahay basay jo chand an paas. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਬਸੁ ਬਡਾਈ  ਬੂਿਡਆ  ਇਉ ਮਤ ਡੂਬਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the bamboo is drowned in its egotistical pride. No one should drown like this.
lines.transliteration: kabeer baaNs badaa-ee boodi-aa i-o mat doobahu ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੰਦਨ  ਕੈ ਿਨਕਟੇ  ਬਸੈ ਬਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Bamboo also dwells near the sandalwood tree, but it does not take up its fragrance.||12||
lines.transliteration: chandan kai niktay basai baaNs suganDh  na ho-ay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਦੀਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਦੁਨੀ  ਿਸਉ ਦੁਨੀ  ਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਸਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal loses his faith, for the sake of the world, but the world shall not goalong with him in the end.
lines.transliteration: kabeer deen gavaa-i-aa d unee si-o d unee na chaalee saath.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਇ  ਕੁਹਾੜਾ  ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਗਾਫਿਲ  ਅਪੁਨੈ  ਹਾਿਥ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The idiot strikes his own foot with the axe by his own hand. ||13||
lines.transliteration: paa-ay kuhaarhaa maari-aa gaafal apunai haath. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਹ ਜਹ ਹਉ ਿਫਿਰਓ  ਕਉਤਕ  ਠਾਓ ਠਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, wherever I go, I see wonders everywhere.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jah jah ha-o firi-o ka-utak th aa-o th aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਊਜਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭਇ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: But without the devotees of the One Lord, it is all wilderness to me. ||14||
lines.transliteration: ik raam sanayhee baahraa oojar mayrai bhaaN-ay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਤਨ  ਕੀ ਝੁੰਗੀਆ  ਭਲੀ ਭਿਠ ਕੁਸਤੀ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the dwelling of the Saints is good; the dwelling of the unrighteous burns likean oven.
lines.transliteration: kabeer santan kee jh ungee-aa bh alee bh ath kustee gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਗ  ਲਗਉ  ਿਤਹ ਧਉਲਹਰ  ਿਜਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Those mansions in which the Lord's Name is not chanted might just as well burndown. ||15||
lines.transliteration: aag laga-o tih Dh a-ulhar jih naahee har ko naa-o. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਤ ਮੂਏ ਿਕਆ  ਰੋਈਐ ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਿਗਰ੍ਿਹ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, why cry at the death of a Saint? He is just going back to his home.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sant moo-ay ki-aa ro-ee-ai jo apunay garihi jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਸਾਕਤ  ਬਾਪੁਰੇ  ਜੁ ਹਾਟੈ ਹਾਟ ਿਬਕਾਇ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Cry for the wretched, faithless cynic, who is sold from store to store. ||16||
lines.transliteration: rovhu saakat baapuray jo haatai haat bikaa-ay. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਕਤੁ  ਐਸਾ  ਹੈ ਜੈਸੀ ਲਸਨ  ਕੀ ਖਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the faithless cynic is like a piece of garlic.
lines.transliteration: kabeer saakat aisaa hai jaisee lasan kee kh aan.

lines.english: Even if you eat it sitting in a corner, it becomes obvious to everyone. ||17||
lines.transliteration: konay baithay kh aa-ee-ai pargat ho-ay nid aan. ||17||

lines.english: Kabeer, Maya is the butter-churn, and the breath is the churning-stick.
lines.transliteration: kabeer maa-i-aa dolnee pavan jhakolanhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ  ਛਾਿਛ  ਪੀਐ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The Saints eat the butter, while the world drinks the whey. ||18||
lines.transliteration: santahu maakh an kh aa-i-aa chh aachh  pee-ai sansaar. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਡੋਲਨੀ  ਪਵਨੁ ਵਹੈ ਿਹਵ ਧਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, Maya is the butter-churn; the breath flows like ice water.
lines.transliteration: kabeer maa-i-aa dolnee pavan vahai hiv Dhaar.

lines.english: Whoever does the churning eats the butter; the others are just churning-sticks. ||19||
lines.transliteration: jin bilo-i-aa tin kh aa-i-aa avar bilovanhaar. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਚੋਰਟੀ  ਮੁਿਸ ਮੁਿਸ ਲਾਵੈ  ਹਾਿਟ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, Maya is the thief, which breaks in and plunders the store.
lines.transliteration: kabeer maa-i-aa chortee mus mus laavai haat.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਨਾ ਮੁਸੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਬਾਰਹ  ਬਾਟ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Only Kabeer is not plundered; he has cut her into twelve pieces. ||20||
lines.transliteration: ayk kabeeraa naa musai jin keenee baarah baat. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਏਂਹ ਜੁਿਗ  ਕਰਿਹ ਜੁ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, peace does not come in this world by making lots of friends.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sookh na ayNh jug karahi jo bahut ai meet .

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਚਤੁ  ਰਾਖਿਹ  ਏਕ ਿਸਉ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਨੀਤ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Those who keep their consciousness focused on the One Lord shall find eternal peace. ||21||
lines.transliteration: jo chit raakh ahi ayk si-o t ay sukh  paavahi neet . ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਜਸੁ ਮਰਨੇ  ਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਡਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਿਨ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the world is afraid of death - that death fills my mind with bliss.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jis marnay tay jag darai mayray man aanand .

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਨੇ  ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: It is only by death that perfect, supreme bliss is obtained. ||22||
lines.transliteration: marnay hee tay paa-ee-ai pooran parmaanand . ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇ  ਕੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਗਿਠ ਨ ਖੋਲ ॥
lines.english: The Treasure of the Lord is obtained, O Kabeer, but do not undo its knot.
lines.transliteration: raam padaarath paa-ay kai kabeeraa gaaNth na kh olH.

lines.punjabi: ਨਹੀ ਪਟਣੁ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਰਖੂ  ਨਹੀ ਗਾਹਕੁ  ਨਹੀ ਮੋਲੁ ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: There is no market to sell it, no appraiser, no customer, and no price. ||23||
lines.transliteration: nahee patan nahee paarkh oo nahee gaahak nahee mol. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਿਰ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, be in love with only that one, whose Master is the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kabeer taa si-o pareet  kar jaa ko th aakur raam.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਰਾਜੇ ਭੂਪਤੀ ਆਵਿਹ  ਕਉਨੇ  ਕਾਮ ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, kings and landlords - what good is love for them?||24||
lines.transliteration: pandit raajay bh ooptee aavahi ka-unay kaam. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਇਕ ਿਸਉ ਕੀਏ ਆਨ  ਦੁਿਬਧਾ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, when you are in love with the One Lord, duality and alienation depart.
lines.transliteration: kabeer pareet ik si-o kee-ay aan d ubiDh aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਵੈ ਲਬੇ  ਕੇਸ ਕਰੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਘਰਿਰ  ਮੁਡਾਇ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: You may have long hair, or you may shave your head bald. ||25||
lines.transliteration: bhaavai laaNbay kays kar bh aavai gh arar mudaa-ay. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ  ਕੀ ਕੋਠਰੀ  ਅੰਧ ਪਰੇ ਿਤਸ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the world is a room filled with black soot; the blind fall into its trap.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jag kaajal kee kothree anDh  paray t is maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਪੈਿਸ ਜੁ ਨੀਕਿਸ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to those who are thrown in, and still escape. ||26||
lines.transliteration: ha-o balihaaree tin ka-o pais jo neekas jaahi. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ  ਸਕਹੁ ਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਹੋਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, this body shall perish; save it, if you can.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ih tan jaa-igaa sakahu t a layho bahor.

lines.punjabi: ਨਗੇ  ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇ ਗਏ ਿਜਨ ਕੇ ਲਾਖ  ਕਰੋਿਰ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: Even those who have tens of thousands and millions, must depart bare-footed in the end. ||27||
lines.transliteration: naaNgay paavhu tay ga-ay jin kay laakh  karor. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ  ਕਵਨੈ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, this body shall perish; place it on the path.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ih tan jaa-igaa kavnai maarag laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: Either join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, or sing the Glorious Praises ofthe Lord. ||28||
lines.transliteration: kai sangat kar saaDh  kee kai har kay gun gaa-ay. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਰਤਾ  ਮਰਤਾ  ਜਗੁ ਮੂਆ ਮਿਰ ਭੀ ਨ ਜਾਿਨਆ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, dying, dying, the whole world has to die, and yet, none know how to die. pMnw 1366
lines.transliteration: kabeer martaa mart aa jag moo-aa mar bh ee na jaani-aa ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਐਸੇ ਮਰਨੇ  ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Let those who die, die such a death, that they shall never have to die again. ||29||
lines.transliteration: aisay marnay jo marai bahur na marnaa ho-ay. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਾਨਸ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਦੁਲੰਭੁ  ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਬਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, it is so difficult to obtain this human body; it does not just come over and over again.
lines.transliteration: kabeer maanas janam dulambh  hai ho-ay na baarai baar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਬਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਕੇ ਭੁਇ ਿਗਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਹ  ਡਾਰ ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: It is like the ripe fruit on the tree; when it falls to the ground, it cannot be re-attachedto the branch. ||30||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ban fal paakay bhu-ay gireh bahur na laageh daar. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਤੁਹੀ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, you are Kabeer; your name means great.
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa tuhee kabeer t oo tayro naa-o kabeer.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਬ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜਉ ਪਿਹਲੇ  ਤਜਿਹ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: O Lord, You are Kabeer. The Jewel of the Lord is obtained, when the mortal first givesup his body. ||31||
lines.transliteration: raam ratan t ab paa-ee-ai ja-o pahilay t ajeh sareer. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਝੰਖੁ ਨ ਝੰਖੀਐ  ਤੁਮਰੋ  ਕਿਹਓ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not struggle in stubborn pride; nothing happens just because you say so.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jhankh  na jh ankhee-ai t umro kahi-o na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਕਰੀਮ  ਜੁ ਕਿਰ ਰਹੇ ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: No one can erase the actions of the Merciful Lord. ||32||
lines.transliteration: karam kareem jo kar rahay mayt na saakai ko-ay. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਸਉਟੀ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਝੂਠਾ ਿਟਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, no one who is false can withstand the Touchstone of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kasa-utee raam kee jhooth aa tikai na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ  ਸੋ ਸਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਰ ਜੀਵਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
lines.english: He alone can pass the test of the Lord's Touchstone, who remains dead while yetalive. ||33||
lines.transliteration: raam kasa-utee so sahai jo mar jeevaa ho-ay. ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਊਜਲ  ਪਿਹਰਿਹ  ਕਾਪਰੇ  ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ  ਖਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, some wear gaudy robes, and chew betel leaves and betel nuts.
lines.transliteration: kabeer oojal pahirahi kaapray paan supaaree khaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਸ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਿਬਨੁ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਜਿਹ  ॥੩੪॥
lines.english: Without the Name of the One Lord, they are bound and gagged and taken to the City of Death. ||34||
lines.transliteration: aykas har kay naam bin baaDhay jam pur jaaNhi. ||34||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਬੇੜਾ ਜਰਜਰਾ  ਫੂਟੇ ਛੇਂਕ ਹਜਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the boat is old, and it has thousands of holes.
lines.transliteration: kabeer bayrhaa jarjaraa footay chh ayNk hajaar.

lines.english: Those who are light get across, while those who carry the weight of their sins on theirheads are drowned. ||35||
lines.transliteration: haroo-ay haroo-ay tir ga-ay doobay jin sir bh aar. ||35||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਾਡ ਜਰੇ ਿਜਉ ਲਾਕਰੀ  ਕੇਸ ਜਰੇ ਿਜਉ  ਘਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the bones burn like wood, and the hair burns like straw.
lines.transliteration: kabeer haad jaray ji-o laakree kays jaray ji-o ghaas.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਰਤਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਉਦਾਸੁ  ॥੩੬॥
lines.english: Seeing the world burning like this, Kabeer has become sad. ||36||
lines.transliteration: ih jag jartaa d aykh kai bh a-i-o kabeer ud aas. ||36||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ਚਾਮ ਲਪੇਟੇ  ਹਾਡ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not be so proud of your bones wrapped up in skin.
lines.transliteration: kabeer garab na keejee-ai chaam lapaytay haad.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈਵਰ ਊਪਿਰ  ਛਤਰ੍ ਤਰ ਤੇ ਫੁਿਨ ਧਰਨੀ  ਗਾਡ  ॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Those who were on their horses and under their canopies, were eventually buriedunder the ground. ||37||
lines.transliteration: haivar oopar chhat ar tar tay fun Dh arnee gaad. ||37||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ਊਚਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਅਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not be so proud of your tall mansions.
lines.transliteration: kabeer garab na keejee-ai oochaa daykh  avaas.

lines.punjabi: ਆਜੁ  ਕਾਿਲ ਭੁਇ ਲੇਟਣਾ  ਊਪਿਰ  ਜਾਮੈ ਘਾਸੁ  ॥੩੮॥
lines.english: Today or tomorrow, you shall lie beneath the ground, and the grass shall grow aboveyou. ||38||
lines.transliteration: aaj kaaliH bhu-ay laytn aa oopar jaamai gh aas. ||38||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ਰੰਕੁ ਨ ਹਸੀਐ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not be so proud, and do not laugh at the poor.
lines.transliteration: kabeer garab na keejee-ai rank na hasee-ai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਹੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ੍  ਮਿਹ ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਨਉ  ਿਕਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥੩੯॥
lines.english: Your boat is still out at sea; who knows what will happen? ||39||
lines.transliteration: ajahu so naa-o samundar meh ki-aa jaan-o ki-aa ho-ay. ||39||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ਦੇਹੀ ਦੇਿਖ ਸੁਰੰਗ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not be so proud, looking at your beautiful body.
lines.transliteration: kabeer garab na keejee-ai dayhee d aykh surang.

lines.punjabi: ਆਜੁ  ਕਾਿਲ ਤਿਜ ਜਾਹੁਗੇ ਿਜਉ  ਕਚੁਰੀ  ਭੁਯੰਗ  ॥੪੦॥
lines.english: Today or tomorrow, you will have to leave it behind, like the snake shedding its skin.||40||
lines.transliteration: aaj kaaliH taj jaahugay ji-o kaaNchuree bh uyang. ||40||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਲੂਟਨਾ  ਹੈ ਤ ਲੂਿਟ  ਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ਲੂਿਟ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, if you must rob and plunder, then plunder the plunder of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: kabeer lootnaa hai ta loot lai raam naam hai loot.

lines.english: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will regret and repent, when the breath of lifeleaves the body. ||41||
lines.transliteration: fir paachhai pachh utaahugay paraan jaahingay chh oot. ||41||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਐਸਾ  ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਨਿਮਓ  ਅਪਨੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਲਾਵੈ  ਆਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, there is no one born, who burns his own home,
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa ko-ee na janmi-o apnai ghar laavai aag.

lines.punjabi: ਪਚਉ ਲਿਰਕਾ  ਜਾਿਰ  ਕੈ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਿਗ  ॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: paaNcha-o larikaa jaar kai rahai raam liv laag. ||42|| and burning his five sons, remains lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||42||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋ ਹੈ ਲਿਰਕਾ  ਬੇਚਈ  ਲਿਰਕੀ  ਬੇਚੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, how rare are those who sell their son and sell their daughter
lines.transliteration: ko hai larikaa baych-ee larikee baychai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਝਾ  ਕਰੈ ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਸਉ ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਬਨਜੁ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: saajhaa karai kabeer si-o har sang banaj karay-i. ||43|| and, entering into partnership with Kabeer, deal with the Lord. ||43||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਇਹ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ  ਮਤ ਸਹਸਾ  ਰਿਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, let me remind you of this. Do not be skeptical or cynical.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ih chaytaavnee mat  sahsaa reh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਛੈ ਭੋਗ ਜੁ ਭੋਗਵੇ  ਿਤਨ ਕੋ ਗੁੜੁ ਲੈ ਖਾਿਹ  ॥੪੪॥
lines.english: Those pleasures which you enjoyed so much in the past - now you must eat their fruits. ||44||
lines.transliteration: paachhai bh og jo bh ogvay t in ko gurh  lai kh aahi. ||44||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੈ ਜਾਿਨਓ  ਪਿੜਬੋ  ਭਲੋ ਪਿੜਬੇ  ਿਸਉ ਭਲ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, at first, I thought learning was good; then I thought Yoga was better.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mai jaani-o parhibo bh alo parh ibay si-o bh al jog.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਛਾਡਉ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਿਨੰਦਉ  ਲੋਗੁ ॥੪੫॥
lines.english: I shall never abandon devotional worship of the Lord, even though people mayslander me. ||45||
lines.transliteration: bhagat  na chh aada-o raam kee bh aavai nind a-o log. ||45||

lines.english: Kabeer, how can the wretched people slander me? They have no wisdom orintelligence.
lines.transliteration: kabeer log ke nindai bapurh aa jih man naahee gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਰਿਵ ਰਹੇ ਅਵਰ  ਤਜੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥੪੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer continues to dwell upon the Lord's Name; I have abandoned all other affairs.||46||
lines.transliteration: raam kabeeraa rav rahay avar tajay sabh  kaam. ||46||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਪਰਦੇਸੀ  ਕੈ ਘਾਘਰੈ  ਚਹੁ ਿਦਿਸ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਆਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the robe of the stranger-soul has caught fire on all four sides.
lines.transliteration: kabeer pardaysee kai gh aaghrai chahu d is laagee aag.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖੰਥਾ ਜਿਲ  ਕੋਇਲਾ  ਭਈ ਤਾਗੇ  ਆਂਚ  ਨ ਲਾਗ  ॥੪੭॥
lines.english: The cloth of the body has been burnt and reduced to charcoal, but the fire did nottouch the thread of the soul. ||47||
lines.transliteration: khinthaa jal ko-ilaa bh a-ee t aagay aaNch na laag. ||47||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਖੰਥਾ  ਜਿਲ  ਕੋਇਲਾ  ਭਈ ਖਾਪਰੁ ਫੂਟ ਮਫੂਟ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the cloth has been burnt and reduced to charcoal, and the begging bowl is shattered into pieces.
lines.transliteration: kabeer khinthaa jal ko-ilaa bh a-ee kh aapar foot mafoot.

lines.english: The poor Yogi has played out his game; only ashes remain on his seat. ||48|| pMnw 1367
lines.transliteration: jogee bapurhaa kh ayli-o aasan rahee bibh oot. ||48||

lines.english: Kabeer, the fish is in the shallow water; the fisherman has cast his net.
lines.transliteration: kabeer thorai jal maachhulee jh eevar mayli-o jaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਥੋਰੈ ਜਿਲ  ਮਾਛੁਲੀ  ਝੀਵਿਰ  ਮੇਿਲਓ  ਜਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: You shall not escape this little pool; think about returning to the ocean. ||49||
lines.transliteration: ih toghnai na chh ootsahi fir kar samund  samHaal. ||49||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਟੋਘਨੈ  ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿਹ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਕਿਰ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੪੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not leave the ocean, even if it is very salty.
lines.transliteration: kabeer samund na chh odee-ai ja-o at  khaaro ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਮੁੰਦੁ  ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ  ਜਉ ਅਿਤ  ਖਾਰੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: If you poke around searching from puddle to puddle, no one will call you smart. ||50||
lines.transliteration: pokhar pokh ar dhoodh-tay bh alo na kahihai ko-ay. ||50||

lines.punjabi: ਪੋਖਿਰ  ਪੋਖਿਰ  ਢੂਢਤੇ  ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਿਹਹੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥੫੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those who have no guru are washed away. No one can help them.
lines.transliteration: kabeer nigusaaN-ayN bahi ga-ay thaaNghee naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਨਗੁਸਏਂ  ਬਿਹ ਗਏ ਥਘੀ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Be meek and humble; whatever happens is what the Creator Lord does. ||51||
lines.transliteration: deen gareebee aapunee kart ay ho-ay so ho-ay. ||51||

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ ਗਰੀਬੀ  ਆਪੁਨੀ  ਕਰਤੇ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, even the dog of a devotee is good, while the mother of the faithless cynic is bad.
lines.transliteration: kabeer baisna-o kee kookar bhalee saakat  kee buree maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਬੈਸਨਉ  ਕੀ ਕੂਕਿਰ  ਭਲੀ ਸਾਕਤ  ਕੀ ਬੁਰੀ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The dog hears the Praises of the Lord's Name, while the other is engaged in sin. ||52||
lines.transliteration: oh nit sunai har naam jas uh paap bisaahan jaa-ay. ||52||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਿਨਤ  ਸੁਨੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਉਹ ਪਾਪ ਿਬਸਾਹਨ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੫੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the deer is weak, and the pool is lush with green vegetation.
lines.transliteration: kabeer harnaa dooblaa ih haree-aaraa t aal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਰਨਾ  ਦੂਬਲਾ  ਇਹੁ ਹਰੀਆਰਾ ਤਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: Thousands of hunters are chasing after the soul; how long can it escape death? ||53||
lines.transliteration: laakh ahayree ayk jee-o kayt aa bancha-o kaal. ||53||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਖ  ਅਹੇਰੀ  ਏਕੁ ਜੀਉ  ਕੇਤਾ  ਬੰਚਉ  ਕਾਲੁ  ॥੫੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, some make their homes on the banks of the Ganges, and drink pure water.
lines.transliteration: kabeer gangaa teer jo gh ar karahi peeveh nirmal neer.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗੰਗਾ  ਤੀਰ ਜੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੀਵਿਹ  ਿਨਰਮਲ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, they are not liberated. Kabeer proclaims this.||54||
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagat  na mukat  ho-ay i-o kahi ramay kabeer. ||54||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਇਉ ਕਿਹ ਰਮੇ ਕਬੀਰ  ॥੫੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, my mind has become immaculate, like the waters of the Ganges.
lines.transliteration: kabeer man nirmal bha-i-aa jaisaa gangaa neer.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਜੈਸਾ ਗੰਗਾ  ਨੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord follows after me, calling, "Kabeer! Kabeer!"||55||
lines.transliteration: paachhai laago har firai kahat  kabeer kabeer. ||55||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਛੈ ਲਾਗੋ  ਹਿਰ ਿਫਰੈ ਕਹਤ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਬੀਰ  ॥੫੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, tumeric is yelow, and lime is white.
lines.transliteration: kabeer hardee pee-aree chooNnaaN oojal bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਰਦੀ  ਪੀਅਰੀ  ਚੂੰਨ  ਊਜਲ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: You shall meet the Beloved Lord, only when both colors are lost. ||56||
lines.transliteration: raam sanayhee ta-o milai don-o baran gavaa-ay. ||56||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ  ਤਉ ਿਮਲੈ ਦੋਨਉ  ਬਰਨ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥੫੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, tumeric has lost its yellow color, and no trace of lime's whiteness remains.
lines.transliteration: kabeer hardee peert an harai choon chihan na rahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਰਦੀ  ਪੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰੈ ਚੂਨ ਿਚਹਨੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to this love, by which social class and status, color and ancestry are taken away. ||57||
lines.transliteration: balihaaree ih pareet ka-o jih jaat  baran kul jaa-ay. ||57||

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਇਹ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਕਉ ਿਜਹ ਜਾਿਤ  ਬਰਨੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੫੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the door of liberation is very narrow, less than the width of a mustard seed.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mukat d u-aaraa sankuraa raa-ee d as-ayN bhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦੁਆਰਾ  ਸੰਕੁਰਾ  ਰਾਈ ਦਸਏਂ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your mind is larger than an elephant; how will it pass through? ||58||
lines.transliteration: man ta-o maigal ho-ay rahi-o nikso ki-o kai jaa-ay. ||58||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਨਕਸੋ  ਿਕਉ  ਕੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥੫੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, if I meet such a True Guru, who mercifully blesses me with the gift,
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa satgur jay milai t uthaa karay pasaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਐਸਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat d u-aaraa moklaa sehjay aava-o jaa-o. ||59|| then the door of liberation will open wide for me, and I will easily pass through. ||59||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਦੁਆਰਾ  ਮੋਕਲਾ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਆਵਉ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੫੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have no hut or hovel, no house or village.
lines.transliteration: kabeer naa mohi chhaan na chh aapree naa mohi gh ar nahee gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਨਾ ਮਿਹ ਛਾਿਨ  ਨ ਛਾਪਰੀ ਨਾ ਮਿਹ ਘਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I hope that the Lord will not ask who I am. I have no social status or name. ||60||
lines.transliteration: mat har poochh ai ka-un hai mayray jaat  na naa-o. ||60||

lines.punjabi: ਮਤ ਹਿਰ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਾਿਤ  ਨ ਨਾਉ  ॥੬੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I long to die; let me die at the Lord's Door.
lines.transliteration: kabeer muhi marnay kaa chaa-o hai mara-o ta har kai d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੁਿਹ ਮਰਨੇ  ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ਹੈ ਮਰਉ  ਤ ਹਿਰ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: I hope that the Lord does not ask, "Who is this, lying at my door?"||61||
lines.transliteration: mat har poochh ai ka-un hai paraa hamaarai baar. ||61||

lines.punjabi: ਮਤ ਹਿਰ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਰਾ ਹਮਾਰੈ  ਬਾਰ ॥੬੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have not done anything; I shall not do anything; my body cannot doanything.
lines.transliteration: kabeer naa ham kee-aa na karhigay naa kar sakai sareer.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਆ  ਨ ਕਰਿਹਗੇ  ਨਾ ਕਿਰ ਸਕੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I do not know what the Lord has done, but the call has gone out: "Kabeer,Kabeer."||62||
lines.transliteration: ki-aa jaan-o kichh har kee-aa bh a-i-o kabeer kabeer. ||62||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਜਾਨਉ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀਆ  ਭਇਓ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੬੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, if someone utters the Name of the Lord even in dreams,
lines.transliteration: kabeer supnai hoo barrhaa-ay kai jih mukh  niksai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਪਨੈ  ਹੂ ਬਰੜਾਇ  ਕੈ ਿਜਹ ਮੁਿਖ ਿਨਕਸੈ  ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: I would make my skin into shoes for his feet. ||63||
lines.transliteration: taa kay pag kee paanhee mayray t an ko chaam. ||63||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਕੀ ਪਾਨਹੀ  ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੋ ਚਾਮੁ ॥੬੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, we are puppets of clay, but we take the name of mankind.
lines.transliteration: kabeer maatee kay ham pootray maanas raakh i-o naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਪੂਤਰੇ  ਮਾਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਖਓ  ੁ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: We are guests here for only a few days, but we take up so much space. ||64||
lines.transliteration: chaar divas kay paahunay bad bad rooNDheh thaa-o. ||64||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਿਦਵਸ  ਕੇ ਪਾਹੁਨੇ ਬਡ ਬਡ ਰੂੰਧਿਹ  ਠਾਉ  ॥੬੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have made myself into henna, and I grind myself into powder.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mahidee kar gh aali-aa aap peesaa-ay peesaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਿਹਦੀ ਕਿਰ ਘਾਿਲਆ  ਆਪੁ  ਪੀਸਾਇ  ਪੀਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But You, O my Husband Lord, have not asked about me; You have never applied meto Your Feet. ||65||
lines.transliteration: tai sah baat  na poochh ee-ai kabahu na laa-ee paa-ay. ||65||

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛੀਐ  ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਲਾਈ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੬੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, that door, through which people never stop coming and going
lines.transliteration: kabeer jih dar aavat  jaati-ahu hatkai naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਜਹ ਦਿਰ ਆਵਤ  ਜਾਿਤਅਹੁ ਹਟਕੈ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so dar kaisay chh odee-ai jo d ar aisaa ho-ay. ||66|| - how can I leave such a door as that? ||66||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਛੋਡੀਐ  ਜੋ ਦਰੁ ਐਸਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੬੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I was drowning, but the waves of virtue saved me in an instant. pMnw 1368
lines.transliteration: kabeer doobaa thaa pai ubri-o gun kee lahar jhabak.

lines.punjabi: ਪੈ ਉਬਿਰਓ  ਗੁਨ ਕੀ ਲਹਿਰ  ਝਬਿਕ  ॥
lines.english: When I saw that my boat was rotten, then I immediately got out. ||67||
lines.transliteration: jab daykh i-o bayrh aa jarjaraa t ab utar pari-o ha-o farak. ||67||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਬੇੜਾ ਜਰਜਰਾ  ਤਬ ਉਤਿਰ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਹਉ ਫਰਿਕ  ॥੬੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the sinner does not like devotion to the Lord; he does not appreciate worship.
lines.transliteration: kabeer paapee bhagat  na bh aav-ee har poojaa na suhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਪਾਪੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਭਾਵਈ  ਹਿਰ ਪੂਜਾ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The fly abandons the sandalwood tree, and goes after the rotten smell. ||68||
lines.transliteration: maakhee chand an parharai jah biganDh  tah jaa-ay. ||68||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਖੀ  ਚੰਦਨੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ  ਜਹ ਿਬਗੰਧ  ਤਹ ਜਾਇ  ॥੬੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the physician is dead, and the patient is dead; the whole world is dead.
lines.transliteration: kabeer baid moo-aa rogee moo-aa moo-aa sabh  sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਬੈਦੁ ਮੂਆ ਰੋਗੀ ਮੂਆ ਮੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Only Kabeer is not dead; there is no one to mourn for him. ||69||
lines.transliteration: ayk kabeeraa naa moo-aa jih naahee rovanhaar. ||69||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਨਾ ਮੂਆ ਿਜਹ ਨਾਹੀ  ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੬੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have not meditated on the Lord; such is the bad habit I have developed.
lines.transliteration: kabeer raam na Dhi-aa-i-o motee laagee kh or.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਿਧਆਇਓ  ਮੋਟੀ ਲਾਗੀ  ਖੋਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The body is a wooden pot; it cannot be put back on the fire. ||70||
lines.transliteration: kaa-i-aa haaNdee kaath kee naa oh charHai bahor. ||70||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਇਆ  ਹਡੀ  ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਨਾ ਓਹ ਚਰੈ ਬਹੋਿਰ  ॥੭੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, it came to pass, that I did whatever I pleased.
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisee ho-ay paree man ko bhaavat  keen.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸੀ  ਹੋਇ ਪਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਤੁ  ਕੀਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Why should I be afraid of death? I have invited death for myself. ||71||
lines.transliteration: marnay tay ki-aa darapnaa jab haath siDh a-uraa leen. ||71||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਨੇ  ਤੇ ਿਕਆ  ਡਰਪਨਾ  ਜਬ ਹਾਿਥ  ਿਸਧਉਰਾ  ਲੀਨ  ॥੭੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortals suck at the sugar cane, for the sake of the sweet juice. Theyshould work just as hard for virtue.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ras ko gaaNdo choosee-ai gun ka-o maree-ai ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਸ ਕੋ ਗਡੋ  ਚੂਸੀਐ  ਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਮਰੀਐ  ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The person who lacks virtue - no one calls him good. ||72||
lines.transliteration: avgunee-aaray maansai bhalo na kahihai ko-ay. ||72||

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ  ਮਾਨਸੈ  ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਿਹਹੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥੭੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the pitcher is full of water; it will break, today or tomorrow.
lines.transliteration: kabeer gaagar jal bharee aaj kaaliH jaihai foot.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਾਗਿਰ  ਜਲ ਭਰੀ ਆਜੁ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਜੈਹੈ ਫੂਿਟ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not remember their Guru, shall be plundered on the way. ||73||
lines.transliteration: gur jo na cheeteh aapno aDh  maajh  leejhigay loot. ||73||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਆਪਨੋ  ਅਧ ਮਾਿਝ  ਲੀਜਿਹਗੇ  ਲੂਿਟ  ॥੭੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I am the Lord's dog; Moti is my name.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kookar raam ko mutee-aa mayro naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੂਕਰੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਤੀਆ  ਮੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: There is a chain around my neck; wherever I am pulled, I go. ||74||
lines.transliteration: galay hamaaray jayvree jah khinchai t ah jaa-o. ||74||

lines.punjabi: ਗਲੇ ਹਮਾਰੇ  ਜੇਵਰੀ  ਜਹ ਿਖੰਚੈ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ  ॥੭੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, why do you show other people your rosary beads?
lines.transliteration: kabeer japnee kaath kee ki-aa d ikhlaavahi lo-ay.

lines.english: You do not remember the Lord in your heart, so what use is this rosary to you? ||75||
lines.transliteration: hirdai raam na chayt hee ih japnee ki-aa ho-ay. ||75||

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ  ਇਹ ਜਪਨੀ  ਿਕਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥੭੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the snake of separation from the Lord abides within my mind; it does not respond to any mantra.
lines.transliteration: kabeer birahu bhuyangam man basai mant  na maanai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਬਰਹੁ ਭੁਯੰਗਮੁ  ਮਿਨ ਬਸੈ ਮੰਤੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: One who is separated from the Lord does not live; if he does live, he goes insane.||76||
lines.transliteration: raam bi-ogee naa jee-ai jee-ai ta ba-uraa ho-ay. ||76||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਿਬਓਗੀ  ਨਾ ਜੀਐ  ਜੀਐ  ਤ ਬਉਰਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥੭੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the philosopher's stone and sandalwood oil have the same good quality.
lines.transliteration: kabeer paaras chandnai t inH hai ayk suganDh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਪਾਰਸ ਚੰਦਨੈ  ਿਤਨ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਸੁਗੰਧ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever comes into contact with them is up lifted. Iron is transformed into gold, and ordinary wood becomes fragrant. ||77||
lines.transliteration: tih mil t ay-oo oot am bh a-ay loh kaath  nirganDh . ||77||

lines.english: Kabeer, Death's club is terrible; it cannot be endured.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jam kaa thayNgaa buraa hai oh nahee sahi-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਮ ਕਾ ਠੇਂਗਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਹਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I have met with the holy man; he has attached me to the hem of his robe. ||78||
lines.transliteration: ayk jo saaDhoo mohi mili-o t iniH lee-aa anchal laa-ay. ||78||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਹ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਲੀਆ  ਅੰਚਿਲ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੭੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the physician says that he alone is good, and all the medicine is under hiscontrol.
lines.transliteration: kabeer baid kahai ha-o hee bh alaa d aaroo mayrai vas.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਹਉ ਹੀ ਭਲਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਵਿਸ ॥
lines.english: But these things belong to the Lord; He takes them away whenever He wishes. ||79||
lines.transliteration: ih ta-o basat  gupaal kee jab bh aavai lay-ay kh as. ||79||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਤਉ ਬਸਤੁ  ਗੁਪਾਲ  ਕੀ ਜਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਲੇਇ ਖਿਸ ॥੭੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, take your drum and beat it for ten days.
lines.transliteration: kabeer na-ubat aapnee d in das layho bajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਨਉਬਿਤ  ਆਪਨੀ  ਿਦਨ ਦਸ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Life is like people meeting on a boat on a river; they shall not meet again. ||80||
lines.transliteration: nadee naav sanjog ji-o bahur na milhai aa-ay. ||80||

lines.punjabi: ਨਦੀ  ਨਾਵ ਸੰਜੋਗ  ਿਜਉ  ਬਹੁਿਰ ਨ ਿਮਲਹੈ  ਆਇ  ॥੮੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, if I could change the seven seas into ink and make all the vegetation my pen,
lines.transliteration: kabeer saat samund eh mas kara-o kalam kara-o banraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦਿਹ  ਮਸੁ ਕਰਉ  ਕਲਮ  ਕਰਉ  ਬਨਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: basuDhaa kaagad  ja-o kara-o har jas likh an na jaa-ay. ||81|| and the earth my paper, even then, I could not write the Praises of the Lord. ||81||

lines.punjabi: ਬਸੁਧਾ  ਕਾਗਦੁ  ਜਉ ਕਰਉ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਿਲਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੮੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what can my lowly status as a weaver do to me? The Lord dwells in my heart.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaat julaahaa ki-aa karai hird ai basay gupaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਾਿਤ  ਜੁਲਾਹਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੈ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਬਸੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Lord hugs me close in His Embrace; I have forsaken all my entanglements. ||82||
lines.transliteration: kabeer rama-ee-aa kanth mil chookeh sarab janjaal. ||82||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਮਈਆ  ਕੰਿਠ ਿਮਲੁ ਚੂਕਿਹ ਸਰਬ  ਜੰਜਾਲ  ॥੮੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, will anyone set fire to his home
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa ko nahee mandar d ay-ay jaraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਐਸਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: paaNcha-o larikay maar kai rahai raam li-o laa-ay. ||83|| and kill his five sons (the five thieves) to remain lovingly attached to the Lord? ||83||

lines.punjabi: ਪਚਉ  ਲਿਰਕੇ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਕੈ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਿਲਉ ਲਾਇ  ॥੮੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, will anyone burn his own body?
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa ko nahee ih tan d ayvai fook.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਐਸਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਫੂਿਕ ॥
lines.english: The people are blind - they do not know, although Kabeer continues to shout at them. ||84||
lines.transliteration: anDhaa log na jaan-ee rahi-o kabeeraa kook. ||84||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧਾ  ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਕੂਿਕ ॥੮੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the widow mounts the funeral pyre and cries out, "Listen, O brother funeralpyre.
lines.transliteration: kabeer satee pukaarai chih charh ee sun ho beer masaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਤੀ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ  ਿਚਹ ਚੜੀ ਸੁਨੁ ਹੋ ਬੀਰ ਮਸਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: All people must depart in the end; it is only you and I."||85|| pMnw 1369
