lines.transliteration: log sabaa-i-aa chal ga-i-o ham tum kaam nid aan. ||85||

lines.english: Kabeer, the mind has become a bird; it soars and flies in the ten directions.
lines.transliteration: kabeer man pankhee bh a-i-o ud ud d ah dis jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਭਇਓ  ਉਿਡ ਉਿਡ ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: According to the company it keeps, so are the fruits it eats. ||86||
lines.transliteration: jo jaisee sangat milai so t aiso fal kh aa-ay. ||86||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੈਸੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਲੈ ਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਇ  ॥੮੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, you have found that place which you were seeking.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaa ka-o khojt ay paa-i-o so-ee th a-ur.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਤੇ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਸੋਈ ਠਉਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You have become that which you thought was separate from yourself. ||87||
lines.transliteration: so-ee fir kai too bh a-i-aa jaa ka-o kaht aa a-or. ||87||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਿਫਿਰ  ਕੈ ਤੂ ਭਇਆ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤਾ  ਅਉਰੁ ॥੮੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have been ruined and destroyed by bad company, like the banana plantnear the thorn bush.
lines.transliteration: kabeer maaree mara-o kusang kee kaylay nikat jo bayr.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਾਰੀ  ਮਰਉ  ਕੁਸੰਗ  ਕੀ ਕੇਲੇ ਿਨਕਿਟ  ਜੁ ਬੇਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The thorn bush waves in the wind, and pierces the banana plant; see this, and do notassociate with the faithless cynics. ||88||
lines.transliteration: uh jhoolai uh cheeree-ai saakat  sang na hayr. ||88||

lines.punjabi: ਉਹ ਝੂਲੈ ਉਹ ਚੀਰੀਐ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੇਿਰ ॥੮੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal wants to walk on the path, carrying the load of others' sins on hishead.
lines.transliteration: kabeer bhaar paraa-ee sir charai chali-o chaahai baat.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਭਾਰ ਪਰਾਈ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਚਰੈ ਚਿਲਓ  ਚਾਹੈ ਬਾਟ ॥
lines.english: He is not afraid of his own load of sins; the road ahead shall be difficult andtreacherous. ||89||
lines.transliteration: apnay bhaareh naa darai aagai a-ugh at ghaat. ||89||

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨੇ  ਭਾਰਿਹ  ਨਾ ਡਰੈ ਆਗੈ  ਅਉਘਟ  ਘਾਟ ॥੮੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the forest is burning; the tree standing in it is crying out,
lines.transliteration: kabeer ban kee daaDh ee laakree th aadhee karai pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਬਨ ਕੀ ਦਾਧੀ  ਲਾਕਰੀ  ਠਾਢੀ  ਕਰੈ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: "Do not let me fall into the hands of the blacksmith, who would burn me a secondtime."||90||
lines.transliteration: mat bas para-o luhaar kay jaarai d oojee baar. ||90||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਬਿਸ ਪਰਉ  ਲੁਹਾਰ  ਕੇ ਜਾਰੈ ਦੂਜੀ  ਬਾਰ ॥੯੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, when one died, two were dead. When two died, four were dead.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ayk marantay d u-ay moo-ay d o-ay marant ah chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਏਕ ਮਰੰਤੇ  ਦੁਇ ਮੂਏ ਦੋਇ ਮਰੰਤਹ  ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: When four died, six were dead, four males and two females. ||91||
lines.transliteration: chaar marantah chh ah moo-ay chaar purakh  du-ay naar. ||91||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਰ  ਮਰੰਤਹ  ਛਹ ਮੂਏ ਚਾਿਰ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਦੁਇ ਨਾਿਰ ॥੯੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have seen and observed, and searched all over the world, but I have found no place of rest anywhere.
lines.transliteration: kabeer daykh  daykh jag dh ooNdhi-aa kahoo-aN na paa-i-aa th a-ur.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਦੇਿਖ ਦੇਿਖ ਜਗੁ ਢੂੰਿਢਆ  ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਠਉਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Those who do not remember the Lord's Name - why do they delude themselves inother pursuits? ||92||
lines.transliteration: jin har kaa naam na chayti-o kahaa bh ulaanay a-or. ||92||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਕਹਾ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ  ਅਉਰ  ॥੯੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, associate with the Holy people, who will take you to Nirvaanaa in the end.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sangat karee-ai saaDh  kee ant  karai birbaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਕਰੀਐ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਰੈ ਿਨਰਬਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Do not associate with the faithless cynics; they would bring you to ruin. ||93||
lines.transliteration: saakat sang na keejee-ai jaa t ay ho-ay binaahu. ||93||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਿਬਨਾਹੁ ॥੯੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I contemplate the Lord in the world; I know that He is permeating the world.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jag meh chayti-o jaan kai jag meh rahi-o samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਜਾਿਨ  ਕੈ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who do not contemplate the Name of the Lord - their birth into this world isuseless. ||94||
lines.transliteration: jin har kaa naam na chayti-o baad eh janmayN aa-ay. ||94||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਬਾਦਿਹ  ਜਨਮੇਂ  ਆਇ  ॥੯੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, place your hopes in the Lord; other hopes lead to despair.
lines.transliteration: kabeer aasaa karee-ai raam kee avrai aas niraas.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਆਸਾ  ਕਰੀਐ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅਵਰੈ  ਆਸ  ਿਨਰਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: Those who dissociate themselves from the Lord's Name - when they fall into hell, thenthey will appreciate its value. ||95||
lines.transliteration: narak pareh tay maan-ee jo har naam ud aas. ||95||

lines.punjabi: ਨਰਿਕ ਪਰਿਹ  ਤੇ ਮਾਨਈ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਉਦਾਸ  ॥੯੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer has made many students and disciples, but he has not made God his friend.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sikh saakh aa bahut ay kee-ay kayso kee-o na meet .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਸਖ ਸਾਖਾ  ਬਹੁਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੀਓ  ਨ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.english: He set out on a journey to meet the Lord, but his consciousness failed him half-way. ||96||
lines.transliteration: chaalay thay har milan ka-o beechai atki-o cheet. ||96||

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਲੇ ਥੇ ਹਿਰ ਿਮਲਨ  ਕਉ ਬੀਚੈ ਅਟਿਕਓ  ਚੀਤੁ  ॥੯੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what can the poor creature do, if the Lord does not give him assistance?
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaaran bapuraa ki-aa karai ja-o raam na karai sahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਾਰਨੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਸਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever branch he steps on breaks and collapses. ||97||
lines.transliteration: jih jih daalee pag Dhara-o so-ee mur mur jaa-ay. ||97||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਿਜਹ ਡਾਲੀ  ਪਗੁ ਧਰਉ  ਸੋਈ ਮੁਿਰ ਮੁਿਰ ਜਾਇ  ॥੯੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those who only preach to others - sand falls into their mouths.
lines.transliteration: kabeer avrah ka-o updayst ay mukh  mai par hai rayt .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਅਵਰਹ  ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸਤੇ  ਮੁਖ ਮੈ ਪਿਰ ਹੈ ਰੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: They keep their eyes on the property of others, while their own farm is being eatenup. ||98||
lines.transliteration: raas biraanee raakh-t ay kh aa-yaa gh ar kaa kh ayt. ||98||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਸ  ਿਬਰਾਨੀ  ਰਾਖਤੇ  ਖਾਯਾ  ਘਰ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੯੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I will remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even if I haveonly coarse bread to eat.
lines.transliteration: kabeer saaDhoo kee sangat  raha-o ja-o kee bh oosee kh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਰਹਉ  ਜਉ ਕੀ ਭੂਸੀ ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Whatever will be, will be. I will not associate with the faithless cynics. ||99||
lines.transliteration: honhaar so ho-ihai saakat sang na jaa-o. ||99||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਨਹਾਰੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਹੈ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਜਾਉ  ॥੯੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, in the Saadh Sangat, love for the Lord doubles day by day.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sangat saaDh  kee d in din doonaa hayt .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਿਦਨ  ਿਦਨ  ਦੂਨਾ  ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.english: The faithless cynic is like a black blanket, which does not become white by beingwashed. ||100||
lines.transliteration: saakat kaaree kaaNbree Dh o-ay ho-ay na sayt . ||100||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾਰੀ  ਕਬਰੀ  ਧੋਏ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਸੇਤੁ ॥੧੦੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, you have not shaved your mind, so why do you shave your head?
lines.transliteration: kabeer man mooNdi-aa nahee kays mundaa-ay kaaN-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਨੁ ਮੂੰਿਡਆ  ਨਹੀ ਕੇਸ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ  ਕਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever is done, is done by the mind; it is useless to shave your head. ||101||
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kee-aa so man kee-aa mooNdaa moond ajaaN-ay. ||101||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਕੀਆ  ਮੂੰਡਾ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਅਜਇ  ॥੧੦੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not abandon the Lord; your body and wealth shall go, so let them go.
lines.transliteration: kabeer raam na chhodee-ai t an Dh an jaa-ay t a jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ  ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ  ਤ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: My consciousness is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; I am absorbed in the Name ofthe Lord. ||102||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal chit bayDh i-aa raameh naam samaa-o. ||102||

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ ਿਚਤੁ  ਬੇਿਧਆ  ਰਾਮਿਹ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਉ  ॥੧੦੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, all the strings of the instrument I played are broken.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jo ham jant bajaavt ay toot ga-eeN sabh  taar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੋ ਹਮ ਜੰਤੁ ਬਜਾਵਤੇ  ਟੂਿਟ ਗਈਂ  ਸਭ ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.english: What can the poor instrument do, when the player has departed as well. ||103||
lines.transliteration: jant bichaaraa ki-aa karai chalay bajaavanhaar. ||103||

lines.english: Kabeer, shave the mother of that guru, who does not take away one's doubt. pMnw 1370
lines.transliteration: kabeer maa-ay moonda-o tih guroo kee jaa t ay bh aram na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਡੁਬੇ ਚਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਮਿਹ ਚੇਲੇ ਦੀਏ ਬਹਾਇ  ॥੧੦੪॥
lines.english: He himself is drowning in the four Vedas; he drowns his disciples as well. ||104||
lines.transliteration: aap dubay chahu bayd meh chaylay d ee-ay bahaa-ay. ||104||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੇਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਖੇ ਤਲੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, whatever sins the mortal has committed, he tries to keep hidden under cover.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaytay paap kee-ay raakh ay talai d uraa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਿਨਦਾਨ  ਸਭ ਜਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ॥੧੦੫॥
lines.english: But in the end, they shall all be revealed, when the Righteous Judge of Dharma investigates. ||105||
lines.transliteration: pargat bha-ay nid aan sabh  jab poochh ay Dh aram raa-ay. ||105||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਿਡ  ਕੈ ਪਾਿਲਓ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, you have given up meditating on the Lord, and you have raised a largefamily.
lines.transliteration: kabeer har kaa simran chhaad kai paali-o bahut  kutamb.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਾ  ਰਿਹ ਗਇਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਰਿਹਆ  ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ॥੧੦੬॥
lines.english: DhanDh aa kart aa reh ga-i-aa bh aa-ee rahi-aa na banDh . ||106|| You continue to involve yourself in worldly affairs, but none of your brothers andrelatives remain. ||106||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਿਡ  ਕੈ ਰਾਿਤ  ਜਗਾਵਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those who give up meditation on the Lord, and get up at night to wake thespirits of the dead,
lines.transliteration: kabeer har kaa simran chhaad kai raat  jagaavan jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਪਿਨ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਉਤਰੈ  ਜਾਏ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਖਾਇ  ॥੧੦੭॥
lines.transliteration: sarpan ho-ay kai a-utarai jaa-ay apunay kh aa-ay. ||107|| shall be reincarnated as snakes, and eat their own offspring. ||107||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਿਡ  ਕੈ ਅਹੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the woman who gives up meditation on the Lord, and observes the ritual fastof Ahoi,
lines.transliteration: kabeer har kaa simran chhaad kai aho-ee raakh ai naar.

lines.punjabi: ਗਦਹੀ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਉਤਰੈ  ਭਾਰੁ ਸਹੈ ਮਨ ਚਾਿਰ  ॥੧੦੮॥
lines.transliteration: gadhee ho-ay kai a-ut arai bh aar sahai man chaar. ||108|| shall be reincarnated as a donkey, to carry heavy burdens. ||108||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ਅਿਤ  ਘਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, it is the most clever wisdom, to chant and meditate on the Lord in the heart.
lines.transliteration: kabeer chaturaa-ee at  ghanee har jap hird ai maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰੀ ਊਪਿਰ  ਖੇਲਨਾ  ਿਗਰੈ ਤ ਠਾਹਰ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੧੦੯॥
lines.english: It is like playing on a pig; if you fall off, you will find no place of rest. ||109||
lines.transliteration: sooree oopar khaylnaa girai t a thaahar naahi. ||109||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਈ ਮੁਖੁ ਧੰਿਨ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਕਹੀਐ  ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, blessed is that mouth, which utters the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: kabeer so-ee mukh Dh an hai jaa mukh  kahee-ai raam.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਿਕਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਪੁਰੀ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍ੁ  ਹੋਇਗੋ  ਗਰ੍ਾਮੁ  ॥੧੧੦॥
lines.english: It purifies the body, and the whole village as well. ||110||
lines.transliteration: dayhee kis kee baapuree pavit ar ho-igo garaam. ||110||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੋਈ ਕੁਲ ਭਲੀ ਜਾ ਕੁਲ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, that family is good, in which the Lord's slave is born.
lines.transliteration: kabeer so-ee kul bhalee jaa kul har ko d aas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਕੁਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਸੋ ਕੁਲ ਢਾਕੁ  ਪਲਾਸੁ  ॥੧੧੧॥
lines.english: But that family in which the Lord's slave is not born is as useless as weeds. ||111||
lines.transliteration: jih kul daas na oopjai so kul dh aak palaas. ||111||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹੈ ਗਇ ਬਾਹਨ  ਸਘਨ ਘਨ ਲਾਖ  ਧਜਾ ਫਹਰਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, some have lots of horses, elephants and carriages, and thousands of banners waving.
lines.transliteration: kabeer hai ga-ay baahan saghan gh an laakh  Dhajaa fahraahi.

lines.punjabi: ਇਆ  ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਿਭਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ  ਭਲੀ ਜਉ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਿਦਨ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥੧੧੨॥
lines.english: But begging is better than these comforts, if one spends his days meditating inremembrance on the Lord. ||112||
lines.transliteration: i-aa sukh t ay bh ikh-yaa bh alee ja-o har simrat  din jaahi. ||112||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਉ ਿਫਿਰਓ  ਮਦਲੁ  ਕੰਧ ਚਢਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have wandered all over the world, carrying the drum on my shoulder.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sabh jag ha-o firi-o maaNdal kanDh  chadh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀ ਠੋਿਕ ਬਜਾਇ  ॥੧੧੩॥
lines.english: No one belongs to anyone else; I have looked and carefully studied it. ||113||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee kaahoo ko nahee sabh d aykhee thok bajaa-ay. ||113||

lines.english: The pearls are scattered on the road; the blind man comes along.
lines.transliteration: maarag motee beethray anDh aa niksi-o aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ  ਿਬਨਾ  ਜਗਦੀਸ  ਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਲੰਘੇ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੧੪॥
lines.english: Without the Light of the Lord of the Universe, the world just passes them by. ||114||
lines.transliteration: jot binaa jagd ees kee jagat  ulangh ay jaa-ay. ||114||

lines.punjabi: ਬੂਡਾ ਬੰਸੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਪੂਤੁ ਕਮਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: My family is drowned, O Kabeer, since the birth of my son Kamaal.
lines.transliteration: boodaa bans kabeer kaa upji-o poot kamaal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਿਡ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਲੇ ਆਯਾ  ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧੧੫॥
lines.english: He has given up meditating on the Lord, in order to bring home wealth. ||115||
lines.transliteration: har kaa simran chhaad kai gh ar lay aa-yaa maal. ||115||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਧੂ ਕਉ ਿਮਲਨੇ  ਜਾਈਐ  ਸਾਿਥ  ਨ ਲੀਜੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, go out to meet the holy man; do not take anyone else with you.
lines.transliteration: kabeer saaDhoo ka-o milnay jaa-ee-ai saath na leejai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਉ ਨ ਦੀਜੀਐ  ਆਗੈ  ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧੬॥
lines.english: Do not turn back - keep on going. Whatever will be, will be. ||116||
lines.transliteration: paachhai paa-o na d eejee-ai aagai ho-ay so ho-ay. ||116||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਗੁ ਬਾਿਧਓ  ਿਜਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ  ਿਤਹ ਮਤ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not bind yourself with that chain, which binds the whole world.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jag baaDhi-o jih jayvree t ih mat  banDh hu kabeer.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਹਿਹ  ਆਟਾ  ਲੋਨ ਿਜਉ  ਸੋਨ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥੧੧੭॥
lines.english: As the salt is lost in the flour, so shall your golden body be lost. ||117||
lines.transliteration: jaiheh aataa lon ji-o son samaan sareer. ||117||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹੰਸੁ ਉਿਡਓ  ਤਨੁ ਗਾਿਡਓ  ਸੋਝਾਈ  ਸੈਨਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the soul-swan is flying away, and the body is being buried, and still he makesgestures.
lines.transliteration: kabeer hans udi-o tan gaadi-o sojh aa-ee sainaah.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਹੂ ਜੀਉ  ਨ ਛੋਡਈ  ਰੰਕਾਈ  ਨੈਨਾਹ  ॥੧੧੮॥
lines.english: Even then, the mortal does not give up the cruel look in his eyes. ||118||
lines.transliteration: ajhoo jee-o na chhod-ee rankaa-ee nainaah. ||118||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨੈਨ ਿਨਹਾਰਉ  ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਸਰ੍ਵਨ  ਸੁਨਉ  ਤੁਅ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer: with my eyes, I see You, Lord; with my ears, I hear Your Name.
lines.transliteration: kabeer nain nihaara-o tujh  ka-o sarvan sun-o t u-a naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਨ ਉਚਰਉ  ਤੁਅ ਨਾਮ ਜੀ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਰਦ ਠਾਉ ॥੧੧੯॥
lines.english: With my tongue I chant Your Name; I enshrine Your Lotus Feet within my heart. ||119||
lines.transliteration: bain uchara-o tu-a naam jee charan kamal rid  thaa-o. ||119||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੁਰਗ  ਨਰਕ  ਤੇ ਮੈ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have been spared from heaven and hell, by the Grace of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: kabeer surag narak tay mai rahi-o sat gur kay parsaad .

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਕੀ ਮਉਜ  ਮਿਹ ਰਹਉ ਅੰਿਤ  ਅਰੁ ਆਿਦ  ॥੧੨੦॥
lines.english: From beginning to end, I abide in the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||120||
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kee ma-uj meh raha-o ant ar aad . ||120||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਕੀ ਮਉਜ  ਕੋ ਕਿਹ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਨਮਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, how can I even describe the extent of the joy of the Lord's Lotus Feet?
lines.transliteration: kabeer charan kamal kee ma-uj ko kahi kaisay unmaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹਬੇ  ਕਉ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖਾ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨੧॥
lines.english: I cannot describe its sublime glory; it has to be seen to be appreciated. ||121||
lines.transliteration: kahibay ka-o sobhaa nahee d aykhaa hee parvaan. ||121||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਦੇਿਖ ਕੈ ਿਕਹ ਕਹਉ  ਕਹੇ ਨ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, how can I describe what I have seen? No one will believe my words.
lines.transliteration: kabeer daykh  kai kih kaha-o kahay na ko pat ee-aa-ay.

lines.english: The Lord is just as He is. I dwell in delight, singing His Glorious Praises. ||122|| pMnw 1371
lines.transliteration: har jaisaa taisaa uhee raha-o harakh  gun gaa-ay. ||122||

lines.english: Kabeer, the flamingo pecks and feeds, and remembers her chicks. She pecks and pecks and feeds, and remembers them always. Her chicks are very dear to her, justlike the love of wealth and Maya is dear to the mortal's mind. ||123||
lines.transliteration: slok, Bgq kbIr jI) kabeer chugai chitaarai bh ee chugai chug chug chit aaray. jaisay bachrahi kooNj man maa-i-aa mamtaa ray. ||123||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਚੁਗੈ ਿਚਤਾਰੈ  ਭੀ ਚੁਗੈ ਚੁਿਗ  ਚੁਿਗ  ਿਚਤਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the sky is overcast and cloudy; the ponds and lakes are overflowing withwater.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ambar ghanhar chh aa-i-aa barakh  bharay sar t aal.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਚਰਿਹ  ਕੂੰਜ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਰੇ ॥੧੨੩॥
lines.english: Like the rainbird, some remain thirsty - what is their condition? ||124||
lines.transliteration: chaatrik ji-o t arsat rahai t in ko ka-un havaal. ||124||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਅੰਬਰ  ਘਨਹਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ  ਬਰਿਖ  ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਤਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the chakvi duck is separated from her love through the night, but in themorning, she meets him again.
lines.transliteration: kabeer chak-ee ja-o nis beechhurai aa-ay milai parbh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਿਤਰ੍ਕ  ਿਜਉ ਤਰਸਤ  ਰਹੈ ਿਤਨ  ਕੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ  ॥੧੨੪॥
lines.english: Those who are separated from the Lord do not meet Him in the day, or in the night.||125||
lines.transliteration: jo nar bichhuray raam si-o naa d in milay na raat . ||125||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਚਕਈ  ਜਉ ਿਨਿਸ  ਬੀਛੁਰੈ  ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੈ ਪਰਭਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer: O conch shell, remain in the ocean.
lines.transliteration: kabeer rainaa-ir bichhori-aa rahu ray sankh  majh oor.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਿਬਛੁਰੇ  ਰਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਨਾ ਿਦਨ ਿਮਲੇ ਨ ਰਾਿਤ  ॥੧੨੫॥
lines.english: If you are separated from it, you shall scream at sunrise from temple to temple.||126||
lines.transliteration: dayval d ayval Dh aahrh ee dayseh ugvat  soor. ||126||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰੈਨਾਇਰ  ਿਬਛੋਿਰਆ  ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਖ ਮਝੂਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Wake up and cry in fear and pain.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sootaa ki-aa karahi jaag ro-ay bh ai dukh.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵਲ  ਦੇਵਲ  ਧਾਹੜੀ  ਦੇਸਿਹ  ਉਗਵਤ  ਸੂਰ ॥੧੨੬॥
lines.english: Those who live in the grave - how can they sleep in peace? ||127||
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa baasaa gor meh so ki-o sovai sukh. ||127||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੂਤਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਜਾਗੁ  ਰੋਇ ਭੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Why not rise up and meditate on the Lord?
lines.transliteration: kabeer sootaa ki-aa karahi uth  ke na jaapeh muraar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਾਸਾ  ਗੋਰ ਮਿਹ ਸੋ ਿਕਉ  ਸੋਵੈ ਸੁਖ ॥੧੨੭॥
lines.english: One day you shall sleep with your legs outstretched. ||128||
lines.transliteration: ik din sovan ho-igo laaNbay god pasaar. ||128||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੂਤਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਉਿਠ ਿਕ ਨ ਜਪਿਹ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what are you doing sleeping? Wake up, and sit up.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sootaa ki-aa karahi baith aa rahu ar jaag.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਿਦਨ ਸੋਵਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ  ਲਬੇ  ਗੋਡ ਪਸਾਿਰ  ॥੧੨੮॥
lines.english: Attach yourself to the One, from whom you have been separated. ||129||
lines.transliteration: jaa kay sang tay beechh uraa t aa hee kay sang laag. ||129||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੂਤਾ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਬੈਠਾ ਰਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਜਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not leave the Society of the Saints; walk upon this Path.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sant kee gail na chh odee-ai maarag laagaa jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਬੀਛੁਰਾ  ਤਾ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਾਗੁ  ॥੧੨੯॥
lines.english: See them, and be sanctified; meet them, and chant the Name. ||130||
lines.transliteration: paykhat  hee punneet  ho-ay bh aytat japee-ai naa-o. ||130||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਗੈਲ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ  ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, do not associate with the faithless cynics; run far away from them.
lines.transliteration: kabeer saakat sang na keejee-ai d ooreh jaa-ee-ai bh aag.

lines.punjabi: ਪੇਖਤ  ਹੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਤ  ਹੋਇ ਭੇਟਤ  ਜਪੀਐ  ਨਾਉ  ॥੧੩੦॥
lines.english: If you touch a vessel stained with soot, some of the soot will stick to you. ||131||
lines.transliteration: baasan kaaro parsee-ai ta-o kachh  laagai d aag. ||131||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ਦੂਰਿਹ  ਜਾਈਐ ਭਾਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, you have not contemplated the Lord, and now old age has overtaken you.
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa raam na chayti-o jaraa pahooNchi-o aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਸਨੁ ਕਾਰੋ ਪਰਸੀਐ  ਤਉ ਕਛੁ ਲਾਗੈ  ਦਾਗੁ  ॥੧੩੧॥
lines.english: Now that the door of your mansion is on fire, what can you take out? ||132||
lines.transliteration: laagee mandir d u-aar t ay ab ki-aa kaadh i-aa jaa-ay. ||132||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਜਰਾ ਪਹੂੰਿਚਓ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Creator does whatever He pleases.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaaran so bha-i-o jo keeno kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਗੀ  ਮੰਿਦਰ  ਦੁਆਰ  ਤੇ ਅਬ ਿਕਆ  ਕਾਿਢਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੩੨॥
lines.english: There is none other than Him; He alone is the Creator of all. ||133||
lines.transliteration: tis bin d oosar ko nahee aykai sirjanhaar. ||133||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੋ ਭਇਓ  ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the fruit trees are bearing fruit, and the mangoes are becoming ripe.
lines.transliteration: kabeer fal laagay falan paakan laagay aaNb.

lines.english: They will reach the owner, only if the crows do not eat them first. ||134||
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay pahoocheh khasam ka-o ja-o beech na kh aahee kaaNb. ||134||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ  ਫਲਿਨ  ਪਾਕਿਨ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਆਂਬ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, some buy idols and worship them; in their stubborn-mindedness, they makepilgrimages to sacred shrines.
lines.transliteration: kabeer thaakur poojeh mol lay manhath  tirath jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਇ  ਪਹੂਚਿਹ ਖਸਮ  ਕਉ ਜਉ ਬੀਿਚ  ਨ ਖਾਹੀ  ਕਬ ॥੧੩੪॥
lines.english: They look at one another, and wear religious robes, but they are deluded and lost.||135||
lines.transliteration: daykh aa daykhee savaaNg Dhar bhoolay bh atkaa kh aahi. ||135||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਿਹ  ਮੋਿਲ ਲੇ ਮਨਹਿਠ ਤੀਰਥ  ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, someone sets up a stone idol and all the world worships it as the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kabeer paahan parmaysur kee-aa poojai sabh sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਗੁ ਧਿਰ  ਭੂਲੇ ਭਟਕਾ  ਖਾਿਹ  ॥੧੩੫॥
lines.english: Those who hold to this belief will be drowned in the river of darkness. ||136||
lines.transliteration: is bharvaasay jo rahay booday kaalee Dh aar. ||136||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਪਾਹਨੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਕੀਆ  ਪੂਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the paper is the prison, and the ink of rituals are the bars on the windows.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaagad kee obree mas kay karam kapaat.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ ਭਰਵਾਸੇ  ਜੋ ਰਹੇ ਬੂਡੇ ਕਾਲੀ  ਧਾਰ ॥੧੩੬॥
lines.english: The stone idols have drowned the world, and the Pandits, the religious scholars, have plundered it on the way. ||137||
lines.transliteration: paahan boree pirathmee pandit paarh ee baat. ||137||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਾਗਦ  ਕੀ ਓਬਰੀ  ਮਸੁ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ  ਕਪਾਟ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, that which you have to do tomorrow - do it today instead; and that which youhave to do now - do it immediately!
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaal karantaa abeh kar ab kart aa su-ay t aal.

lines.english: Later on, you will not be able to do anything, when death hangs over your head.||138||
lines.transliteration: paachhai kachh oo na ho-igaa ja-o sir par aavai kaal. ||138||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਕਰੰਤਾ  ਅਬਿਹ  ਕਰੁ ਅਬ ਕਰਤਾ  ਸੁਇ ਤਾਲ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have seen a person, who is as shiny as washed wax.
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa jant ik d aykhi-aa jaisee Dh o-ee laakh .

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇਗਾ  ਜਉ ਿਸਰ ਪਿਰ ਆਵੈ  ਕਾਲੁ  ॥੧੩੮॥
lines.english: He seems very clever and very virtuous, but in reality, he is without understanding,and corrupt. ||139||
lines.transliteration: deesai chanchal baho gunaa mat  heenaa naapaak. ||139||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਐਸਾ  ਜੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਜੈਸੀ ਧੋਈ ਲਾਖ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Messenger of Death shall not compromise my understanding.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mayree buDh ka-o jam na karai t iskaar.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਸੈ ਚੰਚਲੁ  ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਾ  ਮਿਤ ਹੀਨਾ  ਨਾਪਾਕ  ॥੧੩੯॥
lines.english: I have meditated on the Lord, the Cherisher, who created this Messenger of Death.||140||
lines.transliteration: jin ih jamoo-aa sirji-aa so japi-aa parvidagaar. ||140||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਿਧ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਿਤਸਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Lord is like musk; all His slaves are like bumble bees. pMnw 1372
lines.transliteration: kabeer kastooree bh a-i-aa bh avar bh a-ay sabh  daas.

lines.english: The more Kabeer worships Him, the more the Lord abides within his mind. ||141||
lines.transliteration: ji-o ji-o bhagat  kabeer kee t i-o ti-o raam nivaas. ||141||

lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal has fallen into the grip of family life, and the Lord has been set aside.
lines.transliteration: kabeer gahgach pari-o kutamb kai kaaNthai reh ga-i-o raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗਹਗਿਚ ਪਿਰਓ  ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਕੈ ਕਠੈ ਰਿਹ ਗਇਓ  ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: The messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma descend upon the mortal, in themidst of all his pomp and ceremony. ||142||
lines.transliteration: aa-ay paray Dharam raa-ay kay beecheh Dh oomaa Dh aam. ||142||

lines.punjabi: ਆਇ  ਪਰੇ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੇ ਬੀਚਿਹ  ਧੂਮਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧੪੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, even a pig is better than the faithless cynic; at least the pig keeps the villageclean.
lines.transliteration: kabeer saakat t ay sookar bh alaa raakh ai aachh aa gaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਕਤ  ਤੇ ਸੂਕਰ  ਭਲਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਛਾ  ਗਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: When the wretched, faithless cynic dies, no one even mentions his name. ||143||
lines.transliteration: uho saakat bapuraa mar ga-i-aa ko-ay na laihai naa-o. ||143||

lines.punjabi: ਉਹੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ  ਬਪੁਰਾ  ਮਿਰ ਗਇਆ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲੈਹੈ ਨਾਉ  ॥੧੪੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal gathers wealth, shell by shell, accumulating thousands andmillions.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ka-udee ka-udee jor kai joray laakh karor.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਉਡੀ  ਕਉਡੀ  ਜੋਿਰ ਕੈ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ  ਕਰੋਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: But when the time of his departure comes, he takes nothing at all with him. He iseven stripped of his loin-cloth. ||144||
lines.transliteration: chaltee baar na kachh  mili-o la-ee langotee t or. ||144||

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਤੀ  ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਲਈ ਲੰਗੋਟੀ  ਤੋਿਰ ॥੧੪੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what good is it to become a devotee of Vishnu, and wear four malas?
lines.transliteration: kabeer baisno hoo-aa ta ki-aa bh a-i-aa maalaa mayleeN chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਬੈਸਨੋ  ਹੂਆ ਤ ਿਕਆ  ਭਇਆ  ਮਾਲਾ  ਮੇਲੀਂ  ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: On the outside, he may look like pure gold, but on the inside, he is stuffed with dust. ||145||
lines.transliteration: baahar kanchan baarhaa bheet ar bharee bh angaar. ||145||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬਾਰਹਾ  ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਭਰੀ ਭੰਗਾਰ ॥੧੪੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, let yourself be a pebble on the path; abandon your egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: kabeer rorhaa ho-ay rahu baat kaa t aj man kaa abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਬਾਟ ਕਾ ਤਿਜ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Such a humble slave shall meet the Lord God. ||146||
lines.transliteration: aisaa ko-ee daas ho-ay t aahi milai bh agvaan. ||146||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਕੋਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਿਹ  ਿਮਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੪੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what good would it be, to be a pebble? It would only hurt the traveller on thepath.
lines.transliteration: kabeer rorhaa hoo-aa t a ki-aa bh a-i-aa panthee ka-o d ukh day-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰੋੜਾ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਿਕਆ  ਭਇਆ  ਪੰਥੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Your slave, O Lord, is like the dust of the earth. ||147||
lines.transliteration: aisaa tayraa d aas hai ji-o Dh arnee meh kh ayh. ||147||

lines.punjabi: ਐਸਾ  ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਉ ਧਰਨੀ  ਮਿਹ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੪੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what then, if one could become dust? It is blown up by the wind, and sticksto the body.
lines.transliteration: kabeer khayh hoo-ee t a-o ki-aa bh a-i-aa ja-o ud laagai ang.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਖੇਹ ਹੂਈ ਤਉ ਿਕਆ  ਭਇਆ  ਜਉ ਉਿਡ ਲਾਗੈ  ਅੰਗ  ॥
lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord should be like water, which cleans everything. ||148||
lines.transliteration: har jan aisaa chaahee-ai ji-o paanee sarbang. ||148||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਚਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜਉ  ਪਾਨੀ  ਸਰਬੰਗ  ॥੧੪੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what then, if one could become water? It becomes cold, then hot.
lines.transliteration: kabeer paanee hoo-aa ta ki-aa bh a-i-aa seeraa t aataa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਪਾਨੀ  ਹੂਆ ਤ ਿਕਆ  ਭਇਆ  ਸੀਰਾ  ਤਾਤਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The humble servant of the Lord should be just like the Lord. ||149||
lines.transliteration: har jan aisaa chaahee-ai jaisaa har hee ho-ay. ||149||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ  ਚਾਹੀਐ  ਜੈਸਾ ਹਿਰ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੪੯॥
lines.english: The banners wave above the lofty mansions, filled with gold and beautiful women.
lines.transliteration: ooch bhavan kankaamnee sikh ar Dh ajaa fehraa-ay.

lines.english: But better than these is dry bread, if one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord in theSociety of the Saints. ||150||
lines.transliteration: taa tay bh alee maDh ookree sat sang gun gaa-ay. ||150||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਭਲੀ ਮਧੂਕਰੀ  ਸੰਤਸੰਿਗ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ॥੧੫੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the wilderness is better than a city, if the Lord's devotees live there.
lines.transliteration: kabeer paatan tay oojar bh alaa raam bh agat jih th aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਪਾਟਨ  ਤੇ ਊਜਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ  ਿਜਹ ਠਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Without my Beloved Lord, it is like the City of Death for me. ||151||
lines.transliteration: raam sanayhee baahraa jam pur mayray bhaaN-ay. ||151||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਜਮ ਪੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਇ  ॥੧੫੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, between the Ganges and Jamunaa Rivers, on the shore of Celestial Silence,
lines.transliteration: kabeer gang jamun kay antray sahj sunn kay gh aat.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ  ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰੇ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੁੰਨ ਕੇ ਘਾਟ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tahaa kabeerai mat kee-aa kh ojat mun jan baat. ||152|| there, Kabeer has made his home. The silent sages and the humble servants of theLord search for the way to get there. ||152||

lines.punjabi: ਤਹਾ ਕਬੀਰੈ  ਮਟੁ ਕੀਆ  ਖੋਜਤ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਬਾਟ ॥੧੫੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, if the mortal continues to love the Lord in the end, as he pledged in thebeginning,
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaisee upjee payd tay ja-o t aisee nibhai orh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੈਸੀ ਉਪਜੀ  ਪੇਡ ਤੇ ਜਉ ਤੈਸੀ ਿਨਬਹੈ  ਓਿੜ ॥
lines.transliteration: heeraa kis kaa baapuraa pujeh na ratan karorh . ||153|| no poor diamond, not even millions of jewels, can equal him. ||153||

lines.punjabi: ਹੀਰਾ  ਿਕਸ ਕਾ ਬਾਪੁਰਾ  ਪੁਜਿਹ  ਨ ਰਤਨ  ਕਰੋਿੜ  ॥੧੫੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I saw a strange and wonderful thing. A jewel was being sold in a store.
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa ayk achambha-o d aykhi-o heeraa haat bikaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਏਕੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ  ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਹੀਰਾ  ਹਾਟ ਿਬਕਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Because there was no buyer, it was going in exchange for a shell. ||154||
lines.transliteration: banjanhaaray baahraa ka-udee badlai jaa-ay. ||154||

lines.english: Kabeer, where there is spiritual wisdom, there is righteousness and Dharma. Where there is falsehood, there is sin.
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa jahaa gi-aan tah Dh aram hai jahaa jh ooth tah paap.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਜਹਾ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਤਹ ਧਰਮੁ  ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਹ ਪਾਪੁ ॥
lines.english: Where there is greed, there is death. Where there is forgiveness, there is God Himself.||155||
lines.transliteration: jahaa lobh t ah kaal hai jahaa kh imaa t ah aap. ||155||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਹ ਕਾਲੁ  ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਿਖਮਾ  ਤਹ ਆਿਪ  ॥੧੫੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what good is it to give up Maya, if the mortal does not give up his pride?
lines.transliteration: kabeer maa-i-aa tajee t a ki-aa bh a-i-aa ja-o maan t aji-aa nahee jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਤਜੀ  ਤ ਿਕਆ  ਭਇਆ  ਜਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਜਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Even the silent sages and seers are destroyed by pride; pride eats up everything.||156||
lines.transliteration: maan munee munivar galay maan sabhai ka-o kh aa-ay. ||156||

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਨ ਮੁਨੀ ਮੁਿਨਵਰ  ਗਲੇ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ  ॥੧੫੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the True Guru has met me; He aimed the Arrow of the Shabad at me.
lines.transliteration: kabeer saachaa satgur mai mili-aa sabad  jo baahi-aa ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਿਮਿਲਆ ਸਬਦੁ  ਜੁ ਬਾਿਹਆ  ਏਕੁ ॥
lines.english: As soon as it struck me, I fell to the ground with a hole in my heart. ||157||
lines.transliteration: laagat hee bh u-ay mil ga-i-aa pari-aa kalayjay chh ayk. ||157||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਗਤ  ਹੀ ਭੁਇ ਿਮਿਲ  ਗਇਆ  ਪਿਰਆ  ਕਲੇਜੇ  ਛੇਕੁ ॥੧੫੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, what can the True Guru do, when His Sikhs are at fault?
lines.transliteration: kabeer saachaa satgur ki-aa karai ja-o sikh aa meh chook.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਿਸਖਾ  ਮਿਹ ਚੂਕ ॥
lines.english: The blind do not take in any of His Teachings; it is as useless as blowing into bamboo. ||158||
lines.transliteration: anDhay ayk na laag-ee ji-o baaNs bajaa-ee-ai fook. ||158||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਧੇ ਏਕ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ  ਿਜਉ ਬਸੁ ਬਜਾਈਐ  ਫੂਕ ॥੧੫੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the wife of the king has all sorts of horses, elephants and carriages. pMnw 1373
lines.transliteration: kabeer hai gai baahan saghan gh an chh atarpatee kee naar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਗੈ ਬਾਹਨ  ਸਘਨ  ਘਨ ਛਤਰ੍ਪਤੀ  ਕੀ ਨਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: But she is not equal to the water-carrier of the Lord's humble servant. ||159||
lines.transliteration: taas patant ar na pujai har jan kee panihaar. ||159||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਸੁ ਪਟੰਤਰ  ਨਾ ਪੁਜੈ ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਨਹਾਿਰ  ॥੧੫੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, why do you slander the wife of the king? Why do you honor the slave of the Lord?
lines.transliteration: kabeer nrip naaree ki-o nindee-ai ki-o har chayree ka-o maan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਨਰ੍ਪ ਨਾਰੀ  ਿਕਉ  ਿਨੰਦੀਐ  ਿਕਉ  ਹਿਰ ਚੇਰੀ ਕਉ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Because one combs her hair for corruption, while the other remembers the Name ofthe Lord. ||160||
lines.transliteration: oh maaNg savaarai bikhai ka-o oh simrai har naam. ||160||

lines.punjabi: ਓਹ ਮਗ  ਸਵਾਰੈ  ਿਬਖੈ ਕਉ ਓਹ ਿਸਮਰੈ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧੬੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, with the Support of the Lord's Pillar, I have become steady and stable.
lines.transliteration: kabeer thoonee paa-ee thit bh a-ee sat gur banDh ee Dh eer.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਥੂਨੀ ਪਾਈ  ਿਥਿਤ  ਭਈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬੰਧੀ ਧੀਰ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru has given me courage. Kabeer, I have purchased the diamond, on thebanks of the Mansarovar Lake. ||161||
lines.transliteration: kabeer heeraa banji-aa maan sarovar teer. ||161||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹੀਰਾ  ਬਨਿਜਆ  ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਤੀਰ ॥੧੬੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Lord is the Diamond, and the Lord's humble servant is the jeweller whohas set up his shop.
lines.transliteration: kabeer har heeraa jan ja-uharee lay kai maaNdai haat.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਿਰ ਹੀਰਾ  ਜਨ ਜਉਹਰੀ  ਲੇ ਕੈ ਮਡੈ ਹਾਟ ॥
lines.english: As soon as an appraiser is found, the price of the jewel is set. ||162||
lines.transliteration: jab hee paa-ee-ah paarkhoo t ab heeran kee saat. ||162||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਈਅਿਹ  ਪਾਰਖੂ  ਤਬ ਹੀਰਨ  ਕੀ ਸਾਟ ॥੧੬੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, you remember the Lord in meditation, only when the need arises. You should remember Him all the time.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaam paray har simree-ai aisaa simrahu nit.

lines.english: You shall dwell in the city of immortality, and the Lord shall restore the wealth youlost. ||163||
lines.transliteration: amraa pur baasaa karahu har ga-i-aa bahorai bit. ||163||

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰਾ  ਪੁਰ ਬਾਸਾ  ਕਰਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਗਇਆ  ਬਹੋਰੈ  ਿਬਤ ॥੧੬੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, it is good to perform selfless service for two - the Saints and the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sayvaa ka-o du-ay bh alay ayk sant  ik raam.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਇ ਭਲੇ ਏਕੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Giver of liberation, and the Saint inspires us to chant the Naam. ||164||
lines.transliteration: raam jo daat aa mukat  ko sant  japaavai naam. ||164||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜੁ ਦਾਤਾ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਕੋ ਸੰਤੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧੬੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the crowds follow the path which the Pandits, the religious scholars, havetaken.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jih maarag pandit ga-ay paachh ai paree baheer.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਜਹ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਗਏ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੀ ਬਹੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: There is a difficult and treacherous cliff on that path to the Lord; Kabeer is climbingthat cliff. ||165||
lines.transliteration: ik avghat gh aatee raam kee t ih charh  rahi-o kabeer. ||165||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਅਵਘਟ  ਘਾਟੀ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਿਤਹ ਚਿੜ ਰਿਹਓ  ਕਬੀਰ  ॥੧੬੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal dies of his worldly troubles and pain, after worrying about hisfamily.
lines.transliteration: kabeer dunee-aa kay d okhay moo-aa chaalat  kul kee kaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਕੇ ਦੋਖੇ ਮੂਆ ਚਾਲਤ  ਕੁਲ ਕੀ ਕਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Whose family is dishonored, when he is placed on the funeral pyre? ||166||
lines.transliteration: tab kul kis kaa laajsee jab lay Dh areh masaan. ||166||

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਕੁਲੁ ਿਕਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਜਸੀ  ਜਬ ਲੇ ਧਰਿਹ  ਮਸਾਿਨ  ॥੧੬੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, you shall drown, you wretched being, from worrying about what other peoplethink.
lines.transliteration: kabeer doob-higo ray baapuray baho logan kee kaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਡੂਬਿਹਗੋ  ਰੇ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ  ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ  ਕੀ ਕਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: You know that whatever happens to your neighbors, will also happen to you. ||167||
lines.transliteration: paarosee kay jo hoo-aa too apnay bh ee jaan. ||167||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰੋਸੀ  ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹੂਆ ਤੂ ਅਪਨੇ  ਭੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧੬੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, even dry bread, made of various grains, is good.
lines.transliteration: kabeer bhalee maDh ookree naanaa biDh  ko naaj.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਭਲੀ ਮਧੂਕਰੀ  ਨਾਨਾ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੋ ਨਾਜੁ ॥
lines.english: No one brags about it, throughout the vast country and great empire. ||168||
lines.transliteration: daavaa kaahoo ko nahee badaa d ays bad raaj. ||168||

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਵਾ  ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਡਾ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਡ ਰਾਜੁ ॥੧੬੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those who brag, shall burn. Those who do not brag remain carefree.
lines.transliteration: kabeer daavai d aajhan hot  hai nird aavai rahai nisank.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਦਾਵੈ ਦਾਝਨੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਿਨਰਦਾਵੈ  ਰਹੈ ਿਨਸੰਕ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being who does not brag, looks upon the gods and the poor alike.||169||
lines.transliteration: jo jan nirdaavai rahai so ganai ind ar so rank. ||169||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਿਨਰਦਾਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਗਨੈ ਇੰਦਰ੍  ਸੋ ਰੰਕ ॥੧੬੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the pool is filled to overflowing, but no one can drink the water from it.
lines.transliteration: kabeer paal samuhaa sarvar bharaa pee na sakai ko-ee neer.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਪਾਿਲ  ਸਮੁਹਾ  ਸਰਵਰੁ ਭਰਾ ਪੀ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, you have found it; drink it in handfuls, O Kabeer. ||170||
lines.transliteration: bhaag baday t ai paa-i-o t ooN bhar bhar pee-o kabeer. ||170||

lines.punjabi: ਭਾਗ ਬਡੇ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ  ਤੂੰ ਭਿਰ ਭਿਰ ਪੀਉ ਕਬੀਰ  ॥੧੭੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, just as the stars disappear at dawn, so shall this body disappear.
lines.transliteration: kabeer parbhaat ay taaray kh iseh t i-o ih kh isai sareer.

lines.english: Only the letters of God's Name do not disappear; Kabeer holds these tight. ||171||
lines.transliteration: ay du-ay akh ar naa kh iseh so geh rahi-o kabeer. ||171||

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਦੁਇ ਅਖਰ  ਨਾ ਿਖਸਿਹ  ਸੋ ਗਿਹ ਰਿਹਓ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੧੭੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the wooden house is burning on all sides.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kothee kaath  kee d ah dis laagee aag.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੋਠੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਦਹ ਿਦਿਸ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਆਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, have been burnt to death, while the illiterate ones run to safety. ||172||
lines.transliteration: pandit pandit  jal moo-ay moorakh  ubray bh aag. ||172||

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਿਡਤ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਜਿਲ  ਮੂਏ ਮੂਰਖ ਉਬਰੇ  ਭਾਿਗ  ॥੧੭੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, give up your skepticism; let your papers float away.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sansaa door kar kaagad  dayh bihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰੁ ਕਾਗਦ  ਦੇਹ ਿਬਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Find the essence of the letters of the alphabet, and focus your consciousness on theLord. ||173||
lines.transliteration: baavan akhar soDh  kai har charnee chit  laa-ay. ||173||

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਵਨ  ਅਖਰ ਸੋਿਧ ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥੧੭੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Saint does not forsake his Saintly nature, even though he meets withmillions of evil-doers.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sant na chh aadai sant -ee ja-o kotik mileh asant .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਛਾਡੈ ਸੰਤਈ  ਜਉ ਕੋਿਟਕ  ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਅਸੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: Even when sandalwood is surrounded by snakes, it does not give up its coolingfragrance. ||174||
lines.transliteration: mali-aagar bhuyangam baydh i-o ta seet altaa na t ajant. ||174||

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਲਆਗਰ ੁ ਭੁਯੰਗਮ  ਬੇਿਢਓ  ਤ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ  ਨ ਤਜੰਤ  ॥੧੭੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, my mind is cooled and soothed; I have become God-conscious.
lines.transliteration: kabeer man seetal bh a-i-aa paa-i-aa barahm gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਭਇਆ  ਪਾਇਆ ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The fire which has burnt the world is like water to the Lord's humble servant. ||175||
lines.transliteration: jin ju-aalaa jag jaari-aa so jan kay udak samaan. ||175||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜੁਆਲਾ  ਜਗੁ ਜਾਿਰਆ  ਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਉਦਕ  ਸਮਾਿਨ  ॥੧੭੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, no one knows the Play of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: kabeer saaree sirjanhaar kee jaanai naahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਾਰੀ  ਿਸਰਜਨਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Only the Lord Himself and the slaves at His Court understand it. ||176||
lines.transliteration: kai jaanai aapan Dhanee kai d aas d eevaanee ho-ay. ||176||

lines.punjabi: ਕੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਨ  ਧਨੀ ਕੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਦੀਵਾਨੀ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧੭੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, it is good that I feel the Fear of God; I have forgotten everything else. pMnw 1374
lines.transliteration: kabeer bhalee bh a-ee jo bh a-o pari-aa d isaa ga-eeN sabh  bhool.

lines.english: The hail-stone has melted into water, and flowed into the ocean. ||177||
lines.transliteration: oraa gar paanee bha-i-aa jaa-ay mili-o dh al kool. ||177||

lines.punjabi: ਓਰਾ ਗਿਰ ਪਾਨੀ  ਭਇਆ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਮਿਲਓ  ਢਿਲ  ਕੂਿਲ  ॥੧੭੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the body is a pile of dust, collected and packed together.
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa Dhoor sakayl kai puree-aa baaNDhee dayh.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਧੂਿਰ ਸਕੇਿਲ  ਕੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ  ਬਧੀ  ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: It is a show which lasts for only a few days, and then dust returns to dust. ||178||
lines.transliteration: divas chaar ko paykh naa ant  khayh kee kh ayh. ||178||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਵਸ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਕੋ ਪੇਖਨਾ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਖੇਹ ਕੀ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੭੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, bodies are like the rising and setting of the sun and the moon.
lines.transliteration: kabeer sooraj chaaNd kai ud ai bha-ee sabh  dayh.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸੂਰਜ  ਚਦ  ਕੈ ਉਦੈ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: Without meeting the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, they are all reduced to dust again. ||179||
lines.transliteration: gur gobind kay bin milay palat bh a-ee sabh  khayh. ||179||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਕੇ ਿਬਨੁ ਿਮਲੇ ਪਲਿਟ  ਭਈ ਸਭ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੭੯॥
lines.english: Where the Fearless Lord is, there is no fear; where there is fear, the Lord is not there.
lines.transliteration: jah anbha-o t ah bh ai nahee jah bh a-o tah har naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਅਨਭਉ  ਤਹ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਹ ਭਉ ਤਹ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer speaks after careful consideration; hear this, O Saints, in your minds. ||180||
lines.transliteration: kahi-o kabeer bichaar kai sant sunhu man maahi. ||180||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹਓ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਬਚਾਿਰ  ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧੮੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those who do not know anything, pass their lives in peaceful sleep.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jinahu kichhoo jaani-aa nahee t in sukh  need  bihaa-ay.

lines.english: But I have understood the riddle; I am faced with all sorts of troubles. ||181||
lines.transliteration: hamhu jo boojhaa boojh naa pooree paree balaa-ay. ||181||

lines.punjabi: ਹਮਹੁ ਜੁ ਬੂਝਾ ਬੂਝਨਾ  ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ਬਲਾਇ  ॥੧੮੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those who are beaten cry a lot; but the cries of the pain of separation are different.
lines.transliteration: kabeer maaray bahut pukaari-aa peer pukaarai a-or.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਾਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਿਰਆ  ਪੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ  ਅਉਰ  ॥
lines.english: Struck by the Mystery of God, Kabeer remains silent. ||182||
lines.transliteration: laagee chot maramm kee rahi-o kabeeraa tha-ur. ||182||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਗੀ  ਚੋਟ ਮਰੰਮ  ਕੀ ਰਿਹਓ  ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਠਉਰ  ॥੧੮੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the stroke of a lance is easy to bear; it takes away the breath.
lines.transliteration: kabeer chot suhaylee sayl kee laagat lay-ay usaas.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚੋਟ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ  ਸੇਲ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਤ  ਲੇਇ ਉਸਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: But one who endures the stroke of the Word of the Shabad is the Guru, and I am hisslave. ||183||
lines.transliteration: chot sahaarai sabad kee t aas guroo mai d aas. ||183||

lines.punjabi: ਚੋਟ ਸਹਾਰੈ  ਸਬਦ  ਕੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਦਾਸ ॥੧੮੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer: O Mullah, why do you climb to the top of the minaret? The Lord is not hard ofhearing.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mulaaN munaaray ki-aa chadheh saaN-ee na bahraa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਲ  ਮੁਨਾਰੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਚਢਿਹ  ਸਈ  ਨ ਬਹਰਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Look within your own heart for the One, for whose sake you shout your prayers. ||184||
lines.transliteration: jaa kaaran tooN baaNg deh dil hee bh eetar jo-ay. ||184||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਿਨ  ਤੂੰ ਬਗ  ਦੇਿਹ ਿਦਲ  ਹੀ ਭੀਤਿਰ  ਜੋਇ ॥੧੮੪॥
lines.english: Why does the Shaykh bother to go on pilgrimage to Mecca, if he is not content withhimself?
lines.transliteration: saykh sabooree baahraa ki-aa haj kaabay jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਖ ਸਬੂਰੀ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਿਕਆ  ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, one whose heart is not healthy and whole - how can he attain his Lord?||185||
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaa kee dil saabat  nahee t aa ka-o kahaaN khudaa-ay. ||185||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਿਦਲ  ਸਾਬਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹ ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥੧੮੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, worship the Lord Allah; meditating in remembrance on Him, troubles andpains depart.
lines.transliteration: kabeer alah kee kar bandagee jih simrat  dukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਅਲਹ  ਕੀ ਕਿਰ ਬੰਦਗੀ  ਿਜਹ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord shall be revealed within your own heart, and the burning fire within shall beextinguished by His Name. ||186||
lines.transliteration: dil meh saaN-ee pargatai bujh ai balant ee naaN-ay. ||186||

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਲ  ਮਿਹ ਸਈ  ਪਰਗਟੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਲੰਤੀ  ਨਇ  ॥੧੮੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, to use force is tyranny, even if you call it legal.
lines.transliteration: kabeer joree kee-ay julam hai kahtaa naa-o halaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੋਰੀ ਕੀਏ ਜੁਲਮੁ  ਹੈ ਕਹਤਾ  ਨਾਉ  ਹਲਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: When your account is called for in the Court of the Lord, what will your condition bethen? ||187||
lines.transliteration: daftar laykh aa maaNgee-ai t ab ho-igo ka-un havaal. ||187||

lines.punjabi: ਦਫਤਿਰ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਮਗੀਐ ਤਬ ਹੋਇਗੋ  ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ  ॥੧੮੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the dinner of beans and rice is excellent, if it is flavored with salt.
lines.transliteration: kabeer khoob kh aanaa kh eechree jaa meh amrit  lon.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਖੂਬੁ ਖਾਨਾ  ਖੀਚਰੀ  ਜਾ ਮਿਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਲੋਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Who would cut his throat, to have meat with his bread? ||188||
lines.transliteration: hayraa rotee kaarnay galaa kataavai ka-un. ||188||

lines.punjabi: ਹੇਰਾ ਰੋਟੀ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਗਲਾ  ਕਟਾਵੈ  ਕਉਨੁ ॥੧੮੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, one is known to have been touched by the Guru, only when his emotionalattachment and physical illnesses are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: kabeer gur laagaa tab jaanee-ai mitai moh t an taap.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗੁਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ  ਤਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ  ਿਮਟੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਪ ॥
lines.english: He is not burned by pleasure or pain, and so he becomes the Lord Himself. ||189||
lines.transliteration: harakh sog d aajhai nahee t ab har aapeh aap. ||189||

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖ  ਸੋਗ ਦਾਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਤਬ ਹਿਰ ਆਪਿਹ  ਆਿਪ  ॥੧੮੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, it does make a difference, how you chant the Lord's Name, 'Raam'. This issomething to consider.
lines.transliteration: kabeer raam kahan meh bhayd  hai taa meh ayk bichaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ  ਮਿਹ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਮਿਹ ਏਕੁ ਿਬਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Everyone uses the same word for the son of Dasrath and the Wondrous Lord. ||190||
lines.transliteration: so-ee raam sabhai kaheh so-ee ka-ut akhaar. ||190||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਹਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਕਉਤਕਹਾਰ  ॥੧੯੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, use the word 'Raam', only to speak of the All-pervading Lord. You must makethat distinction.
lines.transliteration: kabeer raamai raam kaho kahibay maahi bibayk.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਹਬੇ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਬਬੇਕ  ॥
lines.english: One 'Raam' is pervading everywhere, while the other is contained only in himself.||191||
lines.transliteration: ayk anaykeh mil ga-i-aa ayk samaanaa ayk. ||191||

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕਿਹ  ਿਮਿਲ ਗਇਆ  ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ  ਏਕ ॥੧੯੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those houses in which neither the Holy nor the Lord are served
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaa ghar saaDh  na sayvee-ah har kee sayvaa naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਾ ਘਰ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਸੇਵੀਅਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tay gh ar marhat saarkh ay bh oot baseh t in maahi. ||192|| - those houses are like cremation grounds; demons dwell within them. ||192||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਘਰ ਮਰਹਟ  ਸਾਰਖੇ  ਭੂਤ ਬਸਿਹ  ਿਤਨ  ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੧੯੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I have become mute, insane and deaf.
lines.transliteration: kabeer goongaa hoo-aa baavraa bahraa hoo-aa kaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਗੂੰਗਾ  ਹੂਆ ਬਾਵਰਾ  ਬਹਰਾ  ਹੂਆ ਕਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: I am crippled - the True Guru has pierced me with His Arrow. ||193||
lines.transliteration: paavhu tay pingul bh a-i-aa maari-aa sat gur baan. ||193||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇ ਿਪੰਗੁਲ  ਭਇਆ  ਮਾਿਰਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਬਾਨ ॥੧੯੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the True Guru, the Spiritual Warrior, has shot me with His Arrow.
lines.transliteration: kabeer satgur soormay baahi-aa baan jo ayk.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੂਰਮੇ  ਬਾਿਹਆ  ਬਾਨੁ ਜੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
lines.english: As soon as it struck me, I fell to the ground, with a hole in my heart. ||194||
lines.transliteration: laagat hee bh u-ay gir pari-aa paraa karayjay chh ayk. ||194||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਗਤ  ਹੀ ਭੁਇ ਿਗਿਰ  ਪਿਰਆ  ਪਰਾ ਕਰੇਜੇ  ਛੇਕੁ ॥੧੯੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, onto the dirty ground. pMnw 1375
lines.transliteration: kabeer nirmal boond akaas kee par ga-ee bh oom bikaar.

lines.english: You must acknowledge this, that without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, it turns into burnt ashes. ||195||
lines.transliteration: bin sangat i-o maaNn-ee ho-ay ga-ee bh ath chhaar. ||195||

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਇਉ ਮਨਈ  ਹੋਇ ਗਈ ਭਠ ਛਾਰ ॥੧੯੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, and mixes with the dust.
lines.transliteration: kabeer nirmal boond akaas kee leenee bh oom milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਬੂੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ  ਕੀ ਲੀਨੀ  ਭੂਿਮ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of clever people may try, but they will fail - it cannot be made separate again.||196||
lines.transliteration: anik si-aanay pach ga-ay naa nirvaaree jaa-ay. ||196||

lines.english: Kabeer, I was going on a pilgrimage to Mecca, and God met me on the way.
lines.transliteration: kabeer haj kaabay ha-o jaa-ay thaa aagai mili-aa khud aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਇ  ਥਾ ਆਗੈ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He scolded me and asked, "Who told you that I am only there?"||197||
lines.transliteration: saaN-ee mujh si-o lar pari-aa t ujhai kiniH furmaa-ee gaa-ay. ||197||

lines.punjabi: ਸਈ  ਮੁਝ ਿਸਉ ਲਿਰ ਪਿਰਆ ਤੁਝੈ  ਿਕਿਨ  ਫੁਰਮਾਈ  ਗਾਇ  ॥੧੯੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I went to Mecca - how many times, Kabeer?
lines.transliteration: kabeer haj kaabai ho-ay ho-ay ga-i-aa kaytee baar kabeer.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ  ਕੇਤੀ  ਬਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, what is the problem with me? You have not spoken to me with Your Mouth. ||198||
lines.transliteration: saaN-ee mujh meh ki-aa kh ataa mukh ahu na bolai peer. ||198||

lines.punjabi: ਸਈ  ਮੁਝ ਮਿਹ ਿਕਆ  ਖਤਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧੯੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, they oppress living beings and kill them, and call it proper.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jee-a jo maareh jor kar kahtay heh jo halaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੀਅ  ਜੁ ਮਾਰਿਹ  ਜੋਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਕਹਤੇ  ਹਿਹ ਜੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord calls for their account, what will their condition be? ||199||
lines.transliteration: daftar da-ee jab kaadh  hai ho-igaa ka-un havaal. ||199||

lines.punjabi: ਦਫਤਰੁ ਦਈ ਜਬ ਕਾਿਢ  ਹੈ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ  ॥੧੯੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, it is tyranny to use force; the Lord shall call you to account.
lines.transliteration: kabeer jor kee-aa so julam hai lay-ay jabaab khud aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੋਰੁ ਕੀਆ  ਸੋ ਜੁਲਮੁ  ਹੈ ਲੇਇ ਜਬਾਬੁ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: When your account is called for, your face and mouth shall be beaten. ||200||
lines.transliteration: daftar laykh aa neeksai maar muhai muhi kh aa-ay. ||200||

lines.punjabi: ਦਫਤਿਰ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਨੀਕਸੈ  ਮਾਰ ਮੁਹੈ ਮੁਿਹ ਖਾਇ  ॥੨੦੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, it is easy to render your account, if your heart is pure.
lines.transliteration: kabeer laykhaa d aynaa suhaylaa ja-o d il soochee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਲੇਖਾ  ਦੇਨਾ  ਸੁਹੇਲਾ  ਜਉ ਿਦਲ  ਸੂਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: In the True Court of the Lord, no one will seize you. ||201||
lines.transliteration: us saachay deebaan meh palaa na pakrai ko-ay. ||201||

lines.punjabi: ਉਸੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੀਬਾਨ  ਮਿਹ ਪਲਾ  ਨ ਪਕਰੈ  ਕੋਇ ॥੨੦੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer: O duality, you are mighty and powerful in the earth and the sky.
lines.transliteration: kabeer Dhart ee ar aakaas meh d u-ay t ooN baree abaDh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਅਰੁ ਆਕਾਸ  ਮਿਹ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰ ਬਰੀ ਅਬਧ  ॥
lines.english: The six Shaastras and the eighty-four Siddhas are entrenched in skepticism. ||202||
lines.transliteration: khat d arsan sansay paray ar cha-oraaseeh siDh . ||202||

lines.punjabi: ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ  ਸੰਸੇ ਪਰੇ ਅਰੁ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਿਸਧ ॥੨੦੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, nothing is mine within myself. Whatever there is, is Yours, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: kabeer mayraa mujh meh kichh  nahee jo kichh  hai so t ayraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮੇਰਾ ਮੁਝ ਮਿਹ ਿਕਛੁ  ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.english: If I surrender to You what is already Yours, what does it cost me? ||203||
lines.transliteration: tayraa t ujh ka-o sa-upat ay ki-aa laagai mayraa. ||203||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਸਉਪਤੇ  ਿਕਆ  ਲਾਗੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨੦੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, repeating, "You, You", I have become like You. Nothing of me remains in myself.
lines.transliteration: kabeer tooN tooN kartaa too hoo-aa mujh  meh rahaa na hooN.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ  ਤੂ ਹੂਆ ਮੁਝ ਮਿਹ ਰਹਾ ਨ ਹੂੰ ॥
lines.english: When the difference between myself and others is removed, then wherever I look, Isee only You. ||204||
lines.transliteration: jab aapaa par kaa mit ga-i-aa jat d aykh-a-u t at too. ||204||

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਆਪਾ  ਪਰ ਕਾ ਿਮਿਟ  ਗਇਆ  ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ  ਤਤ ਤੂ ॥੨੦੪॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those who think of evil and entertain false hopes
lines.transliteration: kabeer bikaareh chitvat ay jhoothay kart ay aas.
manorath ko-ay na poori-o chaalay ooth niraas. ||205|| - none of their desires shall be fulfilled; they shall depart in despair. ||205||

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੋਰਥੁ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੂਿਰਓ  ਚਾਲੇ  ਊਿਠ ਿਨਰਾਸ  ॥੨੦੫॥
lines.english: Kabeer, whoever meditates in remembrance on the Lord, he alone is happy in thisworld.
lines.transliteration: kabeer har kaa simran jo karai so sukhee-aa sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: One who is protected and saved by the Creator Lord, shall never waver, here or hereafter. ||206||
lines.transliteration: it ut kateh na dol-ee jis raakh ai sirjanhaar. ||206||

lines.punjabi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਿਹ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ  ਿਜਸ ਰਾਖੈ ਿਸਰਜਨਹਾਰ  ॥੨੦੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I was being crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press, but the True Gurusaved me.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ghaan ee peerh -tay sat gur lee-ay chh adaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਘਾਣੀ  ਪੀੜਤੇ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My pre-ordained primal destiny has now been revealed. ||207||
lines.transliteration: paraa poorablee bhaavnee pargat ho-ee aa-ay. ||207||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਆਇ  ॥੨੦੭॥
lines.english: Kabeer, my days have passed, and I have postponed my payments; the interest onmy account continues to increase.
lines.transliteration: kabeer taalai tolai din ga-i-aa bi-aaj badh anta-o jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਟਾਲੈ  ਟੋਲੈ ਿਦਨੁ ਗਇਆ  ਿਬਆਜੁ  ਬਢੰਤਉ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I have not meditated on the Lord and my account is still pending, and now, themoment of my death has come! ||208|| mhlw 5 ] (1375-15) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naa har bhaji-o na kh at fati-o kaal pahooNcho aa-ay. ||208||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਿਜਓ  ਨ ਖਤੁ ਫਿਟਓ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਪਹੂੰਚੋ ਆਇ  ॥੨੦੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal is a barking dog, chasing after a carcass.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kookar bha-ukanaa karang pichh ai uth  Dhaa-ay.

lines.english: By the Grace of good karma, I have found the True Guru, who has saved me. ||209|| mhlw 5 ] (1375-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: karmee satgur paa-i-aa jin ha-o lee-aa chh adaa-ay. ||209||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੂਕਰੁ ਭਉਕਨਾ  ਕਰੰਗ  ਿਪਛੈ ਉਿਠ ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but it is being occupied by thieves.
lines.transliteration: kabeer Dhart ee saaDh  kee t askar baiseh gaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹਉ ਲੀਆ  ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੨੦੯॥
lines.english: Dhart ee bh aar na bi-aapa-ee un ka-o laahoo laahi. ||210|| They are not a burden to the earth; they receive its blessings. ||210|| mhlw 5 ] (1375-17) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
Kabeer, the rice is beaten with a mallet to get rid of the husk.
lines.transliteration: kabeer chaaval kaarnay tukh  ka-o muhlee laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ  ਬੈਸਿਹ  ਗਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: When people sit in evil company, the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls them toaccount. ||211||
lines.transliteration: sang kusangee baistay t ab poochh ai Dharam raa-ay. ||211||

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਤੀ  ਭਾਿਰ  ਨ ਿਬਆਪਈ  ਉਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਹੂ ਲਾਿਹ  ॥੨੧੦॥
lines.english: Trilochan says, O Naam Dayv, Maya has enticed you, my friend.
lines.transliteration: naamaa maa-i-aa mohi-aa kahai tilochan meet .

lines.english: Why are you printing designs on these sheets, and not focusing your consciousnesson the Lord? ||212||
lines.transliteration: kaahay chheepahu chh aa-ilai raam na laavhu cheet . ||212||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਚਾਵਲ  ਕਾਰਨੇ  ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Naam Dayv answers, O Trilochan, chant the Lord's Name with your mouth. pMnw 1376
lines.transliteration: naamaa kahai tilochanaa mukh  tay raam samHaal.

lines.english: With your hands and feet, do all your work, but let your consciousness remain with the Immaculate Lord. ||213|| mhlw 5 ] (1376-1) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: haath paa-o kar kaam sabh cheet  niranjan naal. ||213||

lines.punjabi: ਹਾਥ ਪਾਉ ਕਿਰ ਕਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਚੀਤੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੨੧੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, no one belongs to me, and I belong to no one else.
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa hamraa ko nahee ham kis hoo kay naahi.

lines.english: The One who created the creation - into Him I shall be absorbed. ||214||
lines.transliteration: jin ih rachan rachaa-i-aa tis hee maahi samaahi. ||214||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰਾ  ਹਮਰਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਿਕਸ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the flour has fallen into the mud; nothing has come into my hands.
lines.transliteration: kabeer keecharh aataa gir pari-aa kichh oo na aa-i-o haath.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ  ਿਤਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਹ ॥੨੧੪॥
lines.english: That which was eaten while it was being ground - that alone is of any use. ||215||
lines.transliteration: peesat peesat  chaabi-aa so-ee nibhi-aa saath. ||215||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੀਚਿੜ  ਆਟਾ  ਿਗਿਰ  ਪਿਰਆ  ਿਕਛੂ  ਨ ਆਇਓ  ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal knows everything, and knowing, he still makes mistakes.
lines.transliteration: kabeer man jaanai sabh baat  jaanat  hee a-ugan karai.

lines.english: What good is a lamp in one's hand, if he falls into the well? ||216||
lines.transliteration: kaahay kee kuslaat haath d eep koo-ay parai. ||216||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਮਨੁਜਾਨੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨਤ  ਹੀ ਅਉਗਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I am in love with the All-knowing Lord; the ignorant ones try to hold me back.
lines.transliteration: kabeer laagee pareet sujaan si-o barjai log ajaan.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੀ ਕੁਸਲਾਤ  ਹਾਿਥ ਦੀਪੁ ਕੂਏ ਪਰੈ ॥੨੧੬॥
lines.english: How could I ever break with the One, who owns our soul and breath of life. ||217||
lines.transliteration: taa si-o tootee ki-o banai jaa kay jee-a paraan. ||217||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਲਾਗੀ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਸੁਜਾਨ  ਿਸਉ ਬਰਜੈ  ਲੋਗੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, why kill yourself for your love of decorations of your home and mansion?
lines.transliteration: kabeer kothay mandap hayt  kar kaahay marahu savaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਟੂਟੀ ਿਕਉ  ਬਨੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ  ਪਰਾਨ  ॥੨੧੭॥
lines.english: In the end, only six feet, or a little more, shall be your lot. ||218||
lines.transliteration: kaaraj saadhay t een hath gh anee t a pa-unay chaar. ||218||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ  ਹੇਤੁ ਕਿਰ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, whatever I wish for does not happen. What can I accomplish by merely thinking?
lines.transliteration: kabeer jo mai chitva-o naa karai ki-aa mayray chit vay ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਸਾਢੇ ਤੀਿਨ  ਹਥ ਘਨੀ  ਤ ਪਉਨੇ  ਚਾਿਰ  ॥੨੧੮॥
lines.english: The Lord does whatever He wishes; it is not up to me at all. ||219|| mÚ 3 ] (1376-8) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: apnaa chitvi-aa har karai jo mayray chit  na ho-ay. ||219||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜੋ ਮੈ ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਨਾ ਕਰੈ ਿਕਆ  ਮੇਰੇ ਿਚਤਵੇ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: God Himself makes the mortals anxious, and He Himself takes the anxiety away.
lines.transliteration: chintaa bh e aap karaa-isee achint  bhe aapay d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨਾ  ਿਚਤਿਵਆ ਹਿਰ ਕਰੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੧੯॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the One, who takes care of all. ||220|| mÚ 5 ] (1376-9) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak so salaahee-ai je sabhnaa saar karay-i. ||220||

lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal does not remember the Lord; he wanders around, engrossed in greed.
lines.transliteration: kabeer raam na chayti-o firi-aa laalach maahi.

lines.english: Committing sins, he dies, and his life ends in an instant. ||221||
lines.transliteration: paap karantaa mar ga-i-aa a-oDh  punee kh in maahi. ||221||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਿਜ ਸਭਨਾ  ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੨੨੦॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the body is like a clay vessel or a brittle metal pot.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaa-i-aa kaachee kaarvee kayval kaachee Dhaat .

lines.english: If you wish to keep it safe and sound, then vibrate and meditate on the Lord;otherwise, the thing shall break. ||222||
lines.transliteration: saabat rakh eh ta raam bh aj naahi t a binth ee baat . ||222||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਿਫਿਰਆ  ਲਾਲਚ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, chant the Name of the Beautifully-haired Lord; do not sleep unaware.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kayso kayso kookee-ai na so-ee-ai asaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੰਤਾ  ਮਿਰ ਗਇਆ  ਅਉਧ  ਪੁਨੀ ਿਖਨ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨੨੧॥
lines.english: Chanting His Name night and day, the Lord will eventually hear your call. ||223||
lines.transliteration: raat d ivas kay kooknay kabhoo kay sunai pukaar. ||223||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਾਚੀ  ਕਾਰਵੀ  ਕੇਵਲ ਕਾਚੀ  ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the body is a banana forest, and the mind is an intoxicated elephant.
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaa-i-aa kajlee ban bha-i-aa man kunchar ma-y mant .

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਬਤੁ  ਰਖਿਹ  ਤ ਰਾਮ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ਤ ਿਬਨਠੀ  ਬਾਤ ॥੨੨੨॥
lines.english: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is the prod, and the rare Saint is the rider. ||224||
lines.transliteration: ankas ga-yaan ratan hai kh ayvat birlaa sant . ||224||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕੇਸੋ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੂਕੀਐ  ਨ ਸੋਈਐ ਅਸਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Lord's Name is the jewel, and the mouth is the purse; open this purse tothe Appraiser.
lines.transliteration: kabeer raam ratan mukh  kothree paarakh  aagai kh ol.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਿਤ  ਿਦਵਸ  ਕੇ ਕੂਕਨੇ  ਕਬਹੂ ਕੇ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥੨੨੩॥
lines.english: If a buyer can be found, it will go for a high price. ||225||
lines.transliteration: ko-ee aa-ay milaigo gaahkee laygo mahgay mol. ||225||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਕਾਇਆ  ਕਜਲੀ  ਬਨੁ ਭਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਮਯ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal does not know the Lord's Name, but he has raised a very largefamily.
lines.transliteration: kabeer raam naam jaani-o nahee paali-o katak kutamb.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਕਸੁ  ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਿਬਰਲਾ  ਸੰਤੁ ॥੨੨੪॥
lines.english: DhanDh ay hee meh mar ga-i-o baahar bh a-ee na bamb. ||226|| He dies in the midst of his worldly affairs, and then he is not heard in the externalworld. ||226||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਕੋਥਰੀ  ਪਾਰਖ ਆਗੈ  ਖੋਿਲ ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, in the blink of an eye, moment by moment, life is passing by.
lines.transliteration: kabeer aakhee kayray maatukay pal pal ga-ee bihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਈ ਆਇ  ਿਮਲੈਗੋ  ਗਾਹਕੀ  ਲੇਗੋ ਮਹਗੇ  ਮੋਿਲ ॥੨੨੫॥
lines.english: The mortal does not give up his worldly entanglements; the Messenger of Death walksin and beats the drum. ||227||
lines.transliteration: man janjaal na chhod-ee jam d ee-aa d amaamaa aa-ay. ||227||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਿਨਓ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਿਲਓ  ਕਟਕੁ  ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Lord is the tree, and disillusionment with the world is the fruit.
lines.transliteration: kabeer tarvar roopee raam hai fal roopee bairaag.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਧੇ ਹੀ ਮਿਹ ਮਿਰ ਗਇਓ  ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਭਈ ਨ ਬੰਬ ॥੨੨੬॥
lines.english: The Holy man, who has abandoned useless arguments, is the shade of the tree.||228||
lines.transliteration: chhaa-i-aa roopee saaDh  hai jin t aji-aa baad  bibaad . ||228||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਆਖੀ  ਕੇਰੇ ਮਾਟੁਕੇ ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਗਈ ਿਬਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, plant the seeds of such a plant, which shall bear fruit throughout the twelvemonths,
lines.transliteration: kabeer aisaa beej bo-ay baarah maas falant.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ  ਨ ਛੋਡਈ  ਜਮ ਦੀਆ  ਦਮਾਮਾ  ਆਇ  ॥੨੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: seetal chh aa-i-aa gahir fal pankh ee kayl karant . ||229|| with cooling shade and abundant fruit, upon which birds joyously play. ||229||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਤਰਵਰ  ਰੂਪੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਫਲ ਰੂਪੀ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Great Giver is the tree, which blesses all with the fruit of compassion.
lines.transliteration: kabeer daat aa tarvar d a-yaa fal upkaaree jeevant .

lines.punjabi: ਛਾਇਆ  ਰੂਪੀ ਸਾਧੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਤਿਜਆ  ਬਾਦੁ ਿਬਬਾਦੁ  ॥੨੨੮॥
lines.english: When the birds migrate to other lands, O Tree, you bear the fruits. ||230||
lines.transliteration: pankhee chalay d isaavaree birkh aa sufal falant . ||230||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਐਸਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੋਇ ਬਾਰਹ  ਮਾਸ ਫਲੰਤ  ॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the mortal finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, if he has such destiny written upon his forehead. pMnw 1377
lines.transliteration: kabeer saaDhoo sang paraapat ee likh i-aa ho-ay lilaat.

lines.english: He obtains the treasure of liberation, and the difficult road to the Lord is not blocked. ||231||
lines.transliteration: mukat pad aarath paa-ee-ai th aak na avgh at ghaat. ||231||

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਠਾਕ ਨ ਅਵਘਟ  ਘਾਟ  ॥੨੩੧॥
lines.english: Kabeer, whether is is for an hour, half an hour, or half of that,
lines.transliteration: kabeer ayk gharh ee aaDh ee gh aree aaDh ee hooN tay aaDh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਏਕ ਘੜੀ  ਆਧੀ  ਘਰੀ  ਆਧੀ  ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਆਧ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagt an sayt ee gostay jo keenay so laabh . ||232|| whatever it is, it is worthwhile to speak with the Holy. ||232||

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤਨ  ਸੇਤੀ ਗੋਸਟੇ  ਜੋ ਕੀਨੇ  ਸੋ ਲਾਭ ॥੨੩੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, those mortals who consume marijuana, fish and wine
lines.transliteration: kabeer bhaaNg maachh ulee suraa paan jo jo paraanee kh aaNhi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ ਭਗ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ  ਸੁਰਾ ਪਾਿਨ  ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਖਿਹ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tirath barat  naym kee-ay t ay sabh ai rasaat al jaaNhi. ||233|| - no matter what pilgrimages, fasts and rituals they follow, they will all go to hell.||233||

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਬਰਤ  ਨੇਮ ਕੀਏ ਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਰਸਾਤਿਲ  ਜਿਹ  ॥੨੩੩॥
lines.english: Kabeer, I keep my eyes lowered, and enshrine my Friend within my heart.
lines.transliteration: neechay lo-in kar raha-o lay saajan ghat maahi.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ  ਕਿਰ ਰਹਉ  ਲੇ ਸਾਜਨ  ਘਟ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I enjoy all pleasures with my Beloved, but I do not let anyone else know. ||234||
lines.transliteration: sabh ras kh ayla-o pee-a sa-o kisee lakh aava-o naahi. ||234||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਖੇਲਉ  ਪੀਅ  ਸਉ ਿਕਸੀ  ਲਖਾਵਉ  ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੨੩੪॥
lines.english: Twenty-four hours a day, every hour, my soul continues to look to You, O Lord.
lines.transliteration: aath jaam cha-usath  gharee t u-a nirkh at rahai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਠ  ਜਾਮ ਚਉਸਿਠ  ਘਰੀ  ਤੁਅ ਿਨਰਖਤ  ਰਹੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Why should I keep my eyes lowered? I see my Beloved in every heart. ||235||
lines.transliteration: neechay lo-in ki-o kara-o sabh gh at daykh-a-u pee-o. ||235||

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਚੇ ਲੋਇਨ  ਿਕਉ  ਕਰਉ  ਸਭ ਘਟ ਦੇਖਉ  ਪੀਉ ॥੨੩੫॥
lines.english: Listen, O my companions: my soul dwells in my Beloved, and my Beloved dwells in my soul.
lines.transliteration: sun sakhee pee-a meh jee-o basai jee-a meh basai ke pee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਪੀਅ  ਮਿਹ ਜੀਉ  ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ  ਮਿਹ ਬਸੈ ਿਕ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.english: I realize that there is no difference between my soul and my Beloved; I cannot tellwhether my soul or my Beloved dwells in my heart. ||236||
lines.transliteration: jee-o pee-o boojha-o nahee gh at meh jee-o ke pee-o. ||236||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਪੀਉ ਬੂਝਉ  ਨਹੀ ਘਟ ਮਿਹ ਜੀਉ  ਿਕ ਪੀਉ ॥੨੩੬॥
lines.english: Kabeer, the Brahmin may be the guru of the world, but he is not the Guru of thedevotees.
lines.transliteration: kabeer baaman guroo hai jagat kaa bh agtan kaa gur naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਬਾਮਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ  ਕਾ ਭਗਤਨ  ਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He rots and dies in the perplexities of the four Vedas. ||237||
lines.transliteration: arajh urajh  kai pach moo-aa chaara-o bayd ahu maahi. ||237||

lines.punjabi: ਅਰਿਝ  ਉਰਿਝ  ਕੈ ਪਿਚ ਮੂਆ ਚਾਰਉ  ਬੇਦਹੁ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥੨੩੭॥
lines.english: The Lord is like sugar, scattered in the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.
lines.transliteration: har hai khaaNd rayt  meh bikh ree haathee chunee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹੈ ਖਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਿਹ ਿਬਖਰੀ  ਹਾਥੀ  ਚੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Says Kabeer, the Guru has given me this sublime understanding: become an ant, and feed on it. ||238||
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer gur bhalee bujh aa-ee keetee ho-ay kai kh aa-ay. ||238||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਿਰ ਭਲੀ ਬੁਝਾਈ  ਕੀਟੀ  ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਖਾਇ  ॥੨੩੮॥
lines.english: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, then cut off your head,and make it into a ball.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ja-o tuhi saaDh  piramm kee sees kaat kar go-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਉ ਤੁਿਹ ਸਾਧ ਿਪਰੰਮ  ਕੀ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਾਿਟ  ਕਿਰ ਗੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Lose yourself in the play of it, and then whatever will be, will be. ||239||
lines.transliteration: khaylat  khaylat haal kar jo kichh  ho-ay t a ho-ay. ||239||

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਲਤ  ਖੇਲਤ  ਹਾਲ ਕਿਰ ਜੋ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਇ ਤ ਹੋਇ ॥੨੩੯॥
lines.english: Kabeer, if you desire to play the game of love with the Lord, play it with someone withcommittment.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ja-o tuhi saaDh  piramm kee paakay sayt ee kh ayl.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਉ ਤੁਿਹ ਸਾਧ ਿਪਰੰਮ  ਕੀ ਪਾਕੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
lines.english: Pressing the unripe mustard seeds produces neither oil nor flour. ||240||
lines.transliteration: kaachee sarsa-uN payl kai naa khal bh a-ee na t ayl. ||240||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚੀ  ਸਰਸਉਂ  ਪੇਿਲ  ਕੈ ਨਾ ਖਿਲ ਭਈ ਨ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨੪੦॥
lines.english: Searching, the mortal stumbles like a blind person, and does not recognize the Saint.
lines.transliteration: dhooNdhat doleh anDh  gat ar cheenat  naahee sant .

lines.punjabi: ਢੂੰਢਤ  ਡੋਲਿਹ  ਅੰਧ ਗਿਤ  ਅਰੁ ਚੀਨਤ  ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤ ॥
lines.english: Says Naam Dayv, how can one obtain the Lord God, without His devotee? ||241||
lines.transliteration: kahi naamaa ki-o paa-ee-ai bin bhagt ahu bh agvant . ||241||

lines.english: Forsaking the Diamond of the Lord, the mortals put their hopes in another.
lines.transliteration: har so heeraa chhaad kai karahi aan kee aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਸੋ ਹੀਰਾ  ਛਾਿਡ  ਕੈ ਕਰਿਹ  ਆਨ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ॥
lines.english: Those people shall go to hell; Ravi Daas speaks the Truth. ||242||
lines.transliteration: tay nar d ojak jaahigay sat  bhaakhai ravid aas. ||242||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਦੋਜਕ  ਜਾਿਹਗੇ  ਸਿਤ ਭਾਖੈ ਰਿਵਦਾਸ  ॥੨੪੨॥
lines.english: Kabeer, if you live the householder's life, then practice righteousness; otherwise, you might as well retire from the world.
lines.transliteration: kabeer ja-o garihu karahi ta Dh aram kar naahee t a kar bairaag.

lines.punjabi: ਕਬੀਰ  ਜਉ ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਤ ਧਰਮੁ  ਕਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤ ਕਰੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: If someone renounces the world, and then gets involved in worldly entanglements, heshall suffer terrible misfortune. ||243|| slok syK PrId ky  (1377-15) salok saykh fareed  kay Shaloks Of Shaykh Fareed Jee: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1377-15) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bairaagee banDhan karai t aa ko bado abh aag. ||243||

lines.punjabi: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ  ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਡੋ ਅਭਾਗੁ  ॥੨੪੩॥
lines.english: The day of the bride's wedding is pre-ordained.
lines.transliteration: jit dihaarh ai Dhan varee saahay la-ay likh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਲੋਕ  ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ  ਕੇ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: On that day, the Messenger of Death, of whom she had only heard, comes and showsits face.
lines.transliteration: malak je kannee suneed aa muhu d aykhaalay aa-ay.

lines.english: It breaks the bones of the body and pulls the helpless soul out.
lines.transliteration: jind nimaan ee kadh ee-ai hadaa koo karh kaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲਕੁ  ਿਜ ਕੰਨੀ  ਸੁਣੀਦਾ  ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: That pre-ordained time of marriage cannot be avoided. Explain this to your soul.
lines.transliteration: saahay likhay na chalnee jind oo kooN samjh aa-ay.

lines.english: The soul is the bride, and death is the groom. He will marry her and take her away.
lines.transliteration: jind vahutee maran  var lai jaasee parn aa-ay.

lines.english: After the body sends her away with its own hands, whose neck will it embrace?
lines.transliteration: aapan hathee jol kai kai gal lagai Dh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜੰਦੁ  ਵਹੁਟੀ ਮਰਣੁ  ਵਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਰਣਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The bridge to hell is narrower than a hair; haven't you heard of it with your ears?
lines.transliteration: vaalahu nikee puraslaat kannee na sun ee aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣ  ਹਥੀ ਜੋਿਲ  ਕੈ ਕੈ ਗਿਲ  ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, the call has come; be careful now - don't let yourself be robbed. ||1||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kirh ee pavaNdee-ee kh arhaa na aap muhaa-ay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਿਨਕੀ  ਪੁਰਸਲਾਤ  ਕੰਨੀ  ਨ ਸੁਣੀ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, it is so difficult to become a humble Saint at the Lord's Door. pMnw 1378
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d ar darvaysee gaakh -rhee chalaaN dunee-aaN bhat.

lines.english: I am so accustomed to walking in the ways of the world. I have tied and picked up the bundle; where can I go to throw it away? ||2||
lines.transliteration: baneh uthaa-ee potlee kithai vanj aa gh at. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਝੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਿਕਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ  ਗੁਝੀ  ਭਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I know nothing; I understand nothing. The world is a smouldering fire.
lines.transliteration: kijh na bujh ai kijh  na sujh ai dunee-aa gujh ee bh aahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਈਂ  ਮੇਰੈ ਚੰਗਾ  ਕੀਤਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਤ ਹੰ ਭੀ ਦਝ ਆਿਹ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: My Lord did well to warn me about it; otherwise, I would have been burnt as well.||3||
lines.transliteration: saa-eeN mayrai changa keetaa naahee t a haN bhee dajhaaN aahi. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ  ਿਤਲ  ਥੋੜੜੇ  ਸੰਮਿਲ  ਬੁਕੁ ਭਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, if I had known that I had so few sesame seeds, I would have been morecareful with them in my hands.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jay jaan aa til thorh -rhay sammal buk bh aree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਹੁ ਨੰਢੜਾ  ਤ ਥੋੜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.english: If I had known that my Husband Lord was so young and innocent, I would not have been so arrogant. ||4||
lines.transliteration: jay jaanaa saho nandh -rhaa taaN thorh aa maan  karee. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ  ਲੜੁ ਿਛਜਣਾ  ਪੀਡੀ  ਪਾਈਂ  ਗੰਿਢ  ॥
lines.english: If I had known that my robe would come loose, I would have tied a tighter knot.
lines.transliteration: jay jaanaa larh  chhijnaa peedee paa-eeN gandh .

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਿਹ  ਕੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਿਡਠਾ  ਹੰਿਢ ॥੫॥
lines.english: I have found none as great as You, Lord; I have looked and searched throughout theworld. ||5||
lines.transliteration: tai jayvad mai naahi ko sabh  jag dith aa handh . ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜੇ ਤੂ ਅਕਿਲ  ਲਤੀਫੁ  ਕਾਲੇ  ਿਲਖੁ ਨ ਲੇਖ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, if you have a keen understanding, then do not write black marks againstanyone else.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jay t oo akal lat eef kaalay likh  na laykh .

lines.english: Look underneath your own collar instead. ||6||
lines.transliteration: aapnarhay gireevaan meh sir neeNvaaN kar d aykh. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜੋ ਤੈ ਮਾਰਿਨ  ਮੁਕੀਆਂ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਘੁੰਿਮ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, do not turn around and strike those who strike you with their fists.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jo t ai maaran mukee-aaN tinHaa na maaray gh umm.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਨੜੈ  ਘਿਰ ਜਾਈਐ  ਪੈਰ ਿਤਨਾ  ਦੇ ਚੁੰਿਮ ॥੭॥
lines.english: Kiss their feet, and return to your own home. ||7||
lines.transliteration: aapnarhai gh ar jaa-ee-ai pair t inHaa day chumm. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜ ਤਉ ਖਟਣ  ਵੇਲ ਤ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੁਨੀ  ਿਸਉ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, when there was time for you to earn good karma, you were in love with theworld instead.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jaaN ta-o kh atan vayl t aaN too rat aa dunee si-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਗ  ਸਵਾਈ  ਨੀਿਹ ਜ ਭਿਰਆ  ਤ ਲਿਦਆ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Now, death has a strong foothold; when the load is full, it is taken away. ||8||
lines.transliteration: marag savaa-ee neehi jaaN bhari-aa t aaN ladi-aa. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜੁ ਥੀਆ  ਦਾੜੀ  ਹੋਈ ਭੂਰ ॥
lines.english: See, Fareed, what has happened: your beard has become grey.
lines.transliteration: daykh  fareed aa jo thee-aa d aarhee ho-ee bh oor.

lines.english: That which is coming is near, and the past is left far behind. ||9||
lines.transliteration: agahu nayrhaa aa-i-aa pichh aa rahi-aa d oor. ||9||

lines.english: See, Fareed, what has happened: sugar has become poison.
lines.transliteration: daykh  fareed aa je thee-aa sakar ho-ee vis.

lines.english: Without my Lord, who can I tell of my sorrow? ||10||
lines.transliteration: saaN-ee baajhahu aapn ay vayd an kahee-ai kis. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਅਖੀ  ਦੇਿਖ ਪਤੀਣੀਆਂ  ਸੁਿਣ ਸੁਿਣ ਰੀਣੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, my eyes have become weak, and my ears have become hard of hearing.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa akh ee daykh pateenee-aaN sun sun reenay kann.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਖ ਪਕੰਦੀ  ਆਈਆ  ਹੋਰ ਕਰੇਂਦੀ  ਵੰਨ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The body's crop has become ripe and turned color. ||11||
lines.transliteration: saakh pakand ee aa-ee-aa hor karayNdee vann. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਕਾਲੀ ਿਜਨੀ  ਨ ਰਾਿਵਆ  ਧਉਲੀ  ਰਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, those who did not enjoy their Spouse when their hair was black - hardly any of them enjoy Him when their hair turns grey.
