lines.transliteration: fareedaa kaaleeN jinee na raavi-aa Dh a-ulee raavai ko-ay.

lines.english: So be in love with the Lord, so that your color may ever be new. ||12|| mÚ 3 ] (1378-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: kar saaN-ee si-o pirharhee rang navaylaa ho-ay. ||12||

lines.english: Fareed, whether one's hair is black or grey, our Lord and Master is always here if one remembers Him.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kaalee Dh a-ulee saahib sad aa hai jay ko chit  karay.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਕਾਲੀ  ਧਉਲੀ  ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਿਚਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: This loving devotion to the Lord does not come by one's own efforts, even though allmay long for it.
lines.transliteration: aapnaa laa-i-aa piram na lag-ee jay lochai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪਣਾ  ਲਾਇਆ  ਿਪਰਮੁ  ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: This cup of loving devotion belongs to our Lord and Master; He gives it to whomeverHe likes. ||13||
lines.transliteration: ayhu piram pi-aalaa khasam kaa jai bh aavai t ai day-ay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਿਪਰਮੁ  ਿਪਆਲਾ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Fareed, those eyes which have enticed the world - I have seen those eyes.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jinH lo-in jag mohi-aa say lo-in  mai dith .

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਿਜਨ ਲੋਇਣ  ਜਗੁ ਮੋਿਹਆ ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ  ਮੈ ਿਡਠੁ ॥
lines.english: Once, they could not endure even a bit of mascara; now, the birds hatch their youngin them! ||14||
lines.transliteration: kajal raykh na sehd i-aa say pankh ee soo-ay bahith . ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਕਜਲ  ਰੇਖ ਨ ਸਹਿਦਆ  ਸੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਸੂਇ ਬਿਹਠੁ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: Fareed, they shouted and yelled, and constantly gave good advice.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kookayd i-aa chaaNgaydi-aa mat ee daydi-aa nit .

lines.english: But those whom the devil has spoiled - how can they turn their consciousness towardsGod? ||15||
lines.transliteration: jo saitaan vanj aa-i-aa say kit  fayreh chit . ||15||

lines.english: Fareed, become the grass on the path,
lines.transliteration: fareedaa thee-o pavaahee d abh.
jay saaN-ee lorheh sabh . if you long for the Lord of all.

lines.english: One will cut you down, and another will trample you underfoot;
lines.transliteration: ik chhijeh bi-aa lat aarhee-ah.
taaN saa-ee d ai dar vaarh ee-ah. ||16|| then, you shall enter the Court of the Lord. ||16||

lines.english: Fareed, do not slander the dust; noting is as great as dust.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kh aak na nind ee-ai kh aakoo jayd na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਨ ਿਨੰਦੀਐ  ਖਾਕੂ ਜੇਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When we are alive, it is under our feet, and when we are dead, it is above us. ||17||
lines.transliteration: jeevdi-aa pairaa t alai mu-i-aa upar ho-ay. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਿਦਆ  ਪੈਰਾ ਤਲੈ ਮੁਇਆ  ਉਪਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Fareed, when there is greed, what love can there be? When there is greed, love is false.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jaa lab t aa nayhu ki-aa lab t a koorh aa nayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜਾ ਲਬੁ ਤਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਿਕਆ  ਲਬੁ ਤ ਕੂੜਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: How long can one remain in a thatched hut which leaks when it rains? ||18||
lines.transliteration: kichar jhat  laghaa-ee-ai chh apar t utai mayhu. ||18||

lines.english: Fareed, why do you wander from jungle to jungle, crashing through the thorny trees?
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jangal jangal ki-aa bh aveh van  kandaa morh ayhi.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜੰਗਲੁ  ਜੰਗਲੁ ਿਕਆ  ਭਵਿਹ  ਵਿਣ  ਕੰਡਾ ਮੋੜੇਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord abides in the heart; why are you looking for Him in the jungle? ||19||
lines.transliteration: vasee rab hi-aalee-ai jangal ki-aa dhoodh ayhi. ||19||

lines.english: Fareed, with these small legs, I crossed deserts and mountains.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa inee nikee jangh ee-ai thal doongar bh avi-omiH.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਇਨੀ  ਿਨਕੀ ਜੰਘੀਐ  ਥਲ ਡੂੰਗਰ  ਭਿਵਓਿਮ ॥
lines.english: But today, Fareed, my water jug seems hundreds of miles away. ||20||
lines.transliteration: aj fareedai koojrh aa sai kohaaN thee-om. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਅਜੁ ਫਰੀਦੈ  ਕੂਜੜਾ  ਸੈ ਕੋਹ ਥੀਓਿਮ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Fareed, the nights are long, and my sides are aching in pain. pMnw 1379
lines.transliteration: fareedaa raat ee vadee-aaN Dhukh Dhukh uthan paas.

lines.english: Dhig t inHaa daa jeevi-aa jinaa vidaan ee aas. ||21|| Cursed are the lives of those who place their hopes in others. ||21||
Fareed, if I had been there when my friend came, I would have made myself a sacrifice to him.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jay mai hod aa vaari-aa mit aa aa-irh i-aaN.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਦਾ ਵਾਿਰਆ ਿਮਤਾ  ਆਇਿੜਆਂ ॥
lines.english: Now my flesh is burning red on the hot coals. ||22||
lines.transliteration: hayrhaa jalai majeeth  ji-o upar angaaraa. ||22||

lines.english: Fareed, the farmer plants acacia trees, and wishes for grapes.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa lorh ai daakh bij-uree-aaN kikar beejai jat.

lines.english: He is spinning wool, but he wishes to wear silk. ||23||
lines.transliteration: handhai unn kat aa-idaa paiDh aa lorh ai pat. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਢੈ ਉਂਨ ਕਤਾਇਦਾ  ਪੈਧਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਪਟੁ ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Fareed, the path is muddy, and the house of my Beloved is so far away.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa galee-ay chikarh  door gh ar naal pi-aaray nayhu.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਗਲੀਏ  ਿਚਕੜੁ  ਦੂਿਰ ਘਰੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਪਆਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.english: If I go out, my blanket will get soaked, but if I remain at home, then my heart will be broken. ||24||
lines.transliteration: chalaa ta bh ijai kamblee rahaaN ta tutai nayhu. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਚਲਾ  ਤ ਿਭਜੈ ਕੰਬਲੀ  ਰਹ ਤ ਤੁਟੈ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: My blanket is soaked, drenched with the downpour of the Lord's Rain.
lines.transliteration: bhija-o sija-o kamblee alah varsa-o mayhu.

lines.english: I am going out to meet my Friend, so that my heart will not be broken. ||25||
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay milaa tinaa sajn aa tuta-o naahee nayhu. ||25||

lines.english: Fareed, I was worried that my turban might become dirty.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa mai bh olaavaa pag d aa mat  mailee ho-ay jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਮੈ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ  ਪਗ ਦਾ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My thoughtless self did not realize that one day, dust will consume my head as well. ||26||
lines.transliteration: gahilaa roohu na jaan-ee sir bh ee mitee kh aa-ay. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹਲਾ ਰੂਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ  ਿਸਰੁ ਭੀ ਿਮਟੀ  ਖਾਇ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: Fareed: sugar cane, candy, sugar, molasses, honey and buffalo's milk
lines.transliteration: fareedaa sakar kh and nivaat  gurh maakh i-o maaNjhaa duDh.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਸਕਰ  ਖੰਡੁ ਿਨਵਾਤ  ਗੁ ੜੁ ਮਾਿਖਓ  ੁ ਮਝਾ  ਦੁਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhay vast oo mith ee-aaN rab na pujan t uDh. ||27|| - all these things are sweet, but they are not equal to You. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਿਮਠੀਆਂ  ਰਬ ਨ ਪੁਜਿਨ  ਤੁਧੁ ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: Fareed, my bread is made of wood, and hunger is my appetizer.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa rotee mayree kaath  kee laavan  mayree bh ukh.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਰੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਲਾਵਣੁ  ਮੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
lines.english: Those who eat buttered bread, will suffer in terrible pain. ||28||
lines.transliteration: jinaa khaaDh ee choprh ee gh anay sehnigay d ukh. ||28||

lines.english: Eat dry bread, and drink cold water.
lines.transliteration: rukhee sukh ee kh aa-ay kai th andhaa paan ee pee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਖਾਇ  ਕੈ ਠੰਢਾ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, if you see someone else's buttered bread, do not envy him for it. ||29||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d aykh paraa-ee choprh ee naa t arsaa-ay jee-o. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਦੇਿਖ ਪਰਾਈ  ਚੋਪੜੀ  ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਏ ਜੀਉ  ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: This night, I did not sleep with my Husband Lord, and now my body is suffering in pain.
lines.transliteration: aj na sutee kant  si-o ang murh ay murh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜੁ ਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਿਸਉ ਅੰਗੁ ਮੁੜੇ ਮੁਿੜ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Go and ask the deserted bride, how she passes her night. ||30||
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay puchhahu dohaagan ee tum ki-o rain  vihaa-ay. ||30||

lines.english: She finds no place of rest in her father-in-law's home, and no place in her parents'home either.
lines.transliteration: saahurai dho-ee naa lahai pay-ee-ai naahee thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਪੇਈਐ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Her Husband Lord does not care for her; what sort of a blessed, happy soul-bride isshe? ||31||
lines.transliteration: pir vaat-rh ee na puchh -ee Dh an sohagan  naa-o. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰੁ ਵਾਤੜੀ  ਨ ਪੁਛਈ  ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਨਾਉ ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, shebelongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.
lines.transliteration: saahurai pay-ee-ai kant kee kant  agamm athaahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ  ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ  ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Carefree Lord. ||32||
lines.transliteration: naanak so sohaaganee jo bh aavai bayparvaah. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੋ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਜੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ  ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: Bathing, washing and decorating herself, she comes and sleeps without anxiety.
lines.transliteration: naatee Dh otee sambhee sut ee aa-ay nachind .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਤੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਸੰਬਹੀ  ਸੁਤੀ ਆਇ  ਨਿਚੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, she still smells like asafoetida; the fragrance of musk is gone. ||33||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa rahee so bayrh ee hiny  dee ga-ee kathooree ganDh . ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਿਹੰਙੁ ਦੀ ਗਈ ਕਥੂਰੀ  ਗੰਧੁ ॥੩੩॥
lines.english: I am not afraid of losing my youth, as long as I do not lose the Love of my Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: joban jaaNday naa daraaN jay sah pareet  na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਬਨ  ਜਦੇ  ਨਾ ਡਰ ਜੇ ਸਹ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, so many youths, without His Love, have dried up and withered away. ||34||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kit eeN joban pareet  bin suk ga-ay kumlaa-ay. ||34||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਿਕਤੀ ਜੋਬਨ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸੁਿਕ ਗਏ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ  ॥੩੪॥
lines.english: Fareed, anxiety is my bed, pain is my mattress, and the pain of separation is myblanket and quilt.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa chint  khatolaa vaan  dukh bireh vichh aavan  layf.

lines.english: Behold, this is my life, O my True Lord and Master. ||35||
lines.transliteration: ayhu hamaaraa jeevnaa t oo saahib sachay vaykh . ||35||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ  ਜੀਵਣਾ  ਤੂ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਸਚੇ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.english: Many talk of the pain and suffering of separation; O pain, you are the ruler of all.
lines.transliteration: birhaa birhaa aakhee-ai birhaa t oo sult aan.

lines.english: Fareed, that body, within which love of the Lord does not well up - look upon thatbody as a cremation ground. ||36||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jit  tan birahu na oopjai so t an jaan  masaan. ||36||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਿਜਤੁ ਤਿਨ  ਿਬਰਹੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ  ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ  ਮਸਾਨੁ ॥੩੬॥
lines.english: Fareed, these are poisonous sprouts coated with sugar.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa ay vis gand laa Dh aree-aaN khand livaarh .

lines.english: Some die planting them, and some are ruined, harvesting and enjoying them. ||37||
lines.transliteration: ik raahayday reh ga-ay ik raaDh ee ga-ay ujaarh . ||37||

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਰਾਹੇਦੇ  ਰਿਹ ਗਏ ਇਿਕ  ਰਾਧੀ  ਗਏ ਉਜਾਿੜ  ॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Fareed, the hours of the day are lost wandering around, and the hours of the nightare lost in sleep.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa chaar gavaa-i-aa handh  kai chaar gavaa-i-aa samm.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਾਿਰ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਹੰਿਢ ਕੈ ਚਾਿਰ  ਗਵਾਇਆ  ਸੰਿਮ ॥
lines.english: God will call for your account, and ask you why you came into this world. ||38||
lines.transliteration: laykhaa rab mangaysee-aa t oo aaNho kayrHay kamm. ||38||

lines.punjabi: ਲੇਖਾ  ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ  ਤੂ ਆਂਹੋ  ਕੇਰੇ ਕੰਿਮ ॥੩੮॥
lines.english: Fareed, you have gone to the Lord's Door. Have you seen the gong there?
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d ar darvaajai jaa-ay kai ki-o dith o gharhee-aal.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਿਰ ਦਰਵਾਜੈ  ਜਾਇ  ਕੈ ਿਕਉ  ਿਡਠੋ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ  ॥
lines.english: This blameless object is being beaten - imagine what is in store for us sinners! ||39||
lines.transliteration: ayhu nidosaaN maaree-ai ham d osaaN daa ki-aa haal. ||39||

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਿਨਦੋਸ  ਮਾਰੀਐ  ਹਮ ਦੋਸ ਦਾ ਿਕਆ  ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩੯॥
lines.english: Each and every hour, it is beaten; it is punished every day.
lines.transliteration: gharh ee-ay gh arhee-ay maaree-ai pahree lahai sajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਘੜੀਏ  ਘੜੀਏ  ਮਾਰੀਐ  ਪਹਰੀ  ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This beautiful body is like the gong; it passes the night in pain. ||40|| pMnw 1380
lines.transliteration: so hayrhaa gh arhee-aal ji-o dukh ee rain  vihaa-ay. ||40||

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਆ  ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ  ਕੰਬਿਣ  ਲਗੀ  ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: Shaykh Fareed has grown old, and his body has begun to tremble.
lines.transliteration: budhaa ho-aa saykh  fareed  kamban  lagee d ayh.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਿਰਆ  ਜੀਵਣਾ  ਭੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖੇਹ ॥੪੧॥
lines.english: Even if he could live for hundreds of years, his body will eventually turn to dust. ||41||
lines.transliteration: jay sa-o vareh-aa jeevnaa bh ee tan hosee kh ayh. ||41||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਬਾਿਰ ਪਰਾਇਐ  ਬੈਸਣਾ  ਸਈ  ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਦੇਿਹ ॥
lines.english: Fareed begs, O Lord, do not make me sit at another's door.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa baar paraa-i-ai baisn aa saaN-ee mujh ai na d eh.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਏਵੈ ਰਖਸੀ  ਜੀਉ  ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਲੇਿਹ ॥੪੨॥
lines.english: If this is the way you are going to keep me, then go ahead and take the life out of my body. ||42||
lines.transliteration: jay too ayvai rakh see jee-o sareerahu layhi. ||42||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਿਧ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ  ਿਸਿਰ ਘੜਾ  ਵਿਣ ਕੈ ਸਰੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: With the axe on his shoulder, and a bucket on his head, the blacksmith is ready to cut down the tree.
lines.transliteration: kanDh kuhaarh aa sir gh arhaa van  kai sar lohaar.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਹਉ ਲੋੜੀ  ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ  ਤੂ ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਅੰਿਗਆਰ  ॥੪੩॥
lines.english: Fareed, I long for my Lord; you long only for the charcoal. ||43||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa ha-o lorh ee saho aapn aa too lorh eh angi-aar. ||43||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਇਕਨਾ ਆਟਾ  ਅਗਲਾ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਲੋਣੁ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, some have lots of flour, while others do not even have salt.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa iknaa aataa aglaa iknaa naahee lon .

lines.english: When they go beyond this world, it shall be seen, who will be punished. ||44||
lines.transliteration: agai ga-ay sinjaapsan chotaaN khaasee ka-un . ||44||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਿਸ  ਦਮਾਮੇ  ਛਤੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਭੇਰੀ ਸਡੋ ਰਡ ॥
lines.english: Drums were beaten in their honor, there were canopies above their heads, and buglesannounced their coming.
lines.transliteration: paas damaamay chh at sir bh ayree sado rad.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਇ  ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣ  ਮਿਹ ਥੀਏ ਅਤੀਮਾ  ਗਡ ॥੪੫॥
lines.english: They have gone to sleep in the cemetary, buried like poor orphans. ||45||
lines.transliteration: jaa-ay sutay jeeraan  meh thee-ay at eemaa gad. ||45||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ  ਮਾੜੀਆ ਉਸਾਰੇਦੇ  ਭੀ ਗਏ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, those who built houses, mansions and lofty buildings, are also gone.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa koth ay mandap maarh ee-aa usaarayd ay bh ee ga-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜਾ ਸਉਦਾ  ਕਿਰ ਗਏ ਗੋਰੀ ਆਇ  ਪਏ ॥੪੬॥
lines.english: They made false deals, and were dropped into their graves. ||46||
lines.transliteration: koorhaa sa-ud aa kar ga-ay goree aa-ay pa-ay. ||46||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਿਖੰਥਿੜ  ਮੇਖਾ ਅਗਲੀਆ ਿਜੰਦੁ  ਨ ਕਾਈ  ਮੇਖ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, there are many seams on the patched coat, but there are no seams on thesoul.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kh intharh  maykh aa aglee-aa jind  na kaa-ee maykh .

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਰੀ  ਆਪੋ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਚਲੇ ਮਸਾਇਕ  ਸੇਖ ॥੪੭॥
lines.english: The shaykhs and their disciples have all departed, each in his own turn. ||47||
lines.transliteration: vaaree aapo aapnee chalay masaa-ik saykh . ||47||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਦੁਹੁ ਦੀਵੀ  ਬਲੰਿਦਆ ਮਲਕੁ  ਬਿਹਠਾ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, the two lamps are lit, but death has come anyway.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d uhu d eevee baland i-aa malak bahith aa aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੜੁ ਲੀਤਾ  ਘਟੁ ਲੁਿਟਆ  ਦੀਵੜੇ  ਗਇਆ  ਬੁਝਾਇ  ॥੪੮॥
lines.english: It has captured the fortress of the body, and plundered the home of the heart; it extinguishes the lamps and departs. ||48||
lines.transliteration: garh leet aa gh at luti-aa d eevrh ay ga-i-aa bujh aa-ay. ||48||

lines.english: Fareed, look at what has happened to the cotton and the sesame seed,
lines.transliteration: fareedaa vaykh  kapaahai je thee-aa je sir thee-aa t ilaah.
kamaadai ar kaagd ai kunnay ko-ili-aah. the sugar cane and paper, the clay pots and the charcoal.

lines.english: This is the punishment for those who do evil deeds. ||49||
lines.transliteration: manday amal karayd i-aa ayh sajaa-ay t inaah. ||49||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਕੰਿਨ ਮੁਸਲਾ  ਸੂਫੁ ਗਿਲ  ਿਦਿਲ  ਕਾਤੀ  ਗੁੜੁ ਵਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, you wear your prayer shawl on your shoulders and the robes of a Sufi; yourwords are sweet, but there is a dagger in your heart.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kann muslaa soof gal d il kaat ee gurh  vaat.

lines.english: Outwardly, you look bright, but your heart is dark as night. ||50||
lines.transliteration: baahar disai chaann aa dil anDh i-aaree raat . ||50||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਰਤੀ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਿਨਕਲੈ  ਜੇ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, not even a drop of blood would issue forth, if someone cut my body.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa rat ee rat  na niklai jay t an cheerai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਤਨ ਰਤੇ ਰਬ ਿਸਉ ਿਤਨ ਤਿਨ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
lines.english: Those bodies which are imbued with the Lord - those bodies contain no blood. ||51|| mÚ 3 ] (1380-12) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo tan rat ay rab si-o t in tan rat  na ho-ay. ||51||

lines.english: This body is all blood; without blood, this body could not exist.
lines.transliteration: ih tan sabh o rat hai rat  bin tann na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those who are imbued with their Lord, do not have the blood of greed in their bodies.
lines.transliteration: jo sah ratay aapn ay tit tan lobh  rat na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ  ਿਤਤੁ ਤਿਨ ਲੋਭੁ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the Fear of God fills the body, it becomes thin; the blood of greed departs fromwithin.
lines.transliteration: bhai pa-i-ai t an kh een ho-ay lobh  rat vichahu jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ  ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭੁ ਰਤੁ ਿਵਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Just as metal is purified by fire, the Fear of God removes the filthy residues of evil- mindedness.
lines.transliteration: ji-o baisantar Dh aat suDh  ho-ay t i-o har kaa bh a-o durmat  mail gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਿਰ  ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਿਤਉ  ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those humble beings are beautiful, who are imbued with the Lord's Love.||52||
lines.transliteration: naanak tay jan sohn ay je rat ay har rang laa-ay. ||52||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਿਜ ਰਤੇ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥੫੨॥
lines.english: Fareed, seek that sacred pool, in which the genuine article is found.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa so-ee sarvar dh oodh lahu jithahu labh ee vath.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਢੂਿਢ  ਲਹੁ ਿਜਥਹੁ ਲਭੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
lines.english: Why do you bother to search in the pond? Your hand will only sink into the mud.||53||
lines.transliteration: chhaparh  dhoodhai ki-aa hovai chikarh  dubai hath. ||53||

lines.english: Fareed, when she is young, she does not enjoy her Husband. When she grows up, she dies.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa nandh ee kant  na raavi-o vadee thee mu-ee-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਨੰਢੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਿਵਓ  ਵਡੀ ਥੀ ਮੁਈਆਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan kookayNdee gor mayN tai sah naa milee-aas. ||54|| Lying in the grave, the soul-bride cries, "I did not meet You, my Lord."||54||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨ ਕੂਕੇਂਦੀ  ਗੋਰ ਮੇਂ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾ ਿਮਲੀਆਸੁ  ॥੫੪॥
lines.english: Fareed, your hair has turned grey, your beard has turned grey, and your moustachehas turned grey.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa sir pali-aa d aarhee palee muchh aaN bhee palee-aaN.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਿਸਰੁ ਪਿਲਆ  ਦਾੜੀ  ਪਲੀ  ਮੁਛ ਭੀ ਪਲੀਆਂ ॥
lines.english: O my thoughtless and insane mind, why are you indulging in pleasures? ||55||
lines.transliteration: ray man gahilay baavlay maaneh ki-aa ralee-aaN. ||55||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਿਹਲੇ  ਬਾਵਲੇ  ਮਾਣਿਹ  ਿਕਆ  ਰਲੀਆਂ ॥੫੫॥
lines.english: Fareed, how long can you run on the rooftop? You are asleep to your Husband Lord -give it up!
lines.transliteration: fareedaa koth ay Dh ukan kayt-rhaa pir need -rhee nivaar.

lines.english: The days which were allotted to you are numbered, and they are passing, passingaway. ||56||
lines.transliteration: jo dih laDh ay gaan vay ga-ay vilaarh  vilaarh . ||56||

lines.english: Fareed, houses, mansions and balconies - do not attach your consciousness to these.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa koth ay mandap maarh ee-aa ayt  na laa-ay chit .

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ  ਮਾੜੀਆ  ਏਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ  ਿਚਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: When these collapse into heaps of dust, none of them will be your friend. ||57||
lines.transliteration: mitee pa-ee atolavee ko-ay na hosee mit . ||57||

lines.english: Fareed, do not focus on mansions and wealth; center your consciousness on death, your powerful enemy. pMnw 1381
lines.transliteration: fareedaa mandap maal na laa-ay marag sat aanee chit  Dhar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਲੁ  ਨ ਲਾਇ  ਮਰਗ  ਸਤਾਣੀ  ਿਚਿਤ  ਧਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Remember that place where you must go. ||58||
lines.transliteration: saa-ee jaa-ay samHaal jithai hee ta-o vanjn aa. ||58||

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਈ  ਜਾਇ  ਸਮਾਿਲ  ਿਜਥੈ ਹੀ ਤਉ ਵੰਞਣਾ  ॥੫੮॥
lines.english: Fareed, those deeds which do not bring merit - forget about those deeds.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jinHee kammee naahi gun  tay kammrh ay visaar.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਿਜਨੀ  ਕੰਮੀ ਨਾਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਕੰਮੜੇ  ਿਵਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Otherwise, you shall be put to shame, in the Court of the Lord. ||59||
lines.transliteration: mat sarmind aa theevhee saaN-ee dai darbaar. ||59||

lines.punjabi: ਮਤੁ ਸਰਿਮੰਦਾ  ਥੀਵਹੀ  ਸਈ  ਦੈ ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥੫੯॥
lines.english: Fareed, work for your Lord and Master; dispel the doubts of your heart.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa saahib d ee kar chaakree d il dee laahi bh araaNd.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਾਿਹਬ  ਦੀ ਕਿਰ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਿਦਲ  ਦੀ ਲਾਿਹ  ਭਰਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: The dervishes, the humble devotees, have the patient endurance of trees. ||60||
lines.transliteration: darvaysaaN no lorh ee-ai rukh aaN dee jeeraaNd. ||60||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਵੇਸ  ਨੋ ਲੋੜੀਐ  ਰੁਖ ਦੀ ਜੀਰਿਦ  ॥੬੦॥
lines.english: Fareed, my clothes are black, and my outfit is black.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kaalay maiday kaprh ay kaalaa maidaa vays.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ  ਮੈਡੇ ਕਪੜੇ  ਕਾਲਾ  ਮੈਡਾ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.english: I wander around full of sins, and yet people call me a dervish - a holy man. ||61||
lines.transliteration: gunhee bhari-aa mai firaa lok kahai d arvays. ||61||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨਹੀ  ਭਿਰਆ  ਮੈ ਿਫਰਾ  ਲੋਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ  ॥੬੧॥
lines.english: The crop which is burnt will not bloom, even if it is soaked in water.
lines.transliteration: tatee to-ay na palvai jay jal tubee d ay-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੀ  ਤੋਇ ਨ ਪਲਵੈ ਜੇ ਜਿਲ  ਟੁਬੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, she who is forsaken by her Husband Lord, grieves and laments. ||62||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jo dohaagan  rab d ee jhoorayd ee jooray-ay. ||62||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜੋ ਡੋਹਾਗਿਣ  ਰਬ ਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ  ਝੂਰੇਇ  ॥੬੨॥
lines.english: When she is a virgin, she is full of desire; but when she is married, then her troubles begin.
lines.transliteration: jaaN ku-aaree taa chaa-o veevaahee t aaN maamlay.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਕੁਆਰੀ  ਤਾ ਚਾਉ  ਵੀਵਾਹੀ  ਤ ਮਾਮਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, she has this one regret, that she cannot be a virgin again. ||63||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa ayho pachh otaa-o vat  ku-aaree na thee-ai. ||63||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਏਹੋ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ  ਵਿਤ ਕੁਆਰੀ  ਨ ਥੀਐ  ॥੬੩॥
lines.english: The swans have landed in a small pond of salt water.
lines.transliteration: kalar kayree chhaprh ee aa-ay ulthay hanjh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਰ  ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ  ਆਇ  ਉਲਥੇ  ਹੰਝ ॥
lines.english: They dip in their bills, but do not drink; they fly away, still thirsty. ||64||
lines.transliteration: chinjoo borhniH naa peeveh udan  sand ee danjh . ||64||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਜੂ ਬੋੜਿਨ  ਨਾ ਪੀਵਿਹ  ਉਡਣ  ਸੰਦੀ ਡੰਝ ॥੬੪॥
lines.english: The swans fly away, and land in the fields of grain. The people go to chase themaway.
lines.transliteration: hans udar koDhrai pa-i-aa lok vidaaran  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਿਰ  ਕੋਧਰ੍ੈ ਪਇਆ  ਲੋਕੁ ਿਵਡਾਰਿਣ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The thoughtless people do not know, that the swans do not eat the grain. ||65||
lines.transliteration: gahilaa lok na jaandaa hans na koDh raa kh aa-ay. ||65||

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹਲਾ  ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਹੰਸੁ ਨ ਕੋਧਰ੍ਾ ਖਾਇ  ॥੬੫॥
lines.english: The birds which lived in the pools have flown away and left.
lines.transliteration: chal chal ga-ee-aa pankhee-aaN jinHee vasaa-ay t al.

lines.punjabi: ਚਿਲ  ਚਿਲ  ਗਈਆਂ  ਪੰਖੀਆਂ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਵਸਾਏ  ਤਲ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, the overflowing pool shall also pass away, and only the lotus flowers shallremain. ||66||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa sar bh ari-aa bh ee chalsee thakay kaval ikal. ||66||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਸਰੁ ਭਿਰਆ ਭੀ ਚਲਸੀ  ਥਕੇ ਕਵਲ  ਇਕਲ  ॥੬੬॥
lines.english: Fareed, a stone will be your pillow, and the earth will be your bed. The worms shalleat into your flesh.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa it siraan ay bh u-ay savan  keerh aa larh i-o maas.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਇਟ ਿਸਰਾਣੇ  ਭੁਇ ਸਵਣੁ  ਕੀੜਾ  ਲਿੜਓ  ਮਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: Countless ages will pass, and you will still be lying on one side. ||67||
lines.transliteration: kayt-rh i-aa jug vaapray ikat  pa-i-aa paas. ||67||

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਤਿੜਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਾਪਰੇ  ਇਕਤੁ  ਪਇਆ  ਪਾਿਸ  ॥੬੭॥
lines.english: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa bh annee gh arhee savannvee tutee naagar laj.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ  ਸਵੰਨਵੀ  ਟੁਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ  ਲਜੁ ॥
lines.english: In which house will the Messenger of Death be a guest today? ||68||
lines.transliteration: ajraa-eel faraystaa kai gh ar naath ee aj. ||68||

lines.punjabi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ  ਕੈ ਘਿਰ  ਨਾਠੀ  ਅਜੁ ॥੬੮॥
lines.english: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breathshall be snapped.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa bh annee gh arhee savannvee tootee naagar laj.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ  ਸਵੰਨਵੀ  ਟੂਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ  ਲਜੁ ॥
lines.english: Those friends who were a burden on the earth - how can they come today? ||69||
lines.transliteration: jo sajan bh u-ay bh aar thay say ki-o aavahi aj. ||69||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਸਜਣ  ਭੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਥੇ ਸੇ ਿਕਉ  ਆਵਿਹ  ਅਜੁ ॥੬੯॥
lines.english: Fareed: O faithless dog, this is not a good way of life.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa bay nivaajaa kut i-aa ayh na bh alee reet .

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਬੇ ਿਨਵਾਜਾ  ਕੁਿਤਆ  ਏਹ ਨ ਭਲੀ ਰੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: You never come to the mosque for your five daily prayers. ||70||
lines.transliteration: kabhee chal na aa-i-aa panjay vakhat  maseet . ||70||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬਹੀ  ਚਿਲ  ਨ ਆਇਆ ਪੰਜੇ ਵਖਤ  ਮਸੀਿਤ  ॥੭੦॥
lines.english: Rise up, Fareed, and cleanse yourself; chant your morning prayer.
lines.transliteration: uth fareed aa ujoo saaj subah nivaaj gujaar.

lines.punjabi: ਉਠੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਉਜੂ ਸਾਿਜ  ਸੁਬਹ  ਿਨਵਾਜ  ਗੁਜਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The head which does not bow to the Lord - chop off and remove that head. ||71||
lines.transliteration: jo sir saaN-ee naa nivai so sir kap utaar. ||71||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਿਸਰੁ ਸਈ  ਨਾ ਿਨਵੈ ਸੋ ਿਸਰੁ ਕਿਪ ਉਤਾਿਰ  ॥੭੧॥
lines.english: That head which does not bow to the Lord - what is to be done with that head?
lines.transliteration: jo sir saa-ee naa nivai so sir keejai kaaN-ay.

lines.english: Put it in the fireplace, instead of firewood. ||72||
lines.transliteration: kunnay hayth jalaa-ee-ai baalan  sand ai thaa-ay. ||72||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁੰਨੇ ਹੇਿਠ ਜਲਾਈਐ  ਬਾਲਣ  ਸੰਦੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੭੨॥
lines.english: Fareed, where are your mother and father, who gave birth to you?
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kithai t aiday maapi-aa jinHee too jan i-ohi.

lines.english: They have left you, but even so, you are not convinced that you shall also have to go.||73||
lines.transliteration: tai paashu o-ay lad  ga-ay t ooN ajai na pat eenohi. ||73||

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਓਇ ਲਿਦ  ਗਏ ਤੂੰ ਅਜੈ ਨ ਪਤੀਣੋਿਹ ॥੭੩॥
lines.english: Fareed, flatten out your mind; smooth out the hills and valleys.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa man maid aan kar to-ay tibay laahi.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਮਨੁ ਮੈਦਾਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਟੋਏ ਿਟਬੇ ਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Hereafter, the fires of hell shall not even approach you. ||74|| mhlw 5 ] (1381-17) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: agai mool na aavsee dojak sand ee bh aahi. ||74||

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ ਮੂਿਲ ਨ ਆਵਸੀ  ਦੋਜਕ  ਸੰਦੀ ਭਾਿਹ  ॥੭੪॥
lines.english: Fareed, the Creator is in the Creation, and the Creation abides in God.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kh aalak kh alak meh kh alak vasai rab maahi.

lines.english: Whom can we call bad? There is none without Him. ||75||
lines.transliteration: mandaa kis no aakh ee-ai jaaN tis bin ko-ee naahi. ||75||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਖਾਲਕੁ  ਖਲਕ  ਮਿਹ ਖਲਕ  ਵਸੈ ਰਬ ਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, if on that day when my umbilical cord was cut, my throat had been cut instead,
lines.transliteration: fareedaa je d ihi naalaa kapi-aa jay gal kapeh chukh .

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਦਾ ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਜ ਿਤਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥੭੫॥
lines.english: I would not have fallen into so many troubles, or undergone so many hardships.||76||
lines.transliteration: pavan na itee maamlay sahaaN na itee dukh. ||76||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਿਜ ਿਦਿਹ  ਨਾਲਾ  ਕਿਪਆ  ਜੇ ਗਲੁ ਕਪਿਹ  ਚੁਖ ॥
lines.english: My teeth, feet, eyes and ears have stopped working.
lines.transliteration: chaban chalan  ratann say sun ee-ar bahi ga-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਵਿਨ  ਨ ਇਤੀ  ਮਾਮਲੇ  ਸਹ ਨ ਇਤੀ ਦੁਖ ॥੭੬॥
lines.english: My body cries out, "Those whom I knew have left me!"||77||
lines.transliteration: hayrhay mut ee Dh aah say jaanee chal ga-ay. ||77||

lines.punjabi: ਚਬਣ  ਚਲਣ  ਰਤੰਨ  ਸੇ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ  ਬਿਹ ਗਏ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, answer evil with goodness; do not fill your mind with anger. pMnw 1382
lines.transliteration: fareedaa buray d aa bh alaa kar gusaa man na hadh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੁਰੇ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਰ ਗੁਸਾ  ਮਿਨ ਨ ਹਢਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your body shall not suffer from any disease, and you shall obtain everything. ||78||
lines.transliteration: dayhee rog na lag-ee palai sabh  kichh  paa-ay. ||78||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਪਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੭੮॥
lines.english: Fareed, the bird is a guest in this beautiful world-garden.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa pankh  paraahun ee dunee suhaavaa baag.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਪੰਖ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੀ ਦੁਨੀ  ਸੁਹਾਵਾ  ਬਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: The morning drums are beating - get ready to leave! ||79||
lines.transliteration: na-ubat vajee subah si-o chalan  kaa kar saaj. ||79||

lines.punjabi: ਨਉਬਿਤ  ਵਜੀ ਸੁਬਹ  ਿਸਉ ਚਲਣ  ਕਾ ਕਿਰ ਸਾਜੁ ॥੭੯॥
lines.english: Fareed, musk is released at night. Those who are sleeping do not receive their share.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa raat  kathooree vandee-ai sut i-aa milai na bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵੰਡੀਐ  ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਿਮਲੈ ਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Those whose eyes are heavy with sleep - how can they receive it? ||80||
lines.transliteration: jinHaa nain neeNdraavalay t inHaa milan  ku-aa-o. ||80||

lines.english: Fareed, I thought that I was in trouble; the whole world is in trouble!
lines.transliteration: fareedaa mai jaani-aa d ukh mujh  koo d ukh sabaa-i-ai jag.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਮੈ ਜਾਿਨਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੁਝ ਕੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਐ  ਜਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: When I climbed the hill and looked around, I saw this fire in each and every home. ||81|| mhlw 5 ] (1382-4) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: oochay charh kai d aykhi-aa taaN ghar ghar ayhaa ag. ||81||

lines.punjabi: ਊਚੇ ਚਿੜ ਕੈ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਤ ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਏਹਾ ਅਿਗ  ॥੮੧॥
lines.english: Fareed, in the midst of this beautiful earth, there is a garden of thorns.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa bh oom rangaavalee manjh  visoolaa baag.

lines.english: Those humble beings who are blessed by their spiritual teacher, do not suffer even ascratch. ||82|| mhlw 5 ] (1382-6) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jo jan peer nivaaji-aa tinHaa anch na laag. ||82||

lines.english: Fareed, life is blessed and beautiful, along with the beautiful body.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa umar suhaavarh ee sang suvannrh ee dayh.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪੀਿਰ  ਿਨਵਾਿਜਆ  ਿਤੰਨਾ  ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ  ॥੮੨॥
lines.english: Only a rare few are found, who love their Beloved Lord. ||83||
lines.transliteration: virlay kay-ee paa-ee-an jinHaa pi-aaray nayh. ||83||

lines.english: O river, do not destroy your banks; you too will be asked to give your account.
lines.transliteration: kanDhee vahan  na dh aahi t a-o bh ee laykh aa dayvnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਉਮਰ  ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ  ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.english: The river flows in whatever direction the Lord orders. ||84||
lines.transliteration: jiDhar rab rajaa-ay vahan  tiDhaa-oo gaN-o karay. ||84||

lines.english: Fareed, the day passes painfully; the night is spent in anguish.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa dukh aa sayt ee dihu ga-i-aa soolaaN saytee raat .

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਧੀ ਵਹਣ  ਨ ਢਾਿਹ  ਤਉ ਭੀ ਲੇਖਾ  ਦੇਵਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The boatman stands up and shouts, "The boat is caught in the whirlpool!"||85||
lines.transliteration: kharh aa pukaaray paat -nee bayrh aa kapar vaat . ||85||

lines.english: The river flows on and on; it loves to eat into its banks.
lines.transliteration: lammee lammee nadee vahai kanDh ee kayrai hayt .

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਡੁਖਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਿਦਹੁ ਗਇਆ  ਸੂਲ  ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: What can the whirlpool do to the boat, if the boatman remains alert? ||86||
lines.transliteration: bayrhay no kapar ki-aa karay jay paat an rahai suchayt . ||86||

lines.punjabi: ਖੜਾ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ  ਪਾਤਣੀ  ਬੇੜਾ ਕਪਰ  ਵਾਿਤ  ॥੮੫॥
lines.english: Fareed, there are dozens who say they are friends; I search, but I cannot find even one.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa galeeN so sajan  veeh ik dh ooNdhaydee na lahaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਲੰਮੀ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦੀ  ਵਹੈ ਕੰਧੀ ਕੇਰੈ ਹੇਿਤ ॥
lines.english: Dhukh aaN ji-o maaNleeh kaaran  tinHaa maa piree. ||87|| I yearn for my beloved like a smouldering fire. ||87||

lines.punjabi: ਬੇੜੇ ਨੋ ਕਪਰੁ ਿਕਆ  ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਪਾਤਣ  ਰਹੈ ਸੁਚੇਿਤ  ॥੮੬॥
lines.english: Fareed, this body is always barking. Who can stand this constant suffering?
lines.transliteration: fareedaa ih t an bh a-ukan aa nit  nit dukhee-ai ka-un .

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਗਲੀ ਸੁ ਸਜਣ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੁ ਢੂੰਢੇਦੀ  ਨ ਲਹ ॥
lines.english: I have put plugs in my ears; I don't care how much the wind is blowing. ||88||
lines.transliteration: kannee bujay day rahaaN kitee vagai pa-un . ||88||

lines.english: Fareed, God's dates have ripened, and rivers of honey flow.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa rab kh ajooree pakee-aaN maakh i-a na-ee vahaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਉਕਣਾ ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਦੁਖੀਐ  ਕਉਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: With each passing day, your life is being stolen away. ||89||
lines.transliteration: jo jo vanjaiN deehrh aa so umar hath pavann. ||89||

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਨੀ  ਬੁਜੇ ਦੇ ਰਹ ਿਕਤੀ  ਵਗੈ ਪਉਣੁ  ॥੮੮॥
lines.english: Fareed, my withered body has become a skeleton; the crows are pecking at my palms.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa t an sukaa pinjar thee-aa t alee-aaN khooNdeh kaag.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਰਬ ਖਜੂਰੀ  ਪਕੀਆਂ ਮਾਿਖਅ  ਨਈ ਵਹੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: Even now, God has not come to help me; behold, this is the fate of all mortal beings.||90||
lines.transliteration: ajai so rab na baahurhi-o d aykh band ay kay bh aag. ||90||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਵੰਞੈਂ ਡੀਹੜਾ  ਸੋ ਉਮਰ  ਹਥ ਪਵੰਿਨ  ॥੮੯॥
lines.english: The crows have searched my skeleton, and eaten all my flesh.
lines.transliteration: kaagaa karang dhandh oli-aa saglaa kh aa-i-aa maas.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਤਨੁ ਸੁਕਾ ਿਪੰਜਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਤਲੀਆਂ  ਖੂੰਡਿਹ  ਕਾਗ  ॥
lines.english: But please do not touch these eyes; I hope to see my Lord. ||91||
lines.transliteration: ay du-ay nainaa mat  chhuha-o pir d aykhan kee aas. ||91||

lines.punjabi: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰਬੁ ਨ ਬਾਹੁਿੜਓ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ॥੯੦॥
lines.english: O crow, do not peck at my skeleton; if you have landed on it, fly away.
lines.transliteration: kaagaa choond na pinjraa basai ta udar jaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਗਾ  ਕਰੰਗ  ਢੰਢੋਿਲਆ  ਸਗਲਾ ਖਾਇਆ  ਮਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Do not eat the flesh from that skeleton, within which my Husband Lord abides. ||92||
lines.transliteration: jit pinjrai mayraa saho vasai maas na t idoo kh aahi. ||92||

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨਾ ਮਿਤ ਛੁਹਉ  ਿਪਰ ਦੇਖਨ  ਕੀ ਆਸ  ॥੯੧॥
lines.english: Fareed, the poor grave calls out, "O homeless one, come back to your home.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa gor nimaan ee sad karay nigh ri-aa gh ar aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਗਾ  ਚੂੰਿਡ ਨ ਿਪੰਜਰਾ  ਬਸੈ ਤ ਉਡਿਰ ਜਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: You shall surely have to come to me; do not be afraid of death."||93||
lines.transliteration: sarpar maithai aavnaa marn ahu na dari-aahu. ||93||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਤੁ ਿਪੰਜਰੈ  ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਿਤਦੂ  ਖਾਿਹ  ॥੯੨॥
lines.english: These eyes have seen a great many leave.
lines.transliteration: aynee lo-inee d aykh-di-aa kayt ee chal ga-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਗੋਰ ਿਨਮਾਣੀ  ਸਡੁ ਕਰੇ ਿਨਘਿਰਆ ਘਿਰ  ਆਉ  ॥
lines.english: Fareed, the people have their fate, and I have mine. ||94||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa lokaaN aapo aapn ee mai aapn ee pa-ee. ||94||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਪਰ  ਮੈਥੈ ਆਵਣਾ  ਮਰਣਹੁ ਨਾ ਡਿਰਆਹੁ ॥੯੩॥
lines.english: God says, "If you reform yourself, you shall meet me, and meeting me, you shall be at peace.
lines.transliteration: aap savaareh mai mileh mai mili-aa sukh ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਨੀ ਲੋਇਣੀ  ਦੇਖਿਦਆ  ਕੇਤੀ  ਚਿਲ  ਗਈ ॥
lines.english: O Fareed, if you will be mine, the whole world will be yours."||95||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa jay t oo mayraa ho-ay raheh sabh  jag tayraa ho-ay. ||95||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਲੋਕ  ਆਪੋ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਮੈ ਆਪਣੀ  ਪਈ ॥੯੪॥
lines.english: How long can the tree remain implanted on the river-bank?
lines.transliteration: kanDhee ut ai rukh -rhaa kichrak bannai Dh eer.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਸਵਾਰਿਹ  ਮੈ ਿਮਲਿਹ  ਮੈ ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, how long can water be kept in a soft clay pot? ||96||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kachai bh aaNdai rakh ee-ai kichar t aa-ee neer. ||96||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਹ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੯੫॥
lines.english: Fareed, the mansions are vacant; those who lived in them have gone to live underground. pMnw 1383
lines.transliteration: fareedaa mahal nisakh an reh ga-ay vaasaa aa-i-aa t al.

lines.english: They remain there, in those unhonored graves.
lines.transliteration: goraaN say nimaanee-aa bahsan roohaaN mal.

lines.english: O Shaykh, dedicate yourself to God; you will have to depart, today or tomorrow. ||97||
lines.transliteration: aakheeN saykh aa band agee chalan  aj ke kal. ||97||

lines.punjabi: ਆਖੀਂ  ਸੇਖਾ ਬੰਦਗੀ  ਚਲਣੁ  ਅਜੁ ਿਕ ਕਿਲ  ॥੯੭॥
lines.english: Fareed, the shore of death looks like the river-bank, being eroded away.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa ma-ut ai daa bannaa ayvai d isai ji-o d aree-aavai dh aahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਮਉਤੈ  ਦਾ ਬੰਨਾ ਏਵੈ ਿਦਸੈ ਿਜਉ  ਦਰੀਆਵੈ  ਢਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Beyond is the burning hell, from which cries and shrieks are heard.
lines.transliteration: agai dojak t api-aa sun ee-ai hool pavai kaahaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗੈ  ਦੋਜਕੁ  ਤਿਪਆ  ਸੁਣੀਐ  ਹੂਲ ਪਵੈ ਕਾਹਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Some understand this completely, while others wander around carelessly.
lines.transliteration: iknaa no sabh sojh ee aa-ee ik fird ay vayparvaahaa.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਨੋ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਆਈ  ਇਿਕ  ਿਫਰਦੇ  ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ  ॥
lines.english: Those actions which are done in this world, shall be examined in the Court of theLord. ||98||
lines.transliteration: amal je keeti-aa d unee vich say d argeh ohaagaa. ||98||

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਲ  ਿਜ ਕੀਿਤਆ  ਦੁਨੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ  ਓਗਾਹਾ ॥੯੮॥
lines.english: Fareed, the crane perches on the river bank, playing joyfully.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d aree-aavai kanHai bagulaa baith aa kayl karay.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਦਰੀਆਵੈ ਕੰਨੈ  ਬਗੁਲਾ  ਬੈਠਾ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: While it is playing, a hawk suddenly pounces on it.
lines.transliteration: kayl karayday hanjh  no achint ay baaj pa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਦੇ  ਹੰਝ ਨੋ ਅਿਚੰਤੇ  ਬਾਜ ਪਏ ॥
lines.english: When the Hawk of God attacks, playful sport is forgotten.
lines.transliteration: baaj pa-ay tis rab d ay kaylaaN visree-aaN.

lines.english: God does what is not expected or even considered. ||99||
lines.transliteration: jo man chit na chayt ay san so gaalee rab kee-aaN. ||99||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਮਿਨ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਚੇਤੇ ਸਿਨ ਸੋ ਗਾਲੀ  ਰਬ ਕੀਆਂ ॥੯੯॥
lines.english: The body is nourished by water and grain.
lines.transliteration: saadhay t arai man  dayhuree chalai paan ee ann.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਢੇ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਮਣ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਪਾਣੀ  ਅੰਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal comes into the world with high hopes.
lines.transliteration: aa-i-o bandaa d unee vich vat  aasoon ee baneh.

lines.punjabi: ਆਇਓ  ਬੰਦਾ ਦੁਨੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਿਤ ਆਸੂਣੀ  ਬੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: But when the Messenger of Death comes, it breaks down all the doors.
lines.transliteration: malkal ma-ut jaaN aavsee sabh  darvaajay bh ann.

lines.punjabi: ਮਲਕਲ  ਮਉਤ  ਜ ਆਵਸੀ ਸਭ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ  ਭੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: It binds and gags the mortal, before the eyes of his beloved brothers.
lines.transliteration: tinHaa pi-aari-aa bh aa-ee-aaN agai d itaa baneh.

lines.english: Behold, the mortal being is going away, carried on the shoulders of four men.
lines.transliteration: vaykhhu band aa chali-aa chahu jan i-aa d ai kaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਚਿਲਆ  ਚਹੁ ਜਿਣਆ  ਦੈ ਕੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: Fareed, only those good deeds done in the world will be of any use in the Court of the Lord. ||100||
lines.transliteration: fareedaa amal je keet ay dunee vich d argeh aa-ay kamm. ||100||

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਅਮਲ  ਿਜ ਕੀਤੇ  ਦੁਨੀ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਦਰਗਹ  ਆਏ  ਕੰਿਮ ॥੧੦੦॥
lines.english: Fareed, I am a sacrifice to those birds which live in the jungle.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa ha-o balihaaree t inH pankh ee-aa jangal jinHaa vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਹਉ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਿਤਨ ਪੰਖੀਆ  ਜੰਗਿਲ  ਿਜੰਨਾ  ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: They peck at the roots and live on the ground, but they do not leave the Lord's side.||101||
lines.transliteration: kakar chugan thal vasan rab na chhodan paas. ||101||

lines.punjabi: ਕਕਰੁ ਚੁਗਿਨ  ਥਿਲ ਵਸਿਨ  ਰਬ ਨ ਛੋਡਿਨ  ਪਾਸੁ ॥੧੦੧॥
lines.english: Fareed, the seasons change, the woods shake and the leaves drop from the trees.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa rut  firee van  kambi-aa pat  jharhay jharh paahi.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਰੁਿਤ ਿਫਰੀ  ਵਣੁ ਕੰਿਬਆ  ਪਤ ਝੜੇ ਝਿੜ ਪਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: I have searched in the four directions, but I have not found any resting place anywhere. ||102||
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa dhooNdhee-aaN rahan  kithaa-oo naahi. ||102||

lines.english: Fareed, I have torn my clothes to tatters; now I wear only a rough blanket.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa paarh  patolaa Dh aj karee kamblarh ee pahiray-o.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਪਾਿੜ ਪਟੋਲਾ  ਧਜ ਕਰੀ ਕੰਬਲੜੀ  ਪਿਹਰੇਉ  ॥
lines.english: I wear only those clothes which will lead me to meet my Lord. ||103|| mÚ 3 ] (1383-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jinHee vaysee saho milai say-ee vays karay-o. ||103||

lines.english: Why do you tear apart your fine clothes, and take to wearing a rough blanket?
lines.transliteration: kaa-ay patolaa paarh-t ee kamblarh ee pahiray-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, even sitting in your own home, you can meet the Lord, if your mind is in theright place. ||104|| mÚ 5 ] (1383-13) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: naanak ghar hee baith i-aa saho milai jay nee-at  raas karay-i. ||104||

lines.english: Fareed, those who are very proud of their greatness, wealth and youth,
lines.transliteration: fareedaa garab jinHaa vad i-aa-ee-aa Dh an joban aagaah.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਘਰ ਹੀ ਬੈਿਠਆ  ਸਹੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਜੇ ਨੀਅਿਤ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਕਰੇਇ  ॥੧੦੪॥
lines.transliteration: khaalee chalay Dh anee si-o tibay ji-o meehahu. ||105|| shall return empty-handed from their Lord, like sandhills after the rain. ||105||

lines.english: Fareed, the faces of those who forget the Lord's Name are dreadful.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa t inaa mukh  daraavan ay jinaa visaari-on naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਗਰਬੁ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਧਿਨ ਜੋਬਿਨ  ਆਗਾਹ  ॥
lines.english: They suffer terrible pain here, and hereafter they find no place of rest or refuge. ||106||
lines.transliteration: aithai dukh  ghanayri-aa agai th a-ur na th aa-o. ||106||

lines.english: Fareed, if you do not awaken in the early hours before dawn, you are dead while yetalive.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa pichh al raat  na jaagi-ohi jeevad -rho mu-i-ohi.

lines.english: Although you have forgotten God, God has not forgotten you. ||107|| mÚ 5 ] (1383-16) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay tai rab visaari-aa t a rab na visari-ohi. ||107||

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇਿਰਆ  ਅਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ  ॥੧੦੬॥
lines.english: Fareed, my Husband Lord is full of joy; He is Great and Self-sufficient.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa kant  rangvaalaa vadaa vaymuht aaj.

lines.punjabi: ਫਰੀਦਾ  ਿਪਛਲ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਨ ਜਾਿਗਓਿਹ  ਜੀਵਦੜੋ  ਮੁਇਓਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: To be imbued with the Lord God - this is the most beautiful decoration. ||108|| mÚ 5 ] (1383-17) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: alah saytee rat i-aa ayhu sachaavaaN saaj. ||108||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੈ ਰਬੁ ਿਵਸਾਿਰਆ  ਤ ਰਿਬ ਨ ਿਵਸਿਰਓਿਹ  ॥੧੦੭॥
lines.english: Fareed, look upon pleasure and pain as the same; eradicate corruption from your heart.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d ukh sukh  ik kar d il tay laahi vikaar.

lines.english: Whatever pleases the Lord God is good; understand this, and you will reach His Court.||109|| mÚ 5 ] (1383-18) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: alah bhaavai so bh alaa t aaN labhee darbaar. ||109||

lines.english: Fareed, the world dances as it dances, and you dance with it as well.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d unee vajaa-ee vajd ee tooN bhee vajeh naal.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਹ  ਸੇਤੀ ਰਿਤਆ  ਏਹੁ ਸਚਾਵ  ਸਾਜੁ ॥੧੦੮॥
lines.english: That soul alone does not dance with it, who is under the care of the Lord God. ||110|| mÚ 5 ] (1383-19) mehlaa 5. Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: so-ee jee-o na vajdaa jis alhu kard aa saar. ||110||

lines.english: Fareed, the heart is imbued with this world, but the world is of no use to it at all. pMnw 1384
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d il rataa is d unee si-o d unee na kit ai kamm.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਸਲ  ਫਕੀਰ  ਗਾਖੜੀ  ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਿਮ  ॥੧੧੧॥
lines.english: It is so difficult to be like the fakeers - the Holy Saints; it is only achieved by perfect karma. ||111||
lines.transliteration: misal fakeeraaN gaakh-rh ee so paa-ee-ai poor karamm. ||111||

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲੈ  ਪਹਰੈ  ਫੁਲੜਾ  ਫਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਛਾ ਰਾਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: The first watch of the night brings flowers, and the later watches of the night bring fruit.
lines.transliteration: pahilai pahrai fulrhaa fal bh ee pachh aa raat .

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੰਿਨ  ਲਹੰਿਨ  ਸੇ ਸਾਈ  ਕੰਨੋ ਦਾਿਤ  ॥੧੧੨॥
lines.english: Those who remain awake and aware, receive the gifts from the Lord. ||112||
lines.transliteration: jo jaagaNniH lahann say saa-ee kanno daat . ||112||

lines.english: The gifts are from our Lord and Master; who can force Him to bestow them?
lines.transliteration: daatee saahib sand ee-aa ki-aa chalai t is naal.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ  ਨਾ ਲਹਿਨ  ਇਕਨਾ  ਸੁਿਤਆ  ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਿਲ  ॥੧੧੩॥
lines.english: Some are awake, and do not receive them, while He awakens others from sleep tobless them. ||113||
lines.transliteration: ik jaaganday naa lahniH iknHaa sut i-aa d ay-ay uth aal. ||113||

lines.punjabi: ਢੂਢੇਦੀਏ  ਸੁਹਾਗ  ਕੂ ਤਉ ਤਿਨ  ਕਾਈ  ਕੋਰ ॥
lines.english: You search for your Husband Lord; you must have some fault in your body.
lines.transliteration: dhoodh aydee-ay suhaag koo t a-o tan kaa-ee kor.

lines.english: Those who are known as happy soul-brides, do not look to others. ||114||
lines.transliteration: jinHaa naa-o suhaaganee t inHaa jhaak na hor. ||114||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਰ  ਮੰਝ ਕਮਾਣ  ਏ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਨੀਹਣੋ  ॥
lines.english: Within yourself, make patience the bow, and make patience the bowstring.
lines.transliteration: sabar manjh kamaan  ay sabar kaa neehn o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਰ  ਸੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ  ਖਾਲਕੁ  ਖਤਾ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥੧੧੫॥
lines.english: Make patience the arrow, the Creator will not let you miss the target. ||115||
lines.transliteration: sabar sandaa baan  khaalak kh ataa na karee. ||115||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਰ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸਾਬਰੀ  ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਲੇਿਨ ॥
lines.english: Those who are patient abide in patience; in this way, they burn their bodies.
lines.transliteration: sabar andar saabree t an ayvai jaalayniH.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਿਨ ਨਜੀਿਕ  ਖੁਦਾਇ  ਦੈ ਭੇਤੁ ਨ ਿਕਸੈ ਦੇਿਨ  ॥੧੧੬॥
lines.english: They are close to the Lord, but they do not reveal their secret to anyone. ||116||
lines.transliteration: hon najeek khud aa-ay d ai bhayt na kisai d ayn. ||116||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ  ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੰਦਾ  ਿਦੜੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Let patience be your purpose in life; implant this within your being.
lines.transliteration: sabar ayhu su-aa-o jay tooN band aa dirh karahi.

lines.punjabi: ਵਿਧ ਥੀਵਿਹ  ਦਰੀਆਉ  ਟੁਿਟ ਨ ਥੀਵਿਹ  ਵਾਹੜਾ  ॥੧੧੭॥
lines.english: In this way, you will grow into a great river; you will not break off into a tiny stream. ||117||
lines.transliteration: vaDh theeveh d aree-aa-o tut na theeveh vaahrh aa. ||117||

lines.english: Fareed, it is difficult to be a dervish - a Holy Saint; it is easier to love bread when it isbuttered.
lines.transliteration: fareedaa d arvaysee gaakh -rhee choprh ee pareet .

lines.english: Only a rare few follow the way of the Saints. ||118||
lines.transliteration: ikan kinai chaalee-ai darvaysaavee reet . ||118||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਤਪੈ ਤਨੂਰ ਿਜਉ  ਬਾਲਣੁ  ਹਡ ਬਲੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: My body is cooking like an oven; my bones are burning like firewood.
lines.transliteration: tan tapai t anoor ji-o baalan  had balaNniH.

lines.english: If my feet become tired, I will walk on my head, if I can meet my Beloved. ||119||
lines.transliteration: pairee thakaaN sir julaaN jay mooN piree milaNniH. ||119||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਨ ਤਪਾਇ  ਤਨੂਰ ਿਜਉ  ਬਾਲਣੁ  ਹਡ ਨ ਬਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Do not heat up your body like an oven, and do not burn your bones like firewood.
lines.transliteration: tan na t apaa-ay t anoor ji-o baalan  had na baal.

lines.english: What harm have your feet and head done to you? Behold your Beloved withinyourself. ||120||
lines.transliteration: sir pairee ki-aa fayrhi-aa and ar piree nihaal. ||120||

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ  ਸਜਣਾ  ਸਜਣੁ  ਮੈਡੇ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: I search for my Friend, but my Friend is already with me.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhoodh aydee sajn aa sajan  maiday naal.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਨ ਲਖੀਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਦੇਇ ਿਦਖਾਿਲ  ॥੧੨੧॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Unseen Lord cannot be seen; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh. ||121||
lines.transliteration: naanak alakh na lakh ee-ai gurmukh  day-ay d ikhaal. ||121||

lines.punjabi: ਹੰਸਾ ਦੇਿਖ ਤਰੰਿਦਆ  ਬਗਾ  ਆਇਆ  ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing the swans swimming, the cranes became excited.
lines.transliteration: hansaa daykh  tarand i-aa bagaa aa-i-aa chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਡੁਿਬ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ  ਿਸਰੁ ਤਿਲ  ਉਪਿਰ ਪਾਉ ॥੧੨੨॥
lines.english: The poor cranes were drowned to death, with their heads below the water and theirfeet sticking out above. ||122||
lines.transliteration: dub mu-ay bag bapurhay sir t al upar paa-o. ||122||

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤ ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ  ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: I knew him as a great swan, so I associated with him.
lines.transliteration: mai jaani-aa vad hans hai t aaN mai keet aa sang.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ  ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ  ਜਨਿਮ  ਨ ਭੇੜੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੧੨੩॥
lines.english: If I had known that he was a only wretched crane, I would never in my life havecrossed paths with him. ||123||
lines.transliteration: jay jaanaa bag bapurh aa janam na bh ayrhee ang. ||123||

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਆ  ਹੰਸੁ ਿਕਆ  ਬਗੁਲਾ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Who is a swan, and who is a crane, if God blesses him with His Glance of Grace?
lines.transliteration: ki-aa hans ki-aa bagulaa jaa ka-o nadar Dh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਿਤਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੨੪॥
lines.english: If it pleases Him, O Nanak, He changes a crow into a swan. ||124||
lines.transliteration: jay tis bh aavai naankaa kaagahu hans karay. ||124||

lines.english: There is only one bird in the lake, but there are fifty trappers.
lines.transliteration: sarvar pankhee haykrh o faaheevaal pachaas.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ  ਗਡੁ ਿਥਆ  ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ  ॥੧੨੫॥
lines.english: This body is caught in the waves of desire. O my True Lord, You are my only hope! ||125||
lines.transliteration: ih tan lahree gad thi-aa sachay t ayree aas. ||125||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਣੁ  ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ  ਗੁਣੁ ਕਵਣੁ  ਸੁ ਮਣੀਆ  ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: What is that word, what is that virtue, and what is that magic mantra?
lines.transliteration: kavan so akh ar kavan  gun kavan  so man ee-aa mant .

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਣੁ  ਸੁ ਵੇਸੋ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਿਜਤੁ  ਵਿਸ ਆਵੈ  ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੬॥
lines.english: What are those clothes, which I can wear to captivate my Husband Lord? ||126||
lines.transliteration: kavan so vayso ha-o karee jit  vas aavai kant . ||126||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਖਵਣੁ  ਗੁਣੁ ਿਜਹਬਾ  ਮਣੀਆ  ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.english: Humility is the word, forgiveness is the virtue, and sweet speech is the magic mantra.
lines.transliteration: nivan so akh ar khavan gun jihbaa man ee-aa mant .

lines.punjabi: ਏ ਤਰ੍ੈ ਭੈਣੇ  ਵੇਸ ਕਿਰ ਤ ਵਿਸ ਆਵੀ  ਕੰਤੁ ॥੧੨੭॥
lines.english: Wear these three robes, O sister, and you will captivate your Husband Lord. ||127||
lines.transliteration: ay tarai bh ainay vays kar t aaN vas aavee kant . ||127||

lines.english: If you are wise, be simple;
lines.transliteration: mat hod ee ho-ay i-aan aa.
taan hoday ho-ay nit aanaa. if you are powerful, be weak;
anhod ay aap vandaa-ay. and when there is nothing to share, then share with others.

lines.english: How rare is one who is known as such a devotee. ||128||
lines.transliteration: ko aisaa bhagat  sadaa-ay. ||128||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਫਕਾ  ਨ ਗਾਲਾਇ  ਸਭਨਾ  ਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.english: Do not utter even a single harsh word; your True Lord and Master abides in all.
lines.transliteration: ik fikaa na gaalaa-ay sabhnaa mai sachaa Dh anee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਹਆਉ  ਨ ਕੈਹੀ ਠਾਿਹ  ਮਾਣਕ  ਸਭ ਅਮੋਲਵੇ  ॥੧੨੯॥
lines.english: Do not break anyone's heart; these are all priceless jewels. ||129||
lines.transliteration: hi-aa-o na kaihee thaahi maan ak sabh  amolvay. ||129||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਣਕ  ਠਾਹਣੁ  ਮੂਿਲ ਮਚਗਵਾ  ॥
lines.english: The minds of all are like precious jewels; to harm them is not good at all.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa man maan ik thaahan  mool machaaNgvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤਉ ਿਪਰੀਆ  ਦੀ ਿਸਕ ਿਹਆਉ  ਨ ਠਾਹੇ ਕਹੀ ਦਾ ॥੧੩੦॥
lines.english: If you desire your Beloved, then do not break anyone's heart. ||130|| pMnw 1385 <> siq nwmu krqw purKu inrBau inrvYru Akwl mUriq AjUnI sYBM gur pRswid ] (1385-1) ik-oNkaar sat naam kart aa purakh  nirbh a-o nirvair akaal moorat  ajoonee saibh aN gur parsaad. One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace: svXy sRI muKbwk´ mhlw 5 ] (1385-3) sava-yay saree mukhbaak-y mehlaa 5. Swaiyas From The Mouth Of The Great Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jay ta-o piree-aa d ee sik hi-aa-o na th aahay kahee d aa. ||130||

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O Primal Lord God, You Yourself are the Creator, the Cause of all causes.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  kartaar karan  kaaran  sabh  aapay.

lines.english: You are All-pervading everywhere, totally filling all hearts.
lines.transliteration: sarab rahi-o bharpoor sagal gh at rahi-o bi-aapay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਕਰਤਾਰ  ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਭ ਆਪੇ  ॥
lines.english: You are seen pervading the world; who can know Your State? You protect all; You are our Lord and Master.
lines.transliteration: ba-yaapat d aykhee-ai jagat  jaanai ka-un t ayree gat  sarab kee rakh -yaa karai aapay har pat.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਭਰਪੂਿਰ  ਸਗਲ  ਘਟ ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਬਆਪੇ  ॥
lines.english: O my Imperishable and Formless Lord, You formed Yourself.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee abigat  aapay aap ut pat.

lines.punjabi: ਬਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਪਤੁ  ਦੇਖੀਐ  ਜਗਿਤ  ਜਾਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਿਤ  ਸਰਬ  ਕੀ ਰਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ ਕਰੈ ਆਪੇ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਤ ॥
lines.english: You are the One and Only; no one else is like You.
lines.transliteration: aykai toohee aykai an naahee t um bh at.

lines.english: O Lord, You have no end or limitation. Who can contemplate You? You are the Fatherof the world, the Support of all life.
lines.transliteration: har ant naahee paaraavaar ka-un hai karai beechaar jagat  pitaa hai sarab paraan ko aDhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕੈ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤੁਮ ਭਿਤ ॥
lines.english: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servantNanak describe them with only one tongue?
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bhagat  dar tul barahm samsar ayk jeeh ki-aa bakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਹੈ ਸਰ੍ਬ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||1||
lines.transliteration: haaN ke bal bal bal bal sad balihaar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਦਿਰ ਤੁਿਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਿਕਆ  ਬਖਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Streams of Ambrosial Nectar flow; Your Treasures are unweighable and overflowing inabundance. You are the Farthest of the far, Infinite and Incomparably Beautiful.
lines.transliteration: amrit parvaah sar at ul bhandaar bh ar parai hee t ay parai apar apaar par.

lines.punjabi: ਹ ਿਕ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You do whatever You please; You do not take advice from anyone else. In YourHome, creation and destruction happen in an instant.
lines.transliteration: aapuno bhaavan kar mant ar na d oosro Dh ar opat  parloua aykai nimakh  to ghar.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਪਰ੍ਵਾਹ  ਸਿਰ ਅਤੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਭਿਰ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਪਿਰ ॥
lines.english: No one else is equal to You; Your Light is Immaculate and Pure. Millions of sins are washed away, chanting Your Name, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: aan naahee samsar ujee-aaro nirmar kot paraachhat  jaahi naam lee-ay har har.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁਨੋ  ਭਾਵਨੁ ਕਿਰ ਮੰਿਤਰ੍ ਨ ਦੂਸਰੋ  ਧਿਰ ਓਪਿਤ  ਪਰਲੌ ਏਕੈ ਿਨਮਖ  ਤੁ ਘਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Your devotees are at Your Door, God - they are just like You. How can servant Nanakdescribe them with only one tongue?
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bhagat  dar tul barahm samsar ayk jeeh ki-aa bakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਉਜੀਆਰੋ  ਿਨਰਮਿਰ  ਕੋਿਟ ਪਰਾਛਤ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਨਾਮ ਲੀਏ ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||
lines.transliteration: haaN ke bal bal bal bal sad balihaar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਦਿਰ ਤੁਿਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਿਕਆ  ਬਖਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: You established all the worlds from within Yourself, and extended them outward. Youare All-pervading amongst all, and yet You Yourself remain detached.
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan Dh aaray ayk thayN kee-ay bisthaaray poor rahi-o sarab meh aap hai niraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਹ ਿਕ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: O Lord, there is no end or limit to Your Glorious Virtues; all beings and creatures areYours. You are the Giver of all, the One Invisible Lord. pMnw 1386
lines.transliteration: har gun naahee ant paaray jee-a jant  sabh  thaaray sagal ko d aataa aykai alakh muraaray.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਧਾਰਨ  ਧਾਰੇ ਕੁਦਰਿਤ  ਹੈ ਦੇਖਾਰੇ  ਬਰਨੁ ਿਚਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੁਖ ਨ ਮਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself supports the Universe, revealing His All-powerful Creative Potency. He hasno color, form, mouth or beard.
lines.transliteration: aap hee Dhaaran Dh aaray kud rat hai d aykhaaray baran chihan naahee mukh  na masaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਦਿਰ ਤੁਿਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਿਕਆ  ਬਖਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servantNanak describe them with only one tongue?
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bhagat  dar tul barahm samsar ayk jeeh ki-aa bakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਹ ਿਕ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||3||
lines.transliteration: haaN ke bal bal bal bal sad balihaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਧਾਨੰ  ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਨ ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੰ  ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੰ ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚੌ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਥਾਨੰ ॥
lines.english: You are the Treasure of all virtue; who can know the value of Your spiritual wisdom and meditation? O God, Your Place is known as the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: sarab gun niDh aanaN keemat  na ga-yaana Dh a-yaana oochay t ay oochou jaaneejai parabh t ayro thaanaN.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੰ ਏਕੈ ਸੂਿਤ ਹੈ ਜਹਾਨੰ  ਕਵਨ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਦੇਉ ਬਡੇ ਤੇ ਬਡਾਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: Mind, wealth and the breath of life belong to You alone, Lord. The world is strungupon Your Thread. What praises can I give to You? You are the Greatest of the great.
lines.transliteration: man Dhan t ayro paraanaN aykai soot  hai jahaanaN kavan upmaa d ay-o baday t ay badaanaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਭੇਉ ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਦੇਉ ਅਕਲ  ਕਲਾ ਹੈ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਰਬ  ਕੋ ਧਾਨੰ ॥
lines.english: Who can know Your Mystery? O Unfathomable, Infinite, Divine Lord, Your Power isunstoppable. O God, You are the Support of all.
lines.transliteration: jaanai ka-un tayro bh ay-o alakh  apaar d ay-o akal kalaa hai parabh  sarab ko Dh aanaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨੁਨਾਨਕੁ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਦਿਰ ਤੁਿਲ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਿਕਆ  ਬਖਾਨੈ  ॥
lines.english: Your devotees are at Your Door, O God - they are just like You. How can servantNanak describe them with only one tongue?
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bhagat  dar tul barahm samsar ayk jeeh ki-aa bakh aanai.

lines.punjabi: ਹ ਿਕ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਬਿਲ  ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||
lines.transliteration: haaN ke bal bal bal bal sad balihaar. ||4||

lines.english: O Formless, Formed, Undeceivable, Perfect, Imperishable,
lines.transliteration: nirankaar aakaar achhal pooran abh inaasee.

lines.english: Blissful, Unlimited, Beautiful, Immaculate, Blossoming Lord:
lines.transliteration: harakhvant  aanant  roop nirmal bigaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਬੇਅੰਤ  ਅੰਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਨਹੀ ਪਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: Countless are those who sing Your Glorious Praises, but they do not know even a tiny bit of Your extent.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi bay-ant  ant ik til nahee paasee.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਂਿਹ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਤੁਮਿਹ  ਿਮਲਾਸੀ  ॥
lines.english: That humble being upon whom You shower Your Mercy meets with You, O God.
lines.transliteration: jaa ka-o hoNhi kirpaal so jan parabh t umeh milaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਤੇ ਧੰਿਨ ਜਨ ਿਜਹ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਭਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an tay Dh an jan jih kirpaal har har bh a-ya-o. Blessed, blessed, blessed are those humble beings, upon whom the Lord, Har, Har,showers His Mercy.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਿਜਨ ਪਰਿਸਅਉ  ਿਸ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਹ ਥੇ ਰਿਹਓ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: Whoever meets with the Lord through Guru Nanak is rid of both birth and death. ||5||
lines.transliteration: har gur naanak jin parsi-o se janam maran d uh thay rahi-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਸਿਤ ਸਤੇ ਸਿਤ ਭਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is said to be True, True, True, True, the Truest of the True.
lines.transliteration: sat sat  har sat  sat satay sat  bhanee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਸਰ ਆਨ  ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਊਰਾਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: There is no other like Him. He is the Primal Being, the Primal Soul.
lines.transliteration: doosar aan na avar purakh  pa-uraat an sun ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਮਿਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Chanting the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, the mortal is blessed with all comforts.
lines.transliteration: amrit har ko naam lait  man sabh  sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇਹ ਰਸਨ ਚਾਿਖਓ  ਤੇਹ ਜਨ ਿਤਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਅਘਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: Those who taste it with their tongues, those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: jayh rasan chaakhi-o t ayh jan t aripat  aghaa-ay.

lines.english: That person who becomes pleasing to his Lord and Master, loves the Sat Sangat, theTrue Congregation.
lines.transliteration: jih thaakur suparsan bh a-yo sat sangat  tih pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਨ ਪਰਿਸਓ  ਿਤਨ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕੀਓ  ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Whoever meets with the Lord through Guru Nanak, saves all his generations. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har gur naanak jinH parsi-o tinH sabh  kul kee-o uDh aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ  ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਿਹ ਧਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: True is His Congregation and His Court. The True Lord has established Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach sabhaa d eebaan  sach sachay peh Dh ari-o.

lines.english: Sitting upon His Throne of Truth, He administers True Justice.
lines.transliteration: sachai takh at nivaas sach t apaavas kari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਚ ਿਸਰਿਜਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਆਿਪ  ਆਭੁਲੁ  ਨ ਭੁਲਉ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself fashioned the Universe. He is Infallible, and does not make mistakes.
lines.transliteration: sach sirji-ya-o sansaar aap aabhul na bh ula-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਕੀਮ ਨਹੁ ਪਵੈ ਅਮੁਲਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord, is the jewel. Its value cannot be appraised -it is priceless.
lines.transliteration: ratan naam apaar keem nahu pavai amula-o.

lines.english: That person, upon whom the Lord of the Universe showers His Mercy obtains allcomforts.
lines.transliteration: jih kirpaal ho-ya-o gobind sarab sukh  tinhoo paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਿਜਨ ਪਰਿਸਓ  ਤੇ ਬਹੁਿੜ ਿਫਿਰ  ਜੋਿਨ ਨ ਆਏ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who touch the Feet of the Lord through Guru Nanak, do not have to enter thecycle of reincarnation ever again. ||7||
lines.transliteration: har gur naanak jinH parsi-o tay bahurh  fir jon na aa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਕਵਨ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਉਸ੍ਤਿਤ ਕਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: What is the Yoga, what is the spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what is the way,to praise the Lord?
lines.transliteration: kavan jog ka-un ga-yaan Dhayaan kavan biDh  ustat karee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਕੋਿਰ ਿਤਰੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਰੀਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas and seekers and the three hundred thirty million gods cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord's Value.
lines.transliteration: siDh saaDh ik taytees kor t ir keem na paree-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਿਦਕ  ਸਨਕਾਿਦ  ਸੇਖ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: Neither Brahma, nor Sanak, nor the thousand-headed serpent king can find the limitsof His Glorious Virtues.
lines.transliteration: barahmaadik sankaad  saykh  gun ant na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਹੁ ਗਿਹਓ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ  ਪੂਿਰ ਸਰ੍ਬ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: The Inapprehensible Lord cannot be apprehended. He is pervading and permeatingamongst all.
lines.transliteration: agahu gahi-o nahee jaa-ay poor sarab rahi-o samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਕਾਟੀ  ਿਸਲਕ  ਦਯਾਲ  ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਸੇਇ ਜਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਗਤੇ  ॥
lines.english: Those whom God has mercifully freed from their nooses - those humble beings areattached to His devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: jih kaatee silak da-yaal parabh  say-ay jan lagay bh agtay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਜਨ ਪਰਿਸਓ  ਤੇ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Those who meet with the Lord through Guru Nanak are liberated forever, here andhereafter. ||8||
lines.transliteration: har gur naanak jinH parsi-o tay it  ut sadaa mukt ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਭ ਦਾਤਉ  ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪਿਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਜਾਚਕੁ  ਇਕੁ ਸਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: I am a beggar; I seek the Sanctuary of God, the Giver of givers.
lines.transliteration: parabh d aata-o daataar pari-ya-o jaachak ik sarnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਲੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਜੇਹ ਲਿਗ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਰਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Please bless me with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints; grasping them, Icross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: milai daan sant  rayn jayh lag bh a-ojal t arnaa.

lines.english: Please listen to my prayer, if it pleases You, O my Lord and Master. pMnw 1387
lines.transliteration: binat kara-o ard aas sunhu jay th aakur bh aavai.

lines.english: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. This mind abides in devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: dayh d aras man chaa-o bh agat ih man th ehraavai.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਚਾਉ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The lamp is lit in the darkness; all are saved in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, through theOne Name and faith in the Dharma.
lines.transliteration: bali-o charaag anDh-yaar meh sabh  kal uDh ree ik naam Dh aram.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਓ  ਚਰਾਗੁ  ਅੰਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਰ  ਮਿਹ ਸਭ ਕਿਲ  ਉਧਰੀ  ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਧਰਮ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is revealed in all the worlds. O servant Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme LordGod. ||9|| svXy sRI muKbwk´ mhlw 5  (1387-3) sava-yay saree mukhbaak-y mehlaa 5 Swaiyas From The Mouth Of The Great Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1387-3) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: pargat sagal har bhavan meh jan naanak gur paarbarahm. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਸਗਲ  ਹਿਰ ਭਵਨ  ਮਿਹ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: This body is frail and transitory, and bound to emotional attachment. I am foolish,stone-hearted, filthy and unwise.
lines.transliteration: kaachee dayh moh fun baaNDhee sath  kathor kucheel kugi-aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਵਯੇ  ਸਰ੍ੀ ਮੁਖਬਾਕਯ੍ਯ੍  ਮਹਲਾ  ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaavat  bharmat  rahan nahee paavat  paarbarahm kee gat  nahee jaanee. My mind wanders and wobbles, and will not hold steady. It does not know the state ofthe Supreme Lord God.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਚੀ  ਦੇਹ ਮੋਹ ਫੁਿਨ ਬਧੀ  ਸਠ ਕਠੋਰ  ਕੁਚੀਲ  ਕੁਿਗਆਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I am intoxicated with the wine of youth, beauty and the riches of Maya. I wanderaround perplexed, in excessive egotistical pride.
lines.transliteration: joban roop maa-i-aa mad maat aa bichrat  bikal badou abh imaanee.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਤ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਤ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਕੀ ਗਿਤ  ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The wealth and women of others, arguments and slander, are sweet and dear to my soul.
lines.transliteration: par Dhan par apvaad  naar nind aa yeh meeth ee jee-a maahi hit aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਬਨ  ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ  ਿਬਚਰਤ  ਿਬਕਲ  ਬਡੌ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I try to hide my deception, but God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts, seesand hears all.
lines.transliteration: balbanch chhap karat  upaavaa paykh at sunat  parabh  antarjaamee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਅਪਵਾਦ  ਨਾਿਰ  ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਯਹ ਮੀਠੀ  ਜੀਅ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਿਹਤਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have no humility, faith, compassion or purity, but I seek Your Sanctuary, O Giver oflife.
lines.transliteration: seel Dharam d a-yaa such naasit  aa-i-o saran jee-a kay d aanee.

lines.punjabi: ਬਲਬੰਚ  ਛਿਪ ਕਰਤ  ਉਪਾਵਾ  ਪੇਖਤ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ  ॥
lines.english: The All-powerful Lord is the Cause of causes. O Lord and Master of Nanak, pleasesave me! ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaaran karan  samrath sireeDh ar raakh  layho naanak kay su-aamee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਲ  ਧਰਮ  ਦਯਾ  ਸੁਚ ਨਾਿਸ੍ਤ  ਆਇਓ  ਸਰਿਨ  ਜੀਅ  ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Praises of the Creator, the Enticer of the mind, are potent to destroy sins.
lines.transliteration: keerat karan saran manmohan johan paap bid aaran ka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਰਣ  ਕਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥ ਿਸਰੀਧਰ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The All-powerful Lord is the boat, to carry us across; He saves all our generations.
lines.transliteration: har taaran t aran samrath sabh ai biDh  kulah samooh uDh aaran sa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕਰਨ  ਸਰਨ  ਮਨਮੋਹਨ  ਜੋਹਨ  ਪਾਪ ਿਬਦਾਰਨ  ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: O my unconscious mind, contemplate and remember Him in the Sat Sangat, the TrueCongregation. Why are you wandering around, enticed by the darkness of doubt?
lines.transliteration: chit chayt  achayt  jaan sat sangat  bharam anDh ayr mohi-o kat  DhaN-u.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਤਾਰਨ  ਤਰਨ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਸਭੈ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕੁਲਹ  ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਨ  ਸਉ ॥
lines.english: Remember Him in meditation, for an hour, for a moment, even for an instant. Chantthe Name of the Lord with your tongue.
lines.transliteration: moorat gh aree chasaa pal simran raam naam rasnaa sang la-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤ  ਚੇਿਤ  ਅਚੇਤ  ਜਾਿਨ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਭਰਮ  ਅੰਧੇਰ  ਮੋਿਹਓ  ਕਤ ਧਂਉ ॥
lines.english: You are bound to worthless deeds and shallow pleasures; why do you spend millions of lifetimes wandering in such pain?
lines.transliteration: hochha-o kaaj alap sukh  banDh an kot jannam kahaa d ukh bhaN-u.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਤ ਘਰੀ  ਚਸਾ ਪਲੁ ਿਸਮਰਨ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਲਉ ॥
lines.english: Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, through the Teachings of theSaints. Meditate on the Lord with love in your soul. ||2||
lines.transliteration: sikh-yaa sant  naam bh aj naanak raam rang aat am si-o raN-u. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਛਉ  ਕਾਜੁ ਅਲਪ  ਸੁਖ ਬੰਧਨ  ਕੋਿਟ ਜਨੰਮ  ਕਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਭਂਉ ॥
lines.english: The little sperm is planted in the body-field of the mother, and the human body, sodifficult to obtain, is formed.
lines.transliteration: ranchak rayt kh ayt tan nirmit  durlabh  dayh savaar Dh aree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ  ਸੰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਰੰਿਗ ਆਤਮ  ਿਸਉ ਰਂਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He eats and drinks, and enjoys pleasures; his pains are taken away, and his sufferingis gone.
lines.transliteration: khaan paan soDh ay sukh  bhuNchat sankat kaat bipat  haree.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਚਕ  ਰੇਤ ਖੇਤ ਤਿਨ  ਿਨਰਿਮਤ  ਦੁਰਲਭ  ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ਧਰੀ ॥
lines.english: He is given the understanding to recognize mother, father, siblings and relatives.
lines.transliteration: maat pit aa bh aa-ee ar banDh ap boojh an kee sabh  soojh  paree.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸੋਧੇ ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚਤ  ਸੰਕਟ  ਕਾਿਟ ਿਬਪਿਤ  ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.english: He grows day by day, as the horrible specter of old age comes closer and closer.
lines.transliteration: baraDhmaan hovat  din parat  nit aavat  nikat bikh amm jaree.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਤ ਿਪਤਾ  ਭਾਈ  ਅਰੁ ਬੰਧਪ  ਬੂਝਨ  ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੂਝ ਪਰੀ ॥
lines.english: You worthless, petty worm of Maya - remember your Lord and Master, at least for aninstant!
lines.transliteration: ray gun heen deen maa-i-aa kiram simar su-aamee ayk gh aree.

lines.english: Please take Nanak's hand, O Merciful Ocean of Mercy, and take away this heavy loadof doubt. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kar geh layho kirpaal kirpaa niDh naanak kaat bh aramm bh aree. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਕਰ੍ਮ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਏਕ ਘਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: O mind, you are a mouse, living in the mousehole of the body; you are so proud of yourself, but you act like an absolute fool.
lines.transliteration: ray man moos bilaa meh garbat kart ab karat  mahaaN mugh naaN.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੁ ਗਿਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾਲ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਾਿਟ  ਭਰੰਮ  ਭਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.english: You swing in the swing of wealth, intoxicated with Maya, and you wander around likean owl.
lines.transliteration: sampat d ol jhol sang jh oolat maa-i-aa magan bh armat  ghughnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂਸ ਿਬਲਾ  ਮਿਹ ਗਰਬਤ  ਕਰਤਬ  ਕਰਤ ਮਹ ਮੁਘਨ ॥
lines.english: You take pleasure in your children, spouse, friends and relatives; your emotionalattachment to them is increasing.
lines.transliteration: sut banit aa saajan sukh  banDh ap taa si-o moh badh i-o so gh anaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਪਤ  ਦੋਲ ਝੋਲ ਸੰਿਗ  ਝੂਲਤ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਗਨ  ਭਰ੍ਮਤ  ਘੁਘਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: You have planted the seeds of egotism, and the sprout of possessiveness has comeup. You pass your life making sinful mistakes.
lines.transliteration: bo-i-o beej ahaN mam ankur beetat  a-oDh  karat  aghnaaN.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤ ਬਿਨਤਾ  ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੁਖ ਬੰਧਪ  ਤਾ ਿਸਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਢਓ  ਸੁ ਘਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The cat of death, with his mouth wide-open, is watching you. You eat food, but youare still hungry.
lines.transliteration: mirat manjaar pasaar mukh  nirkh at bhuNchat bhugat bhookh bhukhnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਇਓ  ਬੀਜੁ ਅਹੰ ਮਮ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਬੀਤਤ  ਅਉਧ  ਕਰਤ  ਅਘਨ ॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Merciful Lord of the World, O Nanak, in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Know that the world is just a dream. ||4|| pMnw 1388
lines.transliteration: simar gupaal da-i-aal sat sangat  naanak jag jaanat  supnaa. ||4||

lines.english: Neither body, nor house, nor love last forever. You are intoxicated with Maya; how long will you be proud of them?
lines.transliteration: dayh na gayh na nayh na neet aa maa-i-aa mat  kahaa la-o gaarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਗੇਹ ਨ ਨੇਹ ਨ ਨੀਤਾ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਤ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਗਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Neither crown, nor canopy, nor servants last forever. You do not consider in your heart that your life is passing away.
lines.transliteration: chhat ar na pat ar na cha-ur na chaavar baht ee jaat  ridai na bichaarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਛਤਰ੍ ਨ ਪਤਰ੍ ਨ ਚਉਰ  ਨ ਚਾਵਰ  ਬਹਤੀ  ਜਾਤ  ਿਰਦੈ ਨ ਿਬਚਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Neither chariots, nor horses, nor elephants or royal thrones shall last forever. In aninstant, you will have to leave them, and depart naked.
lines.transliteration: rath na asav na gaj singhaasan chh in meh t i-aagat  naaNg siDh aarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਰਥ ਨ ਅਸ ਨ ਗਜ ਿਸੰਘਾਸਨ  ਿਛਨ ਮਿਹ ਿਤਆਗਤ  ਨਗ ਿਸਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Neither warrior, nor hero, nor king or ruler last forever; see this with your eyes.
lines.transliteration: soor na beer na meer na khaanam sang na ko-oo d arisat nihaarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸੂਰ ਨ ਬੀਰ ਨ ਮੀਰ ਨ ਖਾਨਮ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕੋਊ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਿਨਹਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Neither fortress, nor shelter, nor treasure will save you; doing evil deeds, you shalldepart empty-handed.
lines.transliteration: kot na ot na kos na chhotaa karat  bikaar d o-oo kar jh aarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਟ ਨ ਓਟ ਨ ਕੋਸ ਨ ਛੋਟਾ ਕਰਤ  ਿਬਕਾਰ  ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਝਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Friends, children, spouses and friends - none of them last forever; they change likethe shade of a tree.
lines.transliteration: mitar na put ar kalt ar saajan sakh  ultat jaat birakh  kee chh aaNrahu.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਤਰ੍ ਨ ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਕਲਤਰ੍  ਸਾਜਨ  ਸਖ ਉਲਟਤ  ਜਾਤ  ਿਬਰਖ  ਕੀ ਛਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: God is the Perfect Primal Being, Merciful to the meek; each and every instant,meditate in remembrance on Him, the Inaccessible and Infinite.
lines.transliteration: deen d a-yaal purakh  parabh  pooran chh in chh in simrahu agam apaarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਦੀਨ  ਦਯਾਲ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪੂਰਨ  ਿਛਨ ਿਛਨ ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਅਗਮ  ਅਪਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: O Great Lord and Master, servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; please shower himwith Your Mercy, and carry him across. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sareepat naath saran  naanak jan hay bh agvant  kirpaa kar t aarahu. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀਪਿਤ  ਨਾਥ ਸਰਿਣ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਨ ਹੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਤਾਰਹੁ ॥੫॥
lines.english: I have used up my breath of life, sold my self-respect, begged for charity, committedhighway robbery, and dedicated my consciousness to the love and pursuit of acquiringwealth.
lines.transliteration: paraan maan daan mag johan heet  cheet  day lay lay paaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਨ  ਮਗ ਜੋਹਨ  ਹੀਤੁ ਚੀਤੁ  ਦੇ ਲੇ ਲੇ ਪਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have kept it secretly hidden from my friends, relatives, companions, children and siblings.
lines.transliteration: saajan sain meet sut  bhaa-ee t aahoo t ay lay rakh ee niraaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਸੈਨ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ  ਤਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਲੇ ਰਖੀ ਿਨਰਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Dhaavan paavan koor kamaavan ih biDh  karat  a-oDh  tan jaaree. I ran around practicing falsehood, burning up my body and growing old.

lines.punjabi: ਧਾਵਨ  ਪਾਵਨ  ਕੂਰ ਕਮਾਵਨ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਕਰਤ  ਅਉਧ  ਤਨ ਜਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I gave up good deeds, righteousness and Dharma, self-discipline, purity, religiousvows and all good ways; I associated with the fickle Maya.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam sanjam such naymaa chanchal sang sagal biDh  haaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਸੰਜਮ  ਸੁਚ ਨੇਮਾ ਚੰਚਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਬਿਧ  ਹਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: Beasts and birds, trees and mountains - in so many ways, I wandered lost inreincarnation.
lines.transliteration: pas pankhee birakh  asthaavar baho biDh  jon bh armi-o at  bhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਿਬਰਖ  ਅਸਥਾਵਰ  ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ ਜੋਿਨ ਭਰ੍ਿਮਓ  ਅਿਤ  ਭਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I did not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for a moment, or even aninstant. He is the Master of the meek, the Lord of all life.
lines.transliteration: khin pal chasaa naam nahee simri-o d eenaa naath paraanpat  saaree.

lines.punjabi: ਿਖਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਿਸਮਿਰਓ  ਦੀਨਾ  ਨਾਥ ਪਰ੍ਾਨਪਿਤ  ਸਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The food and drink, and the sweet and tasty dishes became totally bitter at the lastmoment.
lines.transliteration: khaan paan meeth  ras bh ojan ant  kee baar hot  kat khaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਮੀਠ ਰਸ ਭੋਜਨ  ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਕਤ ਖਾਰੀ  ॥
