lines.english: O Nanak, I was saved in the Society of the Saints, at their feet; the others, intoxicatedwith Maya, have gone, leaving everything behind. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak sant charan sang uDh ray hor maa-i-aa magan chalay sabh  daaree. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਉਧਰੇ  ਹੋਿਰ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਗਨ  ਚਲੇ ਸਿਭ ਡਾਰੀ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Brahma, Shiva, the Vedas and the silent sages sing the Glorious Praises of their Lordand Master with love and delight.
lines.transliteration: barahmaadik siv chh and muneesur rasak rasak th aakur gun gaavat .

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਿਦਕ  ਿਸਵ ਛੰਦ ਮੁਨੀਸੁਰ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਰਸਿਕ  ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ  ॥
lines.english: Indra, Vishnu and Gorakh, who come to earth and then go to heaven again, seek the Lord.
lines.transliteration: indar munind ar khojtay gorakh  Dharan gagan aavat  fun Dh aavat .

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦਰ੍ ਮੁਿਨੰਦਰ੍ ਖੋਜਤੇ  ਗੋਰਖ  ਧਰਿਣ  ਗਗਨ  ਆਵਤ  ਫੁਿਨ ਧਾਵਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas, human beings, gods and demons cannot find even a tiny bit of HisMystery.
lines.transliteration: siDh manukh -y dayv ar d aanav ik t il taa ko maram na paavat .

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਧ ਮਨੁਖਯ੍ਯ੍ ਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਦਾਨਵ  ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ  ਨ ਪਾਵਤ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble servants are imbued with love and affection for God their Beloved;in the delight of devotional worship, they are absorbed in the Blessed Vision of HisDarshan.
lines.transliteration: pari-a parabh pareet  paraym ras bh agtee har jan t aa kai d aras samaavat .

lines.punjabi: ਿਪਰ੍ਅ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸ ਭਗਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਿਸ  ਸਮਾਵਤ  ॥
lines.english: But those who forsake Him, and beg from another, shall see their mouths, teeth andtongues wear away.
lines.transliteration: tiseh t i-aag aan ka-o jaacheh mukh  dant rasan sagal gh as jaavat .

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਿਹ  ਿਤਆਿਗ  ਆਨ  ਕਉ ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤ ਰਸਨ  ਸਗਲ  ਘਿਸ  ਜਾਵਤ  ॥
lines.english: O my foolish mind, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the Giver of peace. SlaveNanak imparts these teachings. ||7||
lines.transliteration: ray man moorh simar sukh -daata naanak d aas tujheh samjh aavat . ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਤੁਝਿਹ ਸਮਝਾਵਤ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The pleasures of Maya shall fade away. In doubt, the mortal falls into the deep darkpit of emotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa rang birang karat bh aram moh kai koop gubaar pari-o hai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਰੰਗ ਿਬਰੰਗ  ਕਰਤ  ਭਰ੍ਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਕੂਿਪ ਗੁਬਾਿਰ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He is so proud, even the sky cannot contain him. His belly is filled with manure, bonesand worms.
lines.transliteration: aytaa gab akaas na maavat  bistaa ast  kiram ud ar bhari-o hai.

lines.punjabi: ਏਤਾ ਗਬੁ ਅਕਾਿਸ  ਨ ਮਾਵਤ  ਿਬਸਟਾ  ਅਸ੍ਤ ਿਕਰ੍ਿਮ  ਉਦਰੁ ਭਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He runs around in the ten directions, for the sake of the great poison of corruption.He steals the wealth of others, and in the end, he is destroyed by his own ignorance.
lines.transliteration: dah d is Dhaa-ay mahaa bikh i-aa ka-o par Dh an chh een agi-aan hari-o hai.

lines.punjabi: ਦਹ ਿਦਸ ਧਾਇ  ਮਹਾ ਿਬਿਖਆ  ਕਉ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਛੀਿਨ  ਅਿਗਆਨ ਹਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: His youth passes away, the illnesses of old age seize him, and the Messenger of Death punishes him; such is the death he dies.
lines.transliteration: joban beet jaraa rog garsi-o jamd ootan dann mirat  mari-o hai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਬਨ  ਬੀਿਤ  ਜਰਾ ਰੋਿਗ ਗਰ੍ਿਸਓ  ਜਮਦੂਤਨ  ਡੰਨੁ ਿਮਰਤੁ  ਮਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: He suffers the agony of hell in countless incarnations; he rots away in the pit of painand condemnation.
lines.transliteration: anik jon sankat narak bhuNchat saasan d ookh garat  gari-o hai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਨਕ  ਜੋਿਨ ਸੰਕਟ  ਨਰਕ ਭੁੰਚਤ  ਸਾਸਨ  ਦੂਖ ਗਰਿਤ  ਗਿਰਓ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those whom the Saint mercifully takes as his own, are carried across bytheir loving devotional worship. ||8||
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  uDhrahi say naanak kar kirpaa sant  aap kari-o hai. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਉਧਰਿਹ  ਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਸੰਤੁ ਆਿਪ  ਕਿਰਓ ਹੈ ॥੮॥
lines.english: All virtues are obtained, all fruits and rewards, and the desires of the mind; my hopeshave been totally fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: gun samooh fal sagal manorath pooran ho-ee aas hamaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਸਮੂਹ ਫਲ ਸਗਲ  ਮਨੋਰਥ  ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਈ ਆਸ  ਹਮਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Medicine, the Mantra, the Magic Charm, will cure all illnesses and totally take away all pain. pMnw 1389
lines.transliteration: a-ukhaDh  mant ar tantar par d ukh har sarab rog kh andan  gunkaaree.

lines.english: Lust, anger, egotism, jealousy and desire are eliminated by chanting the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh mad  matsar tarisnaa binas jaahi har naam uchaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ  ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The merits of cleansing baths, charity, penance, purity and good deeds, are obtainedby enshrining the Lotus Feet of God within the heart.
lines.transliteration: isnaan daan t aapan such kiri-aa charan  kamal hird ai parabh  Dhaaree.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸਨਾਨ  ਦਾਨ  ਤਾਪਨ  ਸੁਿਚ ਿਕਿਰਆ  ਚਰਣ  ਕਮਲ  ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord is my Friend, my Very Best Friend, Companion and Relative. God is the Sustenance of the soul, the Support of the breath of life.
lines.transliteration: saajan meet sakh aa har banDh ap jee-a Dh aan parabh  paraan aDh aaree.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਜਨ  ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਿਰ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ  ਧਾਨ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਪਰ੍ਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: I have grasped the Shelter and Support of my All-powerful Lord and Master; slaveNanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||9||
lines.transliteration: ot gahee su-aamee samartheh naanak daas sad aa balihaaree. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਸਮਰਥਹ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Weapons cannot cut that person who delights in the love of the Lord's Lotus Feet.
lines.transliteration: aavaDh kati-o na jaat  paraym ras charan kamal sang.

lines.punjabi: ਆਵਧ ਕਿਟਓ  ਨ ਜਾਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Ropes cannot bind that person whose mind is pierced through by the Vision of theLord's Way.
lines.transliteration: daavan banDh i-o na jaat  biDhay man d aras mag.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਵਿਨ  ਬੰਿਧਓ  ਨ ਜਾਤ  ਿਬਧੇ ਮਨ ਦਰਸ  ਮਿਗ ॥
lines.english: Fire cannot burn that person who is attached to the dust of the feet of the Lord'shumble servant.
lines.transliteration: paavak jari-o na jaat rahi-o jan Dh oor lag.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਵਕ ਜਿਰਓ  ਨ ਜਾਤ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਜਨ ਧੂਿਰ ਲਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Water cannot drown that person whose feet walk on the Lord's Path.
lines.transliteration: neer na saakas bor chaleh har panth pag.

lines.punjabi: ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਸਾਕਿਸ  ਬੋਿਰ ਚਲਿਹ  ਹਿਰ ਪੰਿਥ ਪਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, diseases, faults, sinful mistakes and emotional attachment are pierced bythe Arrow of the Name. ||1||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak rog dokh  agh moh chh iday har naam kh ag. ||1||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਅਘ  ਮੋਹ ਿਛਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਖਿਗ ॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.english: People are engaged in making all sorts of efforts; they contemplate the variousaspects of the six Shaastras.
lines.transliteration: udam kar laagay baho bh aatee bichrahi anik saast ar baho kh atoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਮੁ  ਕਿਰ ਲਾਗੇ  ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ  ਿਬਚਰਿਹ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਸਾਸਤਰ੍ ਬਹੁ ਖਟੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: Rubbing ashes all over their bodies, they wander around at the various sacred shrines of pilgrimage; they fast until their bodies are emaciated, and braid their hair intotangled messes.
lines.transliteration: bhasam lagaa-ay t irath baho bh aramt ay sookh am dayh banDh eh baho jatoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਸਮ  ਲਗਾਇ  ਤੀਰਥ  ਬਹੁ ਭਰ੍ਮਤੇ  ਸੂਖਮ  ਦੇਹ ਬੰਧਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਜਟੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: Without devotional worship of the Lord, they all suffer in pain, caught in the tangledweb of their love.
lines.transliteration: bin har bhajan sagal d ukh paavat  ji-o paraym badh aa-ay soot  kay hatoo-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨ  ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਤ  ਿਜਉ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਬਢਾਇ  ਸੂਤ ਕੇ ਹਟੂਆ  ॥
lines.english: They perform worship ceremonies, draw ritual marks on their bodies, cook their ownfood fanatically, and make pompous shows of themselves in all sorts of ways.||2||11||20|| sveIey mhly pihly ky 1  (1389-10) sava-ee-ay mahlay pahilay kay 1 Swaiyas In Praise Of The First Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1389-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: poojaa chakar karat sompaakaa anik bh aaNt thaateh kar thatoo-aa. ||2||11||20||

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਕਰ੍ ਕਰਤ  ਸੋਮਪਾਕਾ  ਅਿਨਕ  ਭਿਤ  ਥਾਟਿਹ  ਕਿਰ ਥਟੂਆ  ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Meditate single-mindedly on the Primal Lord God, the Bestower of blessings.
lines.transliteration: ik man purakh Dh i-aa-ay bard aataa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਵਈਏ  ਮਹਲੇ  ਪਿਹਲੇ  ਕੇ ੧ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Helper and Support of the Saints, manifest forever.
lines.transliteration: sant sahaar sad aa bikh i-aataa.

lines.english: Grasp His Feet and enshrine them in your heart.
lines.transliteration: taas charan lay rid ai basaava-o.

lines.english: Then, let us sing the Glorious Praises of the most exalted Guru Nanak. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ta-o param guroo naanak gun gaava-o. ||1||

lines.english: I sing the Glorious Praises of the most exalted Guru Nanak, the Ocean of peace, the Eradicator of sins, the sacred pool of the Shabad, the Word of God.
lines.transliteration: gaava-o gun param guroo sukh saagar d urat nivaaran  sabad  saray.

lines.punjabi: ਤਉ ਪਰਮ  ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The beings of deep and profound understanding, oceans of wisdom, sing of Him; theYogis and wandering hermits meditate on Him.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi gambheer Dh eer mat  saagar jogee jangam Dh i-aan Dh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਉ  ਗੁਨ ਪਰਮ  ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ  ਦੁਰਤ  ਿਨਵਾਰਣ ਸਬਦ  ਸਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Indra and devotees like Prahlaad, who know the joy of the soul, sing of Him.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi indraad  bhagat par-hilaad ik aat am ras jin jaan i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਧੀਰ ਮਿਤ ਸਾਗਰ  ਜੋਗੀ  ਜੰਗਮ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.english: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of RajaYoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas gaava-o gur naanak raaj jog jin maani-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਇੰਦਰ੍ਾਿਦ  ਭਗਤ ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਿਦਕ  ਆਤਮ  ਰਸੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਾਿਣਓ  ॥
lines.english: King Janak and the great Yogic heroes of the Lord's Way, sing the Praises of the All-powerful Primal Being, filled with the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi jankaad jugat  jogaysur har ras pooran sarab kalaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਬ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ  ਗਾਵਉ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਾਿਣਓ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Sanak and Brahma's sons, the Saadhus and Siddhas, the silent sages and humbleservants of the Lord sing the Praises of Guru Nanak, who cannot be deceived by thegreat deceiver.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi sankaad saaDh  siDhaadik mun jan gaavahi achh al chh alaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਜਨਕਾਿਦ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਜੋਗੇਸੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ  ਸਰਬ  ਕਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: Dhoma the seer and Dhroo, whose realm is unmoving, sing the Glorious Praises ofGuru Nanak, who knows the ecstasy of loving devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: gaavai gun Dh om atal mandlavai bh agat bhaa-ay ras jaan i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਨਕਾਿਦ  ਸਾਧ ਿਸਧਾਿਦਕ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਅਛਲ  ਛਲਾ  ॥
lines.english: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of RajaYoga. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas gaava-o gur naanak raaj jog jin maani-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਧੋਮੁ ਅਟਲ  ਮੰਡਲਵੈ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ਰਸੁ ਜਾਿਣਓ  ॥
lines.english: Kapila and the other Yogis sing of Guru Nanak. He is the Avataar, the Incarnation of the Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi kapilaad aad  jogaysur aprampar avt aar varo.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਬ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ  ਗਾਵਉ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਾਿਣਓ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Parasraam the son of Jamdagan, whose axe and powers were taken away byRaghuvira, sing of Him.
lines.transliteration: gaavai jamadgan parasraamaysur kar kuth aar ragh  tayj hari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਕਿਪਲਾਿਦ ਆਿਦ  ਜੋਗੇਸੁਰ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਅਵਤਾਰ  ਵਰੋ ॥
lines.english: Udho, Akrur and Bidur sing the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, who knows the Lord,the Soul of All.
lines.transliteration: uDhou akroor bid ar gun  gaavai sarbaat am jin jaan i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵੈ  ਜਮਦਗਿਨ  ਪਰਸਰਾਮੇਸੁਰ  ਕਰ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਰਘੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਹਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||4|| pMnw 1390
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas gaava-o gur naanak raaj jog jin maani-o. ||4||

lines.english: The four castes and the six Shaastras sing His Glorious Praises; Brahma and the others contemplate His Virtues.
lines.transliteration: gaavahi gun baran chaar kh at darsan barahmaad ik simranth gunaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਬਰਨ  ਚਾਿਰ  ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਿਦਕ ਿਸਮਰੰਿਥ  ਗੁਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: The thousand-tongued serpent king sings His Praises with delight, remaining lovinglyattached to Him.
lines.transliteration: gaavai gun says sahas jihbaa ras aad  ant liv laag Dh unaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗਾਵੈ  ਗੁਣ ਸੇਸੁ ਸਹਸ  ਿਜਹਬਾ  ਰਸ ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਿਗ  ਧੁਨਾ ॥
lines.english: Shiva, detached and beyond desire, sings the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, whoknows the Lord's endless meditation.
lines.transliteration: gaavai gun mahaad ay-o bairaagee jin Dh i-aan nirant ar jaan i-o.

lines.english: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||5||
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas gaava-o gur naanak raaj jog jin maani-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਬ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ  ਗਾਵਉ  ਗੁ ਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਾਿਣਓ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He mastered Raja Yoga, and enjoys sovereignty over both worlds; the Lord, beyondhate and revenge, is enshrined within His Heart.
lines.transliteration: raaj jog maani-o basi-o nirvair rid antar.

lines.english: The whole world is saved, and carried across, chanting the Naam, the Name of theLord.
lines.transliteration: sarisat sagal uDhree naam lay t ari-o nirant ar.

lines.english: Sanak and Janak and the others sing His Praises, age after age.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi sankaad  aad jankaad  jugah lag.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਨਕਾਿਦ  ਆਿਦ  ਜਨਕਾਿਦ  ਜੁਗਹ  ਲਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an gur Dh an janam sakyath bh alou jag. Blessed, blessed, blessed and fruitful is the sublime birth of the Guru into the world.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਿਨ ਜਨਮੁ  ਸਕਯਥੁ  ਭਲੌ ਜਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Even in the nether regions, His Victory is celebrated; so says KAL the poet.
lines.transliteration: paataal puree jaikaar Dh un kab jan kal vakh aani-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਤਾਲ  ਪੁਰੀ ਜੈਕਾਰ  ਧੁਿਨ ਕਿਬ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਿਣਓ  ॥
lines.english: You are blessed with the Nectar of the Lord's Name, O Guru Nanak; You havemastered Raja Yoga, and enjoy sovereignty over both worlds. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har naam rasik naanak gur raaj jog tai maan i-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸਕ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤੈ ਮਾਿਣਓ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, You were pleased to deceive Baal the king, in the formof a dwarf.
lines.transliteration: satjug t ai maan i-o chh ali-o bal baavan bh aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਜੁਿਗ  ਤੈ ਮਾਿਣਓ  ਛਿਲਓ  ਬਿਲ ਬਾਵਨ ਭਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, You were called Raam of the Raghu dynasty.
lines.transliteration: tarayt ai tai maan i-o raam ragh oovans kahaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰ੍ੇਤੈ ਤੈ ਮਾਿਣਓ  ਰਾਮੁ ਰਘੁਵੰਸੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, You were Krishna; You killed Mur the demon and saved Kans.
lines.transliteration: du-aapur krisan muraar kans kirt aarath kee-o.

lines.english: You blessed Ugrasain with a kingdom, and You blessed Your humble devotees withfearlessness.
lines.transliteration: ugarsain ka-o raaj abh ai bhagtah jan d ee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਉਗਰ੍ਸੈਣ  ਕਉ ਰਾਜੁ ਅਭੈ ਭਗਤਹ  ਜਨ ਦੀਓ  ॥
lines.english: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, You are known and accepted as GuruNanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Das.
lines.transliteration: kalijug parmaan naanak gur angad  amar kahaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਜੁਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਮਾਣੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ  ਅਮਰੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: The sovereign rule of the Great Guru is unchanging and permanent, according the Command of the Primal Lord God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: saree guroo raaj abichal atal aad purakh  furmaa-i-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਜੁ ਅਿਬਚਲੁ  ਅਟਲੁ  ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਫੁਰਮਾਇਓ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: His Glorious Praises are sung by the devotees Ravi Daas, Jai Dayv and Trilochan.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai ravid aas bh agat jaidayv tarilochan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਰਿਵਦਾਸੁ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਜੈਦੇਵ ਿਤਰ੍ਲੋਚਨ  ॥
lines.english: The devotees Naam Dayv and Kabeer praise Him continually, knowing Him to beeven-eyed.
lines.transliteration: naamaa bhagat  kabeer sad aa gaavahi sam lochan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮਾ  ਭਗਤੁ  ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਸਮ ਲੋਚਨ  ॥
lines.english: The devotee Baynee sings His Praises; He intuitively enjoys the ecstasy of the soul.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bayn  gun ravai sahj aat am rang maan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤੁ  ਬੇਿਣ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਆਤਮ  ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.english: He is the Master of Yoga and meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru; Heknows none other except God.
lines.transliteration: jog Dhi-aan gur gi-aan binaa parabh  avar na jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗ ਿਧਆਿਨ  ਗੁਰ ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਿਬਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Sukh Dayv and Preekhyat sing His Praises, and Gautam the rishi sings His Praise.
lines.transliteration: sukh-d ay-o part eekh-yat gun ravai got am rikh  jas gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖਦੇਉ  ਪਰੀਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਤੁ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੋਤਮ  ਿਰਿਖ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Says KAL the poet, the ever-fresh praises of Guru Nanak are spread throughout the world. ||8||
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas naanak gur nit navt an jag chh aa-i-o. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਬ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਨਤ  ਨਵਤਨੁ ਜਿਗ  ਛਾਇਓ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: In the nether worlds, His Praises are sung by the devotees like Shaysh-naag inserpent form.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi paa-yaal bh agat naagaad  bhuyangam.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ ਪਾਯਾਿਲ  ਭਗਤ  ਨਾਗਾਿਦ  ਭੁਯੰਗਮ  ॥
lines.english: Shiva, the Yogis and the wandering hermits sing His Praises forever.
lines.transliteration: mahaaday-o gun  ravai sad aa jogee jat  jangam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਜੋਗੀ  ਜਿਤ  ਜੰਗਮ  ॥
lines.english: Vyaas the silent sage, who studied the Vedas and its grammar, sings His Praise.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai mun bayaas jin bayd  ba-yaakaran  beechaari-a.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ  ਮੁਿਨ ਬਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਸੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਬੇਦ ਬਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਕਰਣ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰਅ  ॥
lines.english: His Praises are sung by Brahma, who created the entire universe by God's Command.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa gun uchrai jin hukam sabh  sarisat savaaree-a.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਹੁਕਿਮ ਸਭ ਿਸਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸਵਾਰੀਅ  ॥
lines.english: God fills the galaxies and realms of the universe; He is known to be the same,manifest and unmanifest.
lines.transliteration: barahmand khand pooran barahm gun  nirgun  sam jaan i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਖੰਡ ਪੂਰਨ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਗੁਣ ਿਨਰਗੁਣ  ਸਮ ਜਾਿਣਓ  ॥
lines.english: KAL chants the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Yoga. ||9||
lines.transliteration: jap kal sujas naanak gur sahj jog jin maani-o. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ  ਜੋਗੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਮਾਿਣਓ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The nine masters of Yoga sing His Praises; blessed is the Guru, who is merged intothe True Lord.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi nav naath Dh an gur saach samaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਧੰਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਿਚ  ਸਮਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Maandhaataa, who called himself ruler of all the world, sings His Praises.
lines.transliteration: maaNDhaat aa gun  ravai jayn chakarvai kahaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਧਾਤਾ  ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਜੇਨ ਚਕਰ੍ਵੈ  ਕਹਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Bal the king, dwelling in the seventh underworld, sings His Praises.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai bal raa-o sapat  paataal basant ou.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਿਲ ਰਾਉ ਸਪਤ  ਪਾਤਾਿਲ  ਬਸੰਤੌ  ॥
lines.english: Bhart'har, abiding forever with Gorakh, his guru, sings His Praises.
lines.transliteration: bharthar gun  uchrai sad aa gur sang rahant ou.

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਥਿਰ  ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹੰਤੌ  ॥
lines.english: Doorbaasaa, King Puro and Angra sing the Praises of Guru Nanak.
lines.transliteration: doorbaa paroora-o angrai gur naanak jas gaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਰਬਾ  ਪਰੂਰਉ ਅੰਗਰੈ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: Says KAL the poet, the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak intuitively permeate each and every heart. ||10|| pMnw 1391 sveIey mhly dUjy ky 2  (1391-1) sava-ee-ay mahlay doojay kay 2 Swaiyas In Praise Of The Second Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1391-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas naanak gur ghat gh at sahj samaa-i-o. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਵਈਏ  ਮਹਲੇ  ਦੂਜੇ ਕੇ ੨ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed is the Primal Lord God, the Creator, the All-powerful Cause of causes.
lines.transliteration: so-ee purakh Dh an kart aa kaaran  kartaar karan  samratho.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਧੰਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥੋ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed is the True Guru Nanak, who placed His hand upon Your forehead.
lines.transliteration: satguroo Dh an naanak mast ak tum Dh ari-o jin hatho.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਧੰਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਤੁਮ ਧਿਰਓ  ਿਜਿਨ ਹਥੋ ॥
lines.english: When He placed His hand upon Your forehead, then the celestial nectar began to rain down in torrents; the gods and human beings, heavenly heralds and sages weredrenched in its fragrance.
lines.transliteration: dUjy ky, kl shwr) ta Dh ari-o mast ak hath sahj ami-o vuth -o chh aj sur nar gan  mun bohiy agaaj.

lines.punjabi: ਤ ਧਿਰਓ  ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਥੁ ਸਹਿਜ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਵੁਠਉ ਛਿਜ ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਮੁਿਨ ਬੋਿਹਯ  ਅਗਾਿਜ  ॥
lines.english: You challenged and subdued the cruel demon of death; You restrained Your wandering mind; You overpowered the five demons and You keep them in one home.
lines.transliteration: dUjy ky, kl shwr) maari-o kantak kaal garaj Dhaavat  lee-o baraj panch bh oot ayk gh ar raakh  lay samaj.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਿਰਓ ਕੰਟਕੁ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਗਰਿਜ  ਧਾਵਤੁ  ਲੀਓ  ਬਰਿਜ  ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਏਕ ਘਿਰ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇ ਸਮਿਜ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Guru's Door, the Gurdwara, You have conquered the world; You play the game even-handedly. You keep the flow of your love steady for the Formless Lord.
lines.transliteration: ky, kl shwr) jag jeeta-o gur d u-aar kh ayleh samat  saar rath unman liv raakh  nirankaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਉ  ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਿਰ ਖੇਲਿਹ  ਸਮਤ  ਸਾਿਰ  ਰਥੁ ਉਨਮਿਨ  ਿਲਵ ਰਾਿਖ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ky, kl shwr) kaho keerat kal sahaar sapat  deep majh aar lahn aa jagt ar gur paras muraar. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ  ਸਪਤ  ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ  ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਿਸ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar from His eyes washes away the slime and filth of sins; the sight of His door dispels the darkness of ignorance.
lines.transliteration: dUjy ky, kl shwr) jaa kee darisat amrit  Dhaar kaalukh  khan utaar timar ag-yaan jaahi d aras d u-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਧਾਰ ਕਾਲੁਖ  ਖਿਨ ਉਤਾਰ  ਿਤਮਰ  ਅਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨ ਜਾਿਹ  ਦਰਸ  ਦੁਆਰ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever accomplishes this most difficult task of contemplating the most sublime Word of the Shabad - those people cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and cast offtheir loads of sin.
lines.transliteration: dUjy ky, kl shwr) o-ay jo sayveh sabad saar gaakh -rhee bikh am kaar t ay nar bh av utaar kee-ay nirbhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਸੇਵਿਹ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਾਰੁ ਗਾਖੜੀ  ਿਬਖਮ  ਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਿਰ  ਕੀਏ ਿਨਰਭਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is celestial and sublime; whoever remains awake and aware, contemplating the Guru, embodies humility, and is imbued foreverwith the Supreme Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ky, kl shwr) satsangat  sahj saar jaageelay gur beechaar nimmree bh oot sadeev param pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਹਜ  ਸਾਿਰ  ਜਾਗੀਲੇ  ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ਿਨੰਮਰੀ  ਭੂਤ ਸਦੀਵ  ਪਰਮ  ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||2||
lines.transliteration: ky, kl shwr) kaho keerat kal sahaar sapat  deep majh aar lahn aa jagt ar gur paras muraar. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਿਤ ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ  ਸਪਤ  ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ  ਲਹਣਾ  ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਿਸ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: You hold tight to the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord; Your expanse is immaculate. You are the Support of the Siddhas and seekers, and the good andhumble beings.
lines.transliteration: mhly dUjy ky, kl shwr) tai ta-o darirha-o naam apaar bimal jaas bithaar saaDh ik siDh  sujan jee-aa ko aDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਤਉ ਿਦਰ੍ਿੜਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਿਬਮਲ  ਜਾਸੁ ਿਬਥਾਰੁ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਸੁਜਨ  ਜੀਆ  ਕੋ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You are the incarnation of King Janak; the contemplation of Your Shabad is sublime throughout the universe. You abide in the world like the lotus on the water.
lines.transliteration: ky, kl shwr) too taa janik raajaa a-ut aar sabad  sansaar saar raheh jagt ar jal pad am beechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਤਾ ਜਿਨਕ  ਰਾਜਾ  ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ ਸਾਰੁ ਰਹਿਹ  ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਜਲ ਪਦਮ  ਬੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Like the Elyisan Tree, You cure all illnesses and take away the sufferings of the world. The three-phased soul is lovingly attuned to You alone.
lines.transliteration: dUjy ky, kl shwr) kalip tar rog bid aar sansaar t aap nivaar aat maa t aribaDh  tayrai ayk liv t aar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲਪ  ਤਰੁ ਰੋਗ ਿਬਦਾਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਤਾਪ ਿਨਵਾਰੁ ਆਤਮਾ  ਿਤਰ੍ਿਬਿਧ ਤੇਰੈ ਏਕ ਿਲਵ  ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.english: O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||3||
lines.transliteration: ky, kl shwr) kaho keerat kal sahaar sapat  deep majh aar lahn aa jagt ar gur paras muraar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ  ਸਪਤ  ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ  ਲਹਣਾ  ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਿਸ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: You were blessed with glory by the Prophet; You serve the Guru, certified by the Lord, who has subdued the snake of the mind, and who abides in the state of sublime bliss.
lines.transliteration: mhly dUjy ky, kl shwr) tai taa had rath paa-i-o maan sayvi-aa gur parvaan saaDh  ajgar jin kee-aa unmaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਤਾ ਹਦਰਿਥ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਮਾਨੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ਸਾਿਧ  ਅਜਗਰੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਕੀਆ  ਉਨਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Your Vision is like that of the Lord, Your soul is a fount of spiritual wisdom; You know the unfathomable state of the certified Guru.
lines.transliteration: ky, kl shwr) har har daras samaan aat maa vant gi-aan jaan ee-a akal gat  gur parvaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਸ  ਸਮਾਨ  ਆਤਮਾ  ਵੰਤਿਗਆਨ  ਜਾਣੀਅ  ਅਕਲ  ਗਿਤ  ਗੁਰ ਪਰਵਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Your Gaze is focused upon the unmoving, unchanging place. Your Intellect is immaculate; it is focused upon the most sublime place. Wearing the armor of humility,you have overcome Maya.
lines.transliteration: dUjy ky, kl shwr) jaa kee darisat achal th aan bimal buDh  suthaan pahir seel sanaahu sakat  bidaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਅਚਲ  ਠਾਣ ਿਬਮਲ  ਬੁਿਧ ਸੁਥਾਨ  ਪਿਹਿਰ  ਸੀਲ  ਸਨਾਹੁ ਸਕਿਤ  ਿਬਦਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Kal Sakaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||4||
lines.transliteration: ky, kl shwr) kaho keerat kal sahaar sapat  deep majh aar lahn aa jagt ar gur paras muraar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕਲ ਸਹਾਰ  ਸਪਤ  ਦੀਪ ਮਝਾਰ ਲਹਣਾ  ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਿਸ  ਮੁਰਾਿਰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Casting Your Glance of Grace, you dispel the darkness, burn away evil, and destroysin.
lines.transliteration: darisat Dh arat tam haran d ahan agh  paap parnaasan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਧਰਤ  ਤਮ ਹਰਨ  ਦਹਨ  ਅਘ  ਪਾਪ ਪਰ੍ਨਾਸਨ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Heroic Warrior of the Shabad, the Word of God. Your Power destroyssexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: sabad soor balvant  kaam ar kroDh  binaasan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦ  ਸੂਰ ਬਲਵੰਤ  ਕਾਮ ਅਰੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਿਬਨਾਸਨ  ॥
lines.english: You have overpowered greed and emotional attachment; You nurture and cherishthose who seek Your Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: lobh moh vas karan  saran  jaachik part ipaalan .

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਸ ਕਰਣ  ਸਰਣ  ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਲਣ  ॥
lines.english: You gather in the joyful love of the soul; Your Words have the Potency to bring forth Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: aatam rat  sangar-han  kahan  amrit  kal dh aalan .

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮ  ਰਤ ਸੰਗਰ੍ਹਣ  ਕਹਣ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕਲ ਢਾਲਣ  ॥
lines.english: You are appointed the True Guru, the True Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga;whoever is truly attached to You is carried across.
lines.transliteration: satguroo kal sat gur tilak sat  laagai so pai t arai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਕਲ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਤਲਕੁ  ਸਿਤ ਲਾਗੈ  ਸੋ ਪੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The lion, the son of Pheru, is Guru Angad, the Guru of the World; Lehnaa practices Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||5|| pMnw 1392
lines.transliteration: gur jagat firan seeh angara-o raaj jog lahn aa karai. ||5||

lines.english: Your mind remains lovingly attuned to the Lord forever; You do whatever you desire.
lines.transliteration: sadaa akal liv rahai karan si-o ichh aa chaarah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਅਕਲ  ਿਲਵ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਨ  ਿਸਉ ਇਛਾ  ਚਾਰਹ  ॥
lines.english: Like the tree heavy with fruit, You bow in humility, and endure the pain of it; You are pure of thought.
lines.transliteration: darum sapoor ji-o nivai kh avai kas bimal beechaareh.

lines.english: You realize this reality, that the Lord is All-pervading, Unseen and Amazing.
lines.transliteration: ihai tat  jaani-o sarab gat  alakh  bidaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੈ ਤਤੁ ਜਾਿਣਓ  ਸਰਬ  ਗਿਤ  ਅਲਖੁ  ਿਬਡਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: With intuitive ease, You send forth the rays of the Ambrosial Word of power.
lines.transliteration: sahj bhaa-ay sanchi-o kiran  amrit  kal ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਭਾਇ  ਸੰਿਚਓ  ਿਕਰਿਣ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਕਲ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: You have risen to the state of the certified Guru; you grasp truth and contentment.
lines.transliteration: gur gam parmaan t ai paa-i-o sat  santokh garaahaj la-you.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਮ ਪਰ੍ਮਾਣੁ  ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ  ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਗਰ੍ਾਹਿਜ  ਲਯੌ ॥
lines.english: KAL proclaims, that whoever attains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of Lehnaa, meets with the Lord. ||6||
lines.transliteration: har parsi-o kal samulavai jan darsan lahn ay bh a-you. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰਿਸਓ  ਕਲੁ ਸਮੁਲਵੈ  ਜਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ  ਭਯੌ ॥੬॥
lines.english: My mind has faith, that the Prophet has given You access to the Profound Lord.
lines.transliteration: man bisaas paa-i-o gahar gahu hadrath d ee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਿਬਸਾਸੁ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਗਹਿਰ  ਗਹੁ ਹਦਰਿਥ ਦੀਓ  ॥
lines.english: Your body has been purged of the deadly poison; You drink the Ambrosial Nectardeep within.
lines.transliteration: garal naas tan nath yo ami-o ant argat pee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਲ  ਨਾਸੁ ਤਿਨ  ਨਠਯੋ  ਅਿਮਉ  ਅੰਤਰਗਿਤ  ਪੀਓ ॥
lines.english: Your Heart has blossomed forth in awareness of the Unseen Lord, who has infused HisPower throughout the ages.
lines.transliteration: rid bigaas jaagi-o alakh  kal Dh aree jugant ar.

lines.english: O True Guru, You are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi, with continuity and equality.
lines.transliteration: satgur sahj samaaDh  ravi-o saamaan nirant ar.

lines.english: You are open-minded and large-hearted, the Destroyer of poverty; seeing You, sinsare afraid.
lines.transliteration: udaara-o chit  daarid haran pikh antai kalmal t arsan.

lines.english: Says KAL, I lovingly, continually, intuitively chant the Praises of Lehnaa with mytongue. ||7||
lines.transliteration: sad rang sahj kal uchrai jas jampa-o lahn ay rasan. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਰੰਿਗ ਸਹਿਜ  ਕਲੁ ਉਚਰੈ  ਜਸੁ ਜੰਪਉ  ਲਹਣੇ  ਰਸਨ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our medicine; the Naam is our support; the Naam is the peace of Samaadhi. The Naam is the insignia which embellishes us forever.
lines.transliteration: kl) naam avkhaDh  naam aaDh aar ar naam samaaDh  sukh  sadaa naam neesaan  sohai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: KAL is imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Naam which is the fragrance of gods and human beings.
lines.transliteration: rang ratou naam si-o kal naam sur narah bohai.

lines.punjabi: ਰੰਿਗ ਰਤੌ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਉ ਕਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰਹ  ਬੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Whoever obtains the Naam, the Philosopher's Stone, becomes the embodiment ofTruth, manifest and radiant throughout the world.
lines.transliteration: naam paras jin paa-i-o sat pargati-o rav lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਪਰਸੁ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਾਇਓ  ਸਤੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟਓ  ਰਿਵ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, it is as if one has bathed at thesixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||8||
lines.transliteration: darsan parsi-ai guroo kai ath sath majan ho-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਪਰਿਸਐ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਅਠਸਿਠ  ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The True Name is the sacred shrine, the True Name is the cleansing bath ofpurification and food. The True Name is eternal love; chant the True Name, and beembellished.
lines.transliteration: sach tirath sach isnaan ar bh ojan bh aa-o sach sad aa sach bh aakhant sohai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ  ਸਚੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੰਤੁ  ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The True Name is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Sangat, theHoly Congregation, is fragrant with the True Name.
lines.transliteration: sach paa-i-o gur sabad sach naam sangt ee bohai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ  ਬੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: KAL the poet utters the Praises of the one whose self-discipline is the True Name, andwhose fast is the True Name.
lines.transliteration: jis sach sanjam varat sach kab jan kal vakh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਵਰਤੁ  ਸਚੁ ਕਿਬ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, one's life is approved andcertified in the True Name. ||9||
lines.transliteration: darsan parsi-ai guroo kai sach janam parvaan . ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਪਰਿਸਐ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: When You bestow Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace, You eradicate all wickedness, sinand filth.
lines.transliteration: ami-a darisat subh  karai harai agh  paap sakal mal.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਮਅ  ਿਦਰ੍ਸਿਟ  ਸੁਭ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਅਘ  ਪਾਪ ਸਕਲ  ਮਲ ॥
lines.english: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - You have overcome all these powerful passions.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh ar lobh  moh vas karai sabh ai bal.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਸ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਬਲ ॥
lines.english: Your mind is filled with peace forever; You banish the sufferings of the world.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sukh  man vasai d ukh sansaarah kh ovai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ  ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the river of the nine treasures, washing off the dirt of our lives.
lines.transliteration: gur nav niDh d aree-aa-o janam ham kaalakh  Dhovai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਦਰੀਆਉ  ਜਨਮ  ਹਮ ਕਾਲਖ  ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: So speaks TAL the poet: serve the Guru, day and night, with intuitive love andaffection.
lines.transliteration: so kaho tal gur sayvee-ai ahinis sahj subhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਟਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru, the pains of death and rebirth are takenaway. ||10|| sveIey mhly qIjy ky 3  (1392-16) sava-ee-ay mahlay teejay kay 3 Swaiyas In Praise Of The Third Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1392-16) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: darsan parsi-ai guroo kai janam maran  dukh jaa-ay. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਦਰਸਿਨ  ਪਰਿਸਐ  ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Dwell upon that Primal Being, the True Lord God; in this world, His One Name isUndeceivable.
lines.transliteration: so-ee purakh sivar saachaa jaa kaa ik naam achh al sansaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਵਈਏ  ਮਹਲੇ  ਤੀਜੇ  ਕੇ ੩ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: He carries His devotees across the terrifying world-ocean; meditate in remembranceon His Naam, Supreme and Sublime.
lines.transliteration: jin bhagat  bhavjal t aaray simrahu so-ee naam parDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਸਵਿਰ  ਸਾਚਾ  ਜਾ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak delighted in the Naam; He established Lehnaa as Guru, who was imbued with all supernatural spiritual powers.
lines.transliteration: tit naam rasik naanak lahn aa thapi-o jayn sarab siDh ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਭਗਤ  ਭਵਜਲ  ਤਾਰੇ ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL the poet: the glory of the wise, sublime and humble Amar Daas isspread throughout the world.
lines.transliteration: kav jan kal-y sabuDhee keerat  jan amard aas bist ree-yaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਿਸਕੁ  ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਲਹਣਾ  ਥਿਪਓ  ਜੇਨ ਸਰ੍ਬ ਿਸਧੀ  ॥
lines.english: His Praises radiate throughout the world, like the rays of the sun, and the branches ofthe maulsar (fragrant) tree.
lines.transliteration: keerat rav kiran  pargat sansaarah saakh  tarovar mavalsaraa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਵ ਜਨ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਸਬੁਧੀ  ਕੀਰਿਤ ਜਨ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਿਬਸ੍ਤਰੀਯਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the north, south, east and west, people proclaim Your Victory. pMnw 1393
lines.transliteration: utar d akh-nahi pub ar pascham jai jai kaar japanth naraa.

lines.punjabi: ਦਿਖਣਿਹ  ਪੁਿਬ ਅਰੁ ਪਸ੍ਚਿਮ  ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪੰਿਥ  ਨਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The Guru spoke the Lord's Name with His mouth and broadcast it throughout the world, to turn the tide of the hearts of men.
lines.transliteration: har naam rasan gurmukh baraad -ya-o ulat gang pascham Dh aree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਿਨ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬਰਦਾਯਉ  ਉਲਿਟ  ਗੰਗ ਪਸ੍ਚਿਮ  ਧਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, cameinto Guru Amar Daas. ||1||
lines.transliteration: so-ee naam achhal bh agtah bh av taaran  amard aas gur ka-o furi-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ  ਭਗਤਹ  ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ  ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਿਰਆ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The gods and heavenly heralds, the Siddhas and seekers and Shiva in Samaadhimeditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: simrahi so-ee naam jakh-y ar kinnar saaDh ik siDh  samaaDh  haraa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਖਯ੍ਯ੍ ਅਰੁ ਿਕੰਨਰ  ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਹਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The stars and the realms of Dhroo, and devotees like Naaraad and Prahlaad meditate on the Naam.
lines.transliteration: simrahi nakh-yat ar avar Dh aroo mandal naard aad parahlaad  varaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਮਰਿਹ  ਨਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਤਰ੍  ਅਵਰ  ਧਰ੍ੂ ਮੰਡਲ  ਨਾਰਦਾਿਦ  ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਿਦ ਵਰਾ ॥
lines.english: The moon and the sun long for the Naam; it has saved even mountain ranges.
lines.transliteration: sasee-ar ar soor naam ulaaseh sail lo-a jin uDhri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਲਾਸਿਹ  ਸੈਲ ਲੋਅ ਿਜਿਨ  ਉਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, cameinto Guru Amar Daas. ||2||
lines.transliteration: so-ee naam achhal bh agtah bh av taaran  amard aas gur ka-o furi-aa. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ  ਭਗਤਹ  ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਿਰਆ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Dwelling upon that Immaculate Naam, the nine Yogic masters, Shiva and Sanak andmany others have been emancipated.
lines.transliteration: so-ee naam sivar nav naath niranjan siv sankaad samuDh ri-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਵਿਰ  ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਿਨਰੰਜਨੁ ਿਸਵ ਸਨਕਾਿਦ  ਸਮੁਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of supernatural spiritual powers, and the Buddhasare imbued with the Naam; it carried Ambreek across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: chavraaseeh siDh buDh  jit raatay ambreek bh avjal t ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਚਵਰਾਸੀਹ  ਿਸਧ ਬੁਧ ਿਜਤੁ  ਰਾਤੇ ਅੰਬਰੀਕ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: It has erased the sins of Oodho, Akroor, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer, in thisDark Age of Kali Yuga.
lines.transliteration: uDha-o akroor t ilochan naamaa kal kabeer kilvikh  hari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਉਧਉ  ਅਕਰ੍ੂਰੁ ਿਤਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ  ਕਿਲ  ਕਬੀਰ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਹਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, cameinto Guru Amar Daas. ||3||
lines.transliteration: so-ee naam achhal bh agtah bh av taaran  amard aas gur ka-o furi-aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ  ਭਗਤਹ  ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ  ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਿਰਆ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it isenshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.
lines.transliteration: tit naam laag t aytees Dh i-aavahi jat ee tapeesur man vasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਜਤੀ  ਤਪੀਸੁਰ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: Bhisham Pitama, the son of the Ganges, meditated on that Naam; his consciousness delighted in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: so-ee naam simar gangayv pitaameh charan  chit amrit  rasi-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਮਿਰ  ਗੰਗੇਵ  ਿਪਤਾਮਹ  ਚਰਣ ਿਚਤ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਰਿਸਆ  ॥
lines.english: The great and profound Guru has brought forth the Naam; accepting the teachings astrue, the Holy Congregation has been saved.
lines.transliteration: tit naam guroo gambh eer garoo-a mat  sat kar sangat  uDhree-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਗੁਰੂ ਗੰਭੀਰ  ਗਰੂਅ  ਮਿਤ ਸਤ ਕਿਰ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਉਧਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, cameinto Guru Amar Daas. ||4||
lines.transliteration: so-ee naam achhal bh agtah bh av taaran  amard aas gur ka-o furi-aa. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ  ਭਗਤਹ  ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ  ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਿਰਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: The Glory of the Naam shines forth, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of theElysian Tree.
lines.transliteration: naam kit sansaar kiran  rav surt ar saakh ah.

lines.english: In the countries of the north, south, east and west, the Praises of the Naam arechanted.
lines.transliteration: utar d akhin pub d ays pascham jas bh aakhah.

lines.punjabi: ਉਤਿਰ  ਦਿਖਿਣ  ਪੁਿਬ ਦੇਿਸ ਪਸ੍ਚਿਮ  ਜਸੁ ਭਾਖਹ  ॥
lines.english: Life is fruitful, when the Name of the Lord abides in the heart.
lines.transliteration: janam ta ih sakyath jit  naam har rid ai nivaasai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਤ ਇਹੁ ਸਕਯਥੁ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਰਦੈ ਿਨਵਾਸੈ  ॥
lines.english: The angelic beings, heavenly heralds, celestial singers and the six Shaastras yearn forthe Naam.
lines.transliteration: sur nar gan ganDh arab chh i-a darsan aasaasai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ  ਿਛਅ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਆਸਾਸੈ  ॥
lines.english: The son of Tayj Bhaan of the Bhalla dynasty is noble and famous; with his palmspressed together, KALL meditates on Him.
lines.transliteration: bhala-o parsiDh  tayjo t anou kal-y jorh  kar Dh ayaa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਲਉ  ਪਰ੍ਿਸਧੁ  ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨੌ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਜੋਿੜ ਕਰ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਇਅਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam takes away the fears of the devotees about the word-ocean; Guru Amar Daas has obtained it. ||5||
lines.transliteration: so-ee naam bhagat  bhavjal haran  gur amard aas tai paa-i-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ  ਭਵਜਲ  ਹਰਣੁ  ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The thirty-one million gods meditate on the Naam, along with the Siddhas and seekers; the Naam supports solar systems and galaxies.
lines.transliteration: kl´) naam Dhi-aavahi d ayv taytees ar saaDh ik siDh  nar naam kh and barahmand Dh aaray.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਵਿਹ  ਦੇਵ ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਅਰੁ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਨਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਖੰਡ ਬਰ੍ਹਮੰਡ  ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.english: One who meditates on the Naam in Samaadhi, endures sorrow and joy as one and thesame.
lines.transliteration: jah naam samaaDhi-o harakh  sog sam kar sahaaray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਧਓ  ਹਰਖੁ  ਸੋਗੁ ਸਮ ਕਿਰ ਸਹਾਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is the most sublime of all; the devotees remain lovingly attuned to it.
lines.transliteration: naam siroman sarab mai bh agat rahay liv Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਸਰੋਮਿਣ  ਸਰਬ  ਮੈ ਭਗਤ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the treasure of the Naam, by the Creator Lord, inHis Pleasure. ||6||
lines.transliteration: so-ee naam padaarath amar gur t us dee-o kart aar. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਅਮਰ  ਗੁਰ ਤੁਿਸ ਦੀਓ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He is the Warrior Hero of Truth, humility is His Power. His Loving Nature inspires the Congregation with deep and profound understanding; He is absorbed in the Lord, freeof hate and vengeance.
lines.transliteration: ky, kl´) sat soora-o seel balvant  sat bhaa-ay sangat  sagh an garoo-a mat  nirvair leen aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸੂਰਉ  ਸੀਿਲ  ਬਲਵੰਤੁ  ਸਤ ਭਾਇ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਘਨ  ਗਰੂਅ  ਮਿਤ ਿਨਰਵੈਿਰ  ਲੀਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Patience has been His white banner since the beginning of time, planted on the bridgeto heaven.
lines.transliteration: jis Dheeraj Dh ur Dh aval Dh ujaa sayt  baikunth  been aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ  ਧੁਿਰ ਧਵਲੁ  ਧੁਜਾ ਸੇਿਤ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ  ਬੀਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Saints meet their Beloved Guru, who is united with the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: parseh sant pi-aar jih kart aareh sanjog.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, they find peace; Guru Amar Daas has given them this ability. ||7||
lines.transliteration: satguroo sayv sukh  paa-i-o amar gur keet a-o jog. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਅਮਿਰ  ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਤਉ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Naam is His cleansing bath; the Naam is the food He eats; the Naam is the taste He enjoys. With deep yearning, He chants the Sweet Bani of the Guru's Word forever.
lines.transliteration: ky, kl´) naam naavan naam ras kh aan ar bh ojan naam ras sad aa chaa-y mukh  mist ban ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਵਣੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸ ਖਾਣੁ  ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਯ  ਮੁਿਖ ਿਮਸ੍ਟ ਬਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan sat gur sayvi-o jis pasaa-ay gat  agam jaan ee. Blessed is service to the True Guru; by His Grace, the State of the Unfathomable Lordis known.

lines.punjabi: ਧਿਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਿਜਸੁ ਪਸਾਇ  ਗਿਤ  ਅਗਮ  ਜਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: All Your generations are totally saved; You dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. pMnw 1394
lines.transliteration: kul sambooh samuDhray paa-ya-o naam nivaas.

lines.english: So speaks KALL: fruitful is the life of one who meets with Guru Amar Daas, radiantwith the Light of God. ||8||
lines.transliteration: sakyath janam kal-yuchrai gur paras-yi-o amar pargaas. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਯਥੁ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੁਚਰੈ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਿਸਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਅਮਰ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: On His right hand is the sign of the lotus; the Siddhis, the supernatural spiritualpowers, await His Command.
lines.transliteration: baarij kar daahin ai siDh  sanmukh  mukh  jovai.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਿਰਜੁ  ਕਿਰ ਦਾਿਹਣੈ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਸਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: On His left are worldly powers, which fascinate the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: riDh basai baaNvaaNg jo teen lokaant ar mohai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਿਧ  ਬਸੈ ਬਵਿਗ  ਜੁ ਤੀਿਨ  ਲੋਕਤਰ  ਮੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The Inexpressible Lord abides in His Heart; He alone knows this joy.
lines.transliteration: ridai basai ak-hee-o so-ay ras t in hee jaat a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਅਕਹੀਉ  ਸੋਇ ਰਸੁ ਿਤਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas utters the words of devotion, imbued with the Love of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mukhahu bh agat uchrai amar gur it  rang raat a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਉਚਰੈ  ਅਮਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਤੁ ਰੰਿਗ ਰਾਤਉ  ॥
lines.english: On His forehead is the true insignia of the Lord's Mercy; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.
lines.transliteration: mastak neesaan  sacha-o karam kal-y jorh  kar Dh ayaa-i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ਸਚਉ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਜੋਿੜ ਕਰ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਇਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever meets with the Guru, the certifie d True Guru, has all his desires fulfilled. ||9||
lines.transliteration: parsi-o guroo satgur t ilak sarab ichh  tin paa-i-a-o. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਿਸਅਉ  ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਤਲਕੁ  ਸਰਬ  ਇਛ ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਾਇਅਉ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Supremely fruitful are the feet which walk upon the path of Guru Amar Daas.
lines.transliteration: charan t a par sakyath charan  gur amar paval ra-y.

lines.punjabi: ਚਰਣ  ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਚਰਣ  ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ  ਪਵਿਲ  ਰਯ ॥
lines.english: Supremely fruitful are the hands which touch the feet of Guru Amar Daas.
lines.transliteration: hath ta par sakyath hath lageh gur amar pa-y.

lines.punjabi: ਹਥ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ  ਹਥ ਲਗਿਹ  ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ  ਪਯ ॥
lines.english: Supremely fruitful is the tongue which utters the praises of Guru Amar Daas.
lines.transliteration: jeeh ta par sakyath jeeh gur amar bh anijai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਹ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਿਣਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Supremely fruitful are the eyes which behold Guru Amar Daas.
lines.transliteration: nain t a par sakyath na-yan  gur amar pikh ijai.

lines.punjabi: ਨੈਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ  ਨਯਿਣ  ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਿਪਿਖਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Supremely fruitful are the ears which hear the Praises of Guru Amar Daas.
lines.transliteration: sarvan t a par sakyath sarvan  gur amar sun ijai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ਵਣ  ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ  ਸਰ੍ਵਿਣ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁਿਣਜੈ  ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the heart in which Guru Amar Daas, the Father of the world, Himself abides.
lines.transliteration: sakyath so hee-o jit hee-a basai gur amard aas nij jagat  pit.

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਯਥੁ  ਸੁ ਹੀਉ ਿਜਤੁ  ਹੀਅ  ਬਸੈ ਗੁ ਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ  ਿਨਜ ਜਗਤ  ਿਪਤ ॥
lines.english: Fruitful is the head, says Jaalap, which bows forever before Guru Amar Daas. ||1||10||
lines.transliteration: jwlp) sakyath so sir jaalap bhan ai jo sir nivai gur amar nit . ||1||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਯਥੁ  ਸੁ ਿਸਰੁ ਜਾਲਪੁ  ਭਣੈ ਜੁ ਿਸਰੁ ਿਨਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ  ਿਨਤ ॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.english: They do not suffer pain or hunger, and they cannot be called poor.
lines.transliteration: te nar d ukh nah bh ukh te nar niDh an nahu kahee-ahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤ ਨਰ ਦੁਖ ਨਹ ਭੁਖ ਿਤ ਨਰ ਿਨਧਨ  ਨਹੁ ਕਹੀਅਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They do not grieve, and their limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: te nar sok nahu hu-ai t e nar say ant  na lahee-ah.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤ ਨਰ ਸੋਕੁ ਨਹੁ ਹੂਐ ਿਤ ਨਰ ਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਅਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They do not serve anyone else, but they give gifts to hundreds and thousands.
lines.transliteration: te nar sayv nahu karahi t e nar sa-y sahas sampeh.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤ ਨਰ ਸੇਵ ਨਹੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਤ ਨਰ ਸਯ ਸਹਸ ਸਮਪਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They sit on beautiful carpets; they establish and disestablish at will.
lines.transliteration: te nar d uleechai baheh t e nar uthap bithpahi.

lines.english: They find peace in this world, and live fearlessly amidst their enemies.
lines.transliteration: sukh laheh t e nar sansaar meh abh ai pat rip maDh  tih.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਲਹਿਹ  ਿਤ ਨਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਮਿਹ ਅਭੈ ਪਟੁ ਿਰਪ ਮਿਧ ਿਤਹ ॥
lines.english: They are fruitful and prosperous, says Jaalap. Guru Amar Daas is pleased with them. ||2||11||
lines.transliteration: jwlp) sakyath te nar jaalap bh anai gur amard aas suparsan jih. ||2||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਕਯਥ  ਿਤ ਨਰ ਜਾਲਪੁ  ਭਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ  ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨੁ ਿਜਹ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.english: You read about the One Lord, and enshrine Him in Your mind; You realize the One and Only Lord.
lines.transliteration: tai padh i-a-o ik man dh ari-a-o ik kar ik pachh aani-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਪਿਢਅਉ  ਇਕੁ ਮਿਨ ਧਿਰਅਉ  ਇਕੁ ਕਿਰ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਿਣਓ  ॥
lines.english: With Your eyes and the words You speak, You dwell upon the One Lord; You do not know any other place of rest.
lines.transliteration: na-yan ba-yan  muhi ik ik d uhu th aaN-ay na jaan i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਯਿਣ  ਬਯਿਣ  ਮੁਿਹ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਠਇ  ਨ ਜਾਿਣਓ  ॥
lines.english: You know the One Lord while dreaming, and the One Lord while awake. You areabsorbed in the One.
lines.transliteration: supan ik partakh  ik ikas meh leen a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਪਿਨ  ਇਕੁ ਪਰਤਿਖ  ਇਕੁ ਇਕਸ  ਮਿਹ ਲੀਣਉ  ॥
lines.english: At the age of seventy-one, You began to march towards the Indestructible Lord.
lines.transliteration: tees ik ar panj siDh  paitees na kh eena-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਸ ਇਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਪੰਿਜ ਿਸਧੁ ਪੈਤੀਸ  ਨ ਖੀਣਉ  ॥
lines.english: The One Lord, who takes hundreds of thousands of forms, cannot be seen. He canonly be described as One.
lines.transliteration: ikahu je laakh lakh ahu alakh  hai ik ik kar varni-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਹੁ ਿਜ ਲਾਖੁ  ਲਖਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ  ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਕਿਰ ਵਰਿਨਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks Jaalap: O Guru Amar Daas, You long for the One Lord, and believe in the One Lord alone. ||3||12||
lines.transliteration: jwlp) gur amardaas jaalap bh anai too ik lorh eh ik manni-a-o. ||3||12||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਜਾਲਪੁ  ਭਣੈ ਤੂ ਇਕੁ ਲੋੜਿਹ  ਇਕੁ ਮੰਿਨਅਉ  ॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.english: The understanding which Jai Dayv grasped, the understanding which permeatedNaam Dayv,
lines.transliteration: je mat gahee jaid ayv je mat  naamai sammaan ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜ ਮਿਤ ਗਹੀ ਜੈਦੇਿਵ  ਿਜ ਮਿਤ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਮਾਣੀ  ॥
lines.transliteration: je mat t arilochan chit  bhagat kambeereh jaan ee. the understanding which was in the consciousness of Trilochan and known by thedevotee Kabeer,
rukmaaNgad kart oot raam jampahu nit  bhaa-ee. by which Rukmaangad constantly meditated on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny,

lines.english: Universe, and which brought them to salvation
lines.transliteration: ammreek parahlaad saran  gobind  gat paa-ee. which brought Ambreek and Prahlaad to seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਮਰੀਿਕ  ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਿਦ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: tai lobh  kroDh  tarisnaa t ajee so mat  jal-y jaan ee jugat . -says JALL that sublime understanding has brought You to renounce greed, anger anddesire, and to know the way.

lines.punjabi: ਤੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਸਨਾ  ਤਜੀ  ਸੁ ਮਿਤ ਜਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਜਾਣੀ  ਜੁਗਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas is the Lord's own devotee; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of HisDarshan, one is liberated. ||4||13||
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas nij bh agat hai d aykh daras paava-o mukat . ||4||13||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ  ਿਨਜ ਭਗਤੁ  ਹੈ ਦੇਿਖ ਦਰਸੁ  ਪਾਵਉ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the earth is purged of its sin.
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas parsee-ai puham paat ik binaaseh.

lines.english: The Siddhas and seekers long to meet with Guru Amar Daas.
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas parsee-ai siDh  saaDh ik aasaaseh.

lines.english: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the mortal meditates on the Lord, and his journeycomes to its end.
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas parsee-ai Dh i-aan lahee-ai pa-o mukihi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ  ਪਰਸੀਐ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ਲਹੀਐ  ਪਉ ਮੁਿਕਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and the cycle of reincarnation is brought to an end. pMnw 1395
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas parsee-ai abh a-o labh ai ga-o chukihi.

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ  ਪਰਸੀਐ  ਅਭਉ  ਲਭੈ ਗਉ ਚੁਿਕਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Realizing the One Lord, love of duality ceases, and one comes to accept the Sublime Mantra of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: ik binn dugan  jo ta-o rahai jaa sumant ar maanvahi leh.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਿਬੰਿਨ  ਦੁਗਣ  ਜੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਸੁਮੰਿਤਰ੍  ਮਾਨਵਿਹ ਲਿਹ ॥
lines.english: So speaks Jaalap: countless treasures are obtained, by the sight of Guru Amar Daas. ||5||14||
lines.transliteration: jaalpaa padaarath it -rhay gur amard aas dith ai mileh. ||5||14||

lines.english: Guru Nanak gathered up the True Name of the Creator Lord, and implanted it within.
lines.transliteration: sach naam kartaar so d arirh naanak sangar-hi-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਸੰਗਰ੍ਿਹਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through Him, Lehnaa became manifest in the form of Guru Angad, who remainedlovingly attuned to His Feet.
lines.transliteration: taa tay angad  lahnaa pargat t aas charn ah liv rahi-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ  ਲਹਣਾ  ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟ  ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣਹ  ਿਲਵ  ਰਿਹਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas of that dynasty is the home of hope. How can I express His GloriousVirtues?
lines.transliteration: tit kul gur amard aas aasaa nivaas t aas gun  kavan  vakh aana-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਤੁ  ਕੁਿਲ  ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ  ਆਸਾ  ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਣ  ਵਖਾਣਉ  ॥
lines.english: His Virtues are unknowable and unfathomable. I do not know the limits of His Virtues.
lines.transliteration: jo gun alakh  agamm t inah gun  ant na jaan a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਅਲਖ  ਅਗੰਮ  ਿਤਨਹ  ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, has made Him a boat to carry all Hisgenerations across, along with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.
lines.transliteration: bohitha-o biDhaat ai niramyou sabh  sangat  kul uDh ran.

lines.english: So speaks Keerat: O Guru Amar Daas, please protect me and save me; I seek theSanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||15||
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas keerat  kahai t araahi t araahi t u-a paa saran . ||1||15||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਕੀਰਤੁ  ਕਹੈ ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਤਰ੍ਾਿਹ  ਤੁਅ ਪਾ ਸਰਣ  ॥੧॥੧੫॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself wielded His Power and entered the world.
lines.transliteration: aap naraa-in kalaa Dh aar jag meh parvari-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਪ  ਨਰਾਇਣੁ  ਕਲਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਪਰਵਿਰਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Formless Lord took form, and with His Light He illuminated the realms of the world.
lines.transliteration: nirankaar aakaar jot jag mandal kari-ya-o.

lines.english: He is All-pervading everywhere; the Lamp of the Shabad, the Word, has been lit.
lines.transliteration: jah kah tah bh arpoor sabad  deepak d eepaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਕਹ ਤਹ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ  ਦੀਪਿਕ  ਦੀਪਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever gathers in the essence of the teachings shall be absorbed in the Feet of theLord.
lines.transliteration: jih sikhah sangarahi-o t at har charan  milaa-ya-o.

lines.english: Lehnaa, who became Guru Angad, and Guru Amar Daas, have been reincarnated intothe pure house of Guru Nanak.
lines.transliteration: naanak kul nimmal avtar-yi-o angad  lahnay sang hu-a.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੁਿਲ  ਿਨੰਮਲੁ  ਅਵਤਿਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਅੰਗਦ  ਲਹਣੇ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਹੁਅ ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas is our Saving Grace, who carries us across; in lifetime after lifetime, Iseek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||2||16||
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas t aaran  taran janam janam paa saran  tu-a. ||2||16||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁ ਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ  ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ  ਪਾ ਸਰਿਣ  ਤੁਅ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the Gursikh is blessed with chantingand deep meditation, truth and contentment.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sat  santokh pikh darsan gur sikh ah.

lines.punjabi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਿਪਿਖ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਸਖਹ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever seeks His Sanctuary is saved; his account is cleared in the City of Death.
lines.transliteration: saran pareh t ay ubrahi chh od jam pur kee likh ah.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਿਣ ਪਰਿਹ  ਤੇ ਉਬਰਿਹ  ਛੋਿਡ ਜਮ ਪੁਰ ਕੀ ਿਲਖਹ  ॥
lines.english: His heart is totally filled with loving devotion; he chants to the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  bhaa-ay bh arpoor rid ai uchrai kart aarai.

lines.english: The Guru is the river of pearls; in an instant, he carries the drowning ones across.
lines.transliteration: gur ga-uhar daree-aa-o palak dubaNt-yah t aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ  ਪਲਕ  ਡੁਬੰਤਯ੍ਯ੍ਹ  ਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: He was reincarnated into the House of Guru Nanak; He chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak kul nimmal avtar-yi-o gun  kartaarai uchrai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੁਿਲ  ਿਨੰਮਲੁ  ਅਵਤਿਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਗੁਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੈ  ਉਚਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who serve Guru Amar Daas - their pains and poverty are taken away, far away. ||3||17||
lines.transliteration: kIrqu) gur amardaas jinH sayvi-a-o t inH dukh daridar parhar parai. ||3||17||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਿਜਨ ਸੇਿਵਅਉ  ਿਤਨ  ਦੁਖੁ ਦਿਰਦਰ੍ੁ  ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਪਰੈ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
lines.english: I consciously pray within my consciousness, but I cannot express it in words.
lines.transliteration: chit chit va-o ard aas kaha-o par kahi bh e na saka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਿਤ  ਿਚਤਵਉ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਕਹਉ  ਪਰੁ ਕਿਹ ਿਭ ਨ ਸਕਉ  ॥
lines.english: I place all my worries and anxieties before You; I look to the Saadh Sangat, theCompany of the Holy, for help.
lines.transliteration: sarab chint t ujh paas saaDh sangat  ha-o t aka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਬ  ਿਚੰਤ  ਤੁਝੁ ਪਾਿਸ  ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਉ ਤਕਉ  ॥
lines.english: By the Hukam of Your Command, I am blessed with Your Insignia; I serve my Lordand Master.
lines.transliteration: tayrai hukam pavai neesaan  ta-o kara-o saahib kee sayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ਤਉ ਕਰਉ  ਸਾਿਹਬ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: When You, O Guru, gaze at me with Your Glance of Grace, the fruit of the Naam, theName of the Creator, is placed within my mouth.
lines.transliteration: jab gur daykh ai subh  disat naam kart aa mukh  mayvaa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਗੁ ਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਭ ਿਦਸਿਟ  ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਮੇਵਾ ॥
lines.english: The Unfathomable and Unseen Primal Lord God, the Cause of causes - as He orders,so do I speak.
lines.transliteration: agam alakh kaaran  purakh  jo furmaaveh so kaha-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਅਲਖ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਪੁਰਖ  ਜੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਵਿਹ ਸੋ ਕਹਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Guru Amar Daas, Doer of deeds, Cause of causes, as You keep me, I remain; asYou protect me, I survive. ||4||18|| iBKy ky ] (1395-15) bhikh ay kay. Of Bhikhaa:
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas kaaran  karan  jiv too rakh eh tiv raha-o. ||4||18||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਕਰਣ  ਿਜਵ ਤੂ ਰਖਿਹ  ਿਤਵ ਰਹਉ  ॥੪॥੧੮॥
lines.english: In deep meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru, one's essence merges with the essence of reality.
lines.transliteration: gur gi-aan ar Dhi-aan t at si-o t at milaavai.

lines.english: In truth, the True Lord is recognized and realized, when one is lovingly attuned toHim, with one-pointed consciousness.
lines.transliteration: sach sach jaanee-ai ik chit eh liv laavai.

lines.english: Lust and anger are brought under control, when the breath does not fly around,wandering restlessly.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh vas karai pavan  udant  na Dh aavai.

lines.english: Dwelling in the land of the Formless Lord, realizing the Hukam of His Command, Hiscontemplative wisdom is attained.
lines.transliteration: nirankaar kai vasai days hukam bujh  beechaar paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਵਿਸ ਕਰੈ ਪਵਣੁ  ਉਡੰਤ  ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Guru is the Form of the Creator, the Primal LordGod; he alone knows, who has tried it.
lines.transliteration: kal maahi roop kartaa purakh  so jaan ai jin kichh  kee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰ  ਕੈ ਵਸੈ ਦੇਿਸ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਿਝ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: So speaks Bhikhaa: I have met the Guru. With love and intuitive affection, He hasbestowed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||19||
lines.transliteration: gur mili-ya-o so-ay bhikh aa kahai sahj rang d arsan d ee-a-o. ||1||19||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਰੂਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਕਛੁ  ਕੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: I have been searching for the Saints; I have seen so many Holy and spiritual people.
lines.transliteration: rahi-o sant ha-o tol saaDh  bahut ayray dith ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਿਲਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਸੋਇ ਿਭਖਾ  ਕਹੈ ਸਹਜ  ਰੰਿਗ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਅਉ  ॥੧॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The hermits, Sannyaasees, ascetics, penitents, fanatics and Pandits all speak sweetly.
lines.transliteration: sani-aasee tapsee-ah mukh ahu ay pandit  mithay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਹਓ  ਸੰਤ ਹਉ ਟੋਿਲ  ਸਾਧ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਿਡਠੇ ॥
lines.english: I wandered around lost for a year, but no one touched my soul. pMnw 1396
lines.transliteration: baras ayk ha-o firi-o kinai nahu parcha-o laa-ya-o.

lines.english: I listened to preachers and teachers, but I could not be happy with their lifestyles.
lines.transliteration: kehti-ah kaht ee sun ee rahat  ko kh usee na aa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹਿਤਅਹ  ਕਹਤੀ  ਸੁਣੀ ਰਹਤ  ਕੋ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have abandoned the Lord's Name, and become attached to duality - why should I speak in praise of them?
lines.transliteration: har naam chhod d oojai lagay t inH kay gun  ha-o ki-aa kaha-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਿਡ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਿਕਆ  ਕਹਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks Bhikhaa: the Lord has led me to meet the Guru. As You keep me, I remain;as You protect me, I survive. ||2||20||
lines.transliteration: gur da-yi milaa-ya-o bh ikhi-aa jiv t oo rakh eh tiv raha-o. ||2||20||

lines.english: Wearing the armor of Samaadhi, the Guru has mounted the saddled horse of spiritualwisdom.
lines.transliteration: pahir samaaDh sanaahu gi-aan hai aasan  charh i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਿਰ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਸਨਾਹੁ ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਹੈ ਆਸਿਣ  ਚਿੜਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dharamm Dh anakh  kar gahi-o bh agat seelah sar larh i-a-o. Holding the bow of Dharma in His Hands, He has shot the arrows of devotion andhumility.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰ੍ੰਮ ਧਨਖੁ  ਕਰ ਗਿਹਓ  ਭਗਤ  ਸੀਲਹ ਸਿਰ ਲਿੜਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: He is fearless in the Fear of the Eternal Lord God; He has thrust the spear of the Wordof the Guru's Shabad into the mind.
lines.transliteration: bhai nirbh a-o har atal man sabad  gur nayjaa gadi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਹਿਰ ਅਟਲੁ  ਮਿਨ ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰ ਨੇਜਾ ਗਿਡਓ  ॥
lines.english: He has cut down the five demons of unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger, unsatisfied greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh lobh  moh apat  panch d oot bikhandi-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਤੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਿਬਖੰਿਡਓ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas, the son of Tayj Bhaan, of the noble Bhalla dynasty, blessed by GuruNanak, is the Master of kings.
lines.transliteration: bhala-o bh oohaal t ayjo t anaa nript  naath naanak bar.

lines.punjabi: ਭਲਉ  ਭੂਹਾਲੁ ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨਾ  ਿਨਰ੍ਪਿਤ  ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਿਰ ॥
lines.english: SALL speaks the truth; O Guru Amar Daas, you have conquered the army of evil,fighting the battle this way. ||1||21||
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas sach sal-y bh an tai dal jita-o iv juDh  kar. ||1||21||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਸਚੁ ਸਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਭਿਣ ਤੈ ਦਲੁ ਿਜਤਉ  ਇਵ ਜੁਧੁ ਕਿਰ ॥੧॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The raindrops of the clouds, the plants of the earth, and the flowers of the springcannot be counted.
lines.transliteration: ghanhar boond  basu-a romaaval kusam basant  ganant  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਘਨਹਰ  ਬੂੰਦ ਬਸੁਅ  ਰੋਮਾਵਿਲ  ਕੁਸਮ  ਬਸੰਤ  ਗਨੰਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: Who can know the limits of the rays of the sun and the moon, the waves of the oceanand the Ganges?
lines.transliteration: rav sas kiran ud ar saagar ko gang t arang ant  ko paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਸਿਸ ਿਕਰਿਣ  ਉਦਰੁ ਸਾਗਰ  ਕੋ ਗੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ  ਅੰਤੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: With Shiva's meditation and the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, says BHALL thepoet, these may be counted.
lines.transliteration: rudr Dh i-aan gi-aan sat gur kay kab jan bh al-y unah jo gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਰੁਦਰ੍ ਿਧਆਨ  ਿਗਆਨ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੇ ਕਿਬ ਜਨ ਭਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਉਨਹ  ਜ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Guru Amar Daas, Your Glorious Virtues are so sublime; Your Praises belong only toYou. ||1||22|| sveIey mhly cauQy ky 4  (1396-10) sava-ee-ay mahlay cha-uthay kay 4 Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1396-10) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: bhalay amard aas gun  tayray t ayree upmaa t ohi ban aavai. ||1||22||

lines.punjabi: ਭਲੇ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ  ਤੋਿਹ ਬਿਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Meditate single-mindedly on the Immaculate Primal Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ik man purakh niranjan Dh i-aava-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਵਈਏ  ਮਹਲੇ  ਚਉਥੇ  ਕੇ ੪ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad har gun  sad gaava-o.

lines.english: Singing His Praises, the mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat man ho-ay bigaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਗਾਵਉ  ॥
lines.english: The True Guru fulfills the hopes of His humble servant.
lines.transliteration: satgur poor janah kee aasaa.

lines.english: Serving the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv param pad  paa-ya-o.

lines.english: Meditate on the Imperishable, Formless Lord God.
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee abigat  Dhi-aa-ya-o.

lines.english: Meeting with Him, one escapes poverty.
lines.transliteration: tis bh aytay d aaridar na champai.

lines.english: Kal Sahaar chants His Glorious Praises.
lines.transliteration: kal-y sahaar taas gun  jampai.

lines.english: I chant the pure praises of that humble being who has been blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jampa-o gun bimal sujan jan kayray ami-a naam jaa ka-o furi-aa.

lines.english: He served the True Guru and was blessed with the sublime essence of the Shabad,the Word of God. The Immaculate Naam has been enshrined in his heart.
lines.transliteration: in satgur sayv sabad  ras paa-yaa naam niranjan ur Dh ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਪਉ  ਗੁਣ ਿਬਮਲ  ਸੁਜਨ  ਜਨ ਕੇਰੇ ਅਿਮਅ  ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He enjoys and savors the Lord's Name, and purchases the Glorious Virtues of the Lordof the Universe. He seeks the essence of reality; he is the Fountain of even-handedjustice.
lines.transliteration: har naam rasik gobind gun  gaahak chaahak t at samat  saray.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਨ  ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਬਦ  ਰਸੁ ਪਾਯਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਉਿਰ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty poolsto overflowing. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kav kal-y thakur hard aas tanay gur raamd aas sar abh ar bharay. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਿਸਕੁ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ  ਚਾਹਕੁ  ਤਤ ਸਮਤ  ਸਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The stream of ambrosial nectar flows and the immortal status is obtained; the pool isforever overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: chhutat  parvaah ami-a amraa pad  amrit  sarovar sad  bhari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਵ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਠਕੁਰ  ਹਰਦਾਸ  ਤਨੇ ਗੁ ਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਸਰ ਅਭਰ  ਭਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Those Saints who have served the Lord in the past drink in this Nectar, and bathetheir minds in it.
lines.transliteration: tay peeveh sant  karahi man majan pub jinahu sayvaa karee-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਛੁਟਤ  ਪਰਵਾਹ  ਅਿਮਅ  ਅਮਰਾ  ਪਦ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਰੋਵਰ  ਸਦ ਭਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: God takes their fears away, and blesses them with the state of fearless dignity.Through the Word of His Shabad, He has saved them.
lines.transliteration: tin bh a-o nivaar anbh ai pad  deenaa sabad  matar tay uDh ar Dh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਪੀਵਿਹ  ਸੰਤ ਕਰਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਪੁਬ ਿਜਨਹੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀਆ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty poolsto overflowing. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kav kal-y thakur hard aas tanay gur raamd aas sar abh ar bharay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਭਉ ਿਨਵਾਿਰ  ਅਨਭੈ  ਪਦੁ ਦੀਨਾ  ਸਬਦ ਮਾਤਰ੍ ਤੇ ਉਧਰ  ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru's understanding is deep and profound. The Sat Sangat is His Pure Congregation. His Soul is drenched in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.
lines.transliteration: satgur mat  goorhH bimal sat sangat  aatam rang chalool bh a-yaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਵ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਠਕੁਰ  ਹਰਦਾਸ  ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਸਰ ਅਭਰ  ਭਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Lotus of His mind remains awake and aware, illuminated with intuitive wisdom. In His own home, He has obtained the Fearless, Immaculate Lord. pMnw 1397
lines.transliteration: jaag-yaa man kaval sahj parkaas-yaa abhai niranjan gh areh lahaa.

lines.english: The Merciful True Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me, and by His Grace, I have overpowered the five thieves.
lines.transliteration: satgur d a-yaal har naam d arirh-aa-yaa t is parsaad  vas panch karay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦਯਾਿਲ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਯਾ  ਿਤਸੁ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਵਿਸ ਪੰਚ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty poolsto overflowing. ||3||
lines.transliteration: kav kal-y thakur hard aas tanay gur raamd aas sar abh ar bharay. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਵ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ  ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਸਰ ਅਭਰ  ਭਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.english: With intuitive detachment, He is lovingly attuned to the Fearless, Unmanifest Lord; Hemet with Guru Amar Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, within his own home.
lines.transliteration: anbha-o unmaan akal liv laagee paaras bh ayti-aa sahj gh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਭਉ  ਉਨਮਾਿਨ  ਅਕਲ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਭੇਿਟਆ ਸਹਜ  ਘਰੇ ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the True Guru, He attained the supreme status; He is overflowingwith the treasures of loving devotion.
lines.transliteration: satgur parsaad  param pad  paa-yaa bh agat bhaa-ay bh andaar bh aray.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਾ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਾਇ  ਭੰਡਾਰ  ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He was released from reincarnation, and the fear of death was taken away. Hisconsciousness is attached to the Lord, the Ocean of contentment.
lines.transliteration: mayti-aa janmaaNt maran  bha-o bh aagaa chit  laagaa sant okh saray.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਿਟਆ  ਜਨਮਤੁ  ਮਰਣ  ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਗਾ  ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਸਰੇ ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kav kal-y thakur hard aas tanay gur raamd aas sar abh ar bharay. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਵ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਠਕੁਰ  ਹਰਦਾਸ  ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਸਰ ਅਭਰ  ਭਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He fills the empty to overflowing; He has enshrined the Infinite within His heart.
lines.transliteration: abhar bh aray paa-ya-o apaar rid  antar Dh aari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਾਯਉ  ਅਪਾਰੁ ਿਰਦ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਧਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: Within His mind, He contemplates the essence of reality, the Destroyer of pain, theEnlightener of the soul.
lines.transliteration: dukh bhanjan aat am parboDh  man t at beechaari-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਬੋਧੁ  ਮਿਨ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਿਰਓ  ॥
lines.english: He yearns for the Lord's Love forever; He Himself knows the sublime essence of thisLove.
lines.transliteration: sadaa chaa-ay har bh aa-ay paraym ras aapay jaan -ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਚਾਇ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਇ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ  ਜਾਣਇ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of the True Guru, He intuitively enjoys this Love.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai parsaad  sahj sayt ee rang maan -ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਿਦ  ਸਹਜ  ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਇ  ॥
lines.english: By the Grace of Guru Nanak, and the sublime teachings of Guru Angad, Guru AmarDaas broadcast the Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: naanak parsaad angad  sumat  gur amar amar vart aa-i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ ਅੰਗਦ  ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਗੁਿਰ ਅਮਿਰ  ਅਮਰੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the status of eternal andimperishable dignity. ||5||
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas kal-yuchrai t aiN atal amar pad  paa-i-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੁਚਰੈ  ਤੈਂ ਅਟਲ  ਅਮਰ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: You abide in the pool of contentment; Your tongue reveals the Ambrosial Essence.
lines.transliteration: santokh  sarovar basai ami-a ras rasan parkaasai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਸਰੋਵਿਰ  ਬਸੈ ਅਿਮਅ  ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਸੈ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with You, a tranquil peace wells up, and sins run far away.
lines.transliteration: milat saaNt upjai d urat doorant ar naasai.

lines.english: You have attained the Ocean of peace, and You never grow tired on the Lord's path.
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar paa-i-a-o binn har mag na hutai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ  ਿਦੰਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਗ ਨ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
lines.english: The armor of self-restraint, truth, contentment and humility can never be pierced.
lines.transliteration: sanjam sat sant okh seel sannahu mafutai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸੀਲ  ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ਮਫੁਟੈ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Lord certified the True Guru, and now the world blows the trumpet of His Praises.
lines.transliteration: satgur parmaan  biDh nai siri-o jag jas t oor bajaa-i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਮਾਣੁ  ਿਬਧ ਨੈ ਿਸਿਰਉ  ਜਿਗ  ਜਸ ਤੂਰੁ ਬਜਾਇਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the state of fearlessimmortality. ||6||
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas kal-yuchrai t ai abh ai amar pad  paa-i-a-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੁਚਰੈ  ਤੈ ਅਭੈ ਅਮਰ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: O certified True Guru, You have conquered the world; You meditate single-mindedlyon the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: jag jita-o sat gur parmaan  man ayk Dh i-aa-ya-o.

lines.english: Dhan Dh an sat gur amard aas jin naam d arirhaa-ya-o. Blessed, blessed is Guru Amar Daas, th e True Guru, who implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.
The Naam is the wealth of the nine treasures; prosperity and supernatural spiritualpowers are His slaves.
lines.transliteration: nav niDh naam niDh aan riDh  siDh taa kee d aasee.

lines.english: He is blessed with the ocean of intuitive wisdom; He has met with the Imperishable Lord God.
lines.transliteration: sahj sarovar mili-o purakh bh ayti-o abh inaasee.

lines.english: The Guru has implanted the Naam deep within; attached to the Naam, the devotees have been carried across since ancient times.
lines.transliteration: aad lay bh agat jit lag taray so gur naam d arirhaa-i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਲੇ ਭਗਤ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਲਿਗ  ਤਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਇਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have obtained the wealth of the Lord'sLove. ||7||
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas kal-yuchrai t ai har paraym pad aarath paa-i-a-o. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੁਚਰੈ  ਤੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The flow of loving devotion and primal love does not stop.
lines.transliteration: paraym bhagat  parvaah pareet  publee na hut-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਰਵਾਹ  ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਪੁਬਲੀ  ਨ ਹੁਟਇ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru drinks in the stream of nectar, the sublime essence of the Shabad, theInfinite Word of God.
lines.transliteration: satgur sabad  athaahu ami-a Dh aaraa ras gut-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਿਮਅ  ਧਾਰਾ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਟਇ  ॥
lines.english: Wisdom is His mother, and contentment is His father; He is absorbed in the ocean ofintuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: mat maat aa sant okh pitaa sar sahj samaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਿਪਤਾ  ਸਿਰ ਸਹਜ  ਸਮਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Embodiment of the Unborn, Self-illumined Lord; by the Word of HisTeachings, the Guru carries the world across.
lines.transliteration: aajonee sambhvi-a-o jagat  gur bachan t araa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਜੋਨੀ  ਸੰਭਿਵਅਉ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ ਤਰਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Within His mind, the Guru has enshrined the Shabad, the Word of the Unseen,Unfathomable, Infinite Lord.
lines.transliteration: abigat agochar aparpar man gur sabad  vasaa-i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਗਤ  ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰਪਰੁ ਮਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਵਸਾਇਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the Lord, the Saving Grace ofthe world. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas kal-yuchrai t ai jagat  uDhaaran  paa-i-a-o. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੁਚਰੈ  ਤੈ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ  ਪਾਇਅਉ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Saving Grace of the world, the nine treasures, carries the devotees across the world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jagat uDh aaran  nav niDh aan bh agtah bh av taaran .

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣੁ  ਨਵ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਭਗਤਹ  ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Drop of Ambrosial Nectar, the Lord's Name, is the antidote to the poison of sin.
lines.transliteration: amrit boond  har naam bis kee bikh ai nivaaran .

lines.english: The tree of intuitive peace and poise blossoms and bears the ambrosial fruit ofspiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sahj tarovar fali-o gi-aan amrit  fal laagay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਜ  ਤਰੋਵਰ  ਫਿਲਓ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed are those fortunate people who receive it, by Guru's Grace.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad paa-ee-ah Dh an tay jan badbh aagay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਪਾਈਅਿਹ ਧੰਿਨ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਬਡਭਾਗੇ  ॥
lines.english: They are liberated through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; their minds arefilled with the Guru's Wisdom.
lines.transliteration: tay mukt ay bh a-ay sat gur sabad  man gur parchaa paa-i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ  ਭਏ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚਾ  ਪਾਇਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You beat the drum of the Shabad. ||9|| pMnw 1398
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas kal-yuchrai t ai sabad  neesaan bajaa-i-a-o. ||9||

lines.english: On the bed of faith, with the blankets of intuitive peace and poise and the canopy of contentment, You are embellished forever with the armor of humility.
lines.transliteration: sayj saDhaa sahj chh aavaan  santokh saraa-icha-o sad aa seel sannahu sohai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਜ ਸਧਾ ਸਹਜੁ  ਛਾਵਾਣੁ  ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸਰਾਇਚਉ  ਸਦਾ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you practice the Naam; You lean on itsSupport, and give Your Fragrance to Your companions.
lines.transliteration: gur sabad samaachri-o naam tayk sangaad  bohai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਚਿਰਓ  ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਸੰਗਾਿਦ  ਬੋਹੈ ॥
lines.english: You abide with the Unborn Lord, the Good and Pure True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ajonee-o bhalyu amal sat gur sang nivaas.

lines.english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You abide in the sacred pool of intuitive peace and poise. ||10||
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas kal-yuchrai t u-a sahj sarovar baas. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੁਚਰੈ  ਤੁਅ ਸਹਜ  ਸਰੋਵਿਰ  ਬਾਸੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name abides in the hearts of those who are pleasing to the Guru.
