lines.transliteration: gur jinH ka-o suparsan naam har ridai nivaasai.

lines.english: Sins run far away from those who are pleasing to the Guru.
lines.transliteration: jinH ka-o gur suparsan durat  doorant ar naasai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨੁ ਦੁਰਤੁ  ਦੂਰੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਸੈ ॥
lines.english: Those who are pleasing to the Guru eradicate pride and egotism from within.
lines.transliteration: gur jinH ka-o suparsan maan abhimaan nivaarai.

lines.english: Those who are pleasing to the Guru are attached to the Shadad, the Word of God;they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: jinH ka-o gur suparsan sabad lag bh avjal t aarai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਲਿਗ  ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with the wisdom of the certified Guru - blessed and fruitful istheir birth into the world.
lines.transliteration: parcha-o parmaan gur paa-i-a-o t in sakaytha-o janam jag.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਚਉ  ਪਰ੍ਮਾਣੁ  ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਅਉ  ਿਤਨ ਸਕਯਥਉ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਜਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: KALL the poet runs to the Sanctuary of the Great Guru; attached to the Guru, they areblessed with worldly enjoyments, liberation and everything. ||11||
lines.transliteration: saree guroo saran bh aj kal-y kab bh ugat mukat  sabh  guroo lag. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਰਿਣ  ਭਜੁ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਕਿਬ ਭੁਗਿਤ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਸਭ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਗ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Guru has pitched the tent; under it, all the ages are gathered.
lines.transliteration: satgur kh aymaa t aani-aa jug jooth samaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ ਖੇਮਾ ਤਾਿਣਆ  ਜੁਗ ਜੂਥ ਸਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: He carries the spear of intuition, and takes the Support of Naam, the Name of the Lord, through which the devotees are fulfilled.
lines.transliteration: anbha-o nayjaa naam tayk jit  bhagat aghaanay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਭਉ  ਨੇਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਿਜਤੁ ਭਗਤ  ਅਘਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, through devotional worship, havemerged into the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur naanak angad amar bh agat har sang samaan ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਸੰਿਗ  ਸਮਾਣੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Guru Raam Daas, You alone know the taste of this Raja Yoga. ||12||
lines.transliteration: ih raaj jog gur raamdaas t umH hoo ras jaan ay. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ  ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਤੁਮ ਹੂ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣੇ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: He alone is enlightened like Janaka, who links the chariot of his mind to the state ofecstatic realization.
lines.transliteration: janak so-ay jin jaani-aa unman rath Dh ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਕੁ  ਸੋਇ ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਉਨਮਿਨ  ਰਥੁ ਧਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He gathers in truth and contentment, and fills up the empty pool within.
lines.transliteration: sat sant okh samaachray abh raa sar bh ari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਸਮਾਚਰੇ  ਅਭਰਾ  ਸਰੁ ਭਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: He speaks the Unspoken Speech of the eternal city. He alone obtains it, unto whomGod gives it.
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa amraa puree jis day-ay so paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਅਮਰਾ  ਪੁਰੀ ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Guru Raam Daas, Your sovereign rule, like that of Janak, is Yours alone. ||13||
lines.transliteration: ih janak raaj gur raamdaas t ujh hee ban  aavai. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਕ  ਰਾਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਬਿਣ ਆਵੈ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Tell me, how can sin and suffering cling to that humble being who chants the Naam, given by the Guru, with single-minded love and firm faith?
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) satgur naam ayk liv man japai d arirhHu tinH jan d ukh paap kaho kat  hovai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕ ਿਲਵ ਮਿਨ ਜਪੈ ਿਦਰ੍ੜ ਿਤਨ  ਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: When the Lord, the Boat to carry us across, bestows His Glance of Grace, even for an instant, the mortal contemplates the Shabad within his heart; unfulfilled sexual desireand unresolved anger are eradicated.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) taaran  taran khin mat ar jaa ka-o d arisat Dh aarai sabad  rid beechaarai kaam kroDh khovai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਰਣ  ਤਰਣ  ਿਖਨ ਮਾਤਰ੍ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਿਦਰ੍ਿਸ੍ਟ  ਧਾਰੈ ਸਬਦੁ  ਿਰਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ  ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is the Giver to all beings; He speaks the spiritual wisdom of theUnfathomable Lord, and meditates on Him day and night. He never sleeps, even foran instant.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) jee-an sabhan d aataa agam ga-yaan bikh -yaataa ahinis Dh ayaan Dh aavai palak na sovai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਅਨ  ਸਭਨ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਅਗਮ  ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨ  ਿਬਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਤਾ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨ ਧਾਵੈ ਪਲਕ  ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing Him, poverty vanishes, and one is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The spiritual wisdom of the Guru's Word washes away the filth ofevil-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, nl´) jaa ka-o daykh at daridar jaavai naam so niDh aan paavai gurmukh  ga-yaan d urmat mail Dhovai jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਤ  ਦਿਰਦਰ੍ੁ  ਜਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਿਨ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ ਮੈਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Tell me, how can sin and suffering cling to that humble being who chants the Naam, given by the Guru, with single-minded love and firm faith? ||1||
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) satgur naam ayk liv man japai d arirh tin jan d ukh paap kaho kat  hovai jee-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕ ਿਲਵ ਮਿਨ ਜਪੈ ਿਦਰ੍ੜੁ ਿਤਨ  ਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dharam karam poorai sat gur paa-ee hai. Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas and Holy Saadhus, the silent sages and angelic beings, yearn to serve Him; through the most excellent Word of the Shabad, they are lovingly attuned to theOne Lord.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) jaa kee sayvaa siDh saaDh  mun jan sur nar jaacheh sabad  saar ayk liv laa-ee hai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਿਸਧ ਸਾਧ ਮੁਿਨ ਜਨ ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਜਾਚਿਹ  ਸਬਦ  ਸਾਰੁ ਏਕ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਈ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Who can know Your limits? You are the Embodiment of the Fearless, Formless Lord. You are the Speaker of the Unspoken Speech; You alone understand this.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) fun jaanai ko tayraa apaar nirbh a-o nirankaar akath kathanhaar t ujheh bujh aa-ee hai.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ਤੁਝਿਹ  ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Dhayaa-ee hai. O foolish worldly mortal, you are deluded by doubt; give up birth and death, and you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death. Meditate on the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: ky, nl´) bharam bh oolay sansaar chh utahu joonee sangh aar jam ko na dand kaal gurmat

lines.punjabi: ਭਰਮ  ਭੂਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਛੁਟਹੁ ਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਘਾਰ  ਜਮ ਕੋ ਨ ਡੰਡ ਕਾਲ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਈ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: ||2|| You foolish mortal being, reflect on this in your mind; chant and meditate day andnight. Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect TrueGuru. ||2||
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) man paraanee mugaDh  beechaar ahinis jap Dh aram karam poorai sat gur paa-ee hai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਮੁਗਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਜਪੁ ਧਰਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈ  ਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru.
lines.transliteration: ha-o bal bal jaa-o satgur saachay naam par.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਉ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ ॥
lines.english: What Praises can I offer to You? What service can I do for You? I have only one mouth and tongue; with my palms pressed together, I chant to You with joy anddelight.
lines.transliteration: nl´) kavan upmaa day-o kavan sayvaa saray-o ayk mukh  rasnaa rasahu jug jor kar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਨ  ਉਪਮਾ  ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ  ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰੇਉ  ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਸਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਿਰ ਕਰ ॥
lines.english: Dhar. In thought, word and deed, I know the Lord; I do not worship any other. The Guru has enshrined the most excellent Name of the Infinite Lord within my heart. pMnw 1399
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, nl´) fun man bach karam jaan anat d oojaa na maan naam so apaar saar d eeno gur rid

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ੍ਮ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨਤ  ਦੂਜਾ  ਨ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਦੀਨੋ  ਗੁਿਰ ਿਰਦ ਧਰ ॥
lines.english: So speaks NALL the poet: touching the Philosopher's Stone, glass is transformed into gold, and the sandalwood tree imparts its fragrance to other trees; meditating inremembrance on the Lord, I am transformed.
lines.transliteration: ky, nl´) nal-y kav paaras paras kach kanchnaa hu-ay chandnaa subaas jaas simrat  an tar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਕਿਵ ਪਾਰਸ  ਪਰਸ  ਕਚ ਕੰਚਨਾ  ਹੁਇ ਚੰਦਨਾ  ਸੁਬਾਸੁ  ਜਾਸੁ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਅਨ ਤਰ ॥
lines.english: Seeing His Door, I am rid of sexual desire and anger. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, tothe True Name, O my True Guru. ||3||
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, nl´) jaa kay daykh at du-aaray kaam kroDh  hee nivaaray jee ha-o bal bal jaa-o sat gur saachay naam par. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਤ  ਦੁਆਰੇ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਹੀ ਿਨਵਾਰੇ  ਜੀ ਹਉ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲ  ਜਾਉ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ ॥੩॥
lines.english: Guru Raam Daas was blessed with the Throne of Raja Yoga.
lines.transliteration: raaj jog takh at dee-an gur raamd aas.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ  ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: First, Guru Nanak illuminated the world, like the full moon, and filled it with bliss. Tocarry humanity across, He bestowed His Radiance.
lines.transliteration: parathmay naanak chand jagat  bha-yo aanand  taaran manukh -y jan kee-a-o pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਥਮੇ  ਨਾਨਕ ਚੰਦੁ ਜਗਤ  ਭਯੋ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਤਾਰਿਨ  ਮਨੁਖਯ੍ਯ੍ ਜਨ ਕੀਅਉ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ॥
lines.english: He blessed Guru Angad with the treasure of spiritual wisdom, and the Unspoken Speech; He overcame the five demons and the fear of the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) gur angad d ee-a-o niDh aan akath kathaa gi-aan panch bh oot bas keenay jamat  na taraas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ  ਦੀਅਉ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਬਿਸ ਕੀਨੇ  ਜਮਤ  ਨ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ॥
lines.english: The Great and True Guru, Guru Amar Daas, has preserved honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Seeing His Lotus Feet, sin and evil are destroyed.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, nl´) gur amar guroo saree sat kalijug raakh ee pat  aghan daykhat gat charan kaval jaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਲਜੁਿਗ  ਰਾਖੀ  ਪਿਤ ਅਘਨ  ਦੇਖਤ ਗਤੁ ਚਰਨ  ਕਵਲ  ਜਾਸ ॥
lines.english: When His mind was totally satisfied in every way, when He was totally pleased, He bestowed upon Guru Raam Daas the Throne of Raja Yoga. ||4|| rf ] (1399-7) rad. Radd:
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, nl´) sabh biDh  maani-ya-o man t ab hee bh a-ya-o parsann raaj jog t akhat dee-an gur raamdaas. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਮਾਿਨਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਮਨੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਭਯਉ  ਪਰ੍ਸੰਨੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ  ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: He established the earth, the sky and the air, the water of the oceans, fire and food.
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, nl´) jisahi Dhaari-ya-o Dh arat ar vi-um ar pavan  tay neer sar avar anal anaad  kee-a-o.

lines.english: He created the moon, the starts and the sun, night and day and mountains; he blessed the trees with flowers and fruits.
lines.transliteration: sas rikh nis soor d in sail t aroo-a fal ful d ee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਧਾਿਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਧਰਿਤ  ਅਰੁ ਿਵਉਮੁ  ਅਰੁ ਪਵਣੁ  ਤੇ ਨੀਰ ਸਰ ਅਵਰ  ਅਨਲ  ਅਨਾਿਦ ਕੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: He created the gods, human beings and the seven seas; He established the threeworlds.
lines.transliteration: sur nar sapat samud ar ki-a Dh aari-o t aribhavan jaas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਸ ਿਰਿਖ  ਿਨਿਸ  ਸੂਰ ਿਦਿਨ  ਸੈਲ ਤਰੂਅ  ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਦੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the Light of the One Name, the True Name of theLord. ||1||5||
lines.transliteration: so-ee ayk naam har naam sat paa-i-o gur amar pargaas. ||1||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਸਪਤ  ਸਮੁਦਰ੍  ਿਕਅ ਧਾਿਰਓ  ਿਤਰ੍ਭਵਣ  ਜਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Glass is transformed into gold, listening to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: kachahu kanchan bha-i-a-o sabad  gur sarvan eh sun i-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਤ ਪਾਇਓ  ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥੫॥
lines.english: Poison is transformed into ambrosial nectar, speaking the Name of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: bikh t ay amrit  hu-ya-o naam sat gur mukh  bhani-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਚਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਅਉ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰ ਸਰ੍ਵਣਿਹ  ਸੁਿਣਓ  ॥
lines.english: Iron is transformed into jewels, when the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: loha-o ho-ya-o laal nadar sat gur jad  Dhaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਤੇ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਹੁਯਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮੁਿਖ ਭਿਣਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Stones are transformed into emeralds, when the mortal chants and contemplates the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: paahan maan ak karai gi-aan gur kahi-a-o beechaarai.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਹਉ  ਹੋਯਉ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਦ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.english: The True Guru transforms ordinary wood into sandalwood, eradicating the pains ofpoverty.
lines.transliteration: kaathahu sareekh and sat gur kee-a-o d ukh daridar tin kay ga-i-a.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਹਣ  ਮਾਣਕ  ਕਰੈ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਹਅਉ  ਬੀਚਾਰੈ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever touches the Feet of the True Guru, is transformed from a beast and a ghostinto an angelic being. ||2||6||
lines.transliteration: satguroo charan jinH parsi-aa say pas parayt  sur nar bh a-i-a. ||2||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਠਹੁ ਸਰ੍ੀਖੰਡ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਕੀਅਉ  ਦੁਖ ਦਿਰਦਰ੍  ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਗਇਅ  ॥
lines.english: One who has the Guru on his side - how could he be proud of his wealth?
lines.transliteration: jaam guroo ho-ay val dhaneh ki-aa gaarav d ij-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਚਰਨ  ਿਜਨ ਪਰਿਸਆ  ਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਪਰੇਤ  ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਭਇਅ  ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.english: One who has the Guru on his side - what would hundreds of thousands of supportersdo for him?
lines.transliteration: jaam guroo ho-ay val lakh baahay ki-aa kij-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਮ  ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਲ  ਧਨਿਹ  ਿਕਆ  ਗਾਰਵੁ ਿਦਜਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who has the Guru on his side, does not depend on anyone else for spiritualwisdom and meditation.
lines.transliteration: jaam guroo ho-ay val gi-aan ar Dhi-aan anan par.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਮ  ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਲ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੇ ਿਕਆ  ਿਕਜਇ  ॥
lines.english: One who has the Guru on his side contemplates the Shabad and the Teachings, andabides in the Home of Truth.
lines.transliteration: jaam guroo ho-ay val sabad saakh ee so sachah gh ar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਮ  ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਲ  ਿਗਆਨ  ਅਰੁ ਿਧਆਨ  ਅਨਨ  ਪਿਰ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's humble slave and poet utters this prayer: whoever chants to the Guru night and day,
lines.transliteration: jo guroo guroo ahinis japai daas bh at baynat  kahai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਿਮ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਲ ਸਬਦੁ  ਸਾਖੀ  ਸੁ ਸਚਹ  ਘਿਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jo guroo naam rid meh Dh arai so janam maran  duh thay rahai. ||3||7|| whoever enshrines the Name of the Guru within his heart, is rid of both birth anddeath. ||3||7||

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਜਪੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਟੁ ਬੇਨਿਤ  ਕਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, there is utter darkness; without the Guru, understanding does notcome.
lines.transliteration: gur bin ghor anDh aar guroo bin samajh  na aavai.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਰਦ ਮਿਹ ਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣ  ਦੁਹ ਥੇ ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥੭॥
lines.english: Without the Guru, there is no intuitive awareness or success; without the Guru, thereis no liberation.
lines.transliteration: gur bin surat na siDh  guroo bin mukat  na paavai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਮਝ  ਨ ਆਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: So make Him your Guru, and contemplate the Truth; make Him your Guru, O mymind.
lines.transliteration: gur kar sach beechaar guroo kar ray man mayray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨ ਿਸਿਧ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: Make Him your Guru, who is embellished and exalted in the Word of the Shabad; allyour sins shall be washed away.
lines.transliteration: gur kar sabad sapunn agh an kateh sabh  tayray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: So speaks NALL the poet: with your eyes, make Him your Guru; with the words you speak, make Him your Guru, your True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur na-yan ba-yan  gur gur karahu guroo sat  kav nal-y kahi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਸਬਦ  ਸਪੁੰਨ  ਅਘਨ  ਕਟਿਹ  ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Those who have not seen the Guru, who have not made Him their Guru, are uselessin this world. ||4||8||
lines.transliteration: jin guroo na daykh i-a-o nahu kee-a-o t ay akyath sansaar meh. ||4||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਯਿਣ  ਬਯਿਣ  ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਵ ਨਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਕਿਹ ॥
lines.english: Dwell upon the Guru, the Guru, the Guru, O my mind. pMnw 1400
lines.transliteration: guroo guroo gur kar man mayray.

lines.english: The All-powerful Guru is the Boat to carry us across in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Hearing the Word of His Shabad, we are transported into Samaadhi.
lines.transliteration: taaran  taran samrath kalijug sunat  samaaDh  sabad  jis kayray.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਰਣ  ਤਰਣ  ਸਮਰ੍ਥੁ  ਕਿਲਜੁਿਗ  ਸੁਨਤ  ਸਮਾਿਧ  ਸਬਦ  ਿਜਸੁ ਕੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He is the Spiritual Hero who destroys pain and brings peace. Whoever meditates on Him, dwells near Him.
lines.transliteration: fun dukh an naas sukh -daa-yak soora-o jo Dh arat Dhi-aan basat  tih nayray.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਦੁਖਿਨ  ਨਾਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਯਕੁ ਸੂਰਉ  ਜੋ ਧਰਤ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ਬਸਤ  ਿਤਹ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
lines.english: He is the Perfect Primal Being, who meditates in remembrance on the Lord within hisheart; seeing His Face, sins run away.
lines.transliteration: poora-o purakh rid ai har simrat  mukh  daykhat agh jaahi parayray.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਉ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਰਦੈ ਹਿਰ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਤ  ਅਘ  ਜਾਿਹ  ਪਰੇਰੇ  ॥
lines.english: If you long for wisdom, wealth, spiritual perfection and properity, O my mind, dwell upon the Guru, the Guru, the Guru. ||5||9||
lines.transliteration: ja-o har buDh riDh  siDh chaahat  guroo guroo gur kar man mayray. ||5||9||

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਹਿਰ ਬੁਿਧ ਿਰਿਧ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਚਾਹਤ  ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੫॥੯॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Face of the Guru, I find peace.
lines.transliteration: guroo mukh d aykh garoo sukh  paa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: I was thirsty, yearning to drink in the Nectar; to fulfill that wish, the Guru laid out theway.
lines.transliteration: hutee jo pi-aas pi-oos pivann kee banchh at siDh ka-o biDh  milaa-ya-o.

lines.english: My mind has become perfect; it dwells in the Lord's Place; it had been wandering inall directions, in its desire for tastes and pleasures.
lines.transliteration: pooran bho man th a-ur baso ras baasan si-o jo d ahaN dis Dhaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੂਰਨ  ਭੋ ਮਨ ਠਉਰ  ਬਸੋ ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ  ਿਸਉ ਜੁ ਦਹੰ ਿਦਿਸ  ਧਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Goindwal is the City of God, built on the bank of the Beas River.
lines.transliteration: gobind vaal gobind  puree sam jal-yan t eer bipaas banaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਵਾਲੁ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਪੁਰੀ ਸਮ ਜਲਯ੍ਯ੍ਨ  ਤੀਿਰ  ਿਬਪਾਸ  ਬਨਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of so many years have been taken away; gazing upon the Face of the Guru, I find peace. ||6||10||
lines.transliteration: ga-ya-o dukh  door barkh an ko so guroo mukh  daykh garoo sukh  paa-ya-o. ||6||10||

lines.punjabi: ਗਯਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਿਰ ਬਰਖਨ  ਕੋ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਯਉ  ॥੬॥੧੦॥
lines.english: The All-powerful Guru placed His hand upon my head.
lines.transliteration: samrath guroo sir hath Dhar-ya-o.

lines.english: The Guru was kind, and blessed me with the Lord's Name. Gazing upon His Feet, mysins were dispelled.
lines.transliteration: gur keenee kirpaa har naam dee-a-o jis d aykh charann agh ann har-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਕੀਨੀ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ  ਦੀਅਉ  ਿਜਸੁ ਦੇਿਖ ਚਰੰਨ  ਅਘੰਨ  ਹਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, the Guru meditates on the One Lord; hearing His Name, theMessenger of Death is scared away.
lines.transliteration: nis baasur ayk samaan Dhi-aan so naam sunay sut  bhaan dar-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਿਸ  ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨ  ਿਧਆਨ  ਸੁ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਨੇ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਾਨ ਡਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks the Lord's slave: Guru Raam Daas placed His Faith in Guru Amar Daas, theGuru of the World; touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was transformed into thePhilosopher's Stone.
lines.transliteration: bhan d aas so aas jagt ar guroo kee paaras bh ayt paras kar-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਿਨ ਦਾਸ ਸੁ ਆਸ  ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਭੇਿਟ ਪਰਸੁ  ਕਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Raam Daas recognized the Lord as True; the All-powerful Guru placed His handupon His head. ||7||11||
lines.transliteration: raamdaas guroo har sat  kee-ya-o samrath guroo sir hath Dh ar-ya-o. ||7||11||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ ਕੀਯਉ  ਸਮਰਥ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਸਿਰ  ਹਥੁ ਧਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ॥੭॥੧੧॥
lines.english: Now, please preserve the honor of Your humble slave.
lines.transliteration: ab raakho d aas bh aat kee laaj.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਭਾਟ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ  ॥
lines.english: God saved the honor of the devotee Prahlaad, when Harnaakhash tore him apart with his claws.
lines.transliteration: jaisee raakhee laaj bh agat par-hilaad  kee harnaakh as faaray kar aaj.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੀ ਰਾਖੀ  ਲਾਜ  ਭਗਤ  ਪਰ੍ਿਹਲਾਦ  ਕੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ  ਫਾਰੇ ਕਰ ਆਜ  ॥
lines.english: And the Dear Lord God saved the honor of Dropadi; when her clothes were strippedfrom her, she was blessed with even more.
lines.transliteration: fun daropat ee laaj rakh ee har parabh  jee chh eenat  bastar deen baho saaj.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਦਰ੍ੋਪਤੀ  ਲਾਜ  ਰਖੀ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜੀ ਛੀਨਤ ਬਸਤਰ੍  ਦੀਨ  ਬਹੁ ਸਾਜ ॥
lines.english: Sudaamaa was saved from misfortune; and Ganikaa the prostitute - when she chantedYour Name, her affairs were perfectly resolved.
lines.transliteration: sodaamaa apd aa tay raakh i-aa ganikaa parhHat pooray t ih kaaj.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਦਾਮਾ  ਅਪਦਾ  ਤੇ ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਗਿਨਕਾ  ਪੜਤ  ਪੂਰੇ ਿਤਹ ਕਾਜ ॥
lines.english: O Great True Guru, if it pleases You, please save the honor of Your slave in this DarkAge of kali Yuga. ||8||12|| Jolnw ] (1400-12) jholnaa. Jholnaa:
lines.transliteration: saree satgur suparsan kaljug ho-ay raakh o daas bh aat kee laaj. ||8||12||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੁਪਰ੍ਸੰਨ ਕਲਜੁਗ  ਹੋਇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਭਾਟ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ  ॥੮॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O mortal beings.
lines.transliteration: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap paraanee-ahu.

lines.english: Chant the Shabad, the Word of the Lord, Har, Har; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, brings the nine treasures. With your tongue, taste it, day and night, and know it astrue.
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) sabad har har japai naam nav niDh  apai rasan ahinis rasai sat  kar jaanee-ahu.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Then, you shall obtain His Love and Affection; become Gurmukh, and meditate onHim. Give up all other ways; vibrate and meditate on Him, O spiritual people.
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) fun paraym rang paa-ee-ai gurmukheh Dh i-aa-ee-ai ann maarag t ajahu bh ajahu har gayaanee-ahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਅਪੈ ਰਸਿਨ  ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਰਸੈ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ਜਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart, and overpower the fivepassions. Your life, and your generations, shall be saved, and you shall be honored atthe Lord's Door.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) bachan gur rid Dh arahu panch bh oo bas karahu janam kul uDh rahu d avaar har maanee-ahu.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਰੰਗ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿਹ  ਿਧਆਈਐ  ਅੰਨ ਮਾਰਗ  ਤਜਹੁ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
lines.english: ||1||13|| If you desire all the peace and comforts of this world and the next, then chant Guru,Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O mortal beings. ||1||13||
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) ja-o ta sabh  sukh  it ut tum banchh vahu guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap paraanee-ahu.

lines.punjabi: ਬਚਨ  ਗੁਰ ਿਰਿਦ  ਧਰਹੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਬਿਸ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ  ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਦਾਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਮਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true.
lines.transliteration: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap sat kar.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਤ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਮ ਬੰਛਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀਅਹ ੁ ॥੧॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Dhar. Know that the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Enshrine Him in your mind, and meditate on Him. Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart.
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) agam gun jaan niDhaan har man Dh arahu Dh ayaan ahinis karahu bachan gur rid ai

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਪ ਸਿਤ ਕਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Then, cleanse yourself in the Immaculate and Unfathomable Water of the Guru; O Gursikhs and Saints, cross over the Ocean of Love of the True Name.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) fun guroo jal bimal athaah majan karahu sant gursikh  tarahu naam sach rang sar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮ  ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਧਰਹੁ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਅਿਹਿਨਿਸ  ਕਰਹੁ ਬਚਨ  ਗੁਰ ਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Meditate lovingly forever on the Lord, free of hate and vengeance, Formless and Fearless; lovingly savor the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and implant devotionalworship of the Lord deep within.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) sadaa nirvair nirankaar nirbh a-o japai paraym gur sabad  ras karat  darirh bhagat har.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਲ ਿਬਮਲ ਅਥਾਹ  ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਤਰਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਸਚ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਰ ॥
lines.english: O foolish mind, give up your doubts; as Gurmukh, vibrate and meditate on the Naam. Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true. ||2||14|| pMnw 1401
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) mugaDh man bh aram t ajahu naam gurmukh  bhajahu guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap sat kar. ||2||14||

lines.english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru; through the Guru, the Lord is obtained.
lines.transliteration: guroo gur gur karahu guroo har paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru is an Ocean, deep and profound, infinite and unfathomable. Lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name, you shall be blessed with jewels, diamonds and emeralds.
lines.transliteration: ky, gXMd) udaDh  gur gahir gambh eer bay-ant  har naam nag heer man  milat  liv laa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦਿਧ  ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਗ ਹੀਰ ਮਿਣ ਿਮਲਤ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: And, the Guru makes us fragrant and fruitful, and His Touch transforms us into gold.The filth of evil-mindedness is washed away, meditating on the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) fun guroo parmal saras karat kanchan paras mail d urmat  hirat sabad  gur Dh a-yaa-ee- ai.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਮਲ  ਸਰਸ  ਕਰਤ  ਕੰਚਨੁ ਪਰਸ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਹਰਤ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਗੁਰੁ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar flows constantly from His Door. The Saints and Sikhs bathe in the immaculate pool of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) amrit parvaah chh utkant  sad davaar jis ga-yaan gur bimal sar sant  sikh naa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਪਰਵਾਹ  ਛੁਟਕੰਤ  ਸਦ ਦਾਿਰ  ਿਜਸੁ ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਮਲ  ਸਰ ਸੰਤ ਿਸਖ ਨਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: ||3||15|| Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart, and dwell in Nirvaanaa.Chant Guru, Guru, Guru; through the Guru, the Lord is obtained. ||3||15||
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) naam nirbaan niDh aan har ur Dh arahu guroo gur gur karahu guroo har paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰਬਾਣੁ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind.
lines.transliteration: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap man ray.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Serving Him, Shiva and the Siddhas, the angels and demons and servants of the gods, and the thrity-three million gods cross over, listening to the Word of the Guru'sTeachings.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) jaa kee sayv siv siDh saaDh ik sur asur gan  tareh t aytees gur bachan sun  kann ray.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਿਸਵ ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਸੁਰ ਅਸੁਰ  ਗਣ ਤਰਿਹ ਤੇਤੀਸ  ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ  ਸੁਿਣ ਕੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: And, the Saints and loving devotees are carried across, chanting Guru, Guru. Prahlaad and the silent sages met the Guru, and were carried across.
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) fun tareh t ay sant  hit bhagat gur gur karahi t ari-o parahlaad  gur milat  mun jann ray.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਤਰਿਹ  ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਿਹਤ ਭਗਤ  ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਤਿਰਓ  ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦੁ  ਗੁਰ ਿਮਲਤ  ਮੁਿਨ ਜੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: Naarad and Sanak and those men of God who became Gurmukh were carried across; attached to the One Name, they abandoned other tastes and pleasures, and werecarried across.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) tareh naard aad sankaad  har gurmukh eh tareh ik naam lag t ajahu ras ann ray.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਿਹ  ਨਾਰਦਾਿਦ  ਸਨਕਾਿਦ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿਹ  ਤਰਿਹ  ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਗ  ਤਜਹੁ ਰਸ ਅੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.english: ||4||16||29|| This is the prayer of the Lord's humble slave: the Gurmukh obtains the Naam, theName of the Lord, chanting Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind. ||4||16||29||
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) daas baynat  kahai naam gurmukh  lahai guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap man ray.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਸੁ ਬੇਨਿਤ  ਕਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਨ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The Great, Supreme Guru showered His Mercy upon all;
lines.transliteration: siree guroo saahib sabh oopar.
karee kirpaa satjug jin Dh aroo par. in the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, He blessed Dhroo.

lines.english: He saved the devotee Prahlaad,
lines.transliteration: saree parahlaad bh agat uDhree-aN.
hast kamal maathay par Dh aree-aN. placing the Lotus of His Hand upon his forehead.

lines.english: The Unseen Form of the Lord cannot be seen.
lines.transliteration: alakh roop jee-a lakh -yaa na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਲਖ  ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ  ਲਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ  ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Siddhas and seekers all seek His Sanctuary.
lines.transliteration: saaDhik siDh  sagal sarn aa-ee.

lines.english: True are the Words of the Guru's teachings. Enshrine them in your soul.
lines.transliteration: gur kay bachan sat jee-a Dh aarahu.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ  ਸਿਤ ਜੀਅ  ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Emancipate your body, and redeem this human incarnation.
lines.transliteration: maanas janam d ayh nist aarahu.

lines.english: The Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Boatman. Without the Guru, no one can cross over.
lines.transliteration: gur jahaaj khayvat guroo gur bin t ari-aa na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਹਾਜੁ  ਖੇਵਟੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, God is obtained. Without the Guru, no one is liberated.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad parabh  paa-ee-ai gur bin mukat  na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਗੁਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak dwells near the Creator Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur naanak nikat basai banvaaree.

lines.english: He established Lehnaa as Guru, and enshrined His Light in the world.
lines.transliteration: tin lahn aa thaap jot  jag Dh aaree.

lines.english: Lehnaa established the path of righteousness and Dharma,
lines.transliteration: lahnai panth Dh aram kaa kee-aa.
amardaas bh alay ka-o d ee-aa. which He passed on to Guru Amar Daas, of the Bhalla dynasty.

lines.english: Then, He firmly established the Great Raam Daas of the Sodhi dynasty.
lines.transliteration: tin saree raamd aas sodh ee thir thap-ya-o.

lines.english: He was blessed with the inexhaustible treasure of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam akhai niDh  ap-ya-o.

lines.english: He was blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Name; throughout the four ages, it isinexhaustible. Serving the Guru, He received His reward.
lines.transliteration: ap-ya-o har naam akhai niDh  chahu jug gur sayvaa kar fal lahee-aN.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੈ ਿਨਿਧ  ਚਹੁ ਜੁਿਗ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਰ ਫਲੁ ਲਹੀਅੰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who bow at His Feet and seek His Sanctuary, are blessed with peace; thoseGurmukhs are blessed with supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: bandeh jo charan  saran  sukh  paavahi parmaanand  gurmukh  kahee-aN.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਦਿਹ  ਜੋ ਚਰਣ  ਸਰਿਣ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਹੀਅੰ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Body is the Embodiment of the Supreme Lord God, our Lord and Master, the Form of the Primal Being, who nourishes and cherishes all.
lines.transliteration: partakh  dayh paarbarahm su-aamee aad  roop pokh an bharnaN.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਤਿਖ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਆਿਦ  ਰੂਿਪ ਪੋਖਣ  ਭਰਣੰ  ॥
lines.english: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The GreatGuru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||1||
lines.transliteration: satgur gur sayv alakh  gat jaa kee saree raamd aas taaran  tarnaN. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਅਲਖ  ਗਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ  ਤਰਣੰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: The Holy people chant the Ambrosial Words of His Bani with delight in their minds.
lines.transliteration: jih amrit bachan ban ee saaDh oo jan jaapeh kar bichit  chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਚਨ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਜਪਿਹ  ਕਿਰ ਿਬਿਚਿਤ  ਚਾਓ  ॥
lines.english: The Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world; itbrings lasting bliss and joy.
lines.transliteration: aanand nit  mangal gur d arsan safal sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਨੰਦੁ  ਿਨਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ  ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world, like the Ganges. MeetingHim, the supreme sacred status is obtained.
lines.transliteration: sansaar safal gangaa gur darsan parsan param pavit ar gat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਿਰ  ਸਫਲੁ  ਗੰਗਾ  ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਰਸਨ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਿਵਤਰ੍  ਗਤੇ ॥
lines.english: Even sinful people conquer the realm of Death, if they become the Lord's humbleservants, and are imbued with the Guru's spiritual wisdom.
lines.transliteration: jeeteh jam lok pat it jay paraan ee har jan siv gur ga-yaan rat ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਤਿਹ  ਜਮ ਲੋਕੁ ਪਿਤਤ  ਜੇ ਪਰ੍ਾਣੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਿਸਵ ਗੁਰ ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਿਨ  ਰਤੇ ॥
lines.english: He is certified, like the handsome Ram Chander in the house of Dasrath of the Raghwa dynasty. Even the silent sages seek His Sanctuary. pMnw 1402
lines.transliteration: raghubans t ilak sund ar dasrath gh ar mun banchh eh jaa kee sarn aN.

lines.english: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||2||
lines.transliteration: satgur gur sayv alakh  gat jaa kee saree raamd aas taaran  tarnaN. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਅਲਖ  ਗਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ  ਤਾਰਣ  ਤਰਣੰ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord, from the Mouth of the Guru, is the Raft to cross over theunfathomable world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: sansaar agam saagar tulhaa har naam guroo mukh  paa-yaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਗਮ  ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਯਾ  ॥
lines.english: The cycle of birth and death in this world is ended for those who have this faith intheir hearts.
lines.transliteration: jag janam maran bh agaa ih aa-ee hee-ai part eet.

lines.punjabi: ਜਿਗ  ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਭਗਾ ਇਹ ਆਈ  ਹੀਐ  ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Those humble beings who have this faith in their hearts, are awarded the higheststatus.
lines.transliteration: parteet  hee-ai aa-ee jin jan kai t inH ka-o pad vee uch bh a-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਹੀਐ  ਆਈ  ਿਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਪਦਵੀ  ਉਚ ਭਈ ॥
lines.english: They forsake Maya, emotional attachment and greed; they are rid of the frustrationsof possessiveness, sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: taj maa-i-aa moh lobh  ar laalach kaam kroDh  kee baritha ga-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਿਜ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਰੁ ਲਾਲਚੁ  ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਕੀ ਿਬਰ੍ਥਾ  ਗਈ ॥
lines.english: They are blessed with the Inner Vision to see God, the Cause of causes, and all theirdoubts are dispelled.
lines.transliteration: avlok-yaa barahm bharam sabh  chhut-yaa d ib-y d arisat kaaran  karnaN.

lines.punjabi: ਅਵਲੋਕਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਸਭੁ ਛੁਟਕਯ੍ਯ੍ਾ  ਿਦਬਯ੍ਯ੍ ਿਦਰ੍ਿਸ੍ਟ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਕਰਣੰ  ॥
lines.english: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The GreatGuru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||3||
lines.transliteration: satgur gur sayv alakh  gat jaa kee saree raamd aas taaran  tarnaN. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਅਲਖ  ਗਿਤ  ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ  ਤਾਰਣ  ਤਰਣੰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Glorious Greatness of the Guru is manifest forever in each and every heart. His humble servants sing His Praises.
lines.transliteration: partaap sad aa gur kaa gh at ghat pargaas bh a-yaa jas jan kai.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ  ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਪਰਗਾਸੁ  ਭਯਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ॥
lines.english: Some read and listen and sing of Him, taking their cleansing bath in the early hours ofthe morning before the dawn.
lines.transliteration: ik parheh sun eh gaavahi parbh aatihi karahi isnaan.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਪੜਿਹ  ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਪਰਭਾਿਤਿਹ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: After their cleansing bath in the hours before the dawn, they worship the Guru withtheir minds pure and clear.
lines.transliteration: isnaan karahi parbhaat  suDh  man gur poojaa biDh  sahit  karaN.

lines.punjabi: ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰਭਾਿਤ ਸੁਧ ਮਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਾ ਿਬਿਧ  ਸਿਹਤ  ਕਰੰ ॥
lines.english: Touching the Philosopher's Stone, their bodies are transformed into gold. They focustheir meditation on the Embodiment of Divine Light.
lines.transliteration: kanchan tan ho-ay paras paaras ka-o jot  saroopee Dh ayaan Dh araN.

lines.punjabi: ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਿਸ  ਪਾਰਸ  ਕਉ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਰੂਪੀ  ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਧਰੰ ॥
lines.english: The Master of the Universe, the very Life of the World pervades the sea and the land,manifesting Himself in myriads of ways.
lines.transliteration: jagjeevan jagannaath jal thal meh rahi-aa poor baho biDh baranaN.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ  ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਿਹ ਰਿਹਆ  ਪੂਿਰ ਬਹੁ ਿਬਿਧ  ਬਰਨੰ  ॥
lines.english: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The GreatGuru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur gur sayv alakh  gat jaa kee saree raamd aas taaran  tarnaN. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਅਲਖ  ਗਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ  ਤਾਰਣ  ਤਰਣੰ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who realize the Eternal, Unchanging Word of God, like Dhroo, are immune todeath.
lines.transliteration: jinahu baat nischal Dh aroo-a jaanee t ay-ee jeev kaal t ay bachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਿਨਸ੍ਚਲ  ਧਰ੍ੂਅ ਜਾਨੀ  ਤੇਈ ਜੀਵ ਕਾਲ  ਤੇ ਬਚਾ ॥
lines.english: They cross over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant; the Lord created the world like a bubble of water.
lines.transliteration: gXMd) tinH tari-o samud ar rud ar khin ik meh jalhar bimb jugat  jag rachaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਤਿਰਓ  ਸਮੁਦਰ੍ੁ  ਰੁਦਰ੍ੁ ਿਖਨ ਇਕ ਮਿਹ ਜਲਹਰ  ਿਬੰਬ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਜਗੁ ਰਚਾ ॥
lines.english: The Kundalini rises in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; through the Word of the Guru, they enjoy the Lord of Supreme Bliss.
lines.transliteration: kundlanee surjhee sat sangat  parmaanand  guroo mukh  machaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੁੰਡਲਨੀ  ਸੁਰਝੀ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ  ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਿਖ ਮਚਾ ॥
lines.english: The Supreme Guru is the Lord and Master over all; so serve the True Guru, inthought, word and deed. ||5||
lines.transliteration: siree guroo saahib sabh oopar man bach krem sayvee-ai sachaa. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਰੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਭ ਊਪਿਰ  ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰ੍ੰਮ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਸਚਾ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o.
lines.transliteration: vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jee-o.

lines.english: You are lotus-eyed, with sweet speech, exalted and embellished with millions ofcompanions. Mother Yashoda invited You as Krishna to eat the sweet rice.
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) kaval nain maDhur bain kot sain sang sobh  kahat  maa jasod  jisahi d ahee bh aat khaahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਵਲ  ਨੈਨ ਮਧੁਰ  ਬੈਨ ਕੋਿਟ ਸੈਨ ਸੰਗ ਸੋਭ ਕਹਤ  ਮਾ ਜਸੋਦ  ਿਜਸਿਹ  ਦਹੀ ਭਾਤੁ ਖਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon Your supremely beautiful form, and hearing the musical sounds of Yoursilver bells tinkling, she was intoxicated with delight.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) daykh  roop at  anoop moh mahaa mag bh a-ee kinknee sabad  jhanatkaar kh ayl paahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਿਖ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਿਤ  ਅਨੂਪੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਗ ਭਈ ਿਕੰਕਨੀ  ਸਬਦ  ਝਨਤਕਾਰ  ਖੇਲੁ ਪਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dharat  hee-ai chaahi jee-o. Death's pen and command are in Your hands. Tell me, who can erase it? Shiva and Brahma yearn to enshrine Your spiritual wisdom in their hearts.
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) kaal kalam hukam haath kahhu ka-un mayt sakai ees bamm-yu ga-yaan Dhayaan

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਲ  ਕਲਮ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਿਥ  ਕਹਹੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮੇਿਟ ਸਕੈ ਈਸੁ ਬੰਮਯ੍ਯ੍ੁ ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਧਰਤ  ਹੀਐ  ਚਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. WaahayGuru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||1||6||
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) sat saach saree nivaas aad  purakh  sadaa tuhee vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jee-o. ||1||6||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਵਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੧॥੬॥
lines.english: You are blessed with the Lord's Name, the supreme mansion, and clear understanding. You are the Formless, Infinite Lord; who can compare to You?
lines.transliteration: gXMd) raam naam param Dhaam suDh  buDh  nireekaar baysumaar sarbar ka-o kaahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਮ  ਧਾਮ ਸੁਧ ਬੁਧ ਿਨਰੀਕਾਰ  ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ  ਸਰਬਰ  ਕਉ ਕਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: For the sake of the pure-hearted devotee Prahlaad, You took the form of the man- lion, to tear apart and destroy Harnaakhash with your claws.
lines.transliteration: gXMd) suthar chit bh agat hit bhaykh Dhari-o harnaakh as hari-o nakh  bidaar jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਥਰ  ਿਚਤ  ਭਗਤ  ਿਹਤ ਭੇਖੁ ਧਿਰਓ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ  ਹਿਰਓ  ਨਖ ਿਬਦਾਿਰ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are the Infinite Supreme Lord God; with your symbols of power, You deceived Baliraja; who can know You?
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) sankh chakar gad aa pad am aap aap kee-o chh adam aprampar paarbarahm lakh ai ka- un taahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਖ ਚਕਰ੍ ਗਦਾ  ਪਦਮ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੁ  ਕੀਓ  ਛਦਮ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰ  ਪਾਰਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਲਖੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਤਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. WaahayGuru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||2||7||
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) sat saach saree nivaas aad  purakh  sadaa tuhee vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jee-o. ||2||7||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ਆਿਦ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੨॥੭॥
lines.english: As Krishna, You wear yellow robes, with teeth like jasmine flowers; You dwell with Your lovers, with Your mala around Your neck, and You joyfully adorn Your head withthe crow of peacock feathers. pMnw 1403
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, gXMd) peet basan kund  dasan pari-a sahit  kanth  maal mukat sees mor pankh  chaahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਵਜੀਰ  ਬਡੇ ਧੀਰ ਧਰਮ  ਅੰਗ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਗਮ  ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਉਛਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: You have no advisors, You are so very patient; You are the Upholder of the Dharma, unseen and unfathomable. You have staged the play of the Universe with joy anddelight.
lines.transliteration: gXMd) bayvjeer baday Dheer Dh aram ang alakh  agam kh ayl kee-aa aapn ai uchh aahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤੀਿਨ  ਲੋਕ ਰਿਹਆ  ਸਮਾਇ  ਸੁਤਹ  ਿਸਧ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਿਰਓ  ਸਾਹਨ  ਕੈ ਸਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: No one can speak Your Unspoken Speech. You are pervading the three worlds. Youassume the form of spiritual perfection, O King of kings.
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) akath kathaa kathee na jaa-ay teen lok rahi-aa samaa-ay sut ah siDh  roop Dh ari-o saahan kai saahi jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ਆਿਦ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਵਾਿਹ  ਜੀਉ  ॥੩॥੮॥
lines.english: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. WaahayGuru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||3||8||
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) sat saach saree nivaas aad  purakh  sadaa tuhee vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahiguroo vaahi jee-o. ||3||8||

lines.english: The True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself.
lines.transliteration: satguroo sat guroo sat gur gubind  jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਬਿਲਿਹ  ਛਲਨ  ਸਬਲ  ਮਲਨ  ਭਿਗ੍ਤ ਫਲਨ  ਕਾਨ  ਕੁਅਰ  ਿਨਹਕਲੰਕ  ਬਜੀ ਡੰਕ ਚੜ ਦਲ ਰਿਵੰਦ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Enticer of Baliraja, who smothers the mighty, and fulfills the devotees; the Prince Krishna, and Kalki; the thunder of His army and the beat of His drum echoes acrossthe Universe. rwm rvx durq dvx skl Bvx kusl krx srb BUq Awip hI dyvwiD dyv shs muK PinMd jIau ] (1403-5, sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) raam ravan d urat davan sakal bh avan kusal karan  sarab bh oot aap hee d ayvaaDh dayv sahas mukh  fanind  jee-o. The Lord of contemplation, Destroyer of sin, who brings pleasure to the beings of all realms, He Himself is the God of gods, Divinity of the divine, the thousand-headedking cobra.
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) balihi chhalan sabal malan bh agat falan kaanH ku-ar nihklank bajee dank charh hoo d al ravind jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਰਵਣ  ਦੁਰਤ  ਦਵਣ  ਸਕਲ  ਭਵਣ  ਕੁਸਲ  ਕਰਣ  ਸਰਬ  ਭੂਤ ਆਿਪ  ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾਿਧ  ਦੇਵ ਸਹਸ  ਮੁਖ ਫਿਨੰਦ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: He took birth in the Incarnations of the Fish, Tortoise and Wild Boar, and played His part. He played games on the banks of the Jamunaa River.
lines.transliteration: ky, gXMd) jaram karam machh kachh  hu-a baraah jamunaa kai kool kh ayl kh ayli-o jin binn jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਰਮ  ਕਰਮ  ਮਛ ਕਛ ਹੁਅ ਬਰਾਹ  ਜਮੁਨਾ  ਕੈ ਕੂਿਲ  ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਿਲਓ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਗੰਦ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness ofthe mind, O Gayand the True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of theUniverse Himself. ||4||9||
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) naam saar hee-ay Dhaar t aj bikaar man ga-yand  satguroo sat guroo sat gur gubind  jee- o. ||4||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰੁ ਤਜੁ ਿਬਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਗਯੰਦ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਗੁਿਬੰਦ  ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.english: The Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the True, Dear Lord. gur kihAw mwnu inj inDwnu scu jwnu mMqRü iehY  inis bwsur hoie kl´wnu lhih prm giq jIau ] (1403-8, sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) gur kahi-aa maan nij niDhaan sach jaan mant ar ihai nis baasur ho-ay kal-yaan laheh param gat jee-o. Respect and obey the Guru's Word; this is your own personal treasure - know this mantra as true. Night and day, you shall be saved, and blessed with the supremestatus.
lines.transliteration: siree guroo siree guroo siree guroo sat jee-o.

lines.english: Renounce sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment; give up your games of deception. Snap the noose of egotism, and let yourself be at home in the SaadhSangat, the Company of the Holy.
lines.transliteration: mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) kaam kroDh lobh  moh jan  jan si-o chh aad Dh ohu ha-umai kaa fanDh  kaat saaDh sang rat jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਹਆ  ਮਾਨੁ ਿਨਜ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਇਹੈ ਿਨਿਸ  ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਹੋਇ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਲਹਿਹ  ਪਰਮ  ਗਿਤ  ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Free your consciousness of attachment to your body, your home, your spouse, and the pleasures of this world. Serve forever at His Lotus Feet, and firmly implant theseteachings within.
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) dayh gayhu t ari-a sanayhu chit  bilaas jagat  ayhu charan kamal sad aa say-o d arirh-taa kar mat jee-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਣ ਜਣ ਿਸਉ ਛਾਡੁ ਧੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਾ ਫੰਧੁ ਕਾਟੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਿਗ  ਰਿਤ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand. the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, theTrue, Dear Lord. ||5||10||
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, gXMd) naam saar hee-ay Dhaar t aj bikaar man ga-yand  siree guroo siree guroo siree guroo sat jee-o. ||5||10||

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਹ ਗੇਹੁ ਿਤਰ੍ਅ  ਸਨੇਹੁ ਿਚਤ  ਿਬਲਾਸੁ ਜਗਤ  ਏਹੁ ਚਰਨ  ਕਮਲ  ਸਦਾ ਸੇਉ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਤਾ  ਕਰੁ ਮਿਤ ਜੀਉ  ॥
lines.english: Your servants are totally fulfilled, throughout the ages; O Waahay Guru, it is all You,forever.
lines.transliteration: sayvak kai bharpoor jug jug vaahguroo t ayraa sabh  sadkaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰੁ ਤਜੁ ਿਬਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਗਯੰਦ  ਿਸਰੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਸਰੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਸਰੀ  ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਤ ਜੀਉ  ॥੫॥੧੦॥
lines.english: O Formless Lord God, You are eternally intact; no one can say how You came intobeing.
lines.transliteration: nirankaar parabh sad aa salaamat  kahi na sakai ko-oo t oo kad  kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੈ ਭਰਪੂਰ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਦਕਾ  ॥
lines.english: You created countless Brahmas and Vishnus; their minds were intoxicated withemotional attachment.
lines.transliteration: barahmaa bisan siray tai agnat  tin ka-o moh bh a-yaa man mad  kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਿਤ  ਕਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਊ ਤੂ ਕਦ ਕਾ ॥
lines.english: You created the 8.4 million species of beings, and provide for their sustanance.
lines.transliteration: chavraaseeh lakh jon upaa-ee rijak d ee-aa sabh  hoo ka-o t ad kaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਿਬਸਨੁ ਿਸਰੇ ਤੈ ਅਗਨਤ  ਿਤਨ ਕਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਯਾ ਮਨ ਮਦ ਕਾ ॥
lines.english: Your servants are totally fulfilled, throughout the ages; O Waahay Guru, it is all You,forever. ||1||11||
lines.transliteration: sayvak kai bharpoor jug jug vaahguroo t ayraa sabh  sadkaa. ||1||11||

lines.punjabi: ਚਵਰਾਸੀਹ  ਲਖ ਜੋਿਨ ਉਪਾਈ  ਿਰਜਕੁ  ਦੀਆ  ਸਭ ਹੂ ਕਉ ਤਦ ਕਾ ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Great! Great is the Play of God!
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu kaa badaa tamaasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਕੈ ਭਰਪੂਰ  ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ  ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਦਕਾ  ॥੧॥੧੧॥
lines.english: He Himself laughs, and He Himself thinks; He Himself illumines the sun and the moon.
lines.transliteration: aapay hasai aap hee chitvai aapay chand  soor pargaasaa.

lines.english: He Himself is the water, He Himself is the earth and its support. He Himself abides in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: aapay jal aapay thal thamHan aapay kee-aa ghat gh at baasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਹਸੈ ਆਿਪ  ਹੀ ਿਚਤਵੈ  ਆਪੇ  ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: He Himself is male, and He Himself is female; He Himself is the chessman, and HeHimself is the board.
lines.transliteration: aapay nar aapay fun naaree aapay saar aap hee paasaa.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਜਲੁ ਆਪੇ  ਥਲੁ ਥੰਮਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਆ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਬਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: As Gurmukh, join the Sangat, and consider all this: Waaho! Waaho! Great! Great isthe Play of God! ||2||12||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sangat  sabh ai bichaarahu vaahu vaahu kaa badaa t amaasaa. ||2||12||

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਨਰੁ ਆਪੇ  ਫੁਿਨ ਨਾਰੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਸਾਿਰ  ਆਪ  ਹੀ ਪਾਸਾ  ॥
lines.english: You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is all You, forever.
lines.transliteration: kee-aa khayl bad mayl t amaasaa vaahiguroo t ayree sabh  rachnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸੰਗਿਤ ਸਭੈ ਿਬਚਾਰਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਾ ਬਡਾ ਤਮਾਸਾ  ॥੨॥੧੨॥
lines.english: You are pervading and permeating the water, land, skies and nether regions; Your Words are sweeter than Ambrosial Nectar.
lines.transliteration: gXMd) too jal thal gagan pa-yaal poor rah-yaa amrit  tay meeth ay jaa kay bachnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਆ  ਖੇਲੁ ਬਡ ਮੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ  ਵਾਿਹਗੁਰੂ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਚਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: Brahmas and Shivas respect and obey You. O Death of death, Formless Lord, I beg of You. pMnw 1404
lines.transliteration: maaneh barahmaadik rud raadik kaal kaa kaal niranjan jachnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾਿਦਕ  ਰੁਦਰ੍ਾਿਦਕ  ਕਾਲ  ਕਾ ਕਾਲੁ  ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਜਚਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the greatest thing is obtained, and the mind is involved with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaad paa-ee-ai parmaarath sat sangat  saytee man kh achnaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ  ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਖਚਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is allYour making. ||3||13||42||
lines.transliteration: kee-aa khayl bad mayl t amaasaa vaahguroo t ayree sabh  rachnaa. ||3||13||42||

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਆ  ਖੇਲੁ ਬਡ ਮੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ  ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਚਨਾ  ॥੩॥੧੩॥੪੨॥
lines.english: The Lord is Inaccessible, Infinite, Eternal and Primordial; no one knows His beginning.
lines.transliteration: agam anant anaad  aad jis ko-ay na jaan ai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਨੰਤੁ ਅਨਾਿਦ  ਆਿਦ  ਿਜਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Shiva and Brahma meditate on Him; the Vedas describe Him again and again.
lines.transliteration: siv biranch Dhar Dh ayaan nit eh jis bayd  bakh aanai.

lines.english: The Lord is Formless, beyond hate and vengeance; there is no one else like Him.
lines.transliteration: nirankaar nirvair avar nahee doosar ko-ee.

lines.english: He creates and destroys - He is All-powerful; God is the Boat to carry all across.
lines.transliteration: bhanjan garhHan samath t aran taaran  parabh  so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭੰਜਨ  ਗੜਣ  ਸਮਥੁ  ਤਰਣ  ਤਾਰਣ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He created the world in its various aspects; His humble servant Mat'huraa delights inHis Praises.
lines.transliteration: naanaa parkaar jin jag kee-o jan mathuraa rasnaa rasai.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਾ  ਪਰ੍ਕਾਰ  ਿਜਿਨ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਓ  ਜਨੁ ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਰਸੈ ॥
lines.english: Sat Naam, the Great and Supreme True Name of God, the Personification ofCreativity, dwells in the Consciousness of Guru Raam Daas. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saree sat naam kart aa purakh  gur raamd aas chit ah basai. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਿਚਤਹ  ਬਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: I have grasped hold of the All-powerful Guru; He has made my mind steady and stable, and embellished me with clear consciousness.
lines.transliteration: guroo samrath geh karee-aa Dharuv buDh  sumat  samHaaran ka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਗਿਹ ਕਰੀਆ  ਧਰ੍ੁਵ ਬੁਿਧ ਸੁਮਿਤ  ਸਮਾਰਨ  ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: And, His Banner of Righteousness waves proudly forever, to defend against the wavesof sin.
lines.transliteration: fun Dharamm Dh ujaa fahrant  sadaa agh  punj t arang nivaaran ka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਧਰ੍ੰਮ ਧੁਜਾ ਫਹਰੰਿਤ  ਸਦਾ ਅਘ  ਪੁੰਜ ਤਰੰਗ ਿਨਵਾਰਨ  ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: His humble servant Mat'hraa knows this as true, and speaks it from his soul; there isnothing else to consider.
lines.transliteration: mathuraa jan jaan kahee jee-a saach so a-or kachhoo na bichaaran ka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਜਨ ਜਾਿਨ  ਕਹੀ ਜੀਅ  ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਅਉਰ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਿਬਚਾਰਨ  ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the Great Ship, to carry us all acrossthe terrifying world-ocean, safely to the other side. ||2||
lines.transliteration: har naam bohith badou kal mai bhav saagar paar ut aaran ka-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਬਡੌ ਕਿਲ  ਮੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਰਨ  ਕਉ ॥੨॥
lines.english: The Saints dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; imbued with purecelestial love, they sing the Lord's Praises.
lines.transliteration: santat  hee sat sangat  sang surang rat ay jas gaavat  hai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤਤ  ਹੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ  ਰਤੇ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Dharam panth Dh ari-o Dh arneeDh ar aap rahay liv Dh aar na Dh aavat  hai. The Support of the Earth has established this Path of Dharma; He Himself remainslovingly attuned to the Lord, and does not wander in distraction.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰ੍ਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਧਿਰਓ  ਧਰਨੀਧਰ  ਆਿਪ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਨ ਧਾਵਤ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: So speaks Mat'huraa: those blessed with good fortune receive the fruits of their minds'desires.
lines.transliteration: mathuraa bhan bh aag bh alay unH kay man ichh at hee fal paavat  hai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਭਿਨ ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ ਉਨ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਇਛਤ  ਹੀ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਤ  ਹੈ ॥
lines.english: Those who focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet, they do not fear thejudgement of Dharamraj. ||3||
lines.transliteration: rav kay sut ko t inH taraas kahaa jo charann guroo chit  laavat  hai. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਵ ਕੇ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਿਤਨ ਤਰ੍ਾਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਜੁ ਚਰੰਨ  ਗੁਰੂ ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਵਤ  ਹੈ ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Immaculate, Sacred Pool of the Guru is overflowing with the waves of the Shabad, radiantly revealed in the early hours before the dawn.
lines.transliteration: nirmal naam suDhaa parpooran sabad  tarang paragtit  din aagar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਧਾ ਪਰਪੂਰਨ  ਸਬਦ  ਤਰੰਗ  ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟਤ  ਿਦਨ  ਆਗਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is Deep and Profound, Unfathomable and utterly Great, eternally overflowing withall sorts of jewels.
lines.transliteration: gahir gambheer athaah at  bad subh ar sad aa sabh  biDh ratnaagar.

lines.punjabi: ਗਿਹਰ  ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹ  ਅਿਤ  ਬਡ ਸੁਭਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਭ ਿਬਿਧ  ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: The Saint-swans celebrate; their fear of death is erased, along with the accounts oftheir pain.
lines.transliteration: sant maraal karahi kant oohal t in jam t araas miti-o d ukh kaagar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਮਰਾਲ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਕੰਤੂਹਲ  ਿਤਨ ਜਮ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਿਮਿਟਓ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the sins are taken away; the Blessed Vision of theGuru's Darshan is the Ocean of all peace and comfort. ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaljug durat  door karbay ka-o d arsan guroo sagal sukh  saagar. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਜੁਗ  ਦੁਰਤ  ਦੂਿਰ ਕਰਬੇ  ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਗਲ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: For His Sake, the silent sages meditated and focused their consciousness, wanderingall the ages through; rarely, if ever, their souls were enlightened.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, mQurw) jaa ka-o mun Dhayaan Dh arai firat  sagal jug kabahu ka ko-oo paavai aat am pargaas ka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਿਨ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨੁ ਧਰੈ ਿਫਰਤ  ਸਗਲ  ਜੁਗ ਕਬਹੁ ਕ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸ  ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: In the Hymns of the Vedas, Brahma sang His Praises; for His Sake, Shiva the silent sage held his place on the Kailaash Mountain.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, mQurw) bayd ban ee sahit  biranch jas gaavai jaa ko siv mun geh na t ajaat kabilaas kaN-u.

lines.punjabi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ  ਸਿਹਤ  ਿਬਰੰਿਚ  ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ  ਜਾ ਕੋ ਿਸਵ ਮੁਿਨ ਗਿਹ ਨ ਤਜਾਤ  ਕਿਬਲਾਸ  ਕੰਉ ॥
lines.english: For His Sake, the Yogis, celibates, Siddhas and seekers, the countless sects of fanatics with matted hair wear religious robes, wandering as detached renunciates.
lines.transliteration: cauQy ky, mQurw) jaa kou jogee jatee siDh  saaDh ik anayk t ap jataa joot bh aykh kee-ay firat  udaas ka-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾ ਕੌ ਜੋਗੀ  ਜਤੀ  ਿਸਧ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਤਪ ਜਟਾ ਜੂਟ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਏ ਿਫਰਤ  ਉਦਾਸ  ਕਉ ॥
lines.english: That True Guru, by the Pleasure of His Will, showered His Mercy upon all beings, and blessed Guru Raam Daas with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||5||
lines.transliteration: sveIey mhly cauQy ky, mQurw) so tin sat gur sukh  bhaa-ay kirpaa Dh aaree jee-a naam kee badaa-ee d a-ee gur raamdaas ka-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਸੁ ਿਤਿਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ  ਿਕਰ੍ਪਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਜੀਅ  ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਡਾਈ  ਦਈ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਕਉ ॥੫॥
lines.english: He focuses His Meditation deep within; the Embodiment of Light, He illuminates thethree worlds.
lines.transliteration: naam niDhaan Dh i-aan ant argat tayj punj t ihu log pargaasay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ਿਧਆਨ  ਅੰਤਰਗਿਤ  ਤੇਜ ਪੁੰਜ ਿਤਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, doubt runs away, pain is eradicated,and celestial peace spontaneously wells up.
lines.transliteration: daykh at daras bh atak bh aram bh ajat dukh parhar sukh  sahj bigaasay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਖਤ  ਦਰਸੁ  ਭਟਿਕ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਜਤ  ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ  ਿਬਗਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: The selfless servants and Sikhs are always totally captivated by it, like bumble beeslured by the fragrance of the flower.
lines.transliteration: sayvak sikh sad aa at lubhit al samooh ji-o kusam subaasay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇਵਕ  ਿਸਖ ਸਦਾ ਅਿਤ  ਲੁਿਭਤ ਅਿਲ  ਸਮੂਹ ਿਜਉ  ਕੁਸਮ  ਸੁਬਾਸੇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru Himself established the Eternal Throne of Truth, in Guru Raam Daas. ||6|| pMnw 1405
lines.transliteration: bid-yamaan gur aap thap-ya-o thir saacha-o t akhat guroo raamd aasai. ||6||

lines.english: The Universe is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, but it has been saved; the All- powerful Guru has blessed it with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: taar-ya-o sansaar maa-yaa mad  mohit  amrit  naam d ee-a-o samrath.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਮਾਯਾ  ਮਦ ਮੋਿਹਤ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਅਉ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ॥
lines.english: And, the Praiseworthy Guru is blessed with eternal peace, wealth and prosperity; thesupernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhis never leave him.
lines.transliteration: fun keertivant  sadaa sukh  sampat  riDh ar siDh  na chh od-ay sath.

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਕੀਰਿਤਵੰਤ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਿਰਿਧ  ਅਰੁ ਿਸਿਧ  ਨ ਛੋਡਇ  ਸਥੁ ॥
lines.english: His Gifts are vast and great; His awesome Power is supreme. Your humble servant and slave speaks this truth.
lines.transliteration: daan badou at ivant mahaabal sayvak d aas kahi-o ih t ath.

lines.punjabi: ਦਾਿਨ  ਬਡੌ ਅਿਤਵੰਤੁ  ਮਹਾਬਿਲ  ਸੇਵਿਕ  ਦਾਿਸ  ਕਿਹਓ  ਇਹੁ ਤਥੁ ॥
lines.english: One, upon whose head the Guru has placed His Hand - with whom should he beconcerned? ||7||49||
lines.transliteration: taahi kahaa parvaah kaahoo kee jaa kai basees Dh ari-o gur hath. ||7||49||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਿਹ  ਕਹਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ  ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਸੀਿਸ  ਧਿਰਓ  ਗੁਿਰ ਹਥੁ ॥੭॥੪੯॥
lines.english: He is totally pervading and permeating the three realms;
lines.transliteration: teen bh avan bh arpoor rahi-o so-ee.
apan saras kee-a-o na jagat ko-ee. in all the world, He has not created another like Himself.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਨ  ਸਰਸੁ  ਕੀਅਉ  ਨ ਜਗਤ  ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: He Himself created Himself.
lines.transliteration: aapun aap aap hee upaa-ya-o.

lines.english: The angels, human beings and demons have not found His limits.
lines.transliteration: sur nar asur ant nahee paa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਅਸੁਰ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: The angels, demons and human beings have not found His limits; the heavenlyheralds and celestial singers wander around, searching for Him.
lines.transliteration: paa-ya-o nahee ant suray asureh nar gan  ganDh arab kh ojant firay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਯਉ  ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਰੇ ਅਸੁਰਹ  ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰ੍ਬ  ਖੋਜੰਤ  ਿਫਰੇ ॥
lines.english: The Eternal, Imperishable, Unmoving and Unchanging, Unborn, Self-Existent, PrimalBeing of the Soul, the Infinity of the Infinite,
lines.transliteration: abhinaasee achal ajonee sambh a-o purkh otam apaar paray.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਬਨਾਸੀ  ਅਚਲੁ  ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ  ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran  samrath sad aa so-ee sarab jee-a man Dh ayaa-i-ya-o. the Eternal All-powerful Cause of causes - all beings meditate on Him in their minds.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣ  ਕਾਰਣ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ਸਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ  ਜੀਅ  ਮਿਨ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਇਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Great and Supreme Guru Raam Daas, Your Victory resounds across the universe. You have attained the supreme status of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: saree gur raamdaas ja-yo ja-y jag meh t ai har param pad  paa-i-ya-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਗੁ ਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਜਯੋ ਜਯ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਤੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Nanak, the True Guru, worships God single-mindedly; He surrenders His body, mindand wealth to the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: satgur naanak bh agat karee ik man t an man Dh an gobind  dee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੀ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਦੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Infinite Lord enshrined His Own Image in Guru Angad. In His heart, He delights inthe spiritual wisdom of the Unfathomable Lord.
lines.transliteration: angad anant  moorat  nij Dh aaree agam ga-yaan ras ras-ya-o hee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਗਿਦ  ਅਨੰਤ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਿਨਜ ਧਾਰੀ  ਅਗਮ  ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਿਨ  ਰਿਸ ਰਸਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਹੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas brought the Creator Lord under His control. Waaho! Waaho! Meditateon Him!
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas kart aar kee-a-o vas vaahu vaahu kar Dh ayaa-i-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਿਸ  ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕੀਅਉ  ਵਿਸ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਿਰ ਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਇਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Great and Supreme Guru Raam Daas, Your Victory resounds across the universe.You have attained the supreme status of the Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: saree gur raamdaas ja-yo ja-y jag meh t ai har param pad  paa-i-ya-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਜਯੋ ਜਯ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਤੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Naarad, Dhroo, Prahlaad and Sudaamaa are accounted among the Lord's devotees ofthe past.
lines.transliteration: naarad Dh aroo parahlaad  sudaamaa pub bh agat har kay jo gan aN.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਰਦੁ  ਧਰ੍ੂ ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦੁ  ਸੁਦਾਮਾ  ਪੁਬ ਭਗਤ  ਹਿਰ ਕੇ ਜੁ ਗਣੰ ॥
lines.english: Ambreek, Jai Dayv, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer are also remembered.
lines.transliteration: ambreek ja-ydayv t arilochan naamaa avar kabeer bh anaN.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ  ਜਯਦੇਵ  ਿਤਰ੍ਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ  ਅਵਰੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਭਣੰ ॥
lines.english: They were incarnated in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; their praises have spread over allthe world.
lines.transliteration: tin kou avt aar bh a-ya-o kal bh intar jas jagt ar par chh aa-i-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੌ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਭਯਉ  ਕਿਲ  ਿਭੰਤਿਰ  ਜਸੁ ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਪਿਰ ਛਾਇਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Great and Supreme Guru Raam Daas, Your Victory resounds across the universe. You have attained the supreme status of the Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: saree gur raamdaas ja-yo ja-y jag meh t ai har param pad  paa-i-ya-o. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਜਯੋ ਜਯ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਤੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Those who meditate in remembrance on You within their minds - their sexual desireand anger are taken away.
lines.transliteration: mansaa kar simrant t ujhai nar kaam kroDh  miti-a-o jo t inaN.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਿਰ ਿਸਮਰੰਤ  ਤੁਝੈ ਨਰ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਿਮਿਟਅਉ  ਜੁ ਿਤਣੰ  ॥
lines.english: Those who remember You in meditation with their words, are rid of their poverty and pain in an instant.
lines.transliteration: baachaa kar simrant t ujhai tinH dukh daridar miti-ya-o jo kh inaN.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਚਾ  ਕਿਰ ਿਸਮਰੰਤ  ਤੁਝੈ ਿਤਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਿਰਦਰ੍ੁ ਿਮਟਯਉ  ਜੁ ਿਖਣੰ ॥
lines.english: Those who obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, by the karma of their gooddeeds, touch the Philosopher's Stone, and like BALL the poet, sing Your Praises.
lines.transliteration: karam kar tu-a d aras paras paaras sar bal-y bh at jas gaa-i-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਕਿਰ ਤੁਅ ਦਰਸ  ਪਰਸ  ਪਾਰਸ  ਸਰ ਬਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਭਟ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Great and Supreme Guru Raam Daas, Your Victory resounds across the universe.You have attained the supreme status of the Lord. ||4||
lines.transliteration: saree gur raamdaas ja-yo ja-y jag meh t ai har param pad  paa-i-ya-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਰ੍ੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਜਯੋ ਜਯ ਜਗ ਮਿਹ ਤੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru - the darkness of their eyes isremoved in an instant.
lines.transliteration: jih satgur simrant  na-yan kay t imar miteh kh in.

lines.english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru within their hearts, areblessed with the Lord's Name, day by day.
lines.transliteration: jih satgur simranth rid ai har naam d ino din.

lines.english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru within their souls - the fire ofdesire is extinguished for them.
lines.transliteration: jih satgur simranth jee-a kee t apat mitaavai.

lines.english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru, are blessed with wealth and prosperity, supernatural spiritual powers and the nine treasures.
lines.transliteration: jih satgur simranth riDh  siDh nav niDh  paavai.

lines.english: So speaks BALL the poet: Blessed is Guru Raam Daas; joining the Sangat, theCongregation, call Him blessed and great.
lines.transliteration: so-ee raamdaas gur bal-y bh an mil sangat  Dhan Dh an karahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਬਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਭਿਣ ਿਮਿਲ  ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਧੰਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Meditate on the True Guru, O men, through Whom the Lord is obtained. ||5||54||
lines.transliteration: jih satgur lag parabh  paa-ee-ai so sat gur simrahu marahu. ||5||54||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਲਿਗ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਸਮਰਹੁ ਨਰਹੁ ॥੫॥੫੪॥
lines.english: Living the Word of the Shabad, He attained the supreme status; while performingselfless service, He did not leave the side of Guru Amar Daas.
lines.transliteration: jin sabad kamaa-ay param pad  paa-i-o sayvaa karat  na chh odi-o paas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਕਮਾਇ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ  ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ  ਨ ਛੋਿਡਓ  ਪਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: From that service, the light from the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, radiant and bright; it has destroyed pain, poverty and darkness. pMnw 1406
lines.transliteration: taa tay ga-uhar ga-yaan pargat ujee-aara-o d ukh daridar anDh -yaar ko naas.

lines.punjabi: ਗਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਨ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟੁ ਉਜੀਆਰਉ  ਦੁਖ ਦਿਰਦਰ੍  ਅੰਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਰ  ਕੋ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: So speaks Keerat the poet: those who grasp hold of the feet of the Saints, are not afraid of death, sexual desire or anger.
lines.transliteration: bl´) kav keerat jo sant  charan murh  laageh t inH kaam kroDh  jam ko nahee t araas.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਵ ਕੀਰਤ  ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ  ਮੁਿੜ ਲਾਗਿਹ  ਿਤਨ ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤਰ੍ਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Just as Guru Nanak was part and parcel, life and limb with Guru Angad, so is Guru Amar Daas one with Guru Raam Daas. ||1||
lines.transliteration: ky, bl´) jiv angad ang sang naanak gur t iv gur amard aas kai gur raamd aas. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਵ ਅੰਗਦੁ  ਅੰਿਗ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਿਤਵ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Whoever serves the True Guru obtains the treasure; night and day, he dwells at the Lord's Feet.
lines.transliteration: jin satgur sayv pad aarath paa-ya-o nis baasur har charan nivaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਯਉ  ਿਨਿਸ  ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਹਿਰ ਚਰਨ  ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: And so, the entire Sangat loves, fears and respects You. You are the sandalwood tree;Your fragrance spreads gloriously far and wide.
lines.transliteration: taa tay sangat  sagh an bh aa-ay bh a-o maaneh t um malee-aagar pargat subaas.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗਿਤ ਸਘਨ  ਭਾਇ  ਭਉ ਮਾਨਿਹ  ਤੁਮ ਮਲੀਆਗਰ  ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਸੁਬਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Dharoo parahlaad  kabeer t ilochan naam lait  upjayo jo pargaas. Dhroo, Prahlaad, Kabeer and Trilochan chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, andHis Illumination radiantly shines forth.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰ੍ੂ ਪਰ੍ਹਲਾਦ  ਕਬੀਰ  ਿਤਲੋਚਨ  ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਉਪਜਯ੍ਯ੍ੋ  ਜੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: Seeing Him, the mind is totally delighted; Guru Raam Daas is the Helper and Supportof the Saints. ||2||
lines.transliteration: jih pikhat  at ho-ay rahas man so-ee sant  sahaar guroo raamd aas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਿਪਖਤ  ਅਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਰਹਸੁ  ਮਿਨ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak realized the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. He was lovinglyattuned to loving devotional worship of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niranjan jaan-ya-o keenee bhagat  paraym liv laa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਿਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਜਾਨਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਕੀਨੀ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Gur Angad was with Him, life and limb, like the ocean; He showered His consciousness with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: bl´) taa tay angad  ang sang bh a-yo saa-ir t in sabad  surat  kee neev rakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ  ਅੰਗ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਭਯੋ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਿਤਿਨ ਸਬਦ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਕੀ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Unspoken Speech of Guru Amar Daas cannot be expressed with only one tongue.
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas kee akath kathaa hai ik jeeh kachh  kahee na jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ  ਕੀ ਅਕਥ  ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Raam Daas of the Sodhi dynasty has now been blessed with Glorious Greatness, to carry the whole world across. ||3||
lines.transliteration: bl´) sodhee sarisat sakal t aaran  ka-o ab gur raamd aas ka-o milee badaa-ee. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਢੀ ਿਸਰ੍ਿਸ੍ਟ  ਸਕਲ  ਤਾਰਣ  ਕਉ ਅਬ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਕਉ ਿਮਲੀ  ਬਡਾਈ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: I am overflowing with sins and demerits; I have no merits or virtues at all. I abandoned the Ambrosial Nectar, and I drank poison instead.
lines.transliteration: ham avgun bh aray ayk gun  naahee amrit  chhaad bikh ai bikh  khaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗੁਿਣ  ਭਰੇ ਏਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਛਾਿਡ  ਿਬਖੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I am attached to Maya, and deluded by doubt; I have fallen in love with my childrenand spouse.
lines.transliteration: maa-yaa moh bharam pai bh oolay sut  daaraa si-o pareet  lagaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਯਾ  ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ  ਪੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ  ਿਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਲਗਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: I have heard that the most exalted Path of all is the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation.Joining it, the fear of death is taken away.
lines.transliteration: ik utam panth suni-o gur sangat  tih milant  jam t araas mitaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕੁ ਉਤਮ  ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਿਨਓ  ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਤਹ ਿਮਲੰਤ  ਜਮ ਤਰ੍ਾਸ ਿਮਟਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Keerat the poet offers this one prayer: O Guru Raam Daas, save me! Take me into Your Sanctuary! ||4||58||
lines.transliteration: bl´) ik ardaas bh aat keerat  kee gur raamd aas raakh o sarn aa-ee. ||4||58||

lines.punjabi: ਇਕ ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ਭਾਟ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ॥੪॥੫੮॥
lines.english: He has crushed and overpowered emotional attachment. He seized sexual desire bythe hair, and threw it down.
lines.transliteration: moh mal bivas kee-a-o kaam geh kays pachhaarh -ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਲ ਿਬਵਿਸ  ਕੀਅਉ  ਕਾਮੁ ਗਿਹ ਕੇਸ ਪਛਾੜਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ॥
lines.english: With His Power, He cut anger into pieces, and sent greed away in disgrace.
lines.transliteration: kroDh kh and parchand lobh  apmaan si-o jh aarh-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਖੰਿਡ ਪਰਚੰਿਡ  ਲੋਭੁ ਅਪਮਾਨ  ਿਸਉ ਝਾੜਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ॥
lines.english: Life and death, with palms pressed together, respect and obey the Hukam of HisCommand.
lines.transliteration: janam kaal kar jorh hukam jo ho-ay so mannai.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੁ  ਕਾਲੁ  ਕਰ ਜੋਿੜ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮੰਨੈ ॥
lines.english: He brought the terrifying world-ocean under His Control; by His Pleasure, He carriedHis Sikhs across.
lines.transliteration: bhav saagar banDh i-a-o sikh  taaray suparsannai.

lines.english: He is seated upon the Throne of Truth, with the canopy above His Head; He is embellished with the powers of Yoga and the enjoyment of pleasures.
lines.transliteration: sir aatpat  sachou t akhat jog bh og sanjut  bal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਿਰ  ਆਤਪਤੁ  ਸਚੌ ਤਖਤੁ  ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸੰਜੁਤੁ  ਬਿਲ ॥
lines.english: So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, Your sovereign power is eternal andunbreakable; Your army is invincible. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas sach sal-y bh an too atal raaj abh ag dal. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਸਚੁ ਸਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਭਿਣ ਤੂ ਅਟਲੁ  ਰਾਿਜ  ਅਭਗੁ  ਦਿਲ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are the True Guru, throughout the four ages; You Yourself are the TranscendentLord.
lines.transliteration: too sat gur chahu jugee aap aapay parmaysar.

lines.punjabi: ਤੂ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ  ਆਿਪ  ਆਪੇ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The angelic beings, seekers, Siddhas and Sikhs have served You, since the verybeginning of time.
lines.transliteration: sur nar saaDhik siDh  sikh sayvant  Dhurah Dh ur.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਰ ਨਰ ਸਾਿਧਕ  ਿਸਧ ਿਸਖ ਸੇਵੰਤ  ਧੁਰਹ  ਧੁਰੁ ॥
lines.english: You are the Primal Lord God, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages; YourPower supports the three worlds.
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad  anaad  kalaa Dh aaree t arihu lo-ah.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ  ਜੁਗਾਿਦ  ਅਨਾਿਦ  ਕਲਾ  ਧਾਰੀ  ਿਤਰ੍ਹੁ ਲੋਅਹ  ॥
lines.english: You are Inaccessible; You are the Saving Grace of the Vedas. You have conquered oldage and death.
lines.transliteration: agam nigam uDhran  jaraa jamihi aaro-ah.

lines.english: Guru Amar Daas has permanently established You; You are the Emancipator, to carryall across to the other side.
lines.transliteration: gur amardaas thir thapi-a-o pargaamee t aaran  taran.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਿਸ  ਿਥਰੁ ਥਿਪਅਉ  ਪਰਗਾਮੀ  ਤਾਰਣ  ਤਰਣ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, You are the Destroyer of sins; I seekYour Sanctuary. ||2||60|| sveIey mhly pMjvy ky 5  (1406-18) sava-ee-ay mahlay panjvay kay 5 Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1406-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: agh ant ak bad ai na sal-y kav gur raamd aas tayree saran . ||2||60||

lines.punjabi: ਅਘ  ਅੰਤਕ ਬਦੈ ਨ ਸਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਕਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣ  ॥੨॥੬੦॥
lines.english: Meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord God, Eternal and Imperishable.
lines.transliteration: simaraN so-ee purakh achal abh inaasee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਵਈਏ  ਮਹਲੇ  ਪੰਜਵੇ  ਕੇ ੫ ੧ਓ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, the filth of evil-mindedness is eradicated.
lines.transliteration: jis simrat d urmat  mal naasee.

lines.english: I enshrine the Lotus Feet of the True Guru within my heart. pMnw 1407
lines.transliteration: satgur charan  kaval rid  DhaaraN.

lines.english: With intuitive peace and poise, I contemplate the Glorious Virtues of Guru Arjun.
lines.transliteration: gur arjun gun sahj bichaaraN.

lines.english: He was revealed in the House of Guru Raam Daas,
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas gh ar kee-a-o pargaasaa.
sagal manorath pooree aasaa. and all hopes and desires were fulfilled.

lines.english: From birth, He realized God through the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: tai janmat  gurmat  barahm pachh aani-o.

lines.english: With palms pressed together, KALL the poet speaks His praises.
lines.transliteration: kal-y jorh kar sujas vakh aani-o.

lines.english: The Lord brought Him into the world, to practice the Yoga of devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: bhagat  jog kou jait vaar har janak upaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਿਤ  ਜੋਗ ਕੌ ਜੈਤਵਾਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਜਨਕੁ  ਉਪਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has been revealed, and the Lord dwells on His tongue.
lines.transliteration: sabad guroo parkaasi-o har rasan basaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਕਾਿਸਓ  ਹਿਰ ਰਸਨ  ਬਸਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Attached to Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, He attained the supremestatus.
lines.transliteration: gur naanak angad amar laag ut am pad  paa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਗਦ  ਅਮਰ ਲਾਿਗ  ਉਤਮ  ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: In the House of Guru Raam Daas, the devotee of the Lord, Guru Arjun was born. ||1||
lines.transliteration: gur arjun ghar gur raamd aas bh agat utar aa-ya-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਘਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਭਗਤ  ਉਤਿਰ  ਆਯਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, the mind is uplifted and exalted, and the Word of the Shabaddwells in the heart.
lines.transliteration: badbhaagee unmaani-a-o rid  sabad  basaa-ya-o.

lines.english: The jewel of the mind is contented; the Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord, within.
lines.transliteration: man maanak santhokh i-a-o gur naam d arirhaaH-ya-o.

lines.english: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable, Supreme Lord God is revealed through the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar paarbarahm satgur d arsaa-ya-o.

lines.english: In the House of Guru Raam Daas, Guru Arjun has appeared as the Embodiment of the Fearless Lord. ||2||
lines.transliteration: gur arjun ghar gur raamd aas anbh a-o th ahraa-ya-o. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਘਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਅਨਭਉ  ਠਹਰਾਯਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: The benign rule of Raja Janak has been established, and the Golden Age of Sat Yugahas begun.
lines.transliteration: janak raaj bartaa-i-aa sat jug aaleen aa.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is pleased and appeased; theunsatisfied mind is satisfied.
lines.transliteration: gur sabday man maani-aa apt eej pat eenaa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ  ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਅਪਤੀਜੁ  ਪਤੀਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak laid the foundation of Truth; He is blended with the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur naanak sach neev saaj satgur sang leen aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਚੁ ਨੀਵ ਸਾਿਜ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਲੀਣਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the House of Guru Raam Daas, Guru Arjun has appeared as the Embodiment of theInfinite Lord. ||3||
lines.transliteration: gur arjun ghar gur raamd aas aprampar been aa. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਘਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਬੀਣਾ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: The Sovereign Lord King has staged this wondrous play; contentment was gathered together, and pure understanding was infused in the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: pMjvyN ky, kl´) khayl goorhHa-o kee-a-o har raa-ay sant okh samaachri-ya-o bimal buDh  satgur samaana-o.

lines.punjabi: ਖੇਲੁ ਗੂੜਉ ਕੀਅਉ  ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ਸੰਤੋਿਖ  ਸਮਾਚਿਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਓ  ਿਬਮਲ  ਬੁਿਧ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਸਮਾਣਉ  ॥
lines.english: KALL the poet utters the Praises of the Unborn, Self-existent Lord.
lines.transliteration: aajonee sambhvi-a-o sujas kal-y kavee-an  bakh aani-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਜੋਨੀ  ਸੰਭਿਵਅਉ  ਸੁਜਸੁ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਕਵੀਅਿਣ  ਬਖਾਿਣਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak blessed Guru Angad, and Guru Angad blessed Guru Amar Daas with thetreasure.
lines.transliteration: gur naanak angad var-ya-o gur angad  amar niDh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਨਾਨਿਕ  ਅੰਗਦੁ  ਵਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਗੁਿਰ ਅੰਗਿਦ  ਅਮਰ  ਿਨਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Guru Raam Daas blessed Guru Arjun, who touched the Philosopher's Stone, and was certified. ||4||
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas arjun var-ya-o paaras paras parmaan . ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਵਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਪਰਸੁ  ਪਰ੍ਮਾਣੁ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: O Guru Arjun, You are Eternal, Invaluable, Unborn, Self-existent,
lines.transliteration: sad jeevan  arjun amol aajonee sambh a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ  ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ  ਆਜੋਨੀ  ਸੰਭਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: bha-y bh anjan par d ukh nivaar apaar anmbh a-o. the Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, Infinite and Fearless.

lines.punjabi: ਭਯ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਿਨਵਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਨੰਭਉ  ॥
lines.english: You have grasped the Ungraspable, and burnt away doubt and skepticism. Youbestow cooling and soothing peace.
lines.transliteration: agah gahan bh aram bh araaNt dahan seetal sukh  daata-o.
