lines.punjabi: ਅਗਹ  ਗਹਣੁ  ਭਰ੍ਮੁ ਭਰ੍ਿਤ  ਦਹਣੁ  ਸੀਤਲੁ  ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Self-existent, Perfect Primal Lord God Creator has taken birth.
lines.transliteration: asambha-o ud vi-a-o purakh  pooran biDh aata-o.

lines.english: First, Guru Nanak, then Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, the True Guru, have beenabsorbed into the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: naanak aad angad  amar sat gur sabad  samaa-i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਦ  ਅੰਗਦ  ਅਮਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an guroo raamd aas gur jin paaras paras milaa-i-a-o. ||5|| Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, who transformed GuruArjun unto Himself. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਗੁਰੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਪਰਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਇਅਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: His victory is proclaimed all over the world; His Home is blessed with good fortune; Heremains united with the Lord.
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar jaas jag andar mand ar bhaag jugat  siv raht aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਭਾਗੁ ਜੁਗਿਤ  ਿਸਵ ਰਹਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, He has found the Perfect Guru; He remains lovingly attuned to Him, and endures the load of the earth.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paa-ya-o bad bhaagee liv laagee mayd an bh ar saht aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਯਉ  ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ  ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਮੇਦਿਨ  ਭਰੁ ਸਹਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of the pains of others. Kall Sahaar the poetutters Your Praise, O Guru.
lines.transliteration: bha-y bh anjan par peer nivaaran kal-y sahaar t ohi jas bakt aa.

lines.punjabi: ਭਯ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਪੀਰ ਿਨਵਾਰਨੁ ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਤੋਿਹ ਜਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ  ॥
lines.english: In the Sodhi family, is born Arjun, the son of Guru Raam Daas, the holder of thebanner of Dharma and the devotee of God. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kul sodhee gur raamd aas tan Dh aram Dh ujaa arjun har bh agtaa. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਕੁਿਲ  ਸੋਢੀ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਤਨੁ ਧਰਮ  ਧੁਜਾ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਤਾ ॥੬॥
lines.english: Dharamm Dh eer gurmat  gabh eer par d ukh bisaaran . The Support of the Dharma, immersed in the deep and profound Teachings of theGuru, the Remover of the pains of others.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰ੍ੰਮ ਧੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਗਭੀਰੁ ਪਰ ਦੁਖ ਿਬਸਾਰਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Shabad is excellent and sublime, kind and generous like the Lord, the Destroyerof egotism.
lines.transliteration: sabad saar har sam ud aar ahaNmayv nivaaran .

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦ  ਸਾਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਮ ਉਦਾਰੁ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ  ਿਨਵਾਰਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Great Giver, the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, His mind does not grow wearyof its yearning for the Lord.
lines.transliteration: mahaa daan sat gur gi-aan man chaa-o na hutai.

lines.punjabi: ਮਹਾ ਦਾਿਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਗਆਿਨ  ਮਿਨ ਚਾਉ  ਨ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
lines.english: The Embodiment of Truth, the Mantra of the Lord's Name, the nine treasures arenever exhausted.
lines.transliteration: satvant  har naam mant ar nav niDh  na nikh utai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਵੰਤੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤਰ੍ੁ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨ ਿਨਖੁਟੈ  ॥
lines.english: O Son of Guru Raam Daas, You are contained amidst all; the canopy of intuitivewisdom is spread above You.
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas t an sarab mai sahj chand o-aa t aani-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਤਨੁ ਸਰਬ  ਮੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਚੰਦੋਆ  ਤਾਿਣਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL the poet: O Guru Arjun, You know the sublime essence of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||7|| pMnw 1408
lines.transliteration: gur arjun kal-yuchrai tai raaj jog ras jaan i-a-o. ||7||

lines.english: In the Fear of God, You enjoy the Fearless Lord; among the thousands of beings, You see the Unseen Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhai nirbh a-o maan i-a-o laakh  meh alakh  lakhaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਮਾਿਣਅਉ  ਲਾਖ  ਮਿਹ ਅਲਖੁ  ਲਖਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Through the True Guru, You have realized the state of the Inaccessible,Unfathomable, Profound Lord.
lines.transliteration: agam agochar gat gabh eer sat gur parchaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਮੁ  ਅਗੋਚਰ  ਗਿਤ  ਗਭੀਰੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਪਰਚਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, You are certified and approved; You practice Yoga in the midstof wealth and power.
lines.transliteration: gur parchai parvaan raaj meh jog kamaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ  ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ਰਾਜ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an gur Dh an abh ar sar subh ar bharaa-ya-o. Blessed, blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has filled to overflowing the pools whichwere empty.

lines.punjabi: ਧੰਿਨ ਧੰਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਿਨ ਅਭਰ  ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ  ਭਰਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Reaching up to the certified Guru, You endure the unendurable; You are immersed inthe pool of contentment.
lines.transliteration: gur gam parmaan ajar jari-o sar sant okh samaa-i-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਪਰ੍ਮਾਿਣ  ਅਜਰੁ ਜਿਰਓ  ਸਿਰ ਸੰਤੋਖ  ਸਮਾਇਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have intuitively attained the state of Yoga withinYourself. ||8||
lines.transliteration: gur arjun kal-yuchrai tai sahj jog nij paa-i-ya-o. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੁਚਰੈ  ਤੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਜੋਗੁ ਿਨਜੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: Nectar drips from Your tongue, and Your mouth gives Blessings, O Incomprehensible and Infinite Spiritual Hero. O Guru, the Word of Your Shabad eradicates egotism.
lines.transliteration: ky, kl´) ami-o rasnaa badan bar d aat alakh  apaar gur soor sabad  ha-umai nirvaar-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਮਉ  ਰਸਨਾ  ਬਦਿਨ  ਬਰ ਦਾਿਤ  ਅਲਖ  ਅਪਾਰ  ਗੁਰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਿਦ ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਨਵਾਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ॥
lines.english: You have overpowered the five enticers, and established with intuitive ease theAbsolute Lord within Your own being.
lines.transliteration: panchaahar nidli-a-o sunn sahj nij gh ar sahaar-ya-o.

lines.english: Attached to the Lord's Name, the world is saved; enshrine the True Guru within yourheart.
lines.transliteration: har naam laag jag uDhar-ya-o sat gur rid ai basaa-i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਿਗ  ਜਗ ਉਧਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਇਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have illliminated the highest pinnacle of wisdom.||9|| sorTy ] (1408-7) sorthay. Sorat'h
lines.transliteration: gur arjun kal-yuchrai tai jankah kalas d eepaa-i-a-o. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ  ਕਲਯ੍ਯ੍ੁਚਰੈ  ਤੈ ਜਨਕਹ  ਕਲਸੁ  ਦੀਪਾਇਅਉ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: : Guru Arjun is the certified Primal Person ; like Arjuna, He never leaves the field of battle.
lines.transliteration: gur arjun purakh parmaan  paartha-o chaalai nahee.

lines.english: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is His spear and insignia. He is embellished with theShabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: nayjaa naam neesaan sat gur sabad  savaari-a-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਪਰ੍ਮਾਣੁ  ਪਾਰਥਉ  ਚਾਲੈ  ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the Boat, the Bridge to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: bhavjal saa-ir sayt  naam haree kaa bohithaa.

lines.punjabi: ਨੇਜਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਬਿਦ ਸਵਾਿਰਅਉ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You are in love with the True Guru; attached to the Naam, You have saved the world. ||2||
lines.transliteration: tu-a sat gur saN hayt naam laag jag uDh ar-yao. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਵਜਲੁ  ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸੇਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬੋਿਹਥਾ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam is the Saving Grace of the world; by the Pleasure of the True Guru, it isobtained.
lines.transliteration: jagat uDh aaran  naam sat gur tuthai paa-i-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤੁਅ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੰ ਹੇਤੁ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਾਿਗ ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ॥੨॥
lines.english: Now, I am not concerned with anything else; at Your Door, I am fulfilled. ||3||12||
lines.transliteration: ab naahi avar sar kaam baarantar pooree parh ee. ||3||12||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤ  ਉਧਾਰਣੁ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Embodiment of Light, the Lord Himself is called Guru Nanak.
lines.transliteration: jot roop har aap guroo naanak kahaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਬ ਨਾਿਹ  ਅਵਰ  ਸਿਰ ਕਾਮੁ ਬਾਰੰਤਿਰ  ਪੂਰੀ ਪੜੀ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.english: From Him, came Guru Angad; His essence was absorbed into the essence.
lines.transliteration: taa tay angad  bha-ya-o t at si-o t at milaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਿਤ  ਰੂਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਆਿਪ  ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਕਹਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Angad showed His Mercy, and established Amar Daas as the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: angad kirpaa Dh aar amar sat gur thir kee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ  ਭਯਉ ਤਤ ਿਸਉ ਤਤੁ ਿਮਲਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Amar Daas blessed Guru Raam Daas with the umbrella of immortality.
lines.transliteration: amardaas amrat  chhatar gur raameh d ee-a-o.

lines.english: So speaks Mat'huraa: gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of Guru RaamDaas, His speech became as sweet as nectar.
lines.transliteration: gur raamdaas d arsan paras kahi mathuraa amrit  ba-yan .

lines.punjabi: ਅਮਰਦਾਿਸ  ਅਮਰਤੁ ਛਤਰ੍ੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਿਹ  ਦੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: With your eyes, see the certified Primal Person, Guru Arjun, the Fifth Manifestation ofthe Guru. ||1||
lines.transliteration: moorat panch parmaan  purakh  gur arjun pikh ahu na-yan . ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ  ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਰਿਸ  ਕਿਹ ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਯਣ  ॥
lines.english: He is the Embodiment of Truth; He has enshrined the True Name, Sat Naam, Truth and contentment within His heart.
lines.transliteration: sat roop sat  naam sat  santokh Dhari-o ur.

lines.punjabi: ਮੂਰਿਤ ਪੰਚ ਪਰ੍ਮਾਣ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਿਪਖਹੁ ਨਯਣ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: From the very beginning, the Primal Being has written this destiny upon His forehead.
lines.transliteration: aad purakh  partakh likh-ya-o achh ar mast ak Dh ur.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਧਿਰਓ  ਉਿਰ ॥
lines.english: His Divine Light shines forth, dazzling and radiant; His Glorious Grandeur pervades the realms of the world.
lines.transliteration: pargat jot jagmagai t ayj bh oo-a mandal chh aa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਆਿਦ ਪੁਰਿਖ  ਪਰਤਿਖ  ਿਲਖਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਅਛਰੁ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਧੁਿਰ ॥
lines.english: Meeting the Guru, touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was acclaimed as Guru.
lines.transliteration: paaras paras paras paras gur guroo kahaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਗਟ  ਜੋਿਤ ਜਗਮਗੈ  ਤੇਜੁ ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਿਲ  ਛਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks Mat'huraa: I constantly focus my consciousness on Him; as sunmukh, I lookto Him.
lines.transliteration: bhan mathuraa moorat  sadaa thir laa-ay chit  sanmukh  rahhu.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਰਸੁ  ਪਰਿਸ  ਪਰਸੁ  ਪਰਿਸ  ਗੁਿਰ ਗੁ ਰੂ ਕਹਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, Guru Arjun is the Boat; attached to him, the entireuniverse is safely carried across. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaljug jahaaj arjun guroo sagal sarisat lag bitrahu. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਭਿਨ ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਸਦਾ ਿਥਰੁ ਲਾਇ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਹਹੁ ॥
lines.english: I beg from that humble being who is known all over the world, who lives in, and loves the Name, night and day.
lines.transliteration: pMjvyN ky, mQurw) tih jan jaachahu jagt ar par jaanee-at  baasur ra-yan baas jaa ko hit  naam si-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਜੁਿਗ  ਜਹਾਜੁ  ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਗਲ  ਿਸਰ੍ਿਸ੍ਟ  ਲਿਗ  ਿਬਤਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.english: He is supremely unattached, and imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; heis free of desire, but he lives as a family man.
lines.transliteration: ky, mQurw) param ateet  parmaysur kai rang rang-y-ou baasnaa t ay baahar pai d aykhee-at Dhaam si-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਹ ਜਨ ਜਾਚਹੁ ਜਗਤਰ੍  ਪਰ ਜਾਨੀਅਤੁ  ਬਾਸੁਰ  ਰਯਿਨ  ਬਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਿਹਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਿਸਉ ॥
lines.english: He is dedicated to the Love of the Infinite, Limitless Primal Lord God; he has noconcerns for any other pleasure, except for the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: pMjvyN ky, mQurw) apar parampar purakh si-o paraym laag-y-ou bin bh agvant  ras naahee a-urai kaam si- o.

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਮ  ਅਤੀਤੁ  ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ  ਕੈ ਰੰਿਗ ਰੰਗਯ੍ਯ੍ੌ ਬਾਸਨਾ  ਤੇ ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਪੈ ਦੇਖੀਅਤੁ  ਧਾਮ ਿਸਉ ॥
lines.english: ||3|| Guru Arjun is the All-pervading Lord God of Mat'huraa. Devoted to His Worship, heremains attached to the Lord's Feet. ||3|| pMnw 1409
lines.transliteration: mhly pMjvyN ky, mQurw) mathuraa ko parabh sarab ma-y arjun gur bh agat kai hayt  paa-ay rahi-o mil raam si-o.

lines.english: All the gods, silent sages, Indra, Shiva and Yogis have not found the Lord's limits
lines.transliteration: ant na paavat  dayv sabai mun ind ar mahaa siv jog karee.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ  ਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ ਮੁਿਨ ਇੰਦਰ੍ ਮਹਾ ਿਸਵ ਜੋਗ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Lord, even for an instant.
lines.transliteration: fun bayd biranch bichaar rahi-o har jaap na chh aadi-ya-o ayk gh aree. - not even Brahma who contemplates the Vedas. I shall not give up meditating on the

lines.punjabi: ਫੁਿਨ ਬੇਦ ਿਬਰੰਿਚ ਿਬਚਾਿਰ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਹਿਰ ਜਾਪੁ ਨ ਛਾਿਡਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਏਕ ਘਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: The God of Mat'huraa is Merciful to the meek; He blesses and uplifts the Sangatsthroughout the Universe.
lines.transliteration: mathuraa jan ko parabh d een d a-yaal hai sangat  sarisat nihaal karee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਜਨ ਕੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਦੀਨ  ਦਯਾਲੁ  ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਸਰ੍ਿਸ੍ਟ ਿਨਹਾਲੁ  ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.english: Guru Raam Daas, to save the world, enshrined the Guru's Light into Guru Arjun. ||4||
lines.transliteration: raamdaas guroo jag t aaran ka-o gur jot  arjun maahi Dh aree. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮਦਾਿਸ  ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗ ਤਾਰਨ  ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਜੋਿਤ ਅਰਜੁਨ  ਮਾਿਹ  ਧਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.english: In the great darkness of this world, the Lord revealed Himself, incarnated as GuruArjun.
lines.transliteration: jag a-or na yaahi mahaa tam mai avt aar ujaagar aan kee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਯਾਿਹ  ਮਹਾ ਤਮ ਮੈ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਉਜਾਗਰੁ ਆਿਨ  ਕੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Millions of pains are taken away, from those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, says Mat'huraa.
lines.transliteration: tin kay d ukh kotik d oor ga-ay mathuraa jinH amrit  naam pee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਕੋਿਟਕ  ਦੂਿਰ ਗਏ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਿਜਨ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: O mortal being, do not leave this path; do not think that there is any differencebetween God and Guru.
lines.transliteration: ih paDhat  tay mat  chookeh ray man bh ayd bibhayd na jaan bee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹ ਪਧਿਤ  ਤੇ ਮਤ ਚੂਕਿਹ  ਰੇ ਮਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਿਬਭੇਦੁ  ਨ ਜਾਨ ਬੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Perfect Lord God has manifested Himself; He dwells in the heart of Guru Arjun.||5||
lines.transliteration: partachh  ridai gur arjun kai har pooran barahm nivaas lee-a-o. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰਤਿਛ  ਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ  ਕੈ ਹਿਰ ਪੂਰਨ  ਬਰ੍ਹਿਮ  ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ਲੀਅਉ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: As long as the destiny written upon my forehead was not activated, I wanderedaround lost, running in all directions.
lines.transliteration: jab la-o nahee bhaag lilaar ud ai tab la-o bh aramt ay firt ay baho Dh aa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਬ ਲਉ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਗ ਿਲਲਾਰ ਉਦੈ ਤਬ ਲਉ ਭਰ੍ਮਤੇ  ਿਫਰਤੇ  ਬਹੁ ਧਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: I was drowning in the horrible world-ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and myremorse would never have ended.
lines.transliteration: kal ghor samud ar mai boodat  thay kabhoo mit hai nahee ray pachh otaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਘੋਰ ਸਮੁਦਰ੍  ਮੈ ਬੂਡਤ  ਥੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਿਮਿਟ  ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Mat'huraa, consider this essential truth: to save the world, the Lord incarnatedHimself.
lines.transliteration: tat bichaar yahai mathuraa jag t aaran ka-o avt aar banaa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਤੁ ਿਬਚਾਰੁ ਯਹੈ ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਜਗ ਤਾਰਨ  ਕਉ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever meditates on Guru Arjun Dayv, shall not have to pass through the painfulwomb of reincarnation ever again. ||6||
lines.transliteration: jap-ya-o jinH arjun dayv guroo fir sankat jon garabh  na aa-ya-o. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਜਪਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਿਜਨ ਅਰਜੁਨ  ਦੇਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਿਫਿਰ  ਸੰਕਟ  ਜੋਿਨ ਗਰਭ  ਨ ਆਯਉ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: In the ocean of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name has been revealed in theForm of Guru Arjun, to save the world.
lines.transliteration: kal samudar bh a-ay roop pargat har naam uDh aaran.

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਲ  ਸਮੁਦਰ੍  ਭਏ ਰੂਪ ਪਰ੍ਗਿਟ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Pain and poverty are taken away from that person, within whose heart the Saint abides.
lines.transliteration: baseh sant jis rid ai dukh daridar nivaaran.

lines.english: He is the Pure, Immaculate Form of the Infinite Lord; except for Him, there is noother at all.
lines.transliteration: nirmal bhaykh  apaar t aas bin avar na ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਭੇਖ ਅਪਾਰ  ਤਾਸੁ ਿਬਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Whoever knows Him in thought, word and deed, becomes just like Him.
lines.transliteration: man bach jin jaani-a-o bh a-ya-o t ih samsar so-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਾਿਣਅਉ  ਭਯਉ  ਿਤਹ ਸਮਸਿਰ  ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Dharan gagan nav kh and meh jot  savroopee rahi-o bh ar. He is totally pervading the earth, the sky and the nine regions of the planet. He is theEmbodiment of the Light of God.

lines.punjabi: ਧਰਿਨ  ਗਗਨ  ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਮਿਹ ਜੋਿਤ  ਸਰੂਪੀ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਭਿਰ ॥
lines.english: So speaks Mat'huraa: there is no difference between God and Guru; Guru Arjun is thePersonification of the Lord Himself. ||7||19||
lines.transliteration: bhan mathuraa kachh  bhayd nahee gur arjun part akh-y har. ||7||19||

lines.punjabi: ਭਿਨ ਮਥੁਰਾ  ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪਰਤਖਯ੍ਯ੍  ਹਿਰ ॥੭॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The stream of the Lord's Name flows like the Ganges, invincible and unstoppable. TheSikhs of the Sangat all bathe in it.
lines.transliteration: ajai gang jal atal sikh sangat  sabh  naavai.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜੈ ਗੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ  ਿਸਖ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
lines.english: It appears as if the holy texts like the Puraanaas are being recited there and Brahmahimself sings the Vedas.
lines.transliteration: nit puraan  baachee-ah bayd  barahmaa mukh  gaavai.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਤ  ਪੁਰਾਣ  ਬਾਚੀਅਿਹ  ਬੇਦ ਬਰ੍ਹਮਾ  ਮੁਿਖ ਗਾਵੈ  ॥
lines.english: The invincible chauri, the fly-brush, waves over His head; with His mouth, He drinks inthe Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
lines.transliteration: ajai chavar sir dhulai naam amrit  mukh  lee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਅਜੈ ਚਵਰੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਢੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਲੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Transcendent Lord Himself has placed the royal canopy over the head of Guru Arjun.
lines.transliteration: gur arjun sir chhat ar aap parmaysar d ee-a-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ  ਿਸਿਰ  ਛਤਰ੍ੁ ਆਿਪ  ਪਰਮੇਸਿਰ  ਦੀਅਉ  ॥
lines.english: Guru Nanak, Guru Angad, Guru Amar Daas and Guru Raam Daas met together beforethe Lord.
lines.transliteration: mil naanak angad amar gur gur raamd aas har peh ga-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਿਮਿਲ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਅੰਗਦ ਅਮਰ  ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ  ਹਿਰ ਪਿਹ ਗਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: So speaks HARBANS: Their Praises echo and resound all over the world; who canpossibly say that the Great Gurus are dead? ||1||
lines.transliteration: harbans jagat jas sanchar-ya-o so kavan  kahai saree gur mu-ya-o. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰਬੰਸ  ਜਗਿਤ  ਜਸੁ ਸੰਚਰਯ੍ਯ੍ਉ  ਸੁ ਕਵਣੁ  ਕਹੈ ਸਰ੍ੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਯਉ ॥੧॥
lines.english: When it was the Will of the Transcendent Lord Himself, Guru Raam Daas went to theCity of God.
lines.transliteration: dayv puree meh ga-ya-o aap parmaysvar bh aa-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ਦੇਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਮਿਹ ਗਯਉ  ਆਿਪ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰ  ਭਾਯਉ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord offered Him His Royal Throne, and seated the Guru upon it.
lines.transliteration: har singhaasan  dee-a-o siree gur t ah bath aa-ya-o.

lines.english: The angels and gods were delighted; they proclaimed and celebrated Your victory, OGuru.
lines.transliteration: rahas kee-a-o sur dayv t ohi jas ja-y ja-y jampeh.

lines.punjabi: ਰਹਸੁ  ਕੀਅਉ  ਸੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਤੋਿਹ ਜਸੁ ਜਯ ਜਯ ਜੰਪਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The demons ran away; their sins made them shake and tremble inside.
lines.transliteration: asur ga-ay tay bh aag paap t inH bheetar kampeh.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸੁਰ  ਗਏ ਤੇ ਭਾਿਗ  ਪਾਪ ਿਤਨ ਭੀਤਿਰ ਕੰਪਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Those people who found Guru Raam Daas were rid of their sins. lines.transliteration: kaatay so paap tinH marahu kay gur raamd aas jinH paa-i-ya-o.

lines.punjabi: ੧ਓ ਸਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਿਨਰਭਉ  ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ  ਮੂਰਿਤ ਅਜੂਨੀ  ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਿਦ  ॥
lines.english: O you with swollen breasts, let your consciousness become deep and profound.
lines.transliteration: utangee pai-ohree gahiree gambh eeree.

lines.english: O mother-in-law, how can I bow? Because of my stiff nipples, I cannot bow.
lines.transliteration: sasurh suhee-aa kiv karee nivan  na jaa-ay than ee.

lines.english: O sister, those mansions built as high as mountains
lines.transliteration: gach je lagaa girvarhee sakh ee-ay Dh a-ulharee.

lines.english: - I have seen them come crumbling down. O bride, do not be so proud of yournipples. ||1||
lines.transliteration: say bhee dh ahday dith  mai munDh  na garab than ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਸਸੁਿੜ  ਸੁਹੀਆ  ਿਕਵ ਕਰੀ ਿਨਵਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ਥਣੀ  ॥
lines.english: O bride with deer-like eyes, listen to the words of deep and infinite wisdom.
lines.transliteration: sun munDh ay harn aakhee-ay goorh aa vain  apaar.

lines.english: First, examine the merchandise, and then, make the deal.
lines.transliteration: pahilaa vasat sinj aan kai taaN keechai vaapaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਭੀ ਢਹਦੇ  ਿਡਠੁ ਮੈ ਮੁੰਧ ਨ ਗਰਬੁ  ਥਣੀ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Proclaim that you will not associate with evil people; celebrate victory with your friends.
lines.transliteration: dohee d ichai d urjanaa mit raaN kooN jaikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਿਣ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਹਰਣਾਖੀਏ ਗੂੜਾ  ਵੈਣੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: This proclamation, to meet with your friends, O bride - give it some thought.
lines.transliteration: jit dohee sajan  milan lahu munDh ay veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਹਲਾ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਿਸਞਾਿਣ  ਕੈ ਤ ਕੀਚੈ  ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Surrender mind and body to the Lord your Friend; this is the most excellent pleasure.
lines.transliteration: tan man d eejai sajn aa aisaa hasan  saar.

lines.english: Do not fall in love with one who is destined to leave.
lines.transliteration: tis sa-o nayhu na keech-ee je d isai chalan haar.

lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who understand this. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak jinHee iv kar bujhi-aa t inHaa vitahu kurbaan . ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ  ਸਜਣਾ  ਐਸਾ  ਹਸਣੁ  ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: If you wish to swim across the water, then consult those who know how to swim.
lines.transliteration: jay tooN taaroo paan  taahoo puchh  tirhHaN-nH kal.

lines.english: Those who have survived these treacherous waves are very wise. ||3||
lines.transliteration: taahoo kh aray sujaan  vanjaa aynHee kapree. ||3||

lines.english: The storm rages and the rain floods the land; thousands of waves rise and surge.
lines.transliteration: jharh jhakharh ohaarh  lahree vahan lakh aysaree.

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਰੂ ਪਾਿਣ  ਤਾਹੂ ਪੁਛੁ ਿਤੜੰਨ  ਕਲ ॥
lines.english: If you cry out for help from the True Guru, you have nothing to fear - your boat will not sink. ||4||
lines.transliteration: satgur si-o aalaa-ay bayrh ay duban  naahi bh a-o. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਤਾਹੂ ਖਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਣ  ਵੰਞਾ ਏਨੀ ਕਪਰੀ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: O Nanak, what has happened to the world?
lines.transliteration: naanak dunee-aa kaisee ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਝੜ ਝਖੜ  ਓਹਾੜ ਲਹਰੀ  ਵਹਿਨ  ਲਖੇਸਰੀ  ॥
lines.english: There is no guide or friend.
lines.transliteration: saalak mit na rahi-o ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਸਉ ਆਲਾਇ  ਬੇੜੇ ਡੁਬਿਣ ਨਾਿਹ  ਭਉ ॥੪॥
lines.english: There is no love, even among brothers and relatives.
lines.transliteration: bhaa-ee banDh ee hayt  chukaa-i-aa.

lines.english: For the sake of the world, people have lost their faith. ||5||
lines.transliteration: dunee-aa kaaran  deen gavaa-i-aa. ||5||

lines.english: They cry and weep and wail.
lines.transliteration: hai hai kar kai ohi karayn.

lines.english: They slap their faces and pull their hair out.
lines.transliteration: galHaa pitan sir khohayn.

lines.english: But if they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they shall be absorbed into it.
lines.transliteration: naa-o lain ar karan samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੈ ਹੈ ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਓਿਹ ਕਰੇਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to them. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin balihaarai jaa-ay. ||6||

lines.english: O my mind, do not waver or walk on the crooked path; take the straight and true path.
lines.transliteration: ray man deeg na dolee-ai seeDhai maarag Dh aa-o.

lines.english: The terrible tiger is behind you, and the pool of fire is ahead.
lines.transliteration: paachhai baagh  daraavn o aagai agan t alaa-o.

lines.english: My soul is skeptical and doubtful, but I cannot see any other way to go.
lines.transliteration: sahsai jee-araa par rahi-o maa ka-o avar na dhang.

lines.punjabi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਡੀਿਗ  ਨ ਡੋਲੀਐ  ਸੀਧੈ ਮਾਰਿਗ  ਧਾਉ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, dwell with your Beloved Lord, and you shall be saved. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh chh utee-ai har pareet am si-o sang. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਛੈ ਬਾਘੁ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ  ਆਗੈ ਅਗਿਨ  ਤਲਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: The tiger is killed, and the mind is killed, through the Teachings of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: baagh marai man maaree-ai jis sat gur deekhi-aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਹਸੈ  ਜੀਅਰਾ  ਪਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਮਾ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਢੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: One who understands himself, meets with the Lord, and never dies again. pMnw 1411
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan ai har milai bahurh  na marn aa ho-ay.

lines.english: One who sees the One and Only Lord with his eyes - his hands shall not get muddy and dirty.
lines.transliteration: keecharh haath na bood-ee aykaa nad ar nihaal.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਚਿੜ  ਹਾਥੁ ਨ ਬੂਡਈ  ਏਕਾ ਨਦਿਰ  ਿਨਹਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; the Guru has surrounded the ocean with the embankment of Truth. ||8||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh ubray gur sarvar sachee paal. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਿਲ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: If you wish to put out the fire, then look for water; without the Guru, the ocean ofwater is not found.
lines.transliteration: agan marai jal lorh lahu vin  gur niDh  jal naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਅਗਿਨ  ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਲੋਿੜ  ਲਹੁ ਿਵਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਿਨਿਧ  ਜਲੁ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: You shall continue to wander lost in reincarnation through birth and death, even if youdo thousands of other deeds.
lines.transliteration: janam marai bharmaa-ee-ai jay lakh  karam kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਿਮ  ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: But you shall not be taxed by the Messenger of Death, if you walk in harmony withthe Will of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jam jaagaat na lag-ee jay chalai sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਿਤ  ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the immaculate, immortal status is obtained, and the Guru will unite you inthe Lord's Union. ||9||
lines.transliteration: naanak nirmal amar pad gur har maylai maylaa-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਨਰਮਲੁ ਅਮਰ  ਪਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਇ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The crow rubs and washes itself in the mud puddle.
lines.transliteration: kalar kayree chhaprh ee ka-oo-aa mal mal naa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਲਰ  ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ  ਕਊਆ  ਮਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਨਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Its mind and body are polluted with its own mistakes and demerits, and its beak isfilled with dirt.
lines.transliteration: man tan mailaa avgun ee binn bh aree ganDh ee aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਅਵਗੁਣੀ  ਿਚੰਜੁ ਭਰੀ ਗੰਧੀ  ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The swan in the pool associated with the crow, not knowing that it was evil.
lines.transliteration: sarvar hans na jaani-aa kaag kupankh ee sang.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੰਿਸ ਨ ਜਾਿਣਆ  ਕਾਗ  ਕੁਪੰਖੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: Such is the love of the faithless cynic; understand this, O spiritually wise ones, through love and devotion.
lines.transliteration: saakat si-o aisee pareet  hai boojh hu gi-aanee rang.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਕਤ  ਿਸਉ ਐਸੀ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਹੈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਰੰਿਗ ॥
lines.english: So proclaim the victory of the Society of the Saints, and act as Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: sant sabh aa jaikaar kar gurmukh  karam kamaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Immaculate and pure is that cleansing bath, O Nanak, at the sacred shrine of theGuru's river. ||10||
lines.transliteration: nirmal nHaavan naankaa gur t irath d aree-aa-o. ||10||

lines.english: What should I account as the rewards of this human life, if one does not feel love anddevotion to the Lord?
lines.transliteration: janmay kaa fal ki-aa ganee jaaN har bh agat na bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮੇ  ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਿਕਆ  ਗਣੀ  ਜ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Wearing clothes and eating food is useless, if the mind is filled with the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: paiDhaa kh aaDhaa baad  hai jaaN man d oojaa bh aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਪੈਧਾ ਖਾਧਾ  ਬਾਿਦ  ਹੈ ਜ ਮਿਨ ਦੂਜਾ  ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Seeing and hearing is false, if one speaks lies.
lines.transliteration: vaykhan  sunn aa jhooth hai mukh  jhoothaa aalaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਵੇਖਣੁ  ਸੁਨਣਾ  ਝੂਠੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਿਖ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਲਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; everything else is coming and goingin egotism. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too hor ha-umai aava-o jaa-o. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹ  ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵਉ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Saints are few and far between; everything else in the world is just a pompousshow. ||12||
lines.transliteration: hain virlay naahee ghan ay fail fakarh  sansaar. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਹੈਿਨ ਿਵਰਲੇ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਘਣੇ ਫੈਲ ਫਕੜੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: O Nanak, one who is struck by the Lord dies instantaneously; the power to live is lost.
lines.transliteration: naanak lagee tur marai jeevan  naahee t aan.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਗੀ  ਤੁਿਰ ਮਰੈ ਜੀਵਣ ਨਾਹੀ  ਤਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: If someone dies by such a stroke, then he is accepted.
lines.transliteration: chotai saytee jo marai lagee saa parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਚੋਟੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਲਗੀ  ਸਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: He alone is struck, who is struck by the Lord; after such a stroke, he is approved.
lines.transliteration: jis no laa-ay tis lagai lagee t aa parvaan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ  ਿਤਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਲਗੀ  ਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: The arrow of love, shot by the All-knowing Lord, cannot be pulled out. ||13||
lines.transliteration: piram paikaam na niklai laa-i-aa tin sujaan . ||13||

lines.english: Who can wash the unbaked clay pot?
lines.transliteration: bhaaNdaa Dh ovai ka-un  je kachaa saaji-aa.

lines.english: Dhaat oo panj ralaa-ay koorh aa paaji-aa. Joining the five elements together, the Lord made a false cover.
When it pleases Him, He makes it right.
lines.transliteration: bhaaNdaa aan ag raas jaaN tis bhaavsee.

lines.english: The supreme light shines forth, and the celestial song vibrates and resounds. ||14||
lines.transliteration: param jot jaagaa-ay vaajaa vaavsee. ||14||

lines.english: Those who are totally blind in their minds, do not have the integrity to keep their word.
lines.transliteration: manhu je anDhay gh oop kahi-aa birad  na jaan nee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਹੁ ਿਜ ਅੰਧੇ ਘੂਪ ਕਿਹਆ  ਿਬਰਦੁ  ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: With their blind minds, and their upside-down heart-lotus, they look totally ugly.
lines.transliteration: man anDhai ooNDhai kaval d isan kh aray karoop.

lines.punjabi: ਮਿਨ ਅੰਧੈ ਊਂਧੈ ਕਵਲ  ਿਦਸਿਨ  ਖਰੇ ਕਰੂਪ  ॥
lines.english: Some know how to speak and understand what they are told. Those people are wise and good-looking.
lines.transliteration: ik kahi jaanan kahi-aa bujh an tay nar sugh arh saroop.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਕਿਹ ਜਾਣਿਨ  ਕਿਹਆ  ਬੁਝਿਨ  ਤੇ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ  ਸਰੂਪ  ॥
lines.english: Some do not know the Sound-current of the Naad, spiritual wisdom or the joy of song.They do not even understand good and bad.
lines.transliteration: iknaa naad na bayd  na gee-a ras ras kas na jaan ant.

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਨਾਦੁ  ਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਗੀਅ  ਰਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Some have no idea of perfection, wisdom or understanding; they know nothing aboutthe mystery of the Word.
lines.transliteration: iknaa siDh na buDh  na akal sar akh ar kaa bh ay-o na laahant .

lines.punjabi: ਇਕਨਾ  ਿਸਿਧ  ਨ ਬੁਿਧ ਨ ਅਕਿਲ  ਸਰ ਅਖਰ  ਕਾ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਲਹੰਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those people are really donkeys; they have no virtue or merit, but still, theyare very proud. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak tay nar asal kh ar je bin gun  garab karant . ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੇ ਨਰ ਅਸਿਲ  ਖਰ ਿਜ ਿਬਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ  ਕਰੰਤ  ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows God.
lines.transliteration: so barahman jo bind ai barahm.

lines.english: He chants and meditates, and practices austerity and good deeds.
lines.transliteration: jap tap sanjam kamaavai karam.

lines.english: He keeps to the Dharma, with faith, humility and contentment.
lines.transliteration: seel santokh  kaa rakh ai Dharam.

lines.english: Breaking his bonds, he is liberated.
lines.transliteration: banDhan t orhai hovai mukat .

lines.english: Such a Brahmin is worthy of being worshipped. ||16||
lines.transliteration: so-ee barahman poojan  jugat . ||16||

lines.english: He alone is a Kh'shaatriyaa, who is a hero in good deeds.
lines.transliteration: khatree so jo karmaa kaa soor.

lines.punjabi: ਖਤਰ੍ੀ ਸੋ ਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ  ਕਾ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He uses his body to give in charity;
lines.transliteration: punn daan kaa karai sareer.
khayt  pachh aanai beejai d aan. he understands his farm, and plants the seeds of generosity.

lines.english: Such a Kh'shaatriyaa is accepted in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: so khat ree dargeh parvaan .

lines.english: Whoever practices greed, possessiveness and falsehood,
lines.transliteration: lab lobh jay koorh  kamaavai.
apnaa keet aa aapay paavai. ||17|| shall receive the fruits of his own labors. ||17||

lines.english: Do not heat your body like a furnace, or burn your bones like firewood.
lines.transliteration: tan na t apaa-ay t anoor ji-o baalan  had na baal.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਨ ਤਪਾਇ  ਤਨੂਰ ਿਜਉ  ਬਾਲਣੁ  ਹਡ ਨ ਬਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: What have your head and feet done wrong? See your Husband Lord within yourself. ||18|| pMnw 1412
lines.transliteration: sir pairee ki-aa fayrhi-aa and ar piree samHaal. ||18||

lines.english: God the Cosmic Husband dwells within all hear ts; without Him, there is no heart at all.
lines.transliteration: sabhnee gh atee saho vasai sah bin gh at na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨੀ  ਘਟੀ  ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਹ ਿਬਨੁ ਘਟੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are the happy, virtuous soul-brides; the Lord is revealed to them. ||19||
lines.transliteration: naanak tay sohaagan ee jinHaa gurmukh  pargat ho-ay. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: If you desire to play this game of love with Me,
lines.transliteration: ja-o ta-o paraym kh aylan kaa chaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਤਉ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਖੇਲਣ  ਕਾ ਚਾਉ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sir Dhar t alee galee mayree aa-o. then step onto My Path with your head in hand.

lines.english: When you place your feet on this Path,
lines.transliteration: it maarag pair Dh areejai.
sir deejai kaan  na keejai. ||20|| give Me your head, and do not pay any attention to public opinion. ||20||

lines.english: False is friendship with the false and greedy. False is its foundation.
lines.transliteration: naal kiraarhaa d ostee koorhai koorh ee paa-ay.

lines.english: O Moollah, no one knows where death shall strike. ||21||
lines.transliteration: maran na jaapai mooli-aa aavai kit ai thaa-ay. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਮੂਿਲਆ  ਆਵੈ  ਿਕਤੈ  ਥਾਇ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Without spiritual wisdom, the people worship ignorance.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan heenaN agi-aan poojaa.

lines.english: They grope in the darkness, in the love of duality. ||22||
lines.transliteration: anDh vart aavaa bh aa-o d oojaa. ||22||

lines.english: Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom; without Dharma, there is no meditation.
lines.transliteration: gur bin gi-aan Dharam bin Dh i-aan.

lines.english: Without Truth, there is no credit; without capital, there is no balance. ||23||
lines.transliteration: sach bin saakhee moolo na baakee. ||23||

lines.english: The mortals are sent into the world; then, they arise and depart.
lines.transliteration: maanoo gh alai uth ee chalai.

lines.english: There is no joy in this. ||24||
lines.transliteration: saad naahee ivayhee galai. ||24||

lines.english: Raam Chand, sad at heart, assembled his army and forces.
lines.transliteration: raam jhurai d al maylvai ant ar bal aDh ikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਝੁਰੈ ਦਲ ਮੇਲਵੈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਲੁ ਅਿਧਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The army of monkeys was at his service; his mind and body became eager for war.
lines.transliteration: bantar kee sainaa sayvee-ai man t an jujh  apaar.

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਤਰ  ਕੀ ਸੈਨਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਜੁਝੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Raawan captured his wife Sita, and Lachhman was cursed to die.
lines.transliteration: seetaa lai ga-i-aa d ehsiro lachh man moo-o saraap.

lines.punjabi: ਸੀਤਾ  ਲੈ ਗਇਆ ਦਹਿਸਰੋ  ਲਛਮਣੁ  ਮੂਓ ਸਰਾਿਪ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator Lord is the Doer of all; He watches over all, and destroys whatHe has created. ||25||
lines.transliteration: naanak kartaa karanhaar kar vaykh ai thaap uthaap. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਿਰ ਵੇਖੈ ਥਾਿਪ  ਉਥਾਿਪ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: In his mind, Raam Chand mourned for Sita and Lachhman.
lines.transliteration: man meh jhoorai raamchand  seetaa lachh man jog.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਝੂਰੈ ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ  ਸੀਤਾ  ਲਛਮਣ  ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Then, he remembered Hanuman the monkey-god, who came to him.
lines.transliteration: hanvant ar aaraaDh i-aa aa-i-aa kar sanjog.

lines.english: The misguided demon did not understand that God is the Doer of deeds.
lines.transliteration: bhoolaa d ait na samjh a-ee t in parabh  kee-ay kaam.

lines.punjabi: ਭੂਲਾ ਦੈਤੁ ਨ ਸਮਝਈ  ਿਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the actions of the Self-existent Lord cannot be erased. ||26||
lines.transliteration: naanak vayparvaahu so kirat na mit-ee raam. ||26||

lines.english: The city of Lahore suffered terrible destruction for four hours. ||27|| mhlw 3 ] (1412-11) mehlaa 3. Third Mehl:
lines.transliteration: laahour sahar jahar kahar savaa pahar. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹੌਰ  ਸਹਰੁ ਜਹਰੁ ਕਹਰੁ ਸਵਾ ਪਹਰੁ ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: The city of Lahore is a pool of ambrosial nectar, the home of praise. ||28|| mhlw 1 ] (1412-12) mehlaa 1. First Mehl:
lines.transliteration: laahour sahar amrit sar sift ee daa gh ar. ||28||

lines.english: What are the signs of a prosperous person? His stores of food never run out.
lines.transliteration: udosaahai ki-aa neesaanee t ot na aavai annee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਾਹੌਰ  ਸਹਰੁ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਸਰੁ ਿਸਫਤੀ  ਦਾ ਘਰੁ ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: Prosperity dwells in his home, with the sounds of girls and women.
lines.transliteration: udosee-a gh aray hee vuth ee kurh i-eeN rannee Dh ammee.

lines.english: All the women of his home shout and cry over useless things.
lines.transliteration: satee rannee gh aray si-aapaa rovan koorh ee kammee.

lines.punjabi: ਉਦੋਸਾਹੈ  ਿਕਆ  ਨੀਸਾਨੀ  ਤੋਿਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ  ਅੰਨੀ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever he takes, he does not give back. Seeking to earn more and more, he is troubled and uneasy. ||29||
lines.transliteration: jo layvai so dayvai naahee kh atay d amm sahamee. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਉਦੋਸੀਅ  ਘਰੇ ਹੀ ਵੁਠੀ ਕੁਿੜਈ ਰੰਨੀ ਧੰਮੀ ॥
lines.english: O lotus, your leaves were green, and your blossoms were gold.
lines.transliteration: pabar tooN haree-aavlaa kavlaa kanchan vann.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤੀ ਰੰਨੀ ਘਰੇ ਿਸਆਪਾ  ਰੋਵਿਨ  ਕੂੜੀ ਕੰਮੀ ॥
lines.english: What pain has burnt you, and made your body black? O Nanak, my body is battered.
lines.transliteration: kai dokh -rhai sarh i-ohi kaalee ho-ee-aa d ayhuree naanak mai t an bh ang.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ  ਖਟੇ ਦੰਮ ਸਹੰਮੀ  ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: I have not received that water which I love.
lines.transliteration: jaanaa paan ee naa lahaaN jai sayt ee mayraa sang.

lines.punjabi: ਪਬਰ  ਤੂੰ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ  ਕਵਲਾ  ਕੰਚਨ  ਵੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: Seeing it, my body blossomed forth, and I was blessed with a deep and beautiful color. ||30||
lines.transliteration: jit dith ai tan parfurh ai charh ai chavgan  vann. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਕੈ ਦੋਖੜੈ  ਸਿੜਓਿਹ  ਕਾਲੀ  ਹੋਈਆ  ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮੈ ਤਿਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: No one lives long enough to accomplish all he wishes.
lines.transliteration: raj na ko-ee jeevi-aa pahuch na chali-aa ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਾਣਾ  ਪਾਣੀ  ਨਾ ਲਹ ਜੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.english: Only the spiritually wise live forever; they are honored for their intuitive awareness.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee jeevai sadaa sad aa surt ee hee pat  ho-ay.

lines.english: Bit by bit, life passes away, even though the mortal tries to hold it back.
lines.transliteration: sarfai sarfai sadaa sad aa ayvai ga-ee vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਿਜ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਿਵਆ  ਪਹੁਿਚ ਨ ਚਿਲਆ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, unto whom should we complain? Death takes one's life away withoutanyone's consent. ||31||
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no aakhee-ai vin  puchh i-aa hee lai jaa-ay. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਜੀਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਰਤੀ  ਹੀ ਪਿਤ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Do not blame the Sovereign Lord; when someone grows old, his intellect leaves him.
lines.transliteration: dos na d ay-ahu raa-ay no mat  chalai jaaN budh aa hovai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਰਫੈ ਸਰਫੈ  ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਏਵੈ ਗਈ ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The blind man talks and babbles, and then falls into the ditch. ||32||
lines.transliteration: galaaN karay ghan ayree-aa t aaN annHay pavn aa kh aatee tovai. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਕਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ  ਿਵਣੁ ਪੁਿਛਆ  ਹੀ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ  ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: All that the Perfect Lord does is perfect; there is not too little, or too much.
lines.transliteration: pooray kaa kee-aa sabh kichh  pooraa gh at vaDh  kichh  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਅਹੁ ਰਾਇ  ਨੋ ਮਿਤ ਚਲੈ ਜ ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, knowing this as Gurmukh, the mortal merges into the Perfect Lord God. ||33|| pMnw 1413 slok mhlw 3  (1413-1) salok mehlaa 3 Shalok, Third Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1413-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh aisaa jaan ai pooray maaNhi samaaNhee. ||33||

lines.english: Do not call the wandering beggars holy men, if their minds are filled with doubt.
lines.transliteration: abhi-aagat  ayh na aakh ee-ahi jin kai man meh bh aram.

lines.punjabi: ਅਿਭਆਗਤ  ਏਹ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਹ  ਿਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਨ ਮਿਹ ਭਰਮੁ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever gives to them, O Nanak, earns the same sort of merit. ||1||
lines.transliteration: tin kay d itay naankaa t ayho jayhaa Dh aram. ||1||

lines.english: One who begs for the supreme status of the Fearless and Immaculate Lord
lines.transliteration: abhai niranjan param pad  taa kaa bh eekhak ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਭੈ ਿਨਰੰਜਨ  ਪਰਮ  ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੀਖਕੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaa bh ojan naankaa virlaa paa-ay ko-ay. ||2|| - how rare are those who have the opportunity, O Nanak, to give food to such a person. ||2||

lines.english: If I were a religious scholar, an astrologer, or one who could recite the four Vedas,
lines.transliteration: hovaa pandit jot kee vayd  parhaa mukh  chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਿਡਤੁ  ਜੋਤਕੀ  ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਿਖ ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: I could be famous throughout the nine regions of the earth, for my wisdom andthoughtful contemplation. ||3||
lines.transliteration: navaa khanda vich jaan ee-aa apnay chaj veechaar. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਿਵਿਚ  ਜਾਣੀਆ  ਅਪਨੇ  ਚਜ ਵੀਚਾਰ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: If a Brahmin kills a cow or a female infant, and accepts the offerings of an evil person,
lines.transliteration: barahman kailee gh aat kanjkaa an chaaree kaa Dh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਬਰ੍ਹਮਣ  ਕੈਲੀ ਘਾਤੁ  ਕੰਞਕਾ  ਅਣਚਾਰੀ  ਕਾ ਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: fitak fitkaa korh bad ee-aa sad aa sad aa abh imaan. he is cursed with the leprosy of curses and criticism; he is forever and ever filled withegotistical pride.

lines.english: One who forgets the Naam, O Nanak, is covered by countless sins.
lines.transliteration: paahi aytay jaahi veesar naankaa ik naam.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਿਹ  ਏਤੇ ਜਾਿਹ ਵੀਸਿਰ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Let all wisdom be burnt away, except for the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||4||
lines.transliteration: sabh buDh ee jaalee-ah ik rahai t at gi-aan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਸਭ ਬੁਧੀ ਜਾਲੀਅਿਹ  ਇਕੁ ਰਹੈ ਤਤੁ ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: No one can erase that primal destiny written upon one's forehead.
lines.transliteration: maathai jo Dhur likh i-aa so mayt na sakai ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਥੈ ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whatever is written there, comes to pass. He alone understands, who isblessed by God's Grace. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak jo likhi-aa so varatd aa so boojh ai jis no nad ar ho-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੋ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਿਰ  ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and become attached to greedand fraud,
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaari-aa koorhai laalach lag.

lines.english: DhanDh aa maa-i-aa mohn ee ant ar tisnaa ag. are engrossed in the entanglements of Maya the enticer, with the fire of desire withinthem.
Those who, like the pumpkin vine, are too stubborn climb the trellis, are cheated byMaya the cheater.
lines.transliteration: jinHaa vayl na toombrh ee maa-i-aa th agay th ag.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਵੇਿਲ  ਨ ਤੂੰਬੜੀ ਮਾਇਆ  ਠਗੇ ਠਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged and led away; the dogs do not jointhe herd of cows.
lines.transliteration: manmukh baneh chalaa-ee-ah naa milhee vag sag.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੰਿਨ ਚਲਾਈਅਿਹ  ਨਾ ਿਮਲਹੀ  ਵਿਗ  ਸਿਗ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself misleads the misguided ones, and He Himself unites them in HisUnion.
lines.transliteration: aap bhulaa-ay bh ulee-ai aapay mayl milaa-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they walk in harmony with the Will of the TrueGuru. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh chh utee-ai jay chalai sat gur bh aa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਛੁਟੀਐ  ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, and sing the Praises of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: saalaahee salaahnaa bh ee sachaa saalaahi.

lines.english: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is True; stay away from all other doors. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa ayk dar beebh aa parhar aahi. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਦਰੁ ਬੀਭਾ  ਪਰਹਿਰ  ਆਿਹ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: O Nanak, wherever I go, I find the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: naanak jah jah mai fira-o tah t ah saachaa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਹ ਜਹ ਮੈ ਿਫਰਉ  ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Wherever I look, I see the One Lord. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jah daykh aa tah ayk hai gurmukh  pargat ho-ay. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is the Dispeller of sorrow, if one enshrines it in the mind.
lines.transliteration: dookh  visaaran  sabad  hai jay man vasaa-ay ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਖ ਿਵਸਾਰਣੁ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਹੈ ਜੇ ਮੰਿਨ ਵਸਾਏ  ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, it dwells in the mind; by God's Mercy, it is obtained. ||9||
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay man vasai karam paraapat  ho-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਕਰਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
lines.english: O Nanak, acting in egotism, countless thousands have wasted away to death.
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-o ha-o kartay kh ap mu-ay kh oohan  lakh asaNkh.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ  ਖਿਪ ਮੁਏ ਖੂਹਿਣ  ਲਖ ਅਸੰਖ  ॥
lines.english: Those who meet with the True Guru are saved, through the Shabad, the True Word of the Inscrutable Lord. ||10||
lines.transliteration: satgur milay so ubray saachai sabad  alankh . ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁ ਉਬਰੇ  ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਲੰਖ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Those who serve the True Guru single-mindedly - I fall at the feet of those humblebeings.
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur ik man sayvi-aa t in jan laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਿਤਨ  ਜਨ ਲਾਗਉ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord abides in the mind, and the hungerfor Maya departs.
lines.transliteration: gur sabdee har man vasai maa-i-aa kee bh ukh jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Immaculate and pure are those humble beings, who, as Gurmukh, merge in theNaam.
lines.transliteration: say jan nirmal oojlay je gurmukh naam samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਊਜਲੇ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, other empires are false; they alone are true emperors, who are imbued with the Naam. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naanak hor patisaahee-aa koorh ee-aa naam rat ay paat isaah. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੋਿਰ ਪਿਤਸਾਹੀਆ  ਕੂੜੀਆ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰਤੇ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The devoted wife in her husband's home has a great longing to perform lovingdevotional service to him;
lines.transliteration: ji-o purkhai gh ar bhagtee naar hai at  lochai bh agtee bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ  ਪੁਰਖੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਿਰ  ਹੈ ਅਿਤ  ਲੋਚੈ ਭਗਤੀ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.transliteration: baho ras saalnay savaard ee kh at ras meeth ay paa-ay. she prepares and offers to him all sorts of sweet delicacies and dishes of all flavors.

lines.punjabi: ਬਹੁ ਰਸ ਸਾਲਣੇ  ਸਵਾਰਦੀ  ਖਟ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the same way, the devotees praise the Word of the Guru's Bani, and focus theirconsciousness on the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: ti-o ban ee bh agat salaahd ay har naamai chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਉ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੈ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They place mind, body and wealth in offering before the Guru, and sell their heads toHim.
lines.transliteration: man tan Dh an aagai raakh i-aa sir vaychi-aa gur aagai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਗੈ  ਰਾਿਖਆ  ਿਸਰੁ ਵੇਿਚਆ  ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the Fear of God, His devotees yearn for His devotional worship; God fulfills their desires, and merges them with Himself. pMnw 1414
lines.transliteration: bhai bh agtee bh agat baho lochd ay parabh  lochaa poor milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭਗਤ  ਬਹੁ ਲੋਚਦੇ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਲੋਚਾ  ਪੂਿਰ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My Lord God is Self-existent and Independent. What does He need to eat to be satisfied?
lines.transliteration: har parabh vayparvaahu hai kit  khaaDhai tiptaa-ay.

lines.english: Whoever walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, is pleasing to Him.
lines.transliteration: satgur kai bh aanai jo chalai t iptaasai har gun  gaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਿਤਪਤਾਸੈ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan Dh an kaljug naankaa je chalay sat gur bh aa-ay. ||12|| Blessed, blessed are they, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, who walk inharmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਜੁਿਗ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜ ਚਲੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and do not keep the Shabad enshrined intheir hearts
lines.transliteration: satguroo na sayvi-o sabad  na rakh i-o ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਨ ਰਿਖਓ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Dhig t inaa kaa jeevi-aa kit  aa-ay sansaar. - cursed are their lives. Why did they even come into the world?
If one follows the Guru's Teachings, and keeps the Fear of God in his mind, then he islovingly attuned to the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee bh a-o man pavai t aaN har ras lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਮਿਨ ਪਵੈ ਤ ਹਿਰ ਰਿਸ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: By his primal destiny, he obtains the Name; O Nanak, he is carried across. ||13||
lines.transliteration: naa-o milai Dhur likh i-aa jan naanak paar ut aar. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਿਮਲੈ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਾਿਰ  ਉਤਾਿਰ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The world wanders lost in emotional attachment to Maya; it does not realize that itsown home is being plundered.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi jag bharmi-aa gh ar musai kh abar na ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਿਮਆ  ਘਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਖਬਿਰ  ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh is blind in the world; his mind is lured away by sexual desireand anger.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh man hir la-i-aa manmukh  anDh aa lo-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਿਧ ਮਨੁ ਿਹਿਰ  ਲਇਆ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.english: With the sword of spiritual wisdom, kill the five demons. Remain awake and aware to the Guru's Teachings.
lines.transliteration: gi-aan kharh ag panch d oot sangh aaray gurmat  jaagai so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨ  ਖੜਗ  ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ  ਗੁਰਮਿਤ  ਜਾਗੈ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: The Jewel of the Naam is revealed, and the mind and body are purified.
lines.transliteration: naam ratan pargaasi-aa man t an nirmal ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਿਸਆ  ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਿਨਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Those who lack the Naam wander around lost, with their noses cut off; without theName, they sit and cry.
lines.transliteration: naamheen naktay fireh bin naavai bahi ro-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, no one can erase that which is pre-ordained by the Creator Lord. ||14||
lines.transliteration: naanak jo Dhur kart ai likh i-aa so mayt na sakai ko-ay. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੁ ਮੇਿਟ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs earn the wealth of the Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru'sShabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa har Dh an kh ati-aa gur kai sabad  veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਹਿਰ ਧਨੁ ਖਿਟਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: They receive the wealth of the Naam; their treasures are overflowing.
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paa-i-aa at ut bharay bh andaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਅਤੁਟ  ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, they utter the Glorious Praises of the Lord,whose end and limitations cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: har gun ban ee uchrahi ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ  ਉਚਰਿਹ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator is the Doer of all; the Creator Lord beholds all. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kaaran  kartaa karai vaykh ai sirjanhaar. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭ ਕਾਰਣ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਕਰੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਿਸਰਜਨਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੧੫॥
lines.english: Within the Gurmukh is intuitive peace and poise; his mind ascends to the Tenth Planeof the Akaashic Ethers.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ant ar sahj hai man charh i-aa d asvai aakaas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਹਜੁ  ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਚਿੜਆ  ਦਸਵੈ  ਆਕਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: No one is sleepy or hungry there; they dwell in the peace of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tithai ooNgh na bh ukh hai har amrit  naam sukh  vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਥੈ ਊਂਘ  ਨ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, pain and pleasure do not afflict anyone, where the Light of the Lord, theSupreme Soul, illuminates. ||16||
lines.transliteration: naanak dukh  sukh  vi-aapat  nahee jithai aat am raam pargaas. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਿਵਆਪਤ  ਨਹੀ ਿਜਥੈ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: All have come, wearing the robes of sexual desire and anger.
lines.transliteration: kaam kroDh kaa cholrh aa sabh  gal aa-ay paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰ੍ੋਧ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੜਾ  ਸਭ ਗਿਲ  ਆਏ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some are born, and some pass away. They come and go according to the Hukam ofthe Lord's Command.
lines.transliteration: ik upjahi ik binas jaaNhi hukmay aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਉਪਜਿਹ  ਇਿਕ  ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਿਹ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; they are imbued with the loveof duality.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  na chuk-ee rang lagaa d oojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Bound in bondage, they are made to wander, and they cannot do anything about it.||17||
lines.transliteration: banDhan banDh  bhavaa-ee-an karn aa kachh oo na jaa-ay. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਬੰਧਿਨ  ਬੰਿਧ ਭਵਾਈਅਨ ੁ ਕਰਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Those, upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, come and meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o kirpaa Dhaaree-an t inaa sat gur mili-aa aa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, they turn away from the world; they remain dead whilestill alive, with intuitive peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: satgur milay ultee bh a-ee mar jeevi-aa sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਲੇ ਉਲਟੀ  ਭਈ ਮਿਰ ਜੀਿਵਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the devotees are imbued with the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||18||
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagt ee rat i-aa har har naam samaa-ay. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ  ਰਿਤਆ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is fi ckle; he is very tricky and clever within.
lines.transliteration: manmukh chanchal mat  hai ant ar bahut  chaturaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਚੰਚਲ  ਮਿਤ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever he has done, and all that he does, is useless. Not even an iota of it is acceptable.
lines.transliteration: keetaa kart i-aa birthaa ga-i-aa ik t il thaa-ay na paa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਿਤਆ  ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਗਇਆ  ਇਕੁ ਿਤਲੁ  ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The charity and generosity he pretends to give will be judged by the Righteous Judgeof Dharma.
lines.transliteration: punn daan jo beejd ay sabh  Dharam raa-ay kai jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਬੀਜਦੇ  ਸਭ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੈ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, the Messenger of Death does not leave the mortal alone; he isruined by the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: bin satguroo jamkaal na chh od-ee d oojai bh aa-ay kh u-aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਜਮਕਾਲੁ  ਨ ਛੋਡਈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਖੁਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: Youth slips away imperceptibly, old age comes, and then he dies.
lines.transliteration: joban jaaNdaa nad ar na aavee jar pahuchai mar jaa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਦਾ  ਨਦਿਰ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The mortal is caught in love and emotional attachment to children and spouse, but none of them will be his helper and support in the end.
lines.transliteration: put kalat  moh hayt  hai ant  baylee ko na sakh aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ  ਮੋਹੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਿਤ  ਬੇਲੀ  ਕੋ ਨ ਸਖਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever serves the True Guru finds peace; the Name comes to abide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvay so sukh  paa-ay naa-o vasai man aa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, great and very fortunate are those who, as Gurmukh, are absorbed in the Naam. ||19||
lines.transliteration: naanak say vaday vadbhaagee je gurmukh  naam samaa-ee. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਈ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Name; without the Name, they cry in pain. pMnw 1415
lines.transliteration: manmukh naam na chayt nee bin naavai d ukh ro-ay.

lines.english: They do not worship the Lord, the Supreme Soul; how can they find peace in duality?
lines.transliteration: aatmaa raam na poojnee d oojai ki-o sukh  ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਤਮਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਨੀ  ਦੂਜੈ ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: They are filled with the filth of egotism; they do not wash it away with the Word of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai antar mail hai sabad  na kaadh eh Dh o-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਮੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਾਢਿਹ  ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, they die in their filth; they waste the pricelessopportunity of this human life. ||20||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai maili-aa mu-ay janam padaarath kh o-ay. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈਿਲਆ  ਮੁਏ ਜਨਮੁ  ਪਦਾਰਥੁ  ਖੋਇ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are deaf and blind; they are filled with the fire of desire.
lines.transliteration: manmukh bolay anDh ulay t is meh agnee kaa vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ  ਿਤਸੁ ਮਿਹ ਅਗਨੀ  ਕਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: They have no intuitive understanding of the Guru's Bani; they are not illumined with the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: banee surat  na bujh nee sabad  na karahi pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਣੀ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨ ਬੁਝਨੀ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕਰਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: They do not know their own inner being, and they have no faith in the Guru's Word.
lines.transliteration: onaa aapnee and ar suDh  nahee gur bachan na karahi visaas.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਸੁਿਧ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਿਨ  ਨ ਕਰਿਹ  ਿਵਸਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is within the being of the spiritually wise ones. They always blossom in His love.
lines.transliteration: gi-aanee-aa andar gur sabad  hai nit  har liv sad aa vigaas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਗਆਨੀਆ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ  ਹੈ ਿਨਤ ਹਿਰ ਿਲਵ  ਸਦਾ ਿਵਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord saves the honor of the spiritually wise ones.I am forever a sacrifice to them.
lines.transliteration: har gi-aanee-aa kee rakh-d aa ha-o sad  balihaaree t aas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਗਆਨੀਆ  ਕੀ ਰਖਦਾ  ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of those Gurmukhs who serve the Lord. ||21||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh jo har sayvd ay jan naanak t aa kaa d aas. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: The poisonous snake, the serpent of Maya, has surrounded the world with its coils, Omother!
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa bhu-i-angam sarap hai jag gh ayri-aa bikh  maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮੁ  ਸਰਪੁ  ਹੈ ਜਗੁ ਘੇਿਰਆ  ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The antidote to this poisonous venom is the Name of the Lord; the Guru places themagic spell of the Shabad into the mouth.
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa maaran  har naam hai gur garurh  sabad  mukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਣੁ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮੁਿਖ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny come and meet the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t in sat gur mili-aa aa-ay.

lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, they become immaculate, and the poison of egotism iseradicated.
lines.transliteration: mil satgur nirmal ho-i-aa bikh  ha-umai ga-i-aa bilaa-ay.

lines.english: Radiant and bright are the faces of the Gurmukhs; they are honored in the Court ofthe Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaa kay mukh  ujlay har d argeh sobh aa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ  ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||22||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sadaa kurbaan  tin jo chaaleh sat gur bh aa-ay. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ਿਤਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਲਿਹ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance. His heart is constantlyattuned to the Lord.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  nirvair hai nit  hirdai har liv laa-ay.

lines.english: Whoever directs hatred against the Guru, who has no hatred at all, only sets his ownhome on fire.
lines.transliteration: nirvairai naal vair rachaa-idaa apn ai ghar lookee laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਰਵੈਰੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ  ਅਪਣੈ  ਘਿਰ  ਲੂਕੀ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Anger and egotism are within him night and day; he burns, and suffers constant pain.
lines.transliteration: antar kroDh  ahaNkaar hai an-d in jalai sad aa dukh paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਕਰ੍ੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They babble and tell lies, and keep on barking, eating the poison of the love ofduality.
lines.transliteration: koorh bol bol nit  bha-ukd ay bikh  khaaDhay doojai bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਿਲ ਬੋਿਲ  ਿਨਤ  ਭਉਕਦੇ  ਿਬਖੁ ਖਾਧੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: For the sake of the poison of Maya, they wander from house to house, and lose theirhonor.
lines.transliteration: bikh maa-i-aa kaaran  bharamd ay fir gh ar ghar pat  gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾਰਿਣ  ਭਰਮਦੇ  ਿਫਿਰ  ਘਿਰ  ਘਿਰ ਪਿਤ ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are like the son of a prostitute, who does not know the name of his father.
lines.transliteration: baysu-aa kayray poot ji-o pit aa naam t is jaa-ay.

lines.english: They do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the Creator Himself bringsthem to ruin.
lines.transliteration: har har naam na chaytnee kart ai aap kh u-aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ  ਕਰਤੈ  ਆਿਪ ਖੁਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord showers His Mercy upon the Gurmukhs, and reunites the separated ones with Himself.
lines.transliteration: har gurmukh kirpaa Dh aaree-an jan vichh urhay aap milaa-ay.

lines.english: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the True Guru. ||23||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaarn ai jo sat gur laagay paa-ay. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਿਤਸੁ ਬਿਲਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਲਾਗੇ  ਪਾਇ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Those who are attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are saved; without theName, they must go to the City of Death.
lines.transliteration: naam lagay say oobray bin naavai jam pur jaaNhi.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਪੁਿਰ ਜਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the Name, they find no peace; they come and go in reincarnationwith regrets. ||24||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai sukh nahee aa-ay ga-ay pachh utaahi. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇ  ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਿਹ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: When anxiety and wanderings come to an end, the mind becomes happy.
lines.transliteration: chintaa Dh aavat  reh ga-ay t aaN man bh a-i-aa anand.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਧਾਵਤ  ਰਿਹ ਗਏ ਤ ਮਿਨ ਭਇਆ  ਅਨੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the soul-bride understands, and then she sleeps without worry.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee bujhee-ai saa Dh an sut ee nichind .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰ੍ਸਾਦੀ  ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਿਨਿਚੰਦ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the Guru, the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o poorab likhi-aa t inHaa bh ayti-aa gur govind .

lines.english: O Nanak, they merge intuitively into the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss.||25||
lines.transliteration: naanak sehjay mil rahay har paa-i-aa parmaanand. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਜੇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Those who serve their True Guru, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad,
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan aapn aa gur sabd ee veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ  ਵੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa bh aanaa man lain har naam rakh eh ur Dh aar. who honor and obey the Will of the True Guru, who keep the Lord's Name enshrined within their hearts,

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਿਨ ਲੈਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਿਹ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai othai mannee-an har naam lagay vaapaar. are honored, here and hereafter; they are dedicated to the business of the Lord'sName.

lines.punjabi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੰਨੀਅਿਨ  ਹਿਰ ਨਾਿਮ  ਲਗੇ ਵਾਪਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs gain recognition in that Court of theTrue Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sabad  sinjaapad ai tit saachai d arbaar.

lines.english: The True Name is their merchandise, the True Name is their expenditure; the Love oftheir Beloved fills their inner beings.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sa-udaa kh arach sach ant ar piram pi-aar.

lines.english: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Creator Lord Himself forgives them. pMnw 1416
lines.transliteration: jamkaal nayrh na aavee aap bakh say kart aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone are wealthy, who are imbued with the Naam; the rest of the world is poor. ||26||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratay say Dh anvant  hain nirDh an hor sansaar. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ  ਹੈਿਨ ਿਨਰਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: The Lord's Name is the Support of the Lord's humble servants. Without the Lord'sName, the there is no other place, no place of rest.
lines.transliteration: jan kee tayk har naam har bin naavai thavar na th aa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਠਵਰ  ਨ ਠਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Name abides in the mind, and one is intuitively, automatically absorbed in the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naa-o man vasai sehjay sahj samaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਨਾਉ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: Those with great good fortune meditate on the Naam; night and day, they embracelove for the Name.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee naam Dh i-aa-i-aa ahinis laagaa bh aa-o.

lines.english: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of their feet; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||27||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mangai Dhoorh  tin ha-o sad  kurbaan ai jaa-o. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂਿੜ ਿਤਨ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: The 8.4 million species of beings burn in desire and cry in pain.
lines.transliteration: lakh cha-oraaseeh mayd nee tisnaa jalt ee karay pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ  ਮੇਦਨੀ  ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਜਲਤੀ  ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: All this show of emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you at that very lastinstant.
lines.transliteration: ih moh maa-i-aa sabh pasri-aa naal chalai na ant ee vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਪਸਿਰਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ਚਲੈ ਨ ਅੰਤੀ  ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Without the Lord, peace and tranquility do not come; unto whom should we go andcomplain?
lines.transliteration: bin har saaNt na aavee kis aagai karee pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and comes to understand thecontemplation of God.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee sat gur paa-i-aa boojh i-aa barahm bichaar.

lines.english: The fire of desire is totally extinguished, O servant Nanak, enshrining the Lord withinthe heart. ||28||
lines.transliteration: tisnaa agan sabh  bujh ga-ee jan naanak har ur Dh aar. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਅਗਿਨ  ਸਭ ਬੁਿਝ ਗਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: I make so many mistakes, there is no end or limit to them.
lines.transliteration: asee khat ay bahut  kamaavd ay ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਅਸੀ  ਖਤੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please be merciful and forgive me; I am a sinner, a great offender.
lines.transliteration: har kirpaa kar kai bakhas laihu ha-o paapee vad gunahgaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਿਰ ਕੈ ਬਖਿਸ  ਲੈਹੁ ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ  ਵਡ ਗੁ ਨਹਗਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: O Dear Lord, if You made an account of my mistakes, my turn to be forgiven would not even come. Please forgive me, and unite me with Yourself.
lines.transliteration: har jee-o laykhai vaar na aavee t ooN bakh as milaavan haar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੀਉ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਰ ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਤੂੰ ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: The Guru, in His Pleasure, has united me with the Lord God; He has cut away all mysinful mistakes.
lines.transliteration: gur tuth ai har parabh  mayli-aa sabh  kilvikh  kat vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਮੇਿਲਆ  ਸਭ ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਕਿਟ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak celebrates the victory of those who meditate on the Name of the Lord,Har, Har. ||29||
lines.transliteration: jinaa har har naam Dhi-aa-i-aa jan naanak t inH jaikaar. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Those who have been separated and alienated from the Lord are united with Himagain, through the Fear and the Love of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: vichhurh  vichh urh jo milay sat gur kay bh ai bhaa-ay.

lines.english: They escape the cycle of birth and death, and, as Gurmukh, they meditate on theNaam, the Name of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: janam maran nihchal bh a-ay gurmukh  naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Guru's Congregation, the diamonds and jewels areobtained.
lines.transliteration: gur saaDhoo sangat  milai heeray rat an labh aNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਿਮਲੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਰਤਨ ਲਭੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the jewel is priceless; the Gurmukhs seek and find it. ||30||
lines.transliteration: naanak laal amolkaa gurmukh kh oj lahaNniH. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਾਲੁ  ਅਮੋਲਕਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਖੋਿਜ ਲਹੰਿਨ ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Naam. Cursed are their lives, and cursed are their homes.
lines.transliteration: manmukh naam na chayt i-o Dh ig jeevan  Dhig vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਿਤਓ  ਿਧਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਿਧਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: That Lord who gives them so much to eat and wear - they do not enshrine that Lord,the Treasure of Virtue, in their minds.
lines.transliteration: jis daa d itaa kh aanaa painn aa so man na vasi-o gunt aas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸ ਦਾ ਿਦਤਾ  ਖਾਣਾ  ਪੈਨਣਾ  ਸੋ ਮਿਨ ਨ ਵਿਸਓ  ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: This mind is not pierced by the Word of the Shabad; how can it come to dwell in itstrue home?
lines.transliteration: ih man sabad na bayd i-o ki-o hovai gh ar vaas.

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਭੇਿਦਓ ਿਕਉ  ਹੋਵੈ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are like discarded brides, ruined by coming and going in thecycle of reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: manmukhee-aa d uhaagan ee aavan  jaan mu-ee-aas.

lines.english: The Gurmukhs are embellished and exalted by the Naam, the Name of the Lord; thejewel of destiny is engraved upon their foreheads.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naam suhaag hai mast ak man ee likh i-aas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ  ਹੈ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਮਣੀ ਿਲਿਖਆਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: They enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within their hearts; the Lord illuminestheir heart-lotus.
lines.transliteration: har har naam ur Dhaari-aa har hird ai kamal pargaas.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਕਮਲ  ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayvan aapn aa ha-o sad  balihaaree t aas.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, radiant and bright are the faces of those whose inner beings are illuminated with the Light of the Naam. ||31||
lines.transliteration: naanak tin mukh  ujlay jin ant ar naam pargaas. ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਜਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰ੍ਗਾਸੁ  ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: Those who die in the Word of the Shabad are saved. Without the Shabad, no one isliberated.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai so-ee jan sijh ai bin sabd ai mukat  na ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਿਸਝੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: They wear religious robes and perform all sorts of rituals, but they are ruined; in thelove of duality, their world is ruined.
lines.transliteration: bhaykh  karahi baho karam vigut ay bh aa-ay d oojai paraj vigo-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿਹ  ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ  ਿਵਗੁਤੇ  ਭਾਇ  ਦੂਜੈ ਪਰਜ  ਿਵਗੋਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, even though one maylong for it hundreds of times. ||32||
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satgur naa-o na paa-ee-ai jay sa-o lochai ko-ee. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਨਾਉ  ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: The Name of the Lord is utterly great, lofty and high, the highest of the high.
lines.transliteration: har kaa naa-o at vad oochaa oochee hoo oochaa ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਅਿਤ  ਵਡ ਊਚਾ  ਊਚੀ  ਹੂ ਊਚਾ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: No one can climb up to it, even though one may long for it, hundreds of times.
lines.transliteration: aparh ko-ay na sak-ee jay sa-o lochai ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਅਪਿੜ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Speaking about self-discipline, no one become pure; everyone walks around wearingreligious robes.
lines.transliteration: mukh sanjam hachh aa na hova-ee kar bh aykh bhavai sabh  ko-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਿਖ ਸੰਜਮ  ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਕਿਰ ਭੇਖ ਭਵੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.english: Those blessed by the karma of good deeds go and climb the ladder of the Guru.
lines.transliteration: gur kee pa-orhee jaa-ay charh ai karam paraapat  ho-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ  ਜਾਇ  ਚੜੈ ਕਰਿਮ  ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.english: The Lord comes and dwells within that one who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. pMnw 1417
lines.transliteration: antar aa-ay vasai gur sabad  veechaarai ko-ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, when someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, the mind is pleased and appeased. True is the reputation of those who are true. ||33||
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad marai man maanee-ai saachay saachee so-ay. ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ  ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੀ  ਸੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
lines.english: Emotional attachment to Maya is a treacherous ocean of pain and poison, whichcannot be crossed.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh dukh  saagar hai bikh  dutar tari-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਬਖੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Screaming, "Mine, mine!", they rot and die; they pass their lives in egotism.
lines.transliteration: mayraa mayraa karday pach mu-ay ha-umai karat  vihaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਦੇ  ਪਿਚ ਮੁਏ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਤ  ਿਵਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are in limbo, neither on this side, nor the other; they arestuck in the middle.
lines.transliteration: manmukhaa urvaar na paar hai aDh  vich rahay laptaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ  ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਧ ਿਵਿਚ  ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They act as they are pre-destined; they cannot do anything else.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa so kamaavan aa karn aa kachh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ  ਕਰਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, the jewel of spiritual wisdom abides in the mind, andthen God is easily seen in all.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee gi-aan rat an man vasai sabh  daykhi-aa barahm subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the very fortunate ones embark on the Boat of the True Guru; they arecarried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||34||
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur bohithai vadbh aagee charh ai tay bh a-ojal paar langh aa-ay. ||34||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਬੋਿਹਥੈ  ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਚੜੈ ਤੇ ਭਉਜਿਲ  ਪਾਿਰ ਲੰਘਾਇ  ॥੩੪॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, there is no giver who can bestow the Support of the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur d aataa ko nahee jo har naam d ay-ay aaDh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਦਾਤਾ  ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the Name comes to dwell in the mind; keep it enshrined in yourheart.
lines.transliteration: gur kirpaa tay naa-o man vasai sad aa rahai ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਤੇ ਨਾਉ  ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: The fire of desire is extinguished, and one finds satisfaction, through the Love of theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: tisnaa bujh ai tipat ho-ay har kai naa-ay pi-aar.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, when He showers His Mercy. ||35||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh paa-ee-ai har apnee kirpaa Dh aar. ||35||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁ ਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਹਿਰ ਅਪਨੀ  ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੩੫॥
lines.english: Without the Shabad, the world is so insane, that it cannot even be described.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai jagat  barli-aa kahn aa kachh oo na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਬਰਿਲਆ  ਕਹਣਾ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who are protected by the Lord are saved; they remain lovingly attuned to theWord of the Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har rakhay say ubray sabad  rahay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਰਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਿਦ  ਰਹੇ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Creator who made this making knows everything. ||36||
lines.transliteration: naanak kartaa sabh  kichh  jaand aa jin rakh ee ban at banaa-ay. ||36||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਸਭ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਰਖੀ ਬਣਤ  ਬਣਾਇ  ॥੩੬॥
lines.english: The Pandits, the religious scholars, have grown weary of making fire-offerings andsacrifices, making pilgrimages to all the sacred shrines, and reading the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: hom jag sabh t eerthaa parhH pandit  thakay puraan .

lines.punjabi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਿਭ ਤੀਰਥਾ  ਪਿੜ ਪੰਿਡਤ  ਥਕੇ ਪੁਰਾਣ  ॥
lines.english: But they cannot get rid of the poison of emotional attachment to Maya; they continue to come and go in egotism.
lines.transliteration: bikh maa-i-aa moh na mit-ee vich ha-umai aavan  jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਿਮਟਈ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਆਵਣੁ  ਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Meeting with the True Guru, one's filth is washed off, meditating on the Lord, thePrimal Being, the All-knowing One.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai mal ut ree har japi-aa purakh  sujaan .

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਆ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who serve their Lord God. ||37||
lines.transliteration: jinaa har har parabh sayvi-aa jan naanak sad  kurbaan . ||37||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸੇਿਵਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥੩੭॥
lines.english: Mortals give great thought to Maya and emotional attachment; they harbor greathopes, in greed and corruption.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh baho chitvad ay baho aasaa lobh  vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਿਚਤਵਦੇ  ਬਹੁ ਆਸਾ  ਲੋਭੁ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs do not become steady and stable; they die and are gone inan instant.
lines.transliteration: manmukh asthir naa thee-ai mar binas jaa-ay kh in vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਅਸਿਥਰੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ  ਮਿਰ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਜਾਇ  ਿਖਨ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Only those who are blessed with great good fortune meet the True Guru, and leavebehind their egotism and corruption.
lines.transliteration: vad bhaag hovai sat gur milai ha-umai t ajai vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਡ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਜੈ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
