lines.english: Chanting the Name of the Lord, they find peace; servant Nanak contemplates theWord of the Shabad. ||38||
lines.transliteration: har naamaa jap sukh paa-i-aa jan naanak sabad  veechaar. ||38||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮਾ  ਜਿਪ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰ  ॥੩੮॥
lines.english: Without the True Guru, there is no devotional worship, and no love of the Naam, theName of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: bin satgur bh agat na hova-ee naam na lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਗਿਤ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak worships and adores the Naam, with love and affection for the Guru. ||39||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam araaDhi-aa gur kai hayt  pi-aar. ||39||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਿਤ ਿਪਆਿਰ  ॥੩੯॥
lines.english: Do not trust greedy people, if you can avoid doing so.
lines.transliteration: lobhee kaa vaysaahu na keejai jay kaa paar vasaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਿਰ  ਵਸਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: At the very last moment, they will deceive you there, where no one will be able tolend a helping hand.
lines.transliteration: ant kaal t ithai Dh uhai jithai hath na paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਤ  ਕਾਿਲ  ਿਤਥੈ ਧੁਹੈ ਿਜਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever associates with the self-willed manmukhs, will have his face blackened anddirtied.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sayt ee sang karay muhi kaalakh  daag lagaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਸੇਤੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੁਿਹ ਕਾਲਖ  ਦਾਗੁ  ਲਗਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Black are the faces of those greedy people; they lose their lives, and leave in disgrace.
lines.transliteration: muh kaalay tinH lobhee-aaN jaasan janam gavaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ  ਿਤਨ ਲੋਭੀਆਂ  ਜਾਸਿਨ  ਜਨਮੁ  ਗਵਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; may the Name of the LordGod abide in my mind.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  har mayl parabh  har naam vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਿਲ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The filth and pollution of birth and death is washed away, O servant Nanak, singingthe Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||40||
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee mal utrai jan naanak har gun gaa-ay. ||40||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ॥੪੦॥
lines.english: Dhur har parabh  kartai likh i-aa so maytn aa na jaa-ay. Whatever is pre-destined by the Lord God Creator, cannot be erased.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਕਰਤੈ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Body and soul are all His. The Sovereign Lord King cherishes all.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is daa part ipaal karay har raa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਦਾ ਪਰ੍ਿਤਪਾਿਲ  ਕਰੇ ਹਿਰ ਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The gossipers and slanderers shall remain hungry and die, rolling in the dust; their hands cannot reach anywhere.
lines.transliteration: chugal nindak bh ukhay rul mu-ay aynaa hath na kithaa-oo paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚੁਗਲ  ਿਨੰਦਕ  ਭੁਖੇ ਰੁਿਲ ਮੁਏ ਏਨਾ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਿਕਥਾਊ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Outwardly, they do all the proper deeds, but they are hypocrites; in their minds andhearts, they practice deception and fraud.
lines.transliteration: baahar pakhand sabh  karam karahi man hird ai kapat kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਹਿਰ  ਪਾਖੰਡ  ਸਭ ਕਰਮ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whatever is planted in the farm of the body, shall come and stand before them in the end. pMnw 1418
lines.transliteration: khayt  sareer jo beejee-ai so ant  khalo-aa aa-ay.

lines.english: Nanak offers this prayer: O Lord God, please forgive me, and unite me with Yourself. ||41||
lines.transliteration: naanak kee parabh baynt ee har bh aavai bakh as milaa-ay. ||41||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੀ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਖਿਸ  ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੪੧॥
lines.english: The mortal being does not understand the comings and goings of reincarnation; hedoes not see the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: man aavan jaan  na sujh -ee naa sujh ai darbaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਆਵਣ  ਜਾਣੁ  ਨ ਸੁਝਈ  ਨਾ ਸੁਝੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: He is wrapped up in emotional attachment and Maya, and within his being is thedarkness of ignorance.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa mohi palayti-aa antar agi-aan gubaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਪਲੇਿਟਆ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਅਿਗਆਨੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The sleeping person wakes, only when he is hit on the head by a heavy club.
lines.transliteration: tab nar sut aa jaagi-aa sir dand lagaa baho bh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਤਬ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਤਾ ਜਾਿਗਆ ਿਸਿਰ  ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾ  ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs dwell upon the Lord; they find the door of salvation.
lines.transliteration: gurmukhaaN karaaN upar har chayt i-aa say paa-in mokh  du-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ  ਕਰ ਉਪਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਚੇਿਤਆ  ਸੇ ਪਾਇਿਨ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they themselves are saved, and all their relatives are carried across as well. ||42||
lines.transliteration: naanak aap ohi uDhray sabh  kutamb t aray parvaar. ||42||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਿਪ ਓਿਹ ਉਧਰੇ  ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬ  ਤਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ  ॥੪੨॥
lines.english: Whoever dies in the Word of the Shabad, is known to be truly dead.
lines.transliteration: sabad marai so mu-aa jaapai.

lines.english: By Guru's Grace, the mortal is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gur parsaadee har ras Dharaapai.

lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is recognized in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har dargahi gur sabad  sinjaapai.

lines.english: Without the Shabad, everyone is dead.
lines.transliteration: bin sabdai mu-aa hai sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh dies; his life is wasted.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mu-aa apunaa janam kh o-ay.

lines.english: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, shall cry in pain in the end.
lines.transliteration: har naam na cheeteh ant  dukh ro-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whatever the Creator Lord does, comes to pass. ||43||
lines.transliteration: naanak kartaa karay so ho-ay. ||43||

lines.english: The Gurmukhs never grow old; within them is intuitive understanding and spiritualwisdom.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh budh ay kad ay naahee jinHaa ant ar surat  gi-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਬੁਢੇ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਿਗਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: They chant the Praises of the Lord, forever and ever; deep within, they intuitively meditate on the Lord.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sad aa har gun  raveh ant ar sahj Dh i-aan.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਿਹ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਹਜ  ਿਧਆਨੁ ॥
lines.english: They dwell forever in blissful knowledge of the Lord; they look upon pain and pleasureas one and the same.
lines.transliteration: o-ay sadaa anand bibayk raheh d ukh sukh  ayk samaan.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਿਦ ਿਬਬੇਕ  ਰਹਿਹ  ਦੁਿਖ ਸੁਿਖ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: They see the One Lord in all, and realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul of all. ||44||
lines.transliteration: tinaa nad ree iko aa-i-aa sabh  aatam raam pachh aan. ||44||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨਾ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਇਕੋ ਆਇਆ  ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੪੪॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are like stupid children; they do not keep the Lord in theirthoughts.
lines.transliteration: manmukh baalak biraDh  samaan hai jinHaa ant ar har surat  naahee.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ  ਬਾਲਕੁ  ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਸਮਾਿਨ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਿਰ ਸੁਰਿਤ  ਨਾਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: They do all their deeds in egotism, and they must answer to the Righteous Judge ofDharma.
lines.transliteration: vich ha-umai karam kamaavday sabh  Dharam raa-ay kai jaaNhee.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਿਚ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਸਭ ਧਰਮ  ਰਾਇ  ਕੈ ਜਹੀ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs are good and immaculately pure; they are embellished and exaltedwith the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hachh ay nirmalay gur kai sabad  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਛੇ ਿਨਰਮਲੇ  ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Not even a tiny bit of filth sticks to them; they walk in harmony with the Will of theTrue Guru.
lines.transliteration: onaa mail patang na lag-ee je chalan sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ  ਨ ਲਗਈ  ਿਜ ਚਲਿਨ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The filth of the manmukhs is not washed away, even if they wash hundreds of times.
lines.transliteration: manmukh jooth  na ut rai jay sa-o Dh ovan paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਜੂਿਠ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ  ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ  ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are united with the Lord; they merge into the Guru's Being. ||45||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh mayli-an gur kai ank samaa-ay. ||45||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਮੇਿਲਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਿਕ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੪੫॥
lines.english: How can someone do bad things, and still live with himself?
lines.transliteration: buraa karay so kayhaa sijhai.

lines.english: By his own anger, he only burns himself.
lines.transliteration: aapnai rohi aapay hee d ajhai.

lines.english: The self-willed manmukh drives himself crazy with worries and stubborn struggles.
lines.transliteration: manmukh kamlaa ragrh ai lujh ai.

lines.english: But those who become Gurmukh understand everything.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh ho-ay t is sabh  kichh  sujhai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh struggles with his own mind. ||46||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh man si-o lujh ai. ||46||

lines.english: Those who do not serve the True Guru, the Primal Being, and do not reflect upon theWord of the Shabad
lines.transliteration: jinaa satgur purakh  na sayvi-o sabad  na keet o veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਸੇਿਵਓ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਨ ਕੀਤੋ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: o-ay maanas joon na aakh ee-an pasoo dh or gaavaar. - do not call them human beings; they are just animals and stupid beasts.

lines.punjabi: ਓਇ ਮਾਣਸ  ਜੂਿਨ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਿਨ  ਪਸੂ ਢੋਰ ਗਾਵਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: They have no spiritual wisdom or meditation within their beings; they are not in lovewith the Lord.
lines.transliteration: onaa antar gi-aan na Dh i-aan hai har sa-o pareet  na pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਓਨਾ  ਅੰਤਿਰ ਿਗਆਨੁ ਨ ਿਧਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਸਉ ਪਰ੍ੀਿਤ  ਨ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs die in evil and corruption; they die and are reborn, again and again.
lines.transliteration: manmukh mu-ay vikaar meh mar jameh vaaro vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਮੁਏ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ਮਿਹ ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: They alone live, who join with the living; enshrine the Lord, the Lord of Life, withinyour heart.
lines.transliteration: jeevdi-aa no milai so jeevd ay har jagjeevan ur Dh aar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਵਿਦਆ  ਨੋ ਿਮਲੈ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ  ਉਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs look beautiful in that Court of the True Lord. ||47||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh sohn ay tit sachai d arbaar. ||47||

lines.english: The Lord built the Harimandir, the Temple of the Lord; the Lord dwells within it.
lines.transliteration: har mandar har saaji-aa har vasai jis naal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਸਾਿਜਆ  ਹਿਰ ਵਸੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have found the Lord; my emotional attachment toMaya has been burnt away.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee har paa-i-aa maa-i-aa moh parjaal.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਹਿਰ ਪਾਇਆ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਪਰਜਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Countless things are in the Harimandir, the Temple of the Lord; contemplate theNaam, and the nine treasures will be yours.
lines.transliteration: har mandar vasat  anayk hai nav niDh  naam samaal.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਮੰਦਿਰ  ਵਸਤੁ  ਅਨੇਕ  ਹੈ ਨਵ ਿਨਿਧ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: Dhan bh agvant ee naankaa jinaa gurmukh  laDhaa har bh aal. Blessed is that happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, seeks and finds theLord.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੀ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਲਧਾ  ਹਿਰ ਭਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, one searches the temple of the body-fortress, and finds theLord within the heart. ||48||
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee garh  mand ar khoji-aa har hird ai paa-i-aa naal. ||48||

lines.punjabi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ  ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਿਜਆ  ਹਿਰ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਨਾਿਲ  ॥੪੮॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in the ten directions, led by intense desire, greed and corruption. pMnw 1419
lines.transliteration: manmukh d ah dis fir rahay at  tisnaa lobh  vikaar.

lines.english: Their attachment to Maya does not cease; they die, only to be reborn, over and overagain.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa moh na chuk-ee mar jameh vaaro vaar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਮਿਰ ਜੰਮਿਹ  ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.english: Serving the True Guru, peace is found; intense desire and corruption are discarded.
lines.transliteration: satgur sayv sukh  paa-i-aa at  tisnaa t aj vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਿਤ  ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਤਿਜ  ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: The pains of death and birth are taken away; servant Nanak reflects upon the Word ofthe Shabad. ||49||
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh  ga-i-aa jan naanak sabad  beechaar. ||49||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਮਰਨ  ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ  ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਬਦੁ  ਬੀਚਾਿਰ  ॥੪੯॥
lines.english: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal being, and you shall behonored in the Court of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: har har naam Dhi-aa-ay man har d argeh paavahi maan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਧਆਇ  ਮਨ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: All your sins and terrible mistakes shall be taken away, and you shall be rid of yourpride and egotism.
lines.transliteration: kilvikh paap sabh  katee-ah ha-umai chukai gumaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਕਲਿਵਖ  ਪਾਪ ਸਿਭ ਕਟੀਅਿਹ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਚੁਕੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, realizing God, the Soul of all.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh kamal vigsi-aa sabh  aatam barahm pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਕਮਲੁ  ਿਵਗਿਸਆ  ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: O Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may chant theName of the Lord. ||50||
lines.transliteration: har har kirpaa Dhaar parabh  jan naanak jap har naam. ||50||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਹਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਧਾਿਰ  ਪਰ੍ਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਜਿਪ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੫੦॥
lines.english: Dhanaasree Dh anvant ee jaan ee-ai bh aa-ee jaaN satgur kee kaar kamaa-ay. In Dhanaasaree, the soul-bride is known to be wealthy, O Siblings of Destiny, when she works for the True Guru.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ  ਧਨਵੰਤੀ  ਜਾਣੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: She surrenders her body, mind and soul, O Siblings of Destiny, and lives according tothe Hukam of His Command.
lines.transliteration: tan man sa-upay jee-a sa-o bh aa-ee la-ay hukam firaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ  ਜੀਅ ਸਉ ਭਾਈ  ਲਏ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਿਫਰਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I sit where He wishes me to sit, O Siblings of Destiny; wherever He sends me, I go.
lines.transliteration: jah baisaaveh baisah bhaa-ee jah bh ayjeh t ah jaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਵਿਹ  ਬੈਸਹ  ਭਾਈ  ਜਹ ਭੇਜਿਹ  ਤਹ ਜਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: There is no other wealth as great, O Siblings of Destiny; such is the greatness of theTrue Name.
lines.transliteration: ayvad Dhan hor ko nahee bh aa-ee jayvad sachaa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਏਵਡੁ ਧਨੁਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ  ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I sing forever the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; I shall remain with the True Oneforever.
lines.transliteration: sadaa sachay kay gun  gaavaaN bhaa-ee sad aa sachay kai sang rahaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵ  ਭਾਈ  ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਹਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: So wear the clothes of His Glorious Virtues and goodness, O Siblings of Destiny; eatand enjoy the flavor of your own honor.
lines.transliteration: painan gun  chang-aa-ee-aa bh aa-ee aapn ee pat  kay saad  aapay kh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੈਨਣੁ  ਗੁ ਣ ਚੰਿਗਆਈਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਆਪਣੀ  ਪਿਤ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਆਪੇ  ਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: How can I praise Him, O Siblings of Destiny? I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision ofHis Darshan.
lines.transliteration: tis kaa ki-aa salaahee-ai bh aa-ee d arsan ka-o bal jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਿਕਆ  ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ  ਭਾਈ  ਦਰਸਨ  ਕਉ ਬਿਲ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Great is the Glorious Greatness of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; if one isblessed with good karma, He is found.
lines.transliteration: satgur vich vadee-aa vad i-aa-ee-aa bh aa-ee karam milai t aaN paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਵਡੀਆ  ਵਿਡਆਈਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਕਰਿਮ  ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Some do not know how to submit to the Hukam of His Command, O Siblings of Destiny; they wander around lost in the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: ik hukam man na jaannee bh aa-ee d oojai bh aa-ay firaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇਿਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਫਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They find no place of rest in the Sangat, O Siblings of Destiny; they find no place tosit.
lines.transliteration: sangat dh o-ee naa milai bh aa-ee baisan  milai na thaa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਗਿਤ  ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਿਮਲੈ ਭਾਈ  ਬੈਸਿਣ  ਿਮਲੈ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.english: Nanak: they alone submit to His Command, O Siblings of Destiny, who are pre-destined to live the Name.
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam tinaa manaa-isee bh aa-ee jinaa Dh uray kamaa-i-aa naa-o.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਿਤਨਾ  ਮਨਾਇਸੀ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਧੁਰੇ ਕਮਾਇਆ  ਨਾਉ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to them, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||51||
lines.transliteration: tinH vitahu ha-o vaari-aa bh aa-ee t in ka-o sad  balihaarai jaa-o. ||51||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਿਵਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ਭਾਈ  ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੈ  ਜਾਉ  ॥੫੧॥
lines.english: Those beards are true, which brush the feet of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: say daarh ee-aaN sachee-aa je gur charnee lagaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਸੇ ਦਾੜੀਆਂ  ਸਚੀਆ  ਿਜ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ  ਲਗੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: Those who serve their Guru night and day, live in bliss, night and day.
lines.transliteration: an-din sayvan gur aapn aa an-d in anad  rahaNniH.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਨ  ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਅਨਿਦ  ਰਹੰਿਨ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, their faces appear beautiful in the Court of the True Lord. ||52||
lines.transliteration: naanak say muh sohnay sachai d ar disaNniH. ||52||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ  ਸਚੈ ਦਿਰ ਿਦਸੰਿਨ ॥੫੨॥
lines.english: True are the faces and true are the beards, of those who speak the Truth and live theTruth.
lines.transliteration: mukh sachay sach d aarhee-aa sach boleh sach kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਮੁਖ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਦਾੜੀਆ  ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their minds; they are absorbed in the TrueGuru.
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad man vasi-aa sat gur maaNhi samaaNhi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ  ਮਿਨ ਵਿਸਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਮਿਹ  ਸਮਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: True is their capital, and true is their wealth; they are blessed with the ultimate status.
lines.transliteration: sachee raasee sach Dhan ut am pad vee paaNhi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸੀ  ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ  ਪਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They hear the Truth, they believe in the Truth; they act and work in the Truth.
lines.transliteration: sach suneh sach man lain sachee kaar kamaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿਹ  ਸਚੁ ਮੰਿਨ ਲੈਿਨ  ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: They are given a place in the Court of the True Lord; they are absorbed in the TrueLord.
lines.transliteration: sachee dargeh baisn aa sachay maahi samaahi.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ  ਬੈਸਣਾ  ਸਚੇ ਮਾਿਹ  ਸਮਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the True Lord is not found. The self-willedmanmukhs leave, wandering around lost. ||53||
lines.transliteration: naanak vin sat gur sach na paa-ee-ai manmukh  bhoolay jaaNhi. ||53||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਵਣੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ  ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭੂਲੇ ਜਿਹ  ॥੫੩॥
lines.english: The rainbird cries, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!" She is in love with the treasure,the water.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa pari-o pari-o karay jalniDh paraym pi-aar.

lines.english: Meeting with the Guru, the cooling, soothing water is obtained, and all pain is takenaway.
lines.transliteration: gur milay seetal jal paa-i-aa sabh  dookh nivaaran haar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਿਮਲੇ ਸੀਤਲ  ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਿਭ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥
lines.english: My thirst has been quenched, and intuitive peace and poise have welled up; my criesand screams of anguish are past.
lines.transliteration: tis chukai sahj oopjai chukai kook pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਸ ਚੁਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ  ਊਪਜੈ  ਚੁਕੈ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are peaceful and tranquil; they enshrine the Naam, the Nameof the Lord, within their hearts. ||54||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh saaNt ho-ay naam rakh ahu ur Dh aar. ||54||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਿਰ  ॥੫੪॥
lines.english: O rainbird, chirp the True Name, and let yourself be attuned to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa tooN sach cha-o sachay sa-o liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਤੂੰ ਸਚੁ ਚਉ ਸਚੇ ਸਉ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Your word shall be accepted and approved, if you speak as Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: boli-aa tayraa thaa-ay pavai gurmukh  ho-ay alaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਇ  ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੋਇ ਅਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Remember the Shabad, and your thirst shall be relieved; surrender to the Will of the Lord. pMnw 1420
lines.transliteration: sabad cheen t ikh utrai man lai rajaa-ay.

lines.english: The clouds are heavy, hanging low, and the rain is pouring down on all sides; the rain-drop is received, with natural ease.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa jhok varasd aa boond  pavai sahj subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਝੋਿਕ ਵਰਸਦਾ  ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵੈ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: From water, everything is produced; without water, thirst is not quenched.
lines.transliteration: jal hee tay sabh  oopjai bin jal pi-aas na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਜੈ  ਿਬਨੁ ਜਲ ਿਪਆਸ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, whoever drinks in the Water of the Lord, shall never feel hunger again.||55||
lines.transliteration: naanak har jal jin pee-aa tis bh ookh na laagai aa-ay. ||55||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਜਲੁ ਿਜਿਨ  ਪੀਆ  ਿਤਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ  ਆਇ  ॥੫੫॥
lines.english: O rainbird, speak the Shabad, the True Word of God, with natural peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa tooN sahj bol sachai sabad  subh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਤੂੰ ਸਹਿਜ  ਬੋਿਲ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Everything is with you; the True Guru will show you this.
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tayrai naal hai sat gur dee-aa d ikhaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ਹੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਦੀਆ  ਿਦਖਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: So understand your own self, and meet your Beloved; His Grace shall rain down in torrents.
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaan eh pareet am milai vuth aa chh ahbar laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਪਛਾਣਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਿਮਲੈ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar rains down softly and gently; thirst and hungerare completely gone.
lines.transliteration: jhim jh im amrit  varasd aa tisnaa bh ukh sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.english: Your cries and screams of anguish have ceased; your light shall merge into the Light.
lines.transliteration: kook pukaar na hova-ee jotee jot  milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ  ਨ ਹੋਵਈ  ਜੋਤੀ  ਜੋਿਤ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they are absorbed in the True Name.||56||
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh savniH sohaagan ee sachai naam samaa-ay. ||56||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਖ ਸਵਿਨ  ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ  ਸਚੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੫੬॥
lines.english: Dharahu kh asam bh ayji-aa sachai hukam path aa-ay. The Primal Lord and Master has sent out the True Hukam of His Command.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਖਸਿਮ  ਭੇਿਜਆ  ਸਚੈ ਹੁਕਿਮ ਪਠਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Indra mercifully sends forth the rain, which falls in torrents.
lines.transliteration: ind varsai d a-i-aa kar goorhHee chh ahbar laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ  ਦਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਗੂੜੀ  ਛਹਬਰ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The body and mind of the rainbird are happy. only when the rain-drop falls into itsmouth.
lines.transliteration: baabeehay tan man sukh  ho-ay jaaN tat boond  muhi paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹੇ  ਤਿਨ  ਮਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜ ਤਤੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਿਹ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The corn grows high, wealth increases, and the earth is embellished with beauty.
lines.transliteration: an Dhan bahut aa upjai Dh artee sobh aa paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਉਪਜੈ  ਧਰਤੀ  ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, people worship the Lord with devotion, and are absorbed in the Wordof the Guru's Shabad.
lines.transliteration: an-din lok bh agat karay gur kai sabad  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਭਗਿਤ  ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The True Lord Himself forgives them, and showering them with His Mercy, He leads them to walk in His Will.
lines.transliteration: aapay sachaa bakhas la-ay kar kirpaa karai rajaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੇ  ਸਚਾ ਬਖਿਸ ਲਏ ਕਿਰ ਿਕਰਪਾ  ਕਰੈ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O brides, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and be absorbed in the True Word ofHis Shabad.
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavhu kaamn ee sachai sabad  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ  ਸਚੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Let the Fear of God be your decoration, and remain lovingly attuned to the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: bhai kaa sahj seegaar karihu sach rahhu liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ  ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਿਰਹੁ ਸਿਚ ਰਹਹੁ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Naam abides in the mind, and the mortal is saved in the Court of theLord. ||57||
lines.transliteration: naanak naamo man vasai har dargeh la-ay chh adaa-ay. ||57||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੋ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੫੭॥
lines.english: The rainbird wanders all over the earth, soaring high through the skies.
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa saglee Dhart ee jay fireh ood charh eh aakaas.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ  ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ  ਜੇ ਿਫਰਿਹ  ਊਿਡ ਚੜਿਹ  ਆਕਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: But it obtains the drop of water, only when it meets the True Guru, and then, itshunger and thirst are relieved.
lines.transliteration: satgur mili-ai jal paa-ee-ai chookai bh ookh pi-aas.

lines.english: Soul and body and all belong to Him; everything is His.
lines.transliteration: jee-o pind sabh t is kaa sabh  kichh  tis kai paas.

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਉ  ਿਪੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਿਤਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: He knows everything, without being told; unto whom should we offer our prayers?
lines.transliteration: vin boli-aa sabh  kichh  jaand aa kis aagai keechai ard aas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਵਣੁ ਬੋਿਲਆ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਜਾਣਦਾ  ਿਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ  ਕੀਚੈ  ਅਰਦਾਿਸ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the One Lord is prevading and permeating each and every heart; the Wordof the Shabad brings illumination. ||58||
lines.transliteration: naanak ghat gh at ayko varatd aa sabad  karay pargaas. ||58||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਘਿਟ  ਘਿਟ  ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤਦਾ  ਸਬਿਦ  ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸ  ॥੫੮॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the season of spring comes to one who serves the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: naanak tisai basant  hai je sat gur sayv samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਸੈ ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਿਵ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Lord rains His Mercy down upon him, and his mind and body totally blossom forth; the entire world becomes green and rejuvenated. ||59||
lines.transliteration: har vuthaa man t an sabh  parfarh ai sabh  jag haree-aaval ho-ay. ||59||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ  ਹੋਇ ॥੫੯॥
lines.english: The Word of the Shabad brings eternal spring; it rejuvenates the mind and body.
lines.transliteration: sabday sad aa basant  hai jit  tan man hari-aa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੇ  ਸਦਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਤੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, which has created everyone.||60||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesrai jin siri-aa sabh ko-ay. ||60||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਸਿਰਆ  ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੬੦॥
lines.english: O Nanak, it is the spring season, for those Gurmukhs, within whose minds the Lordabides.
lines.transliteration: naanak tinaa basant  hai jinaa gurmukh  vasi-aa man so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਨਾ  ਬਸੰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: When the Lord showers His Mercy, the mind and body blossom forth, and all theworld turns green and lush. ||61||
lines.transliteration: har vuthai man t an parfarh ai sabh  jag hari-aa ho-ay. ||61||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਵੁਠੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ  ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਿਰਆ  ਹੋਇ ॥੬੧॥
lines.english: In the early hours of the morning, whose name should we chant?
lines.transliteration: vadrhai jh aal jh alumbh lai naavrh aa la-ee-ai kis.

lines.english: Chant the Name of the Transcendent Lord, who is All-powerful to create and destroy.||62||
lines.transliteration: naa-o la-ee-ai parmaysrai bhannan  gharhan samrath. ||62||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਉ  ਲਈਐ  ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ  ਭੰਨਣ  ਘੜਣ  ਸਮਰਥੁ  ॥੬੨॥
lines.english: The Persian wheel also cries out, "Too! Too! You! You!", with sweet and sublime sounds.
lines.transliteration: harhat bhee t ooN tooN karahi boleh bh alee baan .

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਹਟ  ਭੀ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿਹ  ਬੋਲਿਹ  ਭਲੀ ਬਾਿਣ  ॥
lines.english: Our Lord and Master is always present; why do you cry out to Him in such a loudvoice?
lines.transliteration: saahib sadaa had oor hai ki-aa uchee karahi pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਿਹਬੁ  ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਿਰ  ਹੈ ਿਕਆ  ਉਚੀ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਪੁਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: I am a sacrifice to that Lord who created the world, and who loves it.
lines.transliteration: jin jagat upaa-ay har rang kee-aa t isai vitahu kurbaan .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਉਪਾਇ  ਹਿਰ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ  ਿਤਸੈ ਿਵਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ  ॥
lines.english: Give up your selfishness, and then you shall meet your Husband Lord. Consider thisTruth.
lines.transliteration: aap chhodeh t aaN saho milai sachaa ayhu veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਆਪੁ  ਛੋਡਿਹ  ਤ ਸਹੁ ਿਮਲੈ ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Speaking in shallow egotism, no one understands the Ways of God.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai fikaa bolnaa bujh  na sakaa kaar.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਿਫਕਾ  ਬੋਲਣਾ ਬੁਿਝ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.english: The forests and fields, and all the three worlds meditate on You, O Lord; this is theway they pass their days and nights forever.
lines.transliteration: van tarin taribhavan tujhai Dhi-aa-id aa an-d in sad aa vihaan .

lines.english: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord. People have grown weary of thinking about it. pMnw 1421
lines.transliteration: bin satgur kinai na paa-i-aa kar kar thakay veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨ ਪਾਇਆ  ਕਿਰ ਕਿਰ ਥਕੇ ਵੀਚਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: But if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then He Himself embellishes us.
lines.transliteration: nadar karahi jay aapn ee taaN aapay laihi savaar.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ  ਤ ਆਪੇ  ਲੈਿਹ ਸਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord; blessed and approved is their coming into the world. ||63||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh jinHee Dh i-aa-i-aa aa-ay say parvaan . ||63||

lines.english: Yoga is not obtained by wearing saffron robes; Yoga is not obtained by wearing dirtyrobes.
lines.transliteration: jog na bhagvee kaprh ee jog na mailay vays.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਗਵੀ  ਕਪੜੀ  ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਿਸ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, Yoga is obtained even while sitting in your own home, by following theTeachings of the True Guru. ||64||
lines.transliteration: naanak ghar baith i-aa jog paa-ee-ai sat gur kai upd ays. ||64||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਘਿਰ ਬੈਿਠਆ  ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਿਸ  ॥੬੪॥
lines.english: You may wander in all four directions, and read the Vedas throughout the four ages.
lines.transliteration: chaaray kundaa jay bhaveh bayd  parheh jug chaar.

lines.punjabi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜੇ ਭਵਿਹ  ਬੇਦ ਪੜਿਹ  ਜੁਗ ਚਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, if you meet with the True Guru, the Lord shall come to dwell within yourmind, and you shall find the door of salvation. ||65||
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa bhaytai har man vasai paavahi mokh  du-aar. ||65||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ  ਭੇਟੈ ਹਿਰ ਮਿਨ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ  ॥੬੫॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master, is prevailing. Theintellectually confused person wanders around lost, misled by his fickle consciousness.
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam vartai kh asam kaa mat  bhavee fireh chal chit .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ  ਖਸਮ  ਕਾ ਮਿਤ ਭਵੀ ਿਫਰਿਹ ਚਲ ਿਚਤ  ॥
lines.english: If you make friends with the self-willed manmukhs, O friend, who can you ask forpeace?
lines.transliteration: manmukh sa-o kar d ostee sukh  ke puchh eh mit .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਸਉ ਕਿਰ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਸੁਖ ਿਕ ਪੁਛਿਹ  ਿਮਤ ॥
lines.english: Make friends with the Gurmukhs, and focus your consciousness on the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sa-o kar d ostee sat gur sa-o laa-ay chit .

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ  ਸਉ ਕਿਰ ਦੋਸਤੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਉ ਲਾਇ  ਿਚਤੁ  ॥
lines.english: The root of birth and death will be cut away, and then, you shall find peace, O friend. ||66||
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  kaa mool katee-ai t aaN sukh  hovee mit . ||66||

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣ  ਮਰਣ  ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ  ਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੀ ਿਮਤ ॥੬੬॥
lines.english: The Lord Himself instructs those who are misguided, when He casts His Glance ofGrace.
lines.transliteration: bhuli-aaN aap samjh aa-isee jaa ka-o nad ar karay.

lines.punjabi: ਭੁਿਲਆਂ  ਆਿਪ  ਸਮਝਾਇਸੀ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who are not blessed by His Glance of Grace, cry and weep and wail.||67|| slok mhlw 4  (1421-8) salok mehlaa 4 Shalok, Fourth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1421-8) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: naanak nadree baahree karan  palaah karay. ||67||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਦਰੀ  ਬਾਹਰੀ  ਕਰਣ  ਪਲਾਹ  ਕਰੇ ॥੬੭॥
lines.english: Blessed and very fortunate are those happy soul-brides who, as Gurmukh, meet theirSovereign Lord King.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee-aa sohaagan ee jinHaa gurmukh  mili-aa har raa-ay.

lines.english: The Light of God shines within them; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam, theName of the Lord. ||1||
lines.transliteration: antar jot  pargaasee-aa naanak naam samaa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who hasrealized the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satgur purakh  hai jin sach jaat aa so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਿਤ ਪਰਗਾਸੀਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਿਮ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Meeting Him, thirst is quenched, and the body and mind are cooled and soothed.
lines.transliteration: jit mili-ai t ikh utrai tan man seet al ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਿਨ  ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, the True Primal Being, who looks upon all alike.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satgur sat  purakh  hai jis no samat  sabh  ko-ay.

lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, who has no hatred; slander andpraise are all the same to Him.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satgur nirvair hai jis nind aa ust at tul ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸ ਨੋ ਸਮਤੁ  ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the All-knowing True Guru, who has realizedGod within.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satgur sujaan  hai jis ant ar barahm veechaar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਨਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਿਨੰਦਾ  ਉਸਤਿਤ  ਤੁਿਲ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the Formless True Guru, who has no end or limitation.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satgur nirankaar hai jis ant  na paaraavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ  ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Guru, who implants the Truth within.
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu satguroo hai je sach drirh -aa-ay so-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਨਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਿਜਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, Blessed and Great is the True Guru, through whom the Naam, the Name ofthe Lord, is received. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur vaahu vaahu jis t ay naam paraapat  ho-ay. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੂ  ਹੈ ਿਜ ਸਚੁ ਿਦਰ੍ੜਾਏ  ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.english: For the Gurmukh, the true Song of Praise is to chant the Name of the Lord God.
lines.transliteration: har parabh sachaa sohilaa gurmukh  naam govind .

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਿਜਸ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Chanting the Praises of the Lord, their minds are in ecstasy.
lines.transliteration: an-din naam salaahn aa har japi-aa man aanand .

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਿਹਲਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਿਵੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: By great good fortune, they find the Lord, the Embodiment of perfect, supreme bliss.
lines.transliteration: vadbhaagee har paa-i-aa pooran parmaanand .

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ  ਹਿਰ ਜਿਪਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਨੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak praises the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no obstacle will block his mind or body. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam sahaali-aa bahurh na man t an bh ang. ||3||

lines.english: I am in love with my Beloved; how can I meet my Dear Friend?
lines.transliteration: mooN piree-aa sa-o nayhu ki-o sajan mileh pi-aari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਿਹਆ  ਬਹੁਿੜ ਨ ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: I seek that friend, who is embellished with Truth.
lines.transliteration: ha-o dhoodh aydee tin sajan  sach savaari-aa.

lines.english: The True Guru is my Friend; if I meet Him, I will offer this mind as a sacrifice to Him.
lines.transliteration: satgur maidaa mit  hai jay milai t a ih man vaari-aa.

lines.english: He has shown me my Beloved Lord, my Friend, the Creator.
lines.transliteration: dayNdaa mooN pir das har sajan  sirjan haari-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਿਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਿਮਲੈ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਿਰਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, I was searching for my Beloved; the True Guru has shown me that He hasbeen with me all the time. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak ha-o pir bhaalee aapn aa sat gur naal d ikhaali-aa. ||4||

lines.english: I stand by the side of the road, waiting for You; O my Friend, I hope that You willcome.
lines.transliteration: ha-o kharh ee nihaalee panDh  mat mooN sajan  aav-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਉ ਿਪਰੁ ਭਾਲੀ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ ਨਾਿਲ  ਿਦਖਾਿਲਆ  ॥੪॥
lines.english: If only someone would come today and unite me in Union with my Beloved. pMnw 1422
lines.transliteration: ko aan milaavai aj mai pir mayl milaava-ay.

lines.english: I would cut my living body into four pieces for anyone who shows me my Beloved.
lines.transliteration: ha-o jee-o karee tis vita-o cha-o kh annee-ai jo mai piree d ikhaava-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਜੀਉ  ਕਰੀ ਿਤਸ ਿਵਟਉ  ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ  ਜੋ ਮੈ ਿਪਰੀ  ਿਦਖਾਵਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then He leads us to meet the Perfect Guru. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak har ho-ay da-i-aal t aaN gur pooraa maylaava-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ  ਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਲਾਵਏ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: The power of egotism prevails within, and the body is controlled by Maya; the falseones come and go in reincarnation.
lines.transliteration: antar jor ha-umai t an maa-i-aa koorh ee aavai jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਜੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਿਨ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: If someone does not obey the Command of the True Guru, he cannot cross over thetreacherous world-ocean.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa furmaa-i-aa man na sakee d utar tari-aa na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ  ਮੰਿਨ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਿਰਆ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Whoever is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, walks in harmony with the Will ofthe True Guru.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay jis aapn ee so chalai sat gur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਦਿਰ  ਕਰੇ ਿਜਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ  ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan is fruitful; through it, one obtains thefruits of his desires.
lines.transliteration: satgur kaa d arsan safal hai jo ichh ai so fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ  ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I touch the feet of those who believe in and obey the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jinee satgur manni-aaN ha-o t in kay laaga-o paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਿਨਆਂ  ਹਉ ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is the slave of those who, night and day, remain lovingly attuned to the Lord.||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak taa kaa d aas hai je an-d in rahai liv laa-ay. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਿਜ ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਇ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: Those who are in love with their Beloved - how can they find satisfaction without His Darshan?
lines.transliteration: jinaa piree pi-aar bin darsan ki-o t aripat -ee-ai.

lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meet Him with ease, and this mind blossoms forth in joy.||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak milay subhaa-ay gurmukh  ih man rehsee-ai. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who are in love with their Beloved - how can they live without Him?
lines.transliteration: jinaa piree pi-aar ki-o jeevan pir baahray.

lines.english: When they see their Husband Lord, O Nanak, they are rejuvenated. ||8||
lines.transliteration: jaaN saho daykh an aapn aa naanak theevan bh ee haray. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖਿਨ  ਆਪਣਾ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਥੀਵਿਨ  ਭੀ ਹਰੇ ॥੮॥
lines.english: Those Gurmukhs who are filled with love for You, my True Beloved,
lines.transliteration: jinaa gurmukh and ar nayhu t ai pareet am sachai laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਨੇਹੁ ਤੈ ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, remain immersed in the Lord's Love, night and day. ||9||
lines.transliteration: raatee at ai dayhu naanak paraym samaa-i-aa. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਤੀ  ਅਤੈ ਡੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: The love of the Gurmukh is true; through it, the True Beloved is attained.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh sachee aaskee jit  pareet am sachaa paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਸਚੀ ਆਸਕੀ  ਿਜਤੁ  ਪਰ੍ੀਤਮੁ  ਸਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, remain in bliss, O Nanak, immersed in intuitive peace and poise. ||10||
lines.transliteration: an-din raheh anand naanak sahj samaa-ee-ai. ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਰਹਿਹ  ਅਨੰਿਦ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਸਮਾਈਐ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: True love and affection are obtained from the Perfect Guru.
lines.transliteration: sachaa paraym pi-aar gur pooray tay paa-ee-ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸਚਾ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਪਆਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ  ॥
lines.english: They never break, O Nanak, if one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||11||
lines.transliteration: kabhoo na hovai bhang naanak har gun  gaa-ee-ai. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ  ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: How can those who have true love within them live without their Husband Lord?
lines.transliteration: jinHaa andar sachaa nayhu ki-o jeevniH piree vihoon i-aa.

lines.english: The Lord unites the Gurmukhs with Himself, O Nanak; they were separated from Him for such a long time. ||12||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh maylay aap naanak chiree vichh unni-aa. ||12||

lines.english: You grant Your Grace to those whom You Yourself bless with love and affection.
lines.transliteration: jin ka-o paraym pi-aar ta-o aapay laa-i-aa karam kar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਪਆਰੁ ਤਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇਆ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਕਿਰ ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please let Nanak meet with You; please bless this beggar with Your Name.||13||
lines.transliteration: naanak layho milaa-ay mai jaachik deejai naam har. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਲੇਹੁ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ਮੈ ਜਾਿਚਕ  ਦੀਜੈ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh laughs, and the Gurmukh cries.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hasai gurmukh  rovai.

lines.english: Whatever the Gurmukh does, is devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: je gurmukh karay saa-ee bh agat hovai.

lines.english: Whoever becomes Gurmukh contemplates the Lord.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hovai so karay veechaar.

lines.english: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, crosses over to the other shore. ||14||
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naanak paavai paar. ||14||

lines.english: Those who have the Naam within, contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani.
lines.transliteration: jinaa andar naam niDh aan hai gurbaan ee veechaar.

lines.english: Their faces are always radiant in the Court of the True Lord.
lines.transliteration: tin kay mukh  sad ujlay t it sachai d arbaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ  ਿਤਤੁ  ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Sitting down and standing up, they never forget the Creator, who forgives them.
lines.transliteration: tin bahd i-aa uth -di-aa kad ay na visrai je aap bakh say kart aar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ ਬਹਿਦਆ  ਉਠਿਦਆ  ਕਦੇ ਨ ਿਵਸਰੈ  ਿਜ ਆਿਪ  ਬਖਸੇ  ਕਰਤਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are united with the Lord. Those united by the Creator Lord, shall never be separated again. ||15||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh milay na vichh urheh je maylay sirjan haar. ||15||

lines.english: To work for the Guru, or a spiritual teacher, is terribly difficult, but it brings the mostexcellent peace.
lines.transliteration: gur peeraaN kee chaakree mahaaN karrhee sukh  saar.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ  ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ  ਮਹ ਕਰੜੀ  ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The Lord casts His Glance of Grace, and inspires love and affection.
lines.transliteration: nadar karay jis aapn ee tis laa-ay hayt  pi-aar.

lines.english: Joined to the service of the True Guru, the mortal being crosses over the terrifyingworld-ocean.
lines.transliteration: satgur kee sayvai lagi-aa bh a-ojal t arai sansaar.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਿਗਆ  ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, with clear contemplation anddiscriminating understanding within.
lines.transliteration: man chindi-aa fal paa-isee ant ar bibayk beechaar.

lines.english: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, God is found; He is the Eradicator of all sorrow.||16||
lines.transliteration: naanak satgur mili-ai parabh  paa-ee-ai sabh  dookh nivaaran haar. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ  ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖ ਿਨਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ੁ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukh may perform service, but his consciousness is attached to the love of duality.
lines.transliteration: manmukh sayvaa jo karay d oojai bh aa-ay chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ  ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Through Maya, his emotional attachment to children, spouse and relatives increases.
lines.transliteration: put kalat  kutamb hai maa-i-aa moh vaDh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ  ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: He shall be called to account in the Court of the Lord, and in the end, no one will be able to save him. pMnw 1423
lines.transliteration: dargahi laykh aa mangee-ai ko-ee ant  na sakee chh adaa-ay.

lines.english: Without the Lord's Name, all is pain. Attachment to Maya is agonizingly painful.
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh d ukh hai d ukh-daa-ee moh maa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ  ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Gurmukh comes to see, that attachment to Maya separates all from the Lord. ||17||
lines.transliteration: naanak gurmukh nad ree aa-i-aa moh maa-i-aa vichh urh sabh  jaa-ay. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ  ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ  ਿਵਛੁਿੜ  ਸਭ ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh obeys the Order of her Husband Lord God; through the Hukam of HisCommand, she finds peace.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh hukam mannay sah kayraa hukmay hee sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਹ ਕੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: In His Will, she serves; in His Will, she worship and adores Him.
lines.transliteration: hukmo sayvay hukam araaDhay hukmay samai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ  ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਮੈ ਸਮਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: In His Will, she merges in absorption. His Will is her fast, vow, purity and self-discipline; through it, she obtains the fruits of her mind's desires.
lines.transliteration: hukam varat naym such sanjam man chind i-aa fal paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੁ  ਨੇਮੁ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਮਨ ਿਚੰਿਦਆ  ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: She is always and forever the happy, pure soul-bride, who realizes His Will; she serves the True Guru, inspired by loving absorption.
lines.transliteration: sadaa suhaagan  je hukmai bujh ai sat gur sayvai liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਿਣ  ਿਜ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, are merged and immersed inHis Will. ||18||
lines.transliteration: naanak kirpaa karay jin oopar tinaa hukmay la-ay milaa-ay. ||18||

lines.english: The wretched, self-willed manmukhs do not realize His Will; they continually act inego.
lines.transliteration: manmukh hukam na bujh ay bapurh ee nit  ha-umai karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੇ ਬਪੁੜੀ  ਿਨਤ ਹਉਮੈ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: By ritualistic fasts, vows, purities, self-disciplines and worship ceremonies, they still cannot get rid of their hypocrisy and doubt.
lines.transliteration: varat naym such sanjam poojaa pakh and bh aram na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਵਰਤ  ਨੇਮੁ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਪੂਜਾ ਪਾਖੰਿਡ  ਭਰਮੁ  ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Inwardly, they are impure, pierced through by attachment to Maya; they are like elephants, who throw dirt all over themselves right after their bath.
lines.transliteration: antrahu kusuDh  maa-i-aa mohi bayDh ay ji-o hast ee chh aar udaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਕੁਸੁਧੁ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਿਹ ਬੇਧੇ ਿਜਉ  ਹਸਤੀ  ਛਾਰੁ ਉਡਾਏ  ॥
lines.english: They do not even think of the One who created them. Without thinking of Him, theycannot find peace.
lines.transliteration: jin upaa-ay tisai na cheet eh bin chayt ay ki-o sukh  paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਨ  ਉਪਾਏ ਿਤਸੈ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਹ  ਿਬਨੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਿਕਉ  ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the Primal Creator has made the drama of the Universe; all act as they arepre-ordained. ||19||
lines.transliteration: naanak parpanch kee-aa Dhur kart ai poorab likh i-aa kamaa-ay. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਪਰਪੰਚੁ  ਕੀਆ  ਧੁਿਰ ਕਰਤੈ  ਪੂਰਿਬ  ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਕਮਾਏ ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The Gurmukh has faith; his mind is contented and satisfied. Night and day, he servesthe Lord, absorbed in Him.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh part eet bha-ee man maani-aa an-d in sayvaa karat  samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਪਰਤੀਿਤ  ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਿਨਆ  ਅਨਿਦਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ  ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, is within; all worship and adore Him. Everyone comes to see the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
lines.transliteration: antar sat gur guroo sabh  poojay sat gur kaa d aras d aykhai sabh  aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਭ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ  ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: So believe in the True Guru, the supreme sublime Contemplator. Meeting with Him,hunger and thirst are completely relieved.
lines.transliteration: mannee-ai satgur param beechaaree jit  mili-ai t isnaa bh ukh sabh  jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੰਨੀਐ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪਰਮ  ਬੀਚਾਰੀ  ਿਜਤੁ ਿਮਿਲਐ  ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who leads me to meet the True Lord God.
lines.transliteration: ha-o sadaa sad aa balihaaree gur apunay jo parabh  sachaa d ay-ay milaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲਹਾਰੀ  ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ  ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, those who come and fall at the Feet of the Guru are blessed with the karmaof Truth. ||20||
lines.transliteration: naanak karam paa-i-aa tin sachaa jo gur charn ee lagay aa-ay. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਰਮੁ  ਪਾਇਆ  ਿਤਨ ਸਚਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ  ਲਗੇ ਆਇ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: That Beloved, with whom I am in love, that Friend of mine is with me.
lines.transliteration: jin piree-aa sa-o nayhu say sajan mai naal.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨ ਿਪਰੀਆ  ਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਸੇ ਸਜਣ  ਮੈ ਨਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: I wander around inside and outside, but I always keep Him enshrined within my heart.||21||
lines.transliteration: antar baahar ha-o firaaN bhee hird ai rakh aa samaal. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਬਾਹਿਰ ਹਉ ਿਫਰ  ਭੀ ਿਹਰਦੈ  ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਿਲ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: Those who meditate on the Lord single-mindedly, with one-pointed concentration, linktheir consciousness to the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: jinaa ik man ik chit Dh i-aa-i-aa sat gur sa-o chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨਾ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਇਕ ਿਚਿਤ  ਿਧਆਇਆ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They are rid of pain, hunger, and the great illness of egotism; lovingly attuned to theLord, they become free of pain.
lines.transliteration: tin kee d ukh bhukh ha-umai vadaa rog ga-i-aa nird okh bha-ay liv laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਨ  ਕੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਹਉਮੈ  ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ  ਿਨਰਦੋਖ  ਭਏ ਿਲਵ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: They sing His Praises, and chant His Praises; in His Glorious Praises, they sleep in absorption.
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi gun  uchrahi gun  meh savai samaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰਿਹ  ਗੁਣ ਮਿਹ ਸਵੈ ਸਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, through the Perfect Guru, they come to meet God with intuitive peace andpoise. ||22||
lines.transliteration: naanak gur pooray tay paa-i-aa sahj mili-aa parabh  aa-ay. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ  ਸਹਿਜ  ਿਮਿਲਆ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਆਇ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: The self-willed manmukhs are emotionally attached to Maya; they are not in love withthe Naam.
lines.transliteration: manmukh maa-i-aa moh hai naam na lagai pi-aar.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਿਮ  ਨ ਲਗੈ ਿਪਆਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They practice falsehood, gather falsehood, and eat the food of falsehood.
lines.transliteration: koorh kamaavai koorh  sangh rai koorh  karai aahaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਕੂੜੁ ਸੰਘਰੈ  ਕੂਿੜ ਕਰੈ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Gathering the poisonous wealth and property of Maya, they die; in the end, they areall reduced to ashes.
lines.transliteration: bikh maa-i-aa Dh an sanch mareh ant  ho-ay sabh  chhaar.

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਧਨੁ ਸੰਿਚ ਮਰਿਹ  ਅੰਿਤ  ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: They perform religious rituals of purity an d self-discipline, but they are filled with greed, evil and corruption.
lines.transliteration: karam Dharam such sanjam karahi ant ar lobh  vikaar.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਮ  ਧਰਮ  ਸੁਿਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ  ਕਰਿਹ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਲੋਭੁ ਿਵਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, the actions of the self-willed manmukhs are not accepted; in the Court ofthe Lord, they are miserable. ||23||
lines.transliteration: naanak manmukh je kamaavai so thaa-ay na pavai d argeh ho-ay kh u-aar. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨਮੁਿਖ  ਿਜ ਕਮਾਵੈ  ਸੁ ਥਾਇ  ਨ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ  ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Among all Ragas, that one is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny, by which the Lord comesto abide in the mind.
lines.transliteration: sabhnaa raagaaN vich so bh alaa bh aa-ee jit  vasi-aa man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭਨਾ  ਰਾਗ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਈ  ਿਜਤੁ ਵਿਸਆ  ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those Ragas which are in the Sound-current of the Naad are totally true; their value cannot be expressed.
lines.transliteration: raag naad sabh  sach hai keemat  kahee na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਾਦੁ  ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਿਤ  ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those Ragas which are not in the Sound-current of the Naad - by these, the Lord'sWill cannot be understood.
lines.transliteration: raagai naadai baahraa inee hukam na boojh i-aa jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਗੈ ਨਾਦੈ  ਬਾਹਰਾ  ਇਨੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਿਝਆ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they alone are right, who understand the Will of the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: naanak hukmai boojhai t inaa raas ho-ay sat gur tay sojh ee paa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਿਤਨਾ  ਰਾਿਸ  ਹੋਇ ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Everything happens as He wills. ||24|| pMnw 1424
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh  tis tay ho-i-aa ji-o t isai dee rajaa-ay. ||24||

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur vich amrit  naam hai amrit  kahai kahaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤੁ  ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, one meditates on the Immaculate Naam, the Pure and Holy Naam.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee naam nirmalo nirmal naam Dh i-aa-ay.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Word of His Bani is the true essence. It comes to abide in the mind ofthe Gurmukh.
lines.transliteration: amrit ban ee tat hai gurmukh  vasai man aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਬਾਣੀ  ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਵਸੈ ਮਿਨ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and one's light merges in the Light.
lines.transliteration: hirdai kamal pargaasi-aa jot ee jot  milaa-ay.

lines.english: 4) naanak satgur t in ka-o mayli-on jin Dh ur mast ak bh aag likh aa-ay. ||25|| O Nanak, they alone meet with the True Guru, who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰੁ ਿਤਨ  ਕਉ ਮੇਿਲਓਨੁ ਿਜਨ ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਭਾਗੁ ਿਲਖਾਇ  ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: Within the self-willed manmukhs is the fire of desire; their hunger does not depart.
lines.transliteration: andar t isnaa ag hai manmukh  bhukh na jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਦਿਰ  ਿਤਸਨਾ  ਅਿਗ  ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ  ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Emotional attachments to relatives are totally false; they remain engrossed infalsehood.
lines.transliteration: moh kutamb sabh koorh  hai koorh  rahi-aa laptaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ  ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਕੂਿੜ ਰਿਹਆ  ਲਪਟਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Night and day, they are troubled by anxiety; bound to anxiety, they depart.
lines.transliteration: an-din chint aa chint vai chint aa baDh aa jaa-ay.

lines.english: Their comings and goings in reincarnation never end; they do their deeds in egotism.
lines.transliteration: jaman maran  na chuk-ee ha-umai karam kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੰਮਣੁ  ਮਰਣੁ  ਨ ਚੁਕਈ  ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: But in the Guru's Sanctuary, they are saved, O Nanak, and set free. ||26||
lines.transliteration: gur sarnaa-ee ubrai naanak la-ay chh adaa-ay. ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ  ਉਬਰੈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: The True Guru meditates on the Lord, the Primal Being. The Sat Sangat, the TrueCongregation, loves the True Guru.
lines.transliteration: satgur purakh  har Dh i-aa-id aa sat sangat  satgur bh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਹਿਰ ਿਧਆਇਦਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਭਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Those who join the Sat Sangat, and serve the True Guru - the Guru unites them in theLord's Union.
lines.transliteration: satsangat  satgur sayvd ay har maylay gur maylaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਤਸੰਗਿਤ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸੇਵਦੇ  ਹਿਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: This world, this universe, is a terrifying ocean. On the Boat of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Guru carries us across.
lines.transliteration: ayhu bha-ojal jagat  sansaar hai gur bohith naam t araa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ  ਜਗਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਿਹਥੁ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਤਰਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Sikhs of the Guru accept and obey the Lord's Will; the Perfect Guru carries them across.
lines.transliteration: gursikhee bh aanaa mani-aa gur pooraa paar langh aa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖੀ  ਭਾਣਾ  ਮੰਿਨਆ  ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਿਰ  ਲੰਘਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Lord, please bless me with the dust of the feet of the Guru's Sikhs. I am a sinner -please save me.
lines.transliteration: gursikhaaN kee har Dh oorh deh ham paapee bh ee gat  paaNhi.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖ  ਕੀ ਹਿਰ ਧੂਿੜ ਦੇਿਹ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ  ਭੀ ਗਿਤ  ਪਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: Dhur mast ak har parabh  likhi-aa gur naanak mili-aa aa-ay. Those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads by the LordGod, come to meet Guru Nanak.

lines.punjabi: ਧੁਿਰ ਮਸਤਿਕ  ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਮਿਲਆ ਆਇ  ॥
lines.english: The Messenger of Death is beaten and driven away; we are saved in the Court of theLord.
lines.transliteration: jamkankar maar bidaari-an har d argeh la-ay chh adaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਿਬਦਾਿਰਅਨ ੁ ਹਿਰ ਦਰਗਹ  ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Blessed and celebrated are the Sikhs of the Guru; in His Pleasure, the Lord unitesthem in His Union. ||27||
lines.transliteration: gursikhaa no saabaas hai har t uthaa mayl milaa-ay. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਿਸਖਾ  ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਿਸ  ਹੈ ਹਿਰ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਿਲ ਿਮਲਾਇ  ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me; it has dispelled mydoubts from within.
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam dirh aa-i-aa jin vichahu bh aram chukaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਿਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦੜਾਇਆ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਚੁਕਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Singing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord's Name, the Lord's path is illuminated andshown to His Sikhs.
lines.transliteration: raam naam har keerat gaa-ay kar chaanan  mag d aykhaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰ ਕੀਰਿਤ  ਗਾਇ  ਕਿਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ  ਮਗੁ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Conquering my egotism, I remain lovingly attuned to the One Lord; the Naam, theName of the Lord, dwells within me.
lines.transliteration: ha-umai maar ayk liv laagee antar naam vasaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਹਉਮੈ  ਮਾਿਰ  ਏਕ ਿਲਵ ਲਾਗੀ  ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: I follow the Guru's Teachings, and so the Messenger of Death cannot even see me; I am immersed in the True Name.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee jam johi na sakai sachai naa-ay samaa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ  ਜਮੁ ਜੋਿਹ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ  ਸਮਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: The Creator Himself is All-pervading; as He pleases, He links us to His Name.
lines.transliteration: sabh aapay aap vart ai kart aa jo bh aavai so naa-ay laa-i-aa.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ  ਆਿਪ  ਵਰਤੈ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਇਆ  ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak lives, chanting the Name. Without the Name, he dies in an instant.||28||
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naa-o la-ay taaN jeevai bin naavai kh in mar jaa-i-aa. ||28||

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ  ਨਾਉ  ਲਏ ਤ ਜੀਵੈ ਿਬਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਿਖਨੁ ਮਿਰ ਜਾਇਆ  ॥੨੮॥
lines.english: Within the minds of the faithless cynics is the disease of egotism; these evil peoplewander around lost, deluded by doubt.
lines.transliteration: man antar ha-umai rog bh aram bh oolay ha-umai saakat  durjanaa.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿਰ  ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਭਰ੍ਿਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ  ਸਾਕਤ  ਦੁਰਜਨਾ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, this disease is eradicated only by meeting with the True Guru, the HolyFriend. ||29||
lines.transliteration: naanak rog gavaa-ay mil satgur saaDh oo sajn aa. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ  ਿਮਿਲ  ਸਿਤਗੁਰ  ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਣਾ  ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: Following the Guru's Teachings, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
lines.transliteration: gurmatee har har bolay.

lines.english: Attracted by the Lord's Love, day and night, the body-robe is imbued with the Lord'sLove.
lines.transliteration: har paraym kasaa-ee dinas raat  har rat ee har rang cholay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਪਰ੍ੇਿਮ ਕਸਾਈ  ਿਦਨਸੁ  ਰਾਿਤ  ਹਿਰ ਰਤੀ ਹਿਰ ਰੰਿਗ ਚੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: I have not found any being like the Lord, although I have searched and looked all overthe world.
lines.transliteration: har jaisaa purakh na labh -ee sabh  daykhi-aa jagat  mai tolay.

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜੈਸਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ  ਨ ਲਭਈ  ਸਭੁ ਦੇਿਖਆ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਮੈ ਟੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within; now, my mind does not waver or wander anywhere else.
lines.transliteration: gur satgur naam d irhaa-i-aa man anat  na kaahoo dolay.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਤਗੁਿਰ  ਨਾਮੁ ਿਦੜਾਇਆ  ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ  ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
lines.english: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord, the slave of the slaves of the Guru, the TrueGuru. ||30|| pMnw 1425 slok mhlw 5  (1425-1) salok mehlaa 5 Shalok, Fifth Mehl: <> siqgur pRswid ] (1425-1) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai gur sat gur kay gul golay. ||30||

lines.english: They alone are imbued with the Lord, who do not turn their faces away from Him -they realize Him.
lines.transliteration: ratay say-ee je mukh  na morh aNniH jinHee sinj aataa saa-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਿਜ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੰਿਨ  ਿਜਨੀ  ਿਸਞਾਤਾ  ਸਾਈ  ॥
lines.english: The false, immature lovers do not know the way of love, and so they fall. ||1||
lines.transliteration: jharh jharh pavd ay kachay birhee jinHaa kaar na aa-ee. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਝਿੜ ਝਿੜ ਪਵਦੇ  ਕਚੇ ਿਬਰਹੀ  ਿਜਨਾ  ਕਾਿਰ  ਨ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Dhanee vihoon aa paat patambar bh aahee sayt ee jaalay. Without my Master, I will burn my silk and satin clothes in the fire.

lines.punjabi: ਧਣੀ ਿਵਹੂਣਾ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ  ਭਾਹੀ  ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲੇ  ॥
lines.english: Dhoorh ee vich ludand -rhee sohaaN naanak t ai sah naalay. ||2|| Even rolling in the dust, I look beautiful, O Nanak, if my Husband Lord is with me.||2||

lines.punjabi: ਧੂੜੀ ਿਵਿਚ  ਲੁਡੰਦੜੀ  ਸੋਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
lines.english: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I worship and adore the Naam, with love and balanced detachment.
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad araaDh ee-ai naam rang bairaag.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਿਦ  ਅਰਾਧੀਐ  ਨਾਿਮ  ਰੰਿਗ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ  ॥
lines.english: When the five enemies are overcome, O Nanak, this musical measure of Raga Maaroobecomes frtuiful. ||3||
lines.transliteration: jeetay panch bairaa-ee-aa naanak safal maaroo ih raag. ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਜੀਤੇ  ਪੰਚ ਬੈਰਾਈਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਫਲ  ਮਾਰੂ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਗੁ ॥੩॥
lines.english: When I have the One Lord, I have tens of thousands. Otherwise, people like me begfrom door to door.
lines.transliteration: jaaN mooN ik ta lakh  ta-o jit ee pinn ay dar kit-rhay.

lines.punjabi: ਜ ਮੂੰ ਇਕੁ ਤ ਲਖ ਤਉ ਿਜਤੀ  ਿਪਨਣੇ  ਦਿਰ ਿਕਤੜੇ  ॥
lines.english: O Brahmin, your life has passed away uselessly; you have forgotten the One whocreated you. ||4||
lines.transliteration: baaman birthaa ga-i-o jannam jin keet o so visray. ||4||

lines.english: In Raga Sorat'h, drink in this sublime essence, which never loses its taste.
lines.transliteration: sorath so ras peejee-ai kabhoo na feekaa ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੋਰਿਠ  ਸੋ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੀਐ  ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਫੀਕਾ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, one's reputation isimmaculate in the Court of the Lord. ||5||
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam gun gaa-ee-ah dargeh nirmal so-ay. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਿਹ  ਦਰਗਹ ਿਨਰਮਲ  ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.english: No one can kill those whom God Himself protects.
lines.transliteration: jo parabh rakh ay aap t in ko-ay na maar-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਿਭ ਰਖੇ ਆਿਪ  ਿਤਨ  ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰਈ  ॥
lines.english: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them. They cherish HisGlorious Virtues forever.
lines.transliteration: andar naam niDh aan sad aa gun  saar-ee.

lines.english: They take the Support of the One, the Inaccessible Lord; they enshrine God in their mind and body.
lines.transliteration: aykaa tayk agamm man tan parabh  Dhaar-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਅਗੰਮ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ  ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਧਾਰਈ  ॥
lines.english: They are imbued with the Love of the Infinite Lord, and no one can wipe it away.
lines.transliteration: lagaa rang apaar ko na utaara-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਲਗਾ  ਰੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਉਤਾਰਈ  ॥
lines.english: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they obtain the most excellentcelestial peace and poise.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh har gun  gaa-ay sahj sukh  saar-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਹਿਜ  ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰਈ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, they enshrine the treasure of the Naam in their hearts. ||6||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam niDhaan rid ai ur haar-ee. ||6||

lines.english: Whatever God does, accept that as good; leave behind all other judgements.
lines.transliteration: karay so changa maan duyee gan at laahi.

lines.punjabi: ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਚੰਗਾ  ਮਾਿਨ  ਦੁਯੀ  ਗਣਤ ਲਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: He shall cast His Glance of Grace, and attach you to Himself.
lines.transliteration: apnee nad ar nihaal aapay laihu laa-ay.

lines.english: Instruct yourself with the Teachings, and doubt will depart from within.
lines.transliteration: jan dayh mat ee upd ays vichahu bh aram jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ  ਿਵਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Everyone does that which is pre-ordained by destiny.
lines.transliteration: jo Dhur likh i-aa laykh  so-ee sabh  kamaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਧੁਿਰ ਿਲਿਖਆ  ਲੇਖੁ ਸੋਈ ਸਭ ਕਮਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Everything is under His control; there is no other place at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh kachh  tis dai vas d oojee naahi jaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਿਤਸ ਦੈ ਵਿਸ ਦੂਜੀ  ਨਾਿਹ  ਜਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: Nanak is in peace and bliss, accepting the Will of God. ||7||
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh anad  bha-ay parabh  kee man rajaa-ay. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ  ਭਏ ਪਰ੍ਭ ਕੀ ਮੰਿਨ ਰਜਾਇ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: Those who meditate in remembrance on the Perfect Guru, are exalted and uplifted.
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa jin simri-aa say-ee bha-ay nihaal.

lines.english: O Nanak, dwelling on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all affairs are resolved. ||8||
lines.transliteration: naanak naam araaDhan aa kaaraj aavai raas. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ  ਆਵੈ  ਰਾਿਸ  ॥੮॥
lines.english: The sinners act, and generate bad karma, and then they weep and wail.
lines.transliteration: paapee karam kamaavday kard ay haa-ay haa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਪਾਪੀ  ਕਰਮ  ਕਮਾਵਦੇ  ਕਰਦੇ  ਹਾਏ ਹਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, just as the churning stick churns the butter, so does the Righteous Judge of Dharma churn them. ||9||
lines.transliteration: naanak ji-o mathan maaDhaan ee-aa t i-o mathay Dh aram raa-ay. ||9||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਜਉ ਮਥਿਨ  ਮਾਧਾਣੀਆ  ਿਤਉ ਮਥੇ ਧਰ੍ਮ ਰਾਇ  ॥੯॥
lines.english: Meditating on the Naam, O friend, the treasure of life is won.
lines.transliteration: naam Dhi-aa-in saajnaa janam pad aarath jeet .

lines.english: O Nanak, speaking in Righteousness, one's world becomes sanctified. ||10||
lines.transliteration: naanak Dharam aisay chaveh keet o bhavan puneet . ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਧਰਮ  ਐਸੇ ਚਵਿਹ  ਕੀਤੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਪੁਨੀਤ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: I am stuck in an evil place, trusting the sweet words of an evil advisor.
lines.transliteration: khubh -rhee kuthaa-ay mith ee galan  kumant aree-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone are saved, who have such good destiny inscribed upon theirforeheads. ||11||
lines.transliteration: naanak say-ee ubray jinaa bhaag mathaahi. ||11||

lines.english: They alone sleep and dream in peace, who are imbued with the Love of their Husband Lord.
lines.transliteration: sut-rh ay sukh ee savaNniH jo rat ay sah aapn ai.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਤੜੇ  ਸੁਖੀ ਸਵੰਿਨ  ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਹ ਆਪਣੈ  ॥
lines.english: Those who have been separated from the Love of their Master, scream and crytwenty-four hours a day. ||12||
lines.transliteration: paraym vichhohaa Dh anee sa-o ath ay pahar lavaNniH. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਿਵਛੋਹਾ  ਧਣੀ ਸਉ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ  ਲਵੰਿਨ ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: Millions are asleep, in the false illusion of Maya.
lines.transliteration: sut-rh ay asaNkh maa-i-aa jh oothee kaarn ay.

lines.english: O Nanak, they alone are awake and aware, who chant the Naam with their tongues.||13||
lines.transliteration: naanak say jaagaNniH je rasnaa naam uchaarnay. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੇ ਜਾਗੰਿਨ  ਿਜ ਰਸਨਾ  ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰਣੇ  ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: Seeing the mirage, the optical illusion, the people are confused and deluded.
lines.transliteration: marig tisnaa paykh  bhulnay vuth ay nagar ganDh arab.

lines.english: Those who worship and adore the True Lord, O Nanak, their minds and bodies arebeautiful. ||14||
lines.transliteration: jinee sach araaDhi-aa naanak man t an fab. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਨੀ  ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਿਧਆ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਿਨ ਤਿਨ ਫਬ ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: The All-powerful Supreme Lord God, the Infinite Primal Being, is the Saving Grace of sinners. pMnw 1426
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran  paarbarahm samrath purakh  apaar.

lines.english: Those whom He saves, meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||15||
lines.transliteration: jisahi uDhaaray naankaa so simray sirjan haar. ||15||

lines.english: Forsake duality and the ways of evil; focus your consciousness on the One Lord.
lines.transliteration: doojee chh od kuvaatarh ee ikas sa-o chit  laa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੀ  ਛੋਿਡ ਕੁਵਾਟੜੀ  ਇਕਸ  ਸਉ ਿਚਤੁ  ਲਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: In the love of duality, O Nanak, the mortals are being washed downstream. ||16||
lines.transliteration: doojai bh aaveeN naankaa vahan  lurhHaNdarhee jaa-ay. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਵਹਿਣ  ਲੁੜੰਦੜੀ  ਜਾਇ  ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: In the markets and bazaars of the three qualities, the merchants make their deals.
lines.transliteration: tihtarhay baajaar sa-ud aa karan van jaari-aa.

lines.english: Those who load the true merchandise are the true traders. ||17||
lines.transliteration: sach vakhar jinee lad i-aa say sachrh ay paasaar. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਿਜਨੀ  ਲਿਦਆ  ਸੇ ਸਚੜੇ  ਪਾਸਾਰ  ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: Those who do not know the way of love are foolish; they wander lost and confused.
lines.transliteration: panthaa paraym na jaan-ee bh oolee firai gavaar.

lines.punjabi: ਪੰਥਾ ਪਰ੍ੇਮ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭੂਲੀ ਿਫਰੈ ਗਵਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, forgetting the Lord, they fall into the deep, dark pit of hell. ||18||
lines.transliteration: naanak har bisraa-ay kai pa-uday narak anDh -yaar. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਿਬਸਰਾਇ  ਕੈ ਪਉਦੇ  ਨਰਿਕ  ਅੰਧਯ੍ਯ੍ਾਰ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: In his mind, the mortal does not forget Maya; he begs for more and more wealth.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa manhu na veesrai maaNgai dammaaN damm.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਗੈ  ਦੰਮ ਦੰਮ ॥
lines.english: That God does not even come into his consciousness; O Nanak, it is not in his karma. ||19||
lines.transliteration: so parabh chit  na aavee naanak nahee karamm. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਸੋ ਪਰ੍ਭੁ ਿਚਿਤ  ਨ ਆਵਈ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਹੀ ਕਰੰਿਮ  ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: The mortal does not run out of capital, as long as the Lord Himself is merciful.
lines.transliteration: tichar mool na thurh eeNdo jichar aap kirpaal.

lines.english: The Word of the Shabad is Guru Nanak's inexhaustible treasure; this wealth and capital never runs out, no matter how much it is spent and consumed. ||20||
lines.transliteration: sabad akh ut baabaa naankaa kh aahi kh arach Dh an maal. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਸਬਦੁ  ਅਖੁਟੁ ਬਾਬਾ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਖਾਿਹ  ਖਰਿਚ  ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ  ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: If I could find wings for sale, I would buy them with an equal weight of my flesh.
lines.transliteration: khanbh  vikaaNd-rhay jay lahaaN ghinnaa saavee t ol.

lines.english: I would attach them to my body, and seek out and find my Friend. ||21||
lines.transliteration: tann jarh aaN-ee aapn ai lahaaN so sajan  tol. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਤੰਿਨ  ਜੜਈ  ਆਪਣੈ  ਲਹ ਸੁ ਸਜਣੁ  ਟੋਿਲ  ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: My Friend is the True Supreme King, the King over the heads of kings.
lines.transliteration: sajan sachaa paat isaahu sir saahaaN dai saahu.

lines.punjabi: ਸਜਣੁ  ਸਚਾ ਪਾਿਤਸਾਹੁ ਿਸਿਰ  ਸਾਹ  ਦੈ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.english: Sitting by His side, we are exalted and beautified; He is the Support of all. ||22|| <> siqgur pRswid ] (1426-9) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad . One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: slok mhlw 9 ] (1426-10) salok mehlaa 9. Shalok, Ninth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jis paas bahithi-aa sohee-ai sabh naaN daa vaysaahu. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਸੁ ਪਾਿਸ  ਬਿਹਿਠਆ  ਸੋਹੀਐ  ਸਭਨ  ਦਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: If you do not sing the Praises of the Lord, your life is rendered useless.
lines.transliteration: gun gobind gaa-i-o nahee janam akaarath keen.

lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord; immerse your mind in Him, like the fishin the water. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har bhaj manaa jih biDh  jal ka-o meen. ||1||

lines.english: Why are you engrossed in sin and corruption? You are not detached, even for a moment!
lines.transliteration: bikhi-an si-o kaahay rachi-o nimakh  na hohi ud aas.

lines.punjabi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਗਾਇਓ  ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮੁ  ਅਕਾਰਥ  ਕੀਨੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, and you shall not be caught in thenoose of death. ||2||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhaj har manaa parai na jam kee faas. ||2||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਿਜਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਜਲ ਕਉ ਮੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.english: Your youth has passed away like this, and old age has overtaken your body.
lines.transliteration: tarnaapo i-o hee ga-i-o lee-o jaraa t an jeet .

lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord; your life is fleeting away! ||3||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bhaj har manaa a-oDh  jaat hai beet . ||3||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਜੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਨਾ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥੨॥
lines.english: You have become old, and you do not understand that death is overtaking you.
lines.transliteration: biraDh bh a-i-o soojh ai nahee kaal pahoochi-o aan.

lines.punjabi: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ  ਇਉ ਹੀ ਗਇਓ  ਲੀਓ  ਜਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਿਤ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, you are insane! Why do you not remember and meditate on God? ||4||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak nar baavray ki-o na bhajai bh agvaan. ||4||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਜੁ ਹਿਰ ਮਨਾ ਅਉਧ  ਜਾਤੁ  ਹੈ ਬੀਿਤ  ॥੩॥
lines.english: Dhan d aaraa sampat  sagal jin apunee kar maan. Your wealth, spouse, and all the possessions which you claim as your own

lines.punjabi: ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਭਇਓ  ਸੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਲੁ  ਪਹੂਿਚਓ ਆਿਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: in mai kachh sangee nahee naanak saachee jaan. ||5|| - none of these shall go along with you in the end. O Nanak, know this as true. ||5||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਰ ਬਾਵਰੇ  ਿਕਉ  ਨ ਭਜੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
lines.english: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Master of the masterless.
lines.transliteration: patit uDhaaran bh ai haran har anaath kay naath.

lines.punjabi: ਧਨੁ ਦਾਰਾ  ਸੰਪਿਤ  ਸਗਲ  ਿਜਿਨ  ਅਪੁਨੀ  ਕਿਰ ਮਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, realize and know Him, who is always with you. ||6||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tih jaanee-ai sad aa basat  tum saath. ||6||

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗੀ  ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ  ਜਾਿਨ  ॥੫॥
lines.english: He has given you your body and wealth, but you are not in love with Him.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an jih t o ka-o d ee-o t aaN si-o nayhu na keen.

lines.punjabi: ਪਿਤਤ  ਉਧਾਰਨ  ਭੈ ਹਰਨ  ਹਿਰ ਅਨਾਥ  ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, you are insane! Why do you now shake and tremble so helplessly? ||7||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak nar baavray ab ki-o dolat d een. ||7||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਹ ਜਾਨੀਐ  ਸਦਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਿਥ  ॥੬॥
lines.english: He has given you your body, wealth, property, peace and beautiful mansions.
lines.transliteration: tan Dh an sampai sukh  dee-o ar jih neekay Dh aam.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਿਜਹ ਤੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ  ਤ ਿਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਨ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: why don't you remember the Lord in meditation? ||8||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa simrat kaahi na raam. ||8||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਨਰ ਬਾਵਰੇ  ਅਬ ਿਕਉ ਡੋਲਤ  ਦੀਨ  ॥੭॥
lines.english: The Lord is the Giver of all peace and comfort. There is no other at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh  daataa raam hai d oosar naahin ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਓ  ਅਰੁ ਿਜਹ ਨੀਕੇ  ਧਾਮ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: meditating in remembrance on Him, salvation is attained. ||9|| pMnw 1427
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa tih simrat  gat ho-ay. ||9||

lines.english: Remembering Him in meditation, salvation is attained; vibrate and meditate on Him, O my friend.
lines.transliteration: jih simrat gat  paa-ee-ai t ih bhaj ray t ai meet .

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਿਸਮਰਤ  ਗਿਤ  ਪਾਈਐ  ਿਤਹ ਭਜੁ ਰੇ ਤੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: your life is passing away! ||10||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa a-oDh gh atat hai neet . ||10||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਅਉਧ  ਘਟਤ  ਹੈ ਨੀਤ  ॥੧੦॥
lines.english: Your body is made up of the five elements; you are clever and wise - know this well.
lines.transliteration: paaNch tat  ko tan rachi-o jaanhu chat ur sujaan.

lines.punjabi: ਪਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਤਨੁ ਰਿਚਓ  ਜਾਨਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ  ਸੁਜਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Believe it - you shall merge once again into the One, O Nanak, from whom you originated. ||11||
lines.transliteration: jih tay upji-o naankaa leen t aahi mai maan. ||11||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਿਜਓ  ਨਾਨਕਾ  ਲੀਨ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਮੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੧॥
lines.english: The Dear Lord abides in each and every heart; the Saints proclaim this as true.
lines.transliteration: ghat gh at mai har joo basai sant an kahi-o pukaar.

lines.punjabi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਜੂ ਬਸੈ ਸੰਤਨ  ਕਿਹਓ  ਪੁਕਾਿਰ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate and vibrate upon Him, and you shall cross over the terrifyingworld-ocean. ||12||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak tih bh aj manaa bh a-o niDh  utreh paar. ||12||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਹ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਭਉ ਿਨਿਧ  ਉਤਰਿਹ ਪਾਿਰ  ॥੧੨॥
lines.english: One who is not touched by pleasure or pain, greed, emotional attachment andegotistical pride
lines.transliteration: sukh d ukh jih parsai nahee lobh  moh abh imaan.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਿਜਹ ਪਰਸੈ  ਨਹੀ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਿਭਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa so moorat bh agvaan. ||13|| - says Nanak, listen, mind: he is the very image of God. ||13||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਿਤ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧੩॥
lines.english: One who is beyond praise and slander, who looks upon gold and iron alike
lines.transliteration: ustat nindi-aa naahi jihi kanchan loh samaan.
kaho naanak sun ray manaa mukat t aahi t ai jaan. ||14|| - says Nanak, listen, mind: know that such a person is liberated. ||14||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਨ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਤੈ ਜਾਿਨ  ॥੧੪॥
lines.english: One who is not affected by pleasure or pain, who looks upon friend and enemy alike
lines.transliteration: harakh sog jaa kai nahee bairee meet  samaan.

lines.punjabi: ਹਰਖੁ  ਸੋਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa mukat t aahi t ai jaan. ||15|| - says Nanak, listen, mind: know that such a person is liberated. ||15||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਨ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਤੈ ਜਾਿਨ ॥੧੫॥
