lines.english: One who does not frighten anyone, and who is not afraid of anyone else
lines.transliteration: bhai kaahoo ka-o d ayt neh neh bh ai maanat  aan.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਦੇਤ ਨਿਹ ਨਿਹ ਭੈ ਮਾਨਤ  ਆਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa gi-aanee taahi bakh aan. ||16|| - says Nanak, listen, mind: call him spiritually wise. ||16||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਨ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਿਗਆਨੀ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਬਖਾਿਨ ॥੧੬॥
lines.english: One who has forsaken all sin and corruption, who wears the robes of neutral detachment
lines.transliteration: jihi bikhi-aa saglee t ajee lee-o bh aykh bairaag.
kaho naanak sun ray manaa tih nar maathai bh aag. ||17|| - says Nanak, listen, mind: good destiny is written on his forehead. ||17||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਿਤਹ ਨਰ ਮਾਥੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧੭॥
lines.english: One who renounces Maya and possessiveness and is detached from everything
lines.transliteration: jihi maa-i-aa mamtaa t ajee sabh  tay bh a-i-o ud aas.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਹ  ਮਾਇਆ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਤਜੀ  ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ  ਉਦਾਸੁ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa tih gh at barahm nivaas. ||18|| - says Nanak, listen, mind: God abides in his heart. ||18||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਿਤਹ ਘਿਟ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ ਿਨਵਾਸੁ  ॥੧੮॥
lines.english: That mortal, who forsakes egotism, and realizes the Creator Lord
lines.transliteration: jihi paraanee ha-umai tajee kart aa raam pachh aan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਹਉਮੈ  ਤਜੀ  ਕਰਤਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak vahu mukat nar ih man saachee maan. ||19|| - says Nanak, that person is liberated; O mind, know this as true. ||19||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਿਤ  ਨਰੁ ਇਹ ਮਨ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੯॥
lines.english: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the Lord is the Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of evil-mindedness.
lines.transliteration: bhai naasan d urmat  haran kal mai har ko naam.

lines.punjabi: ਭੈ ਨਾਸਨ  ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਹਰਨ  ਕਿਲ  ਮੈ ਹਿਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Night and day, O Nanak, whoever vibrates and meditates on the Lord's Name, sees allof his works brought to fruition. ||20||
lines.transliteration: nis din jo naanak bh ajai safal hohi t ih kaam. ||20||

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਿਸ  ਿਦਨੁ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ  ਭਜੈ ਸਫਲ  ਹੋਿਹ ਿਤਹ ਕਾਮ ॥੨੦॥
lines.english: Vibrate with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe; with yourears, hear the Lord's Name.
lines.transliteration: jihbaa gun gobind bh ajahu karan sunhu har naam.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹਬਾ  ਗੁਨ ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਭਜਹੁ ਕਰਨ  ਸੁਨਹੁ ਹਿਰ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, man: you shall not have to go to the house of Death. ||21||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa pareh na jam kai Dhaam. ||21||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਨ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਪਰਿਹ  ਨ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਧਾਮ ॥੨੧॥
lines.english: That mortal who renounces possessiveness, greed, emotional attachment and egotism
lines.transliteration: jo paraanee mamtaa t ajai lobh  moh ahaNkaar.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਮਮਤਾ  ਤਜੈ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak aapan tarai a-uran layt  uDhaar. ||22|| - says Nanak, he himself is saved, and he saves many others as well. ||22||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਆਪਨ  ਤਰੈ ਅਉਰਨ  ਲੇਤ ਉਧਾਰ  ॥੨੨॥
lines.english: Like a dream and a show, so is this world, you must know.
lines.transliteration: ji-o supnaa ar paykhnaa aisay jag ka-o jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ  ਅਰੁ ਪੇਖਨਾ  ਐਸੇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਜਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: None of this is true, O Nanak, without God. ||23||
lines.transliteration: in mai kachh saacho nahee naanak bin bh agvaan. ||23||

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ॥੨੩॥
lines.english: Night and day, for the sake of Maya, the mortal wanders constantly.
lines.transliteration: nis din maa-i-aa kaarnay paraanee dolat  neet.

lines.english: Among millions, O Nanak, there is scarcely anyone, who keeps the Lord in his consciousness. ||24||
lines.transliteration: kotan mai naanak ko-oo naaraa-in jih cheet. ||24||

lines.punjabi: ਕੋਟਨ  ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕੋਊ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਿਜਹ ਚੀਿਤ  ॥੨੪॥
lines.english: As the bubbles in the water well up and disappear again,
lines.transliteration: jaisay jal tay bud budaa upjai binsai neet .

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ  ਉਪਜੈ  ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਨੀਤ  ॥
lines.transliteration: jag rachnaa taisay rachee kaho naanak sun meet . ||25|| so is the universe created; says Nanak, listen, O my friend! ||25||

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ  ਤੈਸੇ ਰਚੀ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਨ ਮੀਤ ॥੨੫॥
lines.english: The mortal does not remember the Lord, even for a moment; he is blinded by thewine of Maya.
lines.transliteration: paraanee kachhoo na chayt -ee mad  maa-i-aa kai anDh .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ  ਮਿਦ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, he is caught by the noose of Death.||26||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bin har bhajan parat  taahi jam fanDh . ||26||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨ  ਪਰਤ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ॥੨੬॥
lines.english: If you yearn for eternal peace, then seek the Sanctuary of the Lord.
lines.transliteration: ja-o sukh ka-o chaahai sad aa saran raam kee layh.

lines.punjabi: ਜਉ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਚਾਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਿਨ  ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਲੇਹ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: this human body is difficult to obtain. ||27||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa durlabh  maanukh  dayh. ||27||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਨ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਦੁਰਲਭ  ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ॥੨੭॥
lines.english: For the sake of Maya, the fools and ignorant people run all around.
lines.transliteration: maa-i-aa kaaran Dhaavhee moorakh  log ajaan.

lines.punjabi: ਮਾਇਆ  ਕਾਰਿਨ ਧਾਵਹੀ  ਮੂਰਖ ਲੋਗ ਅਜਾਨ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, life passes away uselessly. ||28||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bin har bhajan birthaa janam siraan. ||28||

lines.english: That mortal who meditates and vibrates upon the Lord night and day - know him to be the embodiment of the Lord. pMnw 1428
lines.transliteration: jo paraanee nis din bh ajai roop raam t ih jaan.

lines.english: There is no difference between the Lord and the humble servant of the Lord; O Nanak, know this as true. ||29||
lines.transliteration: har jan har antar nahee naanak saachee maan. ||29||

lines.punjabi: ਹਿਰ ਜਨ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨੯॥
lines.english: The mortal is entangled in Maya; he has forgotten the Name of the Lord of theUniverse.
lines.transliteration: man maa-i-aa mai faDh rahi-o bisri-o gobind  naam.

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੈ ਫਿਧ ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਬਸਿਰਓ  ਗੋਿਬੰਦ  ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, what is the use of this human life? ||30||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak bin har bhajan jeevan ka-unay kaam. ||30||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਬਨੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨ  ਜੀਵਨ  ਕਉਨੇ  ਕਾਮ ॥੩੦॥
lines.english: The mortal does not think of the Lord; he is blinded by the wine of Maya.
lines.transliteration: paraanee raam na chayt-ee mad  maa-i-aa kai anDh .

lines.punjabi: ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ  ਮਿਦ ਮਾਇਆ  ਕੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, he is caught in the noose of Death.||31||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har bhajan bin parat  taahi jam fanDh . ||31||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰ  ਭਜਨ  ਿਬਨੁ ਪਰਤ  ਤਾਿਹ  ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ॥੩੧॥
lines.english: In good times, there are many companions around, but in bad times, there is no oneat all.
lines.transliteration: sukh mai baho sangee bh a-ay d ukh mai sang na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਗੀ  ਭਏ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਿਗ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord; He shall be your only Help andSupport in the end. ||32||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har bhaj manaa ant  sahaa-ee ho-ay. ||32||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਅੰਿਤ  ਸਹਾਈ  ਹੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
lines.english: Mortals wander lost and confused through countless lifetimes; their fear of death is never removed.
lines.transliteration: janam janam bharmat  firi-o miti-o na jam ko t araas.

lines.punjabi: ਜਨਮ  ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ  ਿਫਿਰਓ  ਿਮਿਟਓ  ਨ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤਰ੍ਾਸੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, vibrate and meditate on the Lord, and you shall dwell in the FearlessLord. ||33||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har bhaj manaa nirbh ai paavahi baas. ||33||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜੁ ਮਨਾ ਿਨਰਭੈ  ਪਾਵਿਹ  ਬਾਸੁ ॥੩੩॥
lines.english: I have tried so many things, but the pride of my mind has not been dispelled.
lines.transliteration: jatan bahut  mai kar rahi-o miti-o na man ko maan.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤਨ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੈ ਕਿਰ ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਮਿਟਓ  ਨ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: I am engrossed in evil-mindedness, Nanak. O God, please save me! ||34||
lines.transliteration: durmat  si-o naanak faDh i-o raakh  layho bh agvaan. ||34||

lines.punjabi: ਦੁਰਮਿਤ  ਿਸਉ ਨਾਨਕ  ਫਿਧਓ  ਰਾਿਖ  ਲੇਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ  ॥੩੪॥
lines.english: Childhood, youth and old age - know these as the three stages of life.
lines.transliteration: baal ju-aanee ar biraDh fun t een avasthaa jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਬਾਲ  ਜੁਆਨੀ  ਅਰੁ ਿਬਰਿਧ  ਫੁਿਨ ਤੀਿਨ  ਅਵਸਥਾ  ਜਾਿਨ  ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, without meditating on the Lord, everything is useless; you mustappreciate this. ||35||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak har bhajan bin birthaa sabh  hee maan. ||35||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜਨ  ਿਬਨੁ ਿਬਰਥਾ  ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.english: You have not done what you should have done; you are entangled in the web ofgreed.
lines.transliteration: karno hut o so naa kee-o pari-o lobh  kai fanDh .

lines.punjabi: ਕਰਣੋ  ਹੁਤੋ ਸੁ ਨਾ ਕੀਓ  ਪਿਰਓ  ਲੋਭ ਕੈ ਫੰਧ ॥
lines.english: Nanak, your time is past and gone; why are you crying now, you blind fool? ||36||
lines.transliteration: naanak sami-o ram ga-i-o ab ki-o rovat anDh . ||36||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਿਮਓ  ਰਿਮ ਗਇਓ  ਅਬ ਿਕਉ  ਰੋਵਤ  ਅੰਧ ॥੩੬॥
lines.english: The mind is absorbed in Maya - it cannot escape it, my friend.
lines.transliteration: man maa-i-aa mai ram rahi-o niksat naahin meet .

lines.punjabi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ  ਮੈ ਰਿਮ ਰਿਹਓ  ਿਨਕਸਤ  ਨਾਿਹਨ  ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Nanak, it is like a picture painted on the wall - it cannot leave it. ||37||
lines.transliteration: naanak moorat chit ar ji-o chh aadit naahin bh eet. ||37||

lines.english: The man wishes for something, but something different happens.
lines.transliteration: nar chaahat kachh  a-or a-urai kee a-urai bh a-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਨਰ ਚਾਹਤ  ਕਛੁ ਅਉਰ  ਅਉਰੈ  ਕੀ ਅਉਰੈ  ਭਈ ॥
lines.english: He plots to deceive others, O Nanak, but he places the noose around his own neck instead. ||38||
lines.transliteration: chitvat  rahi-o th aga-ur naanak faasee gal paree. ||38||

lines.punjabi: ਿਚਤਵਤ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਠਗਉਰ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਫਾਸੀ  ਗਿਲ ਪਰੀ ॥੩੮॥
lines.english: People make all sorts of efforts to find peace and pleasure, but no one tries to earnpain.
lines.transliteration: jatan bahut  sukh  kay kee-ay d ukh ko kee-o na ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਜਤਨ  ਬਹੁਤ ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਦੁਖ ਕੋ ਕੀਓ  ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, listen, mind: whatever pleases God comes to pass. ||39||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak sun ray manaa har bhaavai so ho-ay. ||39||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸੁਿਨ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਹਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੯॥
lines.english: The world wanders around begging, but the Lord is the Giver of all.
lines.transliteration: jagat bh ikhaaree firat  hai sabh  ko daataa raam.

lines.punjabi: ਜਗਤੁ  ਿਭਖਾਰੀ  ਿਫਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ  ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance on Him, and all your works will be successful.||40||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak man simar tih pooran hoveh kaam. ||40||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਨ ਿਸਮਰੁ ਿਤਹ ਪੂਰਨ  ਹੋਵਿਹ  ਕਾਮ ॥੪੦॥
lines.english: Why do you take such false pride in yourself? You must know that the world is just adream.
lines.transliteration: jhooth ai maan kahaa karai jag supnay ji-o jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਝੂਠੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੇ  ਿਜਉ  ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: None of this is yours; Nanak proclaims this truth. ||41||
lines.transliteration: in mai kachh t ayro nahee naanak kahi-o bakh aan. ||41||

lines.punjabi: ਇਨ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਕਿਹਓ  ਬਖਾਿਨ  ॥੪੧॥
lines.english: You are so proud of your body; it shall perish in an instant, my friend.
lines.transliteration: garab karat hai d ayh ko binsai chh in mai meet .

lines.punjabi: ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤੁ  ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਕੋ ਿਬਨਸੈ  ਿਛਨ ਮੈ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: That mortal who chants the Praises of the Lord, O Nanak, conquers the world. ||42||
lines.transliteration: jihi paraanee har jas kahi-o naanak tihi jag jeet . ||42||

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਿਹ  ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਹਿਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਹਓ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਤਿਹ  ਜਗੁ ਜੀਿਤ  ॥੪੨॥
lines.english: That person, who meditates in remembrance on the Lord in his heart, is liberated - know this well.
lines.transliteration: jih ghat simran raam ko so nar mukt aa jaan.

lines.punjabi: ਿਜਹ ਘਿਟ  ਿਸਮਰਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ  ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: There is no difference between that person and the Lord: O Nanak, accept this as theTruth. ||43||
lines.transliteration: tihi nar har ant ar nahee naanak saachee maan. ||43||

lines.punjabi: ਿਤਿਹ  ਨਰ ਹਿਰ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਾਚੀ  ਮਾਨੁ ॥੪੩॥
lines.english: That person, who does not feel devotion to God in his mind
lines.transliteration: ayk bhagat  bhagvaan jih paraanee kai naahi man.

lines.punjabi: ਏਕ ਭਗਿਤ  ਭਗਵਾਨ  ਿਜਹ ਪਰ੍ਾਨੀ  ਕੈ ਨਾਿਹ  ਮਿਨ ॥
lines.english: - O Nanak, know that his body is like that of a pig, or a dog. ||44||
lines.transliteration: jaisay sookar su-aan naanak maano taahi t an. ||44||

lines.punjabi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਕਰ  ਸੁਆਨ  ਨਾਨਕ  ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਿਹ  ਤਨੁ ॥੪੪॥
lines.english: A dog never abandons the home of his master.
lines.transliteration: su-aamee ko garihu ji-o sadaa su-aan t ajat nahee nit .

lines.punjabi: ਸੁਆਮੀ  ਕੋ ਿਗਰ੍ਹੁ ਿਜਉ  ਸਦਾ ਸੁਆਨ  ਤਜਤ  ਨਹੀ ਿਨਤ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, in just the same way, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord, single-mindedly,with one-pointed consciousness. ||45||
lines.transliteration: naanak ih biDh har bh aja-o ik man hu-ay ik chit . ||45||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹ ਿਬਿਧ  ਹਿਰ ਭਜਉ  ਇਕ ਮਿਨ ਹੁਇ ਇਕ ਿਚਿਤ ॥੪੫॥
lines.english: Those who make pilgrimages to sacred shrines, observe ritualistic fasts and makedonations to charity while still taking pride in their minds
lines.transliteration: tirath barat  ar daan kar man mai Dh arai gumaan.

lines.punjabi: ਤੀਰਥ  ਬਰਤ  ਅਰੁ ਦਾਨ  ਕਿਰ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਧਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.english: - O Nanak, their actions are useless, like the elephant, who takes a bath, and then rolls in the dust. ||46||
lines.transliteration: naanak nihfal jaat t ih ji-o kunchar isnaan. ||46||

lines.english: The head shakes, the feet stagger, and the eyes become dull and weak.
lines.transliteration: sir kampi-o pag dagmagay nain jot t ay heen.

lines.punjabi: ਿਸਰੁ ਕੰਿਪਓ  ਪਗ ਡਗਮਗੇ  ਨੈਨ ਜੋਿਤ  ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, this is your condition. And even now, you have not savored the sublime essence of the Lord. ||47|| pMnw 1429
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ih biDh bh a-ee t a-oo na har ras leen. ||47||

lines.english: I had looked upon the world as my own, but no one belongs to anyone else.
lines.transliteration: nij kar daykh i-o jagat  mai ko kaahoo ko naahi.

lines.punjabi: ਿਨਜ ਕਿਰ ਦੇਿਖਓ  ਜਗਤੁ  ਮੈ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਿਹ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, only devotional worship of the Lord is permanent; enshrine this in your mind. ||48||
lines.transliteration: naanak thir har bhagat  hai tih raakh o man maahi. ||48||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਥਰੁ ਹਿਰ ਭਗਿਤ  ਹੈ ਿਤਹ ਰਾਖੋ ਮਨ ਮਾਿਹ ॥੪੮॥
lines.english: The world and its affairs are totally false; know this well, my friend.
lines.transliteration: jag rachnaa sabh jh ooth hai jaan layho ray meet .

lines.punjabi: ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ  ਸਭ ਝੂਠ ਹੈ ਜਾਿਨ  ਲੇਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, it is like a wall of sand; it shall not endure. ||49||
lines.transliteration: kahi naanak thir naa rahai ji-o baaloo kee bheet . ||49||

lines.punjabi: ਕਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਥਰੁ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਿਜਉ ਬਾਲੂ  ਕੀ ਭੀਿਤ  ॥੪੯॥
lines.english: Raam Chand passed away, as did Raawan, even though he had lots of relatives.
lines.transliteration: raam ga-i-o raavan ga-i-o jaa ka-o baho parvaar.

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮੁ ਗਇਓ  ਰਾਵਨੁ ਗਇਓ  ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, nothing lasts forever; the world is like a dream. ||50||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak thir kachh nahee supnay ji-o sansaar. ||50||

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਥਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਪਨੇ  ਿਜਉ  ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੫੦॥
lines.english: People become anxious, when something unexpected happens.
lines.transliteration: chintaa t aa kee keejee-ai jo anhonee ho-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਿਚੰਤਾ  ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ  ਜੋ ਅਨਹੋਨੀ  ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.english: This is the way of the world, O Nanak; nothing is stable or permanent. ||51||
lines.transliteration: ih maarag sansaar ko naanak thir nahee ko-ay. ||51||

lines.punjabi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ  ਸੰਸਾਰ  ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ  ਿਥਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
lines.english: Whatever has been created shall be destroyed; everyone shall perish, today ortomorrow.
lines.transliteration: jo upji-o so binas hai paro aaj kai kaal.

lines.punjabi: ਜੋ ਉਪਿਜਓ ਸੋ ਿਬਨਿਸ  ਹੈ ਪਰੋ ਆਜੁ  ਕੈ ਕਾਿਲ  ॥
lines.english: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and give up all other entanglements.||52|| dohrw ] (1429-5) dohraa. Dohraa:
lines.transliteration: naanak har gun gaa-ay lay chhaad sagal janjaal. ||52||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਹਿਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ  ਲੇ ਛਾਿਡ  ਸਗਲ  ਜੰਜਾਲ  ॥੫੨॥
lines.english: My strength is exhausted, and I am in bondage; I cannot do anything at all.
lines.transliteration: bal chhutki-o banDh an paray kachh oo na hot  upaa-ay.

lines.english: Says Nanak, now, the Lord is my Support; He will help me, as He did the elephant.||53||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ab ot har gaj ji-o hohu sahaa-ay. ||53||

lines.punjabi: ਬਲੁ ਛੁਟਿਕਓ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਪਰੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My strength has been restored, and my bonds have been broken; now, I can doeverything.
lines.transliteration: bal ho-aa banDhan chh utay sabh  kichh  hot upaa-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਅਬ ਓਟ ਹਿਰ ਗਜ ਿਜਉ  ਹੋਹੁ ਸਹਾਇ  ॥੫੩॥
lines.english: Nanak: everything is in Your hands, Lord; You are my Helper and Support. ||54||
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh  tumrai haath mai t um hee hot  sahaa-ay. ||54||

lines.punjabi: ਬਲੁ ਹੋਆ  ਬੰਧਨ  ਛੁਟੇ ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਹੋਤ ਉਪਾਇ  ॥
lines.english: My associates and companions have all deserted me; no one remains with me.
lines.transliteration: sang sakhaa sabh  taj ga-ay ko-oo na nib-hi-o saath.

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਨਕ  ਸਭੁ ਿਕਛੁ  ਤੁਮਰੈ  ਹਾਥ ਮੈ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਇ  ॥੫੪॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, in this tragedy, the Lord alone is my Support. ||55||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ih bipat mai tayk ayk ragh unaath. ||55||

lines.punjabi: ਸੰਗ ਸਖਾ ਸਿਭ ਤਿਜ  ਗਏ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਿਨਬਿਹਓ  ਸਾਿਥ  ॥
lines.english: The Naam remains; the Holy Saints remain; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, remains.
lines.transliteration: naam rahi-o saaDhoo rahi-o rahi-o gur gobind .

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹ ਿਬਪਿਤ  ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ॥੫੫॥
lines.english: Says Nanak, how rare are those who chant the Guru's Mantra in this world. ||56||
lines.transliteration: kaho naanak ih jagat mai kin japi-o gur mant . ||56||

lines.punjabi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਹਓ  ਸਾਧੂ ਰਿਹਓ  ਰਿਹਓ  ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਿਬੰਦੁ  ॥
lines.english: I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart; there is nothing equal to it.
lines.transliteration: raam naam ur mai gahi-o jaa kai sam nahee ko-ay.

lines.punjabi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਇਹ ਜਗਤ  ਮੈ ਿਕਨ ਜਿਪਓ  ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੫੬॥
lines.english: Meditating in remembrance on it, my troubles are taken away; I have received theBlessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||57||1|| muMdwvxI mhlw 5 ] (1429-11) mundaavan ee mehlaa 5. Mundaavanee, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: jih simrat sankat mitai d aras t uhaaro ho-ay. ||57||1||

lines.punjabi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਮੈ ਗਿਹਓ  ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.english: Upon this Plate, three things have been placed: Truth, Contentment andContemplation.
lines.transliteration: thaal vich tinn vast oo pa-ee-o sat  santokh veechaaro.

lines.english: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of our Lord and Master, has been placed upon it as well; it is the Support of all.
lines.transliteration: amrit naam th aakur kaa pa-i-o jis kaa sabh as aDh aaro.

lines.english: One who eats it and enjoys it shall be saved.
lines.transliteration: jay ko khaavai jay ko bh unchai t is kaa ho-ay uDh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਥਾਲ  ਿਵਿਚ  ਿਤੰਿਨ  ਵਸਤੂ  ਪਈਓ  ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ  ਵੀਚਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: This thing can never be forsaken; keep this always and forever in your mind.
lines.transliteration: ayh vasat t ajee nah jaa-ee nit  nit rakh ur Dh aaro.

lines.punjabi: ਅੰਿਮਰ੍ਤ  ਨਾਮੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ  ਕਾ ਪਇਓ  ਿਜਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: The dark world-ocean is crossed over, by grasping the Feet of the Lord; O Nanak, it isall the extension of God. ||1|| slok mhlw 5 ] (1429-14) salok mehlaa 5. Shalok, Fifth Mehl:
lines.transliteration: tam sansaar charan lag t aree-ai sabh  naanak barahm pasaaro. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਖਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਿਤਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੋ  ॥
lines.english: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only You can make meworthy.
lines.transliteration: tayraa keet aa jaat o naahee maino jog keet o-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਏਹ ਵਸਤੁ  ਤਜੀ  ਨਹ ਜਾਈ  ਿਨਤ  ਿਨਤ  ਰਖੁ ਉਿਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.english: I am unworthy - I have no worth or virtues at all. You have taken pity on me.
lines.transliteration: mai nirguni-aaray ko gun  naahee aapay t aras pa-i-o-ee.

lines.punjabi: ਤਮ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਚਰਨ  ਲਿਗ  ਤਰੀਐ  ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ  ਬਰ੍ਹਮ  ਪਸਾਰੋ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: You took pity on me, and blessed me with Your Mercy, and I have met the True Guru,my Friend.
lines.transliteration: taras pa-i-aa mihraamat  ho-ee sat gur sajan  mili-aa.

lines.english: O Nanak, if I am blessed with the Naam, I live, and my body and mind blossom forth.||1|| <> siqgur pRswid (1429-18) ik-oNkaar satgur parsaad One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: rwg mwlw ] (1429-19) raag maalaa. Raag Maalaa:
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai taaN jeevaaN tan man theevai hari-aa. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ  ਜਾਤੋ  ਨਾਹੀ  ਮੈਨੋ ਜੋਗੁ ਕੀਤੋਈ  ॥
lines.english: Each Raga has five wives,
lines.transliteration: raag ayk sang panch barangan.

lines.punjabi: ਮੈ ਿਨਰਗੁਿਣਆਰੇ  ਕੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ  ਆਪੇ  ਤਰਸੁ  ਪਇਓਈ  ॥
lines.transliteration: sang alaapeh aath-o nand an. and eight sons, who emit distinctive notes.

lines.english: In the first place is Raag Bhairao. pMnw 1430
lines.transliteration: paratham raag bhairo vai karhee.

lines.english: It is accompanied by the voices of its five Raaginis:
lines.transliteration: panch raagnee sang uchrahee.

lines.english: First come Bhairavee, and Bilaavalee;
lines.transliteration: paratham bhairvee bilaavalee.
punni-aakee gaavahi banglee. then the songs of Punni-aakee and Bangalee;
pun aslaykhee kee bh a-ee baaree. and then Asalaykhee.

lines.english: These are the five consorts of Bhairao.
lines.transliteration: ay bhairo kee paacha-o naaree.

lines.english: The sounds of Pancham, Harakh and Disaakh;
lines.transliteration: pancham harakh d isaakh  sunaaveh.
bangaalam maDh maaDh av gaavahi. ||1|| the songs of Bangaalam, Madh and Maadhav. ||1||

lines.english: Lalat and Bilaaval - each gives out its own melody.
lines.transliteration: lalat bilaaval gaavhee apunee apunee bh aaNt.
asat putar bh airav kay gaavahi gaa-in paat ar. ||1|| when these eight sons of Bhairao are sung by accomplished musicians. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਟ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਭੈਰਵ  ਕੇ ਗਾਵਿਹ ਗਾਇਨ  ਪਾਤਰ੍ ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the second family is Maalakausak,
lines.transliteration: dutee-aa maalka-usak aalaapeh.
sang raagnee paacha-o thaapeh. who brings his five Raaginis:

lines.english: Gondakaree and Dayv Gandhaaree,
lines.transliteration: goNdkaree ar dayvganDh aaree.
ganDhaaree seehut ee uchaaree. the voices of Gandhaaree and Seehutee,

lines.english: Dhanaasree ay paacha-o gaa-ee. and the fifth song of Dhanaasaree.
This chain of Maalakausak brings along :
lines.transliteration: maal raag ka-usak sang laa-ee.

lines.english: Maaroo, Masta-ang and Mayvaaraa,
lines.transliteration: maaroo masatang mayvaaraa.

lines.english: Prabal, Chandakausak,
lines.transliteration: parabalchand ka-usak ubhaaraa.

lines.english: Khau, Khat and Bauraanad singing.
lines.transliteration: kha-ukh at a-o bh a-uraanad  gaa-ay.

lines.english: These are the eight sons of Maalakausak. ||1||
lines.transliteration: asat maalka-usak sang laa-ay. ||1||

lines.english: Then comes Hindol with his five wives and eight sons;
lines.transliteration: pun aa-i-a-o hindol panch naar sang asat sut.

lines.punjabi: ਪੁਿਨ ਆਇਅਉ  ਿਹੰਡੋਲੁ  ਪੰਚ ਨਾਿਰ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਅਸਟ  ਸੁਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: utheh t aan kalol gaa-in t aar milaavahee. ||1|| it rises in waves when the sweet-voiced chorus sings. ||1||

lines.english: There come Taylangee and Darvakaree;
lines.transliteration: taylangee d ayvkaree aa-ee.

lines.english: Basantee and Sandoor follow;
lines.transliteration: basantee sand oor suhaa-ee.
saras aheeree lai bhaarjaa. then Aheeree, the finest of women.

lines.english: These five wives come together.
lines.transliteration: sang laa-ee paaNcha-o aarjaa.

lines.english: The sons: Surmaanand and Bhaaskar come,
lines.transliteration: surmaanand bh aaskar aa-ay.

lines.english: Chandrabinb and Mangalan follow.
lines.transliteration: chandarbimb manglan suhaa-ay.

lines.english: Sarasbaan and Binodaa then come,
lines.transliteration: sarasbaan a-o aahi binodaa.
gaavahi saras basant kamod aa. and the thrilling songs of Basant and Kamodaa.

lines.english: These are the eight sons I have listed.
lines.transliteration: asat putar mai kahay savaaree.

lines.english: Then comes the turn of Deepak. ||1||
lines.transliteration: pun aa-ee deepak kee baaree. ||1||

lines.english: Kachhaylee, Patamanjaree and Todee are sung;
lines.transliteration: kachhaylee patmanjree todee kahee alaap.

lines.english: Kaamodee and Goojaree accompany Deepak. ||1||
lines.transliteration: kaamodee a-o goojree sang d eepak kay thaap. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਕਾਮੋਦੀ  ਅਉ ਗੂਜਰੀ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਦੀਪਕ  ਕੇ ਥਾਿਪ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: Kaalankaa, Kuntal and Raamaa,
lines.transliteration: kaalankaa kuntal a-o raamaa.

lines.english: Kamalakusam and Champak are their names;
lines.transliteration: kamalkusam champak kay naamaa.

lines.english: Gauraa, Kaanaraa and Kaylaanaa;
lines.transliteration: ga-uraa a-o kaanraa kal-yaanaa.
asat putar d eepak kay jaanaa. ||1|| these are the eight sons of Deepak. ||1||

lines.english: All join together and sing Siree Raag,
lines.transliteration: sabh mil sireeraag vai gaavahi.
paaNcha-o sang barangan laaveh. which is accompanied by its five wives.:

lines.english: Bairaaree and Karnaatee,
lines.transliteration: bairaaree karnaatee Dharee.
gavree gaaveh aasaavaree. the songs of Gawree and Aasaavaree;
tih paachh ai sinDh vee alaapee. then follows Sindhavee.

lines.english: These are the five wives of Siree Raag. ||1||
lines.transliteration: sireeraag si-o paaNcha-o thaapee. ||1||

lines.english: Saaloo, Saarang, Saagaraa, Gond and Gambheer
lines.transliteration: saaloo saarag saagraa a-or gond gambheer.

lines.punjabi: ਸਾਲੂ ਸਾਰਗ  ਸਾਗਰਾ  ਅਉਰ  ਗੋਂਡ ਗੰਭੀਰ  ॥
lines.transliteration: asat putar sareeraag kay gund kumbh  hameer. ||1|| - the eight sons of Siree Raag include Gund, Kumb and Hameer. ||1||

lines.punjabi: ਅਸਟ  ਪੁਤਰ੍ ਸਰ੍ੀਰਾਗ  ਕੇ ਗੁੰਡ ਕੁੰਭ ਹਮੀਰ  ॥੧॥
lines.english: In the sixth place, Maygh Raag is sung,
lines.transliteration: khastam maygh  raag vai gaavahi.
paaNcha-o sang barangan laaveh. with its five wives in accompaniment:

lines.english: Sorat'h, Gond, and the melody of Malaaree;
lines.transliteration: sorath gond malaaree Dh unee.
pun gaavahi aasaa gun gunee. then the harmonies of Aasaa are sung.

lines.english: And finally comes the high tone Soohau.
lines.transliteration: oochai sur sooha-o pun keenee.

lines.english: These are the five with Maygh Raag. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maygh raag si-o paaNcha-o cheenee. ||1||

lines.english: Bairaadhar, Gajadhar, Kaydaaraa,
lines.transliteration: bairaaDhar gajDh ar kayd aaraa.

lines.english: Jabaleedhar, Nat and Jaladhaaraa.
lines.transliteration: jableeDhar nat a-o jalDh aaraa.

lines.english: Then come the songs of Shankar and Shi-aamaa.
lines.transliteration: pun gaavahi sankar a-o si-aamaa.

lines.english: These are the names of the sons of Maygh Raag. ||1||
lines.transliteration: maygh raag put ran kay naamaa. ||1||

lines.english: So all together, they sing the six Raagas and the thirty Raaginis,
lines.transliteration: khasat raag un gaa-ay sang raagnee t ees.

lines.punjabi: ਖਸਟ  ਰਾਗ ਉਿਨ  ਗਾਏ  ਸੰਿਗ  ਰਾਗਨੀ  ਤੀਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhai put ar raagann kay ath aarah d as bees. ||1||1|| and all the forty-eight sons of the Raagas. ||1||1||
